abandon.example: She danced with wild abandon at the wedding reception.  她在婚宴上尽情忘我地跳舞。

unconstraint.example: The children played with cheerful unconstraint in the empty field.  孩子们在空地上无拘无束地欢快玩耍。

uninhibitedness.example: Her uninhibitedness on stage charmed the entire audience.  她在台上的无拘无束让全场观众着迷。

unrestraint.example: He spent money with an unrestraint that alarmed his family.  他花钱毫无节制，令家人担忧。

salvage.example: Divers tried to salvage cargo from the sunken ship.  潜水员试图从沉船中打捞货物。

abase.example: He would not abase himself by begging for the job.  他不愿低声下气地乞求这份工作。

debauch.example: Critics claimed the film would debauch impressionable young viewers.  批评者称这部电影会腐蚀易受影响的年轻观众。

degrade.example: Such insulting jokes degrade everyone who repeats them.  这类侮辱性的笑话贬低了每个转述它们的人。

profane.example: Vandals profaned the temple by scrawling slogans on its walls.  破坏者在庙墙上乱涂标语，亵渎了圣殿。

vitiate.example: A single false statement can vitiate the entire contract.  一句虚假陈述就能使整份合同失效。

discredit.example: The lawyer tried to discredit the witness with old records.  律师试图用旧档案质疑证人的可信度。

foul.example: The scandal fouled the good name he had spent decades building.  这桩丑闻玷污了他数十年积累的好名声。

smirch.example: The rumor smirched the reputation he had built over thirty years.  谣言玷污了他三十年建立起来的名誉。

take down.example: The reporter tried to take him down in front of the whole crowd.  记者试图在众人面前贬低他。

elevate.example: Good literature can elevate the mind and refine one's taste.  优秀的文学能提升心智、陶冶品味。

ennoble.example: Suffering, he believed, could ennoble an ordinary life.  他相信苦难能使平凡的人生变得高贵。

uplift.example: Her cheerful letters uplifted him during the long illness.  她愉快的信在他久病期间给了他鼓舞。

aggrandize.example: The mayor used the crisis to aggrandize his own power.  市长利用危机扩大自己的权力。

canonize.example: The church voted to canonize the nun a century after her death.  教会在这位修女去世百年后决定将她封为圣徒。

deify.example: The regime tried to deify its founder in every textbook.  该政权试图在每本教科书里神化其创始人。

exalt.example: Critics exalt her early novels as masterpieces of the era.  评论家将她早期的小说赞为那个时代的杰作。

abash.example: He looked abashed when everyone applauded his clumsy speech.  当大家为他笨拙的演讲鼓掌时，他显得很窘。

discomfit.example: The blunt question visibly discomfited the confident speaker.  这个直率的问题明显让自信的演讲者局促不安。

disconcert.example: His long silences disconcerted everyone at the table.  他长时间的沉默让餐桌上所有人都不安。

discountenance.example: The committee discountenanced any further spending on the project.  委员会不赞成该项目再有任何支出。

faze.example: The huge crowd did not faze the young pianist at all.  庞大的观众丝毫没让这位年轻钢琴家慌乱。

fluster.example: Unexpected questions always fluster him during interviews.  面试中意外的问题总让他慌乱。

nonplus.example: Her strange reply left the whole panel nonplussed.  她奇怪的回答让整个评审团都困惑不解。

mortify.example: She was mortified to find her mistake printed in the report.  发现自己的错误印在报告里，她羞愧难当。

embolden.example: Early success emboldened her to ask for a promotion.  初期的成功让她有胆量要求升职。

abate.example: The fever finally abated after two days of medication.  服药两天后，烧终于退了。

moderate.example: He agreed to moderate his tone during the debate.  他同意在辩论中缓和语气。

recede.example: The floodwaters slowly receded from the village streets.  洪水缓缓从村庄的街道退去。

subside.example: The noise subsided as soon as the teacher walked in.  老师一进来，喧闹声就平息了。

remit.example: The judge agreed to remit part of the heavy fine.  法官同意减免部分高额罚款。

wane.example: Public interest in the scandal waned within a month.  公众对这桩丑闻的兴趣一个月内就减退了。

die.example: The applause slowly died away as the lights dimmed.  灯光变暗，掌声渐渐消失。

de-escalate.example: Both sides agreed to de-escalate the conflict before it turned violent.  双方同意在冲突转为暴力之前缓和局势。

deplete.example: The long drought depleted the town's water reserves.  长期干旱耗尽了小镇的储水。

downscale.example: The company decided to downscale its overseas operations.  公司决定缩减海外业务规模。

dwindle.example: Their savings dwindled during the months of unemployment.  失业的几个月里他们的积蓄逐渐减少。

ratchet.example: The government hopes to ratchet down tensions with its neighbor.  政府希望逐步缓和与邻国的紧张关系。

intensify.example: The rain intensified just as we reached the summit.  我们刚到山顶，雨就更大了。

augment.example: She augments her salary by teaching evening classes.  她通过教夜校课程增加收入。

promote.example: The campaign aims to promote healthy eating among children.  该活动旨在促进儿童健康饮食。

abbreviate.example: You may abbreviate 'Doctor' to 'Dr.' on the envelope.  信封上可以把 Doctor 缩写为 Dr.。

abridge.example: The publisher abridged the long novel for younger readers.  出版商为年轻读者删节了这部长篇小说。

curtail.example: Bad weather curtailed our trip by three days.  坏天气使我们的旅程缩短了三天。

cut back.example: We had to cut back on spending after the pay cut.  减薪后我们不得不削减开支。

syncopate.cn: 省略词中音节；使切分节奏
syncopate.example: Jazz players often syncopate the beat to create tension.  爵士乐手常把节拍切分以制造张力。

truncate.example: The editor truncated the article to fit the page.  编辑把文章截短以适应版面。

extend.example: They agreed to extend the deadline by two weeks.  他们同意把截止日期延长两周。

protract.example: Endless objections protracted the meeting into the evening.  无休止的反对把会议拖到了晚上。

elongate.example: Tall mirrors elongate the room and make it look larger.  高镜子拉长了房间，使它显得更大。

lengthen.example: The days lengthen noticeably after the spring equinox.  春分之后白天明显变长。

prolong.example: New treatments can prolong life by several years.  新疗法能把生命延长数年。

abdicate.example: The king chose to abdicate in favor of his younger brother.  国王选择退位让给他的弟弟。

cede.example: The defeated nation was forced to cede two provinces.  战败国被迫割让两个省。

relinquish.example: She refused to relinquish control of the family business.  她拒绝放弃对家族企业的控制权。

renounce.example: He renounced his claim to the inheritance in writing.  他以书面形式放弃了继承权。

resign.example: The minister resigned from office after the scandal broke.  丑闻爆发后，那位部长辞职了。

step down.example: He will step down as chairman at the end of the year.  他将于年底辞去董事长职务。

constitute.example: The board was properly constituted under the new rules.  依据新规则，董事会得以正式组成。

assume.example: She will assume office as director next Monday.  她将于下周一就任主任。

usurp.example: The general usurped power after the president fled.  总统逃走后，将军篡夺了权力。

aberrant.example: Doctors were puzzled by the patient's aberrant test results.  医生对病人异常的化验结果感到困惑。

abnormal.example: The scan showed nothing abnormal in her lungs.  扫描显示她的肺部没有异常。

anomalous.example: The team discarded a few anomalous readings from the data.  团队剔除了数据中几个异常读数。

peculiar.example: There was a peculiar smell coming from the basement.  地下室传来一股奇怪的味道。

singular.example: He showed singular courage during the long rescue.  他在漫长的营救中表现出非凡的勇气。

unwonted.example: An unwonted silence fell over the noisy classroom.  嘈杂的教室里出现了不寻常的安静。

uncustomary.example: He spoke with uncustomary frankness about his failures.  他一反常态地坦率谈起自己的失败。

normal.example: Everything returned to normal after the power was restored.  供电恢复后一切都回归正常。

natural.example: It is natural to feel nervous before a big exam.  大考前紧张是很自然的。

regular.example: He goes swimming on a regular basis every week.  他每周都定期去游泳。

standard.example: Checking IDs is standard procedure at the entrance.  在入口查验证件是标准流程。

typical.example: This building is a typical example of the local style.  这栋建筑是当地风格的典型代表。

c m y k.example: Convert the file to C M Y K before sending it to the printer.  送印前请把文件转换为四色模式。

abet.example: He was charged with aiding and abetting the robbery.  他被控协助并教唆抢劫。

aid.example: Neighbors came to her aid within minutes of the fire.  火灾发生几分钟内邻居们就来帮忙。

assist.example: Two nurses assisted the surgeon during the operation.  两名护士在手术中协助医生。

back.example: Several investors agreed to back her new company.  几位投资人同意资助她的新公司。

support.example: Most members voted to support the new proposal.  大多数成员投票支持这项新提案。

prop.example: Foreign loans propped up the failing economy for years.  外国贷款支撑了衰败的经济多年。

stymie.example: Missing records stymied the investigation for months.  档案缺失使调查停滞了数月。

frustrate.example: Heavy snow frustrated our plans to drive home.  大雪打乱了我们开车回家的计划。

obstruct.example: A fallen tree obstructed the only road out of town.  一棵倒下的树堵住了唯一的出城道路。

thwart.example: Alert guards thwarted the escape attempt.  警觉的守卫挫败了这次越狱企图。

impede.example: Thick fog impeded the rescue team's progress.  浓雾阻碍了救援队的前进。

forestall.example: She answered early to forestall further criticism.  她提前作答以预先阻止更多批评。

hinder.example: Poor lighting hindered the search for survivors.  照明不足妨碍了对生还者的搜寻。

abeyance.example: The project was held in abeyance until funding arrived.  项目被搁置，直到资金到位。

doldrums.example: The housing market has been in the doldrums all year.  房地产市场整年都处于低迷状态。

quiescence.example: The volcano entered a long period of quiescence.  这座火山进入了长期的静止期。

moratorium.example: The council imposed a moratorium on new building permits.  议会暂停发放新的建筑许可。

latency.example: The virus can remain in latency for many years.  这种病毒可以潜伏多年。

dormancy.example: Seeds emerge from dormancy when the soil warms.  土壤变暖时种子便结束休眠。

suspension.example: The strike led to a suspension of all train services.  罢工导致所有列车服务暂停。

cold storage.example: The proposal was put in cold storage after the election.  选举后该提案被搁置一旁。

deep freeze.example: Talks between the two sides remain in a deep freeze.  双方的谈判仍处于冻结状态。

continuance.example: Everyone hoped for the continuance of the fragile ceasefire.  所有人都希望脆弱的停火能够持续。

fulfillment.example: The treaty marked the fulfillment of years of patient talks.  该条约标志着多年耐心谈判的实现。

abhor.example: She abhors any form of cruelty to animals.  她极度厌恶任何形式的虐待动物行为。

abominate.example: He abominated the hypocrisy he saw all around him.  他痛恨周围随处可见的虚伪。

despise.example: She despised him for abandoning his closest friends.  她鄙视他抛弃至交的行为。

detest.example: I detest waiting in long lines on hot days.  我讨厌在炎热的日子里排长队。

execrate.example: Historians still execrate the tyrant for his cruelty.  史学家仍因其残暴而痛斥这个暴君。

loathe.example: He loathes the smell of boiled cabbage.  他讨厌煮卷心菜的味道。

greatly admire.example: I greatly admire the way she handled the crisis.  我非常钦佩她处理危机的方式。

abiding.example: She has an abiding love for classical music.  她对古典音乐有着持久的热爱。

ageless.example: Her ageless beauty surprised everyone at the reunion.  她不显岁月的美貌让聚会上的人都惊讶。

enduring.example: Their enduring friendship survived decades of separation.  他们持久的友谊经历了数十年的分离。

eternal.example: The poem promises the beloved eternal youth.  这首诗许诺爱人永恒的青春。

everlasting.example: They vowed everlasting loyalty to each other.  他们发誓永远彼此忠诚。

perennial.example: Traffic is a perennial problem in this old city.  交通是这座老城长期存在的问题。

perpetual.example: He lives in perpetual fear of losing his job.  他一直生活在失业的恐惧中。

timeless.cn: 永恒的，不受时间影响的
timeless.example: The dress has a timeless elegance that never dates.  这条裙子有一种永不过时的优雅。

evanescent.example: The evanescent glow of fireflies lit the summer path.  萤火虫短暂的微光照亮了夏夜小径。

ephemeral.example: Internet fame is often ephemeral and quickly forgotten.  网络名声往往短暂，很快被遗忘。

abject.example: Millions of people still live in abject poverty.  数百万人仍生活在极度贫困中。

base.example: He acted from base motives of greed and envy.  他出于贪婪和嫉妒的卑劣动机行事。

humble.cn: 卑微的，地位低下的；谦逊的
humble.example: He rose from humble origins to lead the company.  他出身卑微，最终领导了这家公司。

menial.example: She took menial jobs to pay for night school.  她做低微的工作来支付夜校学费。

servile.example: His servile manner toward the boss annoyed everyone.  他对老板卑躬屈膝的态度让大家反感。

slavish.example: The design is a slavish imitation of an older model.  这个设计是对旧款的盲目模仿。

abjure.example: The group publicly abjured violence as a political tool.  该团体公开宣布放弃以暴力作为政治手段。

recant.example: Under pressure he agreed to recant his earlier statement.  在压力下他同意撤回先前的声明。

renege.example: The company reneged on its promise to raise wages.  公司背弃了加薪的承诺。

abnegate.example: The monk chose to abnegate all personal comforts.  这位僧人选择放弃一切个人享受。

forswear.example: He forswore gambling after losing all his savings.  输掉全部积蓄后他发誓戒赌。

repudiate.example: The author repudiated the views quoted in the article.  作者否认了文章中引用的观点。

keep.example: He always keeps his promises, however inconvenient they are.  无论多不方便，他总是守约。

affirm.example: The witness affirmed that she had seen the blue car.  证人确认她看见了那辆蓝色汽车。

espouse.example: She openly espoused the cause of prison reform.  她公开拥护监狱改革事业。

embrace.example: Young workers quickly embraced the new technology.  年轻员工迅速接受了这项新技术。

bow to.example: The government finally bowed to pressure and cancelled the new tax.  政府最终屈从于压力，取消了新税。

give in to.example: Don't give in to temptation and buy another pair of shoes.  别屈服于诱惑再买一双鞋。

submit to.example: He refused to submit to the will of the majority.  他拒绝服从多数人的意愿。

succumb to.example: After weeks of resistance she succumbed to their demands.  抵抗数周后，她屈服于他们的要求。

surrender to.example: The rebels finally surrendered to government forces.  叛军最终向政府军投降。

yield to.example: She would not yield to threats of any kind.  她不会屈服于任何形式的威胁。

unsay.example: Once the insult is spoken, you cannot unsay it.  侮辱一旦说出，就无法收回。

take back.example: I take back everything I said about your cooking.  我收回我说过的关于你厨艺的所有话。

reaffirm.example: The president reaffirmed his commitment to the peace process.  总统重申了他对和平进程的承诺。

esteem.example: Her colleagues esteem her for her honesty and courage.  同事们因她的诚实与勇气而敬重她。

love.example: I love walking along the river in the early morning.  我喜欢清晨沿着河边散步。

adore.example: The children adore their new puppy.  孩子们非常喜爱他们的新小狗。

aboveboard.example: The whole deal was entirely open and aboveboard.  整笔交易完全是光明正大的。

surreptitious.example: He took a surreptitious glance at his watch during the meeting.  会上他偷偷看了一眼手表。

underhanded.example: They won the contract through underhanded tactics.  他们靠不正当手段赢得了合同。

abrade.example: The rough rope abraded the sailor's palms.  粗糙的绳子磨伤了水手的手掌。

chafe.example: The stiff new boots chafed his heels until they bled.  硬邦邦的新靴子把他的脚跟磨出了血。

excoriate.example: Critics excoriated the film for its casual cruelty.  批评家严厉批评该片的随意残忍。

rasp.example: He rasped the wood smooth before painting it.  他把木头锉平后再上漆。

graze.example: She fell and grazed her knee on the gravel.  她摔倒了，膝盖在碎石上擦伤。

scuff.example: He scuffed the toes of his new shoes on the steps.  他在台阶上把新鞋头磨花了。

extend in length.example: The bridge was extended in length to reach the far bank.  这座桥被加长以到达对岸。

amplify.example: Could you amplify your last remark a little?  你能把最后那句话再详述一下吗？

abrogate.example: Parliament voted to abrogate the outdated law.  议会投票废除这项过时的法律。

disannul.example: The court moved to disannul the fraudulent agreement.  法院着手废除这份欺诈协议。

invalidate.example: A missing signature will invalidate the whole form.  缺少签名会使整张表格失效。

nullify.example: The judge nullified the election result.  法官宣布选举结果无效。

quash.example: The appeal court quashed his conviction last week.  上诉法院上周撤销了对他的定罪。

rescind.example: The company rescinded the job offer without explanation.  公司未加解释便撤回了聘用通知。

roll back.example: The new administration promised to roll back the tax cuts.  新政府承诺撤销这些减税措施。

strike down.example: The court decided to strike down the law as unconstitutional.  法院裁定该法律违宪而将其废除。

uphold.example: The appeals court chose to uphold the original ruling in full.  上诉法院决定完全维持原判。

institute.example: The school instituted a new dress code this term.  学校本学期制定了新的着装规定。

abscond.example: The treasurer absconded with thousands of dollars.  财务主管带着数千美元潜逃了。

flee.example: Thousands fled the city as the fighting spread.  战火蔓延时数千人逃离该市。

lam.example: The thief has been on the lam for two months.  这名窃贼已潜逃两个月。

run off.example: She ran off with her childhood sweetheart just before the wedding.  她在婚礼前和儿时的恋人私奔了。

break out.example: Two prisoners managed to break out of the jail last night.  两名囚犯昨晚成功越狱。

absolute.cn: 专制的；无限的；纯净不掺杂的；确凿的
absolute.example: The king held absolute power over his subjects.  国王对臣民拥有绝对权力。

arbitrary.cn: 专横的，独断专行的；随意的
arbitrary.example: The rules seemed completely arbitrary to the students.  这些规定在学生看来完全是随意的。

autocratic.example: His autocratic style alienated the entire staff.  他专断的作风疏远了全体员工。

despotic.example: The country suffered under a despotic regime for decades.  这个国家在专制政权下受苦数十年。

dictatorial.example: The coach's dictatorial manner made several players quit.  教练专横的态度让几名球员退出了。

monocratic.example: The constitution replaced monocratic rule with an elected assembly.  宪法用选举议会取代了独裁统治。

tyrannical.example: He was a tyrannical boss who trusted no one.  他是个不信任任何人的暴虐老板。

complete.example: The first attempt was a complete failure.  第一次尝试彻底失败了。

utter.example: What he said was utter nonsense from start to finish.  他说的从头到尾都是彻底的胡话。

deadly.example: She was deadly serious about quitting her job.  她对辞职的事完全是认真的。

downright.example: That suggestion is downright dangerous and should be dropped.  那个建议完全是危险的，应该放弃。

out-and-out.example: What he told the committee was an out-and-out lie.  他对委员会说的完全是弥天大谎。

plain.cn: 完全的，十足的；朴素的，清楚的
plain.example: Ignoring the warning was just plain stupid.  忽视警告纯粹是愚蠢。

refined.cn: 精炼的，纯净的；有教养的
refined.example: Refined sugar has been stripped of every impurity.  精制糖已去除了所有杂质。

unadulterated.example: Her face showed unadulterated delight at the news.  听到这消息她脸上是纯粹的喜悦。

unalloyed.example: The trip was an unalloyed pleasure from start to finish.  这次旅行从头到尾都是纯粹的享受。

undiluted.example: You should never drink this cough syrup undiluted.  你绝不该喝未稀释的止咳糖浆。

unmixed.example: Fame proved to be an unmixed curse for him.  名声对他来说是纯粹的祸事。

clear.example: The party won by a clear majority of votes.  该党以明显多数票获胜。

deciding.example: Cost was the deciding factor in our choice.  成本是我们选择的决定性因素。

decisive.example: Her testimony was decisive in the trial.  她的证词在审判中起了决定性作用。

definitive.cn: 确定的，不容置疑的；权威的
definitive.example: We still have no definitive answer from the committee.  我们仍未从委员会得到确定的答复。

qualified.cn: 有限制的，有保留的；合格的
qualified.example: The plan received only qualified approval from the board.  该计划仅获得董事会有保留的认可。

adulterated.example: Inspectors found adulterated milk on the shelves.  检查人员在货架上发现掺假牛奶。

alloyed.example: Pure gold is soft, so it is usually alloyed with copper.  纯金较软，所以通常掺铜制成合金。

diluted.example: The paint was too heavily diluted to cover the wall.  漆稀释得太厉害，盖不住墙面。

impure.example: The sample was impure and had to be discarded.  样本不纯，只能丢弃。

mixed.cn: 混合的，掺杂的；好坏交织的
mixed.example: I have mixed feelings about moving abroad.  对于出国我心情复杂。

inconclusive.example: The tests were inconclusive, so they ran them again.  检测没有定论，于是他们又做了一次。

indecisive.cn: 犹豫不决的；非决定性的
indecisive.example: He is too indecisive to lead the team.  他太犹豫不决，无法带领团队。

unclear.example: It is still unclear who made the final decision.  谁做的最终决定仍不清楚。

absolve.example: The report absolved the pilot of all blame.  报告免除了飞行员的全部责任。

acquit.example: The jury acquitted him of all charges.  陪审团宣判他所有罪名不成立。

exonerate.example: New evidence exonerated the wrongly jailed man.  新证据为这名被误判入狱者洗清了罪名。

vindicate.cn: 为…平反，为…辩护，使无罪；证明，证实
vindicate.example: The results vindicated her unusual approach.  结果证明了她那不寻常的方法是对的。

blame.example: Don't blame me for the broken window.  别把窗户破了怪在我头上。

criminate.example: His own letters criminated him at the trial.  他自己的信件在审判中给他定了罪。

incriminate.example: He refused to answer questions that might incriminate him.  他拒绝回答可能使自己入罪的问题。

abstain.example: Three members abstained from voting on the motion.  三名成员对该动议投了弃权票。

forgo.example: She agreed to forgo her bonus this year.  她同意放弃今年的奖金。

keep from.cn: 克制不做，避免；不让…知道
keep from.example: I could hardly keep from laughing at his hat.  我几乎忍不住对他的帽子笑出来。

refrain from.example: Please refrain from using your phone during the film.  观影期间请勿使用手机。

withhold.example: He was accused of withholding key information.  他被指控隐瞒关键信息。

abstemious.example: He led an abstemious life, eating little and drinking less.  他生活节制，吃得少喝得更少。

continent.cn: 自我节制的，禁欲的；大陆
continent.example: The monks were expected to be continent in all appetites.  僧侣们应在一切欲望上自我节制。

temperate.cn: （言行举止）有分寸的，有节制的
temperate.example: She gave a temperate reply to a very rude question.  面对无礼的问题她的回答很有分寸。

self-abnegating.example: Her self-abnegating care for others left no time for herself.  她克己地照顾他人，无暇顾及自己。

self-denying.example: His self-denying routine allowed no sweets at all.  他克己的作息完全不允许甜食。

indulgent.example: Her indulgent grandparents let her eat whatever she wanted.  溺爱她的祖父母让她想吃什么就吃什么。

abstract.example: She abstracted the key findings into a single page.  她把主要发现概括成一页。

digest.example: Give me a moment to digest what you just said.  给我点时间消化你刚说的话。

recapitulate.example: Let me recapitulate the main points before we vote.  投票前让我概括一下要点。

synopsize.example: Can you synopsize the plot in two sentences?  你能用两句话概述剧情吗？

sum up.example: To sum up, the project needs more time and money.  总之，这个项目需要更多时间和资金。

boil down.example: It all boils down to a question of trust.  这一切归结为信任问题。

detract.example: The ugly frame detracts from the painting.  难看的画框降低了这幅画的价值。

divert.example: The noise diverted my attention from the lecture.  噪音把我的注意力从讲座上引开。

call off.example: They called off the search because of the storm.  因暴风雨他们取消了搜寻。

throw off.example: The sudden question threw him off and he lost his train of thought.  这个突然的问题打乱了他，让他忘了要说什么。

elaborate.example: Could you elaborate on your last point a little?  你能就最后一点再详细说明一下吗？

attention.example: Please pay attention to the safety instructions.  请注意安全说明。

abstruse.example: His lecture was too abstruse for first-year students.  他的讲座对一年级学生来说太晦涩。

arcane.example: The tax code is full of arcane rules nobody understands.  税法充满无人理解的晦涩规定。

esoteric.example: She writes about esoteric topics in medieval music.  她写中世纪音乐中深奥的题目。

hermetic.example: The poet's hermetic style baffles most readers.  这位诗人晦涩的风格令多数读者困惑。

accessible.example: He makes physics accessible to ordinary readers.  他让普通读者也能理解物理学。

patent.cn: 显而易见的，明显的；专利
patent.example: The excuse was a patent lie and everyone knew it.  这个借口是显而易见的谎言，人人都知道。

shallow.example: His arguments are shallow and easy to refute.  他的论点浅薄，很容易反驳。

superficial.example: She has only a superficial knowledge of the subject.  她对这门学科只有肤浅的了解。

absurd.example: It's absurd to expect results in a single week.  期望一周内出结果是荒谬的。

wild.cn: 荒唐的，毫无根据的；野生的
wild.example: That's a wild guess with no evidence behind it.  那是毫无根据的胡乱猜测。

bizarre.example: By some bizarre coincidence we wore the same coat.  出于某种离奇的巧合，我们穿了同款外套。

ludicrous.example: The price they asked was simply ludicrous.  他们的要价简直可笑。

insane.example: Driving in this thick fog would be insane.  在这种大雾里开车太疯狂了。

nonsensical.example: The instructions were nonsensical and helped nobody.  说明荒谬无理，对谁都没帮助。

preposterous.example: The idea that he acted alone is preposterous.  说他独自行动的说法荒谬至极。

half-baked.example: They rushed ahead with a half-baked plan.  他们仓促推行了一个不成熟的计划。

rational.example: Try to make a rational decision instead of an emotional one.  试着做理性而非情绪化的决定。

sensible.example: Wearing boots was a sensible choice in that mud.  在那种泥地里穿靴子是明智的选择。

realistic.example: Let's set a realistic goal for this month.  我们为本月定一个切合实际的目标吧。

reasonable.example: That seems like a perfectly reasonable request.  那似乎是完全合理的要求。

abundant.example: Water was abundant after the spring rains.  春雨过后水源充足。

ample.example: There is ample room for everyone in the van.  车里有足够的空间容纳所有人。

cornucopian.example: The market offered a cornucopian display of fruit.  市场上摆着丰富多样的水果。

teeming.example: The pond was teeming with tadpoles in May.  五月池塘里满是蝌蚪。

replete.example: His essay was replete with spelling errors.  他的文章满是拼写错误。

abounding.example: They found a river abounding in trout.  他们发现一条鳟鱼很多的河。

infrequent.example: His visits home became increasingly infrequent.  他回家的次数越来越少。

rare.example: It is rare to see snow here in April.  四月这里下雪很罕见。

uncommon.example: Such mistakes are not uncommon among beginners.  这类错误在初学者中并不罕见。

inadequate.example: The lighting in the room is completely inadequate.  房间的照明完全不够。

scanty.example: Evidence for the theory remains scanty.  支持该理论的证据仍然很少。

scarce.example: Fresh water became scarce during the drought.  旱灾期间淡水变得稀缺。

abuse.cn: 辱骂，抨击；不正当或不合理使用
abuse.example: He was accused of abusing his position for profit.  他被指控滥用职位谋利。

assail.example: Opponents assailed the plan as reckless and unfair.  反对者抨击该计划轻率且不公。

bash.example: Politicians love to bash the press at rallies.  政客们喜欢在集会上抨击新闻界。

castigate.example: The judge castigated the company for its negligence.  法官严厉指责该公司的疏忽。

lambaste.example: Critics lambasted the film for its shallow, sentimental ending.  批评家严厉斥责这部电影结局浅薄而煽情。

misemploy.example: Officials were accused of misemploying money meant for schools.  官员们被指控滥用本应用于学校的资金。

misuse.example: The misuse of antibiotics has created dangerous resistant bacteria.  滥用抗生素造成了危险的耐药细菌。

acquainted.example: I am not well acquainted with the rules of this game.  我对这个游戏的规则不太熟悉。

familiar.example: Her voice sounded strangely familiar over the phone.  她的声音在电话里听起来奇怪地熟悉。

conversant.example: She is fully conversant with the new safety regulations.  她非常熟悉新的安全条例。

knowledgeable.cn: 知识丰富的，了解很多的
knowledgeable.example: Our guide was remarkably knowledgeable about local birds.  我们的导游对当地鸟类了解得非常多。

informed.example: Voters need accurate data to make an informed choice.  选民需要准确的数据才能做出明智的选择。

versed.example: He is well versed in both classical and modern poetry.  他对古典诗歌和现代诗歌都很精通。

well-informed.cn: 见闻广博的，消息灵通的
well-informed.example: A well-informed reader spotted the error in the report.  一位见闻广博的读者发现了报告中的错误。

ignorant.example: They were completely ignorant of the danger ahead.  他们对前方的危险毫不知情。

unacquainted.example: Being unacquainted with the city, he got lost very quickly.  由于不熟悉这座城市，他很快就迷路了。

unfamiliar.example: The street names here were all unfamiliar to me.  这里的街名对我来说都很陌生。

uninformed.example: Uninformed criticism rarely helps anyone improve their work.  不了解情况的批评很少能帮助别人改进工作。

unknowledgeable.example: He felt unknowledgeable about finance and hired an adviser.  他觉得自己不懂金融，于是聘请了一位顾问。

abysmal.cn: 糟透的，极差的；深不可测的
abysmal.example: The team's performance this season has been simply abysmal.  这个赛季球队的表现简直糟糕透顶。

profound.example: Her death had a profound effect on the whole family.  她的死对整个家庭产生了深远的影响。

shoal.example: The captain warned us about the shoal water near the reef.  船长提醒我们注意礁石附近的浅水。

skin-deep.example: His interest in the subject turned out to be skin-deep.  他对这个题目的兴趣原来只是浮于表面。

accede.example: The government finally acceded to the union's demands.  政府最终同意了工会的要求。

acquiesce.example: She acquiesced in their plan rather than start an argument.  她默许了他们的计划，以免引起争论。

assent.example: The committee assented to the proposal without further debate.  委员会未经进一步辩论就同意了该提案。

consent.example: The children cannot travel without their parents' consent.  没有父母的同意，孩子们不能出行。

subscribe.example: I do not subscribe to the view that money buys happiness.  我不赞同金钱能买到幸福的观点。

come round.example: It took weeks, but she finally came round to our plan.  过了几周，她终于转变态度，同意了我们的计划。

specific.example: Can you give me a specific example of the problem?  你能给我一个这个问题的具体例子吗？

specified.example: Please return the completed form by the specified deadline.  请在规定的截止日期前交回填好的表格。

demur.example: She demurred at the suggestion that she should resign.  对于让她辞职的建议，她表示了异议。

dissent.cn: 持异议，不同意；反对正统
dissent.example: Two judges dissented from the majority opinion of the court.  两位法官对法院的多数意见持异议。

ad hoc.example: They set up an ad hoc committee to handle the crisis.  他们成立了一个临时委员会来应对这场危机。

hɑːk.cn: ad hoc 音标残片；临时的
hɑːk.example: The phrase ad hoc is pronounced /æd hɑːk/ in American English.  ad hoc 在美式英语中读作 /æd hɑːk/。

handy.example: Keep a flashlight handy in case the power fails tonight.  把手电筒放在手边，以防今晚停电。

reachable.example: The village is reachable only by a narrow mountain road.  这个村子只能通过一条狭窄的山路到达。

apprehensible.example: His argument is barely apprehensible to readers without training.  他的论证对没有受过训练的读者几乎难以理解。

fathomable.example: Her reasons for leaving were not easily fathomable to us.  她离开的原因我们不容易理解。

legible.example: His handwriting is so small that it is hardly legible.  他的字太小，几乎难以辨认。

scrutable.example: Few of his decisions were scrutable to the junior staff.  他的决定很少能被初级员工理解。

inconvenient.example: She called at an inconvenient time, just before dinner.  她在不方便的时候打来电话，正好在晚饭前。

unhandy.cn: 不便使用的；笨手笨脚的
unhandy.example: This unhandy old ladder is difficult to carry upstairs.  这把不好用的旧梯子很难搬上楼。

unreachable.cn: 无法到达的；联系不上的
unreachable.example: He was unreachable all weekend because of the poor signal.  由于信号不好，他整个周末都联系不上。

untouchable.cn: 不可接触的；不可动摇的
untouchable.example: Senior managers at the firm seemed completely untouchable.  这家公司的高层管理者似乎完全碰不得。

incoherent.example: He was so upset that his explanation became incoherent.  他太难受了，解释变得语无伦次。

incomprehensible.example: The instructions were incomprehensible to a first-time user.  这些说明对第一次使用的人来说无法理解。

inscrutable.cn: 高深莫测的，难以理解的
inscrutable.example: His inscrutable smile gave nothing away about his plans.  他那高深莫测的笑容丝毫没有透露他的计划。

insensible.example: The blow left him insensible for several minutes.  这一击使他几分钟内失去了知觉。

accessory.example: The garage is an accessory structure behind the main house.  车库是主屋后面的一座附属建筑。

peripheral.example: That issue is peripheral to our main discussion today.  那个问题对我们今天的主要讨论来说是次要的。

supplementary.example: The teacher handed out supplementary reading for the weekend.  老师发了周末的补充阅读材料。

of primarily importance.example: Safety is of primary importance in every laboratory procedure.  在每一项实验室操作中，安全都是最重要的。

chief.example: Cost was the chief reason they abandoned the project.  成本是他们放弃这个项目的主要原因。

main.example: The main problem is that we have almost no time.  主要问题是我们几乎没有时间。

principal.example: Tourism is the principal source of income on the island.  旅游业是这个岛上的主要收入来源。

accidental.example: The fire was accidental, not the result of arson.  这场火灾是意外，不是纵火所致。

incidental.example: The damage was incidental to the main purpose of the test.  这种损坏只是测试主要目的之外的附带结果。

fortuitous.example: Their fortuitous meeting at the airport changed both careers.  他们在机场的偶然相遇改变了两人的职业道路。

unintended.example: The new rule had several unintended consequences for small firms.  新规定对小公司产生了几个意料之外的后果。

unintentional.example: Any offence caused by my remark was entirely unintentional.  我的话若造成任何冒犯，完全是无意的。

unpremeditated.cn: 非预谋的，未事先计划的
unpremeditated.example: The court decided the killing was sudden and unpremeditated.  法庭认定这起杀人是突发且非预谋的。

unwitting.example: She became an unwitting participant in the whole scheme.  她不知不觉地成了整个阴谋的参与者。

calculated.cn: 经过深思熟虑的，有意的
calculated.example: Investing now was a calculated risk that finally paid off.  现在投资是经过盘算的风险，最终有了回报。

deliberate.example: The delay was deliberate, designed to weaken our position.  这次延误是故意的，目的是削弱我们的立场。

intended.example: The book never reached its intended audience of young readers.  这本书从未触及它预期的年轻读者群。

planned.example: The whole ceremony was planned down to the last detail.  整个典礼被计划到了最后一个细节。

premeditated.example: Prosecutors argued that the robbery was carefully premeditated.  检察官认为这起抢劫是精心预谋的。

acclimate.example: It took the climbers a week to acclimate to the altitude.  登山者花了一周时间适应这个海拔。

adjust.example: It took her months to adjust to life in a new country.  她花了几个月才适应在新国家的生活。

accommodate.example: The schedule was changed to accommodate everyone's travel plans.  日程被改动以适应每个人的出行计划。

shape.example: Early experiences shape the way children see the world.  早期经历塑造了孩子看世界的方式。

suit.example: We can arrange a time that suits your schedule better.  我们可以安排一个更适合你日程的时间。

tailor.example: The training is tailored to each employee's actual duties.  培训是根据每位员工的实际职责量身定制的。

make unfamiliar with.example: Years abroad had made him unfamiliar with his own hometown streets.  多年在国外让他对故乡的街道感到生疏。

accolade.example: The novel received accolades from critics on both continents.  这部小说获得了两大洲评论家的赞誉。

applause.example: Her speech was greeted with long and warm applause.  她的演讲赢得了长时间热烈的掌声。

credit.example: She deserves credit for keeping the project alive.  她值得称赞，因为她让这个项目坚持下来了。

distinction.example: He graduated with distinction from a small rural college.  他以优异成绩从一所乡下的小型学院毕业。

condition.example: Athletes are conditioned to endure long periods of pain.  运动员被训练得能长时间承受痛苦。

conform.example: All new buildings must conform to strict safety codes.  所有新建筑都必须符合严格的安全规范。

doctor.example: He was accused of doctoring the financial records last year.  他被指控篡改了去年的财务记录。

edit.example: She edited the report to make its tone less aggressive.  她修改了报告，使语气不那么强硬。

attune.example: Good teachers are attuned to the moods of their students.  好老师能敏锐感知学生的情绪。

conciliate.example: The manager tried to conciliate the angry customers with refunds.  经理试图用退款来安抚愤怒的顾客。

coordinate.example: Two agencies coordinated the rescue effort after the flood.  洪水过后两个机构协调了救援工作。

reconcile.example: It is hard to reconcile these two versions of the story.  很难把这个故事的两种说法协调一致。

disapprobation.example: His remarks drew strong disapprobation from senior colleagues.  他的言论招致资深同事的强烈非难。

criticise.example: Several members criticised the plan as far too expensive.  几位成员批评这个计划太过昂贵。

reprobate.example: The novel's hero is a charming reprobate with no money.  小说的主角是个迷人却身无分文的堕落者。

derogate.example: Nothing should derogate from her remarkable achievement here.  什么都不应贬损她在这里的非凡成就。

reproof.example: A single glance from her served as a silent reproof.  她的一个眼神就成了无声的责备。

denigrate.example: He never denigrates his opponents, even after losing badly.  即使惨败，他也从不诋毁对手。

denunciate.example: Speakers denunciated the new law at the crowded rally.  演讲者在拥挤的集会上公开谴责这项新法律。

kɑːmədeɪt.example: In this dictionary accommodate is transcribed as /əˈkɑːmədeɪt/.  在这本词典里 accommodate 标注为 /əˈkɑːmədeɪt/。

disharmonize.example: Careless remarks can disharmonize an otherwise united team.  不慎的言论会使原本团结的团队失和。

accentuate.example: The bright lighting accentuated every flaw in the painting.  明亮的灯光突显出这幅画的每处瑕疵。

accent.example: The new design accents clean lines and natural light.  新设计突出了简洁的线条和自然光。

emphasize.example: She emphasized that the deadline could not be moved.  她强调截止日期不能改动。

foreground.example: The report foregrounds the needs of rural communities.  这份报告着重强调农村社区的需求。

highlight.example: The study highlights the risks of sitting all day.  这项研究强调了整天坐着的风险。

de-emphasize.example: The new policy de-emphasizes test scores in admissions decisions.  新政策在录取决定中不再强调考试分数。

play down.example: Officials tried to play down the scale of the leak.  官员们试图淡化这次泄漏的规模。

downplay.example: He downplayed his own role in the company's success.  他淡化了自己在公司成功中的作用。

accrete.example: Layers of sediment accreted slowly along the river mouth.  河口处的沉积层缓慢地逐渐增厚。

accumulate.example: Dust had accumulated on the shelves during our absence.  我们离开期间架子上积了灰。

build up.example: Traffic builds up quickly on this road after five o'clock.  五点以后这条路上的车流迅速积聚。

pile.example: Unread messages piled up while I was away on holiday.  我休假期间未读消息堆积起来。

wear away.example: Centuries of wind and rain slowly wore away the temple carvings.  几百年的风雨慢慢磨蚀了神庙的雕刻。

mount.example: Pressure on the minister mounted as the scandal spread.  随着丑闻扩散，部长承受的压力不断增加。

swell.example: The crowd swelled to thousands by early evening.  傍晚时人群增加到了数千人。

garner.example: The proposal garnered support from both major parties.  该提案获得了两大党的支持。

snowball.cn: 迅速增长，滚雪球般扩大
snowball.example: A small complaint snowballed into a national controversy.  一个小小的投诉迅速演变成全国性争议。

bulk.example: He bulked up considerably after months of weight training.  几个月的力量训练后他体格壮实了许多。

dissipate.example: The morning mist dissipated as soon as the sun rose.  太阳一升起，晨雾就消散了。

diminish.example: His influence diminished steadily after he left the board.  他离开董事会后影响力持续减弱。

acerbic.example: The reviewer is famous for her acerbic comments on new plays.  这位评论家以对新剧的尖酸评论闻名。

pungent.example: His pungent criticism of the report left everyone at the table silent.  他对这份报告辛辣的批评让全桌人都沉默了。

sardonic.example: He answered with a sardonic laugh and said nothing more.  他讥讽地笑了一声，什么也没再说。

satiric.example: The magazine published a satiric cartoon about the election.  这家杂志刊登了一幅关于选举的讽刺漫画。

scalding.example: The critic wrote a scalding review of the opening night.  评论家为首演之夜写了一篇严厉的评论。

scathing.example: She made a scathing remark about his sloppy research.  她对他草率的研究作了一句尖刻的评论。

sweet.example: She spoke in a sweet voice that calmed the frightened child.  她用温柔的声音说话，安抚了害怕的孩子。

saccharine.cn: 甜得发腻的；矫情做作的
saccharine.example: The film's ending is far too saccharine for my taste.  这部电影的结局对我来说太过矫情。

acme.example: That performance marked the acme of her long career.  那场演出标志着她漫长职业生涯的顶峰。

culmination.example: The prize was the culmination of twenty years of research.  这个奖项是二十年研究的最高成果。

pinnacle.example: At thirty she had reached the pinnacle of her profession.  三十岁时她已达到职业生涯的巅峰。

tip-top.example: She keeps her old bicycle in tip-top condition all year.  她全年都把旧自行车保持在极佳状态。

high-water mark.example: That treaty was the high-water mark of postwar cooperation.  那项条约是战后合作的顶峰。

bottom.example: Their team finished at the bottom of the league again.  他们的球队又一次排在联赛末位。

nadir.example: His confidence reached its nadir after the third rejection.  第三次被拒后他的信心降到了最低点。

rock bottom.example: Prices hit rock bottom before the market finally recovered.  价格跌到谷底后市场才终于回升。

resist.example: The villagers resisted every attempt to move them elsewhere.  村民们抵制一切要迁走他们的企图。

defy.example: Thousands of workers defied the ban and gathered in the main square.  数千名工人公然违抗禁令，聚集在中心广场上。

acrid.example: An acrid smell of burning plastic filled the hallway.  一股塑料烧焦的刺鼻气味充满了走廊。

gentle.example: He gave the door a gentle push and stepped inside.  他轻轻推了一下门，走了进去。

acrimonious.example: The meeting ended in an acrimonious exchange of accusations.  会议在互相指责的激烈争吵中结束。

embittered.example: Years of failure left him embittered and deeply suspicious.  多年的失败使他满怀怨恨且极度多疑。

hard.example: Don't be so hard on her; she is still learning.  别对她那么严厉，她还在学。

rancorous.example: The two brothers ended up in a rancorous quarrel over the inheritance.  两兄弟最后为遗产爆发了一场充满怨恨的争吵。

resentful.example: She grew resentful when her contributions were repeatedly ignored.  当她的付出被一再忽视时，她开始心生怨恨。

sore.example: He is still sore about losing the election last year.  他对去年落选的事仍然很气恼。

acumen.cn: 不同寻常的洞察力和鉴别力
acumen.example: Her financial acumen turned a small shop into a national chain.  她的商业洞察力把一家小店变成了全国连锁。

keenness.example: The old judge was admired for the keenness of his legal mind.  这位老法官因其敏锐的法律头脑而受人敬佩。

shrewdness.example: It took real shrewdness to buy the land before prices rose.  在地价上涨之前买下那块地需要真正的精明。

canniness.phrase: the canniness of a veteran trader
canniness.example: His canniness about market timing made him a fortune.  他对入市时机的精明判断让他发了财。

clear-sightedness.example: We need the clear-sightedness to admit that the plan has failed.  我们需要有清醒的眼光去承认这个计划已经失败。

hardheadedness.example: Her hardheadedness about costs saved the project from collapse.  她在成本上的务实精明使项目免于崩溃。

unable to discern.example: Without training he was unable to discern the fake from the original.  没有受过训练，他无法辨别赝品与真品。

acute.cn: 敏锐的；（程度、影响）极强的
acute.example: Dogs have an acute sense of hearing that far exceeds ours.  狗的听觉极其敏锐，远超人类。

delicate.example: She has a delicate ear for the subtle differences between dialects.  她对方言之间的细微差别有很灵敏的耳朵。

fine.example: He drew a fine distinction between courage and recklessness.  他在勇敢与莽撞之间划出了细微的区别。

keen.example: The photographer has a keen eye for unusual light.  这位摄影师对特别的光线有敏锐的眼力。

perceptive.example: Her perceptive comments revealed how carefully she had listened.  她敏锐的评论显示出她听得多么仔细。

sensitive.example: This instrument is sensitive enough to detect the faintest vibration.  这台仪器灵敏到能测出最微弱的震动。

dreadful.example: She had a dreadful headache and went home early.  她头疼得厉害，很早就回家了。

excruciating.cn: 极度痛苦的，难以忍受的
excruciating.example: The excruciating pain in his back made walking impossible.  他背部剧烈的疼痛使他根本无法行走。

light.example: He suffered only light injuries in the accident.  他在事故中只受了轻伤。

soft.example: She spoke in a soft tone so the baby would not wake.  她轻声说话，以免把婴儿弄醒。

adamant.example: The coach was adamant that no player would skip practice.  教练坚决要求没有球员可以缺席训练。

hardheaded.example: Her hardheaded refusal to compromise stalled the talks for weeks.  她固执地拒绝妥协，使谈判停滞了数周。

headstrong.example: The headstrong young man ignored every warning from his parents.  这个任性的年轻人对父母的每句劝告都置之不理。

intransigent.example: Both sides remained intransigent, so the negotiations collapsed.  双方都毫不妥协，谈判因此破裂。

pertinacious.example: The pertinacious reporter kept calling until she got an answer.  这位执着的记者不停打电话，直到得到答复。

obdurate.example: The landlord was obdurate and refused to lower the rent.  房东顽固不化，拒绝降低房租。

uncompromising.example: She took an uncompromising stand against corruption in the department.  她对部门内的腐败采取了毫不妥协的立场。

vacillatory.cn: 犹豫不决的，摇摆不定的
vacillatory.example: His vacillatory decisions confused everyone on the team.  他摇摆不定的决策让团队里的每个人都很困惑。

incline to yield.example: Under family pressure he began to incline to yield on the matter.  在家庭压力下，他开始倾向于在这件事上让步。

amenable.example: The new manager is amenable to any reasonable suggestion.  这位新经理对任何合理的建议都乐于接受。

compliant.example: The children were unusually compliant during the long ceremony.  在漫长的仪式上，孩子们出奇地听话。

relenting.example: After hours of pleading, his relenting expression gave us hope.  在几小时的哀求之后，他态度软化的表情给了我们希望。

yielding.example: Her yielding nature made her an easy target for pushy salesmen.  她顺从的性格使她很容易被强势的推销员盯上。

adapt.example: Immigrants must adapt to unfamiliar customs and a new language.  移民必须适应陌生的习俗和一门新语言。

addict.example: My brother is a complete coffee addict and drinks six cups daily.  我弟弟是个十足的咖啡瘾者，每天喝六杯。

devotee.example: As a devotee of jazz, he attends every festival in the city.  作为爵士乐迷，他参加城里的每一个音乐节。

enthusiast.example: The club is full of cycling enthusiasts who ride every weekend.  俱乐部里全是每周末都骑车的自行车爱好者。

fanatic.example: My roommate is a fitness fanatic who trains twice a day.  我室友是个健身狂，一天训练两次。

maniac.example: He is a football maniac who never misses a single match.  他是个足球狂，一场比赛都不落。

nonfan.example: The movie was so good that even nonfans of the genre enjoyed it.  这部电影好到连不喜欢这类片子的人都看得很开心。

adhere.example: All staff must adhere to the safety procedures without exception.  全体员工必须无例外地遵守安全规程。

cling to.example: He continued to cling to the hope that she would return.  他一直抱着她会回来的希望不放。

hew to.example: The new director promised to hew to the founder's original vision.  新任主管承诺严格遵循创始人最初的理念。

stand by.example: I will stand by my decision no matter what critics say.  不管批评者怎么说，我都坚持我的决定。

stick to.example: Let's stick to the original plan and avoid last-minute changes.  我们还是坚持原计划，避免临时改动。

comply with.example: Every factory must comply with the new emission standards.  每家工厂都必须遵守新的排放标准。

disobey.example: The soldier was punished for choosing to disobey a direct order.  这名士兵因选择违抗直接命令而受到处罚。

rebel against.example: Teenagers often rebel against the rules their parents set.  青少年常常反抗父母定下的规矩。

adjourn.example: The judge decided to adjourn the trial until Monday morning.  法官决定将审判延至周一上午。

prorogate.example: The governor moved to prorogate the assembly for two months.  州长动议将议会休会两个月。

prorogue.example: The prime minister asked the queen to prorogue parliament.  首相请求女王让议会休会。

recess.example: The committee will recess for lunch and resume at two.  委员会将休会吃午饭，两点复会。

suspend.example: Officials had to suspend the search because of the storm.  由于暴风雨，官员们不得不中止搜救。

convoke.example: The president will convoke an emergency session of the council.  总统将召集理事会举行紧急会议。

adjunct.example: Exercise is a valuable adjunct to a healthy diet.  运动是健康饮食的有益辅助。

appendage.example: The small museum is treated as an appendage of the university.  这座小博物馆被当作大学的附属机构。

appliance.example: We bought a new appliance to replace the broken refrigerator.  我们买了一件新电器来替换坏掉的冰箱。

attachment.example: The drill comes with an attachment for sanding wood.  这台电钻附带一个打磨木头的配件。

add-on.example: The camera is sold with an optional add-on for night photography.  这台相机附售一个可选的夜摄附加配件。

essential element.example: Trust is an essential element of any lasting partnership.  信任是任何持久合作关系的必要要素。

adlib.example: His adlib jokes got a bigger laugh than the script did.  他即兴的玩笑比剧本还要逗人笑。

extemporary.example: She gave an extemporary talk that impressed the whole audience.  她做了一场即兴演讲，令全场听众印象深刻。

impromptu.cn: 即席的表演；即席的，即兴的
impromptu.example: The band gave an impromptu concert in the town square.  乐队在镇广场上举行了一场即兴音乐会。

improvisational.example: He teaches an improvisational theater class on Thursday nights.  他在周四晚上教即兴戏剧课。

offhanded.example: His offhanded reply suggested he had not thought about it at all.  他随口的回答显示他根本没考虑过这件事。

considered.example: That is my considered judgment after reading the whole report.  这是我读完整份报告后的慎重判断。

rehearsed.cn: 排练过的，事先准备好的
rehearsed.example: Her apology sounded rehearsed rather than sincere.  她的道歉听起来像是排练过的，而不真诚。

admonish.example: The teacher admonished the boys for shouting in the hallway.  老师责备男孩们在走廊里大喊大叫。

counsel.example: His lawyer counseled him to say nothing to the press.  他的律师建议他对媒体什么都别说。

chide.example: She chided her son for forgetting his grandmother's birthday.  她责备儿子忘了祖母的生日。

reprimand.example: The officer was reprimanded for leaving his post early.  这名警官因提早离岗而受到训斥。

reproach.example: She reproached him for never returning her calls.  她责备他从不回她的电话。

reprove.example: The coach reproved the player for arguing with the referee.  教练责备那名球员与裁判争辩。

tick off.phrase: get ticked off by the boss
tick off.example: The manager ticked him off for arriving late again.  经理因他又迟到而把他训了一顿。

fancy.example: Do you fancy a walk along the river this evening?  今晚想不想去河边散散步？

relish.example: He described the meal with obvious relish.  他津津有味地描述那顿饭。

savor.example: She paused to savor the smell of fresh bread.  她停下来细细品味新鲜面包的香味。

delight in.example: The children delight in splashing through every puddle.  孩子们喜欢在每个水坑里踩水玩。

rejoice in.example: The whole village rejoiced in the news of her recovery.  全村人都为她康复的消息感到欣喜。

cherish.example: I will always cherish the years we spent together.  我会永远珍视我们共度的那些年。

adulate.example: Reporters adulated the young singer after her first hit.  记者们在这位年轻歌手第一首热门歌后对她大加吹捧。

overpraise.example: Critics tend to overpraise any novel by a famous author.  评论家往往对名作家的任何小说都过分赞扬。

belaud.example: The court poets belauded the king in every verse.  宫廷诗人在每一行诗里都对国王大加赞美。

soft-soap.example: He tried to soft-soap the inspector into overlooking the fault.  他试图奉承检查员，让他放过这个问题。

butter up.example: She spent the whole lunch buttering up her new manager.  她整个午饭时间都在讨好她的新经理。

scorn.example: He scorned the idea of asking his parents for money.  他不屑于向父母要钱这个想法。

disdain.example: She disdained the flattery of her ambitious colleagues.  她鄙视那些野心勃勃的同事的奉承。

vituperate.example: The columnist vituperated the mayor in every weekly article.  这位专栏作家在每周的文章里都痛骂市长。

disparage.example: Do not disparage her work simply because she is young.  不要仅仅因为她年轻就贬低她的工作。

adulterate.example: The dealer was fined for adulterating olive oil with cheaper fat.  这个商人因在橄榄油中掺入廉价油脂而被罚款。

alloy.phrase: an alloy of copper and tin
alloy.example: Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin used since ancient times.  青铜是自古就使用的铜锡合金。

contaminate.example: Leaking chemicals contaminated the soil around the factory.  泄漏的化学品污染了工厂周围的土壤。

pollute.example: Factories along the river have polluted the water for decades.  沿河的工厂几十年来一直在污染水体。

taint.example: The scandal tainted his reputation for the rest of his career.  这场丑闻在他余下的职业生涯中都损害着他的名声。

water down.example: Lawmakers watered down the bill to win more votes.  议员们削弱了这项法案的力度以争取更多选票。

enrich.example: Reading widely will enrich your understanding of other cultures.  广泛阅读会丰富你对其他文化的理解。

fortify.example: The milk is fortified with extra vitamin D.  这种牛奶额外强化添加了维生素D。

strengthen.example: Regular exercise will strengthen your heart and lungs.  规律锻炼会增强你的心肺功能。

adumbrate.example: The early chapters adumbrate the tragedy that follows.  开头几章预示了随后的悲剧。

forerun.example: The falling leaves forerun the arrival of a long winter.  落叶预示着漫长冬天的到来。

harbinger.example: The first robin is often seen as a harbinger of spring.  第一只知更鸟常被视为春天的预兆。

herald.example: The invention heralded a new era in communication.  这项发明预示着通信新时代的到来。

prefigure.example: His early sketches prefigure the style of his mature paintings.  他早期的素描预示了他成熟画作的风格。

adventitious.cn: 外来的，后天的，非内在的
adventitious.example: Her success was not adventitious but the result of years of work.  她的成功不是偶然外来的，而是多年努力的结果。

alien.example: Such customs seemed completely alien to the newcomers.  这些习俗对新来者来说完全陌生。
alien.phrase_cn: 与我们的文化格格不入

extraneous.example: Please delete all extraneous details from the summary.  请把摘要中所有无关的细节删掉。

external.example: The delay was caused by external factors beyond our control.  延误是由我们无法控制的外部因素造成的。

foreign.example: The surgeon removed a foreign object from the patient's eye.  外科医生从病人眼中取出一个异物。

supervenient.cn: 后来附加的，额外发生的
supervenient.example: A supervenient illness complicated his already slow recovery.  一场后来出现的疾病使他本已缓慢的康复更加复杂。

constitutional.example: His shyness seems constitutional rather than a habit he learned.  他的害羞似乎是天性使然，而非后天习得的习惯。

essential.example: Patience is an essential part of her character.  耐心是她性格中本质的一部分。

intrinsic.example: The painting has an intrinsic beauty independent of its price.  这幅画有着与价格无关的内在美。

inborn.example: She seems to have an inborn sense of rhythm.  她似乎天生就有节奏感。

inbred.example: He has an inbred distrust of large institutions.  他对大型机构有一种根深蒂固的不信任。

innate.example: Children have an innate curiosity about the world.  儿童对世界有一种天生的好奇心。

inherent.example: There is an inherent danger in climbing without a rope.  无绳攀岩存在内在的危险。

adversary.example: He respected his adversary even while fighting to win.  即使在拼命求胜时，他也尊重自己的对手。

antagonist.example: Her chief antagonist in the debate was a former professor.  她在辩论中的主要对手是一位前教授。

foe.example: In the dark he could not tell friend from foe.  在黑暗中他分不清敌友。

opponent.example: She defeated a much stronger opponent in the final round.  她在决赛中击败了一位强得多的对手。

ally.example: Britain remained a close ally of the United States.  英国一直是美国的亲密盟友。

amigo.example: Thanks for the ride, amigo, I owe you one.  谢谢你载我一程，老兄，我欠你一次。

friend.example: She has been my closest friend since primary school.  她从小学起就是我最亲密的朋友。

advert.example: The speaker briefly adverted to the funding shortage.  演讲者简短地提到了资金短缺问题。

inattentive.example: The inattentive driver failed to see the red light.  这位漫不经心的司机没看到红灯。

remiss.example: I would be remiss if I did not thank the volunteers.  如果我不感谢志愿者，那就是我的疏忽。

heedless.example: He ran into the street heedless of the traffic.  他不顾车流冲进了街道。

negligent.example: The company was found negligent in maintaining its equipment.  该公司被认定在设备维护上存在疏忽。

advocate.example: Many doctors advocate walking as the simplest form of exercise.  许多医生提倡把走路作为最简单的运动方式。

champion.example: She has championed the rights of migrant workers for years.  她多年来一直为农民工的权益奔走呼吁。

endorse.example: The union voted to endorse the mayor for a second term.  工会投票支持市长连任。

patronize.cn: 赞助；以高人一等的态度对待
patronize.example: Wealthy merchants patronized young painters throughout the Renaissance.  富商在整个文艺复兴时期都赞助年轻画家。

impugn.example: He never impugned the honesty of his opponents.  他从不质疑对手的诚实。

affable.example: Our affable neighbor greets everyone on the street by name.  我们和蔼的邻居在街上会叫出每个人的名字打招呼。

cordial.cn: 热情友好的；令人振奋的
cordial.example: The two leaders exchanged cordial greetings before the talks.  两位领导人在会谈前互致亲切的问候。

genial.cn: 和蔼亲切的；温和宜人的
genial.example: Our genial neighbor invited the whole street over for dinner.  我们和蔼可亲的邻居请整条街的人来吃晚饭。

hospitable.cn: 热情好客的；宜于生长的
hospitable.example: The villagers were remarkably hospitable to the exhausted travelers.  村民对疲惫的旅人非常好客。

sociable.example: She is far more sociable than her quiet older brother.  她比她安静的哥哥爱交际得多。

good-natured.example: He accepted the joke with a good-natured shrug.  他和善地耸耸肩接受了这个玩笑。

good-tempered.cn: 性情温和的，不易发怒的
good-tempered.example: The old dog was good-tempered even when children pulled its ears.  即使孩子们拉它的耳朵，这只老狗也很温顺。

well-disposed.example: The committee seemed well-disposed toward our funding request.  委员会似乎对我们的资金申请持友善态度。

irascible.example: The irascible coach shouted at the referee over every call.  这位暴躁的教练对每一次判罚都冲裁判大喊。

testy.example: He grew testy when the reporters kept repeating the question.  记者反复问同一个问题时，他变得不耐烦起来。

ill-tempered.example: His ill-tempered remark silenced everyone at the dinner table.  他脾气暴躁的话让餐桌上所有人都沉默了。

unamiable.example: His unamiable silence made the other guests feel quite uncomfortable.  他不友善的沉默让其他客人感到很不自在。

ungenial.example: The ungenial landlord refused even to greet his tenants.  这位不和气的房东连招呼都不愿跟房客打。

affinity.cn: 喜好，倾向；相似，密切关系
affinity.example: She has a natural affinity for languages and picks them up quickly.  她天生对语言有亲近感，学得很快。

bent.example: From childhood he showed a bent for mechanical things.  他从小就显示出对机械的爱好。

penchant.example: Her penchant for dramatic hats made her instantly recognizable.  她对夸张帽子的偏爱让人一眼就认出她。

predilection.example: The critic's predilection for older films colored every review.  这位评论家对老电影的偏爱影响了他的每篇评论。

predisposition.example: Some patients have a predisposition to high blood pressure.  有些病人有高血压的易感倾向。

proclivity.cn: 癖性，偏好（多指不良倾向）
proclivity.example: His proclivity for gambling eventually ruined the family.  他的赌博癖好最终毁了这个家。

propensity.example: The boy has a propensity to lose every umbrella he owns.  这男孩总有把伞丢掉的习性。

association.example: He denied any association with the group behind the protest.  他否认与抗议背后的团体有任何关联。

kinship.cn: 亲缘关系；相似，密切联系
kinship.example: She felt an instant kinship with the other new students.  她立刻对其他新生产生了亲近感。

aversion.example: He has a lifelong aversion to crowded parties.  他一生都厌恶拥挤的聚会。

repugnance.example: She could not hide her repugnance at the smell of the fish market.  她无法掩饰对鱼市气味的厌恶。

antipathy.example: There has long been an antipathy between the two departments.  这两个部门之间长期存在反感。

affluent.example: They moved to a more affluent neighborhood after the promotion.  升职后他们搬到了更富裕的街区。

opulent.example: The opulent ballroom was lined with gold mirrors and velvet chairs.  这间华丽的舞厅摆满了金框镜子和天鹅绒椅。

loaded.example: Don't worry about the bill; her family is loaded.  别担心账单，她家很有钱。

deep-pocketed.example: The startup was rescued by a deep-pocketed backer from abroad.  这家初创公司被一位来自国外的财力雄厚的支持者救了。

silk-stocking.example: The candidate raised money mainly in silk-stocking neighborhoods.  这位候选人主要在富人区筹款。

well-endowed.cn: 资金充足的，天赋优厚的
well-endowed.example: The well-endowed college offers generous scholarships every year.  这所资金充裕的学院每年提供丰厚奖学金。

well-off.example: Her parents were well-off enough to pay her tuition outright.  她父母相当富裕，能一次付清学费。

well-to-do.example: The school mostly serves children from well-to-do families.  这所学校主要招收富裕家庭的孩子。

needy.cn: 贫困的；情感上过度依赖的
needy.example: The charity distributes winter coats to needy children.  这家慈善机构向贫困儿童发放冬衣。

impecunious.example: As an impecunious young painter, he lived on bread and tea.  作为一个穷困的年轻画家，他靠面包和茶为生。

impoverished.example: War left the once-prosperous city utterly impoverished for many years.  战争让这座曾繁荣的城市多年极度贫困。

indigent.example: The clinic provides free care to indigent patients.  这家诊所为贫困病人提供免费医疗。

penurious.example: He spent a penurious youth in a crowded tenement.  他在拥挤的廉租房里度过了贫困的青年时期。

boost.example: The tax cut is expected to boost consumer spending.  减税预计会促进消费者支出。

expand.example: The company plans to expand into three new markets.  公司计划扩张到三个新市场。

magnify.example: The lens magnifies the specimen four hundred times.  这个镜头把样本放大四百倍。

add.example: The heavy rain only added to our travel troubles.  大雨只是加重了我们的旅行麻烦。

relegate.example: After the scandal he was relegated to a minor post.  丑闻之后他被贬到一个次要职位。

efface.example: Time had effaced the inscription on the old gravestone.  时间已把这块老墓碑上的铭文磨去。

demean.example: He refused to demean his colleagues in front of clients.  他拒绝在客户面前贬低同事。

aggravate.example: Running on the injury will only aggravate it.  带着伤跑步只会让伤势加重。

complicate.example: New evidence complicated the investigation and delayed the final report.  新证据使调查复杂化，并推迟了最终报告。

worsen.example: Her cough worsened after a week outdoors in the cold.  在寒冷的户外待了一周后，她的咳嗽加重了。

alleviate.example: A warm bath helped alleviate the soreness in his back.  热水澡帮他缓解了背部的酸痛。

succor.example: Volunteers hurried to succor the families left homeless by the flood.  志愿者们赶去救助因洪水而无家可归的家庭。

console.example: Nothing anyone said could console her that evening.  那天晚上无论谁说什么都无法安慰她。

assuage.example: The mayor's speech did little to assuage public anger.  市长的演讲几乎没能平息公众的怒火。

mitigate.example: Planting trees can mitigate the effects of summer heat.  种树可以减轻夏季高温的影响。

relieve.example: A short walk relieved the tension in her shoulders.  短暂散步缓解了她肩膀的紧张。

aggregate.example: The aggregate of small donations exceeded a million dollars.  小额捐款的总额超过了一百万美元。

sum.example: The sum of the three numbers is exactly one hundred.  这三个数的总和正好是一百。

summation.example: The lawyer's summation lasted nearly an hour and convinced the jury.  律师的总结陈述持续了近一小时，说服了陪审团。

totality.example: Judged in its totality, the project was a success.  从整体来看，这个项目是成功的。

coalesce.example: The scattered protests coalesced into a national movement.  分散的抗议汇合成一场全国性运动。

join together.example: Several small farms joined together to sell their produce.  几个小农场联合起来出售农产品。

isolated units.cn: 孤立的个体，分散的单元
isolated units.example: Without a shared plan, the teams stayed isolated units.  缺少共同计划，各团队仍是孤立的单元。

aggressive.cn: 好斗的；积极进取的，强有力的
aggressive.example: The dog became aggressive whenever strangers approached the gate.  只要有陌生人靠近大门，这只狗就变得有攻击性。

fierce.example: The two teams faced fierce competition for the final spot.  两队为最后一个名额展开激烈竞争。

assaultive.example: The patient's assaultive behavior required constant supervision by trained staff.  这名病人的攻击性行为需要受过训练的人员持续看护。

combative.example: He answered every question in a combative tone.  他用好斗的语气回答每一个问题。

militant.example: The union took a militant stance in the pay talks.  工会在薪资谈判中采取了强硬立场。

confrontational.example: Her confrontational style alienated several colleagues.  她对抗性的作风疏远了几位同事。

go-getting.example: The firm hired a go-getting young manager to revive sales.  公司聘请了一位有闯劲的年轻经理来振兴销售。

self-assertive.cn: 坚持自我主张的，自信果断的
self-assertive.example: She learned to be more self-assertive in meetings.  她学会了在会议上更敢于表达主张。

truculent.example: The truculent teenager argued with every teacher who tried to correct him.  这个好斗的少年跟每位试图纠正他的老师都吵。

pugnacious.example: The pugnacious little dog barked at every passing car.  这只好斗的小狗对每辆过路的车都叫。

dynamic.example: The city has a dynamic arts scene that keeps changing.  这座城市有着不断变化的活跃艺术圈。

energetic.example: Even at seventy she remains remarkably energetic and full of plans.  即使七十岁了，她依然精力充沛，计划满满。

full-blooded.cn: 强有力的，充满活力的；纯种的
full-blooded.example: The team launched a full-blooded attack in the second half.  球队在下半场发起了猛烈进攻。

vigorous.example: Doctors recommend thirty minutes of vigorous exercise daily.  医生建议每天进行三十分钟的高强度运动。

even-tempered.cn: 性情平和的，不易发怒的
even-tempered.example: He stayed even-tempered throughout the long and difficult negotiation.  在漫长艰难的谈判中他始终保持平和。

nonbelligerent.example: The treaty guaranteed the island's nonbelligerent status during the whole conflict.  条约保证了该岛在整场冲突期间的非交战国地位。

pacific.example: He settled the quarrel with a few pacific words.  他用几句平和的话平息了争吵。

uncombative.example: Her uncombative answer surprised the hostile interviewer and calmed the room.  她不带火气的回答让不友好的采访者意外，也让场面缓和下来。

uncontentious.cn: 不引起争议的，不好争辩的
uncontentious.example: The committee began with the uncontentious items on the agenda.  委员会从议程上无争议的项目开始。

aggrieve.example: The ruling aggrieved thousands of former employees of the closed factory.  这项裁决使那家关闭工厂的数千名前员工感到受了委屈。

discontent.example: Rising prices caused growing discontent among the workers.  物价上涨引起工人越来越大的不满。

disgruntled.example: A disgruntled employee leaked the memo to the press.  一名心怀不满的员工把备忘录泄露给了媒体。

displeased.example: The director was clearly displeased with the rehearsal.  导演显然对排练不满意。

dissatisfied.example: Many readers were dissatisfied with the book's ending.  许多读者对这本书的结局不满意。

malcontent.example: The general dismissed the critics as a few malcontents.  将军把批评者说成是几个不满分子。

gratify.example: It gratified her to see her students succeed.  看到学生成功让她很欣慰。

agitate.example: Students agitated for changes to the exam system.  学生们为改革考试制度而奔走呼吁。

debate.example: The council debated the housing plan for three hours.  议会就住房计划辩论了三个小时。

dispute.example: The neighbors are still in dispute over the fence.  邻居们仍在为那道围栏争执。

bat.example: We batted the proposal around for an hour without deciding.  我们把这个提案反复讨论了一小时也没决定。

bother.example: The constant noise from the street really bothers me.  街上不停的噪音真让我烦。

discomfort.example: He shifted in his seat with obvious discomfort.  他明显不自在地在座位上挪动。

discompose.example: Nothing seemed to discompose the veteran pilot, not even engine failure.  似乎没什么能让这位老飞行员心慌，连引擎故障也不行。

perturb.example: The sudden change of plan perturbed everyone on the team.  计划的突然改变让全队的人都心神不宁。

calm.example: She spoke in a calm voice until the children settled.  她用平静的声音说话，直到孩子们安静下来。

compose.example: He took a breath to compose himself before speaking.  他深吸一口气让自己镇定下来才开口。

soothe.example: Soft music helped soothe the restless patient through the long night.  轻柔的音乐帮助安抚了焦躁的病人度过漫长的夜晚。

tranquilize.example: The vet had to tranquilize the frightened horse.  兽医不得不给这匹惊慌的马注射镇静剂。

agog.cn: 极度感兴趣的，兴奋期待的
agog.example: The children were agog at the sight of the elephants.  孩子们看到大象时兴奋不已。

avid.example: My grandmother is an avid gardener even in winter.  我祖母即使在冬天也是个热衷园艺的人。

ardent.example: He remained an ardent fan of the team for fifty years.  他五十年来一直是这支球队的狂热球迷。

enthusiastic.example: The students were enthusiastic about the field trip.  学生们对这次实地考察很热情。

solicitous.example: The nurse was solicitous about every detail of his recovery.  护士对他康复的每个细节都很关心。

voracious.example: He is a voracious reader who finishes a novel each week.  他是个如饥似渴的读者，每周读完一本小说。

apathetic.example: Most students seemed apathetic about the election and did not vote.  大多数学生对这次选举漠不关心，也没有投票。

indifferent.cn: 不感兴趣的，冷漠的；平庸的
indifferent.example: She is entirely indifferent to what her critics say.  她对批评者说什么完全无所谓。

uneager.example: The team was oddly uneager to take on the new project.  团队对接手新项目出奇地不积极。

unenthusiastic.example: His unenthusiastic nod told us he disliked the idea.  他不情不愿的点头说明他不喜欢这个主意。

agonize.example: She agonized for weeks over whether to accept the job.  她为是否接受这份工作苦恼了好几周。

anguish.example: His face showed the anguish of a sleepless night.  他的脸上写着一夜无眠的痛苦。

suffer.example: Thousands suffered from the drought that struck the region that summer.  那年夏天，数千人饱受该地区旱灾之苦。

airtight.example: The prosecutor claimed the case against him was airtight.  检察官称对他的指控无懈可击。
airtight.phrase_cn: 无懈可击的不在场证明

alacrity.example: He agreed to help with surprising alacrity and arrived within minutes.  他出人意料地爽快答应帮忙，几分钟内就到了。

amenability.example: Her amenability to new methods impressed the trainers.  她对新方法的乐于接受让培训师印象深刻。

gameness.example: The rookie's gameness won over the whole locker room.  这名新人的敢闯劲头赢得了全队的认可。

obligingness.example: The obligingness of the hotel staff made our stay easy.  酒店员工的热心让我们住得很轻松。

willingness.example: Her willingness to listen made her a good manager.  她愿意倾听的态度让她成为一名好经理。

dilatoriness.example: The committee's dilatoriness delayed the repairs by a year.  委员会的拖沓使维修推迟了一年。

hesitance and reluctance.example: The offer was received with hesitance and reluctance.  这项提议遭到了犹豫和不情愿的对待。

alibi.example: Two witnesses confirmed his alibi for that night.  两名证人证实了他当晚的不在场证明。
alibi.phrase_cn: 无懈可击的不在场证明

defense.example: He said nothing in his own defense at the hearing.  在听证会上他没有为自己作任何辩解。

justification.example: There is no justification for treating them so harshly.  如此严厉地对待他们毫无正当理由。

plea.example: She ignored his plea for more time and closed the file.  她无视了他要求延期的恳求，合上了卷宗。

reason.example: He gave no reason for leaving the meeting early.  他没有给出提前离开会议的理由。

alienate.example: His harsh remarks alienated many longtime friends within a single evening.  他刻薄的言辞在一个晚上就疏远了许多老朋友。

disaffect.example: The broken promises disaffected much of the party base.  这些空头承诺使党的许多基础支持者离心。

disgruntle.example: The sudden pay freeze disgruntled the entire department.  突然的薪资冻结让整个部门都不满。

sour.example: The argument soured their friendship for years to come.  那次争吵使他们的友谊多年蒙上阴影。

unite.example: The crisis united the villagers as nothing else had.  这场危机以前所未有的方式团结了村民。

reunite.example: The band reunited after twenty years apart and toured again.  乐队在分开二十年后重新组合，再度巡演。

align.example: The mechanic aligned the front wheels in ten minutes.  修车师傅十分钟就把前轮调正了。

improperly adjusted.example: The machine vibrated because the belt was improperly adjusted.  机器震动是因为皮带没调好。

irregular.example: The path was made of irregular stones of many sizes.  这条小路由各种大小不规则的石头铺成。

allay.example: The statement was meant to allay concerns about safety.  这份声明意在减轻人们对安全的担忧。

ease.example: The medicine eased her headache within minutes of the first dose.  这药在服下第一剂几分钟内就缓解了她的头痛。

mollify.example: A sincere apology from the manager mollified the furious client.  经理诚挚的道歉安抚了这位愤怒的客户。

palliate.example: The new drug can only palliate the pain, not cure the disease.  这种新药只能减轻疼痛，无法治愈疾病。

excite.example: His speech excited strong resentment among the workers.  他的演讲激起了工人们的强烈不满。

foment.example: The pamphlets were designed to foment rebellion in the provinces.  这些小册子意在煽动各省叛乱。

increase the intensity of.example: Adding fuel will increase the intensity of the fire within minutes.  加燃料会在几分钟内加大火势。

exacerbate.example: Cutting the budget would only exacerbate the housing shortage.  削减预算只会使住房短缺进一步恶化。

allegiance.example: New citizens pledge allegiance to the country at the ceremony.  新公民在仪式上宣誓效忠国家。

commitment.example: She showed a deep commitment to protecting local wildlife.  她表现出保护当地野生动物的坚定投入。

dedication.example: Her dedication to her students earned her the teaching award.  她对学生的全心投入为她赢得了教学奖。

piety.example: The old woman was admired for her quiet piety and charity.  这位老妇人因其内敛的虔诚与善行而受人敬重。

faithfulness.example: He was rewarded for years of faithfulness to the family business.  他因多年忠于家族企业而获得回报。

steadfastness.example: Her steadfastness during the strike inspired the other workers.  她在罢工期间的坚定不移鼓舞了其他工人。

inconstancy.example: His inconstancy made it impossible to rely on any promise he made.  他的反复无常使人无法信赖他的任何承诺。

infidelity.example: The couple separated after years of quarrels and infidelity.  这对夫妻在多年争吵和背叛后分居了。

perfidiousness.example: Historians still debate the perfidiousness of the general's secret deal.  史学家仍在争论那位将军密约的背信程度。

treachery.example: He was executed for treachery after selling secrets to the enemy.  他因向敌人出卖机密犯下叛国罪而被处死。

allude.example: She alluded to the scandal without ever mentioning any names.  她间接提到了那桩丑闻，却从未点名。

imply.example: Silence at such a moment may imply consent rather than doubt.  此刻的沉默可能意味着同意而非怀疑。

indicate.example: The survey results indicate a growing distrust of large banks.  调查结果表明人们对大银行的不信任在加深。

infer.example: From his tone we inferred that the negotiations had failed.  从他的语气我们推断谈判已经失败。

insinuate.cn: 含沙射影地暗示；使巧妙混入
insinuate.example: He insinuated that the accounts had been quietly altered.  他暗示账目被人悄悄改动过。

intimate.example: The minister intimated that new rules would appear next month.  部长暗示下月将出台新规。

suggest.example: Her hesitation suggested that she knew more than she admitted.  她的犹豫暗示她知道的比承认的更多。

allure.example: Cheap rents allure young artists to this run-down district.  低廉的租金吸引年轻艺术家来到这个破旧街区。

entice.example: Free samples were used to entice shoppers into the new store.  免费样品被用来引诱购物者进入新店。

seduce.example: High salaries seduced many teachers away from the classroom.  高薪诱使许多教师离开了课堂。

solicit.example: The charity solicited funds from local businesses all winter.  该慈善机构整个冬天向本地企业募捐。

tempt.example: The smell of fresh bread tempted us into the little bakery.  新鲜面包的香味把我们诱进了那家小面包店。

captivate.example: Her first novel captivated readers around the world.  她的第一部小说令世界各地的读者着迷。

enchant.example: The old fishing village enchanted every visitor who stayed there.  那个古老渔村令每位住过的游客陶醉。

lead on.example: She finally realized he was leading her on with empty promises.  她终于意识到他在用空头承诺吊着她。

unattractive.example: The job was well paid but otherwise thoroughly unattractive.  这份工作薪水不错，但其他方面毫无吸引力。

sa.example: Each entry ends with an SA marker before the antonyms.  每个词条在反义词前以 SA 标记结束。

supporter.example: Thousands of supporters gathered outside the stadium before kickoff.  开赛前数千名支持者聚集在体育场外。

confederate.example: The thief and his confederate were arrested the following morning.  那个小偷和他的同伙第二天早上被捕。

sympathizer.example: Police questioned several sympathizers of the banned movement.  警方审问了几名被禁运动的支持者。

rival.example: The two firms have been rivals in this market for decades.  这两家公司在该市场竞争了数十年。

aloft.example: The balloon stayed aloft for nearly three hours.  那只气球在空中停留了近三个小时。

overhead.example: A helicopter circled overhead while we waited on the roof.  我们在屋顶等候时，一架直升机在上方盘旋。

grounded.example: All flights were grounded because of the heavy fog.  由于大雾，所有航班都被迫停飞。

aloof.example: He stayed aloof from office gossip and rarely joined lunch.  他对办公室的闲话保持冷淡，很少参加午餐。

detached.example: She described the accident in a strangely detached voice.  她用一种异常冷漠的语气描述了那场事故。

offish.example: The new neighbors seemed offish until we invited them over.  在我们邀请之前，新邻居显得有些冷淡。

unsociable.example: Long years of study had left him rather unsociable.  多年苦读使他变得相当不爱交际。

withdrawn.cn: 内向孤僻的，不与人来往的
withdrawn.example: The boy grew quiet and withdrawn after moving to the city.  搬到城里后，那男孩变得沉默孤僻。

standoffish.example: Her standoffish greeting made the guests feel unwelcome.  她冷淡的招呼让客人觉得不受欢迎。

altruism.example: Her donation was pure altruism, since she refused any publicity.  她的捐赠纯属无私，因为她拒绝任何宣传。

egoism.example: His politics were driven by egoism rather than any principle.  他的政治行为出于利己主义而非任何原则。

egotistic.example: The director was too egotistic to accept advice from anyone.  这位主管太自负，不肯接受任何人的建议。

self-centered.example: He is so self-centered that he never asks how others feel.  他极其自我中心，从不问别人的感受。

self-concerned.cn: 只顾自己的，自我关注的
self-concerned.example: Their proposal was too self-concerned to win wider support.  他们的提案过于只顾自身，难以获得更广泛支持。

selfish.example: It was selfish of him to take the last seat on the bus.  他抢占公交车最后一个座位真是自私。

amalgamate.example: The two small colleges amalgamated to cut administrative costs.  两所小学院合并以削减行政成本。

mix.example: Mix the flour and water until the dough becomes smooth.  把面粉和水混合，直到面团变得光滑。

fuse.example: Her music fuses jazz rhythms with traditional folk melodies.  她的音乐把爵士节奏与传统民谣旋律融为一体。

intermix.example: The two populations intermixed freely over several centuries.  这两个族群在几个世纪里自由混居。

compound.example: The pharmacist compounded an ointment from three simple ingredients.  药剂师用三种简单原料配制出一种药膏。

meld.example: The choir's voices melded into a single warm sound.  合唱团的声音融合成一种温暖的声响。

mingle.example: Smoke mingled with fog above the crowded harbor.  烟雾与雾气在拥挤的港口上方交织。

integrate.example: The school works hard to integrate new arrivals into class life.  学校努力让新来者融入班级生活。

intermingle.example: At the fair, tourists and locals intermingled all afternoon.  在集市上，游客和当地人整个下午都混在一起。

separate.example: Please separate the recyclable waste from the ordinary rubbish.  请把可回收垃圾与普通垃圾分开。

isolate.example: Doctors isolated the sick passengers as soon as the ship docked.  船一靠岸，医生就隔离了生病的乘客。

ambiguous.example: The contract's wording is ambiguous and invites future disputes.  合同措辞含义不明，容易引发日后争端。

doubtful.example: It is doubtful whether the bridge can carry such loads.  这座桥能否承受如此重量还很难说。

equivocal.example: The witness gave an equivocal account of that evening.  证人对那晚的叙述模棱两可。

uncertain.example: The date of the meeting remains uncertain until funding is approved.  在资金获批前会议日期仍不确定。

distinct.example: There is a distinct difference between the two dialects.  这两种方言之间有明显差别。

pellucid.example: His pellucid explanation made the theory seem obvious.  他清晰的讲解让这个理论显得浅显易懂。

blatant.example: The report exposed a blatant disregard for safety rules.  报告揭露了对安全规则的公然无视。

explicit.example: She gave explicit instructions about how to store the samples.  她就样品的保存方式给出了明确指示。

lucid.example: The professor offered a lucid summary of a difficult argument.  教授对一个艰深论证做了清晰的总结。

perspicuous.cn: 表述清晰的，明白易懂的
perspicuous.example: His writing is perspicuous even when the topic is technical.  即使话题很专业，他的文章也清晰易懂。

amble.example: We ambled along the river until the sun went down.  我们沿着河边漫步，直到日落。

ramble.example: He rambled on about his childhood for a full hour.  他絮絮叨叨讲了整整一小时童年往事。

saunter.example: He sauntered into the office half an hour late.  他迟到半小时，悠然地走进办公室。

stroll.example: They strolled through the old market after dinner.  晚饭后他们在老市场里闲逛。

wander.example: The child wandered off while his parents were shopping.  孩子在父母购物时走开乱逛。

dally.example: Don't dally on the way home; dinner is almost ready.  回家路上别磨蹭，晚饭快好了。

dawdle.example: She dawdled over her homework until it was nearly midnight.  她做作业拖拖拉拉，一直到近午夜。

step quickly.example: We stepped quickly through the rain toward the waiting taxi.  我们在雨中快步走向等候的出租车。

ambrosial.example: The soup had an ambrosial aroma that filled the whole house.  这汤散发的美妙香气弥漫了整座房子。

savory.example: She served a savory pie made with mushrooms and herbs.  她端上一道用蘑菇和香草做的美味派。

aromatic.example: The kitchen was full of aromatic spices from the market.  厨房里满是从市场买来的芳香香料。

perfumed.example: She wrote the letter on thin perfumed paper.  她用薄薄的香纸写了那封信。

redolent.example: The old room was redolent of pipe smoke and leather.  那间旧屋弥漫着烟斗烟味和皮革气息。

odorous.example: The odorous blossoms attracted bees from the whole valley.  这些散发香气的花朵吸引了整个山谷的蜜蜂。

fetid.example: A fetid smell rose from the blocked drain behind the house.  屋后堵塞的下水道散出恶臭。

noisome.example: Workers refused to enter the noisome tunnel without masks.  工人们不戴口罩不肯进入那条恶臭的隧道。

stenchy.example: The stenchy garbage heap made the whole street unbearable.  臭气熏天的垃圾堆让整条街难以忍受。

malodorous.example: Inspectors traced the malodorous discharge to a nearby factory.  检查人员追查到那股恶臭排放来自附近一家工厂。

rancid.example: The butter had turned rancid after a week in the heat.  黄油在高温下放了一周已经变质发臭。

ameliorate.example: The new subsidy did little to ameliorate rural poverty.  新补贴对改善农村贫困几乎没有作用。

improve.example: Regular practice quickly improved her pronunciation and her confidence.  经常练习很快改善了她的发音和自信。

recuperate.example: He spent two weeks at the coast recuperating from surgery.  他在海边待了两周，从手术中康复。

deteriorate.example: Her health deteriorated sharply during the cold winter.  在寒冷的冬天里她的健康急剧恶化。

damper.example: The rain put a damper on our plans for the picnic.  这场雨给我们的野餐计划泼了冷水。

ss.example: The editor used SS to mark each group of synonyms.  编者用 SS 标记每一组同义词。

docile.example: The old horse was docile enough for beginners to ride.  这匹老马很温顺，初学者也能骑。

submissive.example: She spoke in a submissive tone that surprised her colleagues.  她以顺从的语气说话，令同事惊讶。

tractable.example: The puppy proved surprisingly tractable during the first weeks of training.  这只小狗在最初几周的训练中出乎意料地听话。

obedient.example: The dog sat quietly, obedient to every hand signal.  那只狗安静地坐着，服从每个手势。

contumacious.example: The contumacious witness was fined for defying the judge.  那名抗命的证人因违抗法官而被罚款。

ungovernable.cn: 难以控制的，无法管束的
ungovernable.example: The crowd became ungovernable once the gates were opened.  大门一开，人群就变得无法控制。

unruly.example: Two teachers struggled to calm the unruly class.  两位老师费力地安抚那个不守规矩的班级。

amenity.example: The hotel offers every amenity a business traveler could want.  这家酒店提供商务旅客所需的各种便利设施。

comfort.example: The old chair gave him a great deal of comfort.  那把旧椅子给他带来极大的舒适。

convenience.example: For convenience, we booked a hotel next to the station.  为方便起见，我们订了车站旁的酒店。

affability.example: His affability made even nervous newcomers feel at ease.  他的和蔼可亲让紧张的新人也感到自在。

agreeability.example: The agreeability of the host made the long dinner pleasant.  主人的随和让这场长餐变得愉快。

harmony.example: The two communities have lived in harmony for generations.  这两个社区世代和睦相处。

accord.example: His actions were in accord with the policy he announced.  他的行动与他宣布的政策一致。

concord.example: The treaty brought decades of concord between the two states.  该条约给两国带来数十年的和睦。

consonance.example: Her behavior was in consonance with her stated beliefs.  她的行为与她宣称的信念一致。

discordance.example: There is a clear discordance between the two witnesses' accounts.  两位证人的叙述之间存在明显不一致。

inharmony.example: Growing inharmony among members finally split the committee.  成员间日增的不和最终分裂了委员会。

amiable.cn: 好脾气的，友好易相处的
amiable.example: Our amiable guide answered the same question a dozen times.  我们和气的导游把同一个问题回答了十几遍。

friendly.example: The shopkeeper was friendly and remembered every regular customer.  店主很友好，记得每位常客。

amicable.example: The dispute ended in an amicable agreement between neighbors.  这场纠纷以邻里间的友好协议告终。

easy to get along with.example: My new roommate is quiet and easy to get along with.  我的新室友安静又好相处。

disagreeable.example: Cleaning the drains was a thoroughly disagreeable job.  清理下水道是件极其讨人厌的活儿。

ill-natured.example: His ill-natured comments about her work upset everyone at the meeting.  他对她工作的恶意评论让会上每个人都很不快。

ungracious.example: It seemed ungracious to refuse such a generous offer.  拒绝如此大方的提议似乎显得无礼。

unpleasant.example: There was an unpleasant smell coming from the basement.  地下室传来一股难闻的气味。

antagonistic.example: The union was openly antagonistic to the new management.  工会对新管理层公开敌对。

hostile.example: The audience turned hostile as soon as he raised taxes.  他一提加税，观众立刻变得充满敌意。

unfriendly.example: The waiter gave us an unfriendly look and walked away.  服务员不友好地看了我们一眼便走开了。

amity.example: The two nations signed a treaty of amity and commerce.  两国签署了友好通商条约。

friendship.example: Their friendship survived twenty years and three continents.  他们的友谊经历了二十年和三大洲的考验。

enmity.example: Old enmity between the families still poisons village life.  两家的旧仇至今仍毒害着村里的生活。

hostility.example: The plan met with open hostility from local residents.  该计划遭到当地居民的公开敌视。

man errs so long as he strives.cn: 人只要奋斗，就会犯错（歌德语）
man errs so long as he strives.example: He quoted Goethe: man errs so long as he strives.  他引用歌德的话：人只要奋斗，就会犯错。

——.cn: 破折号（引出解释或出处）
——.example: The quotation ends with a dash —— followed by the author's name.  引文以破折号结束，后面跟着作者姓名。

manerrssolongashestrives.cn: 人只要奋斗就难免犯错（原书粘连文本）
manerrssolongashestrives.ipa: ˈmæn ɜrz soʊ ˈlɔŋ æz hi ˈstraɪvz
manerrssolongashestrives.example: The Manerrs-so-long line comes from a famous quotation printed without spaces.  Manerrs-so-long 这一行出自一句名言，原书把它印成了没有空格的一串。

amorphous.example: The fog formed an amorphous grey mass over the harbor at dawn.  黎明时，雾在港口上方形成一团无定形的灰色。

shapeless.cn: 无固定形状的，不成形的
shapeless.example: He wore a shapeless coat that hid his figure completely.  他穿着一件不成形的外套，完全遮住了身形。

unformed.cn: 未成形的，未发育完全的
unformed.example: Her plan was still unformed when the meeting began.  会议开始时她的计划还没有成形。

unshaped.example: The sculptor stared at the unshaped marble for a long time.  雕塑家久久凝视着那块未加工的大理石。

anodyne.example: The spokesman gave anodyne answers that offended nobody at all.  发言人给出的回答不痛不痒，谁也没得罪。

harmless.cn: 无害的，不会造成伤害的
harmless.example: The snake looks frightening but is completely harmless to humans.  这条蛇看起来可怕，但对人完全无害。

benign.example: The change in policy proved benign for most small farmers.  事实证明，政策变化对大多数小农户是无害的。

innocuous.example: What seemed an innocuous question turned out to reveal her deepest secret.  看似无恶意的问题最终却揭露了她最深的秘密。

inoffensive.example: The film is bland but inoffensive enough for family viewing.  这部电影平淡，但足够温和，适合全家观看。

adverse.example: The drug had adverse effects on several elderly patients.  这种药对几位老年病人产生了不良影响。

baleful.example: His baleful influence on the young players worried the coach.  他对年轻球员的有害影响让教练担忧。

baneful.example: Gossip had a baneful effect on the whole department.  流言对整个部门产生了有害的影响。

deleterious.example: Long night shifts had a deleterious effect on the nurses' health.  长期夜班对护士们的健康产生了有害影响。

detrimental.example: Too much screen time is detrimental to a child's eyesight.  过多看屏幕对孩子的视力有害。

nocuous.example: Factory chimneys released nocuous gases into the evening air.  工厂烟囱把有害气体排入夜晚的空气中。

pernicious.example: A pernicious rumor about the school spread quickly through the town.  一则关于学校的极有害谣言迅速在镇上传开。

anarchist.example: The young anarchist refused to recognize any form of state authority.  这位年轻的无政府主义者拒绝承认任何形式的国家权力。
anarchist.cn: 无政府主义者；反抗权威的人

chaos.example: The power cut threw the whole airport into chaos.  停电让整个机场陷入混乱。
