disarray.example: The office was in complete disarray after the movers left boxes everywhere.  搬运工把箱子扔得到处都是，办公室一片混乱。

topsy-turviness.example: The topsy-turviness of the new office confused every visitor.  新办公室的杂乱无序让每位来访者都很困惑。

commotion.example: The escaped goat caused quite a commotion in the market.  逃跑的山羊在市场上引起一阵不小的骚动。

turmoil.example: The country remained in political turmoil for nearly a decade.  这个国家在近十年里一直处于政治动荡之中。

order.example: Police worked all night to restore order in the city.  警察通宵工作以恢复城市的秩序。

anathema.example: Compromise of any kind was anathema to the older party leaders.  任何形式的妥协都是老一辈党内领袖极为厌恶之事。

abhorrence.example: She spoke of her abhorrence of cruelty to animals.  她谈到自己对虐待动物的憎恶。

abomination.example: Critics called the new tower an abomination on the skyline.  批评者称这座新塔是天际线上的可憎之物。

detestation.example: His detestation of dishonesty made him a difficult colleague.  他对不诚实的憎恶使他成了难相处的同事。

execration.example: The traitor's name became a term of execration in his village.  叛徒的名字在村里成了咒骂的代名词。

ancillary.example: The hospital also provides ancillary services such as laundry and catering.  医院还提供洗衣和餐饮等辅助性服务。

subordinate.example: She refused to accept a subordinate role in the research project.  她不愿在研究项目中接受次要的角色。

subsidiary.example: The company sold its subsidiary business to focus on core products.  公司出售了其附属业务，以专注于核心产品。

auxiliary.example: The hospital switched to an auxiliary generator during the storm.  暴风雨中医院切换到了备用发电机。

paramount.example: Safety is paramount when workers handle these highly flammable chemicals.  工人处理这些极易燃的化学品时，安全最为重要。

anecdote.example: He opened the lecture with a funny anecdote about his first job.  他用一个关于自己第一份工作的有趣段子开场。

anemic.example: Sales growth was anemic despite the expensive advertising campaign.  尽管广告投入巨大，销售增长依然疲弱。

sapless.example: The old comedian gave a sapless performance that bored everyone.  这位老喜剧演员的表演毫无生气，让所有人都很无聊。

infirm.example: Her grandmother grew too infirm to climb the stairs without help.  她的祖母身体太虚弱，没人帮忙就爬不了楼梯。

feeble.example: The old man answered in a feeble voice from the bed.  老人从床上用微弱的声音回答。

decrepit.example: They lived for years in a decrepit house with no running water.  他们在一栋没有自来水的破旧房子里住了多年。

wan.example: She gave us a wan smile and went back to bed.  她苍白无力地笑了一下，又回床上躺着了。

pale.example: She turned pale when she heard the bad news.  听到坏消息时她脸色发白。

pallid.example: The remake was a pallid imitation of a far livelier original.  这部翻拍片是对一部活力十足的原作的毫无生气的模仿。

effete.example: An effete aristocracy clung to its titles long after the wealth had vanished.  衰落的贵族阶层在财富早已消失后仍死守头衔。

lethargic.example: The heat left everyone lethargic and unwilling to move before evening.  酷热让所有人都没精打采，天黑前都不愿动。

spirited.example: The candidates held a spirited debate about tax policy.  候选人就税收政策展开了热烈的辩论。

anesthetic.example: The dentist gave her a local anesthetic before drilling the tooth.  牙医在钻牙之前给她做了局部麻醉。

sensate.example: Philosophers debate whether all sensate creatures deserve legal protection.  哲学家们争论是否所有有感觉的生物都应受法律保护。

animate.example: A few well-chosen questions can animate an otherwise dull discussion.  几个精心挑选的问题就能让本来沉闷的讨论活跃起来。
animate.cn: 使有生气，激励；有活力的

bouncing.cn: 活泼健康的，精力充沛的
bouncing.example: She gave birth to a bouncing baby boy last spring.  去年春天她生下一个健康活泼的男婴。

brisk.example: A brisk walk before breakfast leaves me alert all morning.  早餐前快走一趟能让我整个上午都很清醒。

sprightly.example: A sprightly old man led the hikers up the steep mountain path.  一位活泼的老人带着徒步者爬上陡峭的山路。

vivacious.example: Her vivacious manner made every stranger feel welcome at the table.  她活泼的举止让每个陌生人在餐桌旁都感到受欢迎。

brace.example: A cup of hot tea braced him for the long night.  一杯热茶让他为漫长的夜晚振作起来。

energize.example: The new coach energized a team that had lost hope.  新教练让失去希望的球队重新振奋起来。

enliven.example: Her jokes enlivened an otherwise dull afternoon meeting.  她的玩笑让本来沉闷的下午会议活跃起来。

invigorate.example: A short walk in cold air always invigorates my tired mind.  在冷空气中短暂散步总能让我疲惫的头脑重新振作。

ginger.example: The director gingered up the second act with live music.  导演用现场音乐让第二幕更有活力。

inactive.example: The volcano has been inactive for over two hundred years.  这座火山已有两百多年没有活动。

lackadaisical.example: His lackadaisical attitude toward homework worried both parents.  他对作业懒散的态度让父母都很担心。

languid.example: A languid summer afternoon passed with nobody willing to leave the shade.  一个慢悠悠的夏日午后过去了，没人愿意离开树荫。

listless.example: The fever left her listless for nearly a week.  发烧让她将近一周都无精打采。

leaden.cn: 沉重的，无生气的；铅灰的
leaden.example: He walked home with leaden steps after the painful defeat.  痛苦的失败后，他步履沉重地走回家。

damp.example: The rain did not damp our enthusiasm for the trip.  下雨并没有打消我们对这次旅行的热情。

dampen.example: Losing the first game did nothing to dampen the team's spirits.  首场失利丝毫没有打击球队的士气。

deaden.example: Thick carpets deaden the sound of footsteps upstairs.  厚地毯减弱了楼上的脚步声。

lassitude.example: A strange lassitude kept him in bed all afternoon.  一种奇怪的倦怠让他整个下午都躺在床上。

lethargy.example: A short walk helped him shake off his afternoon lethargy.  短短的散步帮他摆脱了午后的倦怠。

animus.example: His criticism seemed driven by personal animus rather than honest doubt.  他的批评似乎出于个人敌意，而非真诚的质疑。

animosity.example: Years of competition bred real animosity between the two families.  多年的竞争在两家之间催生了真正的敌意。

antagonism.example: There was open antagonism between the manager and his staff.  经理与员工之间存在公开的敌对。

rancor.example: She described the long dispute without any rancor toward her opponents.  她讲述这场长期争端时对对手毫无怨恨。

friendliness.example: The villagers treated every stranger with genuine friendliness.  村民们以真诚的友好对待每一个陌生人。

annoy.example: The barking dog began to annoy every neighbor on the quiet street.  那只不停犬吠的狗开始烦扰这条安静街上的每位邻居。

gall.example: His smug tone galled everyone sitting around the conference table.  他自鸣得意的语气激怒了围坐在会议桌旁的每个人。

grate.example: Her constant humming began to grate on everyone in the small office.  她不停的哼唱开始让小办公室里的每个人心烦。

irk.example: His habit of humming while working irked everyone in the office.  他工作时哼歌的习惯使办公室里所有人都很厌烦。

nettle.example: She was clearly nettled by the reporter's rude question.  记者无礼的提问显然惹恼了她。

peeve.example: Loud phone conversations on the train really peeve the other passengers.  火车上大声打电话确实惹恼其他乘客。

pique.example: The strange title piqued her curiosity, so she borrowed the book.  奇怪的书名激起了她的好奇心，于是她借走了那本书。

rile.example: Nothing riles him more than being interrupted in the middle of a sentence.  没有什么比话说到一半被打断更让他恼火。

ruffle.example: A single rude question was enough to ruffle the normally calm witness.  一个无礼的问题就足以扰乱这位平素冷静的证人。

spite.example: He broke the toy out of spite after losing the game.  输了游戏后，他出于恶意弄坏了玩具。

vex.example: Constant interruptions vexed the teacher throughout the long afternoon lesson.  不断的打扰让老师在漫长的下午课上十分恼怒。

defuse.example: A quiet apology defused the quarrel before it could grow worse.  一句平静的道歉在争吵恶化之前化解了它。

propitiate.example: Villagers offered rice and flowers to propitiate the mountain spirits.  村民献上米和花来抚慰山神。

appease.example: The company offered refunds to appease its angry customers.  公司提供退款以安抚愤怒的顾客。

pacify.example: The nurse sang softly to pacify the frightened child before the injection.  打针前，护士轻声唱歌安抚受惊的孩子。

placate.example: The company offered full refunds to placate its angriest customers.  公司提供全额退款以平息最愤怒的客户。

settle.example: The two sides finally settled their dispute out of court.  双方最终在庭外解决了争端。

subdue.example: Government forces moved south to subdue the rebellion within a week.  政府军南下，一周内镇压了叛乱。

solace.example: She found solace in music during the long months of her illness.  在漫长的病中，她在音乐里找到安慰。

annul.example: The court agreed to annul the marriage after only three weeks.  法院同意在仅仅三周之后宣告这段婚姻无效。

cancel.example: They canceled the outdoor concert because of the heavy rain.  因为大雨，他们取消了露天音乐会。

repeal.example: Lawmakers voted to repeal the outdated statute that had confused courts for decades.  议员们投票废除了这部困扰法院数十年的过时法规。

make legal.example: New rules would make legal the sale of raw milk here.  新规定将使这里出售生牛奶变得合法。

atypical.example: This is an atypical response to a very common medicine.  这是对一种常用药物的非典型反应。

phenomenal.example: Her first novel enjoyed phenomenal success in a dozen countries.  她的第一部小说在十几个国家取得了非凡的成功。

unexceptional.example: The restaurant serves decent but unexceptional Italian food.  这家餐厅的意大利菜不错，但平淡无奇。

unextraordinary.example: He led a quiet, unextraordinary life in a small town.  他在一个小镇过着平静普通的一生。

anonymous.example: An anonymous donor gave the library enough money for a new wing.  一位匿名捐赠者给图书馆捐了足够建一座新翼楼的钱。

incognito.example: The famous singer traveled incognito to avoid the reporters.  这位著名歌手隐姓埋名出行以避开记者。

innominate.example: The poem survives from an innominate medieval writer.  这首诗出自一位无名的中世纪作者。

unnamed.example: An unnamed official confirmed the story to reporters yesterday.  一位未透露姓名的官员昨天向记者确认了此事。

unidentified.cn: 身份不明的，未被识别的
unidentified.example: Police are searching for an unidentified man seen near the scene.  警方正在寻找一名在现场附近出现的身份不明男子。

untitled.example: The gallery displayed an untitled painting from his early years.  画廊展出了他早年的一幅无题画作。

dubbed.cn: 被称为，被起绰号的；配音的
dubbed.example: Fans dubbed him the king of late-night television.  粉丝称他为深夜电视之王。

named.example: A girl named Mei won the national spelling contest.  一个名叫梅的女孩赢得了全国拼写比赛。

termed.example: The disorder is now termed chronic fatigue syndrome by doctors.  医生现在把这种病称为慢性疲劳综合征。

antagonize.example: He was careful not to antagonize the allies he still needed.  他小心地避免与仍然需要的盟友为敌。

counteract.example: Exercise can counteract some effects of a poor diet.  运动可以抵消不良饮食的部分影响。

disagree.example: Two experts openly disagreed about the cause of the accident.  两位专家对事故原因公开表示分歧。

exasperate.example: His constant lateness exasperated even the most patient teachers.  他总是迟到，连最有耐心的老师都被激怒了。

inflame.example: The mayor's careless comments only inflamed public anger over the housing shortage.  市长轻率的言论只是加剧了公众对住房短缺的愤怒。

provoke.example: His careless remark provoked an angry response from the whole audience.  他不慎的言论激起了全体观众的愤怒回应。

irritate.example: Loud advertisements before every video irritate most of our customers.  每个视频前的大声广告让我们大多数客户感到恼火。

roil.example: The careless remarks of the mayor roiled the crowd outside the courthouse.  市长轻率的言论激怒了法院外的人群。

agree.example: Both sides finally agreed to the new safety rules.  双方最终同意了新的安全规定。

concede.example: She finally conceded that her opponent had made a fair point.  她最终承认对手说得有道理。

grant.example: I grant that the plan has some obvious weaknesses.  我承认这个计划有些明显的弱点。

antediluvian.example: His antediluvian views on marriage shocked the younger guests.  他对婚姻的陈腐观念让年轻的客人们大为震惊。

aged.example: The aged oak still shades the whole courtyard in summer.  这棵老橡树夏天仍能荫蔽整个庭院。

age-old.example: Making paper by hand is an age-old craft here.  手工造纸在这里是一门古老的技艺。

prehistoric.example: Archaeologists found prehistoric tools beside the dried riverbed.  考古学家在干涸的河床旁发现了史前工具。

antique.example: She collects antique clocks that were made in nineteenth-century France.  她收集在十九世纪法国制造的古董钟。

immemorial.example: Farmers here have shared the same well from time immemorial.  自远古以来，这里的农民一直共用同一口井。

modern.example: Modern phones can do far more than early computers could.  现代手机的功能远超早期的计算机。

new.example: They moved into a new apartment near the river.  他们搬进了河边一套新公寓。

recent.example: Recent studies suggest that short naps improve memory.  最近的研究表明小睡能改善记忆。

anterior.example: The surgeon examined the anterior surface of the injured knee.  外科医生检查了受伤膝盖的前侧表面。

antecedent.example: Historians study the antecedent causes of the revolution.  历史学家研究这场革命的先前起因。

foregoing.example: The foregoing chapters explain how the system was built.  前面几章解释了这个系统是如何建立的。

former.example: Our former neighbor now runs a bakery downtown.  我们从前的邻居现在在市中心开面包店。

forward.example: He leaned forward to hear the quiet speaker better.  他向前倾身以便听清声音轻的讲话者。

precedent.example: The court's ruling set a precedent for all similar cases.  法院的裁决为所有类似案件开创了先例。

preceding.example: Read the preceding paragraph again before you answer.  回答之前请再读一遍前面那段。

prior.example: No prior knowledge of coding is needed for this course.  这门课不需要任何先前的编程知识。

after.example: We talked for hours after the long dinner ended.  漫长的晚餐结束后我们聊了几个小时。

ensuing.example: In the ensuing panic, several passengers lost their luggage.  在随后的慌乱中，几位乘客丢了行李。

following.example: The following day brought heavy snow and closed roads.  第二天下了大雪，道路封闭。

posterior.example: The muscle attaches to the posterior part of the bone.  这块肌肉附着在骨头的后部。

subsequent.example: Subsequent tests confirmed what the first sample had suggested.  后来的检测证实了第一份样本的提示。

succeeding.example: Succeeding generations kept the family recipe almost unchanged.  后世几代人几乎原样保留了这份家传食谱。

antic.example: His antic gestures on stage made the whole audience laugh.  他在台上滑稽可笑的动作让全场观众大笑。

chucklesome.example: His chucklesome stories kept the whole table laughing.  他惹人发笑的故事让整桌人笑不停。

comedic.example: The actor has real comedic talent and perfect timing.  这位演员有真正的喜剧天赋和完美的节奏。

comic.example: The clumsy servant provides comic relief in the play.  笨拙的仆人在剧中起到喜剧调剂的作用。

droll.example: He told the whole story with a droll expression.  他带着古怪好笑的表情讲了整个故事。

farcical.example: The meeting became farcical when nobody could find the agenda.  没人找得到议程，会议变得荒唐可笑。

laughable.example: Their offer was so low that it seemed laughable.  他们的报价低得可笑。

hilarious.example: His story about the runaway goat was absolutely hilarious.  他讲的那只逃跑山羊的故事实在太好笑了。

humorless.example: Her humorless boss never laughed at any office joke.  她那毫无幽默感的老板从不为办公室笑话发笑。

unamusing.example: The comedian's unamusing routine emptied half the room.  这位喜剧演员不好笑的段子让半屋人都走了。

uncomic.example: His uncomic delivery made the funny script fall flat.  他毫不滑稽的表达让搞笑剧本变得平淡。

unfunny.example: The audience sat silent through his unfunny opening joke.  观众在他不好笑的开场玩笑中沉默不语。

unhumorous.example: The lecture was accurate but completely unhumorous and dry.  这场讲座准确，但毫无幽默、十分枯燥。

apathy.example: Widespread apathy among young voters worried the campaign organizers.  年轻选民中普遍的冷漠让竞选组织者担忧。

disinterestedness.example: His apparent disinterestedness hid a very strong personal ambition.  他表面的漠不关心掩藏着极强的个人野心。

disregard.example: Their total disregard for safety rules eventually caused a serious accident.  他们完全不顾安全规定，最终造成了一起严重事故。

incuriosity.example: Her incuriosity about other cultures surprised her traveling companions.  她对其他文化缺乏好奇，令旅伴们惊讶。

insouciance.example: He answered the criticism with complete insouciance and a shrug.  他满不在乎地耸耸肩回应批评。

nonchalance.example: She accepted the important award with surprising nonchalance.  她以出人意料的淡然接受了这个重要奖项。

unconcern.example: His unconcern about the deadline annoyed the whole team.  他对截止日期的漠不关心让整个团队恼火。

concern.example: Parents expressed concern about the safety of the playground.  家长们对操场的安全表示关心。

interest.example: She lost interest in the project after only a month.  仅一个月后她就对这个项目失去了兴趣。

regard.example: He drives fast with little regard for other people.  他开车很快，几乎不顾及他人。

aphorism.example: She ended every letter with the same well-worn aphorism about patience.  她每封信都以同一句关于耐心的老套格言结尾。

adage.example: The old adage says that haste often makes waste.  老话说，欲速则不达。

epigram.example: A witty epigram at the end of the essay made everyone smile.  文章末尾一句机智的警句让所有人都笑了。

maxim.example: Her favorite maxim was that practice always beats talent.  她最喜欢的格言是勤奋胜于天赋。

proverb.example: A Chinese proverb warns against judging people by appearance.  一句中国谚语告诫不要以外貌评判他人。

apocalyptic.example: The film paints an apocalyptic picture of a world without water.  这部电影描绘了一个没有水的末日世界景象。

prophetic.example: His warnings about the flood proved strangely prophetic a year later.  他关于洪水的警告一年后显得出奇地有预言性。

predictive.example: The model has strong predictive power for winter storms.  这个模型对冬季风暴有很强的预测能力。

prognostic.example: Doctors watch several prognostic signs before making a judgment.  医生在做判断前会观察几项预兆性指标。

farsighted.example: The mayor's farsighted planning saved the city millions later.  市长有远见的规划后来为城市省下数百万。

trivial.example: The editor refused to argue over such a trivial difference in wording.  编辑不愿为措辞上如此无足轻重的差别争论。

petty.example: He wasted the meeting on petty complaints about parking spaces.  他把会议浪费在关于停车位的琐碎抱怨上。

minor.example: Only minor repairs were needed after the small accident.  小事故后只需要一些小修理。

immaterial.example: Whether he liked the plan is immaterial to the legal question here.  他是否喜欢这个计划与这里的法律问题无关。

inconsequential.example: The difference between the two prices is quite inconsequential.  两个价格之间的差别微不足道。

insignificant.cn: 无关紧要的，微不足道的
insignificant.example: An insignificant error early on ruined the entire calculation.  早期一个微不足道的错误毁了整个计算。

apocryphal.example: The story about his childhood is almost certainly apocryphal.  关于他童年的那个故事几乎肯定是假的。

spurious.example: The website spread spurious claims about the new vaccine.  该网站传播关于新疫苗的虚假说法。

unauthentic.example: Experts declared the painting unauthentic after careful chemical testing.  专家经仔细化学检测后宣布这幅画并非真品。

ungenuine.example: Her ungenuine praise made everyone at the table uncomfortable.  她虚假的赞美让桌上每个人都不舒服。

factual.example: The report gives a factual account of the whole accident.  这份报告对整起事故做了真实的叙述。

true.example: The film is based on a true story from wartime.  这部电影取材于战时的一个真实故事。

truthful.example: Give me a truthful answer about where you were.  告诉我你当时在哪里，要说实话。

authentic.example: The museum confirmed the letter was an authentic original.  博物馆确认这封信是真实的原件。

apoplectic.example: The manager was apoplectic when he saw the damage.  经理看到损坏时暴跳如雷。

choleric.example: His choleric temper frightened every new employee in the office.  他暴躁的脾气让办公室里每个新员工都害怕。

enraged.example: The enraged customer demanded to speak with the owner.  愤怒的顾客要求与老板对话。

furious.example: She was furious when the airline lost her luggage.  航空公司丢了她的行李，她怒不可遏。

incensed.example: Residents were incensed by the sudden rise in rent.  居民对房租骤涨极为愤怒。

indignant.example: Teachers were indignant about the unfair new grading rules.  老师们对不公平的新评分规定感到愤慨。

infuriated.example: Fans were infuriated when the concert was canceled again.  演唱会再次取消，粉丝们十分愤怒。

irate.example: An irate customer demanded to speak with the manager immediately.  一位极其愤怒的顾客要求立刻与经理谈话。

ireful.example: The old man gave an ireful look at the noisy boys.  老人愤怒地看了一眼那些吵闹的男孩。

outraged.example: Readers were outraged by the newspaper's careless headline.  读者对报纸草率的标题感到愤慨。

angerless.example: His angerless response to the insult surprised everyone present.  他对侮辱毫无怒气的回应让在场的人都惊讶。

delighted.example: She was delighted to hear about her friend's promotion.  听说朋友升职，她非常高兴。

pleased.example: The teacher looked pleased with our group presentation.  老师对我们的小组展示看起来很满意。

apostasy.example: The priest was accused of apostasy and expelled from the order.  这位神父被指控背弃信仰，并被逐出教团。

defection.example: His defection to a rival party shocked old supporters.  他投向对手党派震惊了老支持者。

perfidy.example: The perfidy of the general cost the alliance both territory and trust.  那位将军的背信弃义使联盟失去了领土和信任。

treacherousness.example: The treacherousness of his closest adviser destroyed the king's trust in everyone.  他最亲近顾问的背信弃义摧毁了国王对所有人的信任。

recreancy.example: The knight's recreancy in battle disgraced his whole family.  这位骑士战场上的背信让全家蒙羞。

fidelity.example: His fidelity to the promise surprised everyone who knew him.  他对诺言的忠诚让所有认识他的人都感到意外。

loyalty.example: Years of loyalty finally earned him the manager's trust.  多年的忠诚终于赢得了经理的信任。

appall.example: The violence in the film seemed to appall even veteran critics.  影片中的暴力似乎连资深影评人都感到惊恐。

dismay.example: The abrupt policy reversal dismayed his supporters and delighted his rivals.  政策的突然反转让他的支持者沮丧，让对手高兴。

terrify.example: Loud thunder terrifies our dog every single summer night.  响雷每个夏夜都让我们的狗害怕。

intimidate.example: The defendant's friends tried to intimidate the witness before the trial began.  被告的朋友试图在审判开始前威吓证人。

frighten.example: A loud noise frightened the horses into the open field.  一声巨响把马惊到了空旷的田里。

horrify.example: The graphic images in the documentary horrified many viewers.  纪录片中的血腥画面令许多观众震惊。

daunt.example: The steep climb ahead did not daunt the experienced mountain guide.  前方陡峭的攀登丝毫没有吓倒这位经验丰富的山地导游。

deter.example: Better street lighting may deter thieves from working in this neighborhood.  更好的街道照明或许能威慑小偷不在这一带作案。

encourage.example: Good teachers encourage students to ask difficult questions.  好老师鼓励学生提出有难度的问题。

nerve.example: He lost his nerve at the last moment and never asked the question.  他在最后一刻失去了勇气，始终没有问出那个问题。

appeal.example: Her lawyers will file an appeal against the verdict next week.  她的律师下周将针对判决提出上诉。

adjuration.example: Despite his father's earnest adjuration, the boy left home anyway.  尽管父亲郑重恳求，男孩还是离家了。

conjuration.example: The letter closed with a solemn conjuration to keep the family secret.  这封信以郑重恳求保守家族秘密作结。

entreaty.example: She ignored his desperate entreaties and closed the door firmly.  她无视他绝望的恳求，坚决关上了门。

petition.example: Thousands signed the petition to save the old public library.  数千人签署请愿书，要求保住这座旧的公共图书馆。

pleading.example: He looked at her with pleading eyes but said nothing.  他用恳求的眼神看着她，却什么也没说。

supplication.example: The pilgrims knelt in silent supplication before the ancient shrine.  朝圣者在古老神殿前默默跪地祈求。

charge.example: The prosecutor charged him with fraud after months of investigation.  经过数月调查，检察官指控他欺诈。

accuse.example: They accused the manager of hiding the company's real losses.  他们指控经理隐瞒公司的真实亏损。

inculpate.example: The forged letter was used to inculpate a loyal officer.  那封伪造的信被用来归罪于一名忠诚的军官。

indict.example: A grand jury indicted the mayor for taking bribes last year.  大陪审团去年起诉了这位市长受贿。

appealing.example: The company made an appealing offer that she could hardly refuse.  公司提出了一个她几乎无法拒绝的诱人条件。

alluring.example: The alluring aroma of fresh bread drew us into the bakery.  新鲜面包诱人的香气把我们引进了面包店。

captivating.example: Her captivating voice held the entire audience in complete silence.  她迷人的歌声让全场观众鸦雀无声。

charismatic.example: The charismatic speaker convinced thousands to join his new movement.  这位有魅力的演讲者说服数千人加入他的新运动。

charming.example: We spent the afternoon in a charming village by the lake.  我们在湖边一个迷人的村庄度过了下午。

enchanting.example: The garden looked enchanting under the soft light of lanterns.  花园在灯笼柔和的光线下显得十分迷人。

engaging.cn: 有吸引力的，讨人喜欢的
engaging.example: His engaging manner made strangers feel comfortable within minutes.  他讨人喜欢的举止让陌生人几分钟内就放松下来。

entrancing.cn: 令人入迷的，使人陶醉的
entrancing.example: The dancer's entrancing movements kept every eye fixed on the stage.  舞者令人入迷的动作让所有目光都盯着舞台。

luring.example: Advertisers use luring images to make ordinary products seem exciting.  广告商用诱人的图片让普通产品显得令人兴奋。

seductive.example: The idea of easy money is seductive but usually dangerous.  轻松赚钱的想法很诱人，但通常很危险。

repellent.example: I found his arrogant remarks utterly repellent and left early.  我觉得他傲慢的言论令人极其厌恶，于是提前离开。

repelling.cn: 令人反感的，令人厌恶的
repelling.example: The swamp gave off a repelling smell of rotting plants.  沼泽散发出腐烂植物令人厌恶的气味。

repugnant.example: Most readers found the cruelty of that character morally repugnant and unforgivable.  多数读者觉得那个角色的残忍在道德上令人厌恶，不可宽恕。

repulsive.example: The rotting fish on the beach was absolutely repulsive.  沙滩上腐烂的鱼令人极其恶心。

unalluring.example: The cold, unalluring meal sat untouched on the plastic tray.  那份冰冷、毫无吸引力的饭菜在塑料托盘上没人动过。

acclamation.example: The new chairman was chosen by acclamation without a formal vote.  新主席在没有正式投票的情况下以欢呼方式选出。

cheer.example: A loud cheer rose from the crowd when the goal was scored.  进球时人群中响起一阵响亮的欢呼。

cheering.example: The cheering fans waited outside the stadium for two hours.  欢呼的球迷在体育场外等了两个小时。

ovation.example: The soprano received a standing ovation after her final aria.  女高音唱完最后一首咏叹调后获得全场起立鼓掌。

plaudit.example: Her debut novel earned plaudits from critics across the country.  她的处女作小说赢得全国评论家的赞誉。

rave.example: Critics raved about the film for weeks after its quiet premiere.  影片低调首映后，评论家连续数周对它赞不绝口。

hissing.cn: 嘘声，喝倒彩；发嘶嘶声的
hissing.example: The speaker continued despite loud hissing from the back rows.  尽管后排传来响亮的嘘声，演讲者仍继续讲。

booing.example: The team left the field to booing from angry supporters.  球队在愤怒球迷的喝倒彩声中离场。

apposite.example: She made one apposite comment that settled the whole argument.  她一句恰当的评论就平息了整场争论。

applicable.example: This rule is applicable to all students regardless of their year.  这条规定适用于所有学生，不论他们是哪个年级。

apropos.example: Apropos of nothing, he asked whether I had ever been to Rome.  他毫无来由地问我是否去过罗马。

germane.example: Her question was germane to the discussion and changed our plan.  她的问题与讨论密切相关，改变了我们的计划。

pointed.example: She asked a pointed question that the minister could not answer.  她提出了一个部长无法回答的尖锐问题。

relative.example: Comfort is relative and depends largely on what you expect.  舒适是相对的，很大程度上取决于你的期望。

relevant.example: The judge ruled that the old letters were relevant to the case.  法官裁定那些旧信件与本案有关。

irrelevant.example: The lawyer objected because the question was completely irrelevant here.  律师提出反对，因为这个问题在此完全无关。

impertinent.example: The lawyer objected that the question was impertinent to the charges.  律师反对说，这个问题与指控无关。
impertinent.cn: 不相关的；无礼的，鲁莽的

irrelative.example: He dismissed the data as irrelative to his central argument.  他认为这些数据与他的核心论点无关。

pointless.example: Arguing with him about politics is completely pointless and exhausting.  和他争论政治完全没有意义，而且很累。

appreciable.example: There is no appreciable difference between these two brands of paint.  这两个牌子的油漆之间没有明显的差别。

perceptible.example: There was a barely perceptible change in her tone of voice.  她的语调有一丝几乎察觉不到的变化。

detectable.example: The new sensor finds detectable traces of gas within seconds.  新传感器几秒内就能发现可检测到的气体痕迹。

discernible.example: There was no discernible improvement after three weeks of treatment.  治疗三周后没有可察觉的改善。

palpable.example: A palpable tension filled the room as the verdict was read aloud.  宣读判决时，房间里弥漫着明显的紧张气氛。

distinguishable.example: The twins are barely distinguishable except for a small scar.  这对双胞胎除了一道小疤几乎无法区分。

impalpable.example: A faint, impalpable tension hung over the negotiating table.  谈判桌上笼罩着一种难以察觉的紧张气氛。

imperceptible.example: The change in temperature was almost imperceptible to the guests.  客人几乎察觉不到温度的变化。

inappreciable.cn: 微不足道的，感觉不到的
inappreciable.example: The risk from such a tiny dose is inappreciable.  如此微小剂量带来的风险微不足道。

indistinguishable.cn: 无法区分的，难以辨别的
indistinguishable.example: The copy was almost indistinguishable from the original painting.  这份复制品与原画几乎无法区分。

undetectable.cn: 无法检测到的，察觉不到的
undetectable.example: The virus remained undetectable in blood tests for several weeks.  这种病毒在血液检测中数周都无法检出。

apprise.example: Please apprise him of the risks before he signs the contract.  请在他签合同之前告知他风险。

inform.example: Please inform me as soon as the results become available.  结果一出来请立刻通知我。

acquaint.example: New employees must acquaint themselves with the safety procedures first.  新员工必须先熟悉安全流程。

make known to.example: The decision was made known to the staff on Monday.  这个决定于周一告知全体员工。

withhold information.example: The company was fined for withholding information from the regulators.  公司因向监管机构隐瞒信息而被罚款。

approbation.example: The plan finally won the approbation of the whole city council.  该计划最终获得了整个市议会的同意。

approval.example: The plan needs approval from the board before work begins.  该计划开工前需要董事会批准。

favor.example: The proposal quickly won favor among the younger members.  这项提议很快赢得年轻成员的支持。

disapproval.example: Her father showed clear disapproval of the hasty marriage.  她父亲明确表示不赞成这桩仓促的婚事。

disfavor.example: The old method gradually fell into disfavor among researchers.  这种旧方法逐渐不受研究者青睐。

appropriate.example: Officials were accused of appropriating public money for private use.  官员们被指控将公款挪为私用。

purloin.example: The clerk managed to purloin a secret document from the locked cabinet.  那名职员设法从上锁的柜子里偷走了一份密件。

pirate.example: The company sued several websites for pirating its accounting software.  该公司起诉了几家盗版其会计软件的网站。

embezzle.example: The accountant embezzled company funds for nearly six years without detection.  这名会计挪用公司资金近六年而未被发现。

peculate.example: The treasurer was jailed for peculating funds over many years.  财务主管因多年盗用公款而入狱。

apt.example: That is an apt description of how the meeting actually went.  那是对会议实际情况的一个恰当描述。

becoming.example: Her modest reply was becoming in such a formal setting.  在如此正式的场合，她谦逊的回答很得体。

felicitous.example: The title is a felicitous choice for such a book.  这个书名对这样一本书来说是贴切的选择。

fitting.example: The quiet ceremony was a fitting end to his career.  这场安静的仪式为他的职业生涯做了恰当的收尾。

proper.example: Please store the samples in the proper containers.  请把样本存放在合适的容器里。

meet.example: A public apology seemed the only meet response to such a serious blunder.  公开道歉似乎是对如此严重失误唯一合适的回应。

suitable.example: This film is not suitable for very young children.  这部影片不适合幼儿观看。

improper.example: He was dismissed for improper conduct toward a colleague.  他因对同事行为不当而被解雇。

inapposite.example: The comparison to wartime rationing seems inapposite today.  把它比作战时配给在今天显得不恰当。

inappropriate.example: Wearing shorts to the interview was clearly inappropriate.  穿短裤去面试显然不合适。

inapt.example: His inapt remarks embarrassed everyone at the dinner table.  他不得体的言论让餐桌上的人都很尴尬。

unmeet.example: Such loud laughter seemed unmeet at a solemn funeral.  在庄严的葬礼上这样大笑显得不合适。

unseemly.example: Their unseemly quarrel spoiled the whole wedding reception.  他们不得体的争吵毁了整场婚宴。

unsuitable.example: The soil here is completely unsuitable for growing rice.  这里的土壤完全不适合种稻子。

aproposof.example: Aproposof the delay, the manager offered a full refund.  关于延误一事，经理提供了全额退款。

asfaras.example: Asfaras the budget goes, we still have some room.  就预算而言，我们还有一些余地。

asfor.example: Asfor the second question, I will answer it later.  至于第二个问题，我稍后回答。

asregards.example: Asregards safety, the new design is clearly superior.  就安全性而言，新设计明显更优。

specting.example: Specting the new rules, nobody seemed to understand them.  关于新规定，似乎没人真正理解。

touching.example: The letter said little touching the terms of payment.  信中几乎没有提及付款条件。

toward.example: Her policy toward small businesses has changed a great deal.  她对小企业的政策已经改变了很多。

brilliant.example: She was a brilliant mathematician long before she turned twenty.  她还没到二十岁就已是出色的数学家。

clever.example: That was a clever way to avoid the extra cost.  那是避免额外成本的聪明办法。

quick-witted.example: The quick-witted intern saved the presentation with one remark.  机智的实习生用一句话救了那场演示。

ready-witted.example: Only a ready-witted host could handle such rude questions.  只有才思敏捷的主持人才能应对这种无礼的问题。

smart.example: Buying the tickets early was a very smart decision.  提前买票是个非常明智的决定。

foolish.example: It was foolish of him to ignore the warning signs.  他忽视警示标志实在愚蠢。

dull.example: The lecture was so dull that half the class slept.  讲座乏味得让一半学生睡着了。

dumb.example: Asking that in public was a pretty dumb idea.  在公开场合问那个是个相当愚蠢的想法。

stupid.example: I felt stupid after mixing up their names again.  又把他们的名字弄混后我觉得自己很笨。

unintelligent.example: The character is lazy but by no means unintelligent.  这个角色懒惰，但绝不愚笨。

archaic.example: The contract still uses archaic terms that nobody understands.  这份合同仍在使用无人理解的古旧术语。

antiquated.example: The office still runs on an antiquated system built in the eighties.  办公室仍在使用八十年代建成的过时系统。

outdated.example: Their outdated software could not handle the new files.  他们过时的软件无法处理新文件。

outmoded.example: The factory still relies on outmoded machinery from the nineteen sixties.  这家工厂仍在使用二十世纪六十年代的过时机器。

superannuated.example: The factory still runs on superannuated machinery from the 1960s.  这家工厂仍在使用上世纪六十年代的老旧机器。

fashionable.example: Long coats became fashionable again after that film came out.  那部电影上映后长外套又流行起来。

modern diction.example: The translator replaced the old verses with modern diction.  译者用现代措辞替换了那些旧诗句。

archetype.example: Sherlock Holmes remains the archetype of the brilliant private detective.  夏洛克·福尔摩斯仍是天才私家侦探的原型。

ideal.example: She remains the ideal of quiet courage for many students.  她仍是许多学生心中沉静勇气的典范。

a perfect example.example: This building is a perfect example of early modern design.  这座建筑是早期现代设计的完美范例。

quintessence.example: Her writing is the quintessence of restraint and precision.  她的文字是克制与精确的精髓。

ardor.example: The young recruits sang with revolutionary ardor all the way to the front.  年轻的新兵一路满怀革命热情地高唱。

avidity.example: He collected old maps with an avidity that surprised us.  他收集旧地图的热切劲头让我们吃惊。

zeal.example: She took up the campaign with the zeal of a true believer.  她以真正信徒的热诚投入了这场运动。

fervor.example: The crowd sang the anthem with surprising fervor.  人群以惊人的热情唱起国歌。

fervency.example: She defended her theory with a fervency few expected.  她以少有人预料的热诚为自己的理论辩护。

fervidness.example: The fervidness of his belief unsettled his calmer colleagues.  他信念的狂热让较为冷静的同事不安。

passion.example: He talks about old trains with genuine passion.  他谈起老火车时充满真挚的热情。

passionateness.example: The passionateness of the debate startled the visiting scholars.  辩论的激烈程度让来访学者感到惊讶。

vehemence.example: The vehemence of his denial surprised everyone in the room.  他否认的激烈程度让屋里所有人吃惊。

torpor.example: The heat sank the whole village into a heavy afternoon torpor.  暑热让整个村子陷入沉沉的午后麻木。

impassivity.example: The witness listened with total impassivity to the verdict.  证人完全无动于衷地听着判决。

insensitivity.example: His insensitivity to other people's feelings cost him friends.  他对别人感受的麻木让他失去了朋友。

arduous.example: The climb proved far more arduous than any of them expected.  这次攀登远比他们任何人预想的都费劲。

grueling.example: The team endured a grueling schedule of twelve games in three weeks.  球队熬过了三周十二场比赛这种折磨人的赛程。

laborious.example: Copying the manuscript by hand proved a slow and laborious process.  手抄这份手稿是一个缓慢而费力的过程。

taxing.example: Caring for two infants proved a taxing task for the young couple.  照顾两个婴儿对这对年轻夫妻是繁重的任务。

onerous.example: Caring for the archive proved more onerous than the volunteers had expected.  照管这份档案比志愿者们预想的更费时费心。

burdensome.example: The new paperwork proved burdensome for small rural clinics.  新的文书工作对乡村小诊所来说很繁重。

easy.example: The homework looked easy, but it took him three hours to finish.  作业看起来容易，可他花了三个小时才做完。

simple.example: Follow these simple steps and the machine will restart.  按这些简单步骤操作，机器就会重启。

unchallenging.example: He quit the unchallenging position after only three months.  他只干了三个月就辞掉那份没有挑战性的工作。

undemanding.example: She chose an undemanding role so she could rest more.  她选了个轻松的角色以便多休息。

facile.cn: 容易做到的；肤浅轻率的
facile.example: The report offers a facile explanation for a very complex problem.  这份报告对一个非常复杂的问题给出了肤浅的解释。

effortless.example: Her swimming looked effortless even in the rough water.  即使在波涛中她的游泳也显得毫不费力。

arrest.example: The new drug can arrest the spread of the disease for years.  这种新药能在数年内阻止疾病扩散。

cease.example: The company will cease production at that plant in June.  公司将于六月停止该厂的生产。

cessation.example: Both sides finally agreed to a cessation of hostilities.  双方最终同意停止敌对行动。

closure.example: The closure of the branch left thirty people jobless.  分店关闭让三十人失业。

conclusion.example: The trial reached its conclusion after eleven long weeks.  审判在漫长的十一周后结束。

discontinuance.example: The discontinuance of the bus route angered local residents.  公交线路的停运惹恼了当地居民。

discontinuation.example: Doctors warned against sudden discontinuation of the medication.  医生警告不要突然停药。

ending.example: The novel has an ending that nobody sees coming.  这部小说的结局谁都想不到。

halt.example: Heavy snow brought the whole city to a halt.  大雪使整座城市陷入停滞。

stop.example: The referee stopped the match because of the sudden storm.  裁判因突来的暴风雨中止了比赛。

termination.example: Either side may request termination of the agreement early.  任何一方都可要求提前终止协议。

check.example: Strict quarantine measures checked the spread of the disease.  严格的隔离措施阻止了疾病的蔓延。
check.cn: 使突然停止，阻止；检查，核对

close.example: They closed the discussion before anyone could object.  他们在有人反对之前结束了讨论。

conclude.example: The judge concluded that the evidence was too weak.  法官得出结论认为证据太薄弱。

discontinue.example: The brand discontinued its cheapest model last year.  该品牌去年停产了最便宜的型号。

end.example: The strike ended after both sides agreed on wages.  双方就工资达成一致后罢工结束。

terminate.example: The club terminated his membership without any explanation.  俱乐部未加解释就终止了他的会员资格。

apprehend.example: Police apprehended the thief two streets from the shop.  警方在离商店两条街的地方逮住了小偷。

fascinate.example: Stories about strange deep-sea creatures fascinate young readers all over the world.  关于奇异深海生物的故事让全世界的小读者着迷。

bedazzle.example: The acrobats bedazzled the crowd with almost impossible leaps.  杂技演员用几乎不可能的腾跃让观众目眩神迷。

grip.example: The film gripped us from the very first scene.  这部电影从第一个镜头就抓住了我们。

hypnotize.example: The dancer's slow movements seemed to hypnotize everyone watching.  舞者缓慢的动作似乎让所有观看者入迷。

mesmerize.example: The flickering firelight mesmerized the tired children and kept them quiet.  跳动的火光让疲倦的孩子们看得入迷，安静了下来。

continuation.example: The continuation of the project depends on further funding.  项目的继续取决于后续资金。

discharge.example: The court discharged the prisoner immediately after the new evidence appeared.  新证据出现后，法庭立即释放了那名囚犯。

arresting.example: The poster used an arresting image of a burning city.  海报用了一幅燃烧城市的醒目画面。

absorbing.example: I found her account of the voyage utterly absorbing.  我觉得她对航行的叙述极其引人入胜。

engrossing.cn: 引人入胜的，令人专注的
engrossing.example: The documentary was so engrossing that nobody left early.  这部纪录片如此引人入胜，没人提早离场。

enthralling.cn: 令人入迷的，极吸引人的
enthralling.example: Her enthralling storytelling kept the children silent for an hour.  她迷人的讲述让孩子们安静了一个小时。

fascinating.example: Insect behavior is a fascinating subject for young scientists.  昆虫行为对年轻科学家来说是极有趣的课题。

gripping.example: The final chapter is gripping from start to finish.  最后一章从头到尾都扣人心弦。

immersing.example: The game offers an immersing world full of hidden details.  这款游戏提供了充满隐藏细节的沉浸世界。

intriguing.example: She raised an intriguing point that nobody had considered.  她提出了一个无人考虑过的有趣观点。

riveting.example: The documentary offers a riveting account of life inside the mountain villages.  这部纪录片对山村生活的叙述引人入胜。

boring.example: The meeting was so boring that I nearly fell asleep.  会议无聊得我差点睡着。

drab.example: They painted over the drab gray walls with something warmer and brighter.  他们把单调的灰墙涂上了更暖更亮的颜色。

tedious.example: The manager gave a tedious explanation of the new filing system.  经理对新的归档系统作了冗长乏味的解释。

monotonous.example: His monotonous voice made the afternoon lecture almost impossible to sit through.  他单调的声音让下午的讲座几乎难以听完。

uninteresting.example: The food at the small hotel was cheap but completely uninteresting.  这家小旅馆的食物便宜，却毫无趣味。

arrhythmic.example: The patient's arrhythmic pulse worried the young nurse.  病人不规律的脉搏让年轻护士担心。

disorderly.example: Books lay in disorderly piles across the whole floor.  书杂乱地堆在整个地板上。

orderly.example: The students left the hall in an orderly line.  学生们排成整齐的队伍离开礼堂。

arrogance.example: His arrogance made it impossible for colleagues to offer honest advice.  他的傲慢让同事们无法提出诚实的建议。

assumption.example: His quiet assumption of authority annoyed the older members.  他不声不响地自居权威，惹恼了年长成员。

bumptiousness.example: His bumptiousness made him unpopular with the entire team.  他的自负让整个团队都不喜欢他。

haughtiness.example: The duchess treated the servants with unmistakable haughtiness.  公爵夫人对仆人明显地高傲。

hauteur.example: Her hauteur offended the very people whose support she needed most.  她的傲慢恰恰得罪了她最需要支持的那些人。

imperiousness.example: His imperiousness in meetings silenced every junior colleague.  他在会上的专横让每个年轻同事都不敢开口。

loftiness.example: She spoke with a loftiness that irritated the waiting reporters.  她说话时的高傲让等候的记者们不快。

peremptoriness.example: The peremptoriness of the memo offended the whole department.  那份备忘录的专横语气得罪了整个部门。

pomposity.example: The speech was ruined by pomposity and empty phrases.  演讲被浮夸和空话毁了。

pompousness.example: His pompousness at dinner made the guests exchange glances.  他在晚餐上的浮夸让客人们交换眼神。

presumptuousness.example: Correcting his own mentor in front of the class showed remarkable presumptuousness.  在全班面前纠正自己的导师，显示出惊人的放肆。

superciliousness.example: The critic's superciliousness annoyed even his most loyal readers.  这位评论家的傲慢连最忠实的读者都反感。

humility.example: He accepted the prize with genuine humility and short thanks.  他以真诚的谦逊和简短的致谢接受了奖项。

modesty.example: Her modesty about the discovery impressed the whole committee.  她对这一发现的谦逊让整个委员会印象深刻。

humbleness.example: The old monk's humbleness taught the students more than words.  老僧的谦卑教给学生的比言语更多。

unassumingness.example: Her unassumingness made colleagues trust her almost immediately.  她的谦逊让同事几乎立刻就信任她。

articulate.example: She managed to articulate her concerns clearly at the board meeting.  她在董事会上清晰地表达了自己的顾虑。

enunciate.example: Please enunciate each word clearly so the people at the back can hear.  请把每个词清晰地吐出，好让后排的人听清。

eloquent.example: His eloquent defense of the plan won several extra votes.  他对该计划雄辩的辩护多赢得了几张选票。

fluent.example: She is fluent in three languages and translates for the court.  她精通三门语言，为法庭做翻译。

silver-tongued.example: The silver-tongued salesman persuaded her to buy two cars.  能言善辩的销售员说服她买了两辆车。

well-spoken.cn: 谈吐文雅的，口齿清晰的
well-spoken.example: The well-spoken candidate impressed everyone on the hiring panel.  谈吐文雅的候选人给招聘小组留下深刻印象。

murmur.example: The workers murmured about the new rules but nobody complained openly.  工人们对新规定低声抱怨，却没人公开抗议。

mumble.example: He mumbled an apology and hurried out of the crowded room.  他咕哝了一句道歉，匆匆走出拥挤的房间。

mutter.example: He muttered under his breath as he carried the heavy boxes upstairs.  他把沉重的箱子搬上楼时低声嘟囔着。

slur.example: He was so tired that he began to slur his words.  他累得开始说话含糊不清。
slur.cn: 含糊不清地说；诋毁，污辱

inarticulate.cn: 表达不清的，说不出话的
inarticulate.example: He became inarticulate whenever the topic turned personal.  一旦话题转到私事，他就说不清话。

ineloquent.example: His ineloquent answer disappointed the audience expecting fireworks.  他拙于言辞的回答让期待精彩的听众失望。

unvocal.example: The usually loud critics stayed unvocal about the scandal.  平时高声的批评者对这桩丑闻保持沉默。

ascendant.example: The reformers were ascendant in the party for nearly a decade.  改革派在党内近十年处于主宰地位。

superior.example: This model is clearly superior to the older version.  这个型号明显优于旧版。

dominant.example: The dominant player in the market set prices that everyone else followed.  市场上占主导地位的那家定的价，其他人都跟着走。

sovereign.example: The island became a sovereign nation after years of struggle.  经过多年抗争，该岛成为主权国家。

having no influence/power.example: A committee having no influence/power cannot change the policy.  一个毫无权力的委员会无法改变政策。

ascetic.example: The monk led an ascetic life on bread and cold water.  这位僧人以面包和冷水过着自我克制的生活。

abstinent.example: He stayed abstinent from meat and wine for ten years.  他十年间不吃肉不喝酒。

sumptuous.example: The hotel served a sumptuous banquet for the visiting delegation.  酒店为来访代表团摆了一场奢华的宴会。

luxurious.example: They spent their anniversary in a luxurious hotel suite overlooking the harbor.  他们在一间俯瞰港口的豪华酒店套房里度过了结婚纪念日。

aseptic.example: Surgeons follow strict aseptic procedure before touching any instrument.  外科医生在接触任何器械前都遵守严格的无菌程序。

sterile.example: Surgeons must use sterile instruments to prevent infection during any operation.  外科医生必须使用无菌器械，以防手术中感染。

germfree.example: The lab maintains a germfree environment for breeding these mice.  实验室为饲养这些小鼠保持无菌环境。

germy.example: She refused to touch the germy handrail on the crowded subway.  她不愿碰拥挤地铁里那根满是细菌的扶手。

unsterile.example: Using unsterile instruments in surgery can cause a serious infection.  手术中使用未消毒的器械会引起严重感染。

askew.example: The painting hung askew on the wall above the fireplace.  那幅画歪斜地挂在壁炉上方的墙上。

crooked.example: The old painting hung crooked above the fireplace for years.  那幅旧画歪歪地挂在壁炉上方多年。

cockeyed.example: He came up with a cockeyed plan to get rich overnight.  他想出一个一夜暴富的荒唐计划。

oblique.example: The roof meets the wall at an oblique angle that complicates repairs.  屋顶与墙以一个斜角相接，使修理变得复杂。

lopsided.example: The final score revealed a lopsided victory for the visiting team.  最终比分显示客队取得了一场悬殊的胜利。

skewed.example: The survey gave skewed results because only students answered it.  由于只有学生作答，调查结果出现偏差。

aslant.example: A fallen pine lay aslant the narrow mountain path.  一棵倒下的松树斜横在狭窄的山路上。

slanted.example: The report was clearly slanted in favor of the company.  这份报告明显偏向该公司。

slanting.example: Slanting rain beat against the windows all through the night.  斜雨整夜拍打着窗户。

listing.example: The listing vessel was towed slowly back into the harbor.  那艘倾斜的船被慢慢拖回港口。

tilted.example: She looked at me with her head tilted to one side.  她歪着头看我。

awry.example: All their careful plans went awry within the first hour.  他们精心的计划在第一个小时内就出了岔子。

aligned.example: The two columns are perfectly aligned with the door frame.  两根柱子与门框完全对齐。

aspect.example: The old teacher had a stern aspect that frightened new pupils.  这位老教师神情严厉，让新学生害怕。

appearance.example: Do not judge a stranger only by his outward appearance.  不要仅凭外表判断一个陌生人。

look.example: There was a worried look on the young mother's face.  那位年轻母亲脸上带着担忧的神情。

figure.example: A tall figure appeared suddenly at the end of the corridor.  一个高大的身影突然出现在走廊尽头。

presence.example: The old actor had a stage presence no one could match.  这位老演员有着无人能及的舞台风度。

mien.example: The judge entered the courtroom with a solemn and dignified mien.  法官带着庄严的神情走进法庭。

asperity.example: He answered the reporters with unusual asperity that morning.  那天上午他异常粗暴尖刻地回答了记者。

roughness.example: The roughness of his reply startled everyone at the table.  他回答的粗鲁让满桌人都吃了一惊。

crudity.example: The crudity of his remarks offended the guests at dinner.  他言辞的粗俗令晚宴上的客人不快。

rudeness.example: Her rudeness to the waiter embarrassed everyone in our group.  她对服务员的无礼让我们同行的人都很尴尬。

poignancy.example: The letters gain poignancy when you learn the writer died young.  得知写信人早逝，这些信便更显辛酸。

harshness.example: Critics condemned the harshness of the new immigration rules.  批评者谴责新移民规定的严苛。

severity.example: Doctors were surprised by the severity of her symptoms.  医生对她症状的严重程度感到意外。

hardness.example: The hardness of diamond makes it ideal for cutting tools.  钻石的硬度使它非常适合做切割工具。

hardship.example: The family endured years of hardship after losing their farm.  失去农场后，这家人苦熬了多年。

rigor.example: Students complained about the rigor of the new grading system.  学生抱怨新评分制度过于严格。

softness.example: The softness of his tone calmed the frightened child at once.  他语气的温和立刻安抚了受惊的孩子。

mildness.example: We were grateful for the mildness of that December afternoon.  我们很感激那个十二月午后的和暖。

aspersion.example: She refused to cast aspersions on a colleague she barely knew.  她不愿诽谤一位自己几乎不了解的同事。

defamation.example: The actor sued the tabloid for defamation and won damages.  这位演员起诉小报诽谤并赢得赔偿。

besmirchment.example: He never forgave the besmirchment of his family's good name.  他从未原谅家族好名声被玷污这件事。

calumny.example: The senator dismissed the accusations as pure calumny from rivals.  参议员称这些指控纯属对手的诽谤。

calumniation.example: Years of calumniation finally destroyed the scholar's public standing.  多年的诽谤最终毁掉了这位学者的公众声望。

maligning.example: Maligning your competitors rarely wins you the trust of voters.  中伤竞争对手很少能赢得选民的信任。

obloquy.example: The former minister suffered public obloquy for years after the scandal broke.  丑闻爆发后，这位前部长多年遭受公众谩骂。

vilification.example: The campaign relied on the vilification of immigrant families.  这场运动靠诋毁移民家庭来推进。

glowingtribute.example: His colleagues paid a glowing tribute at the retirement dinner.  同事们在退休晚宴上对他大加赞颂。

eulogy.example: She delivered a moving eulogy at her grandfather's funeral.  她在祖父的葬礼上致了感人的悼词。

extolling.example: The article spent pages extolling the benefits of daily exercise.  文章用数页篇幅盛赞每日锻炼的益处。

laudation.example: The preface is filled with laudation of the author's mentor.  序言中满是对作者恩师的颂扬。

praise.example: Her first novel won high praise from serious critics.  她的第一部小说赢得了严肃评论家的高度赞扬。

commendation.example: The officer received a commendation for rescuing the trapped driver.  这名警官因救出被困司机而获嘉奖。

compliment.example: He paid her a warm compliment on her new painting.  他对她的新画作说了一句诚挚的赞美。

adulation.example: The young star grew uncomfortable with the constant adulation of crowds.  这位年轻明星对人群不断的追捧感到不适。

aspirant.example: Every presidential aspirant promised lower taxes and better schools.  每位总统职位的追求者都承诺减税并改善学校。

seeker.example: Every serious seeker of the nomination must raise money early.  每个真心谋求提名的人都必须及早筹款。

noncandidate.example: The governor insisted she was a noncandidate for the presidency.  这位州长坚称自己无意竞选总统。

assert.example: The defendant continued to assert his innocence throughout the trial.  被告在整个审判过程中不断声称自己无罪。

aver.example: The witness averred that he had never met the defendant before.  证人声明他此前从未见过被告。

allege.example: Prosecutors allege that the manager hid millions from investors.  检方指称该经理向投资者隐匿了数百万资金。

avow.example: He avowed his support for the strike in front of reporters.  他在记者面前公开表明支持这次罢工。

avouch.example: Two witnesses avouched the accuracy of the merchant's account.  两名证人证实了这位商人陈述的准确性。

insist.example: She insisted that the money had been returned last week.  她坚称那笔钱上周已经归还。

deny.example: I do not deny that the plan carries some very real risks.  我不否认这个计划确实带有一些实实在在的风险。

gainsay.example: No one could gainsay the evidence the inspector had collected.  没有人能否认检查员收集到的证据。

assertive.example: A more assertive negotiator would have asked for twice the money.  更自信的谈判者会要求双倍的钱。

assertory.example: The treaty opens with an assertory claim about ancient borders.  条约开篇便对古代边界作出断言。

self-assured.example: She gave a self-assured answer to every question from the panel.  她对评委的每个问题都自信作答。

peremptory.example: His peremptory tone left no room for questions or discussion.  他傲慢的语气不给任何提问或讨论的余地。
peremptory.cn: 不容置疑的；专横傲慢的

diffident.example: He was too diffident to argue with his famous professor.  他太拘谨，不敢与那位名教授争辩。

assess.example: Engineers came to assess the damage caused by the summer flood.  工程师前来评估夏季洪水造成的损失。

evaluate.example: Teachers evaluate each essay using the same detailed rubric.  教师用同一份细则评价每篇作文。

appraise.example: An expert was hired to appraise the antique clock.  他们请专家来鉴定这只古董钟的价值。

guesstimate.example: My guesstimate is that repairs will cost about two thousand dollars.  我粗估修理费大约两千美元。

exact.example: The conquerors exacted tribute from every village in the valley.  征服者向谷中每个村庄强征贡赋。

lay.example: Parliament laid a new duty on tea and paper.  议会对茶叶和纸张课征了新税。

levy.example: The city plans to levy a small fee on plastic bags.  市政府计划对塑料袋征收少量费用。

put.example: The government put a heavy duty on imported cars.  政府对进口汽车课以重税。

assiduous.example: Her assiduous attention to detail saved the project from disaster.  她对细节的专注仔细使项目免于失败。

diligent.example: A diligent editor checked every footnote before the manuscript went to the printer.  一位勤勉的编辑在书稿付印前核对了每一条脚注。

industrious.example: The most industrious student in the class reviewed her notes every single night.  班里最勤奋的学生每晚都复习笔记。

sedulous.example: Her sedulous preparation showed in every answer she gave the examiners.  她勤勉认真的准备体现在给考官的每个回答中。

idle.example: Half the factory's machines stood idle for most of last year.  这家工厂一半的机器去年大部分时间都闲置着。

unbusy.example: Call me on an unbusy morning and we can talk properly.  哪天上午不忙时打给我，我们好好聊。

unemployed.example: He has been unemployed since the plant closed last spring.  自去年春天工厂关闭后他一直失业。

unoccupied.example: The upstairs rooms remained unoccupied for the whole winter.  楼上的房间整个冬天都空着。

astounding.example: The team made an astounding discovery in the desert last summer.  该团队去年夏天在沙漠中有了令人吃惊的发现。

amazing.example: It is amazing how quickly the children learned to swim.  孩子们学会游泳之快令人惊奇。

astonishing.example: The team made astonishing progress in only three months.  这个团队仅三个月就取得惊人进步。

blindsiding.example: The layoffs came as a blindsiding shock to the whole staff.  裁员对全体员工是突如其来的打击。

dumbfounding.example: The verdict was dumbfounding to everyone sitting in the courtroom.  这一判决令法庭上所有人瞠目结舌。

shocking.example: The photographs revealed shocking conditions inside the old prison.  这些照片揭露了旧监狱内骇人的条件。

startling.example: Her startling confession changed the direction of the entire trial.  她令人吃惊的供认改变了整场审判的方向。

stunning.example: The underdog scored a stunning victory in the final round.  弱队在最后一轮取得令人震惊的胜利。

stupefying.cn: 令人惊愕的；令人发懵的
stupefying.example: The tax code has a stupefying number of special exceptions.  税法中的特殊例外多得令人发懵。

unsurprising.cn: 不令人惊讶的，意料之中的
unsurprising.example: It is unsurprising that prices rose after the harvest failed.  歉收之后物价上涨并不意外。

astute.example: An astute observer would have noticed the tension in the room.  一个机敏的观察者会注意到房间里的紧张气氛。

canny.example: A canny investor sold his shares just before the crash.  一位精明的投资者在崩盘前卖掉了股票。

shrewd.example: It was a shrewd judgment that saved the company millions of dollars.  那是个精明的判断，为公司省下了数百万美元。

perspicacious.example: Her perspicacious reading of the market saved the firm millions.  她对市场的敏锐判断为公司省下数百万。

clear-eyed.cn: 看得清楚的，冷静清醒的
clear-eyed.example: We need a clear-eyed view of the risks before investing.  投资前我们需要对风险有清醒的认识。

clear-sighted.example: Only a clear-sighted planner could foresee the coming water shortage.  只有有眼光的规划者才能预见即将到来的缺水。

savvy.example: Her political savvy helped the bill pass with almost no opposition.  她政治上的老练使那项议案几乎无异议通过。

unknowing.example: She was an unknowing carrier of the virus for weeks.  她在数周内一直是不知情的病毒携带者。

asunder.example: The long strike tore the small community asunder.  长期的罢工使这个小社区分崩离析。

apart.example: The two brothers grew apart after their father's death.  父亲去世后两兄弟渐渐疏远了。

together.example: The neighbors came together to rebuild the damaged bridge.  邻居们聚在一起重建那座受损的桥。

asylum.example: The family was granted political asylum after two years of waiting.  这家人在等待两年之后获得了政治庇护。
asylum.cn: 政治庇护；收容所，避难所

harbor.example: The family was accused of harboring a fugitive for several months.  这家人被指控藏匿一名逃犯数月。

haven.example: The old library became a quiet haven for students during exam week.  考试周里，那座旧图书馆成了学生们安静的避难所。

refuge.example: The travelers took refuge in a shepherd's stone hut.  旅人们在牧羊人的石屋里避难。

sanctuary.example: The refugees found sanctuary in a small church near the border.  难民们在边境附近的一座小教堂找到了庇护。

sanctum.example: Few visitors were ever admitted to the editor's inner sanctum.  几乎没有客人被允许进入主编的私人密室。

asymmetrical.example: The architect chose an asymmetrical design for the new library.  建筑师为新图书馆选择了不对称的设计。

asymmetric.example: The two sides fought an asymmetric war for over a decade.  双方进行了十多年的非对称战争。

nonsymmetrical.example: The crystal grew into a strangely nonsymmetrical shape overnight.  这块晶体一夜间长成奇怪的非对称形状。

unsymmetrical.example: Her haircut looked slightly unsymmetrical in the bright morning light.  在明亮的晨光下她的发型显得有点不对称。

unbalanced.example: The report gave an unbalanced picture of the city's economy.  这份报告对该市经济的描述有失均衡。

symmetrical.example: The palace has a perfectly symmetrical front with matching towers.  宫殿正面完全对称，两侧塔楼相同。

atone.example: He spent years trying to atone for the harm he had caused.  他花了多年时间试图弥补自己造成的伤害。

redeem.example: He hoped to redeem himself through years of quiet public service.  他希望通过多年默默的公共服务来改过自新。

atrocious.example: The court described the killing as an atrocious crime.  法庭称这起杀人事件是极其残忍的罪行。

heinous.example: The court described the crime as heinous and utterly without excuse.  法庭称这一罪行十恶不赦，毫无借口可言。

kind.example: It was kind of her to visit the sick neighbor daily.  她每天去看望生病的邻居，真是好心。

kindhearted.example: A kindhearted stranger paid for the child's bus ticket.  一位好心的陌生人替那孩子付了车票。

benignant.example: The old abbot listened with a benignant expression on his face.  老修院长面带慈祥的神情倾听着。

good-hearted.example: He is a rough but good-hearted sailor who helps everyone.  他是个粗鲁却心地善良、乐于助人的水手。

humane.example: Activists demanded more humane conditions inside the detention center.  活动人士要求改善拘留中心内的人道条件。

sympathetic.example: The nurse gave her a sympathetic look and held her hand.  护士同情地看着她，握住了她的手。

tenderhearted.example: Too tenderhearted to kill the mouse, he released it outside.  他心太软，不忍杀老鼠，便把它放到屋外。

attenuate.example: Thick concrete walls attenuate the radio signal inside the building.  厚厚的混凝土墙削弱了建筑内部的无线电信号。

cheapen.example: Endless discounts cheapened the label's carefully built reputation.  没完没了的折扣贬损了该品牌精心建立的声誉。

devalue.example: The government devalued the peso to boost exports quickly.  政府让比索贬值以迅速刺激出口。

downgrade.example: Analysts downgraded the company after two weak quarterly reports.  两份疲弱季报后分析师下调了该公司评级。

reduce.example: New machines reduced the factory's energy use by half.  新机器把工厂的能耗降低了一半。

write down.example: The bank had to write down billions in bad loans.  银行不得不减记数十亿的不良贷款。

appreciate.example: The old farmhouse has appreciated considerably over the last decade.  这座老农舍在过去十年里大幅增值。

enhance.example: A little salt greatly enhances the sweetness of the fruit.  少许盐能大大提升水果的甜味。

upgrade.example: The airline upgraded her to business class without any charge.  航空公司免费把她升级到商务舱。

mark up.example: Dealers mark up rare records by three or four times.  经销商把稀有唱片加价三四倍。

audacious.example: The general approved an audacious plan to cross the river at night.  将军批准了一个夜间渡河的大胆计划。

bold.example: It was a bold decision to leave a secure job.  辞去稳定的工作是个大胆的决定。

adventurous.example: Their adventurous son plans to cycle across the whole continent.  他们爱冒险的儿子打算骑车横穿整个大陆。

brash.example: His brash remarks offended nearly everyone at the dinner table.  他鲁莽的言论几乎冒犯了餐桌上的每个人。

brassy.example: Her brassy confidence annoyed the older members of the committee.  她那种不知羞耻的自信惹恼了委员会的老成员。

brazen.example: She told a brazen lie without even lowering her eyes.  她说了个无耻的谎言，连眼睛都没垂下。

rash.example: He regretted his rash decision to sell the house so quickly.  他后悔自己如此草率地决定迅速卖掉房子。

reckless.example: His reckless driving on the icy road caused a serious accident.  他在结冰路面上的鲁莽驾驶造成了一场严重事故。

striking.example: There is a striking contrast between the two sisters' styles.  两姐妹的风格形成鲜明的对比。

surprising.example: It is surprising how little the old town has changed.  这座老城变化之小令人意外。

shocking amazing.example: The climber's solo ascent was shocking amazing to seasoned experts.  这位攀登者的单人登顶令资深专家既震惊又惊叹。

cautious.example: Investors remained cautious until the election results were announced.  在选举结果公布前投资者一直很谨慎。

circumspect.example: Diplomats stay circumspect in public and blunt behind closed doors.  外交官在公开场合谨慎，关起门来则直言不讳。

guarded.example: The minister gave a guarded welcome to the new proposal.  部长对新提案表示了有保留的欢迎。

wary.example: Children are taught to be wary of strangers offering free rides.  孩子们被教导要警惕主动提供搭车的陌生人。

augur.example: The Roman augur studied the flight of birds before every battle.  这位罗马占卜官在每场战役前都观察鸟的飞行。

forecast.example: Economists forecast slower growth for the coming two years.  经济学家预测未来两年增长会放缓。

predict.example: No one could predict how the jury would finally vote.  没人能预测陪审团最终会如何表决。

presage.example: The sudden silence of the birds was a presage of the storm.  鸟鸣骤然停止，是暴风雨来临的征兆。

prognosticate.example: Analysts hesitate to prognosticate about markets in such uncertain times.  在如此不确定的时期分析师不愿预测市场。

prophesy.example: The old monk prophesied that the city would burn twice.  老僧预言这座城市将两度被焚。

forebode.example: The sudden silence in the forest seemed to forebode coming trouble.  林中突然的寂静似乎预示麻烦将至。

bona fide.example: Only bona fide students may borrow books from this library.  只有真正的在校学生才能从本馆借书。

certified.example: Every guide on the trail must be a certified first responder.  这条路线上的每位导游都必须是持证急救员。

genuine.example: Experts confirmed that the signature on the letter was genuine.  专家确认信上的签名是真的。

bogus.example: Police discovered a stack of bogus passports in the van.  警方在货车里发现一叠伪造护照。

counterfeit.example: Police seized thousands of counterfeit banknotes hidden in the delivery van.  警方缴获了藏在送货车里的数千张假钞。

fake.example: The gallery unknowingly displayed a fake for almost ten years.  这家画廊不知情地展出了一件赝品近十年。

mock.example: Students held a mock election to learn how voting works.  学生举行模拟选举以了解投票如何运作。

phony.example: He used a phony name when renting the small apartment.  他租那间小公寓时用了假名。

authority.example: She is a recognized authority on ancient Greek coins.  她是古希腊钱币方面公认的权威人士。

expert.example: They called in an expert to examine the cracked foundation.  他们请来专家检查开裂的地基。

connoisseur.example: He is a connoisseur of fine wine and rare books.  他是美酒和珍本书的鉴赏家。

maestro.example: The maestro raised his baton and the hall fell silent.  大师举起指挥棒，全场随之安静。

master.example: Only a master of the craft could carve such fine details.  只有行家高手才能雕出这般精细的细节。

virtuoso.example: The violin virtuoso played the difficult passage without a single mistake.  那位小提琴大师毫无差错地演奏了这段难曲。
virtuoso.cn: 技艺大师，演奏名家；技艺精湛的

administration.example: The new administration promised to reform the tax system.  新政府承诺改革税制。

governance.example: Weak governance allowed corruption to spread through the ministry.  治理薄弱使腐败在该部门蔓延。

regime.example: The regime collapsed within weeks of the general strike.  总罢工数周后该政权便崩溃了。

regimen.example: The colony suffered for decades under a harsh military regimen.  这块殖民地在严酷的军事统治下受苦数十年。

amateur.example: The comet was first spotted by an amateur astronomer.  这颗彗星最先由一位业余天文学家发现。

autocracy.example: Critics warned that the reforms were leading toward outright autocracy.  批评者警告这些改革正走向彻底的独裁。

absolutism.example: The revolution finally ended centuries of royal absolutism in France.  革命最终结束了法国数百年的君主专制。

dictatorship.example: Under the dictatorship, newspapers printed only official announcements.  在独裁统治下报纸只刊登官方公告。

totalitarianism.example: Her novel examines how totalitarianism reshapes ordinary family life.  她的小说考察极权主义如何重塑普通家庭生活。

tyranny.example: The pamphlet urged citizens to resist tyranny by peaceful means.  这本小册子呼吁公民以和平方式反抗暴政。

democracy.example: A working democracy depends on free and well-informed voters.  运作良好的民主依赖自由且知情的选民。

autonomy.example: The region was promised greater autonomy after the peace talks.  和谈之后，该地区被承诺更大的自治权。

self-governance.example: The islands were granted limited self-governance after long negotiations.  经过长期谈判，这些岛屿获得了有限自治。

sovereignty.example: Both nations claim sovereignty over the same rocky islands.  两国都对同一批礁岛主张主权。

independence.example: The colony won its independence after eight years of fighting.  该殖民地经过八年战斗赢得独立。

liberty.example: The court ruled that the law restricted individual liberty unlawfully.  法院裁定该法非法限制了个人自由。

free will.example: She signed the agreement of her own free will.  她是出于自由意志签下这份协议的。

dependence.example: The country is reducing its dependence on imported grain.  该国正在减少对进口粮食的依赖。

subjection.example: Centuries of subjection left the region deeply impoverished.  数百年的被统治使该地区极度贫困。

constraint.example: Time constraints forced the team to abandon several experiments.  时间限制迫使团队放弃了几项实验。

duress.example: The contract is void if it was signed under duress.  若合同是在胁迫下签署的则属无效。

avarice.example: The whole scheme was driven by avarice rather than by need.  整个计划是受贪欲驱使，而非出于需要。

acquisitiveness.example: His acquisitiveness filled the house with objects he never used.  他的占有欲让屋里堆满了从不使用的物件。

covetousness.example: The sermon condemned covetousness as the root of much unhappiness.  布道谴责贪心是许多不幸的根源。

cupidity.example: Sheer cupidity led the banker to falsify the accounts.  纯粹的贪财使这位银行家伪造了账目。

greediness.example: The fable shows how greediness costs the fisherman everything.  这则寓言展示贪心如何让渔夫失去一切。

rapacity.example: Villagers still remember the rapacity of the tax collectors.  村民们仍记得税吏的贪婪掠夺。

generosity.example: The library was built through the generosity of one donor.  这座图书馆靠一位捐赠者的慷慨建成。

magnanimity.example: The general's magnanimity toward prisoners surprised both armies.  这位将军对俘虏的宽宏令两军都感意外。

declare.example: The judge declared the earlier verdict invalid and ordered a retrial.  法官宣布先前判决无效并下令重审。

purport.example: Several websites purport to offer free medical advice from real doctors.  有几个网站声称提供真医生的免费医疗建议。

warrant.example: The factory warrants the quality of every tool it sells abroad.  这家工厂为其出口的每件工具的质量提供保证。
warrant.cn: 保证，担保；使有正当理由

averse.example: Older investors are usually averse to risk of any kind.  年长的投资者通常厌恶任何形式的风险。

antipathetic.example: The old faculty was antipathetic to any change in curriculum.  老教员对任何课程改动都心生反感。

opposed.example: Most residents were opposed to building a highway nearby.  多数居民反对在附近修建高速公路。

resistant.example: Older workers proved resistant to the new scheduling software.  年长员工对新排班软件表现出抗拒。

repulsed.example: She was repulsed by the cruelty described in the report.  报告中描述的残忍令她十分厌恶。

revolted.example: Viewers were revolted by the graphic footage from the slaughterhouse.  观众对屠宰场的血腥画面深感厌恶。

eager.example: The children were eager to open their presents at once.  孩子们急切地想立刻打开礼物。

impatient.example: Fans grew impatient for news about the delayed album.  粉丝对延期专辑的消息越来越等不及。

thirsty.example: The young reporter was thirsty for a really big story.  这位年轻记者渴望一条真正的大新闻。

awash.example: The small town was awash with cash during the oil boom.  石油繁荣时期，这个小镇资金充裕。

flush.example: After the bonus he was flush with money for months.  拿到奖金后他有好几个月钱都很充裕。

fraught.example: The mountain route is fraught with danger in early spring.  早春时节这条山路危机四伏。

swarming.example: The market was swarming with shoppers on Saturday morning.  周六早上市场里挤满了购物者。

thronging.example: Thronging fans filled the stadium hours before the concert began.  蜂拥的粉丝在演唱会开始前几小时就挤满了体育场。

dearth.example: There is a real dearth of affordable housing in this district.  这个区确实缺乏买得起的住房。

insufficient.example: The evidence was insufficient to convict him of the crime.  证据不足，无法判定他有罪。

scant.example: The report paid scant attention to the concerns of local residents.  报告对当地居民的关切几乎没有给予关注。

awe.example: The tourists stood in silent awe before the great waterfall.  游客们心怀敬畏，在大瀑布前静静站着。

admiration.example: She earned the admiration of everyone who worked with her.  她赢得了每一位共事者的钦佩。

reverence.example: The old scholar is treated with reverence by his many students.  这位老学者受到众多学生的崇敬。

respect.example: Students should learn to respect opinions that differ from their own.  学生应学会尊重与自己不同的意见。

veneration.example: Ancestors are held in veneration throughout much of East Asia.  在东亚许多地区，祖先受到崇敬。

admire.example: I admire the way she handled such a difficult situation.  我钦佩她处理如此棘手局面的方式。

revere.example: Students in the village still revere the teacher who founded their school.  村里的学生仍然尊崇创办他们学校的那位老师。

venerate.example: Villagers still venerate their ancestors with offerings twice each year.  村民每年两次以供品崇敬他们的祖先。

irreverence.example: His irreverence toward tradition shocked the older members of the club.  他对传统的不敬震惊了俱乐部的老成员。

insolence.example: The waiter's insolence ruined an otherwise pleasant evening.  服务员的傲慢无礼毁了本该愉快的一晚。

awkward.example: An awkward silence followed his remark about her divorce.  他谈到她离婚之后，出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。
awkward.cn: 笨拙的，不灵巧的；尴尬的

handless.example: He is completely handless in the kitchen and burns almost everything.  他在厨房里笨手笨脚，几乎什么都烧糊。

maladroit.example: His maladroit attempt at an apology only made the situation worse.  他笨拙的道歉尝试只是让情况变得更糟。

botched.example: The botched repair left the roof leaking worse than before.  拙劣的修补让屋顶漏得比以前更厉害。

bungling.example: A bungling assistant managed to lose the only copy of the contract.  一个笨手笨脚的助手把合同唯一的副本弄丢了。

fumbled.example: The nervous speaker fumbled his notes and lost his place completely.  紧张的演讲者笨拙地翻弄笔记，完全找不到位置了。

inept.example: The manager was so inept at handling complaints that customers left in droves.  这位经理处理投诉如此无能，导致顾客大量流失。

inexpert.example: To inexpert eyes the two paintings looked exactly the same.  在外行眼里，这两幅画看起来完全一样。

adroit.example: She proved remarkably adroit at handling hostile questions from reporters.  她在应对记者的敌意提问时表现得非常娴熟。

deft.example: With a few deft strokes the artist finished the small sketch.  画家几笔灵巧的勾画便完成了那幅小素描。

dexterous.example: The surgeon's dexterous hands worked steadily for more than six hours.  这位外科医生灵活的双手稳稳地工作了六个多小时。

proficient.example: After two years abroad she became proficient in Spanish and Portuguese.  在国外待了两年后，她精通了西班牙语和葡萄牙语。

skilled.example: The factory struggles to find skilled workers for its new assembly line.  工厂难以为新装配线找到熟练工人。

avantgarde.example: Her early films belonged to the avantgarde of European cinema.  她早期的电影属于欧洲电影的先锋派。

forerunner.example: This simple machine was the forerunner of today's personal computer.  这台简单的机器是今天个人电脑的前身。

pioneer.example: She was a pioneer in genetics long before the field became fashionable.  在遗传学成为热门之前很久，她就是这一领域的先驱。

precursor.example: Rising tensions along the border proved a precursor to open war.  边境紧张局势加剧，成了公开战争的先兆。

vanguard.example: Her lab remains in the vanguard of research on gene editing.  她的实验室仍处于基因编辑研究的前沿。

conservative.example: Her parents were too conservative to accept such an unconventional career choice.  她的父母太守旧，无法接受这样不合常规的职业选择。

diehard.example: Only a few diehard supporters stayed until the end of the match.  只有少数死忠支持者留到比赛结束。
diehard.cn: 顽固的，保守的；顽固分子

amiss.example: She sensed at once that something was seriously amiss at home.  她立刻感到家里出了严重问题。

aside.example: He pushed the papers aside and looked directly at me.  他把文件推到一边，直视着我。

astray.example: The letter went astray and arrived three weeks later.  这封信投递有误，三周后才到。

erroneous.example: The report drew erroneous conclusions from perfectly good data.  该报告从很好的数据中得出了错误的结论。

right.example: You were right about the weather turning cold tonight.  你说今晚天气会变冷，说对了。

well.example: Everything went well until the printer broke down at midnight.  一切都很顺利，直到午夜打印机坏了。

axiomatic.example: Among engineers it is axiomatic that simple designs fail less often.  在工程师中，简单的设计更少出问题是不言自明的。

self-evident.cn: 不言自明的，显而易见的
self-evident.example: It seems self-evident that children learn best through play.  孩子通过玩耍学得最好，这似乎不言自明。

prima facie.example: The police say they have prima facie evidence linking him to the theft.  警方称有初步证据将他与盗窃案联系起来。

controversial.example: The judge's controversial ruling was debated for months afterward.  法官那项有争议的裁决之后被讨论了数月。

babble.example: The toddler would babble happily for hours in his crib.  这个学步的孩子会在婴儿床里开心地咿呀乱说几个小时。

drivel.example: The pamphlet talked complete drivel about curing serious illness with colored light.  那本小册子满口胡言，说用彩色光能治重病。

gabble.example: The child gabbled excitedly about everything he had seen that day.  孩子兴奋地急促讲述那天见到的一切。

gibber.example: He was gibbering with terror and no one could understand him.  他吓得语无伦次，没人能听懂他说什么。

jabber.example: The tourists jabbered away in Italian throughout the entire bus ride.  游客们在整段车程中都用意大利语喋喋不休。

prattle.example: She prattled happily about her garden while we drank our tea.  我们喝茶时她开心地闲扯她的花园。

backhanded.example: He paid her a backhanded compliment about her surprising promotion.  他就她意外的升职说了句表面赞美实为讽刺的话。

feigned.example: He listened with feigned interest while checking his phone.  他一边看手机，一边假装感兴趣地听着。

roundabout.example: She told me the news in a roundabout way that confused everyone.  她以绕弯子的方式告诉我这消息，把大家都搞糊涂了。

sarcastic.example: His sarcastic tone made it clear he disagreed with the plan.  他讽刺的语气清楚表明他不同意这个计划。

hypocritical.example: It is hypocritical to demand honesty while hiding your own mistakes.  一边要求诚实一边隐瞒自己的错误，这很虚伪。

two-faced.example: Nobody trusts him because everyone knows he is two-faced.  没人信他，因为大家都知道他是两面派。

double-faced.example: Her double-faced praise fooled the committee for only a short while.  她口是心非的赞美只骗过委员会一小会儿。

left-handed.example: He paid her a left-handed compliment about her surprisingly good essay.  他对她意外出色的文章说了句言不由衷的赞美。

forthright.example: His forthright answer surprised the reporters who expected evasion.  他直率的回答让原本预期他闪避的记者很意外。

badger.example: Reporters badgered the coach into revealing his starting lineup.  记者们不断纠缠教练，逼他透露首发阵容。

bait.example: The older boys baited him about his accent until he cried.  大孩子们拿他的口音戏弄他，直到他哭了出来。

plague.example: Doubts about the decision plagued him for the rest of the year.  对那个决定的疑虑折磨了他余下的一整年。

badinage.example: Their light badinage over dinner kept the whole table laughing.  他们晚餐时轻松的打趣让整桌人笑声不断。

banter.example: The two old rivals exchanged friendly banter before the match.  两位老对手在比赛前友好地打趣了几句。

persiflage.example: The dinner party was full of idle persiflage and very little substance.  晚宴上尽是无聊的玩笑，几乎没有实质内容。

repartee.example: Their dinner conversation sparkled with witty repartee that kept every guest laughing.  他们的餐桌交谈妙语连珠，逗得每位客人都在笑。

decoy.example: The wooden duck served as a decoy to attract real birds.  木鸭子被用作诱饵来吸引真鸟。

bale.example: The old ballad tells of a life of bale and loss.  这首古老的歌谣讲述了充满悲苦与失落的一生。

misery.example: The war brought years of misery to ordinary families.  战争给普通家庭带来了多年的苦难。

suffering.example: The new drug greatly reduced the suffering of terminal patients.  新药大大减轻了晚期病人的痛苦。

grief.example: She was silent with grief for weeks after her father died.  父亲去世后，她数周沉默悲痛。

joy.example: The news of his recovery filled the whole family with joy.  他康复的消息让全家人充满喜悦。

harmful.example: Too much screen time can be harmful to a child's sleep.  屏幕时间过长可能有害于孩子的睡眠。

beneficent.example: Her long service had a beneficent influence on the whole village.  她多年的服务对整个村子产生了有益的影响。

balk.example: Buyers began to balk at the price after the third increase.  第三次涨价之后，买家开始因价格而退缩。

circumvent.example: Some firms hire consultants to circumvent the new tax rules.  一些公司聘请顾问来规避新的税收规则。

foil.example: Alert guards foiled the plot before anyone was hurt.  警觉的警卫在有人受伤之前挫败了阴谋。

decline.example: She politely declined the invitation to speak at the ceremony.  她礼貌地谢绝了在典礼上发言的邀请。

refuse.example: The witness refused to answer any further questions in court.  证人拒绝在法庭上回答任何进一步的问题。

spurn.example: She spurned the generous offer without giving any explanation at all.  她断然拒绝了这个优厚的提议，且不作任何解释。

turn down.example: He turned down the promotion because it required moving abroad.  他拒绝了晋升，因为那需要搬到国外。

advance.example: The army advanced slowly through the thick forest at dawn.  黎明时军队缓慢穿过密林前进。

foster.example: The new program fosters cooperation between local schools and museums.  新项目促进当地学校与博物馆之间的合作。

nurture.example: Good teachers nurture curiosity rather than simply rewarding correct answers.  好老师培育好奇心，而不只是奖励正确答案。

accept.example: She accepted the award on behalf of her entire research team.  她代表整个研究团队接受了这个奖项。

approve.example: The committee finally approved the plan after three long meetings.  委员会经过三次长会终于批准了该计划。

balky.example: The balky engine refused to start on the coldest morning.  在最冷的那个早晨，这台不听使唤的引擎怎么也发动不起来。

defiant.example: The defiant student refused to apologize to his teacher.  这个公然抗拒的学生拒绝向老师道歉。

perverse.example: He takes perverse pleasure in arguing against every popular opinion.  他反常地乐于反驳每一个流行观点。

intractable.example: Poverty remains an intractable problem in many rural regions.  贫困在许多农村地区仍是棘手的问题。

obstreperous.example: An obstreperous child kept kicking the seat in front of him.  一个吵闹不驯的孩子一直踢着前排的座椅。

refractory.example: One refractory pupil disrupted the lesson for the entire class.  一个不顺从的学生扰乱了全班的课。

wayward.example: Their wayward son ignored every rule his patient parents set.  他们不服管束的儿子无视父母耐心定下的每条规矩。

willful.example: His willful refusal to ask for help delayed the repair by weeks.  他固执地拒绝求助，使维修推迟了好几周。

subdued.example: The crowd grew subdued once the announcement was finally made.  消息宣布后，人群变得安静顺从。

balderdash.example: The professor dismissed the entire theory as utter balderdash.  教授把整套理论斥为一派胡言。

blabber.example: He blabbered about his new car until everyone stopped listening.  他不停地扯他的新车，直到没人再听。

nonsense.example: Most of what he wrote in that letter was pure nonsense.  他在那封信里写的大多是纯粹的胡话。

mumbo jumbo.cn: 故弄玄虚的话，晦涩废话
mumbo jumbo.example: The contract was full of mumbo jumbo that no customer could understand.  合同满是没有客户能看懂的晦涩废话。

balloon.example: Repair costs ballooned from two thousand to twenty thousand dollars.  维修费用从两千美元猛增到两万美元。

inflate.example: The company inflated its sales figures to impress investors.  公司夸大销售数字以取悦投资者。

escalate.example: The border dispute quickly escalated into a full-scale armed conflict.  边界争端迅速升级为全面武装冲突。

burgeon.example: The city's tech sector burgeoned after the new university opened.  新大学开办后，该市的科技产业迅速壮大。

mushroom.example: Small online shops mushroomed across the country within two years.  小型网店两年内在全国迅速涌现。

decrease.example: Traffic accidents decreased noticeably after the new speed limits appeared.  新限速出台后交通事故明显减少。

taper.example: The storm tapered off gradually as the evening wore on.  随着夜色渐深，暴风雨逐渐平息。

balm.example: Her quiet letters were a balm for his grief that winter.  那年冬天，她安静的信件是抚慰他悲伤之物。

irritant.example: Cigarette smoke is a serious irritant to sensitive eyes.  香烟烟雾对敏感的眼睛是严重的刺激物。

banal.example: The film's ending was so banal that the audience laughed.  这部电影的结尾陈腐得让观众笑了。

cliché.example: Saying that time heals everything has become a tired cliché.  说时间治愈一切已成为老套的陈词滥调。

hackneyed.example: The speech relied on hackneyed images of struggle and triumph.  这篇演讲依赖于陈腐的奋斗与胜利意象。

stereotyped.example: The novel is full of stereotyped characters and predictable plots.  这部小说充满刻板人物和可预测的情节。

threadbare.example: He offered the same threadbare excuse for arriving late again.  他又用同一个老掉牙的借口解释迟到。

trite.example: The speech relied on trite phrases that moved nobody in the hall.  那篇演讲满是陈腐的套话，没能感动会场里的任何人。

timeworn.example: He comforted us with timeworn advice about patience and hard work.  他用关于耐心与勤奋的老套建议安慰我们。

shopworn.example: The candidate repeated shopworn arguments that convinced almost nobody in the hall.  那位候选人重复着陈腐的论点，几乎没能说服场内任何人。

stale.example: His stale jokes made the audience shift restlessly in their seats.  他老掉牙的笑话让观众在座位上不安地挪动。

moth-eaten.example: He arrived in a moth-eaten sweater from his college days.  他穿着大学时代那件被虫蛀的毛衣来了。

novel.example: Her novel approach to the old problem surprised even the senior researchers.  她对这个老问题的新奇方法连资深研究员都感到意外。

innovative.example: The firm survived the crisis thanks to an innovative approach to distribution.  这家公司靠创新的分销方式度过了危机。

bane.example: Paperwork has always been the bane of his working life.  文书工作一直是他工作生活中的祸根。

toxic.example: The factory dumped toxic waste into the river for years.  这家工厂多年向河里倾倒有毒废料。

toxin.example: The bacteria release a toxin that damages the nervous system.  这种细菌释放一种损害神经系统的毒素。

venom.example: He spoke with such venom that the whole room fell silent.  他说话时如此恶毒，整个房间都沉默了。

banish.example: The king decided to banish the poet from the court forever.  国王决定把这位诗人永远逐出宫廷。

deport.example: The government threatened to deport anyone without valid papers.  政府威胁要驱逐任何没有有效证件的人。

exile.example: The poet spent twenty years in exile before returning home.  这位诗人流亡二十年后才回国。

expatriate.example: Many expatriates gather at that café to speak their own language.  许多侨民聚在那家咖啡馆说母语。

expel.example: The school expelled two students for cheating on the exam.  学校因考试作弊开除了两名学生。

repatriate.example: The government agreed to repatriate the stranded workers before the holiday season.  政府同意在假期前将滞留的工人遣返回国。

todayisthefirstdayoftherestofmylife.ipa: təˈdeɪ ɪz ðə ˈfɜːrst deɪ əv ðə rest əv maɪ laɪf
todayisthefirstdayoftherestofmylife.example: Today is the first day of the rest of my life, she said quietly.  她轻声说，今天是我余生的第一天。

iwakeasachildtoseetheworld.ipa: aɪ weɪk əz ə tʃaɪld tə siː ðə wɜːrld
iwakeasachildtoseetheworld.cn: 我像孩子般醒来看世界
iwakeasachildtoseetheworld.example: The Iwake-as-a-child line was printed without spaces in the original book.  Iwake-as-a-child 这一行在原书里被印成了没有空格的一串。

wanttoputonfaces.example: Some people want to put on faces instead of showing who they really are.  有些人想装出面孔，而不展示真实的自己。

walk.example: We walk along the river every evening after dinner.  我们每天晚饭后沿河散步。

togrowistochange.example: As the poem says, to grow is to change, and change is life.  正如诗中所说，成长就是改变，而改变就是生活。

tochangeistobenew.ipa: tə tʃeɪndʒ ɪz tə bi nuː
tochangeistobenew.example: He believes that to change is to be new again each morning.  他相信改变就是每个清晨重新变得崭新。

tobenewistobeyoungagain.ipa: tə bi nuː ɪz tə bi jʌŋ əˈɡen
tobenewistobeyoungagain.phrase: to be new is to be young again
tobenewistobeyoungagain.example: The old poet insists that to be new is to be young again.  这位老诗人坚信，变新就是重返年轻。

ibarelyremember.example: The Ibarely-remember line is a run-together printing of a full sentence.  Ibarely-remember 这一行是整句被粘连印刷的结果。

when.example: Call me when you get home so I know you are safe.  到家给我打电话，让我知道你安全。

barb.example: Her final barb about his cooking silenced the whole table.  她最后那句关于他厨艺的尖刻讥讽让整桌人都不说话了。

affront.example: His careless remark was an affront to everyone in the room.  他随口的一句话侮辱了房间里的每个人。
