criticism.example: The plan drew harsh criticism from residents at the meeting.  该计划在会上受到居民的严厉批评。

offense.example: She took offense at his joke about her accent.  她因他拿她的口音开玩笑而生气。

outrage.example: The verdict caused outrage among the victim's family and friends.  判决引起受害者家人和朋友的愤怒。

sarcasm.example: There was a faint note of sarcasm in his polite reply.  他礼貌的回答中带着一丝讽刺。

barbarous.example: The invaders were remembered for their barbarous treatment of prisoners.  侵略者因对俘虏的野蛮对待而被人记住。

brutal.example: The prisoners described the brutal treatment they received in the camp.  囚犯们描述了他们在营中受到的残忍对待。

fiendish.cn: 恶魔般的，恶毒的；极难的
fiendish.example: The detective uncovered a fiendish plan to poison the water supply.  侦探揭露了一个恶毒的投毒供水计划。

heartless.example: It was heartless to fire her the week before Christmas.  在圣诞节前一周解雇她真是无情。

savage.cn: 凶残的，野蛮的；猛烈攻击
savage.example: Critics savaged the film for its careless treatment of history.  批评家猛烈批评该片对历史的草率处理。

vicious.example: The dog gave a vicious bite that required several stitches.  那只狗凶恶地咬了一口，需要缝几针。

merciful.example: The court was merciful and gave him only a small fine.  法庭很宽仁，只罚了他少许款项。

benevolent.example: A benevolent stranger paid for the family's train tickets.  一位仁慈的陌生人为这家人买了火车票。

barefaced.example: He told a barefaced lie to the committee without blinking.  他毫不眨眼地对委员会撒了个明目张胆的谎。

apparent.example: It soon became apparent that the machine had never worked.  很快就明显看出这台机器从未运转过。

bald.example: He gave us the bald facts without any comfort or explanation.  他直白地告知事实，没有任何安慰或解释。

evident.example: Her talent for music was evident from a very early age.  她的音乐才华从很小就显而易见。

manifest.example: His discomfort at the question was manifest to everyone seated around the table.  他对这个问题的不适让围坐桌边的每个人都看得明明白白。

obvious.example: The answer seemed obvious once she explained the method.  她解释了方法后，答案似乎显而易见。

secret.example: They held secret meetings in the basement for several months.  他们在地下室秘密开会数月。

furtive.example: He cast a furtive glance at the answers on her desk.  他偷偷瞥了一眼她桌上的答案。

clandestine.example: They arranged a clandestine meeting in an empty parking garage.  他们在一个空停车场安排了秘密会面。

bargain.example: The dealer likes to drive a hard bargain with new customers.  这个商人喜欢和新客户狠狠地讨价还价。

compact.example: The two nations signed a compact to protect the shared river.  两国签订协议保护共有的河流。

contract.example: Both parties signed the contract without reading the final clause carefully.  双方都没有仔细读最后一条就签了合同。

covenant.example: The two families entered a covenant to share the land.  两家订立盟约共用这块土地。

deal.example: They finally struck a deal after weeks of tense talks.  经过数周紧张谈判，他们终于达成交易。

pact.example: The neighbors made a pact never to sell to developers.  邻居们订下协定，绝不卖给开发商。

settlement.example: The company reached a settlement with the injured workers last month.  公司上月与受伤工人达成和解。

haggle.example: Tourists haggle with vendors over the price of every souvenir.  游客与摊贩为每件纪念品讨价还价。

negotiate.example: The two sides negotiated a contract that satisfied neither of them completely.  双方谈成了一份合同，但双方都不完全满意。

baroque.example: The ceiling was covered with heavy baroque ornamentation in gold.  天花板上覆满了华丽繁复的金色装饰。

byzantine.example: The tax code is so byzantine that even experts disagree.  税法错综复杂，连专家都各执一词。

complicated.example: The tax rules are so complicated that most people hire help.  税务规定如此复杂，多数人都请人帮忙。

convoluted.example: The instructions were so convoluted that nobody could assemble the shelf.  说明书太过费解，没人能装好那个架子。

intricate.example: The carpet shows an intricate pattern of leaves and birds.  地毯上是精细复杂的叶与鸟图案。

knotty.example: The professor posed a knotty question that nobody could answer confidently.  教授提出了一个没人能自信回答的棘手问题。

labyrinthine.example: We got lost in the labyrinthine corridors of the old hospital building.  我们在这座老医院大楼迷宫般的走廊里迷了路。

lavish.example: They hosted a lavish banquet for three hundred guests in the garden.  他们在花园里为三百位客人举办了一场奢华的宴会。

tangled.example: The case involves a tangled web of loans and false names.  此案涉及贷款与假名交织的复杂网络。

austere.example: He slept in an austere room with a bed and one chair.  他睡在一间只有一张床和一把椅子的朴素房间里。

barrage.example: The minister faced a barrage of questions about the missing funds.  部长面对了关于失踪资金的一连串问题。

salvo.example: His article was the first salvo in a long public debate.  他的文章是一场长期公开辩论的第一波攻击。

hail.example: The soldiers advanced through a hail of bullets and smoke.  士兵们在弹雨与烟尘中前进。

cannonade.example: The town endured a cannonade that lasted the entire night.  小镇承受了持续整夜的炮击。

shower.example: The winner received a shower of flowers from the excited crowd.  获胜者收到兴奋人群抛来的一阵鲜花。

storm.cn: 暴风雨；一阵猛烈（如抗议）
storm.example: The decision caused a storm of protest on social media.  这一决定在社交媒体上引发抗议风暴。

volley.example: The minister faced a volley of questions from angry reporters.  部长面对愤怒记者的一连串提问。

barren.example: Nothing grows on the barren land beyond the last village.  最后一个村子之外的贫瘠土地上什么都长不出来。

bootless.example: Arguing with him about money proved a bootless effort.  和他争论钱的事结果是无用的努力。

ineffective.example: The old medicine proved completely ineffective against the new virus.  这种旧药对新病毒完全无效。

inefficacious.example: Doctors abandoned the inefficacious drug after two failed trials.  两次试验失败后，医生放弃了这种无效药物。

unavailing.example: All their efforts to save the old theater proved entirely unavailing.  他们为挽救老剧院所做的一切努力都完全徒劳。

vain.example: They searched all night in vain for the missing dog.  他们整夜寻找失踪的狗，却是徒劳。

desolate.example: The abandoned village looked desolate under the grey winter sky.  废弃的村庄在灰暗冬空下显得荒凉。

waste.example: Nothing grows on this waste ground beside the old factory.  旧工厂旁的这片荒地上什么也长不出来。

effective.example: Simple hand washing is an effective way to prevent illness.  简单洗手是预防疾病的有效方法。

successful.example: Her second attempt at the exam was finally successful.  她第二次考试终于成功了。

productive.example: The morning was productive; we finished three chapters before lunch.  上午很有成效，午饭前我们写完了三章。

virtuous.example: He led a quiet, virtuous life and helped his neighbors freely.  他过着平静高尚的生活，乐于帮助邻里。

arable.example: Only a narrow strip of arable land lies between the desert and the sea.  沙漠与海之间只有一条狭窄的可耕地带。

fruitful.example: Their collaboration proved fruitful and produced several important papers.  他们的合作富有成果，产出了几篇重要论文。

luxuriant.example: Luxuriant ferns covered the damp floor of the forest.  茂盛的蕨类覆盖了潮湿的林地。

verdant.example: After the rains the verdant valley filled with wildflowers.  雨后，翠绿的山谷开满了野花。

barricade.example: Students built a barricade of desks across the main gate.  学生们用课桌在大门前筑起路障。

fence.example: They painted the wooden fence around the garden last summer.  去年夏天他们给花园周围的木栅栏刷了漆。

hedge.example: A neatly trimmed hedge separated the garden from the road.  一道修剪整齐的树篱把花园与马路隔开。

wall.example: Photographs of his children covered the wall behind the desk.  书桌后的墙上贴满了他孩子的照片。

barrier.example: Cost remains the biggest barrier to buying an electric car.  成本仍是购买电动车的最大障碍。

obstacle.example: Lack of funding was the main obstacle to finishing the bridge.  资金不足是完成大桥的主要障碍。

blockade.example: The navy set up a blockade around the island's main port.  海军对该岛主港实施了封锁。

obstruction.example: Police removed the obstruction that had blocked traffic for hours.  警方清除了堵塞交通数小时的障碍物。

bar.example: A fallen tree barred the narrow path up the hill.  一棵倒下的树堵住了上山的窄路。

wall off.example: Builders walled off the damaged wing until repairs could begin.  建筑工人把受损的侧翼隔开，等待开始修复。

permit.example: The school does not permit phones during classroom hours.  学校不允许上课时间使用手机。

barter.example: Farmers used to barter grain for tools and cloth.  农民过去用粮食换取工具和布匹。

swap.example: The boys swapped stickers during the break between classes.  男孩们在课间交换贴纸。

trade.example: The two towns traded salt and wool for many centuries.  这两个镇几个世纪以来用盐交换羊毛。

beguile.example: The magician could beguile an audience for a full hour.  这位魔术师能让观众着迷整整一小时。

deceive.example: He deceived his investors with promises of quick and easy profits.  他用轻松快速获利的承诺欺骗了投资者。

bluff.example: He tried to bluff his way through the whole interview.  他试图靠虚张声势混过整场面试。

con.example: The swindler conned elderly victims out of their life savings.  那个骗子骗走了老年受害者的毕生积蓄。

cozen.example: The swindler cozened elderly widows out of their modest life savings.  那个骗子诱骗年老的寡妇们交出微薄的积蓄。

delude.example: Do not delude yourself into thinking the danger has passed.  别欺骗自己，以为危险已经过去。

dupe.example: The scheme duped trusting investors out of nearly a million dollars.  这个骗局欺骗轻信的投资者，骗走近百万美元。

gull.example: The swindler gulled dozens of elderly investors out of their savings.  骗子欺骗了数十位老年投资者，骗走他们的积蓄。

hoodwink.example: The company hoodwinked customers with promises it could never possibly keep.  这家公司用根本无法兑现的承诺欺骗顾客。

snooker.example: They snookered the old man into signing a worthless contract.  他们诱骗那位老人签了一份毫无价值的合同。

trick.example: She tricked him into revealing the password to the account.  她骗他说出了账户密码。

undeceive.example: Someone must undeceive her before she invests everything in that scheme.  必须有人让她醒悟，别把全部钱投进那个计划。

bathetic.example: The novel ends with a bathetic scene of sudden tears.  小说以一个突然落泪、故作伤感的场面收尾。

commonplace.example: Video calls have become commonplace in ordinary office life.  视频通话在日常办公中已很平常。

offbeat.example: His offbeat sense of humor won over an audience that had arrived skeptical.  他别致的幽默感赢得了原本抱着怀疑到场的观众。

befuddle.example: Long tables of statistics only befuddle the general audience.  长长的统计表格只会使普通听众困惑。

confuse.example: The vague instructions confused nearly everyone in the training class.  含糊的说明让培训班几乎所有人都困惑。

baffle.example: The strange symptoms continued to baffle the visiting experts.  这些奇怪的症状一直使来访的专家疑惑。

bewilder.example: The maze of corridors bewildered every visitor on the first day.  迷宫般的走廊让每位来访者第一天都不知所措。

confound.example: The late victory confounded the critics who had predicted failure.  最后的胜利让预言失败的批评者困惑不已。

disorient.example: The thick fog disoriented the hikers within a few minutes.  浓雾几分钟内就让徒步者失去了方向感。

flummox.example: The final question flummoxed even the best students in class.  最后一题连班上最好的学生都难住了。

muddle.example: Too many footnotes muddled the argument of his short essay.  过多脚注把他短文的论证弄乱了。

perplex.example: The strange results perplexed the researchers for several long months.  奇怪的结果让研究者困惑了好几个月。

puzzle.example: Her sudden recovery puzzled the doctors who had treated her.  她的突然康复让治疗过她的医生们感到困惑。

assure.example: The manager assured us that the missing files were safe.  经理向我们保证，丢失的文件很安全。

reassure.example: The principal tried to reassure worried parents after the accident.  事故之后，校长努力安抚焦虑的父母。

satisfy.example: The extra evidence satisfied the skeptics who had doubted his story.  额外的证据让怀疑他说法的人信服了。

bedeck.example: Villagers bedeck the hall with flowers before every summer festival.  每年夏季节庆前，村民都用花装饰大厅。

adorn.example: Old maps and photographs adorn the walls of the study.  旧地图和照片装饰着书房的墙壁。

beautify.example: Volunteers planted trees to beautify the neglected riverside park.  志愿者种树来美化那座荒废的河滨公园。

decorate.example: The children helped decorate the room with paper lanterns.  孩子们帮忙用纸灯笼装饰房间。

dress.example: She dressed the shop window with silk scarves and dried flowers.  她用丝巾和干花布置了商店橱窗。

embellish.example: He embellished the tale with details that never actually happened.  他给故事添加了从未发生过的细节。

emblaze.example: Golden letters emblaze the cover of the ancient prayer book.  金色字母把那本古老祈祷书的封面装饰得璀璨。

strip.example: Workers stripped the walls bare before applying the fresh coat of paint.  工人把墙剥得光秃，然后刷上新漆。

belabor.example: There is no need to belabor the point any further.  没有必要再对这一点过分强调下去。

beat.example: The guards beat the prisoner until the officer finally intervened.  卫兵殴打囚犯，直到那位军官出面干预。

baste.example: The columnist basted the mayor for wasting so much public money.  专栏作家痛批市长浪费了大量公款。

batter.example: Firefighters battered down the locked door to reach the child.  消防员砸开锁住的门去救那个孩子。

scathe.example: Reviewers scathed the film for its lazy writing and dull acting.  评论者严厉批评这部电影剧本敷衍、表演乏味。

dwell on.example: Don't dwell on the failure; start planning your next attempt instead.  别老想着失败，去筹划下一次尝试吧。

harp on.example: He kept harping on my old error throughout the whole meeting.  整场会议他都在喋喋不休地说我以前的失误。

applaud.example: Teachers applauded the decision to reduce homework for young pupils.  老师们赞成给低年级学生减少作业的决定。

extol.example: Neighbors still extol his kindness during the long winter flood.  邻居们至今仍赞美他在漫长冬季洪水期间的善举。

eulogize.example: Colleagues gathered to eulogize the scientist who had trained them all.  同事们聚在一起颂扬这位培养了他们所有人的科学家。

acclaim.example: Her first novel won wide critical acclaim across Europe and Asia.  她的第一部小说在欧洲和亚洲赢得了广泛的评论界赞誉。

omit.example: The summary omits the details that made his argument convincing.  摘要省略了使他论证有说服力的细节。

ignore.example: The captain ignored the warning and sailed into the storm.  船长忽视了警告，驶入了风暴之中。

neglect.example: He neglected his duties for weeks and was finally dismissed.  他数周疏忽职责，最终被解雇了。

slight.example: He felt slighted when nobody mentioned his contribution during the ceremony.  典礼上无人提及他的贡献，他觉得受到了轻视。
slight.cn: 轻微的，不重要的；轻视，怠慢

slur over.example: The report slurs over the failures and highlights only minor successes.  报告含糊带过失败，只突出一些小成绩。

beleaguer.example: Rising prices continued to beleaguer the new government all year.  物价上涨全年不断困扰着新政府。

harass.example: Enemy cavalry harassed the retreating army for three long days.  敌方骑兵对撤退的军队骚扰了漫长的三天。

pester.example: The reporters pestered her with questions outside the courthouse.  记者们在法院外不停向她追问。

tease.example: The boys teased their little sister about her new haircut.  男孩们拿妹妹的新发型取笑她。

delight.example: The young pianist delighted the audience with a lively encore.  这位年轻钢琴家用一首活泼的加演曲取悦了观众。

belie.example: The company's own records belie his claims about the accident.  公司自己的记录与他关于事故的说法相矛盾。

conceal.example: The witness tried to conceal the truth from the police.  证人试图向警方隐瞒真相。

curtain.example: Heavy drapes curtained the windows and hid the room from view.  厚重的帷幔遮住窗户，把房间藏了起来。

disguise.example: He disguised his disappointment behind a polite and steady smile.  他用礼貌平静的微笑掩饰了失望。

mask.example: Loud music masked the sound of the approaching helicopter.  响亮的音乐掩盖了直升机靠近的声音。

contradict.example: The witness's second statement flatly contradicted everything she had said earlier.  证人的第二份陈述与她此前所说完全矛盾。

contravene.example: Building a factory here would contravene several local environmental regulations.  在此建厂会违反数条当地环保法规。

disclose.example: The company refused to disclose the details of the settlement.  公司拒绝公开和解协议的细节。

expose.example: Two journalists exposed the fraud after months of quiet investigation.  两名记者经过数月暗中调查揭露了这起欺诈。

bellwether.example: This small town has long been a bellwether of national opinion.  这个小镇长期以来是全国民意的风向标。

leader.example: She became the leader of the movement while still a student.  她还是学生时就成了这场运动的领导者。

pacemaker.example: The small firm became the pacemaker for the entire software industry.  这家小公司成了整个软件行业的领跑者。

pilot.example: The school will pilot the new reading program in three classes.  学校将在三个班级试行这个新的阅读项目。

trendsetter.example: That designer was a trendsetter long before critics noticed her.  那位设计师早在评论界注意到她之前就已引领潮流。

follower.example: He remained a devoted follower of his teacher for thirty years.  他三十年来一直是老师忠诚的追随者。

disciple.example: He became a devoted disciple of the old master painter.  他成了这位老画家的忠实追随者。

imitator.example: The painter attracted many imitators but never a genuine rival.  这位画家吸引了许多模仿者，却没有真正的对手。

altruistic.example: Her altruistic work in the clinic earned wide public respect.  她在诊所无私的工作赢得了公众广泛尊敬。

philanthropic.example: Philanthropic donations paid for the new hospital wing for sick children.  慈善捐赠支付了收治病童的医院新翼楼。

compassionate.example: A compassionate nurse sat with the frightened child all night.  一位有同情心的护士整夜陪着那个受惊的孩子。

helpful.example: Your notes were extremely helpful when I revised the report.  我修改报告时你的笔记非常有帮助。

advantageous.example: The new tax rules proved advantageous to small local businesses.  新税收规定对本地小企业很有利。

favorable.example: Favorable weather allowed the harvest to finish a week early.  有利的天气让收割提前一周完成。

kindly.example: A kindly neighbor carried her groceries up the steep stairs.  一位和善的邻居帮她把杂货搬上陡楼梯。

profitable.example: The bakery finally became profitable in its third busy year.  这家面包店在忙碌的第三年终于开始赚钱。

salutary.example: The failed launch had a salutary effect on the careless habits of the team.  那次发射失败对团队的马虎习惯起了有益的作用。

noxious.example: Noxious fumes from the factory forced the school to close for two days.  工厂排出的有毒烟气迫使学校停课两天。

innocent.cn: 无害的，无恶意的；无辜的
innocent.example: What began as an innocent joke ended in a serious quarrel.  一句本无恶意的玩笑最后引发了激烈争吵。

injurious.example: Long hours of night work can be injurious to your health.  长时间夜班工作可能有害健康。

berate.example: The coach began to berate his players in front of reporters.  教练开始在记者面前严厉斥责他的球员。

flay.example: The editorial flayed the officials for ignoring repeated safety warnings.  社论严厉批评官员无视再三的安全警告。

scold.example: The teacher scolded the boys for running through the hallway.  老师因男孩们在走廊跑动而训斥他们。

rail.example: Students railed against the unfair new grading policy all week.  学生们整周都在痛斥不公平的新评分政策。

upbraid.example: The manager upbraided him for missing three deadlines in one month.  经理因他一个月内三次误期而严厉责骂他。

commend.example: The principal commended her courage in front of the whole school.  校长在全校面前赞扬了她的勇气。

beseech.example: The prisoners beseeched the governor for mercy in a long letter.  囚犯们在一封长信中恳求州长开恩。

conjure.example: She conjured him to stay until the doctor finally arrived.  她恳求他留下，直到医生终于赶来。
conjure.cn: 恳求，央求；使浮现于脑海

entreat.example: She entreated him to return before their mother learned of the quarrel.  她恳求他在母亲得知这场争吵之前回来。

implore.example: She implored the judge to give her brother another chance.  她恳求法官再给她弟弟一次机会。

plead.example: The prisoner pleaded for mercy in a trembling, exhausted voice.  囚犯用颤抖疲惫的声音恳求宽恕。

supplicate.example: The prisoner knelt to supplicate for forgiveness before the military tribunal.  囚犯跪下，在军事法庭前乞求宽恕。

demand.example: The angry customers demanded an apology from the store manager.  愤怒的顾客要求店长道歉。

besmirch.example: He sued the paper for trying to besmirch his reputation.  他起诉该报意图诽谤他的名誉。

defile.example: Vandals defiled the ancient temple with paint and broken glass.  破坏者用油漆和碎玻璃亵渎了那座古庙。

smear.example: Rivals tried to smear the candidate with unfounded financial rumors.  对手试图用毫无根据的财务谣言抹黑这位候选人。

soil.example: One reckless lie soiled a reputation built over many years.  一个轻率的谎言玷污了多年建立的声誉。

stain.example: The scandal stained the family name for two whole generations.  这桩丑闻让这个家族的名声蒙污两代人。

honor.example: The city honored the veterans with a quiet morning ceremony.  该市用一场安静的晨间仪式表彰老兵。

bifurcate.example: The path bifurcates into two branches just beyond the wooden bridge.  这条小路在木桥之后分成两条岔路。

divide.example: The teacher divided the class into four groups of five.  老师把班级分成四个五人小组。

diverge.example: The two trails diverge just beyond the old wooden bridge.  两条小径在那座老木桥之后就分岔开来。

fork.example: The trail forks near the old bridge, so read the signs.  小径在旧桥附近分岔，要看清路标。

bigot.example: Only a narrow-minded bigot would object to the new neighbors.  只有心胸狭隘的偏执者才会反对新邻居。

dogmatist.cn: 固执己见者，教条主义者
dogmatist.example: The professor argued like a dogmatist, ignoring every inconvenient fact.  这位教授像教条主义者一样争辩，无视一切不利事实。

partisan.example: The debate quickly sank into partisan shouting about very old grievances.  辩论很快沦为带党派偏见的叫嚷，纠缠陈年旧怨。
partisan.cn: 党派偏见的；盲目拥护者

depreciator.example: He was a tireless depreciator of other people's real achievements.  他总是不停地贬低他人的真实成就。

disparager.example: Critics called him a disparager of every new artistic movement.  批评者称他是所有新艺术运动的贬低者。

bland.example: The critics called it a bland performance with no real feeling.  评论家称这是一场毫无真情、十分无趣的表演。

insipid.example: The film was so insipid that half the audience fell asleep.  这部电影平淡无聊，半数观众都睡着了。

blandishment.example: She resisted every blandishment the salesman could think of.  她抵挡住了推销员能想出的每一句甜言蜜语。

flattery.example: He won the manager's favor through steady flattery rather than work.  他靠不断奉承而非工作赢得了经理的青睐。

blas.example: After a year of parties he grew blas about expensive food.  过了一年的聚会生活，他对昂贵的食物开始腻烦。

jaded.example: After twenty countries, even the most enthusiastic traveler becomes jaded and restless.  走过二十个国家后，就算最热情的旅行者也会厌倦而烦躁。

unconcerned.example: She seemed entirely unconcerned about the noise from the street.  她似乎完全不在意街上的噪音。

world-weary.example: His world-weary voice suggested he had seen every possible disappointment.  他厌世的语调显示他已见过各种失望。

zealous.example: Zealous volunteers knocked on every door in the small town.  热忱的志愿者敲遍了小镇的每一户人家。

blast.example: A bomb blast shattered every window on the narrow street.  一次炸弹爆炸震碎了这条窄街上的每扇窗户。

burst.example: The old pipe burst and flooded the basement within minutes.  旧管子爆裂，几分钟就淹了地下室。

detonation.example: A sudden detonation shook every window along the narrow street.  突然的爆炸震动了这条窄街上的每扇窗。

eruption.example: The eruption buried three villages under ash and molten rock.  这次喷发把三个村庄埋在火山灰和熔岩下。

outburst.example: His angry outburst surprised colleagues who thought him unfailingly calm.  他愤怒的爆发让以为他一向冷静的同事很吃惊。

implosion.example: The implosion of the housing market ruined thousands of small savers.  楼市的内部崩溃毁掉了成千上万小储户。

conspicuous.example: His bright red jacket made him conspicuous in the gray winter crowd.  他鲜红的夹克让他在灰暗的冬日人群中格外显眼。

flagrant.example: The company committed a flagrant violation of basic safety rules.  这家公司公然违反了基本安全规定。

glaring.example: There is a glaring error on the very first printed page.  印刷的第一页上就有一个明显错误。

pronounced.example: She speaks English with a pronounced accent from the north.  她说英语带着明显的北方口音。

subtle.example: There is a subtle difference between these two shades of blue.  这两种蓝色之间有细微的差别。

unimpressive.example: His unimpressive debut gave no hint of the fame ahead.  他平淡的首次登场丝毫看不出日后的名声。

blazon.example: The paper was eager to blazon the news across every front page.  该报急于把这条消息在各家头版上四处宣扬。

annunciate.example: Trumpets annunciated the arrival of the queen at the palace gate.  号角宣告女王已抵达宫门。

broadcast.example: The station broadcast the news of the rescue every hour.  电台每小时播报一次营救消息。

publicize.example: Organizers publicized the concert with posters across the whole campus.  组织者用海报在全校宣传这场音乐会。

proclaim.example: The colony voted to proclaim independence from the empire that summer.  那年夏天，殖民地投票宣告脱离帝国独立。

garnish.example: The chef garnished each plate with parsley and thin lemon slices.  厨师用欧芹和薄柠檬片点缀每个盘子。

blemish.example: One late payment left a small blemish on his credit record.  一次逾期付款在他的信用记录上留下了小小的污点。

deface.example: Someone defaced the statue with spray paint during the night.  有人夜里用喷漆涂污了那座雕像。

mar.example: A careless remark at dinner managed to mar an otherwise perfect evening.  餐桌上一句轻率的话毁掉了本该完美的一晚。

spoil.example: Heavy rain spoiled the picnic we had planned for weeks.  大雨破坏了我们筹划数周的野餐。

blotch.example: Ink blotches covered the corner of the carefully written letter.  墨渍污了那封精心书写信件的一角。

defect.example: A tiny defect in the wiring caused the entire system failure.  线路上一个微小缺陷导致了整个系统故障。

fault.example: His only fault is that he never admits being wrong.  他唯一的缺点是从不承认自己错了。

flaw.example: One small flaw in the design caused the bridge to fail.  设计中一个小缺陷导致桥梁失效。

spot.example: A grease spot on the sleeve ruined his only white shirt.  袖子上的油污弄坏了他唯一的白衬衫。

scar.example: The accident left a thin scar above his left eyebrow.  那次事故在他左眉上方留下一道细疤。

break.example: The cat broke the vase while chasing a moth indoors.  猫在屋里追蛾子时打破了花瓶。

disfigure.example: Cheap repairs disfigured the elegant facade of the old theater.  廉价的修补损毁了老剧院优雅的正面。

harm.example: Pesticide runoff harms the fish living in the nearby stream.  农药径流危害了附近溪流中的鱼。

hurt.example: Your careless comment clearly hurt her feelings at the dinner.  你随口的评论显然在晚餐上伤了她的感情。

impair.example: Lack of sleep seriously impairs judgment and slows your reactions.  睡眠不足严重损害判断力并减慢反应。

injure.example: He injured his knee while running downhill on wet stones.  他在湿滑石头上跑下坡时伤了膝盖。

fix.example: A neighbor fixed the leaking pipe before the floor was ruined.  邻居在地板毁坏前修好了漏水的管子。

renovate.example: We must renovate the old house completely before moving in.  搬进去之前我们必须彻底翻修这栋老房子。

repair.example: Workers repaired the roof just before the rainy season began.  工人们在雨季开始前修好了屋顶。

revamp.example: The company revamped its website to attract younger overseas customers.  公司改版网站以吸引更年轻的海外顾客。

blight.example: Heavy rain and disease can blight the harvest in a single week.  暴雨和病害能在一周之内毁掉收成。

wither.example: The tomato plants withered after a week without rain or shade.  一周无雨又没有遮荫，番茄苗都枯萎了。

shrivel.example: The unwatered seedlings shriveled within two days of intense heat.  没浇水的幼苗在两天酷热中就干瘪了。

damage.example: Late frost damaged the crops across the entire river valley.  晚霜损害了整个河谷的庄稼。

ruin.example: Weeks of drought ruined the harvest and emptied the village granary.  数周干旱毁掉收成，村里粮仓也空了。

flourish.example: Olive trees flourish in the dry, sunny hills of southern Spain.  橄榄树在西班牙南部干燥向阳的山丘上长得茂盛。

bliss.example: They spent a year of quiet domestic bliss in the countryside.  他们在乡下度过了一年宁静而极度幸福的家庭生活。

beatitude.example: The old monk's face wore an expression of quiet beatitude.  那位老僧脸上带着宁静至福的神情。

ecstasy.example: The crowd rose in a state of ecstasy when the winning goal went in.  制胜球进网时，全场观众狂喜地站了起来。

elation.example: Her elation faded once she read the fine print carefully.  她仔细读了小字条款后，兴奋就消退了。

blithe.example: His blithe disregard for the rules annoyed the older staff.  他对规则漫不经心的无视让资深员工不满。

bright.example: She greeted every customer with a bright and genuine smile.  她用开朗真诚的笑容迎接每位顾客。

buoyant.example: He arrived in a buoyant mood after hearing the good news.  听到好消息后，他心情愉快地到了。

gay.example: Gay music and bright lanterns filled the village square that evening.  那晚欢快的音乐和明亮的灯笼充满了村中广场。

jocular.example: His jocular tone kept the tense meeting from turning truly hostile.  他诙谐的语气让紧张的会议没有真正翻脸。

jocund.example: The jocund crowd sang and danced until the last lantern went out.  欢快的人群唱歌跳舞，直到最后一盏灯笼熄灭。

jovial.example: Our jovial host kept the guests laughing throughout the long winter evening.  我们愉快的主人让客人们在漫长的冬夜里笑声不断。

debonair.example: The debonair gentleman charmed every woman in the crowded ballroom.  这位风度翩翩的绅士让拥挤舞厅里的每位女士都为之倾倒。
debonair.cn: 风度翩翩的，温文尔雅的

insouciant.example: He answered the harsh criticism with an insouciant shrug and a smile.  他对严厉的批评只是满不在乎地耸耸肩，笑了笑。

lighthearted.cn: 轻松愉快的，无忧无虑的
lighthearted.example: We wanted a lighthearted film after such a stressful week.  在如此紧张的一周后，我们想看部轻松的电影。

dour.example: The guard's dour expression discouraged anyone from asking him for directions.  警卫严厉的表情让人不敢向他问路。

gloomy.example: She grew gloomy whenever the winter rain lasted more than a week.  每当冬雨连下一周以上，她就变得忧郁起来。

morose.example: After losing the election he grew morose and rarely left his apartment.  落选之后他变得忧郁，很少离开公寓。

saturnine.example: His saturnine expression discouraged anyone from starting a cheerful conversation.  他阴沉的表情让人不敢开启轻松的话题。

sulky.example: The sulky child refused to speak for the whole long afternoon.  那个赌气的孩子整个下午都不肯说话。

sullen.example: A sullen silence fell over the table when the topic was raised.  提到这个话题时，餐桌上陷入闷闷不乐的沉默。

careworn.example: Her careworn face brightened when the children ran into the room.  孩子们跑进房间时，她憔悴的脸上亮了起来。

blueprint.example: The committee published a blueprint for reform of the tax system.  委员会公布了税制改革的蓝图。
blueprint.cn: 蓝图，行动计划；事先规划

arrange.example: She arranged the whole trip in a single busy afternoon.  她在一个忙碌的下午就安排好了整趟行程。

budget.example: We budgeted carefully for the trip and still ran short.  我们为旅行仔细做了预算，钱还是不够。

calculate.example: Engineers calculated the cost of the bridge down to the last bolt.  工程师把这座桥的成本精确算到了最后一颗螺栓。

organize.example: Three students organized the conference without any help from staff.  三名学生在没有职工帮助下筹办了这次会议。

frame.example: The committee framed a new policy on remote work overnight.  委员会一夜之间制定了新的远程工作政策。

lay out.example: She laid out the whole plan in fewer than ten minutes.  她用不到十分钟就把整个计划说清楚了。

blunder.example: Sending the letter unsigned was a costly blunder.  把信未签名就寄出是个代价高昂的失误。

mistake.example: Everyone makes mistakes, but few admit them so quickly.  人人都会犯错，但很少有人这么快承认。

gaffe.example: His remark about the queen was a serious diplomatic gaffe.  他关于女王的言论是严重的外交失礼。

lapse.example: A brief lapse of memory made him forget his colleague's name entirely.  一时的记忆失误使他完全忘了同事的名字。

error.example: A single error in the formula ruined the entire calculation.  公式中一个错误就毁了整个计算。

blunt.example: Her blunt refusal left no room for further discussion.  她直率的拒绝没给进一步讨论留下余地。

hebetate.example: Years of routine labor seemed to hebetate his once quick mind.  多年例行劳作似乎让他曾经敏捷的头脑变迟钝了。

benumb.example: The freezing wind benumbed our fingers within a few short minutes.  刺骨寒风几分钟就让我们的手指麻木了。

enfeeble.example: A long fever enfeebled him so much that walking hurt.  长期发烧使他虚弱到走路都疼。

abrupt.example: His abrupt answer ended the conversation before it really began.  他生硬的回答让谈话还没开始就结束了。

brusque.example: The clerk's brusque manner offended nearly every waiting customer.  那名职员唐突的态度几乎冒犯了所有等候的顾客。

curt.example: Her curt reply made it clear that the discussion was over.  她简慢的回答清楚表明讨论已经结束。

gruff.cn: 生硬粗暴的；声音低沉的
gruff.example: A gruff old sailor pointed silently toward the harbor entrance.  一位声音低沉的老水手默默指向港口入口。

whet.example: The smell of garlic whetted our appetite long before dinner.  蒜香早在开饭前就激起了我们的食欲。

sharpen.example: He sharpened the knife on a wet stone before cutting bread.  他在湿石上磨快刀子后才切面包。

circuitous.example: We took a circuitous route to avoid the flooded highway.  我们绕了一条迂回的路以避开被淹的公路。

mealy-mouthed.example: Voters distrust mealy-mouthed politicians who never give a straight answer.  选民不信任那些从不直接回答、说话含糊的政客。

blur.example: New technology tends to blur the distinction between work and home.  新技术往往模糊了工作与家庭的界限。

shroud.example: Thick mist shrouded the harbor and hid the ships from view.  浓雾笼罩港口，把船只从视线中遮住。

becloud.example: Emotional appeals often becloud the real issue under serious discussion.  情感诉求常常把正在认真讨论的真问题弄模糊。

befog.example: Technical jargon befogs the argument instead of making it clearer.  技术术语让论证更模糊，而非更清楚。

obscure.example: He remained an obscure poet until a critic rediscovered his work decades later.  他一直是个不知名的诗人，直到几十年后一位批评家重新发现他的作品。

obfuscate.example: The witness seemed determined to obfuscate the facts rather than explain them.  证人似乎一心要把事实弄模糊，而不是解释清楚。

clarify.example: The dean clarified the rules after weeks of confused complaints.  在数周混乱的投诉后，院长澄清了规则。

illuminate.example: Her lecture illuminated a problem that had puzzled economists for years.  她的讲座阐明了一个困扰经济学家多年的问题。

blurt.example: He almost blurted out the secret in front of her parents.  他差点在她父母面前突然说出秘密。

bolt.example: He bolted out the secret before anyone could stop him.  他还没等人阻止就把秘密说了出来。

ejaculate.example: She ejaculated a warning just before the heavy branch struck the roof.  就在粗树枝砸到屋顶前，她突然喊出一声警告。

cry out.example: She had to cry out twice before the guard finally heard her.  她不得不大声呼喊两次，警卫才终于听见。

muffle.example: Thick curtains muffle the sound of traffic outside the window.  厚窗帘减弱了窗外的车流声。

mute.example: He remained mute on the issue despite repeated questions from reporters.  尽管记者反复提问，他对此事仍保持沉默。

bluster.example: The manager began to bluster and threaten when questioned closely.  被仔细追问时，经理开始狂妄自大地大声吓唬威胁。

roar.example: The coach roared at the players from the sideline.  教练在场边对球员们大声咆哮。

clamor.example: A clamor of voices rose from the crowded courtyard.  拥挤的院子里传出一片人声喧哗。

rattle.example: The passing train rattled every window in the old house.  驶过的火车震得老屋的每扇窗都咔咔作响。

disturbance.example: Police were called after a disturbance broke out in the bar.  酒吧里发生骚乱后警察被叫来了。

pandemonium.example: Pandemonium broke out when the final goal was scored.  最后一个进球时全场一片沸腾混乱。

tumult.example: The tumult in the square grew louder as more protesters arrived.  随着更多抗议者到来，广场上的骚动越来越大。

whisper.example: She whispered the answer so the teacher would not hear.  她低声说出答案，以免老师听见。

boggle.example: Investors still boggle at the risk of such a large loan.  投资者仍因如此大额贷款的风险而犹豫。

hesitate.example: Do not hesitate to call me if the plan changes.  如果计划有变，别犹豫，给我打电话。

falter.example: Mr. Garrison never faltered in his resolve to finish the project.  加里森先生完成这个项目的决心从未动摇。

waver.example: He wavered for weeks before accepting the job offer.  他犹豫了好几周才接受这份工作。

boisterous.example: A boisterous crowd filled the square outside the stadium.  一群喧闹的人挤满了体育场外的广场。

rowdy.example: The rowdy fans kept the whole neighborhood awake.  吵闹的球迷让整个街区都睡不着。

vociferous.example: She became a vociferous opponent of the new tax law.  她成了新税法的大声反对者。

clamorous.example: The clamorous market made quiet conversation impossible.  喧闹的市场让人根本无法安静交谈。

raucous.example: Raucous laughter spilled out of the crowded pub.  刺耳的笑声从挤满人的酒吧里传出来。

rambunctious.example: Three rambunctious puppies knocked over the coffee table.  三只闹腾的小狗把茶几撞翻了。

quiet.example: The library stays quiet even during exam week.  即使在考试周，图书馆也保持安静。

sedate.example: The hotel keeps a sedate atmosphere that older guests clearly appreciate.  这家酒店保持着安静沉稳的气氛，年长客人显然很喜欢。

bolster.example: A word of praise from her would bolster his confidence enormously.  她一句赞扬就会极大地增强他的信心。

buttress.example: Fresh evidence buttressed the prosecutor's case against the two suspects.  新证据支持了检察官针对两名嫌疑人的指控。

bear.example: These thin beams cannot bear the weight of the roof.  这些细梁承受不了屋顶的重量。

sustain.example: The country cannot sustain such growth without more energy.  没有更多能源，这个国家无法维持这样的增长。

undergird.example: Careful field data undergird every claim made in her new book.  细致的实地数据为她新书中的每一个论断打下了基础。

underpin.example: Careful field data underpin every claim in this paper.  细致的实地数据支撑着本文的每一个论断。

prop up.example: The government spent billions to prop up the failing bank.  政府花了数十亿来扶持这家濒临倒闭的银行。

buoy.example: Kind letters from strangers buoyed her spirits during the long illness.  陌生人的暖心来信在她久病期间让她振作起来。

reinforce.example: Repeated praise reinforced the child's interest in reading.  反复的表扬强化了孩子对阅读的兴趣。

bombast.example: The speech was full of bombast but offered no concrete plan.  那篇演讲充满浮夸之词，却没有具体的计划。

braggadocio.example: His speech was pure braggadocio with no real plan behind it.  他的演讲纯是吹牛，背后没有真正的计划。

grandiloquence.example: The senator's grandiloquence impressed few of the tired voters.  这位参议员的浮夸辞令没打动多少疲惫的选民。

exaggeration.example: To call the film a masterpiece is an exaggeration.  把这部电影称为杰作是一种夸张。

understatement.example: Saying the room was messy is a serious understatement.  说这房间乱，实在是太保守了。

bonhomie.example: The host greeted every guest with easy bonhomie.  主人以随和亲切的态度招待每一位客人。

amiability.example: Her amiability won over even the most difficult clients.  她的和善赢得了连最难缠的客户的好感。

geniality.example: The old professor treated students with unfailing geniality.  这位老教授对学生始终亲切和气。

boo.example: The fans began to boo the referee after the second penalty.  第二次判罚之后，球迷开始对裁判发出嘘声。

jeer.example: The crowd jeered at the player who missed the penalty.  人群嘲笑那名罚失点球的球员。

boon.example: This solar charger is a real boon to travelling photographers.  这款太阳能充电器对旅行摄影师来说是一大福音。

gift.example: The library received a generous gift from a former student.  图书馆收到一位老校友的丰厚捐赠。

benevolence.example: The hospital survives on the benevolence of local donors.  这家医院靠当地捐助者的善心维持。

present.example: She wrapped the birthday present in bright blue paper.  她用亮蓝色的纸包好了生日礼物。

windfall.example: The unexpected windfall allowed them to repay the whole loan early.  这笔意外之财让他们提前还清了全部贷款。

misfortune.example: A series of misfortunes left the family deeply in debt.  一连串的不幸让这家人负债累累。

scourge.example: Famine was the scourge of the region for a whole decade.  饥荒在整整十年间是该地区的祸患。

boorish.example: His boorish behavior at the table embarrassed everyone present.  他在餐桌上粗鲁无礼的举动让在场所有人难堪。

churlish.example: It would be churlish to refuse such a generous gift.  拒绝如此丰厚的礼物就太无礼了。

classless.example: Mocking the waiter was a classless thing to do.  取笑服务员是很没教养的行为。

loutish.example: His loutish manners at the dinner table embarrassed his entire family.  他在餐桌上粗鲁的举止让全家人都很难堪。

uncouth.example: His uncouth remarks at dinner offended nearly everyone at the table.  他在晚餐上粗鲁的言辞几乎惹恼了同桌所有人。

couth.example: He was surprisingly couth for someone raised on the streets.  对一个街头长大的人来说，他出奇地有教养。

cultivated.example: Her cultivated manners impressed everyone at the dinner.  她优雅的举止让晚宴上的每个人都印象深刻。

polished.example: His polished manners impressed everyone at the formal dinner.  他优雅得体的举止让正式晚宴上的每个人都印象深刻。

well-bred.phrase_cn: 一位有教养的年轻女子
well-bred.example: The well-bred guest thanked the host before leaving.  这位有教养的客人离开前向主人道了谢。

courteous.example: Even when customers shouted, the young clerk remained calm and courteous.  即使顾客大声嚷嚷，那位年轻店员仍然平静而有礼。

polite.example: It is polite to greet your neighbors in the morning.  早上向邻居问好是有礼貌的做法。

futile.example: Trying to persuade him was clearly a futile attempt.  试图说服他显然是徒劳之举。

abortive.example: After two abortive attempts, they abandoned the climb.  两次尝试失败后，他们放弃了攀登。

fruitless.example: Weeks of fruitless negotiation left both sides exhausted.  数周毫无结果的谈判让双方都疲惫不堪。

worthy.example: The charity is a worthy cause deserving public support.  这家慈善机构值得公众支持。

bound.example: Her curiosity knew no bounds when she entered the old library.  她走进那座旧图书馆时，好奇心毫无边界。

environs.example: Farms still cover much of the environs of the old capital.  农田仍覆盖着这座古都的大部分近郊。

limit.example: He was fined for exceeding the speed limit downtown.  他因在市区超速而被罚款。

confines.example: Students must stay within the confines of the campus.  学生必须待在校园范围内。

perimeter.example: Soldiers guarded the perimeter of the camp throughout the night.  士兵们整夜守卫着营地的周边界线。

resolute.example: Despite heavy criticism, the mayor remained resolute about closing the old factory.  尽管备受批评，市长在关闭旧工厂一事上依然坚定。

determined.example: She was determined to finish the race despite her injury.  尽管受伤，她仍决心跑完比赛。

single-minded.example: His single-minded pursuit of the record cost him his friendships.  他一心追求纪录，代价是失去了友情。

bent on.example: The young officer seemed bent on proving himself.  这位年轻军官似乎决心要证明自己。

unrestrainedness.example: The unrestrainedness of his spending finally ruined the family.  他毫无节制的花钱最终毁了这个家。

faltering.example: She answered in a faltering voice, unsure of herself.  她声音犹豫地回答，显得没有把握。

hesitant.example: He was hesitant about moving to a new city alone.  他对独自搬到新城市感到犹豫。

vacillating.example: The company suffered under a vacillating chief executive.  公司在一位摇摆不定的总裁手下吃尽苦头。

wavering.example: Polls showed the wavering support of rural voters.  民调显示农村选民的支持正在动摇。

weak-kneed.example: Critics called the deal a weak-kneed surrender to industry.  批评者称这项协议是对行业的软弱屈服。

boycott.example: Angry customers decided to boycott the store until prices came down.  愤怒的顾客决定抵制这家商店，直到价格下降。

bracing.example: A bracing wind off the lake woke us up immediately.  湖面吹来的清冽寒风立刻让我们清醒了。

invigorating.example: A cold shower can be surprisingly invigorating after a run.  跑步后洗个冷水澡出奇地让人精神焕发。

rejuvenating.example: Two weeks by the lake proved wonderfully rejuvenating.  在湖边的两周让人格外恢复了活力。

reviving.example: She handed him a reviving cup of strong coffee.  她给他递上一杯提神的浓咖啡。

stimulating.example: The seminar was the most stimulating class of the term.  这场研讨会是本学期最能激发思考的课。

vapid.example: The party ended in vapid conversation about traffic and the weather.  聚会最后只剩下关于交通和天气的乏味闲谈。

brake.example: The driver braked hard when a deer crossed the road.  司机看到一只鹿穿过马路，猛地刹了车。

decelerate.example: The train decelerated smoothly as it entered the station.  列车进站时平稳地减了速。

retard.example: Language barriers retarded the progress of the peace negotiations.  语言障碍阻碍了和平谈判的进展。

slacken.example: The runners slackened their pace on the final hill.  跑者们在最后一个坡上放慢了速度。

accelerate.example: New funding accelerated the development of the vaccine.  新的资金加快了疫苗的研发。

hasten.example: Warm weather hastened the melting of snow on the high mountain passes.  暖和的天气促进了高山山口积雪的融化。

rush.example: They rushed to the airport and barely caught the flight.  他们赶往机场，勉强赶上了航班。

speed up.example: The factory sped up production to meet holiday demand.  工厂加快生产以满足假期需求。

daredevil.example: The daredevil rider jumped his motorcycle over six parked cars.  那位鲁莽大胆的骑手驾摩托车跃过六辆停放的汽车。

madcap.example: Only a madcap would try to cross that river during the flood.  只有热爱冒险的疯子才会在洪水期试图渡过那条河。
madcap.cn: 莽撞冲动的；莽撞冲动的人

temerarious.example: It was temerarious of him to sail alone in that storm.  他在那场风暴中独自出海实在鲁莽。

heedful.example: Heedful of the forecast, the climbers turned back early.  留意到天气预报，登山者提早返回了。

prudent.example: It would be prudent to save part of every paycheck.  每份工资都存下一部分才是明智之举。

bold-faced.example: He told a bold-faced lie without even blushing.  他撒了个无耻的谎，脸都不红。

impudent.example: The impudent student argued with the professor in class.  这个无礼的学生在课上与教授争辩。

insolent.example: The student's insolent reply to the teacher shocked the entire classroom.  这名学生对老师无礼的回答震惊了整个教室。

unassertive.example: She was too unassertive to ask for the raise she deserved.  她太不敢主张，没去要她应得的加薪。

retiring.example: The author was a retiring man who avoided interviews.  这位作家性格内敛，从不接受采访。

timid.example: She gave a timid smile and slipped into the back row.  她怯生生地一笑，溜进后排座位。

bravado.example: His loud threats were pure bravado, and nobody took them seriously.  他大声的威胁纯属虚张声势，没人当真。

bravura.example: The violinist closed the concert with a stunning bravura solo.  小提琴手以一段炫技独奏为音乐会收尾。

artful.example: The chef's artful plating made the dish look like a painting.  厨师巧妙的摆盘让这道菜看起来像幅画。

masterful.example: Her masterful handling of the violin silenced the whole hall.  她精湛的小提琴技艺让全场肃静。

artless.example: The painting was an artless copy of a famous portrait.  这幅画是对一幅名作的拙劣临摹。

unprofessional.example: Arriving late to every meeting looks deeply unprofessional.  每次会议都迟到显得极不专业。

unskillful.example: The unskillful repair left the table wobbling badly.  这次拙劣的修理让桌子摇晃得厉害。

confront.example: Sooner or later you must confront the problem directly.  你早晚必须直面这个问题。

outface.example: The witness outfaced the lawyer without dropping her gaze.  证人目光丝毫不移，气势压过了律师。

modest.example: He stayed modest about his award and thanked his team.  他对自己的奖项很谦虚，还感谢了团队。

self-effacing.cn: 不爱出头的，谦逊低调的
self-effacing.phrase_cn: 一位低调谦逊的科学家
self-effacing.example: The self-effacing author refused to appear on television.  这位低调的作家拒绝上电视。

dodge.example: The minister managed to dodge the question three times in one interview.  部长在一次采访中三次成功回避了这个问题。

duck.example: The minister ducked every question about the budget.  部长回避了所有关于预算的问题。

shirk.example: No one on this team is allowed to shirk hard work.  这个团队里没人可以逃避苦活。

sidestep.example: The candidate neatly sidestepped the issue of rising unemployment.  这位候选人巧妙地回避了失业率上升的问题。

breach.example: The company breached the contract by delivering the goods late.  这家公司延迟交货，违反了合同。

fracture.example: The scan revealed a hairline fracture in his left wrist.  扫描显示他左手腕有一道细微裂缝。

infringe.example: The new rule infringes on the privacy of every employee.  新规定侵犯了每位员工的隐私。

transgress.example: Any player who transgresses the rules will be removed from the tournament.  任何违反规则的选手都将被逐出这场比赛。

obey.example: Drivers must obey the speed limit in school zones.  司机在学校区域必须遵守限速。

observe.example: All visitors are expected to observe the museum's rules.  所有参观者都应遵守博物馆的规定。

conform to.example: Every part must conform to the national safety standard.  每个零件都必须符合国家安全标准。

brevity.example: For the sake of brevity, I will skip the technical details.  为了简洁，我会略过技术细节。

briefness.example: The briefness of his reply suggested he was annoyed.  他回答之简短说明他有些恼火。

conciseness.example: Editors valued the report for its conciseness and clarity.  编辑们赞赏这份报告简洁清晰。

shortness.example: The shortness of the deadline forced them to work overnight.  截止期限太短，逼得他们通宵赶工。

lengthiness.example: Readers complained about the lengthiness of the introduction.  读者抱怨引言太过冗长。

bribe.example: He tried to bribe the guard with a thick envelope of cash.  他试图用一叠现金贿赂那名警卫。

corrupt.example: The corrupt inspector accepted cash to ignore the violations.  这名腐败的检查员收现金来无视违规。

pay off.example: They tried to pay off the inspector to avoid a fine.  他们试图收买检查员以逃避罚款。

square.example: The developer had squared the local officials long before construction.  开发商早在动工前就把当地官员收买好了。

bridle.example: She bridled her temper and answered the rude question politely.  她克制住脾气，礼貌地回答了那个无礼的问题。

contain.example: Doctors worked around the clock to contain the outbreak.  医生们昼夜不停地努力控制疫情。

curb.example: The city introduced new rules to curb traffic downtown.  市政府出台新规以限制市区交通。

constrain.example: Strict rules constrain his freedom to travel outside the country.  严格的规定限制了他出国旅行的自由。

inhibit.example: Cold weather inhibits the growth of these tropical plants.  寒冷天气抑制了这些热带植物的生长。

regulate.example: New laws regulate how companies collect personal data.  新法规范了公司收集个人数据的方式。

restrain.example: She could hardly restrain her laughter during the speech.  演讲时她几乎忍不住笑。

tame.example: It took the trainer months to tame the wild horse completely.  训马师花了几个月才彻底驯服那匹野马。

rein in.example: The board reined in spending after two bad quarters.  两个季度业绩不佳后，董事会控制了开支。

animated.example: The class turned into an animated debate about ethics.  这堂课变成了一场关于伦理的热烈辩论。

bustling.example: The port grew into a bustling center of trade.  这座港口发展成了繁忙的贸易中心。

frisky.example: The frisky colt raced across the field at dawn.  黎明时那匹活泼的小马驹在田野上奔跑。

kinetic.example: The dancer's kinetic style filled the stage with motion.  这位舞者充满动感的风格让舞台生机勃勃。

vibrant.example: The neighborhood became a vibrant hub for young artists.  这个街区成了年轻艺术家的活力中心。

dead.example: The resort is completely dead in the winter months.  这个度假地在冬季几个月里毫无生气。

lifeless.example: The actors gave a lifeless performance to a bored audience.  演员们在无聊的观众前演得毫无生气。

bristle.example: He bristled at the suggestion that his research was careless.  有人说他的研究草率，他顿时怒不可遏。

fulminate.example: The old editor fulminated against corruption in every weekly column.  那位老编辑在每周的专栏里大声斥责腐败。

rampage.example: Elephants rampaged through the village, destroying several huts.  大象横冲直撞穿过村子，毁了几间棚屋。

fume.example: He sat fuming in the car after the meeting was canceled.  会议取消后他坐在车里生闷气。

cower.example: The frightened puppy cowered under the table during the loud thunderstorm.  雷雨大作时，惊恐的小狗畏缩在桌子下面。

brittle.example: The brittle old pages cracked when I turned them carefully.  我小心翻动时，那些脆化的旧书页还是裂开了。
brittle.cn: 易碎的，脆弱的；冷淡的，不真心的

crispy.example: The crispy skin of the roast duck cracked at the touch.  烤鸭酥脆的皮一碰就裂。

crumbly.example: The soil here is dry and crumbly between the fingers.  这里的土干燥松散，一捏就散。

flaky.cn: 易剥落成片的；不可靠的
flaky.example: The old paint on the door was dry and flaky.  门上的旧漆干裂，一片片剥落。

friable.example: The friable dry soil crumbled easily between his rough fingers.  易碎的干土在他粗糙的手指间轻易碎裂。

chilly.example: The proposal met a chilly reception from the committee.  这项提议受到委员会的冷淡对待。

frigid.example: She gave the latecomer a frigid stare and said nothing.  她冷冰冰地盯了迟到者一眼，什么也没说。

frosty.example: The visitors received a frosty welcome from the village elders.  来访者受到村中长者冷淡的接待。

glacial.example: His glacial tone made everyone at the table stop talking at once.  他冰冷的语气让桌边所有人立刻停止了交谈。

unsympathetic.example: The manager was unsympathetic to complaints about long hours.  经理对加班时间过长的抱怨毫无同情。

warmhearted.example: Their warmhearted host insisted that everyone stay for dinner.  他们热心的主人坚持要所有人留下吃饭。

broach.example: Nobody dared to broach the topic of money at the reunion.  聚会上没人敢提出钱的话题。

moot.example: Several members mooted the idea of moving the deadline.  几名成员提出了推迟截止日期的想法。

place.example: She placed the question before the committee that morning.  那天上午她把这个问题提交给了委员会。

raise.example: He raised an objection just before the vote was taken.  就在投票前他提出了反对意见。

bring up.example: Nobody dared bring up the topic of money at dinner.  晚饭时没人敢提起钱的话题。

bromide.example: His speech ended with a tired old bromide about hard work.  他的演讲以一句关于努力工作的陈腐套话作结。

banality.example: The film offered nothing but banalities about growing up.  这部电影只提供了些关于成长的陈腐说法。

platitude.example: The speech offered nothing but platitudes about hard work and dreams.  这篇演讲除了关于努力与梦想的陈词滥调外别无他物。

homily.example: We had to sit through another homily about punctuality and respect.  我们只得又听了一通关于守时与尊重的冗长训诫。

truism.example: It is a truism that hard work alone rarely guarantees success.  仅靠努力很少能保证成功，这是句老生常谈。

chestnut.example: He repeated that old chestnut about hard work and luck.  他又重复了那句关于努力与运气的老话。

shibboleth.cn: 陈腐的口号；标志性用语
shibboleth.example: Free trade became a shibboleth repeated by every candidate.  自由贸易成了每位候选人都挂在嘴上的口号。

brook.example: The strict coach will brook no excuses for missing practice.  这位严厉的教练不容许任何缺席训练的借口。

abide.example: She cannot abide people who interrupt her while reading.  她无法容忍别人在她读书时打扰。

countenance.example: The headmaster would not countenance cheating of any kind in his school.  校长绝不容忍校内任何形式的作弊。

endure.example: The settlers endured three winters without proper shelter.  移民们在没有像样住所的情况下熬过了三个冬天。

stomach.example: He could not stomach the insult and walked out of the meeting.  他无法忍受这种侮辱，径直退出会议。

browbeat.example: The lawyer tried to browbeat the witness into changing her story.  律师试图恐吓证人改口。

blackjack.example: The gang blackjacked shopkeepers into paying protection money.  这伙人威逼店主交保护费。

bulldoze.cn: 强行逼迫；用推土机推平
bulldoze.example: The chairman bulldozed the plan through the meeting.  主席强行让这个方案在会上通过。

bully.example: The new teacher quickly stopped the bully who terrorized younger children.  新老师很快制止了那个欺负小同学的恶霸。

cow.example: The sergeant's shouting failed to cow the new recruits into silence.  中士的吼叫没能把新兵威吓得沉默下来。

hector.example: The coach hectored his players throughout the second half.  整个下半场教练都在对球员大声恫吓。

bruit.example: The scandal was bruited about long before any facts emerged.  丑闻在任何事实浮现之前就已四处传开。

circulate.example: Rumors of a merger circulated quickly among the staff.  合并的传言在员工中迅速传开。

noise about.example: Someone noised it about that the factory would close.  有人四处传言说工厂要关门。

keep secret.example: They kept the engagement secret from their families for months.  他们对家人隐瞒了订婚的事好几个月。

buck.example: A few senators bucked the party line and voted against it.  几位参议员违抗党内立场，投了反对票。

fight.example: The residents will fight the proposal to widen the old highway.  居民们将反对拓宽这条旧公路的提案。

oppose.example: Two senators openly opposed the new tax bill.  两位参议员公开反对这项新税案。

repel.example: The greasy smell of the kitchen seemed to repel every customer who entered.  厨房油腻的气味似乎让每个进来的顾客都感到厌恶。

withstand.example: The bridge was built to withstand hurricane winds.  这座桥的建造能抵挡飓风。

assent to.example: The board finally assented to the revised contract.  董事会最终同意了修改后的合同。

budge.example: The heavy stone would not budge despite our best efforts.  尽管我们竭尽全力，那块沉重的石头还是挪不动。

relent.example: Her father finally relented and let her borrow the car.  她父亲终于让步，把车借给了她。

submit.example: The rebels refused to submit to the new government.  叛军拒绝向新政府屈服。

succumb.example: The mayor finally succumbed to pressure and withdrew the unpopular proposal.  市长最终屈服于压力，撤回了不受欢迎的提案。

surrender.example: The thief finally surrendered to the police after a long chase.  经过长时间追捕，小偷终于向警方投降。

bulge.example: A strange bulge in his jacket pocket caught the officer's attention.  他夹克口袋里奇怪的鼓包引起了警官的注意。

convexity.example: The slight convexity of the mirror widens the driver's view.  镜面轻微的凸度扩大了司机的视野。

projection.example: Birds nested on a narrow projection of the cliff face.  鸟在崖壁一处狭窄的突出部筑巢。

protrusion.example: The doctor examined a small protrusion on his wrist.  医生检查了他手腕上一处小突起。

protuberance.example: A round protuberance had formed on the trunk of the tree.  树干上长出了一个圆形的凸起。

depressed region.example: Water collected in the depressed region at the field's edge.  水积在田边的凹陷处。

cavity.example: The dentist found a cavity in one of her back teeth.  牙医在她一颗后牙上发现了龋洞。

dent.example: A small dent in the car door annoyed him for years.  车门上一个小凹痕让他好几年都很在意。

indent.example: Please indent the first line of every paragraph.  请把每段的首行缩进。

pit.example: Rain filled the shallow pits left by the machines.  雨水灌满了机器留下的浅坑。

bullyboy.example: The landlord sent bullyboys to frighten the tenants.  房东派打手去恐吓房客。

intimidator.example: He was known as an intimidator who silenced every critic.  他以恐吓者闻名，让所有批评者都不敢发声。

underdog.example: Everyone loves to see the underdog win in the final match.  每个人都喜欢看到弱者在决赛中获胜。

bumptious.example: Her bumptious manner annoyed the older members of the committee.  她自以为是的态度让委员会里年长的成员很反感。

assumptive.cn: 傲慢的，自以为是的；假定的
assumptive.example: His assumptive manner annoyed everyone at the negotiating table.  他傲慢的态度让谈判桌上的人都很反感。

supercilious.example: A supercilious smile crossed his face when he heard my question.  听到我的问题，他脸上掠过傲慢的微笑。

imperious.example: Her imperious manner made junior colleagues afraid to disagree.  她专横的态度让年轻同事不敢有异议。

overweening.example: His overweening confidence led him to ignore every warning from the engineers.  他过度的自信使他忽视了工程师的每一次警告。

pompous.example: The pompous speech bored everyone in the crowded town hall.  那场浮夸的演讲让拥挤的市政厅里每个人都厌烦。

presuming.cn: 自以为是的，冒失放肆的
presuming.example: It was presuming of him to offer advice uninvited.  他未经邀请就给建议，实在冒失。

presumptuous.example: It seems presumptuous to criticize a book you have not read.  批评一本没读过的书，似乎太放肆了。

self-.example: The prefix self- appears in words like self-important and self-taught.  前缀 self- 出现在 self-important、self-taught 这类词中。

haughty.example: She gave the waiter a haughty look and said nothing.  她傲慢地看了服务员一眼，什么也没说。

unarrogant.example: Despite his fame he remained a modest, unarrogant teacher.  尽管成名，他仍是一位谦和不傲的老师。

unpretentious.example: They live in a small, unpretentious house near the river.  他们住在河边一间朴实的小房子里。

bungle.example: The crew bungled the repair and flooded the entire basement.  工人把维修办糟了，整个地下室都被水淹了。

bumble.example: He bumbled through his answer and confused the whole audience.  他含糊其辞地答完，把全场听众都弄糊涂了。

fumble.example: He fumbled for the keys in his dark coat pocket.  他在昏暗的外套口袋里笨拙地摸找钥匙。

mess up.example: Do not mess up the report the night before the deadline.  别在截止前夜把报告搞砸。

screw up.example: He screwed up his first interview but got the job anyway.  他把第一次面试搞砸了，但最后还是拿到了工作。

bring off.example: Somehow she brought off the rescue without any help.  她不知怎么在无人相助下完成了营救。

hearten.example: The crowd's cheering heartened the runners on the last steep hill.  观众的欢呼在最后一个陡坡上鼓舞了跑者。

inspire.example: Her speech inspired the students to work much harder.  她的演讲激励学生更加努力。

bear up.example: She bore up bravely through the long months of treatment.  在漫长的数月治疗中她勇敢地坚持着。

buck up.example: A short walk and some coffee bucked him up nicely.  散散步再喝点咖啡，他精神好了很多。

discourage.example: Early failure should not discourage a young researcher.  早期的失败不该让年轻研究者气馁。

dishearten.example: The string of early losses disheartened even the most loyal fans.  开局连输让最忠实的球迷也失去了信心。

dispirit.example: The endless rain dispirited even the most cheerful campers.  连绵的阴雨让最开朗的营员也沮丧起来。

chipper.example: She sounded surprisingly chipper for someone who slept three hours.  对只睡了三小时的人来说，她听起来出奇地精神。

eupeptic.cn: 乐观愉快的；消化良好的
eupeptic.example: His eupeptic outlook made even bad news seem manageable.  他乐观的心态让坏消息也显得可以应付。

lightsome.example: She crossed the room with a lightsome, dancing step.  她以轻快如舞的步子穿过房间。

upbeat.example: Despite the heavy loss, the coach stayed upbeat about the coming season.  尽管惨败，教练对下个赛季依然乐观。
upbeat.cn: 乐观向上的，令人振奋的

winsome.example: Her winsome smile made the shy children relax almost at once.  她迷人的微笑让害羞的孩子们几乎立刻放松下来。

effervescent.example: Her effervescent laughter filled the small crowded kitchen.  她欢快的笑声充满了狭小拥挤的厨房。

boom.example: Tourism boomed after the new airport opened last spring.  新机场去年春天启用后，旅游业迅速繁荣。

buildup.example: Doctors noticed a slow buildup of fluid in his lungs.  医生注意到他肺部液体缓慢积聚。

multiply.example: Bacteria multiply quickly in warm and damp conditions.  细菌在温暖潮湿的环境中迅速繁殖。

proliferate.example: Cheap smartphones proliferated across the country in just five years.  廉价智能手机在短短五年内遍布全国。

rollup.example: The report gave a monthly rollup of all regional sales.  报告给出了各区域销售的月度汇总。

wax.example: His influence in the party waxed steadily during the long campaign.  在漫长的竞选中，他在党内的影响力稳步增强。

prosper.example: The small bakery prospered once tourists discovered the town.  游客发现这个小镇后，那家小面包店就兴旺起来。

waste away.example: Without proper food the prisoners slowly wasted away.  没有足够食物，囚犯们渐渐消瘦衰弱。

burlesque.example: The play is a clever burlesque of modern political debate.  这部戏是对当代政治辩论的巧妙滑稽模仿。
burlesque.cn: 滑稽夸张的模仿讽刺作品；恶搞

caricature.cn: 讽刺画，夸张的滑稽模仿
caricature.example: The cartoonist drew a cruel caricature of the new mayor.  漫画家画了一幅刻薄的新市长讽刺画。

imitate.example: Children naturally imitate the speech of adults around them.  孩子会自然地模仿身边大人的说话方式。

parody.example: The students wrote a hilarious parody of the morning speech at assembly.  学生们写了一篇滑稽的作品，恶搞集会上的早间讲话。

spoof.example: The show aired a clever spoof of the evening news broadcast.  节目播出了对晚间新闻的一段巧妙恶搞。

travesty.example: Critics called the hasty trial a travesty of justice.  批评者称这场匆忙的审判是对正义的拙劣讽刺。

burnish.example: He spent the afternoon burnishing the brass handles until they gleamed.  他花了一下午把铜把手擦得发亮。

buff.example: He buffed the old silver tray until it gleamed.  他把那只旧银盘擦得闪闪发亮。

polish.example: She polished her essay carefully before sending it in.  她仔细润色文章后才交上去。

furbish.example: They furbished the old theater before the festival began.  他们在节庆开始前翻新了那家老剧院。

grind.example: The workers ground the marble surface until it shone.  工人把大理石表面磨到发亮。

smoothen.example: A little sanding will smoothen the surface of the board.  稍加打磨就能把木板表面弄平滑。

corroborate.example: Two neighbors corroborated the driver's account of the accident that night.  两位邻居证实了司机对那晚事故的说法。

substantiate.example: No evidence has emerged to substantiate his serious accusations.  没有证据能证实他严重的指控。

shore up.example: The government acted quickly to shore up the failing banks.  政府迅速采取行动支撑濒临倒闭的银行。

challenge.example: Several scientists challenged the conclusions of the new study.  几位科学家质疑这项新研究的结论。

involved.example: The plot is so involved that few readers finish the book.  情节太过错综复杂，很少有读者读完这本书。

sophisticated.example: The lab uses highly sophisticated equipment to detect the particles.  实验室用极为精密的设备探测这些粒子。

straightforward.example: The instructions are straightforward enough for a child to follow.  说明简单明了，连孩子都能照着做。

uncomplicated.example: He preferred an uncomplicated life in a quiet mountain village.  他偏爱在宁静山村过简单的生活。

cache.example: Police discovered a cache of weapons beneath the barn floor.  警方在谷仓地板下发现了一批藏匿的武器。

stash.example: She stashed the letters in a box under her bed.  她把那些信藏在床下的盒子里。

stockpile.example: The country stockpiled fuel before the long winter arrived.  这个国家在漫长冬季到来前囤积燃料。

store.example: Squirrels store nuts in hollow trees every autumn.  松鼠每年秋天把坚果藏在树洞里。

deposit.example: Geologists found a rich deposit of copper beneath the dry valley.  地质学家在干谷下面发现了丰富的铜矿藏。

hoard.example: Squirrels hoard nuts in hollow trees long before the first frost.  松鼠早在初霜之前就把坚果贮藏在树洞里。

reserve.example: The city keeps a reserve of water for dry summers.  该市为干旱的夏季保留一份储水。

cachet.example: A degree from that school still carries considerable cachet here.  那所学校的学位在这里仍然很有声望。

authorization.example: No one may enter the lab without written authorization.  未经书面授权，任何人不得进入实验室。

concurrence.example: The plan proceeded with the concurrence of all board members.  该计划在全体董事同意之下推进。

endorsement.example: The candidate won the endorsement of two major unions.  这位候选人获得两大工会的支持。

license.example: She finally obtained a license to practice medicine in three different states.  她终于取得了在三个不同州行医的执业许可。

permission.example: You need permission from the owner before entering the field.  进入这片地之前需要得到主人许可。

sanction.example: The board refused to sanction the plan without a detailed budget.  董事会拒绝在没有详细预算的情况下批准该计划。

homage.example: Thousands came to pay homage to the poet on her ninetieth birthday.  数千人在诗人九十岁生日那天前来致敬。

kudos.example: She earned kudos from critics for her fearless debut novel.  她凭无畏的处女作小说赢得了评论界的赞誉。

prestige.example: The old university still enjoys enormous prestige among employers worldwide.  这所老牌大学在全球雇主中仍享有极高声望。

interdiction.example: Naval interdiction stopped most of the smuggling along the coast.  海军的阻断行动制止了沿岸大部分走私。

prohibition.example: The city enforced a prohibition against building near the lake.  该市执行了禁止在湖边建房的规定。

proscription.example: Wartime proscription of certain newspapers lasted for several years.  战时对某些报纸的查禁持续了数年。

infamy.example: His name lives on in infamy after the scandal.  丑闻之后他的名字以恶名流传下来。

notoriety.example: The video gained him instant notoriety that followed him for the rest of his career.  这段视频让他立刻声名狼藉，并伴随他整个职业生涯。

cacophony.example: A cacophony of horns filled the street during rush hour.  高峰时段街上充满刺耳的喇叭声。

blare.example: Music blared from the open windows of the passing car.  音乐从驶过汽车敞开的车窗里轰响出来。

din.example: We could barely talk above the din of the factory.  在工厂的喧闹声中我们几乎无法交谈。

racket.example: The children upstairs made a racket all afternoon long.  楼上的孩子整个下午都在吵闹。

silence.example: A long silence followed his surprising announcement to the class.  他向全班宣布这惊人消息后是长久的沉默。

still.example: The air was still and the lake looked like glass.  空气静止无风，湖面像玻璃一样。

stillness.example: Only a distant bell broke the stillness of the valley.  只有远处的钟声打破了山谷的寂静。

cavalier.example: The company took a cavalier attitude toward worker safety.  这家公司对工人安全的态度傲慢轻率。
cavalier.cn: 有骑士风度的人；傲慢轻率的

chevalier.example: The old chevalier still bowed like a courtier of Versailles.  这位老骑士仍像凡尔赛宫的朝臣那样行礼。

arrogant.example: His arrogant remarks cost him the respect of his colleagues.  他傲慢的言论使他失去了同事的尊重。

lofty.example: She dismissed our idea with a lofty wave of her hand.  她自大地一挥手就否定了我们的想法。

pre-.example: The prefix pre- means before, as in preview and prepay.  前缀 pre- 表示「之前」，如 preview、prepay。

culprit.example: Police soon identified the culprit behind the string of thefts.  警方很快查明这一连串盗窃的肇事者。

devil.example: In the old story the devil offers wealth for a soul.  在那个古老故事里，恶魔用财富换取灵魂。

felon.example: The law bars a convicted felon from owning any firearm.  法律禁止已定罪的重罪犯持有枪械。

fiend.example: The newspapers described the killer as a heartless fiend.  报纸把这个凶手描述成毫无心肠的恶魔。

miscreant.example: The judge promised to punish the miscreants who had vandalized the village school.  法官承诺惩罚那些破坏村校的恶棍。

rapscallion.example: That little rapscallion stole apples from the neighbor's tree again.  那个小捣蛋鬼又偷了邻居树上的苹果。

rascal.example: That rascal took the last piece of cake again.  那个小淘气又拿走了最后一块蛋糕。

villain.example: Every good film needs a villain the audience loves hating.  每部好片都需要一个让观众爱恨的反派。

cajole.example: She cajoled her brother into driving her to the airport.  她哄着哥哥开车送她去机场。

blandish.example: He blandished the officials until they signed the permit.  他一路奉承官员，直到他们签下许可。

blarney.example: A little blarney got him a free room at the inn.  几句花言巧语让他在旅店白住了一间房。

palaver.example: After an hour of pointless palaver, the committee had decided nothing.  经过一小时无意义的闲谈，委员会什么也没决定。

wheedle.example: She wheedled her father into lending her the old car.  她哄着父亲把那辆旧车借给她。

sweet-talk.example: He sweet-talked the clerk into giving him a discount.  他甜言蜜语哄得店员给他打了折。

calcify.example: Over decades the informal custom calcified into an unbreakable rule.  几十年间，这个非正式习俗僵化成了不可打破的规则。

harden.example: Years of war had hardened the young soldier's heart.  多年战争使这名年轻士兵的心变得冷硬。

ossify.example: Over the decades the bold vision began to ossify into rigid dogma.  几十年间，那个大胆的愿景开始僵化为死板的教条。

make malleable.example: Careful heating can make even the hardest steel alloy malleable.  仔细加热能让最硬的钢合金也变得易塑。

make pliant.example: Steam is used to make the wood for violin backs pliant.  蒸汽被用来让做琴背的木料变柔韧。

make more flexible.example: Daily stretching will make the muscles of your back more flexible.  每天拉伸能让你的背部肌肉更灵活。

calibrate.example: Technicians calibrate the scales every morning before the lab opens.  技术员每天早上在实验室开门前校准天平。

unstandardize.example: Local schools tried to unstandardize the yearly reading exam.  当地学校试图取消年度阅读考试的标准化。

calligraphy.example: He practices Chinese calligraphy for an hour every evening.  他每天晚上练一小时中国书法。

longhand.example: She wrote the whole letter in careful longhand.  她用工整的手写体写完了整封信。

manuscript.example: The library keeps a medieval manuscript under tightly controlled lighting.  图书馆将一份中世纪手稿保存在严格控制的灯光下。

penmanship.example: His penmanship was so neat that teachers displayed his notebooks.  他的书写工整得让老师把他的本子展示出来。

script.example: The invitation was written in flowing italic script.  邀请函以流畅的斜体字写成。

callous.example: His callous joke about the accident shocked everyone in the room.  他拿这场事故开的冷酷玩笑震惊了房间里的每个人。

affectless.example: The witness described the crime in a flat, affectless tone.  证人用平淡无情感的语调描述这桩罪行。

uncharitable.example: It would be uncharitable to blame her for the delay.  为这次延误责怪她就太苛刻了。

unsparing.cn: 毫不留情的；毫不吝惜的
unsparing.example: The review was unsparing about the actor's weak performance.  这篇评论对该演员糟糕的表演毫不留情。

remorseless.cn: 毫无悔意的，冷酷无情的
remorseless.example: The killer remained remorseless throughout the long public trial.  凶手在漫长的公开审判中始终毫无悔意。

indurate.example: Years of betrayal had indurated his heart against every plea for sympathy.  多年的背叛使他的心变得冷硬，对任何求情都无动于衷。

ruthless.example: The general was ruthless with anyone who questioned his orders.  将军对任何质疑其命令的人都残忍无情。

tender.example: She has a tender heart and cannot bear to see animals suffer.  她心地温软，见不得动物受苦。
tender.cn: 温柔的，心软同情的；正式提出

callow.example: The callow recruit asked questions that made the veterans laugh.  这名稚嫩的新兵问的问题让老兵们发笑。

green.example: The green interns needed close supervision during their very first month.  这些毫无经验的实习生在最初一个月需要密切的指导。

immature.example: The fruit is still immature and much too sour to pick.  这些果子还未成熟，太酸，不能采摘。

inexperienced.example: The team was young and inexperienced but full of energy.  这支队伍年轻缺乏经验，却充满活力。

juvenile.example: His juvenile jokes embarrassed everyone at the formal dinner.  他幼稚的玩笑让正式晚宴上的人都很尴尬。

unfledged.example: The unfledged birds could not yet leave the nest.  这些羽毛未齐的雏鸟还不能离巢。

unripened.example: The unripened peaches tasted hard and unpleasantly sour.  这些没熟的桃子又硬又酸，很不好吃。

puerile.example: His puerile complaints annoyed the whole committee.  他幼稚的抱怨让整个委员会都不快。

adult.example: She handled the crisis in a calm, adult way.  她以冷静成熟的方式处理了这场危机。

experienced.example: We hired an experienced nurse to care for my grandmother.  我们请了一位有经验的护士照顾我祖母。

grown-up.example: Only the grown-ups were allowed to stay for the discussion.  只有成年人被允许留下参加讨论。

mature.example: He seems remarkably mature for a boy of fifteen.  对一个十五岁男孩来说他显得格外成熟。

ripe.cn: 成熟的，熟透的；时机成熟的
ripe.example: The peaches are finally ripe enough to pick and eat.  这些桃子终于熟到可以采下来吃了。

calumniate.example: Opponents calumniated the mayor with stories no one could prove.  反对者用无人能证实的说法诽谤市长。

asperse.example: The pamphlet aspersed every officer who supported the reform.  这本小册子中伤了每一位支持改革的官员。

blacken.example: Rumors quickly blackened the name of the honest official.  谣言很快玷污了这位清廉官员的名声。

defame.example: He sued the paper for trying to defame him.  他起诉那家报纸企图诽谤他。

libel.example: The actor claimed the article libeled him and his family.  这位演员称该文诽谤了他和他的家人。

malign.example: Rival newspapers began to malign the senator without offering a shred of evidence.  竞争对手的报纸开始诽谤这位参议员，却拿不出一丝证据。

traduce.example: Rival papers traduced the senator throughout the long campaign.  对立的报纸在整场竞选中中伤这位参议员。

vilify.example: The newspaper tried to vilify the whistleblower instead of examining her evidence.  报纸试图诽谤举报者，而不是审查她的证据。

flattering.example: The portrait was flattering but hardly looked like him.  这幅画像很美化，却几乎不像他。

camaraderie.example: A strong camaraderie grew among the players during the long season.  漫长的赛季让球员之间生出深厚的情谊。

brotherhood.example: Long marches created a deep brotherhood among the soldiers.  长途行军在士兵之间造就了深厚情谊。

comradeship.example: They remembered the comradeship of those difficult early years.  他们怀念那些艰难早年的伙伴情谊。

fellowship.example: The choir offered both music and warm fellowship every week.  合唱团每周既提供音乐也带来温暖情谊。

catharsis.example: Writing the letter provided a real catharsis for her grief.  写这封信真正宣泄了她的悲伤。

cleansing.example: The long cry felt like a cleansing of old pain.  那场大哭像是把旧日痛苦涤净了一样。

expurgation.example: The censor's expurgation removed three chapters from the novel.  审查者的删改从小说中删去了三章。

lustration.example: Ancient priests performed lustration before entering the inner temple.  古代祭司进入内殿前要举行净化仪式。

purgation.example: The pilgrimage was seen as a purgation of past sins.  这次朝圣被视为对往日罪过的净化。

purification.example: The village needed a simple method of water purification.  这个村子需要一种简单的净水方法。

camouflage.example: The soldiers used branches and mud as camouflage in the forest.  士兵们用树枝和泥浆在森林里作伪装。

costume.example: She sewed her own costume for the school play.  她为学校的话剧自己缝了戏服。

guise.example: He entered the palace under the guise of a merchant.  他以商人为幌子进入了宫殿。

cloak.example: Officials cloaked the truth behind pages of confusing statistics.  官员用一堆令人困惑的统计数字掩盖真相。

dress up.example: The children dressed up as ghosts for the school party.  孩子们打扮成鬼怪去参加学校晚会。

unmask.example: The journalist unmasked the company's secret polluting practices.  记者揭露了这家公司秘密排污的做法。

canard.example: The old canard that vaccines cause illness still circulates online.  说疫苗致病的老谣传仍在网上流传。

story.example: The old story about the haunted mill was pure invention.  关于那座鬼磨坊的老传言纯属编造。

candor.example: I appreciated her candor about the risks of the operation.  我很欣赏她坦率说明手术的风险。

bluntness.example: His bluntness offended some listeners but earned lasting respect.  他的直率得罪了一些听众，却赢得长久的尊重。

forthrightness.example: Her forthrightness made negotiations faster and far less painful.  她的坦率让谈判更快，也少了许多痛苦。

frankness.example: I appreciated the frankness of his letter about the problem.  我很欣赏他在信中谈这个问题时的坦率。

unreservedness.example: The unreservedness of her praise surprised the whole class.  她毫无保留的赞美让全班都吃惊。

straightforwardness.example: Her straightforwardness saved the committee hours of pointless debate.  她的直率为委员会省下数小时无谓的争论。

artifice.example: Her apparent shyness was pure artifice designed to disarm her rivals.  她表面的羞怯纯属伪装，为的是麻痹对手。

mendacity.example: Voters grew tired of the candidate's constant mendacity.  选民厌倦了这位候选人不断的谎言。

dissembling.example: After months of dissembling he finally admitted the truth.  掩饰了数月之后，他终于承认了真相。

dissimulation.example: Court life demanded constant dissimulation from every ambitious young noble.  宫廷生活要求每个有野心的年轻贵族不断掩饰。

indirection.example: He learned the news by indirection rather than direct question.  他是通过迂回而非直接询问得知这消息的。

canon.example: That novel has finally entered the canon of American literature.  那部小说终于进入了美国文学正典。

dogma.example: She refused to accept the party's dogma without question.  她拒绝毫不质疑地接受该党的教条。

idolize.example: Young players idolize the captain of the national team.  年轻球员把国家队队长当作偶像崇拜。

worship.example: They gathered at dawn to worship in the small chapel.  他们黎明时聚在小教堂做礼拜。

apocrypha.example: Scholars debate whether the apocrypha belong in the official Bible.  学者争论伪经是否应收入正式圣经。

heterodox.example: Her heterodox economic theories were ignored for decades before gaining respect.  她非正统的经济理论被忽视数十年后才获得尊重。

nontraditional.example: The school welcomes nontraditional students who return after working.  这所学校欢迎工作后返校的非传统学生。

humiliate.example: The teacher never humiliated a student for asking a simple question.  这位老师从不因学生问简单的问题而羞辱他。

amanoftalent.example: The scanned page ran together the words as amanoftalent.  扫描页面把这几个词粘连成了 amanoftalent。

triestouseit.example: The corrupted text shows triestouseit instead of three separate words.  损坏的文本显示成 triestouseit，而非三个分开的词。

canvass.example: Volunteers canvassed the whole district before the local election.  志愿者在地方选举前走遍全区拉票。
canvass.cn: 详尽讨论，仔细检查；挨户游说拉票

interview.example: Researchers interviewed hundreds of voters before writing the report.  研究者在撰写报告前访问了数百名选民。

poll.example: The paper polled a thousand readers about the new tax.  该报就新税向一千名读者做了调查。

survey.example: We surveyed every household about their water use last summer.  去年夏天我们调查了每户人家的用水情况。

capitulate.example: After weeks of protest the company capitulated to the workers' demands.  抗议数周后，公司向工人的要求屈服了。

knuckle under.example: He refused to knuckle under to the angry crowd.  他拒绝向愤怒的人群屈服。

caprice.example: The schedule changed daily at the caprice of the new director.  日程随新主管的一时兴起天天变。

freakishness.example: The freakishness of the spring weather ruined the whole harvest.  春季天气的反复无常毁掉了整季收成。

impulsiveness.example: His impulsiveness cost the company two important clients.  他的冲动让公司失去了两个重要客户。

whimsicalness.example: The whimsicalness of her designs delighted children and puzzled adults.  她设计中的异想天开让孩子欣喜、大人困惑。

confirmation.example: We need written confirmation before we release the funds.  在放款之前我们需要书面确认。

steadfast.example: She remained steadfast in her belief despite years of public ridicule.  尽管多年遭受公众嘲笑，她依然坚定地坚持自己的信念。

constant.example: Her support remained constant through every difficult year.  她的支持在每个艰难年头都不曾改变。

bewitch.example: Her singing bewitched everyone in the crowded little hall.  她的歌声让拥挤小厅里的每个人都着了迷。

magnetize.cn: 强烈吸引，使着迷；使磁化
magnetize.example: The speaker magnetized the audience within the first two minutes.  演讲者在头两分钟内就牢牢吸引住了听众。

repulse.example: The sight of the rotting fruit repulsed everyone standing near the crate.  腐烂水果的样子让站在箱子旁的每个人都感到恶心。

cardinal.example: Honesty is a cardinal rule in this small hospital.  诚实是这家小医院的首要准则。

overbearing.example: His overbearing manner made junior colleagues afraid to voice any objection.  他专横的作风让年轻同事不敢提出任何反对意见。

overriding.cn: 最重要的，优先于一切的
overriding.example: Safety was the overriding concern in designing the bridge.  安全是设计这座桥时最重要的考虑。

preeminent.example: He is the preeminent authority on medieval trade routes in Europe.  他是研究欧洲中世纪贸易路线最杰出的权威。

primal.example: Fear of the dark is a primal human response.  怕黑是人类一种原始的反应。

supreme.example: The court holds supreme authority over all such disputes.  该法院对所有此类争议拥有最高裁判权。

carnal.example: The monk warned his students against carnal pleasures and idle talk.  僧人告诫学生远离肉体享乐和闲谈。

corporal.example: Most countries have banned corporal punishment in their schools.  多数国家已禁止在学校施行体罚。

corporeal.example: The ghost seemed almost corporeal in the flickering candlelight.  在摇曳的烛光中，那鬼影几乎像有实体。

fleshly.example: The monk warned his students against fleshly temptations.  那位僧人告诫学生要远离肉体的诱惑。

material.example: He cared little for material wealth and lived very simply.  他不太在意物质财富，生活极为简朴。

somatic.example: The doctor attributed her somatic symptoms to prolonged emotional stress.  医生把她身体上的症状归因于长期的情绪压力。

earthborn.example: The poem contrasts heavenly spirits with weak earthborn men.  这首诗把天上的神灵与脆弱的凡人相对照。

mundane.example: He spent the morning on mundane daily chores like laundry and dishes.  他整个上午都在做洗衣洗碗这类平凡的日常杂务。

temporal.example: Medieval popes wielded both spiritual and temporal power in Europe.  中世纪的教皇在欧洲同时掌握宗教权力与世俗权力。

terrestrial.example: Astronomers compare Mars with terrestrial deserts to picture its climate.  天文学家把火星与地球上的沙漠作比较来想象其气候。

worldly.example: He gave away all his worldly possessions and entered the monastery.  他捐出全部世俗财产，进了修道院。

spiritual.example: She turned to meditation in search of spiritual peace.  她转向冥想，以寻求精神上的平静。

carouse.example: The sailors caroused in the port until the sun came up.  水手们在港口狂饮作乐直到日出。

binge.cn: 狂欢；无节制地大吃大喝
binge.example: After the exams the students went on a three-day binge.  考完试后学生们狂欢了三天。

revel.example: Young actors often revel in the applause of a packed opening night.  年轻演员常陶醉于首演满座时的掌声。

roister.example: Sailors roistered in the port until the ship sailed at dawn.  水手们在港口喧闹作乐，直到黎明开船。

wassail.example: The villagers wassailed around a bonfire on the longest night.  村民们在最长的夜晚围着篝火举杯狂欢。

carp.example: She carped at every detail of the seating arrangement.  她对座位安排的每个细节都挑剔。

cavil.example: Reviewers caviled over the wording instead of judging the ideas.  评审者在措辞上吹毛求疵，而不评判观点。

fuss.example: Don't make a fuss about a tiny stain on the tablecloth.  别为桌布上一小块污渍小题大做。

niggle.example: Reviewers niggled over commas instead of judging the argument.  评审者在逗号上挑剔，却不评判论点本身。

nitpick.example: Reviewers nitpick about grammar while ignoring the serious flaws in the argument.  评审者在语法上吹毛求疵，却忽视论证中的严重缺陷。

gripe.example: The passengers griped loudly about the delay for nearly a whole hour.  乘客们大声抱怨延误，抱怨了将近一个小时。

grizzle.example: The tired child grizzled all the way home from the park.  疲惫的孩子从公园一路哭闹抱怨回家。

grouch.example: He grouched about the new rules but followed them anyway.  他抱怨新规定，但还是照做了。

grouse.example: The crew groused about long hours during the harvest season.  收割季里工人们抱怨工时太长。

grumble.example: The workers grumbled about the new rules but followed them anyway.  工人们低声抱怨新规定，但还是照办了。

wail.example: The mourners wailed as the coffin was lowered into the grave.  棺木下葬时，吊唁者们放声哀号。

cliquish.example: The department felt cliquish, and newcomers were quietly excluded.  这个部门风气很小圈子化，新人被暗中排斥。

clannish.example: The fishing town is clannish and slow to trust outsiders.  这个渔镇抱团排外，不轻易信任外人。

cliquey.example: Her new school seemed cliquey, so she ate lunch alone.  她的新学校似乎拉帮结派，于是她独自吃午饭。

close-knit.example: They grew up in a close-knit community where everyone helped out.  他们在一个人人互助的紧密社区中长大。

cast.example: The new evidence cast doubt on the official explanation.  新证据让官方的解释受到质疑。

emanate.example: A warm smell of bread emanated from the little bakery.  一股温热的面包香从小面包店里散发出来。

irradiate.example: Sunlight irradiated the valley and the mist quickly lifted.  阳光照亮山谷，雾气很快散去。

issue.example: Water issued from the cracked pipe and flooded the basement overnight.  水从裂开的管道中流出，一夜之间淹了地下室。

shoot.cn: 射出，发射；迅速射出（光线等）
shoot.example: The lighthouse shot a beam of light across the dark water.  灯塔把一束光射过漆黑的水面。

throw out.example: He threw out a suggestion that nobody bothered to discuss.  他提出了一个建议，却没人愿意讨论。

give out.example: The old radiator still gives out a surprising amount of heat.  这台旧暖气片散发的热量仍出人意料地多。

ditch.example: The team ditched the old design after two failed tests.  两次测试失败后，团队放弃了旧设计。

dump.example: Factories once dumped chemical waste straight into the river.  工厂曾把化学废料直接倾倒进河里。

jettison.example: The company jettisoned the proposal as soon as funding became uncertain.  资金一变得不确定，公司就放弃了这项提案。

toss.example: She tossed the crumpled letter into the fire without reading it.  她没读就把那封皱信扔进了火里。

chastise.example: The coach chastised the players for their careless passing.  教练严厉批评球员们传球草率。

rebuke.example: The judge rebuked the lawyer for interrupting the witness.  法官斥责律师打断证人发言。

approbate.example: The board approbated the merger after a long private debate.  经过长时间闭门辩论，董事会认可了这次合并。

catalyze.example: The lawsuit catalyzed a wave of reform across the industry.  这场诉讼引发了整个行业的改革浪潮。

breed.example: Secrecy in government breeds distrust among ordinary citizens.  政府的隐秘作风在普通民众中滋生不信任。

beget.example: Careless words often beget quarrels that last for years.  轻率的言语常引发持续多年的争吵。

effectuate.example: New funding finally effectuated the repairs promised years ago.  新的资金终于使多年前承诺的修缮得以实现。

engender.example: Small acts of honesty engender trust more surely than grand promises do.  小小的诚实之举比宏大的承诺更能可靠地产生信任。

generate.example: The trailer generated enormous interest weeks before the release.  预告片在上映数周前就引起了极大兴趣。

prompt.example: The leaked memo prompted an immediate inquiry by regulators.  泄露的备忘录促使监管机构立即展开调查。

spawn.example: The hit film spawned three sequels and countless imitations.  这部热门影片催生了三部续集和无数仿作。

yield.example: Months of patient testing finally yielded a usable vaccine.  数月耐心的试验终于产出可用的疫苗。

result in.example: Cutting the budget resulted in longer waiting times for patients.  削减预算导致患者等待时间变长。

bring.example: The new law brought about a sharp drop in traffic deaths.  新法律使交通死亡人数大幅下降。

prevent.example: Simple handwashing prevents the spread of many common infections.  简单的洗手就能防止许多常见感染传播。

inhibitor.example: Chemists added an inhibitor to slow the runaway reaction.  化学家加入抑制剂来减缓失控的反应。

catastrophe.example: The oil spill became an ecological catastrophe for the whole coast.  漏油事件成为整个海岸的生态大灾难。

apocalypse.example: The novel imagines an apocalypse caused by a runaway climate crisis.  这部小说设想了失控气候危机引发的末日灾难。

calamity.example: The flood was the worst calamity the small town had faced.  这场洪水是这个小镇遭遇过的最严重灾难。
