cataclysm.example: The eruption was a cataclysm that reshaped the entire island.  那次喷发是一场重塑整座岛屿的大灾难。

debacle.example: The campaign ended in a debacle that cost the party three seats.  这场竞选以溃败收场，使该党丢掉三个席位。

tragedy.example: The mine collapse was a tragedy that the town never forgot.  矿井塌方是这座小镇永难忘却的惨剧。

bummer.cn: 令人失望的事，扫兴的事
bummer.example: Losing the tickets an hour before the show was a real bummer.  演出前一小时丢了票，真是件扫兴的事。

disaster.example: The opening night was a disaster from the very first scene.  首演之夜从第一场戏起就是一场彻底的失败。

fiasco.example: The poorly planned launch party ended in a complete fiasco.  筹划糟糕的发布会以彻底的失败告终。

fizzle.example: The protest fizzled out after the organizers lost their funding.  组织者失去资金后，抗议活动渐渐无声收场。

washout.example: The rainy festival turned out to be a complete washout.  那个下雨的音乐节结果彻底失败。

blockbuster.example: The studio needed a blockbuster to cover last year's losses.  制片厂需要一部大片来弥补去年的亏损。

hit.cn: 成功而流行的事物；打击
hit.example: Her first single became an unexpected hit across three countries.  她的首支单曲在三个国家意外大热。

smash.example: The low-budget comedy became a box-office smash overnight.  这部低成本喜剧一夜之间成为票房大热。

success.example: The fundraising campaign was a resounding success beyond all forecasts.  这次筹款活动大获成功，远超所有预测。

winner.example: The cheap electric scooter proved a winner with city commuters.  这款便宜的电动滑板车在城市通勤者中大获成功。

categorical.example: The minister issued a categorical denial of the corruption charges.  部长断然否认了腐败指控。

definite.example: We need a definite answer before we can book the venue.  我们需要明确答复才能订场地。

fair.example: Everyone deserves a fair hearing before any decision is made.  在做出任何决定之前，人人都应得到公正的申辩机会。

thorough.example: Inspectors carried out a thorough search of every storage room.  检查员对每间储藏室都做了彻底搜查。

unconditional.example: The treaty demanded the unconditional withdrawal of all foreign troops.  条约要求所有外国军队无条件撤离。

unqualified.cn: 绝对的，无保留的；不合格的
unqualified.example: The plan won her unqualified support at the very first meeting.  这个计划在第一次会上就赢得她毫无保留的支持。

conditional.example: She received a conditional offer from her favorite university.  她收到了心仪大学的有条件录取通知。

catholic.example: Her catholic tastes in music surprised everyone at the party.  她在音乐上广泛的爱好让聚会上每个人都惊讶。

unlimited.example: The pass gives unlimited access to every museum in the city.  这张通票可无限次进入城中所有博物馆。

unrestricted.example: Journalists were promised unrestricted access to the disaster zone.  记者们被承诺可不受限制地进入灾区。

unspecialized.example: Small clinics rely on unspecialized doctors who treat almost everything.  小诊所依靠什么都看的非专科医生。

all-around.example: She is an all-around student who excels in sports and music.  她是个全面发展的学生，体育和音乐都很出色。

narrow.example: His narrow reading habits left him ignorant of modern poetry.  他狭窄的阅读习惯使他对现代诗一无所知。

limited.example: With limited time we could visit only two of the temples.  时间有限，我们只能参观其中两座寺庙。

restricted.example: Only staff with special passes may enter the restricted area.  只有持特别通行证的员工才可进入这一限制区域。

specialized.example: Repairing the instrument requires specialized knowledge few technicians have.  修理这台仪器需要少数技师才有的专业知识。

caustic.example: His caustic remarks about the film upset the young director.  他对影片刻薄的评论让年轻导演很难过。

barbed.example: Her barbed compliment made the whole table fall silent.  她那句带刺的赞美让全桌人都沉默了。

mordant.example: His mordant wit amused readers but cost him several close friendships.  他尖刻的机智取悦了读者，却让他失去几段亲密友谊。

sharp.example: The critic has a sharp tongue but an unusually fair mind.  这位评论家言辞尖刻，心思却格外公正。

smooth.example: He is a smooth talker who never offends anyone in negotiations.  他谈判时言辞圆滑，从不得罪任何人。

caveat.example: The report adds one important caveat about the small sample size.  报告就样本量小补充了一条重要的告诫。

warning.example: The agency issued a warning about swimming near the rocks.  该机构就在岩石附近游泳发出了警告。

quibble.example: They quibbled over the wording while the deadline slipped away.  他们在措辞上纠缠不休，截止日期却悄悄过去。

cataclysmal.example: The dam failure had cataclysmal consequences for the valley below.  大坝溃决给下游河谷带来灾难性的后果。

calamitous.example: Ignoring the engineers' report proved a calamitous decision.  忽视工程师的报告最终是个灾难性的决定。

catastrophic.example: A single cracked seal caused the catastrophic failure of the engine.  一个开裂的密封圈导致了发动机的灾难性故障。

destructive.example: The storm's destructive power flattened half the coastal village.  风暴的破坏力摧平了半个沿海村庄。

disastrous.example: Cutting corners on safety had disastrous consequences for the crew.  在安全上走捷径给船员带来了灾难性后果。

ruinous.example: The lawsuit dragged on and became ruinous for the small firm.  诉讼久拖不决，对这家小公司而言是毁灭性的。

unfortunate.example: It was unfortunate that the letter arrived a week too late.  遗憾的是那封信迟到了一周。

render.example: The neighbors rendered assistance long before the ambulance arrived.  邻居们在救护车到达前很久就提供了援助。

turnin.example: He had to turn in his badge and keys on the last day.  最后一天他必须交回工牌和钥匙。

turnover.cn: 移交；营业额；人员更替率
turnover.example: High staff turnover made it hard to train anyone properly.  员工流动率高，使得没法好好培训任何人。

stepaside.example: The aging chairman agreed to step aside for a younger leader.  年迈的主席同意让位给更年轻的领导者。

down.example: The rebels finally laid down their weapons and went home.  叛军最终放下武器回了家。

possess.example: The family possessed the estate for more than two centuries.  这个家族拥有该庄园两百多年。

cement.example: The two visits cemented a friendship between the two towns.  两次互访巩固了两座城镇之间的友谊。

cord.example: She tied the parcel with a thin cord and posted it.  她用细绳捆好包裹寄了出去。

knot.example: The sailor tied a knot that no amount of pulling could loosen.  水手打了个怎么拉都松不开的结。

link.example: Researchers found a close link between sleep and memory.  研究者发现睡眠与记忆之间存在紧密联系。

tie.example: Strong family ties kept the brothers in the same town.  牢固的家庭纽带让兄弟俩留在同一个镇上。

censor.example: Officials censored the news before it reached the public.  官员在新闻传到公众之前进行了审查删改。

bowdlerize.example: Victorian editors bowdlerized the play before letting children read it.  维多利亚时代的编者在让孩子阅读前删改了这部剧。

expurgate.example: Editors expurgated several passages before the book reached young readers.  编辑在这本书交到小读者手中之前删去了几个段落。

red-pencil.example: The editor red-penciled every sentence that might offend advertisers.  编辑删掉了每一句可能得罪广告商的话。

clean up.example: They cleaned up the lyrics before playing the song on radio.  他们在电台播放前净化了歌词。

eulogistic.example: The biography is so eulogistic that it reads like an advertisement.  这本传记颂扬过度，读起来像广告。

concomitant.example: Rapid growth brings concomitant risks that managers often ignore.  快速增长带来管理者常常忽视的伴随风险。

accompanying.example: Please read the accompanying notes before filling in the form.  填表前请阅读随附的说明。

coexistent.example: In that city several coexistent religions share the same old quarter.  在那座城市，几种共存的宗教共用同一片老城区。

coincidental.example: Any resemblance to real persons is purely coincidental.  与真实人物的任何相似之处纯属巧合。

concurrent.example: The judge imposed two concurrent sentences of three years each.  法官判处两项各三年的刑期同时执行。

censure.example: The council voted to censure the mayor for his conduct.  议会投票谴责市长的行为。

condemn.example: World leaders quickly condemned the attack on the hospital.  各国领导人迅速谴责了对医院的袭击。

denounce.example: Local leaders publicly denounced the corruption exposed by the newspaper.  当地领导人公开谴责报纸曝光的腐败行为。

objurgate.example: The old professor objurgated students who plagiarized their essays.  这位老教授严厉斥责抄袭论文的学生。

reprehend.example: The committee did not hesitate to reprehend the officer for his careless report.  委员会毫不犹豫地谴责了那名官员草率的报告。

pan.example: Critics panned the film for its clumsy dialogue and predictable ending.  影评人严厉批评这部电影对话笨拙、结局可预料。

laud.example: Critics lauded the young pianist for her fearless interpretation.  评论家赞扬这位年轻钢琴家大胆的演绎。

chic.example: She looked effortlessly chic in a plain black dress.  她穿着一件素黑连衣裙，显得自然时髦。

stylish.example: She wore a stylish grey coat that everyone asked about.  她穿着一件人人都追问来处的时髦灰外套。

modish.example: The café was full of modish furniture that looked uncomfortable.  咖啡馆里满是看起来并不舒服的时髦家具。

trendy.example: The old docks have become a trendy neighborhood full of galleries.  旧码头已变成满是画廊的时髦街区。

voguish.example: His essay is packed with voguish terms that mean very little.  他的文章塞满了意义不大的时髦术语。

unchic.example: He proudly wore unchic sandals to the fashionable garden party.  他自豪地穿着不时髦的凉鞋去那场时尚花园派对。

unfashionable.example: It is unfashionable now to defend such long, difficult novels.  如今为这类冗长难读的小说辩护已不合时宜。

unmodish.example: Her unmodish hairstyle somehow suited the quiet country town.  她那不时髦的发型倒是很配这个安静的乡镇。

unstylish.example: He bought unstylish shoes because they were built to last.  他买了不好看的鞋子，因为它们经久耐穿。

cutoff.example: The sudden cutoff of aid left the clinic without medicine.  援助突然中断，使诊所无药可用。

expiration.example: Check the expiration date before you open the sealed package.  打开密封包装前请查看保质期。

shutdown.example: The shutdown of the old plant cost the town four hundred jobs.  老工厂停产使小镇失去四百个岗位。

commencement.example: The commencement of construction was delayed by heavy spring rains.  施工的开始因春季大雨而延后。

start.example: From the start it was clear the schedule was too tight.  从一开始就明显看出日程太紧。

chaff.example: His teammates chaffed him about his terrible singing voice.  队友们拿他糟糕的歌喉取笑他。

jape.example: He japed about his own baldness to put the guests at ease.  他拿自己的秃头开玩笑，让客人们放松下来。

jest.example: He said it in jest, but nobody in the room was laughing.  他是开玩笑说的，但屋里没有一个人笑。

quip.example: He answered the hostile question with a quip that eased everyone.  他用一句俏皮话回应了敌意的提问，缓和了气氛。

chagrin.example: To his chagrin, the prize went to a much younger rival.  令他懊恼的是，奖项落到了一位年轻得多的对手手中。

anxiety.example: Waiting for the test results caused her weeks of anxiety.  等待检查结果让她焦虑了好几周。

disquiet.example: There is growing disquiet among parents about the new curriculum.  家长中对新课程的不安情绪日益增长。

inquietude.example: A vague inquietude kept him pacing the corridor all night.  一种莫名的不安让他整夜在走廊来回踱步。

restiveness.example: The crowd's restiveness increased as the speaker kept them waiting.  演讲者让人久等，人群的躁动愈发明显。

solicitude.example: She thanked the nurses for their constant solicitude during her recovery.  她感谢护士们在她康复期间始终的关切。

unease.example: A feeling of unease settled over the village after the warning.  警报之后，一种不安感笼罩了村庄。

unrest.example: Rising food prices led to months of social unrest.  食品价格上涨导致了数月的社会动荡。

worry.example: Money was a constant worry during their first year abroad.  在国外的第一年里，钱是他们持续的忧虑。

aplomb.example: She handled the hostile interview with remarkable aplomb.  她极为从容地应对了那场充满敌意的采访。

composure.example: He lost his composure only once, when the verdict was read.  只有在宣读判决时，他才失了一次镇静。

equanimity.example: She accepted the bad news with surprising equanimity.  她以出人意料的平静接受了这个坏消息。

sangfroid.example: The pilot's sangfroid during the emergency saved every passenger aboard.  飞行员在紧急情况中的冷静救了机上所有乘客。

chameleon.example: The senator is a political chameleon who changes positions constantly.  这位参议员是个政治变色龙，立场变来变去。

chancer.example: The company was founded by a chancer who promised impossible returns.  这家公司由一个承诺不可能回报的投机者创立。

opportunist.example: Critics call him an opportunist who changes sides whenever polls shift.  批评者称他是民调一变就换阵营的机会主义者。

temporizer.cn: 见风使舵者，敷衍拖延者
temporizer.example: The party needed a leader, not a temporizer who avoided every decision.  该党需要的是领袖，而不是回避一切决定的拖延者。

timeserver.cn: 趋炎附势者，随波逐流者
timeserver.example: Reformers dismissed the official as a timeserver protecting his pension.  改革者把这名官员斥为只顾保住养老金的趋炎附势者。

trimmer.example: The senator was a trimmer who voted with whichever side seemed stronger.  这位参议员见风使舵，总投给看似更强的一方。

weathercock.example: His opinions swing like a weathercock in every passing breeze.  他的观点像风向标一样随风摇摆不定。

plump for.example: After hours of argument the committee plumped for the cheaper design.  争论数小时后，委员会选定了较便宜的设计。

compulsive.example: He is a compulsive liar who cannot stop inventing stories.  他是个无法自控的说谎者，编故事停不下来。

besetting.example: Impatience was the besetting fault of an otherwise fine teacher.  急躁是这位本来出色的老师屡犯的毛病。

driven.example: She is so driven that she rarely takes a single day off.  她如此拼命，几乎从不休一天假。

obsessive.example: His obsessive attention to detail slowed the whole project down.  他对细节的过度执着拖慢了整个项目。

chimera.example: Lasting peace seemed a mere chimera to the exhausted soldiers.  对疲惫的士兵来说，持久和平仿佛只是幻想。

conceit.example: The novel rests on the conceit that memories can be traded.  这部小说建立在记忆可以交易的奇想之上。

daydream.example: He sat by the window lost in a daydream about sailing away.  他坐在窗边，沉浸在扬帆远行的白日梦里。

delusion.example: He clung to the delusion that the company would soon rehire him.  他固执地抱着公司很快会重新雇用他的妄想。

fantasy.example: Her plan to retire at thirty was pure fantasy.  她三十岁退休的打算纯属幻想。

figment.example: The threatening letter was a figment of his own imagination.  那封威胁信是他自己凭空想象出来的。

hallucination.example: The high fever gave him vivid hallucinations that lasted through the night.  高烧让他产生了持续整夜的鲜明幻觉。

illusion.example: The mirrors create the illusion that the room is twice as large.  镜子造成了房间大了一倍的错觉。

phantasm.example: In the fog the tower looked like a phantasm floating above water.  雾中那座塔像是漂浮在水面上的幻影。

vision.example: The saint claimed to have seen a vision of a burning city.  这位圣徒声称看到过一座燃烧城市的幻象。

actuality.example: In actuality the treaty changed almost nothing on the border.  实际上这项条约几乎没改变边境的任何情况。

fact.example: Whether the letter existed is a question of fact, not opinion.  那封信是否存在是事实问题，不是意见问题。

reality.example: Sooner or later he must face the reality of his debts.  他迟早得面对自己债务的现实。

truth.example: It took ten years for the truth about the accident to emerge.  这场事故的真相花了十年才浮出水面。

charlatan.example: The journalist exposed the charlatan selling fake medicine.  记者揭穿了那个卖假药的骗子。

fraud.example: The so-called healer turned out to be an outright fraud.  那位所谓的治疗师原来是个彻头彻尾的骗子。

hoaxer.example: A hoaxer sent fake fossils to museums for nearly a decade.  一个骗子近十年间向博物馆寄送假化石。

mountebank.example: The town square once drew mountebanks selling miracle cures.  镇中心广场曾吸引卖神奇药方的江湖骗子。

pretender.example: Three pretenders claimed the crown within a single year.  一年之内有三个觊觎者宣称拥有王位。

quack.example: The medical quack sold colored water as a cure for every illness.  那个江湖郎中把有色的水当作万病灵药出售。

imposter.example: The imposter had used a dead man's name for twelve years.  这个冒充者用一个死者的名字生活了十二年。

chary.example: Editors are chary of publishing claims that cannot be checked.  编辑对发表无法核实的说法非常谨慎。

alert.example: Night guards must stay alert even during the quietest hours.  夜间守卫即便在最安静的时段也必须保持警觉。

gingerly.example: She gingerly lifted the cracked vase onto the padded table.  她小心翼翼地把破裂的花瓶搬到铺垫的桌上。

chase.example: The farmer chased the crows away from his young corn.  农夫把乌鸦从他的嫩玉米地里赶走。

dismiss.cn: 解散，打发走；解雇；不予考虑
dismiss.example: The teacher dismissed the class ten minutes ahead of time.  老师提前十分钟宣布下课。

extrude.example: The machine extrudes hot plastic into long, even tubes.  机器把热塑料挤压成长而均匀的管子。

kick out.example: The club kicked out two members for repeatedly breaking its rules.  俱乐部因两名成员屡次违规而将其开除。

cast out.example: The village cast out anyone suspected of stealing from the granary.  村里驱逐任何被怀疑偷粮仓的人。

chasm.example: A widening chasm separated the party's older and younger members.  日益加深的分歧把该党的老少成员分隔开来。

contradiction.example: There is a glaring contradiction between his speech and his voting record.  他的演讲与投票记录之间存在明显矛盾。

disjunction.example: The report notes a disjunction between policy goals and daily practice.  报告指出政策目标与日常做法之间存在脱节。

discord.example: A single careless remark sowed discord among the previously friendly neighbors.  一句不慎的话在原本和睦的邻居间挑起了不和。

conflict.example: The judge withdrew because of a possible conflict of interest.  法官因可能存在利益冲突而回避。

rift.example: A deep rift opened between the two brothers after their father died.  父亲去世后，两兄弟之间出现了深深的裂痕。

rivalry.example: The two newspapers kept up a bitter rivalry for thirty years.  这两家报纸维持了三十年的激烈竞争。

dichotomy.example: The book rejects the simple dichotomy between nature and human culture.  这本书否认自然与人类文化之间的简单对立。

chauvinistic.example: The newspaper's chauvinistic rhetoric grew louder as the election approached.  随着选举临近，该报盲目爱国的言辞越发高涨。

jingoist.phrase_cn: 直言不讳的好战爱国者
jingoist.example: The columnist was denounced as a jingoist eager for another foreign war.  这位专栏作家被谴责为渴望再打一场对外战争的好战爱国者。

jingoistic.example: Crowds chanted jingoistic slogans outside the embassy all afternoon.  人群整个下午在使馆外高喊极端爱国的口号。

nationalistic.cn: 民族主义的，爱国主义的
nationalistic.example: Nationalistic sentiment rose sharply after the border dispute began.  边境争端开始后，民族主义情绪急剧上升。

superpatriotic.example: Wartime posters used superpatriotic images to encourage young men to enlist.  战时海报用极端爱国的图像鼓励年轻人参军。

stall.example: The lawyer stalled for time while his assistant fetched the file.  律师在助手去取文件时拖延时间。

draw up.example: A black car drew up outside the gate and waited.  一辆黑车在大门外停下并等着。

hold up.example: Roadworks held up traffic on the bridge for over an hour.  道路施工使桥上交通阻塞一个多小时。

pull up.example: The taxi pulled up at the curb just as it began raining.  就在开始下雨时，出租车在路边停了下来。

cohere.example: His account does not cohere with what the other witnesses said.  他的说法与其他证人所言并不相符。

correspond.example: The figures in the report correspond exactly to the bank records.  报告中的数字与银行记录完全相符。

dovetail.example: Her research dovetails neatly with the team's long-term goals.  她的研究与团队的长期目标恰好吻合。

fit.example: The suspect they arrested did not fit the witness's description.  他们逮捕的嫌疑人并不符合证人的描述。

harmonize.example: The new building harmonizes well with the older houses nearby.  这座新建筑与附近的老房子十分协调。

jibe.example: His account of the accident does not jibe with the physical evidence.  他对这场事故的说法与实物证据不符。

tally.example: His account of the accident does not tally with the witness statements.  他对事故的叙述与证人陈述不符。

propagate.example: Missionaries traveled far to propagate their beliefs among distant communities.  传教士远行到偏远社区去传播他们的信仰。

goad.example: His teammates goaded him into accepting the ridiculous bet.  队友们激他接受了那个荒唐的赌约。

differ.example: Experts differ widely on how the disease should be treated.  专家们对该疾病的治疗方式看法大相径庭。

disagree with.example: These figures disagree with the totals printed in the annual report.  这些数字与年报中印的总数不符。

cherubic.example: The baby's cherubic face melted the hearts of everyone present.  婴儿天真可爱的脸融化了在场所有人的心。

devilish.example: The boy wore a devilish grin as he hid the keys.  男孩藏起钥匙时露出一丝邪气的笑。

chicanery.example: The election was decided by chicanery rather than by honest debate.  这次选举靠的是欺骗手段而非诚实辩论。

deception.example: He obtained the money by deception and was later arrested.  他骗取了这笔钱，后来被捕。

legerdemain.example: The accountant used legerdemain to hide the losses for three years.  会计用骗术把亏损隐藏了三年。

wile.example: She used every wile she knew to win his support.  她用尽一切手段来赢得他的支持。

subterfuge.example: The spy resorted to subterfuge to enter the heavily guarded building.  间谍采用诡计进入戒备森严的大楼。

aboveboard action.example: The committee praised his aboveboard action in reporting the conflict.  委员会赞扬他报告利益冲突的正当行为。

crabby.example: He gets crabby whenever he misses his afternoon nap.  他一没睡午觉就变得烦躁易怒。

cranky.example: The baby was cranky all night because of the heat.  因为天热，宝宝整夜都在闹脾气。

peevish.example: She answered in a peevish tone and refused to explain further.  她用不耐烦的语气回答，拒绝再解释。

petulant.example: The actor made a petulant remark and stormed off the stage.  那位演员使性子说了句话，然后气冲冲地离开了舞台。

bad-tempered.example: Our bad-tempered neighbor shouts at children who cross his lawn.  我们那位脾气坏的邻居会对穿过草坪的孩子大喊。

hot-tempered.example: The hot-tempered driver got out and started an argument.  那位火爆脾气的司机下车就开始吵架。

short-tempered.example: He grows short-tempered whenever the deadline gets close.  每到截稿期临近他就变得急躁。

difficult to provoke.example: A good referee is patient and difficult to provoke during heated games.  好裁判在激烈比赛中耐心且不易被激怒。

placid.example: His placid temperament made him ideal for this very stressful job.  他沉静的性情使他非常适合这份高压工作。

serene.example: She watched the serene surface of the lake at dawn without speaking.  她默默看着黎明时宁静的湖面。

tranquil.example: We spent a tranquil afternoon reading beside the quiet river.  我们在静静的河边度过了一个安宁的下午。

composed.example: She stayed composed while answering the reporters' hostile questions.  她在回答记者敌意的提问时始终保持镇静。

nonchalant.example: He answered the accusation with a nonchalant shrug and changed the subject.  他冷淡地一耸肩回应指控，然后换了话题。

chord.example: His plain proposal chords with everything he has said before.  他直白的提议与他此前所说的完全一致。

consist.example: His later remarks hardly consist with what he promised earlier.  他后来的话与先前的承诺很不一致。

rhyme.example: The last two lines of the poem rhyme perfectly.  这首诗最后两行押韵得非常工整。

differ from.example: This edition differs from the original in several important details.  这一版在几个重要细节上与原作不同。

chromatic.example: The quilt showed brilliant chromatic patterns across every square.  这条被子每一格都是绚丽的彩色图案。

colored.example: The child drew the house with brightly colored crayons.  孩子用彩色蜡笔画了那座房子。

colorful.example: The old town is full of colorful shops and banners.  老城里满是色彩缤纷的店铺和旗帜。

motley.example: A motley crowd of farmers, students, and shopkeepers filled the town square.  农民、学生和店主组成的混杂人群挤满了市镇广场。

multicolored.example: She wrapped the gift in multicolored paper and ribbon.  她用彩色的纸和丝带包好礼物。

multihued.example: The garden was filled with multihued blossoms in early spring.  初春花园里开满了五彩斑斓的花。

varicolored.example: The artist arranged varicolored tiles into a huge spiral pattern.  艺术家把杂色瓷砖排成巨大的螺旋图案。

variegated.example: She filled the garden with variegated leaves of green and cream.  她在花园里种满绿白斑驳的叶子。

kaleidoscopic.cn: 千变万化的；万花筒般的
kaleidoscopic.example: The festival offered a kaleidoscopic mix of music and costume.  节庆呈现出千变万化的音乐与服饰。

colorless.example: Pure water is a colorless and odorless liquid at room temperature.  纯水在室温下是无色无味的液体。

blanched.example: Her blanched face showed how frightened she really was.  她发白的脸显出她真的很害怕。

chronic.example: Chronic shortages of water have plagued the region for decades.  长期缺水困扰该地区数十年。

frequent.example: Frequent power cuts made it hard to finish the work.  频繁停电让工作难以完成。

usual.example: He arrived at his usual time and took his usual seat.  他按老时间到达，坐在老位子上。

routine.example: The problem was discovered during a routine inspection last week.  这个问题是上周例行检查时发现的。

sporadic.example: Sporadic gunfire continued through the night on the edge of town.  镇子边缘整夜断断续续传来枪声。

cipher.example: Codebreakers took months to break the enemy cipher.  破译人员花了几个月才破解敌方的密码。

code.example: The spy sent his messages in a simple substitution code.  间谍用一种简单的替换密码传递消息。

secret message.example: The children passed a secret message written in lemon juice.  孩子们传递了一张用柠檬汁写的密信。

indirect.example: We took an indirect route to avoid the flooded highway.  我们走了绕行路线以避开被淹的公路。

circular.example: The path is circular, so it brings you back here.  这条小路是环形的，会把你带回这里。

direct.example: Ask for a direct answer instead of a long explanation.  要个直接的答复，而不是长篇解释。

straight.example: Drive straight ahead until you reach the second traffic light.  一直往前开，直到第二个红绿灯。

direction.example: She asked a stranger for directions to the train station.  她向一位陌生人问去火车站的路。

circumscribe.example: The new law sharply circumscribed the mayor's emergency powers.  新法律大幅限制了市长的紧急权力。

cap.example: The government capped tuition increases at three percent this year.  政府将今年学费涨幅限制在百分之三。

confine.example: Please confine the discussion to the budget for this year.  请把讨论限定在今年的预算上。

delimit.example: The treaty delimits the border between the two countries.  条约划定了两国之间的边界。

restrict.example: New rules restrict the number of visitors allowed each day.  新规定限制了每天允许进入的参观者人数。

exceed.example: Costs must not exceed the budget agreed by the board.  成本不得超过董事会批准的预算。

careful.example: Be careful when you cross this busy street at night.  夜里穿过这条繁忙的街道时要小心。

careless.example: One careless remark ruined months of patient negotiation.  一句不慎的话毁了数月的耐心谈判。

incautious.example: His incautious driving nearly caused a serious accident yesterday.  他不谨慎的驾驶昨天差点造成严重事故。

unmindful.example: Unmindful of the time, they talked until well past midnight.  他们没在意时间，一直聊到深夜。

unwary.example: Such websites are designed to trick the unwary buyer.  这类网站专门欺骗不加防范的买家。

avoid.example: He carefully avoided answering the reporter's most difficult question.  他小心地避开了记者最难的那个问题。

bypass.example: The new road bypasses the crowded center of the town.  新路绕开了拥挤的镇中心。

skirt.example: The minister tried to skirt the issue with a long, vague answer.  部长试图用冗长含糊的回答回避这个问题。

get around.example: Clever accountants found ways to get around the new tax.  精明的会计找到了规避新税的办法。

follow.example: If you follow the instructions exactly, nothing can go wrong.  只要严格按说明操作，就不会出错。

civility.example: The debate was fierce, yet both sides maintained basic civility.  辩论很激烈，但双方都保持了基本的礼貌。

politeness.example: He listened out of politeness, though the story bored him.  他出于礼貌听着，尽管那故事让他厌烦。

courtesy.example: She had the courtesy to apologize for arriving so late.  她很有礼貌地为迟到道歉。

genteelness.example: His genteelness at the table impressed his wife's parents.  他餐桌上的文雅举止让妻子的父母印象深刻。

gentility.example: The hotel still preserves an air of faded gentility.  这家旅馆仍保留着一种昔日的斯文气派。

graciousness.example: Her graciousness made every guest feel immediately at home.  她的亲切让每位客人立刻感到自在。

discourteousness.example: Interrupting an elder is regarded as plain discourteousness here.  在这里打断长辈被视为纯粹的无礼。

discourtesy.example: Ignoring the invitation was a serious discourtesy to the host.  无视邀请对主人是严重的失礼。

impoliteness.example: He apologized for the impoliteness of his earlier reply.  他为先前回复的无礼道歉。

incivility.example: Online incivility has made public discussion much harder lately.  网络上的粗鲁让公共讨论近来变得更难。

surliness.example: The surliness of the staff spoiled an otherwise pleasant meal.  员工的粗鲁态度毁了本来愉快的一餐。

ungraciousness.example: Her ungraciousness toward the volunteers surprised everyone in the room.  她对志愿者的不客气让屋里所有人惊讶。

chokehold.example: The monopoly kept a chokehold on trade for many decades.  这家垄断企业几十年来一直压制着贸易。

covert.example: The agency ran covert operations in several neighboring countries.  该机构在数个邻国进行秘密行动。

sneaky.example: That was a sneaky way to avoid paying the bill.  那是逃避付账的一种鬼祟手段。

stealthy.example: The cat made a stealthy approach toward the sleeping bird.  猫悄悄地靠近那只睡着的鸟。

undercover.example: An undercover officer spent two years inside the smuggling ring.  一名卧底警官在走私团伙里待了两年。

underground.example: The group published an underground newspaper during the occupation.  该团体在占领期间出版了一份地下报纸。

underhand.example: He won the contract through underhand dealings with an official.  他通过与官员的暗中交易赢得合同。

open.example: There was open opposition to the plan at the meeting.  会上有人公开反对这项计划。

overt.example: The policy met overt hostility from local business owners.  该政策遭到当地商户的公开敌视。

public.example: The company made its findings public earlier this month.  公司本月早些时候公开了调查结果。

clarion.example: Her speech was a clarion call for immediate action.  她的演讲是要求立即行动的响亮号召。

soft and indistinct.example: His voice grew soft and indistinct as he fell asleep.  他快睡着时声音变得低柔而模糊。

clarity.example: She explained the complicated rules with surprising clarity.  她把复杂的规则解释得异常清晰。

explicitness.example: The contract's explicitness left no room for later argument.  合同的明确性没给日后争论留下空间。

lucidity.example: He explained the theory with surprising lucidity and patience.  他极为清晰而耐心地解释了这个理论。

lucidness.example: Readers praised the lucidness of her scientific writing.  读者称赞她科学写作的清晰。

perspicuity.example: The judge praised the lawyer for the perspicuity of her written brief.  法官称赞这位律师书面陈述的清晰明了。

perspicuousness.example: The textbook is valued for its perspicuousness and useful examples.  这本教材因清晰易懂和实用例子而受重视。

purify.example: These tablets purify water so it becomes safe to drink.  这些药片能净化水，使其可安全饮用。

elucidate.example: The footnotes elucidate the problem far better than the chapter itself does.  脚注比正文本身更好地阐明了这个问题。

explain.example: Could you explain why the experiment failed the second time?  你能解释一下第二次实验为何失败吗？

illustrate.example: These figures illustrate how quickly the population has grown.  这些数字说明人口增长得多么迅速。

obscureness.example: The obscureness of the wording confused even trained lawyers.  措辞的晦涩连受过训练的律师都困惑。

obscurity.example: The poet died in obscurity but is famous today.  这位诗人默默无闻地去世，如今却很有名。

unclarity.example: Much of the confusion came from unclarity in the guidelines.  许多混乱源于指南中的含糊之处。

clasp.example: He clasped her hand tightly as the train pulled away.  火车开动时，他紧紧握住她的手。

clench.example: He clenched his fists and tried not to shout.  他握紧拳头，努力不喊出来。

grapple.example: Officials still grapple with the city's growing housing crisis.  官员们仍在努力应对该市日益严重的住房危机。

grasp.example: She grasped the rope tightly and pulled herself up.  她紧抓绳子，把自己拉了上去。

handgrip.example: He greeted me with a firm handgrip and a smile.  他用有力的握手和微笑迎接我。

handhold.example: The climber searched the rock for a secure handhold.  攀登者在岩壁上寻找牢靠的抓握处。

clement.example: A clement judge gave the young offender a second chance.  一位宽容的法官给了这名年轻罪犯第二次机会。

charitable.example: He took a charitable view of his student's careless mistake.  他对学生的粗心错误持宽容态度。

lenient.example: The judge handed down a lenient sentence because of the boy's age.  由于这个男孩年纪小，法官作出了从轻的判决。

mild.example: The winter here is unusually mild and rarely brings snow.  这里的冬天格外温和，很少下雪。

balmy.example: We sat outside enjoying the balmy air of early summer.  我们坐在外面享受初夏温和宜人的空气。

equable.example: His equable nature made him easy to work with.  他性情平和，与他共事很轻松。

harsh.example: The judge's harsh sentence surprised even the prosecutors in the courtroom.  法官严厉的判决连法庭上的检察官都感到意外。

severe.example: The judge imposed a severe penalty on the repeat offender.  法官对累犯施以严厉处罚。

stern.example: The teacher gave the boys a stern warning about cheating.  老师就作弊问题严厉警告了那些男孩。

strict.example: Her parents were strict about homework and bedtime.  她父母对作业和睡觉时间很严格。

inclement.example: The ceremony moved indoors because of unusually inclement weather.  由于天气异常恶劣，典礼改在室内举行。

clich.example: His speech ended with a tired clich about chasing dreams.  他的演讲以追逐梦想这类用滥的陈词收尾。

stereotypical.example: The film relies on stereotypical characters and predictable jokes.  这部电影靠刻板人物和老套笑话撑着。

fresh.example: The team needs a fresh approach to this old problem.  团队需要用新颖的方法处理这个老问题。

original.example: Her proposal was genuinely original, unlike the tired ideas we usually hear.  她的提案确实新颖，不像我们常听到的那些陈旧想法。

creative.example: She found a creative solution to the seating problem.  她为座位问题想出了有创意的办法。

clog.example: Old regulations act as a clog on economic progress.  陈旧的法规成了经济进步的阻碍。

block.example: Fear of failure can be a block to learning anything.  怕失败会成为学习任何东西的障碍。

deterrent.example: Heavy fines act as a deterrent to careless drivers.  重罚对粗心司机起到威慑作用。

drag.example: High debt became a drag on the country's economy.  高额债务成了该国经济的阻力。

fetter.example: Heavy family obligations fettered her ambition for many long years.  沉重的家庭责任多年来束缚了她的雄心。

holdback.example: Poor transport was the main holdback to regional growth.  交通落后是地区发展的主要阻碍。

hurdle.example: Funding is the last hurdle before the project begins.  资金是项目启动前的最后一道难关。

impediment.example: Poor roads are a serious impediment to rural development.  路况差是农村发展的严重障碍。

inhibition.example: After a drink he lost his usual inhibition and sang.  喝了一杯后他抛开平日的拘束唱起歌。

interference.example: Radio interference made the broadcast almost impossible to hear.  无线电干扰使广播几乎听不清。

shackles.example: They fought to break the shackles of colonial rule.  他们为打破殖民统治的枷锁而斗争。

stumblingblock.example: Cost remains the biggest stumblingblock to wider use of the technology.  成本仍是该技术广泛应用的最大绊脚石。

trammel.example: Old rules trammel the creativity of young designers here.  旧规矩束缚了这里年轻设计师的创造力。

encumber.example: Too many rules encumber small businesses in this country.  太多规定阻碍了这个国家的小企业。

holdup.example: A broken signal caused a long holdup on the line.  信号故障造成线路长时间延误。

im-.example: The prefix im- before p turns a word negative, like impossible.  前缀 im- 用在 p 前表示否定，如 impossible。

pede.example: The root pede appears in impede and pedestrian, meaning foot.  词根 pede 出现在 impede 和 pedestrian 中，意为脚。

interfere with.example: Loud noise from the street interferes with my concentration.  街上的噪音干扰我集中注意力。

shackle.example: New tariffs would shackle trade between the two neighboring countries.  新关税会束缚这两个邻国之间的贸易。

tie up.example: The accident tied up traffic for more than two hours.  事故使交通堵塞了两个多小时。

help.example: Your advice was a great help during the difficult week.  在那困难的一周里你的建议帮了大忙。

clot.example: A blood clot in his leg required immediate medical attention.  他腿部的血块需要立即接受治疗。

array.example: The museum displayed an impressive array of ancient coins.  博物馆展出了一批蔚为壮观的古钱币。

assemblage.example: The museum displays a strange assemblage of old machines.  博物馆展出一批奇特的老机器。

band.example: A small band of protesters gathered outside the building.  一小群抗议者聚集在大楼外。

bunch.example: A bunch of students waited outside the lecture hall.  一群学生在讲堂外等着。

cluster.example: A small cluster of reporters waited outside the courthouse door.  一小群记者等在法院门口。

clutch.example: A clutch of reporters waited at the airport exit.  一群记者在机场出口等候。

collection.example: He keeps a large collection of old maps at home.  他家里收藏着大量古地图。

constellation.example: The film features a constellation of famous young actors.  这部电影汇集了一批著名的年轻演员。

grouping.example: The parties formed a loose grouping to oppose the bill.  各党派组成松散的一伙反对该法案。

huddle.example: A huddle of workers stood smoking near the gate.  一群工人挤在门边吸烟。

lot.example: The auction sold the whole lot for very little.  拍卖会把这一整批以极低价卖掉。

muster.example: The captain mustered his crew on the upper deck.  船长把船员集合到上层甲板。

package.example: The government announced a package of measures to help farmers.  政府宣布一整套帮助农民的措施。

congeal.example: The gravy congealed as soon as the plate cooled.  盘子一凉，肉汁就凝住了。

jell.example: Leave the mixture to jell overnight in the refrigerator.  把混合物放冰箱里过夜凝固。

jelly.example: The soup had jellied in the pot by the morning.  到早上汤已在锅里凝成了冻状。

refreshing.example: A cold shower is wonderfully refreshing after a long run.  长跑后洗个冷水澡格外提神。

restorative.example: A long walk by the sea proved wonderfully restorative after weeks of stress.  数周压力之后，在海边长时间散步格外有益身心。

vital.example: Regular exercise keeps older people vital and mentally alert.  经常锻炼使老年人保持活力和头脑清醒。

vitalizing.example: The mountain air had a vitalizing effect on the patients.  山间空气对病人有振奋精神的作用。

distant.example: She was polite but distant throughout the whole dinner.  整个晚餐期间她客气却冷淡。

remote.example: His manner remained remote even among close family members.  即使在近亲之间他也显得疏离。

unbending.example: The old teacher was unbending about rules and manners.  这位老教师在规矩和礼节上毫不通融。

debilitating.example: A debilitating fever kept him in bed for weeks.  一场使人虚弱的高烧让他卧床数周。

draining.example: Caring for a sick parent is emotionally draining work.  照顾生病的父母是耗费心力的事。

enervating.example: The enervating heat made everyone slow and irritable.  令人虚脱的暑热使人人迟缓易怒。

enfeebling.example: Years of poor diet had an enfeebling effect on him.  多年饮食不良使他身体日渐衰弱。

exhausting.example: The twelve-hour shift was exhausting for the young nurses.  十二小时的班让年轻护士精疲力竭。

sapping.example: The energy-sapping humidity left the workers exhausted by noon.  耗人精力的湿热让工人们到中午就疲惫不堪。

clout.example: The union still has enough political clout to block the bill.  工会仍有足够的政治影响力阻止这项法案。

power.example: The party came to power after a narrow election victory.  该党以微弱优势胜选后上台执政。

influence.example: Her teacher had a lasting influence on her career choices.  她的老师对她的职业选择有长久影响。

capacity.example: The country lacks the capacity to produce its own vaccines.  该国缺乏自行生产疫苗的能力。

heft.example: The new director brings real heft to the small company.  新总监给这家小公司带来真正的分量。

leverage.example: The union used the strike to gain leverage in talks.  工会利用罢工在谈判中取得影响力。

impuissance.example: The committee's impuissance became clear when nobody obeyed its order.  没人服从命令时，委员会的无权就显露了。

impotence.example: Voters expressed impotence in the face of rising prices.  面对物价上涨，选民表达了无能为力之感。

cloying.example: The cake had a cloying sweetness that ruined the meal.  蛋糕甜得发腻，毁了这顿饭。

lovey-dovey.example: They were so lovey-dovey that their friends teased them.  他们太腻歪，朋友们都笑话他们。

maudlin.example: After two drinks he grew maudlin about his lost youth.  喝了两杯后他为逝去的青春伤感起来。

mawkish.example: The film's mawkish ending made several people in the audience laugh out loud.  这部电影滥情的结局让观众里好几个人笑出声来。

sentimental.example: The old watch has great sentimental value for my mother.  这块旧表对我母亲有很大的情感价值。

unsentimental.example: Her unsentimental account of the war impressed the historians.  她对战争不带感情的叙述令史学家印象深刻。

clumsy.example: My clumsy attempt at juggling ended with three broken plates.  我笨拙地学抛球，结果打碎了三个盘子。

ham-handed.example: His ham-handed attempt to help only made things worse.  他笨拙的帮忙只让事情更糟。

heavy-handed.example: The government's heavy-handed response angered many peaceful protesters.  政府的强硬做法激怒了许多和平抗议者。

coagulate.example: Blood from the small cut coagulated within a few minutes.  小伤口流出的血几分钟内就凝结了。

melt.example: The ice cream melted before we reached the beach.  我们还没到海滩冰淇淋就化了。

liquefy.example: Heat will liquefy the butter in about two minutes.  加热约两分钟就能把黄油化成液体。

fluidify.example: Adding warm water helps fluidify the thick chocolate mixture.  加温水有助于把稠巧克力糊变稀。

dissolve.example: Stir the powder until the crystals dissolve in water completely.  搅拌粉末，直到晶体在水中完全溶解。

associate.example: He refused to associate himself with such a risky plan.  他拒绝与这样冒险的计划有牵连。

combine.example: The recipe combines sweet and sour flavors very successfully.  这道菜谱把甜味和酸味结合得很成功。

conjoin.example: The bridge conjoins the island and the mainland neatly.  这座桥把小岛与大陆巧妙相连。

connect.example: A narrow tunnel connects the two halves of the building.  一条窄隧道把大楼的两半连起来。

couple.example: Workers coupled the new carriage to the waiting train.  工人把新车厢挂到等候的列车上。

interfuse.example: The composer interfuses folk melodies with modern harmony.  作曲家把民间旋律与现代和声交融在一起。

join.example: Join the ends of the rope with a firm knot.  用牢固的结把绳子两端接起来。

break up.example: Police arrived quickly to break up the noisy crowd.  警察迅速赶到驱散嘈杂的人群。

dissever.example: The war dissevered families that had lived together for generations.  战争把世代同住的家庭分割开来。

section.example: The teacher sectioned the class into four working groups.  老师把班级分成四个学习小组。

sever.example: The company severed all ties with its former supplier.  公司与前供应商断绝了一切关系。

split.example: The committee split into two camps over the proposal.  委员会因该提案分裂成两派。

sunder.example: The bitter dispute sundered an alliance that had lasted decades.  这场激烈的争端割断了维持数十年的联盟。

unlink.example: You can unlink your bank card from the app anytime.  你可随时解除银行卡与应用的关联。

disband.example: The band disbanded after their final concert last year.  乐队在去年最后一场演唱会后解散。

coax.example: She coaxed the frightened kitten out from under the porch.  她把受惊的小猫从门廊下哄了出来。

coda.example: The symphony ends with a quiet and unexpectedly gentle coda.  这部交响曲以安静而出乎意料温柔的尾声结束。

finale.example: The orchestra saved its loudest music for the grand finale.  乐团把最响亮的乐段留给了盛大的终场。

epilogue.example: A brief epilogue tells the reader what became of the two brothers.  简短的结语告诉读者两兄弟后来的境况。

overture.example: The orchestra opened the evening with a lively overture by Rossini.  乐团以罗西尼一首轻快的序曲开始了晚会。

prelude.example: The border clashes proved to be a prelude to full-scale war.  边境冲突后来成了全面战争的前奏。

coerce.example: The soldiers coerced the villagers into handing over their grain.  士兵强迫村民交出粮食。

force.example: The heavy rain forced them to cancel the outdoor ceremony.  大雨迫使他们取消了户外典礼。

threaten.example: The company threatened to sue anyone who leaked the documents.  公司威胁要起诉任何泄露文件的人。

compel.example: Illness compelled her to withdraw from the competition.  疾病迫使她退出了比赛。

voluntary behavior.example: Donating blood is voluntary behavior that no law can require.  献血是自愿行为，法律无法强制要求。

coeval.example: Those two coeval civilizations traded across the same narrow sea.  那两个同时代的文明曾在同一片狭海上通商。

coetaneous.example: The two coetaneous poets never once mentioned each other in writing.  这两位同时代的诗人在作品中从未提及对方。

coexisting.example: Several coexisting traditions shaped the music of that region.  几种共存的传统塑造了那个地区的音乐。

contemporaneous.example: Historians rely on contemporaneous letters to date the rebellion.  史学家依靠同时期的信件来确定叛乱的年代。

simultaneous.example: The two explosions were almost simultaneous, seconds apart at most.  两次爆炸几乎同时发生，最多相隔几秒。

synchronic.example: Her synchronic study describes the language as it stood in 1900.  她的共时研究描述了这门语言在1900年的状态。

synchronous.example: The dancers' movements were perfectly synchronous throughout the piece.  舞者的动作在整支舞中完全同步。

asynchronous.example: Email is asynchronous, so nobody has to reply right away.  电子邮件是异步的，所以没人必须立刻回复。

noncontemporary.example: The account is noncontemporary and was written two centuries later.  这份记述并非同时代的，写于两百年后。

nonsimultaneous.example: The two nonsimultaneous eruptions were separated by nine months.  这两次非同时的火山喷发相隔九个月。

cogent.example: The lawyer offered a cogent argument that convinced the jury.  律师提出了令人信服的论证，说服了陪审团。

convincing.cn: 令人信服的，有说服力的
convincing.example: She gave a convincing explanation for the missing money.  她对丢失的钱给出了令人信服的解释。

compelling.example: He gave a compelling reason for leaving the project early.  他给出了提前离开项目的极具说服力的理由。

conclusive.example: The tests were not conclusive, so the doctors ordered more.  检测结果并不确定，医生便要求再做检查。

telling.example: One telling detail in the letter revealed the writer's true motive.  信中一个意味深长的细节揭示了写信人的真实动机。

persuasive.cn: 有说服力的，令人信服的
persuasive.example: His persuasive letter changed the committee's mind overnight.  他那封有说服力的信一夜之间改变了委员会的想法。

satisfying.cn: 令人满意的；有说服力的
satisfying.example: No one offered a satisfying answer to the reporter's question.  没人对记者的问题给出令人满意的答复。

unconvincing.cn: 无说服力的，难以令人信服的
unconvincing.example: The witness gave an unconvincing account of where he had been.  证人对自己的行踪给出了难以令人信服的说法。

unpersuasive.example: The lawyer's unpersuasive closing argument failed to move the jury.  律师毫无说服力的结案陈词未能打动陪审团。

cognizant.example: Investors must be cognizant of the risks before signing anything.  投资者在签署任何文件前必须意识到风险。

aware.example: She was fully aware that the deadline had already passed.  她完全知道截止日期已经过了。

conscious.example: He made a conscious effort to speak more slowly on stage.  他有意识地努力在台上讲得慢一些。

witting.example: She was a witting participant in the scheme from the start.  她从一开始就是这个计划的知情参与者。

apprehensive.example: She was fully apprehensive of the dangers before she signed anything.  在签任何文件之前，她已充分知晓其中的危险。

oblivious.example: Deep in her book, she was oblivious to the noise of the crowd.  她沉浸在书里，察觉不到人群的嘈杂。

unconscious.example: The driver lay unconscious on the road until help arrived.  司机躺在路上昏迷不醒，直到救援到来。

unaware.example: They were unaware that the meeting had been moved to Friday.  他们不知道会议已改到周五。

collapse.example: The collapse of the talks surprised nobody in the capital.  谈判的破裂在首都没让任何人感到意外。

defeat.example: After three hours of argument he finally admitted defeat.  争论三小时后他终于承认失败。

nonachievement.example: Years of nonachievement left the department without funding.  多年毫无成果让这个部门失去了资金。

nonsuccess.example: The nonsuccess of the first launch delayed the program by a year.  首次发射的失败使项目推迟了一年。

accomplishment.example: Finishing the bridge in one year was a real accomplishment.  一年内建成这座桥是了不起的成就。

achievement.example: Her greatest achievement was building the school from nothing.  她最大的成就是从无到有建起这所学校。

collude.example: Two suppliers colluded with rivals to keep prices artificially high.  两家供应商与对手串通，人为维持高价。

connive.example: Two officers connived at the fraud for several years.  两名官员多年来对这起欺诈暗中纵容。

conspire.example: Several generals conspired to seize power while the president was abroad.  几名将军趁总统出国时密谋夺权。

contrive.example: He contrived to leave the party without anyone noticing.  他设法离开了聚会，没被任何人察觉。

intrigue.example: Court records reveal decades of political intrigue behind the sudden fall of the minister.  法庭记录揭示了这位大臣突然倒台背后数十年的政治阴谋。

machinate.example: The ministers machinated for months to remove the young king.  大臣们策划了数月要废掉年轻的国王。

put up.example: The two brothers put up the whole story to fool their teacher.  两兄弟合伙编造了整个故事来骗老师。

act independently.example: Each branch may act independently when local conditions demand it.  当地情况需要时，各分部可以独立行动。

colossal.example: A colossal statue of the founder stands in the square.  广场上矗立着创始人的巨大雕像。

huge.example: A huge crowd waited outside the stadium in the rain.  一大群人在雨中等在体育场外。

giant.example: The company took a giant step into the electric car market.  这家公司向电动车市场迈出了巨大一步。

titanic.example: The two armies fought a titanic battle across the frozen river.  两支军队在冰封的河上展开了一场惊天动地的大战。

gargantuan.example: The young athlete has a gargantuan appetite after every practice.  这名年轻运动员每次训练后都有巨大的食量。

mammoth.example: Rebuilding the port after the storm was a mammoth undertaking.  风暴后重建港口是一项巨大的工程。

tremendous.example: The new policy had a tremendous effect on small farmers everywhere.  新政策对各地小农户产生了极大的影响。

elephantine.example: His elephantine movements on stage made the delicate dance look almost comic.  他在台上笨重的动作让这支细腻的舞蹈显得近乎滑稽。

prodigious.example: The pianist has a prodigious memory for long and complicated scores.  这位钢琴家对冗长复杂的乐谱有惊人的记忆力。

tiny.example: Only a tiny number of applicants pass the first round.  只有极少数申请者能通过第一轮。

micro.example: The report studies the crisis at both the macro and micro level.  报告从宏观和微观两个层面研究这场危机。

minute.example: Even a minute trace of the chemical can spoil the batch.  即使极微量的这种化学品也会毁掉整批产品。
minute.cn: 极小的，微不足道的；细致的

miniature.example: The museum displays a miniature model of the whole city.  博物馆展出了整座城市的微缩模型。

minuscule.example: A minuscule crack in the pipe caused the entire basement to flood overnight.  管道上一道极小的裂缝一夜之间让整个地下室被淹。

wee.example: Add just a wee drop of vinegar to the sauce.  在酱汁里只加一点点醋。

infinitesimal.example: The risk of infection is infinitesimal if the tools are sterile.  只要器械无菌，感染风险微乎其微。

coltish.example: Her coltish humor kept the whole office laughing all morning.  她爱开玩笑的性子让整个办公室笑了一上午。

frolicsome.example: The frolicsome children chased each other around the garden.  那些爱闹的孩子在花园里互相追逐。

larky.example: He was in a larky mood and kept teasing everyone at dinner.  他兴致很高，晚饭时一直逗大家。

sportful.example: Her sportful teasing made even the shy students laugh.  她戏谑的玩笑让连害羞的学生都笑了。

earnest.example: An earnest student stayed behind to ask about the summer reading list.  一名认真的学生留下来询问暑期阅读书目。

serious-minded.example: She is too serious-minded to enjoy their silly office jokes.  她太严肃认真，欣赏不了办公室里那些无聊的玩笑。

sober.example: The committee offered a sober assessment of the country's economic prospects.  委员会对国家经济前景作出冷静的评估。

coma.example: The patient fell into a coma after the second surgery.  病人在第二次手术后陷入昏迷。

insensibility.example: The blow to his head produced complete insensibility for an hour.  头部受到的撞击使他整整一小时毫无知觉。

blackout.example: The pilot had a brief blackout during the steep climb.  飞行员在急速爬升时短暂失去了意识。

knockout.example: The champion ended the fight with a knockout in round two.  冠军在第二回合以击倒结束了比赛。

consciousness.example: She slowly regained consciousness two days after the accident.  事故两天后她慢慢恢复了意识。

awareness.example: The campaign raised awareness of water shortages in rural areas.  这场运动提高了人们对农村缺水的认识。

combustible.example: Store the highly combustible material far from any open flame.  把极易燃的材料存放在远离明火的地方。

burnable.example: Please sort burnable waste into the yellow bags only.  请把可燃垃圾只装进黄色袋子。

combustive.example: Engineers measured how the combustive mixture behaved under pressure.  工程师测量了这种可燃混合物在压力下的表现。

flammable.example: Keep flammable liquids away from the heater at all times.  务必让易燃液体远离取暖器。

ignitable.example: Fine sawdust is ignitable and can explode inside a closed mill.  细木屑可点燃，在密闭厂房内会发生爆炸。

inflammable.example: The truck carried inflammable cargo and was banned from the tunnel.  这辆卡车装载易燃货物，被禁止进入隧道。

excitable.example: The excitable puppy barked at every passing bicycle.  这只容易兴奋的小狗对每辆经过的自行车叫。

agitable.example: His agitable nature made long negotiations difficult for him.  他易激动的性格让他难以应对漫长的谈判。

touchy.example: Money is a touchy subject in that family, so avoid it.  钱在那个家里是敏感话题，别提。

incombustible.example: The walls are lined with incombustible panels for extra safety.  为了更安全，墙面衬有不可燃板材。

nonburnable.example: Glass and metal go in the nonburnable garbage container.  玻璃和金属要放进不可燃垃圾桶。

noncombustible.example: Building codes now require noncombustible insulation in tall towers.  建筑规范现在要求高层塔楼使用不燃保温材料。

nonflammable.example: Children's pajamas must be made of nonflammable fabric here.  这里的儿童睡衣必须用不易燃的织物制作。

noninflammable.example: The lab switched to a noninflammable solvent after the small fire.  小火之后实验室换用了不易燃的溶剂。

unburnable.example: What remains in the furnace is a hard, unburnable residue.  炉中剩下的是坚硬的、烧不掉的残渣。

proof.example: The safe is proof against both fire and water damage.  这个保险箱既防火又防水。

batch.example: The factory recalled an entire batch of defective batteries.  工厂召回了一整批有缺陷的电池。

group.example: A group of tourists gathered around the fountain to take photos.  一群游客聚在喷泉边拍照。

crop.example: This year's crop of graduates is the largest in the school's history.  今年这批毕业生是校史上人数最多的。

comity.example: The treaty was signed in a spirit of genuine comity.  条约是在真诚友好的气氛中签署的。

compatibility.example: Their compatibility as roommates surprised everyone who knew them.  他们作为室友相处融洽，令认识他们的人都惊讶。

peace.example: The two villages have lived in peace for over a century.  这两个村庄和睦相处已逾一个世纪。

birth.example: That meeting marked the birth of the modern computer industry.  那次会议标志着现代计算机产业的诞生。

onset.example: The onset of winter caught the expedition without adequate shelter or fuel.  冬天的到来让探险队没有足够的庇护所和燃料。

outset.example: From the outset, she made it clear that she would not compromise.  从一开始，她就明确表示自己不会妥协。

genesis.example: The genesis of the movement lies in a single student protest.  这场运动的起源是一次学生抗议。

inception.example: The club has doubled in size since its inception three years ago.  这个俱乐部自三年前创立以来规模翻了一倍。

nascence.example: Those pamphlets document the nascence of the labor movement.  那些小册子记录了工人运动的诞生。

threshold.example: The country stands on the threshold of a major reform.  这个国家正处于一场重大改革的开端。

dissension.example: Internal dissension over funding split the small research group into two camps.  关于经费的内部分歧把这个小研究组分成了两派。

matriculation.example: Matriculation takes place during the first week of September.  入学注册在九月的第一周进行。

equal.example: The two shares are equal in value but not in voting power.  这两份股份价值相等，但表决权不同。

tantamount.example: His long silence was tantamount to a refusal of our request.  他久久的沉默等于是拒绝了我们的请求。

commensurable.example: Their achievements are hardly commensurable, since the fields differ.  他们的成就很难相互比较，因为领域不同。

proportionate.example: The fine should be proportionate to the damage actually caused.  罚款应与实际造成的损害相称。

criticize.example: Several members criticized the plan for ignoring small farmers.  几名成员批评该计划忽视了小农。

deplore.example: Church leaders deplored the violence and called for immediate restraint.  教会领袖谴责暴力行为，呼吁立即克制。

commensurate.example: The salary offered is commensurate with your years of service.  所给的薪水与你的工作年限相称。

unequal.example: The two sides entered the contest on decidedly unequal terms.  双方是在明显不平等的条件下参赛的。

disparate.example: The committee somehow reconciled disparate viewpoints into a single workable proposal.  委员会竟把迥然不同的观点整合成一份可行的提案。
disparate.cn: 迥然不同的，全然不同的

preponderant.example: Trade remained the preponderant concern in every round of talks.  贸易在每一轮会谈中都是最主要的议题。

disproportionate.example: Rural schools receive a disproportionate share of the budget cuts.  农村学校承担了不成比例的预算削减。

commingle.example: The lawyer never commingles client funds with his own money.  这位律师从不把客户资金与自己的钱混在一起。

immix.example: The dyer immixed the pigments until the color turned deep green.  染工把颜料掺和到颜色变成深绿。

commix.example: Old recipes tell the cook to commix the herbs with warm oil.  古老的食谱让厨师把香草与温油混合。

immingle.example: Voices from the street immingled with the music inside the hall.  街上的声音与厅内的音乐混在了一起。

merge.example: The two banks merged last year to cut operating costs.  这两家银行去年合并以削减运营成本。

break down.example: Bacteria break down the waste into simpler compounds.  细菌把废物分解成更简单的化合物。

unmix.example: Once you stir them together, you cannot unmix the two powders.  两种粉末一旦搅在一起就无法再分开。

devotedness.example: Her devotedness to the patients impressed every nurse on the ward.  她对病人的忠诚打动了病房里每一位护士。

fealty.example: The barons swore fealty to the new king before the altar.  贵族们在祭坛前宣誓效忠新国王。

ambivalence.example: Her ambivalence about moving abroad delayed the decision for months.  她对出国的矛盾心理使决定推迟了数月。

equivocation.example: The mayor answered without equivocation that he would resign.  市长毫不含糊地回答说他将辞职。

committed.example: She is a committed supporter of the local animal shelter.  她是当地动物收容所的忠实支持者。

loyal.example: He remained loyal to the team even during its worst season.  即使在最糟的赛季，他仍然忠于这支球队。

faithful.example: The film is a faithful adaptation of the original novel.  这部电影是对原著小说的忠实改编。

allegiant.example: The old guard stayed allegiant to the founder until his death.  元老们一直忠于创始人，直到他去世。

disloyal.example: Sharing those emails was disloyal to everyone on the team.  分享那些邮件是对团队所有人的背叛。

confirmable.example: Only confirmable facts should appear in the final report.  只有可证实的事实才应出现在最终报告中。

commodious.example: They rented a commodious apartment with two sunny balconies.  他们租了一套宽敞舒适、带两个阳台的公寓。

spacious.example: The new office is spacious enough for forty desks.  新办公室很宽敞，能放四十张桌子。

roomy.example: The coat is roomy enough to wear over a thick sweater.  这件外套很宽松，可以套在厚毛衣外面。

justified.example: Her complaint was justified, and the store refunded the money.  她的投诉有理，商店退了钱。

logical.example: Selling the old machines was the logical next step.  卖掉旧机器是顺理成章的下一步。

reasoned.cn: 经过推理的，理由充分的
reasoned.example: She presented a reasoned case for keeping the library open.  她提出了有理有据的理由要求图书馆继续开放。

valid.example: Your ticket is valid for travel on any weekday this month.  你的票在本月任何工作日出行均有效。

well-founded.example: Their fear of another flood proved to be well-founded.  他们对再次洪水的担忧被证明有充分根据。

levelheaded.example: Her levelheaded response to the emergency probably saved several lives that night.  她对紧急情况明智冷静的回应那晚可能救了好几条命。

constricted.example: The constricted hallway made carrying furniture almost impossible.  狭窄的走廊让搬家具几乎无法进行。

cramped.example: Four of us shared a cramped room above the noisy bakery.  我们四个人挤在嘈杂面包店楼上一间狭小的房间里。

snug.example: The cabin was snug but far too small for four guests.  小屋很温馨，但对四位客人来说太小了。

constringed.example: Cold air left the constringed airways struggling to pass oxygen.  冷空气使收缩的气道难以输送氧气。

commonsensical.example: His advice was commonsensical: sleep more and worry less.  他的建议合乎常理：多睡觉，少操心。

groundless.example: The court found the accusations entirely groundless and dismissed them.  法庭认定这些指控毫无根据，予以驳回。

illogical.example: It seems illogical to cut staff while demand keeps rising.  在需求持续上升时裁员似乎不合逻辑。

invalid.example: The contract is invalid because it was never signed.  这份合同无效，因为从未签署。

irrational.example: He has an irrational fear of elevators and always takes stairs.  他对电梯有非理性的恐惧，总是走楼梯。

nonrational.example: Many buying decisions rest on nonrational impulses rather than analysis.  许多购买决定基于非理性冲动而非分析。

nonvalid.example: The inspector declared the expired license nonvalid for commercial use.  检查员宣布过期执照对商业用途无效。

unfounded.example: The company called the reports of bankruptcy completely unfounded.  公司称破产的报道完全没有根据。

unjusti-.cn: 断词前半：无正当理由的
unjusti-.example: The word split as unjusti- fied across the printed line break.  这个词在印刷换行处被拆成 unjusti- 和 fied。

fied.example: Here fied is merely the tail of a hyphenated broken word.  这里的 fied 只是一个被连字符断开的词尾。

unreasonable.example: Asking staff to work three weekends running is unreasonable.  要求员工连续三个周末加班是不合理的。

unreasoned.example: Their unreasoned hostility toward newcomers surprised the visiting scholars.  他们对新来者毫无理由的敌意让访问学者感到意外。

unsound.example: The engineer judged the old bridge structurally unsound.  工程师判定这座旧桥结构不牢。

hurry-scurry.example: In the hurry-scurry of departure she left her passport behind.  在出发的慌乱中她把护照忘下了。

tranquility.example: He enjoyed the tranquility of the snowy fields at dusk.  他享受黄昏时白雪覆盖的田野的静谧。

calmness.example: Her calmness during the fire kept the whole class safe.  火灾中她的镇定使全班安然无恙。

serenity.example: The garden offers a rare serenity in the middle of the city.  这座花园在城市中心提供了难得的宁静。

overview.example: Chapter one offers an overview of the entire research field.  第一章对整个研究领域作了概述。

concise.example: Keep your answer concise; the interviewer has only ten minutes.  回答要简洁，面试官只有十分钟。

succinct.example: Her succinct summary covered the entire report in three short paragraphs.  她简洁的总结用三小段概括了整份报告。

complacency.example: Early success bred a complacency that cost the team the title.  早期的成功滋生了自满，害球队丢了冠军。

pride.example: She takes great pride in the garden she built herself.  她对自己亲手建的花园非常自豪。

self-admiration.example: His memoir slips from honesty into pure self-admiration.  他的回忆录从诚实滑向了纯粹的自我欣赏。

self-assumption.example: Her self-assumption annoyed colleagues who had worked twice as long.  她的自以为是让工作时间长一倍的同事很反感。

smugness.example: There was a smugness in his voice as he read the results.  他念结果时语气中带着自鸣得意。

vanity.example: Pure vanity kept him from wearing the glasses he needed.  纯粹的虚荣心使他不肯戴自己需要的眼镜。

good-naturedness.example: His good-naturedness made him the easiest neighbor on the street.  他的和善使他成为街上最好相处的邻居。

complaisance.example: Her complaisance toward every request left her with no free time.  她对每个请求都顺从，结果没有一点空闲时间。

conformable.example: The design must be conformable to the city's new safety code.  设计必须符合城市新的安全规范。

incompliant.example: The incompliant staff refused to follow the new dress rule.  不顺从的员工拒绝遵守新的着装规定。

rebel.example: Students rebelled against the strict new curfew last spring.  学生们去年春天反抗严苛的新宵禁令。

rebellious.example: Her rebellious streak showed early, long before high school.  她的叛逆性格早早就显露，远在高中之前。

recalcitrant.example: A recalcitrant employee refused every instruction his new supervisor gave him.  一名顽抗的员工拒绝了新主管给他的每一条指示。

unamenable.example: The old machine proved unamenable to any modern repair method.  事实证明这台旧机器不适用于任何现代修理方法。

vituperative.example: His vituperative letter to the editor was never printed.  他写给编辑的那封谩骂信从未刊出。

clownish.example: His clownish antics amused the children but embarrassed his wife.  他滑稽的怪动作逗乐了孩子，却让妻子难堪。

cloddish.example: His cloddish remarks embarrassed everyone at the dinner table.  他粗鲁的言论让餐桌上所有人都尴尬。

comprise.example: The collection comprises nine paintings and a dozen sketches.  这批收藏包括九幅画和十几张素描。

make up.example: Women make up more than half of the entering class.  女生占新生班级的一半以上。

disturb.example: Please do not disturb the birds while they are nesting.  鸟类筑巢时请不要打扰它们。

upset.example: The news of the closure upset the staff more than management expected.  停业的消息比管理层预想的更让员工不安。

distraught.example: Distraught with grief, she sat by the window and refused to speak.  她因悲痛而狂乱，坐在窗边不肯说话。

restless.example: He spent a restless night listening to the wind rattle the windows.  他度过了一个不平静的夜晚，听着风摇窗户作响。

amalgam.example: Her music is an amalgam of jazz and traditional folk song.  她的音乐是爵士与传统民歌的混合。

amalgamation.example: The amalgamation of the two unions created a powerful bloc.  两个工会的合并形成了一个强大的集团。

cocktail.example: Patients receive a cocktail of three drugs each morning.  病人每天早上服用三种药物的混合剂。

combination.example: Success came from a combination of luck and careful planning.  成功来自运气与周密计划的结合。

composite.example: The artist built a composite portrait from four separate photographs.  艺术家用四张照片合成了一幅肖像。

fusion.example: Their cooking is a fusion of Korean and Peruvian traditions.  他们的烹饪是韩国与秘鲁传统的融合。

intermixture.example: The port city grew from an intermixture of many trading peoples.  这座港城由许多贸易族群混居发展而来。

conflation.example: The essay suffers from a conflation of law and morality.  这篇文章的问题在于把法律与道德混为一谈。

synthesis.example: His theory is a synthesis of ideas drawn from several disciplines.  他的理论是多个学科思想的综合。

amalgamated.example: The amalgamated company now employs six thousand people.  合并后的公司现有六千名员工。

chain.example: He chained his bicycle to the railing outside the shop.  他把自行车锁在店外的栏杆上。

conjugate.example: Researchers conjugate the drug to an antibody for precise delivery.  研究者把药物与抗体结合以实现精准投递。

hook.example: She hooked the two cables together before starting the engine.  她把两根电缆连接好才启动发动机。

interconnect.example: Bridges interconnect the islands so the ferry is no longer needed.  桥梁把各岛连接起来，渡船已无必要。

interlink.example: The two railways interlink at a single mountain station.  两条铁路在一个山间车站相连。

yoke.example: The farmer yoked two oxen together to pull the heavy plow.  农夫把两头牛套在一起拉那沉重的犁。

noncompound.example: Salt is a compound, but a noncompound element like gold stands alone.  盐是化合物，而像金这样的非复合元素独立存在。

unhitch.example: The farmer stopped to unhitch the horse from the loaded cart.  农夫停下来把马从装满货的车上卸下来。

unyoke.example: At dusk the workers unyoked the oxen and led them to water.  黄昏时工人给牛解开轭，牵它们去饮水。

compress.example: You should compress the file before sending it by email.  用邮件发送之前你应该压缩这个文件。

capsule.example: The editor asked for a capsule version of the long report.  编辑要一份长篇报告的浓缩版本。

condense.example: She managed to condense three chapters into a single clear page.  她把三章内容压缩成清晰的一页。

constrict.example: Cold air constricts the blood vessels near the skin's surface.  冷空气使皮肤表层的血管收缩。

constringe.example: The cold compress constringed the swollen tissue around the wound.  冷敷使伤口周围肿胀的组织收缩了。

shrink.example: The value of the old coins began to shrink after the scandal.  丑闻之后，那些旧币的价值开始缩水。

telescope.example: The director telescoped the novel's events into a two-hour film.  导演把小说的情节压缩成两小时的电影。

accommodation.example: The two sides finally reached an accommodation over water rights.  双方最终就水权问题达成了通融。

negotiation.example: Months of quiet negotiation produced a treaty both nations accepted.  数月的低调谈判促成了两国都接受的条约。

hazard.example: Loose wiring in the basement is a serious fire hazard.  地下室松脱的电线是严重的火灾隐患。

imperil.example: Cutting the inspections would imperil the safety of every passenger.  削减检查会危及每位乘客的安全。

menace.example: Rising sea levels menace coastal villages that have stood for hundreds of years.  海平面上升威胁着屹立数百年的沿海村庄。

peril.example: The old bridge put every crossing traveler in real peril.  那座旧桥让每个通行的旅人都身处险境。

venture.example: He ventured his whole savings on an untested new product.  他把全部积蓄冒险投在一款未经检验的新产品上。

compunction.example: She fired the loyal staff without the slightest compunction.  她毫无内疚地解雇了那些忠诚的员工。

misgiving.example: She had serious misgivings about signing the contract without a lawyer present.  她对在没有律师在场的情况下签合同深感疑虑。

scruple.example: He felt no scruple about reading the private letters of his brother.  他对偷看弟弟的私人信件毫无良心不安。

increase in volume.example: Freezing water shows a surprising increase in volume inside the pipe.  水结冰时在管道内体积会明显增大。

compromise.example: After long debate the committee reached a workable compromise.  经过长时间辩论，委员会达成了可行的妥协。

absence of misgiving.example: His total absence of misgiving about the plan worried the older advisers.  他对该计划毫无疑虑，这让年长顾问们担心。

concatenate.example: The program concatenates two strings into a single long line.  该程序把两个字符串连接成一行长文本。

catenate.example: The chemist catenated the small molecules into one long chain.  化学家把小分子串联成一条长链。

disconnect.example: Please disconnect the printer before you open its back panel.  打开后盖前请先断开打印机的连接。

disjoin.example: The engineer had to disjoin the pipes to replace a valve.  工程师得把管子分开才能更换阀门。

disjoint.example: Careless editing disjointed the argument and confused every reader.  草率的编辑使论证脱节，让每位读者都感到困惑。

unchain.example: The keeper unchained the old elephant and let it wander freely.  饲养员解开老象的链子，让它自由走动。

uncouple.example: Workers uncoupled the rear carriages before the train left the yard.  火车离开车场前工人把后面几节车厢脱开。

concoct.example: The prisoner concocted an elaborate story to win a lighter sentence.  囚犯编造了一个精心的故事以求减轻刑罚。

invent.example: He invented a clumsy excuse for missing the morning meeting.  他为缺席早会编了个拙劣的借口。

construct.example: The lawyer constructed a careful argument from a handful of ordinary documents.  律师用少量普通文件构建出一套严密的论证。

devise.example: The team devised a clever method for testing the old samples.  团队想出了检验旧样本的巧妙方法。

fabricate.example: The witness had fabricated evidence to protect his own brother.  那名证人捏造证据来保护自己的兄弟。

manufacture.example: The witness had manufactured an alibi that fell apart quickly.  证人编造的不在场证明很快就站不住脚了。

secrete.example: The driver had secreted the documents beneath the front seat.  司机把文件藏在了前排座椅下面。

occult.example: The manuscript is filled with occult knowledge that scholars still cannot decipher.  这份手稿满是学者至今无法解读的玄奥知识。

ensconce.example: She ensconced herself in the armchair nearest the fire and opened her book.  她把自己安置在离火最近的扶手椅里，打开了书。

display.example: The museum displays its rarest coins in a locked glass case.  博物馆把最珍稀的钱币陈列在上锁的玻璃柜里。

exhibit.example: Young children often exhibit no fear of strangers at all.  幼童常常对陌生人完全不表现出畏惧。

acknowledge.example: The mayor finally acknowledged that the report contained serious errors.  市长最终承认那份报告有严重错误。

confess.example: After hours of questioning he confessed to taking the money.  盘问数小时后他承认拿了那笔钱。

refuse to grant.example: The board chose to refuse to grant the extra funding.  董事会决定拒绝给予额外资金。

aggression.example: The border raid was widely condemned as naked aggression.  这次边境突袭被广泛谴责为赤裸裸的侵略。

concentrate.example: Boil the syrup slowly in order to concentrate the solution.  慢慢熬煮糖浆以便浓缩溶液。

amass.example: Over thirty years she amassed an astonishing collection of maps.  三十多年间她积累了数量惊人的地图收藏。

assemble.example: Villagers assembled in the square to hear the announcement.  村民聚集在广场上听那则公告。

collect.example: Dust collects quickly on shelves in this dry climate.  在这种干燥气候里灰尘很快就积在架子上。

congregate.example: Students congregate near the fountain between morning classes.  上午课间学生们聚集在喷泉附近。

dilute.example: Please dilute the concentrated juice with three parts water before serving it.  上桌前请用三倍的水稀释这种浓缩果汁。

dispel.example: Clear figures from the auditor dispelled most of the doubts.  审计师提供的清晰数据消除了大部分疑虑。

disperse.example: Police asked the protesters to disperse before nightfall.  警方要求抗议者在天黑前散开。

scatter.example: The birds scattered the moment the gardener opened the gate.  园丁一开门，鸟就四散飞走了。

concerted.example: A concerted effort by volunteers cleaned the river in a week.  志愿者的共同努力一周内清理了这条河。

collaborative.example: The paper was the product of a long collaborative study.  这篇论文是一项长期合作研究的成果。

combined.example: Their combined savings were still not enough for the house.  他们的存款合起来仍不够买房。

cooperative.example: The witness was polite and unusually cooperative with investigators.  这名证人礼貌，而且异常配合调查人员。

united.example: The villages stayed united against the plan to divert the river.  各村庄团结一致反对改道河流的计划。

musty.example: The cellar was dark, damp, and full of musty old books.  地窖阴暗潮湿，堆满带霉味的旧书。

enrage.example: His flippant apology only enraged the families further.  他轻率的道歉只让那些家庭更加愤怒。

incense.example: The proposal is certain to incense feminists across the country.  这项提案肯定会激怒全国的女权主义者。

infuriate.example: The decision to cut pensions infuriated thousands of workers across the country.  削减养老金的决定激怒了全国成千上万的工人。

unhackneyed.example: Her essay pleased the judges with its fresh, unhackneyed images.  她的文章以新鲜不俗的意象取悦了评委。

variance.example: His account was clearly at variance with the official police report.  他的说法明显与警方的官方报告不一致。

concur.example: Two other judges concurred with the opinion she had written.  另外两位法官同意她撰写的意见。

coincide.example: The festival coincides with the first full moon of autumn.  这个节日与秋天第一次满月同时到来。

coexist.example: Two rival species coexist along the narrow river bank.  两个竞争物种在狭窄的河岸上共存。

synchronize.example: The team synchronized their watches before entering the tunnel.  小队进隧道前把手表调成同步。

co-occur.example: These two symptoms co-occur in most untreated patients.  这两种症状在多数未治疗的病人身上同时出现。

band together.example: Small shops banded together to fight the new tax.  小店铺联合起来抵制新税。

collaborate.example: Two labs collaborated closely to finish the vaccine trial.  两个实验室紧密合作完成了疫苗试验。

concert.example: The agencies acted in concert to trace the missing funds.  各机构协同行动追查失踪的资金。

league.example: The merchants formed a league to set fair shipping rates.  商人们结成联盟以定出公道的运费。

team up.example: The two authors teamed up to write a children's history.  两位作者联手写了一部儿童历史读物。

patronizing.example: She disliked his patronizing tone whenever she asked a question.  每次她提问，他那居高临下的语气都让她反感。

condign.example: The court imposed condign punishment on the corrupt inspector.  法庭对腐败的检查员施以应得的惩罚。

due.example: The engineers never received the credit that was rightly due.  工程师们从未得到他们应得的赞誉。

deserved.example: After the long tour she took a well deserved break.  长途巡演后她得到了应有的休息。

merited.example: The award was merited praise for thirty years of quiet, patient teaching.  这个奖项是对三十年默默耐心教学的应得赞誉。

warranted.example: Given the delays, their anger seemed entirely warranted.  考虑到这些延误，他们的愤怒似乎完全合理。

undeserved.example: The quiet clerk suffered years of undeserved blame.  那位沉默的职员多年来承受着不该受的责难。

undue.example: The judge ruled that the will had been signed under undue influence.  法官裁定这份遗嘱是在不当影响下签署的。

unmerited.example: He accepted the unmerited honor with visible embarrassment.  他明显尴尬地接受了这份不该得的荣誉。

condole.example: Neighbors came all week to condole with the grieving widow.  邻居们整周都来慰问那位悲伤的寡妇。

condone.example: The school will never condone violence between its students.  学校绝不会宽恕学生之间的暴力行为。

overlook.example: The teacher chose to overlook the boy's late arrival.  老师决定不追究那男孩的迟到。

gloss over.example: The report glossed over the losses of the previous year.  报告对前一年的亏损轻描淡写。

conducive.example: A quiet room with good light is conducive to learning.  安静明亮的房间有助于学习。

facilitative.cn: 有促进作用的，起助益的

useful.example: This old dictionary is still useful for checking rare words.  这本旧词典查生僻词仍然很有用。

acid.example: Her acid comment about his writing silenced the whole table.  她对他文章的尖刻评论让全桌人都沉默了。

unhelpful.example: The clerk gave a vague and thoroughly unhelpful answer.  职员给出一个含糊而毫无帮助的答复。

useless.example: Without a charger the expensive phone was completely useless.  没有充电器，这部贵手机完全没用。

cantankerous.example: Their cantankerous landlord argued about every small repair.  他们那位爱争吵的房东为每项小修理都要吵。

confluence.example: The city grew up at the confluence of two great rivers.  这座城市在两条大河的汇合处发展起来。

conjunction.example: The drug works best in conjunction with a strict diet.  这种药与严格饮食配合使用效果最好。

face.example: Sooner or later she must face the truth about the debt.  她迟早得正视这笔债务的真相。

rebut.example: She rebutted every charge with documents and dated photographs.  她用文件和标注日期的照片反驳了每项指控。

confirm.example: Later tests confirmed what the first team had suspected.  后来的检测证实了第一个团队的猜测。

validate.example: Independent labs validated the results within three months.  独立实验室在三个月内验证了这些结果。

verify.example: Two independent labs will verify the results before publication.  两家独立实验室将在发表前核实这些结果。

solidify.example: The melted wax solidified quickly in the cold room.  融化的蜡在冷房间里很快凝固了。

congenial.example: Our congenial host made every guest feel completely at home.  我们和善的主人让每位客人都感到自在。

agreeable.example: She found him an agreeable companion on the long train journey.  她觉得他是长途火车旅程中一位讨人喜欢的同伴。

compatible.example: The new driver is compatible with both older printers.  新驱动与两款旧打印机都兼容。

unanimous.example: The jury reached a unanimous verdict after only two hours of discussion.  陪审团仅讨论两小时便达成了一致的裁决。

discordant.example: Discordant voices from the back ruined the quiet ceremony.  后面不和谐的声音破坏了安静的仪式。

incompatible.example: Rapid growth and strict conservation seemed incompatible goals here.  在这里快速发展与严格保护似乎是矛盾的目标。

congruent.example: His account is congruent with the facts we already know.  他的说法与我们已知的事实相符。

consonant.example: His modest lifestyle is consonant with the values he preaches.  他朴素的生活方式与他宣扬的价值观相符。

consistent.example: His account is consistent with what the neighbors reported.  他的说法与邻居们所述一致。

harmonious.example: The two neighbors maintained a harmonious relationship for over thirty years.  这两位邻居三十多年来保持着融洽的关系。

accordant.example: The ruling was accordant with decisions made in earlier cases.  该裁决与早先案件的判决一致。

identical.example: The two samples produced identical readings on every machine.  两个样本在每台机器上都得出相同读数。

conjecture.example: Without records, any date for the painting is pure conjecture.  没有记录，这幅画的年代纯属推测。

speculation.example: Without data the report was little more than speculation.  没有数据，这份报告不过是猜测。

supposition.example: Their conclusion rests on supposition rather than on hard evidence.  他们的结论基于猜测，而非确凿证据。

surmise.example: Without documents, his account is a mere surmise about what happened.  没有文件，他的说法只是对当时情形的揣测。

theory.example: One popular theory holds that the fire began outdoors.  一种流行的说法认为火是从室外烧起的。

imagine.example: I imagine the meeting will run past six o'clock.  我猜会议会开到六点以后。

presume.example: We must presume the letter was lost in the post.  我们只能假定那封信在邮寄中丢失了。

speculate.example: Scientists can only speculate about the cause of the sudden extinction.  科学家只能推测这次突然灭绝的原因。

suppose.example: Suppose the train is late; how will you reach the airport?  假设火车晚点，你怎么去机场？

plot.example: Several officers plotted secretly to seize the northern ports.  几名军官暗中策划夺取北方港口。

aesthete.example: The aesthete spent hours arranging flowers in a plain vase.  那位审美家花几个钟头在素瓶里插花。

cognoscente.example: Only a cognoscente would notice the flaw in that varnish.  只有行家才会注意到那层漆的瑕疵。

adept.example: She is remarkably adept at calming angry customers.  她极擅长安抚愤怒的顾客。

artist.example: The old baker was an artist with sugar and butter.  那位老面包师是驾驭糖与黄油的能手。

maven.example: The magazine hired a marketing maven to explain why the campaign had failed.  杂志请来一位营销专家解释这次宣传为何失败。

nonexpert.example: The guide explains the disease clearly for nonexpert readers.  这本指南为非专业读者清楚地解释了该疾病。

conscientious.example: A conscientious editor checks every fact before the article goes to print.  一丝不苟的编辑会在文章付印前核实每一个事实。

meticulous.example: The restorer's meticulous attention to detail saved the fragile manuscript from further damage.  修复师一丝不苟地关注细节，使这份脆弱的手稿免于进一步损坏。
meticulous.cn: 一丝不苟的，极为细致的

painstaking.cn: 煞费苦心的，一丝不苟的
painstaking.example: Years of painstaking research went into this single short article.  这篇短文背后是多年一丝不苟的研究。

scrupulous.example: Her scrupulous honesty made her the obvious choice to handle the accounts.  她一丝不苟的诚实使她成为管账的当然人选。

conscionable.example: No conscionable judge would enforce so one-sided a contract.  有良心的法官不会强制执行如此偏袒一方的合同。

ethical.example: Reporters must weigh ethical limits before publishing private letters.  记者发表私人信件前必须权衡道德界限。

honest.example: Give me an honest answer, even if it disappoints me.  给我一个诚实的答复，即使会让我失望。

moral.example: They felt a moral obligation to shelter the refugees.  他们觉得有道义上的义务收留难民。

upright.example: Neighbors described him as an upright and reliable man.  邻居们说他是个正直可靠的人。

principled.example: Her principled refusal cost her a promising position.  她基于原则的拒绝让她失去了一个有前途的职位。

unscrupulous.example: Unscrupulous lenders charged the farmers impossible rates of interest.  不择手段的放贷者向农民收取高得离谱的利息。

consensus.example: The board finally reached a consensus after four hours of debate.  董事会经过四小时辩论终于达成了一致。

agreement.example: The two firms signed an agreement to share research costs.  两家公司签署协议分担研究费用。

unanimity.example: There was surprising unanimity among the usually divided members.  在平时意见分歧的成员中出现了惊人的一致。

unison.example: The children answered in unison when the teacher asked.  老师提问时孩子们齐声回答。

disagreement.example: A long disagreement over funding stalled the whole project.  关于资金的长期分歧使整个项目停滞。

consequence.example: The full consequences of the new policy will not be clear for years.  这项新政策的全部后果多年内都不会明朗。

aftermath.example: Aid arrived slowly in the aftermath of the flood.  洪水过后援助迟迟才到。

effect.example: The new rule had little effect on daily traffic.  新规定对日常交通几乎没有影响。

outcome.example: Nobody could predict the outcome of such a close election.  没人能预测这样势均力敌的选举结果。

result.example: The delay resulted from a simple error in the schedule.  这次延误源于日程上的一个小错误。

moment.example: The treaty was an event of real moment for both nations.  这项条约对两国都是意义重大的事件。

magnitude.example: Few people grasped the magnitude of the coming economic crisis.  很少有人明白即将到来的经济危机的严重程度。

weight.example: Her opinion carries considerable weight with the committee.  她的意见在委员会里很有分量。

source.example: Engineers traced the leak to its source under the road.  工程师把漏水追查到路面下的源头。

origin.example: Scholars still argue about the origin of the strange name.  学者们仍在争论这个奇怪名字的来源。

cause.example: Heavy rain caused the small stream to flood the road.  大雨使这条小溪淹了公路。

triviality.example: The long meeting sank into arguments about pure trivialities.  漫长的会议陷入了对纯粹琐事的争论。

hidebound.example: The hidebound innkeeper flatly refused to install internet for guests.  这位死板的旅店老板断然拒绝为客人装网络。

reactionary.example: Critics called the new rules reactionary and openly unfair.  批评者称新规定保守倒退且明显不公。

die-hard.example: Only a few die-hard fans stayed until the final whistle.  只有几个死忠球迷留到终场哨响。

muted.example: The announcement drew a surprisingly muted response from investors.  这项公告得到投资者出奇平淡的反应。

repressed.example: Years of repressed anger finally showed in his shaking voice.  多年压抑的怒气终于在他颤抖的声音里显露。

low-key.example: They chose a low-key wedding with only twelve guests.  他们选了只有十二位客人的低调婚礼。

understated.example: Her understated gray suit suited the solemn occasion perfectly.  她那身低调的灰西装非常适合这个庄重的场合。

radical.example: The council rejected any radical change to the old charter.  议会否决了对旧章程的任何激进改动。

flamboyant.example: The singer wore a flamboyant coat covered in mirrors and feathers.  歌手穿着一件缀满镜片和羽毛的艳丽夺目的外套。

ostentatious.example: His ostentatious diamond watch drew stares from everyone in the modest room.  他炫耀的钻石表引来了朴素房间里所有人的注视。

splashy.example: The magazine ran a splashy cover story about the singer.  杂志刊出一篇关于那位歌手的招眼封面报道。

conservatory.example: He studied piano at a famous conservatory before joining the city orchestra.  他在一所著名的艺术学院学钢琴，之后加入了市交响乐团。

greenhouse.example: These orchids grow only in a heated greenhouse.  这些兰花只能在加温的温室里生长。

hothouse.example: The school became a hothouse for young mathematical talent.  这所学校成了培养年轻数学人才的温床。

consilience.example: The theory gains strength from the consilience of findings across several unrelated fields.  这一理论因多个不相关领域研究结果的融合而更有力。

considerable.example: The renovation required a considerable amount of money and nearly two years of work.  这次翻修耗费了可观的资金和近两年的工期。

extensive.example: The library holds an extensive collection of local newspapers.  这家图书馆藏有大量的地方报纸。

substantial.example: The company reported a substantial increase in profits this quarter.  公司报告本季度利润大幅增长。

large-scale.example: Large-scale planting began after the spring rains stopped.  春雨停后开始了大规模种植。

important.example: Sleep is as important as diet for a young athlete.  对年轻运动员来说，睡眠和饮食一样重要。

significant.example: Researchers found a significant drop in the pollution levels.  研究者发现污染水平显著下降。

consequential.example: That quiet vote proved the most consequential act of the session.  那次不起眼的投票成了本届会议最重要的举动。

momentous.example: The board reached a momentous decision that changed the company's direction entirely.  董事会做出了一个重大决定，彻底改变了公司的方向。

weighty.example: The elders debated weighty questions of land and water.  长者们讨论着土地与水源的重大问题。

distress.example: The sudden news distressed everyone in the small office.  突来的消息让小办公室里的每个人都很难受。

torment.example: Guilt tormented him for years after the accident.  事故之后，负罪感折磨了他多年。

torture.example: The long wait for results was pure torture for her.  漫长等待结果对她来说简直是折磨。

consolidate.example: The new king moved quickly to consolidate his hold over the northern provinces.  新国王迅速行动，巩固他对北方各省的控制。

undermine.example: Constant rumors undermined confidence in the young manager.  不断的谣言削弱了人们对这位年轻经理的信心。

weaken.example: Repeated flooding weakened the foundations of the stone bridge.  反复的洪水削弱了石桥的地基。

congruous.example: The plain wooden benches were congruous with the simple chapel.  素木长凳与这座朴素的礼拜堂很协调。

correspondent.example: His testimony was correspondent to the notes taken that night.  他的证词与那晚记下的笔记相符。

conflicting.example: Witnesses gave conflicting accounts of the driver's speed.  证人对司机车速的说法相互矛盾。

dissonant.example: A dissonant chord broke the calm mood of the piece.  一个不和谐的和弦打破了乐曲平静的气氛。
