discrepant.example: The two audits produced discrepant figures for the same quarter.  两次审计对同一季度得出不一致的数字。

inconsistent.example: His testimony was inconsistent with the facts established by the police.  他的证词与警方查明的事实不符。

noticeable.example: There was a noticeable pause before he answered the question.  他回答问题前有一个明显的停顿。

hidden.example: The contract contained hidden fees no one had mentioned.  合同里含有没人提过的隐藏费用。

concealed.example: A concealed door behind the shelves led to the cellar.  书架后一扇隐蔽的门通向地窖。

cogitate.example: He sat by the window and cogitated on his next move.  他坐在窗边，仔细思量下一步该怎么走。

nominate.example: The staff nominated her for the annual teaching award.  同事们提名她角逐年度教学奖。

designate.example: The council designated the whole valley a protected natural area.  议会将整个山谷指定为自然保护区。

authorize.example: Only the director can authorize spending above that limit.  只有主管能批准超出该限额的开支。

form.example: Six neighbors formed a committee to repair the shared path.  六位邻居组成委员会修理共用的小路。

imprison.example: The poet was imprisoned for three years without any trial.  这位诗人未经审判被监禁了三年。

release.example: The court ordered officials to release him from custody at once.  法庭命令官员立即将他从拘留中释放。

squeeze.example: She squeezed the tube until the last bit of paste came out.  她挤压软管直到最后一点膏体出来。

broaden.example: Travel abroad can broaden a young student's view of the world.  出国旅行能开阔年轻学生的世界观。

outstretch.example: The eagle outstretched its wings and glided over the valley.  雄鹰展开双翼，滑过山谷。

build.example: They plan to build a new library on the empty lot downtown.  他们计划在市中心的空地上建一座新图书馆。

make.example: My grandfather could make a wooden chair with only simple tools.  我祖父只用简单工具就能做出一把木椅。

produce.example: The factory can produce ten thousand units of steel every month.  这家工厂每月能生产一万单位钢材。

rear.example: She had to rear four children alone after her husband died.  丈夫去世后她只能独自养育四个孩子。

set up.example: They set up a small company in the garage two years ago.  两年前他们在车库里创办了一家小公司。

excogitate.example: The engineers excogitated a clever solution after weeks of failure.  几周失败后，工程师们苦心想出了一个巧妙的方案。

vamp up.example: The lazy writer simply vamped up an old story for the magazine.  这个懒作家只是把旧故事拼凑翻新给杂志。

demolish.example: The city decided to demolish the unsafe old building last spring.  去年春天市政府决定拆除这栋危旧建筑。

destroy.example: The fire destroyed nearly every document stored in the basement.  大火毁掉了地下室里几乎所有文件。

raze.example: The invading army razed the village and burned every field around it.  入侵军队将村庄彻底摧毁，并烧掉了周围所有田地。

consummate.example: She handled the hostile interview with the ease of a consummate diplomat.  她像老练的外交家一样从容应对了这场充满敌意的采访。

accomplished.example: She is an accomplished pianist who has toured three continents.  她是位技艺精湛的钢琴家，已在三大洲巡演。

finished.example: The young dancer already gives a remarkably finished performance.  这位年轻舞者的表演已经相当炉火纯青。

virtuosic.example: Critics praised his virtuosic violin playing throughout the long concerto.  评论家称赞他整首长协奏曲中超凡的小提琴演奏。

veteran.example: A veteran journalist, she has covered four wars and six elections.  作为资深记者，她报道过四场战争和六次选举。

flawless.example: Her flawless pronunciation surprised everyone in the language class.  她毫无瑕疵的发音令语言课上所有人惊讶。

impeccable.example: Her impeccable manners impressed even the most demanding guests.  她无可挑剔的举止让最挑剔的客人都印象深刻。

perfect.example: He spent years trying to perfect his technique on the cello.  他花了数年时间钻研以完善自己的大提琴技巧。

defective.example: The company recalled thousands of defective batteries after the accident.  事故后公司召回了数千个有缺陷的电池。

contagious.example: His laughter was so contagious that the whole room was soon giggling.  他的笑声太能唤起共鸣，整个房间很快都笑了起来。

infectious.example: Her infectious laughter soon had the whole room smiling.  她那富有感染力的笑声很快让全屋人都笑了。

pestilent.example: Settlers blamed the pestilent swamp air for the summer fevers.  移民把夏季的热病归咎于招致瘟疫的沼气。

transmissible.example: Researchers warned that the virus is highly transmissible through the air.  研究者警告该病毒极易通过空气传播。

epidemic.example: Health officials worked around the clock to control the epidemic.  卫生官员昼夜不停地工作以控制这场流行病。

catching.example: Stay home, because that kind of flu is very catching.  待在家里吧，那种流感很容易传染。

spreading.example: Doctors struggled to stop the spreading infection in the ward.  医生们努力阻止病房里蔓延的感染。

incommunicable.cn: 不可传染的；难以言表的
incommunicable.example: The doctor assured us the condition was entirely incommunicable.  医生向我们保证这种病完全不会传染。

infect.example: Careless handling can easily infect the wound with bacteria.  处理不当很容易使伤口感染细菌。

sanitize.example: Staff must sanitize every table before the next guests arrive.  员工必须在下批客人到来前给每张桌子消毒。

content.example: The teacher praised the style but questioned the content of my essay.  老师赞赏我文章的文风，却质疑其内容。

rejoice.example: The whole village rejoiced at the news of the safe return.  听到平安归来的消息，全村都欣喜不已。

intention.example: He announced his intention to resign at the end of the year.  他宣布了年底辞职的意图。

sense.example: In a broad sense, every artist borrows from earlier traditions.  广义上讲，每位艺术家都借鉴前人的传统。

significance.example: Scholars still debate the significance of these ancient carvings.  学者们仍在争论这些古代雕刻的含义。

contentious.example: Land ownership remains the most contentious issue in the peace negotiations.  土地所有权仍是和谈中最有争议的议题。

disputatious.example: The disputatious committee argued for hours without reaching any decision.  这个好争辩的委员会争了几小时也没有决定。

polemical.example: His polemical essay on education provoked replies from many teachers.  他那篇关于教育的论战文章引来许多教师回应。

belligerent.example: He answered the question in a belligerent tone that shocked us.  他用一种令我们震惊的好斗口气回答了这个问题。

bellicose.example: The general's bellicose rhetoric alarmed the neighboring countries.  这位将军的好战言辞令邻国警觉。

litigious.example: In such a litigious society, doctors buy expensive insurance.  在这样一个好打官司的社会里，医生都购买昂贵保险。

scrappy.example: A scrappy little dog guarded the yard and challenged every visitor.  一只爱打架的小狗看守院子，向每位来客叫阵。

dovish.example: The bank adopted a dovish policy and kept interest rates unusually low.  央行采取鸽派政策，把利率维持在异常低的水平。

peace-loving.example: They describe themselves as a peace-loving nation with no territorial claims.  他们自称是没有领土要求的爱好和平的国家。

contiguous.example: The farm consists of three contiguous fields separated only by low hedges.  这座农场由三块仅以矮树篱相隔的毗连田地组成。

adjacent.example: The hotel gave us two adjacent rooms on the fifth floor.  酒店给了我们五楼两间相邻的房间。

abutting.example: A tall fence separates our garden from the abutting property.  一道高栅栏把我们的花园与毗邻的地产隔开。

neighboring.example: Farmers from the neighboring village came to help with the harvest.  邻村的农民赶来帮着收割。

juxtaposed.example: The exhibition showed juxtaposed images of the city before and after the war.  展览展示了并置的战前战后城市图像。

verging.example: Their farmland lies at the park's eastern boundary, verging on protected forest.  他们的农田位于公园东界，紧邻受保护的森林。

contort.example: Pain contorted his face as the doctor examined the swollen ankle.  医生检查肿起的脚踝时，疼痛使他面容扭曲。

deform.example: Heat can deform the plastic casing within a few minutes.  高温几分钟内就能使塑料外壳变形。

distort.example: Editing the tape that way would distort the facts of the interview.  那样剪辑录音会歪曲采访的事实。

warp.example: A careless English translation had warped the author's original meaning.  一个粗心的英文译本曲解了作者的原意。

misshape.example: Careless packing had misshaped every hat in the box.  粗心的包装把箱里每顶帽子都弄变形了。

convention.example: Thousands of teachers attended the annual convention held in the capital.  数千名教师参加了在首都举行的年度大会。

treaty.example: The two nations finally signed a peace treaty after years of war.  两国经过多年战争终于签署了和平条约。

catch.example: You will catch a cold if you go out with wet hair.  你要是湿着头发出门就会感冒。

get.example: Half the office got the flu during that freezing week.  那个严寒的星期里办公室一半人得了流感。

sicken.example: Many of the sheep sickened after drinking from the polluted stream.  许多羊喝了污染的溪水后患病。

heal.example: The deep cut took nearly a month to heal completely.  那道深伤口花了近一个月才完全愈合。

reject.example: The committee voted to reject the proposal without further discussion.  委员会投票否决了该提案，不再讨论。

contrite.example: He looked genuinely contrite as he apologized for breaking the window.  他为打破窗户道歉时显得真心悔痛。

compunctious.example: He gave her a compunctious glance and quietly returned the money.  他内疚地看了她一眼，悄悄把钱还了。

regrettable.example: The manager called the delay a regrettable but unavoidable mistake.  经理称这次延误是令人遗憾但无法避免的错误。

remorseful.example: The young thief seemed genuinely remorseful in front of the judge.  这个年轻小偷在法官面前显得真心悔恨。

apologetic.example: She sent an apologetic note explaining why she had missed dinner.  她送来一张致歉的便条，解释为何缺席晚餐。

penitent.example: The penitent thief returned the money and apologized to the shopkeeper.  那个悔过的小偷退还了钱，并向店主道歉。

repentant.example: The thief looked genuinely repentant as he returned the money to its owner.  那名小偷把钱还给主人时显得真心悔过。

rueful.example: He admitted his error with a rueful smile and a shrug.  他带着懊悔的苦笑和一个耸肩承认了错误。

impenitent.example: The thief remained impenitent even after hearing the victims speak.  即便听了受害者的陈述，窃贼仍毫无悔意。

unrepentant.example: Even after the verdict he remained completely unrepentant about the fraud.  即使判决之后，他对这场欺诈仍毫无悔意。

restive.example: The audience became restive when the concert started forty minutes late.  音乐会迟了四十分钟才开始，观众变得焦躁不安。

untoward.example: Nothing untoward happened during the long flight across the ocean.  在这趟跨洋长途飞行中没有发生任何不幸的意外。
untoward.cn: 不幸的；难以驯服的，难以驾驭的

ruly.example: The new teacher was surprised to find such a ruly classroom.  新老师惊讶地发现这个教室如此守规矩。

conundrum.example: How to feed the city without more farmland is a real conundrum.  如何在不增加农田的情况下养活这座城市是个真正的难题。

enigma.example: His sudden disappearance that autumn remains an enigma to local historians.  他那年秋天的突然失踪对当地史学家来说仍是个谜。

mystery.example: Detectives worked for years before they solved the mystery.  侦探们工作数年才解开这个谜团。

puzzlement.example: A look of puzzlement crossed her face when she read the note.  读那张便条时，她脸上掠过困惑的表情。

riddle.example: The old man asked a riddle that nobody in the village could answer.  老人问了一个村里没人能答的谜语。

convalesce.example: She spent three quiet weeks convalescing at home after the surgery.  手术后她在家静养康复了三周。

recover.example: It took him two months to recover from the serious operation.  他花了两个月才从这场大手术中康复。

recoup.example: After the long march the soldiers rested to recoup their strength.  长途行军后，士兵们休息以恢复体力。

snap back.example: Young athletes usually snap back quickly after a minor injury.  年轻运动员在轻伤后通常恢复得很快。

cover.example: They tried to cover up the truth with a vague statement.  他们试图用含糊的声明掩盖真相。

screen.example: A thick screen of trees hid the old house from the road.  一道浓密的树木屏障把老屋从路上遮住了。

sham.example: The couple admitted their marriage was a sham arranged for the visa.  这对夫妻承认他们的婚姻是为签证安排的假婚姻。

suppress.example: The regime used the army to suppress a rebellion in the capital.  该政权动用军队镇压首都的叛乱。

veil.example: Polite words could not veil his true motives for long.  客气话没能长久掩饰他的真实动机。

divulge.example: No employee may divulge a secret learned during the merger negotiations.  任何员工都不得泄露在并购谈判中得知的秘密。

reveal.example: The company refused to reveal the details of the settlement.  公司拒绝透露和解的细节。

show.example: He rarely shows his feelings, even to close friends.  他很少表露感情，连对好友也如此。

uncloak.example: The journalist worked for months to uncloak the corruption scheme.  这位记者花了数月揭露这个腐败阴谋。

uncover.example: Inspectors uncovered evidence of fraud in the accounting records.  检查人员在账目中发现了欺诈的证据。

unveil.example: The company will unveil a new model at the spring show.  公司将在春季展会上发布新款。

custom.example: Removing your shoes indoors is an old custom in that country.  在那个国家，进屋脱鞋是古老的习俗。

ritual.example: Brewing coffee slowly is his cherished morning ritual.  慢慢煮咖啡是他珍视的晨间仪式。

manner.example: She answered every question in a calm and polite manner.  她以平静而礼貌的方式回答了每个问题。

assembly.example: The whole school gathered in the hall for the morning assembly.  全校师生在礼堂集合参加早会。

congress.example: Scientists from forty countries attended the international congress in Vienna.  来自四十国的科学家参加了维也纳的国际大会。

council.example: The city council voted to build a new park near the river.  市议会投票决定在河边建一座新公园。

gathering.example: Every autumn they hold a small family gathering in the orchard.  每年秋天他们在果园里举行小型家庭聚会。

deviation.example: Any deviation from the standard procedure must be reported immediately.  任何对标准流程的偏离都必须立即上报。

converge.example: All the main roads converge on the square in the center.  所有主干道都在中心广场交汇。

focus.example: The lens focuses sunlight into a single bright point.  透镜把阳光聚集成一个明亮的点。

deviate.example: The pilot had to deviate from the planned route because of storms.  因风暴，飞行员不得不偏离既定航线。

digress.example: The professor tended to digress from the topic whenever a student asked about history.  一有学生问到历史，教授就爱偏离主题。

convert.example: Engineers converted the abandoned warehouse into a bright public library.  工程师们把废弃的仓库改造成了明亮的公共图书馆。

alter.example: The architect had to alter the design after the budget was cut.  预算削减后建筑师不得不修改设计。

change.example: Nothing anyone said could change his mind about leaving.  谁说什么都无法改变他离开的主意。

transform.example: The new subway line transformed the quiet neighborhood within five years.  新地铁线五年内彻底改变了这个安静的街区。

transfigure.example: The rising sunlight transfigured the plain valley into a field of gold.  初升的阳光把平凡的山谷变成一片金色的原野。

consort.example: No respectable official would consort with smugglers so openly in public.  没有正派的官员会如此公开地与走私者结交。

company.example: His parents worried that he was keeping bad company at school.  他父母担心他在学校结交坏朋友。

consociate.example: The small firms consociated to bid for the huge contract.  这些小公司联合起来竞标这份大合同。

hook up.example: We hooked up with two other travelers on the mountain trail.  我们在山道上与另外两名旅行者结伴而行。

cagey.example: The manager was cagey about the reasons for her sudden resignation.  经理对她突然辞职的原因含糊其辞。

disinclined.example: After the argument she was disinclined to help him again.  争吵之后她不愿再帮他。

indisposed.example: The witness seemed indisposed to talk about that evening.  证人似乎不愿谈那晚的事。

reluctant.example: The witness seemed reluctant to answer any question about that evening.  证人似乎不愿回答关于那天晚上的任何问题。

reticent.example: He was oddly reticent about the years he spent working abroad.  他对自己在国外工作的那些年出奇地沉默不语。

disposed.example: The judge seemed disposed to grant a shorter sentence.  法官似乎倾向于判处较短刑期。

inclined.example: I am inclined to believe his version of the story.  我倾向于相信他讲的那个版本。

conviction.example: She argued her case with a conviction that silenced every critic.  她以坚定的信念陈述自己的主张，令所有批评者沉默。

assurance.example: She answered the difficult questions with surprising assurance.  她以惊人的自信回答了那些难题。

certainty.example: No one can predict the outcome with absolute certainty.  没人能绝对确定地预测结果。

certitude.example: He spoke of the plan's success with unshakable certitude.  他以不可动摇的确信谈起这项计划的成功。

sentence.example: The court gave him a five-year sentence for the robbery.  法院因抢劫判他五年刑期。

dubiety.example: A trace of dubiety showed in the professor's careful reply.  教授谨慎的回答中透出一丝怀疑。

incredulity.example: She listened to his excuse with obvious incredulity.  她带着明显的怀疑听他的借口。

acquittal.example: The defense lawyer won an acquittal after a three-week trial.  经过三周审判，辩护律师赢得了无罪判决。

convene.example: The board convened an emergency session to discuss the sudden resignation.  董事会召开紧急会议讨论这次突然辞职。

summon.example: The general summoned all his officers before launching the attack.  将军在发动进攻前召集了所有的军官。

complex.example: The paper presents a complex argument about ancient trade routes.  这篇论文提出了关于古代商路的复杂论证。

twisted.example: The novel's twisted plot keeps readers guessing until the last page.  这部小说曲折的情节让读者猜到最后一页。

convulsion.example: The revolution threw the entire country into political convulsions for a decade.  这场革命使整个国家陷入长达十年的政治动荡。

ferment.example: The whole country was in a state of ferment before the election.  大选前全国处于动荡之中。

upheaval.example: The war brought decades of social upheaval to the region.  战争给这一地区带来数十年的社会剧变。

tempest.example: His careless remark raised a tempest of protest online.  他随意的一句话在网上掀起抗议风暴。

uproar.example: The new tax plan caused an uproar among small business owners.  新税收方案在小企业主中引起轩然大波。

coop.example: The heavy rain cooped us up indoors for the whole weekend.  大雨把我们整个周末都困在室内。

box.example: Two trucks boxed our car in at the narrow intersection.  两辆卡车在狭窄路口把我们的车困住了。

cage.example: It seems cruel to cage such a strong wild bird.  把这样一只强健的野鸟关进笼子似乎很残忍。

corral.example: The cowboys corralled the horses before the storm arrived.  牛仔们在暴风雨到来前把马圈进围栏。

encage.example: The zoo no longer encages its larger animals in narrow pens.  动物园不再把大型动物关入狭窄的笼舍。

enclose.example: A stone wall encloses the garden on three sides.  一道石墙把花园三面围住。

envelop.example: Thick fog enveloped the valley before dawn.  黎明前浓雾笼罩了山谷。

immure.example: The scholar immured himself in the archives for the whole winter.  这位学者整个冬天都闭门待在档案馆里。

include.example: The price includes all the costs of shipping and insurance.  价格包含全部运费和保险费用。

pen.example: The farmer penned up the sheep for the cold night.  农民为寒夜把羊圈了起来。

free.example: Negotiators finally persuaded the gunmen to free the hostages.  谈判者最终说服枪手释放了人质。

liberate.example: Allied troops liberated the city in the spring of that year.  盟军在那年春天解放了这座城市。

copious.example: She took copious notes during every lecture and reread them each night.  她每堂课都记大量笔记，并在每晚重读。

plentiful.example: Rain came early, so the harvest was unusually plentiful.  雨来得早，所以收成异常丰富。

gushing.example: A gushing spring supplies the whole village with water.  一股喷涌的泉水供给全村用水。

sparse.example: Vegetation grows sparse as the trail climbs above the tree line.  小径爬上林线以上后，植被变得稀疏。

coquette.example: The young poet coquetted with several admirers but loved none of them.  那位年轻诗人与好几位追慕者调情，却谁也不爱。

trifle.example: Do not trifle with her feelings just to amuse yourself.  不要为了取乐而玩弄她的感情。

flirt.example: The waitress cheerfully flirted with every single man in the restaurant.  女服务员愉快地和餐厅里每个单身男子调情。

mess around.example: Stop messing around and finish your report before midnight.  别再闲混了，午夜前把报告写完。

countervail.example: Higher tariffs were imposed to countervail the subsidies given to foreign producers.  提高关税以抵消给予外国生产者的补贴。

compensate.example: Extra practice can compensate for a lack of natural talent.  额外的练习能弥补天赋的不足。

counterbalance.example: Higher wages counterbalance the long hours of this job.  较高的工资抵消了这份工作的长工时。

counterpoise.example: The senate was designed to counterpoise the power of the president.  参议院的设计意在抗衡总统的权力。

neutralize.example: A spoonful of baking soda will neutralize the acid spilled on the bench.  一勺小苏打就能中和溅在台面上的酸。

offset.example: New tax credits should offset the cost of the equipment.  新的税收抵扣应能抵消设备成本。

cornucopia.example: The market offered a cornucopia of fresh fruit at surprisingly low prices.  市场上有大量新鲜水果，价格低得惊人。

plentitude.example: The region enjoys a plentitude of water and fertile soil.  该地区拥有充足的水源和肥沃的土壤。

plethora.example: The menu offers a plethora of options that confuse first time visitors.  菜单提供过多的选项，让初次光顾的客人不知所选。

wealth.example: The old editor brought a wealth of experience to the team.  这位老编辑给团队带来了丰富的经验。

profusion.example: A profusion of wildflowers covered the hillside after the spring rains.  春雨过后，山坡上开满了大量野花。

affluence.example: The family had lived in quiet affluence for three generations.  这家人已在平静的富裕中生活了三代。

lack.example: The project stalled because of a serious lack of funds.  项目因严重缺乏资金而停滞。

pittance.example: The apprentices worked long hours for a pittance and no benefits.  学徒们长时间工作，只拿微薄津贴且没有福利。

deficiency.example: A serious iron deficiency left her tired and short of breath.  严重缺铁使她疲倦、气短。

coronation.example: Crowds lined the streets to watch the young queen's coronation procession.  人群沿街站立，观看年轻女王的加冕游行。

enthronement.example: Crowds filled the capital for the young king's enthronement.  人群涌入首都参加年轻国王的登基。

crowning.example: That discovery was the crowning achievement of her long career.  那项发现是她漫长职业生涯的最高成就。

abdication.example: The emperor's abdication shocked the whole court.  皇帝的退位震惊了整个朝廷。

bodily.example: The law protects citizens from any threat of bodily harm.  法律保护公民免受任何身体伤害的威胁。

physical.example: Police found no physical evidence linking him to the crime.  警方没有找到把他与罪案联系起来的实物证据。

tangible.example: Voters want tangible benefits, not vague promises about the future.  选民想要实实在在的好处，而不是对未来的空泛承诺。

intangible.example: A company's reputation is an intangible asset that no balance sheet captures.  公司声誉是一项资产负债表无法体现的无形资产。

disembodied.example: A disembodied voice announced the delay over the loudspeaker.  扬声器里传来一个不见其人的声音宣布延误。

authenticate.example: Experts were called in to authenticate the painting's signature.  专家被请来鉴定这幅画签名的真伪。

justify.example: Nothing in the report can justify his decision to conceal the results.  报告里没有任何内容能证明他隐瞒结果的决定是合理的。

controvert.example: New fossil data controvert the long-accepted theory of migration.  新的化石数据反驳了长期公认的迁徙理论。

corrosive.example: Salt water is highly corrosive and slowly eats through the ship's hull.  盐水腐蚀性很强，会慢慢蚀穿船体。

erosive.example: The erosive action of the river carved a deep canyon.  河水的侵蚀作用切出一道深峡谷。

tart.example: Her tart reply silenced everyone at the dinner table.  她尖刻的回答让餐桌上所有人都沉默了。

noncorrosive.example: Use a noncorrosive cleaner on the polished metal surface.  在抛光金属表面上使用无腐蚀性的清洁剂。

corrugated.example: The roof was made of cheap corrugated iron sheets.  屋顶是用便宜的瓦楞铁皮做的。

wrinkled.example: He arrived at the interview in a badly wrinkled shirt.  他穿着一件皱得厉害的衬衫来面试。

creased.example: She smoothed the creased photograph and placed it in the album.  她抚平那张有折痕的照片，放进相册。

folded.example: He pulled a folded map out of his back pocket.  他从后袋里抽出一张折叠的地图。

cosmopolitan.example: Years abroad gave her a cosmopolitan outlook her old classmates clearly lacked.  多年国外生活给了她老同学明显缺乏的世界性眼光。

universal.example: Music seems to have a universal appeal across all cultures.  音乐似乎在所有文化中都有普遍的感染力。

global.example: The pandemic reshaped the global economy in only two years.  疫情仅两年就重塑了全球经济。

worldwide.example: The film earned worldwide recognition after winning the festival prize.  这部影片获奖后赢得了世界性的声誉。

insular.example: His insular attitude toward foreign customs cost him many friendships abroad.  他对外国习俗的狭隘态度使他在国外失去了许多友谊。

provincial.example: His provincial tastes made him suspicious of anything foreign or unfamiliar.  他狭隘的品味使他对一切外来或陌生的事物都怀疑。

cosset.example: Grandparents tend to cosset the youngest child in the family.  祖父母往往宠爱家里最小的孩子。

caress.example: She caressed the child's hair until he fell asleep.  她轻抚孩子的头发，直到他睡着。

cuddle.example: The little girl cuddled the puppy on the sofa all evening.  小女孩整晚在沙发上抱着小狗。

dote.example: She dotes on her grandson and refuses him nothing.  她溺爱孙子，对他从不拒绝。

pet.example: Visitors are allowed to pet the rabbits at the farm.  参观者可以在农场抚摸兔子。

mollycoddle.example: Some parents mollycoddle their children and leave them unprepared for real difficulties.  有些父母溺爱孩子，让他们无法应对真正的困难。

coddle.example: Coaches should not coddle athletes who refuse to train hard.  教练不该娇养那些不肯苦练的运动员。

stand.example: I cannot stand the noise from the construction site next door.  我受不了隔壁工地的噪音。

wear.example: The manager would not wear such a feeble excuse again.  经理不会再容忍这种苍白的借口。

disapprove.example: Her parents strongly disapprove of the plan to drop out.  她父母强烈不赞成退学的计划。

frown.example: Most universities frown on students sharing their assignments.  大多数大学不赞成学生互相分享作业。

forged.example: The bank noticed a forged signature on the withdrawal slip.  银行发现取款单上有伪造的签名。

pseudo.example: The book dresses up old superstitions as pseudo science.  这本书把旧迷信包装成伪科学。

artificial.example: The lobby was decorated with artificial flowers that never wilted.  大厅用永不枯萎的人造花装饰。

copy.example: The painting on the wall is only a cheap copy.  墙上那幅画只是廉价的仿制品。

forge.example: He was arrested for forging a passport and two visas.  他因伪造一本护照和两个签证而被捕。

simulate.example: The training program can simulate battle conditions inside a quiet classroom.  该训练项目能在安静的教室里模拟作战环境。

mimic.example: Certain parrots can mimic human speech well enough to fool a casual listener.  某些鹦鹉能模仿人类说话，足以骗过不留意的听者。

countermand.example: The general countermanded the order before the troops reached the river.  将军在部队抵达河边之前撤销了那道命令。

revoke.example: The court revoked his driving license after the second offense.  法院在他第二次违法后吊销了他的驾照。

court.example: The candidate spent the summer courting voters in small rural towns.  这位候选人整个夏天都在乡村小镇讨好选民。

woo.example: He wooed her with flowers and long handwritten letters.  他用鲜花和长长的手写信追求她。

pursue.example: She pursued him for months before he finally agreed to dinner.  她追了他好几个月，他才终于答应共进晚餐。

invite.example: His careless remarks invited criticism from nearly every member present.  他轻率的言论招致了几乎所有在场成员的批评。

snub.example: She deliberately snubbed her colleague by ignoring him at the meeting.  她在会上故意不理睬同事，冷落了他。

cloistered.example: He led a cloistered life among books, rarely meeting strangers.  他在书堆中过着与世隔绝的生活，很少见陌生人。

sheltered.example: She grew up sheltered and knew little of the world outside.  她在呵护中长大，对外面的世界几乎一无所知。

covetous.example: He cast a covetous eye on his neighbor's newly bought tractor.  他贪婪地盯着邻居新买的拖拉机。

acquisitive.example: The acquisitive collector bought every painting that came onto the market.  这位贪得无厌的收藏家买下了市面上出现的每一幅画。

avaricious.example: The avaricious banker cared for nothing but the size of his bonus.  这个贪财的银行家只在乎奖金的多少。

rapacious.example: Rapacious business practices drove several small competitors out of the market.  贪婪的商业行径把几家小竞争者挤出了市场。

grasping.example: His grasping relatives fought over the estate before the funeral ended.  他贪婪的亲戚在葬礼结束前就争夺遗产。

easily-satiated.example: Unlike his greedy brother, he was easily satiated and asked for little.  与贪心的哥哥不同，他很容易满足，要求很少。

inspirit.example: Her speech inspirited the exhausted volunteers to keep working through the night.  她的演讲鼓舞疲惫的志愿者继续通宵工作。

cowardice.example: Refusing to speak up for a friend struck him later as cowardice.  没有为朋友说话，事后他觉得那是怯懦。

cravenness.example: His cravenness under fire shocked the men who once admired him.  他在炮火下的懦弱令曾敬佩他的人震惊。

dastardliness.example: The dastardliness of the ambush disgusted even their own allies.  这次伏击的卑劣连他们自己的盟友都感到恶心。

gutlessness.example: Voters punished the senator for his gutlessness on the crucial vote.  选民因参议员在关键投票上的懦弱而惩罚了他。

poltroonery.example: The general denounced such poltroonery before the whole assembled regiment.  将军在全团面前谴责这种怯懦。

pusillanimity.example: Their pusillanimity allowed the aggressor to seize the border towns unopposed.  他们的懦弱使侵略者不受阻碍地占领了边境城镇。

spinelessness.example: His spinelessness in meetings meant unfair decisions were never challenged.  他在会上没骨气，导致不公的决定从未被质疑。

courage.example: It took real courage to admit the mistake in front of everyone.  在众人面前承认错误需要真正的勇气。

guts.example: She had the guts to quit and start her own company.  她有胆量辞职创办自己的公司。

pluck.example: It took real pluck to speak up against the whole committee.  敢于当众反对整个委员会需要真正的勇气。

intrepidness.example: The climber's intrepidness carried her to the summit despite the storm.  这位登山者的无畏让她在暴风中登上顶峰。

stoutness.example: The villagers praised his stoutness during the long, hopeless siege.  村民赞扬他在漫长绝望的围城中的刚毅。

valiance.example: Medals were given for valiance shown during the night attack.  奖章授予在夜袭中表现英勇的人。

valor.example: He received a medal for valor after rescuing two trapped miners.  他救出两名被困矿工后获得英勇勋章。

fawn.example: Junior staff fawn on the boss whenever the director visits.  每当董事来访，下级员工就对老板阿谀奉承。

flinch.example: He never flinched from telling his patients the difficult truth.  他从不回避向病人讲述艰难的真相。

grovel.example: He refused to grovel before the committee just to keep his post.  他拒绝为了保住职位而在委员会面前卑躬屈膝。

quail.example: Even veteran soldiers quail at the thought of another winter campaign.  连老兵一想到又一场冬季战役也会畏缩。

recoil.example: She recoiled in horror when the lamp revealed the broken door.  灯光照出被砸坏的门时，她惊恐地退缩了。

wince.example: She winced as the nurse cleaned the deep cut on her arm.  护士清洗她手臂上的深口子时，她疼得直畏缩。

bamboozle.example: The salesman bamboozled them into buying a worthless extended warranty.  推销员骗他们买了毫无价值的延保。

cheat.example: He cheated the old couple out of their entire life savings.  他骗走了这对老夫妇一生的积蓄。

take in.example: Don't be taken in by his charming manner and generous promises.  别被他迷人的举止和大方的承诺骗了。

confined.example: Working in such a confined space made the repair extremely difficult.  在如此狭小的空间作业使维修极为困难。

restrained.example: His restrained reply hid how angry he actually felt inside.  他克制的回答掩盖了他内心真正的愤怒。

crass.example: His crass joke silenced the entire table at dinner.  他粗俗的玩笑让整桌人都沉默了。

coarse.example: The workers used coarse language that shocked the visiting students.  工人们说的粗话让来访的学生们大吃一惊。

crude.cn: 粗糙的，未加工的；粗俗的
crude.example: The furniture was crude but surprisingly sturdy and very cheap.  这家具做得粗糙，却意外结实又便宜。

rude.example: It was rude of him to leave without thanking the host.  他不谢主人就离开，很没礼貌。

incult.example: The travelers found the mountain villages poor and their manners incult.  旅行者发现山村贫穷，村民举止粗野。

vulgar.example: Their vulgar display of wealth embarrassed even their closest friends.  他们粗俗的炫富让连最亲近的朋友都感到难堪。

civilized.example: They settled the dispute in a calm, civilized manner over tea.  他们喝茶时以平静文明的方式解决了争端。

urbane.example: Our urbane host guided the conversation with easy wit and grace.  我们文雅的主人以轻松的机智和风度引导着谈话。

genteel.example: Her genteel accent betrayed an expensive and very traditional upbringing.  她文雅的口音透露出昂贵而传统的成长背景。

crave.example: After weeks in the desert, they craved nothing but cold clean water.  在沙漠里待了几周后，他们只渴望干净的凉水。

need.example: Plants need sunlight and water to grow properly indoors.  室内植物需要阳光和水才能正常生长。

yearn.example: After years abroad he yearned for the food of his childhood.  在国外多年后，他渴望儿时的食物。

desire.example: She desired nothing more than a quiet evening at home.  她只想在家过一个安静的夜晚。

pine.example: After a year abroad he began to pine for the food of home.  在国外一年后，他开始渴望家乡的食物。

thirst.example: He thirsted for recognition far more than for money.  他对认可的渴望远超对金钱的渴望。

itch.example: The children were itching to open their presents early.  孩子们急着想早点拆礼物。

long.example: After months at sea he longed for his family's cooking.  在海上数月后，他渴望家人做的饭菜。

yen.example: She had a sudden yen for spicy noodles at midnight.  她半夜突然特别想吃辣面。

craven.example: His craven silence during the trial disappointed everyone who had trusted him.  他在庭审中懦弱的沉默让所有信任过他的人失望。

cowardly.example: It was cowardly to blame the mistake on his assistant.  把错误推给助手是怯懦的行为。

gutless.example: The team looked gutless in the second half of the match.  球队下半场表现得毫无斗志。

pusillanimous.example: Critics called the government's pusillanimous silence a betrayal of victims.  批评者称政府懦弱的沉默是对受害者的背叛。

spineless.example: He was too spineless to stand up to his own manager.  他太没骨气，不敢反抗自己的经理。

dauntless.example: The dauntless nurse worked through shelling to reach the wounded.  这位无畏的护士在炮击中赶去救伤员。

fearless.example: She was fearless in questioning the most powerful men present.  她敢于质问在场最有权势的人。

gallant.example: The gallant paratroopers jumped from the plane without a moment's hesitation.  英勇的伞兵们毫不犹豫地跳出了飞机。

gutsy.example: It was a gutsy move to bet everything on one project.  把一切押在一个项目上是很有勇气的举动。

intrepid.example: The intrepid explorer crossed the frozen strait alone in the middle of winter.  这位大胆的探险家在隆冬时节独自穿越了结冰的海峡。

stalwart.example: She remained a stalwart supporter of the project through every setback.  历经挫折，她始终是这个项目的坚定支持者。

stout.example: The townspeople put up a stout defense against the raiders.  镇民对袭击者进行了顽强的抵抗。

stouthearted.example: A handful of stouthearted defenders held the bridge until dawn.  少数勇敢的守卫者守住桥梁直到黎明。

valiant.example: A valiant firefighter carried two children out of the burning building.  一位英勇的消防员把两个孩子抱出了燃烧的大楼。

valorous.example: Songs still honor the valorous soldiers who held the bridge.  歌曲仍在颂扬守住那座桥的英勇士兵。

contingency.example: A good manager prepares for every contingency, however unlikely it may seem.  好的管理者会为每一种可能发生的事做准备，无论看来多不可能。

case.example: In every case we studied, the same pattern appeared again.  在我们研究的每个案例中，同样的模式都再次出现。

contingent.example: The bonus is contingent on the company meeting its yearly targets.  奖金取决于公司是否达成年度目标。

eventuality.example: Good managers plan for every eventuality, however unlikely it seems.  优秀的管理者会为各种可能做好准备，无论看来多不可能。

possibility.example: We cannot ignore the possibility of another storm this week.  我们不能忽视本周再来一场风暴的可能。

credence.example: Recent excavations lend credence to the old story of a buried city.  近期的挖掘使那个关于地下古城的传说变得可信。

belief.example: Her belief in the project never wavered, even after the setbacks.  即使遭遇挫折，她对项目的信念也从未动摇。

faith.example: They kept faith in their coach through a terrible season.  在糟糕的赛季里他们始终信任教练。

trust.example: It takes years to build trust and one lie to lose it.  建立信任要数年，一句谎言就足以失去。

reliance.example: The village's reliance on a single crop made it very vulnerable.  村子对单一作物的依赖使其非常脆弱。

doubt.example: There is little doubt that the data was carelessly recorded.  几乎可以肯定，这些数据记录得很草率。

skepticism.example: Scientists greeted the claim with polite but obvious skepticism.  科学家对该说法表现出礼貌却明显的怀疑。

credulous.example: The advertisement was designed to fool credulous shoppers with fake reviews.  这则广告用虚假评论来欺骗轻信的购物者。

believing.example: The believing crowd accepted every word of the sermon without question.  轻信的人群不加质疑地接受了布道中的每一句话。

gullible.example: Scammers target gullible people with promises of quick, easy riches.  骗子用快速致富的承诺瞄准易受骗的人。

naive.example: It was naive to expect honesty from someone with that record.  指望有那种记录的人诚实太天真了。

unsuspecting.example: The thief followed an unsuspecting tourist down the crowded alley.  小偷跟着一位毫无察觉的游客走进拥挤的小巷。

disbelieving.example: She gave him a disbelieving look and asked for proof.  她怀疑地看了他一眼，要他给出证据。

skeptical.example: Voters remain skeptical about promises made just before an election.  选民对选前才作出的承诺仍持怀疑态度。

caterwaul.example: Two stray cats caterwauled outside my window most of the night.  两只流浪猫在我窗外嚎叫了大半夜。

yowl.example: A stray cat yowled outside our window until dawn.  一只流浪猫在我们窗外嚎叫到天亮。

shriek.example: The children shrieked as the roller coaster plunged downward.  过山车俯冲时孩子们尖叫起来。

howl.example: Wolves howled somewhere beyond the frozen ridge that night.  那晚狼在冰封山脊外某处长嚎。

scream.example: She screamed for help when the water reached her knees.  水淹到膝盖时她尖声呼救。

shrill.example: A shrill alarm woke everyone in the building at midnight.  刺耳的警报半夜惊醒了楼里所有人。

yelp.example: The puppy yelped when someone stepped on its tail.  有人踩到尾巴时小狗尖叫了一声。

ofothermen.example: He rarely troubled himself with the affairs of other men.  他很少去操心他人的事务。

livinganddead.example: The old chronicle lists all the villagers, both living and dead.  这本旧编年史列出全村的生者与死者。

andthatimustexertmyselfinordertogivein.ipa: ənd ðæt aɪ mʌst ɪɡˈzɜrt maɪˈsɛlf ɪn ˈɔrdər tə ɡɪv ˈɪn
andthatimustexertmyselfinordertogivein.cn: 而我必须努力才能让步
andthatimustexertmyselfinordertogivein.example: The Andthat-i-must line runs together several words from the original quotation.  Andthat-i-must 这一行把原句里的好几个词粘在了一起。

creep.example: Traffic crept forward only a few meters at a time all morning.  整个上午车流每次只缓慢前进几米。

loiter.example: Teenagers loitered outside the shop until the owner finally complained.  少年们在店外闲荡，直到店主终于抱怨。

tarry.example: Do not tarry here; the last train leaves in minutes.  别在这儿磨蹭，末班车几分钟后就开。

scurry.example: Mice scurried across the floor when the light came on.  灯一亮，老鼠们急匆匆跑过地板。

run.example: He ran three miles before breakfast every single morning.  他每天早餐前都跑三英里。

crescendo.example: Complaints about the choking smoke rose to a deafening crescendo.  对令人窒息的烟雾的抱怨达到了震耳欲聋的顶点。

apex.example: At the apex of her fame she suddenly left the stage.  在名声的顶峰，她突然离开了舞台。

apogee.example: The empire reached its apogee under this remarkably able emperor.  这个帝国在这位极有才干的皇帝治下达到极盛。

climax.example: The film builds slowly toward a violent and unexpected climax.  影片缓慢推向一个暴烈而意外的高潮。

crest.example: The surfers waited patiently for the crest of the next big wave.  冲浪者们耐心等待下一个大浪的浪尖。

peak.example: Sales peaked in December and then fell sharply in January.  销售在十二月达到顶峰，一月急剧下滑。

summit.example: The climbers reached the summit just before the storm closed in.  登山者在风暴逼近前登上顶峰。

zenith.example: The empire stood at the zenith of its power around that year.  大约在那一年，这个帝国正处于国力的巅峰。

crestfallen.example: He came home crestfallen after losing the final match by one point.  决赛以一分之差落败后，他垂头丧气地回了家。

downcast.example: He came home downcast after failing the driving test again.  他又一次没通过驾照考试，沮丧地回到家。

dispirited.example: The dispirited workers returned to a factory nobody expected to survive.  气馁的工人回到一家谁都不看好的工厂。

low.example: She has been feeling low since her closest friend moved away.  自从最好的朋友搬走，她一直情绪低落。

melancholic.example: The melancholic music suited the grey afternoon outside perfectly.  这忧郁的音乐与窗外灰暗的午后十分相配。

sorrowful.example: Her sorrowful eyes told us the news before she spoke.  她悲伤的眼睛在她开口前就告诉了我们消息。

woeful.example: The team's woeful defending cost them the championship again.  球队糟糕的防守又一次让他们丢了冠军。

elated.example: She was elated when the university finally accepted her application.  大学终于录取她时，她欣喜若狂。

excited.example: The children were too excited to sleep before the trip.  孩子们太兴奋了，旅行前根本睡不着。

exhilarated.example: They felt exhilarated after skiing down the long open slope.  滑下那条长长的开阔雪道后，他们感到无比振奋。

exultant.example: Exultant fans filled the streets after the unexpected victory.  意外获胜后，欢腾的球迷挤满了街道。

cronyism.example: The mayor resigned amid loud accusations of cronyism in awarding city contracts.  市长在授予市政合同任人唯亲的强烈指控中辞职。

favoritism.example: Promoting his own nephew looked like blatant favoritism to everyone.  提拔自己的外甥在所有人看来都是明显的偏袒。

crook.example: She crooked her finger to call the waiter across the room.  她弯起手指，招呼房间另一头的服务员。

arch.example: The cat arched its back and hissed at the dog.  猫弓起背，对着狗嘶叫。

bow.example: The old branches bowed under the weight of wet snow.  老树枝在湿雪的重压下弯了下去。

curve.example: The road curves sharply just beyond the stone bridge.  过了石桥不远，道路急剧弯曲。

swerve.example: The driver swerved sharply to avoid a dog crossing the road.  司机猛地转向，避开横穿马路的狗。

straighten.example: He straightened the bent nail carefully with a small hammer.  他用小锤子小心地把弯钉子弄直。

unbend.example: She unbent the wire and used it to pick the lock.  她把铁丝弄直，用它撬开了锁。

uncurl.example: The fern slowly uncurled its new leaves in the spring sunshine.  蕨类在春日阳光下缓缓展开新叶。

croon.example: The mother crooned an old lullaby until the baby fell asleep.  母亲低声哼着一首老摇篮曲，直到婴儿睡去。

shout.example: Please don't shout; I can hear you perfectly well.  请别喊，我听得很清楚。

yell.example: He yelled a warning just before the branch fell down.  就在树枝落下前他大声警告了一声。

culminate.example: Years of quiet training culminated in an Olympic gold medal.  多年默默的训练最终以一枚奥运金牌告终。

crown.example: The prize crowned a long career of quiet, patient research.  这个奖为漫长而耐心的研究生涯锦上添花。

crucial.example: The next two weeks will be crucial to the project's survival.  接下来两周对这个项目的存亡至关重要。

critical.example: Water supply is critical to the survival of this town.  供水对这座小镇的存续至关重要。

key.example: Trust is the key element in any long working relationship.  信任是任何长期工作关系中的关键要素。

pivotal.example: Her testimony played a pivotal role in the outcome of the trial.  她的证词对审判结果起了关键作用。

crumple.example: He crumpled the rejection letter and threw it into the bin.  他把那封拒信揉皱，扔进了垃圾桶。

rumple.example: His aunt always rumpled the little boy's hair when she visited.  他姨妈每次来都会揉乱小男孩的头发。

crimple.example: Careless packing crimpled the silk dress beyond any repair.  草率的打包把这条丝绸裙弄皱得没法补救。

crease.example: Sitting all day had creased his new linen jacket badly.  坐了一整天，他的新麻布外套皱得很厉害。

fold.example: She folded the letter twice and slipped it into her pocket.  她把信折了两次，塞进口袋。

wrinkle.example: The shirt wrinkles easily unless you hang it up immediately.  这件衬衫不马上挂起来就容易起皱。

crutch.example: Humor became a crutch he leaned on whenever conversations turned serious.  每当谈话变得严肃，幽默就成了他依靠的支柱。

column.example: Two marble columns still support the roof of the ruined temple.  两根大理石柱仍支撑着这座残破神庙的屋顶。

stay.example: The tent's stays snapped in the wind and everything collapsed.  帐篷的支索在风中断裂，一切都塌了。

underpinning.example: Cheap credit was the underpinning of the whole housing boom.  廉价信贷是整场房产热的支撑。

underpropping.example: Timber underpropping kept the damaged wall standing through the winter.  木质支撑让受损的墙撑过了整个冬天。

crux.example: The crux of the dispute is who actually owns the water rights.  争端的关键是水权究竟归谁所有。

core.example: At the core of the dispute lies a simple money question.  争端的核心是一个简单的金钱问题。

substance.example: The substance of her complaint was that nobody had asked her.  她抱怨的实质是没人问过她。

kernel.example: There is a kernel of truth in this otherwise absurd rumor.  这个荒唐的谣言里有一点真实的核心。

gist.example: She summarized the gist of the long report in only three sentences.  她只用三句话就概括了那份长报告的要点。

pivot.example: Trade was the pivot on which the whole treaty turned.  贸易是整个条约的关键所在。

cryptic.example: His cryptic note gave us no hint about where he had gone.  他那张费解的便条没有透露他去了哪里。

enigmatic.example: Her enigmatic answer left the reporters guessing for several days.  她神秘的回答让记者们猜了好几天。

impenetrable.example: The contract was written in impenetrable jargon that confused everyone.  合同用晦涩难懂的行话写成，让所有人都困惑。

mystic.example: The old poem describes a mystic union with the natural world.  这首古诗描写了与自然界的神秘合一。

uncanny.example: The twins share an uncanny ability to finish each other's sentences.  这对双胞胎有一种离奇的本事，能接上对方的话。

comprehensible.example: Good teachers make difficult ideas comprehensible to complete beginners.  好老师能让初学者也理解艰深的概念。

understandable.example: His anger was understandable given how badly he was treated.  考虑到他受到的糟糕对待，他的愤怒可以理解。

culpable.example: The report found two managers culpable for the safety failures.  报告认定两位经理对安全事故负有过失。

blameworthy.example: Both drivers were blameworthy, though only one was actually fined.  两位司机都该受责备，但只有一人被罚款。

censurable.example: The committee called his handling of the funds clearly censurable.  委员会称他对资金的处理明显应受谴责。

guilty.example: He felt guilty about forgetting his mother's birthday again.  他又忘了母亲的生日，心里很内疚。

reprehensible.example: Lying to the families was reprehensible and utterly unnecessary.  对那些家庭撒谎既可鄙又完全没有必要。

sinful.example: The preacher called greed the most sinful habit of our age.  牧师称贪婪是我们这个时代最罪恶的习性。

reproachable.example: Nothing in her long record seemed reproachable to the inspectors.  在检查人员看来，她的长期记录中没有可责之处。

inculpable.example: The court declared the young driver inculpable in the accident.  法庭宣布这位年轻司机在事故中无过错。

cultivate.example: She cultivated a wide network of contacts during her years abroad.  她在国外的岁月里培养了广泛的人际关系网。

educate.example: The campaign educated farmers about safer ways to store grain.  这项活动教育农民如何更安全地储存粮食。

instruct.example: She instructed the class in basic first aid last week.  上周她教这个班基本的急救知识。

nurse.example: He nursed the small business through three very difficult years.  他呵护这家小企业度过了三个极艰难的年头。

grow.example: They grow tomatoes and beans on a small rooftop garden.  他们在小小的屋顶花园里种番茄和豆子。

develop.example: She developed a habit of reading for an hour each night.  她养成了每晚阅读一小时的习惯。

cumbersome.example: The old permit system was so cumbersome that few farmers bothered applying.  旧的许可制度太繁琐，很少有农民愿意申请。

ponderous.example: Ponderous machinery filled the workshop and shook the floor all day.  笨重的机器占满车间，整天震动地板。

heavy.example: The box was so heavy that two men could barely move it.  这箱子太重，两个人几乎搬不动。

unwieldy.example: The old camera was unwieldy but produced remarkably sharp pictures.  这台老相机笨重，却能拍出异常清晰的照片。

thorny.example: The council postponed a thorny problem about school funding again.  议会又一次推迟了学校经费这个棘手问题。

weightless.example: Astronauts float weightless while the station circles the earth.  空间站绕地飞行时，航天员在失重中漂浮。

cunning.example: The fox was cunning enough to avoid every trap they set.  这只狐狸够狡猾，避开了他们设的每个陷阱。

crafty.example: A crafty lawyer found a loophole nobody else had noticed.  一位狡猾的律师找到了别人都没注意的漏洞。

devious.example: He used devious means to obtain a copy of the secret contract.  他用狡猾的手段弄到了那份秘密合同的副本。

foxy.example: The foxy old trader always knew when to sell everything.  这位狡猾的老商人总知道何时全部卖出。

sly.example: A sly grin spread across his face as he hid the letter.  他藏起那封信时，脸上露出狡黠的笑。

tricky.example: Parking here is tricky, especially during the busy evening hours.  这里停车很棘手，尤其在傍晚的繁忙时段。

wily.example: A wily negotiator, he never revealed his lowest acceptable price.  作为狡猾的谈判者，他从不透露自己能接受的最低价。

unsophisticated.example: Unsophisticated investors are often the first to lose their money.  不老练的投资者往往最先赔钱。

curmudgeon.example: The old curmudgeon next door complains about every child on the street.  隔壁那个爱抱怨的老怪人对街上每个孩子都有意见。

crosspatch.cn: 脾气坏的人，爱生气的人
crosspatch.example: The neighbors called him a crosspatch who complained about everything.  邻居说他是个什么都要抱怨的坏脾气鬼。

fusser.example: Her uncle was a fusser who rearranged every dish on the table.  她叔叔是个挑剔鬼，把桌上每道菜都重摆一遍。

griper.example: Every office has one griper who is never satisfied.  每个办公室都有一个从不满足的抱怨鬼。

grouser.example: The old grouser muttered about the weather all afternoon long.  这位爱发牢骚的老人整个下午都在嘟囔天气。

growler.example: Our coach is a growler, but he genuinely cares about us.  我们教练爱吼人，但他真心关心我们。

grumbler.example: The grumbler in the corner criticized every dish he was served.  角落里那个抱怨鬼把上的每道菜都批评一通。

whiner.example: Nobody wants a whiner on a team facing this much pressure.  没人愿意在压力这么大的队里有个爱抱怨的人。

agreeable person.example: Her father was an agreeable person whom everyone enjoyed visiting.  她父亲是个和气的人，人人都乐意去看他。

cursory.example: A cursory inspection missed the cracks running along the bridge supports.  一次匆忙的检查漏掉了桥墩上的裂缝。

headlong.example: Their headlong rush to publish left several errors in the final report.  他们急于发表的草率做法使最终报告留下了几处错误。

overhasty.example: Their overhasty decision to expand nearly ruined the young company.  他们草率的扩张决定几乎毁了这家年轻公司。

pell-mell.example: The crowd rushed pell-mell toward the only open exit.  人群慌乱地涌向唯一开着的出口。

precipitate.example: His precipitate resignation surprised colleagues who expected a much longer transition.  他匆忙的辞职让原以为过渡期会长得多的同事大吃一惊。

precipitous.example: The path became precipitous near the summit, forcing us to use ropes.  靠近峰顶时山路变得非常陡峭，迫使我们用上绳索。

fastidious.example: She is fastidious about details and rereads every line twice.  她对细节极为挑剔，每一行都要读两遍。

unhurried.example: He works in an unhurried way but never misses a deadline.  他做事从容，却从不误期。

unrushed.example: We enjoyed a long, unrushed breakfast on the quiet terrace.  我们在安静的露台上享受了一顿悠长从容的早餐。

unceremonious.example: His unceremonious exit surprised the guests still waiting for dessert.  他唐突离场，让还等着甜点的客人吃了一惊。

mealymouthed.example: Voters were tired of mealymouthed answers about the missing money.  选民厌倦了关于失踪款项含糊其辞的回答。

cynic.example: Only a hardened cynic could doubt the sincerity of her apology.  只有顽固的愤世者才会怀疑她道歉的诚意。

misanthrope.example: The old misanthrope lived alone and refused every friendly invitation.  这位厌世的老人独居，拒绝一切友好的邀请。

naysayer.example: The naysayers insisted the bridge could never be built here.  唱反调的人坚持说这里绝不可能建桥。

pessimist.example: Even the pessimists admitted that the harvest looked unusually good.  连悲观者也承认收成看起来格外好。

dabble.example: He dabbled in photography for a year and then lost all interest.  他涉猎摄影一年，之后就完全失去了兴趣。

dedicate.example: She dedicated twenty years to studying a single kind of beetle.  她用二十年只研究一种甲虫。

specialize.example: He specializes in restoring clocks made before the last century.  他专门修复上世纪之前制造的钟表。

specialist.example: Her doctor sent her to a specialist in rare blood diseases.  医生把她转诊给罕见血液病专家。

daft.example: Selling the only truck in winter was a truly daft decision.  在冬天卖掉唯一的卡车实在是个愚蠢的决定。

fatuous.example: His fatuous comment showed he had not read the report.  他愚蠢的评论说明他没读过那份报告。

featherheaded.example: Only a featherheaded manager would sign such a vague contract.  只有轻浮愚笨的经理才会签这么含糊的合同。

senseless.example: Cutting the safety budget now would be completely senseless.  现在削减安全预算完全是愚蠢之举。

judicious.example: A judicious use of savings carried the family through two difficult years.  明智地使用积蓄让这家人度过了两个艰难的年头。

sagacious.example: His sagacious advice saved the family business from certain ruin.  他睿智的建议救家族生意于必败之境。

sapient.example: A few sapient remarks from the editor saved the entire chapter.  编辑几句有洞察力的话救了整整一章。

wise.example: It was wise of her to save money before quitting the job.  她辞职前先存钱，很明智。

dazzling.example: The dancers wore dazzling costumes that glittered under the stage lights.  舞者们穿着在舞台灯光下闪耀的炫目服装。

beaming.cn: 光芒四射的；笑容满面的
beaming.example: She greeted us with a beaming smile at the airport gate.  她在机场门口用灿烂的笑容迎接我们。

candescent.example: The candescent iron glowed orange as the smith hammered it.  铁匠敲打时，白热的铁块发出橙光。

effulgent.example: An effulgent sunrise turned the snow on the eastern ridges pale gold.  灿烂的日出把东侧山脊上的积雪染成浅金色。

glowing.example: Glowing coals gave the little room a warm orange light.  发光的炭火给小屋带来温暖的橙色光线。

incandescent.example: The incandescent filament burned out after only a few weeks.  白炽灯丝仅用几周就烧断了。

luminous.example: The luminous dial of his watch glowed faintly in the dark.  他手表的夜光表盘在黑暗中微微发亮。

refulgent.example: Refulgent golden domes rose above the rooftops of the old city.  灿烂的金色圆顶耸立在老城的屋顶之上。

shining.example: Her shining eyes showed how much the praise meant to her.  她发亮的眼睛显示出这份赞扬对她多重要。

dim.example: The room was too dim for reading anything but large print.  房间太暗，只能看大字。

lackluster.example: Her lackluster hair and tired face worried everyone at home.  她黯淡的头发和疲惫的脸让家人都担心。

unbright.example: The unbright winter sky made the whole town look grey.  暗淡的冬日天空让整座小镇显得灰蒙蒙。

unbrilliant.example: His unbrilliant but steady work earned him quiet respect.  他不出彩却稳健的工作赢得了默默的尊重。

loll.example: The children lolled on the sofa instead of finishing their homework.  孩子们懒躺在沙发上，而不是把作业做完。

lounge.example: They lounged in the shade all afternoon without doing anything.  他们整个下午在阴凉处闲躺，什么也没做。

hang around.example: They hung around the gate for hours waiting for the singer.  他们在门口闲等了几个小时，等那位歌手。

ameliorator.example: Cheap medicine became a great ameliorator of rural poverty here.  廉价药物成为这里农村贫困的重要缓解因素。

dandy.example: The young dandy spent more on silk shirts than on rent.  那位年轻的纨绔子弟买丝绸衬衫的钱比房租还多。

fop.cn: 爱打扮的男子，花花公子
fop.example: The fop spent more on coats than on food each month.  这位花花公子每月买外套的钱多于吃饭的钱。

dank.example: They stored the wine in a dank cellar beneath the kitchen.  他们把酒存放在厨房下面阴湿的地窖里。

wettish.example: The towels were still wettish when we packed them away.  我们收起毛巾时它们还有点湿。

dapper.example: A dapper old gentleman in a gray suit greeted us at the door.  一位身穿灰色西装、衣冠整洁的老先生在门口迎接我们。

natty.example: He arrived at the reception in a natty blue suit and polished shoes.  他穿着时髦的蓝西装和擦亮的皮鞋来到招待会。

snappy.example: He arrived in a snappy grey suit and polished shoes.  他穿着利落的灰西装和擦亮的皮鞋来了。

spruce.example: The old waiter always looked spruce despite his worn uniform.  尽管制服磨旧，这位老侍者总是显得整洁。

frowsy.example: He looked frowsy after sleeping two nights on the train.  在火车上睡了两夜后，他显得很邋遢。

unkempt.example: He arrived at the interview with unkempt hair and a wrinkled shirt.  他去面试时头发蓬乱，衬衫也皱皱巴巴。

slovenly.example: His slovenly desk made a bad impression on every visitor.  他邋遢的办公桌给每位来访者留下坏印象。

dappled.example: Dappled light fell through the leaves onto the quiet forest path.  斑驳的光透过树叶洒在幽静的林间小路上。

blotchy.example: Her face turned blotchy after an hour in the cold wind.  在冷风中待了一小时后，她的脸起了红斑。

mottled.example: The mottled stone floor hid the stains left by rain.  杂色斑驳的石地板藏住了雨水留下的污痕。

specked.example: His glasses were specked with white paint after the long day.  忙了一整天后，他的眼镜上沾满白漆点。

piebald.example: A piebald horse grazed quietly beside the wooden fence.  一匹黑白花的马在木栅栏旁静静吃草。

splotched.example: The letter was splotched with ink and hard to read.  这封信沾满墨渍，很难辨读。

stippled.example: The artist's stippled portrait used thousands of tiny black dots.  这位画家的点画肖像用了数千个小黑点。

spotted.example: A spotted deer stepped quietly out of the morning mist.  一头有斑点的鹿静静走出晨雾。

unspotted.example: She kept the tablecloth unspotted through the entire noisy dinner.  整场喧闹的晚餐里她都让桌布保持洁净。

overbold.example: His overbold plan impressed nobody on the cautious old committee.  他过于冒险的计划没打动谨慎的老委员会。

dart.example: A squirrel darted across the lawn and vanished up the old oak.  一只松鼠猛冲过草坪，蹿上老橡树不见了。

flitter.example: Butterflies flitter among the wildflowers every summer in the sunny meadow.  每年夏天蝴蝶都在阳光下的草地野花间飞舞。

flutter.example: The flags flutter in the breeze above the crowded stadium entrance.  旗帜在拥挤的体育场入口上方随微风飘动。

demoralize.example: Repeated pay cuts demoralized the staff more than the long hours.  反复减薪比长时间工作更让员工士气低落。

unnerve.example: The sudden silence in the courtroom unnerved the young witness completely.  法庭上突然的寂静让年轻证人完全紧张起来。

make resolute.example: Years of hardship made him resolute in pursuing his dream.  多年的艰辛使他在追求梦想上变得坚定。

trepid.example: She took a trepid step onto the swaying rope bridge.  她胆怯地踏上摇晃的绳桥。

easily discouraged.example: Beginners are easily discouraged when their first attempts fail badly.  初学者在最初的尝试严重失败时容易气馁。

meek.example: Too meek to complain, he accepted the extra work without saying a word.  他太顺从了，不敢抱怨，一句话没说就接下了额外的工作。

timorous.example: The timorous student finally raised her hand to answer the question.  那个胆怯的学生终于举手回答问题。

crawl.example: Traffic crawled along the flooded highway for nearly three hours.  车流在被淹的公路上缓慢行进了近三个小时。

dillydally.example: Stop dillydallying and finish your homework before dinner is served.  别磨蹭了，晚饭前把作业写完。

lag.example: The youngest hiker lagged far behind the group on the steep trail.  最年幼的徒步者在陡峭的小道上远远落在队伍后面。

linger.example: Guests lingered in the doorway long after the party had officially ended.  聚会正式结束后很久，客人们还在门口磨蹭。

course.example: Adrenaline coursed through his veins as the race finally began.  比赛终于开始时肾上腺素在他血管中奔涌。

dash.example: She dashed across the street to catch the departing bus.  她冲过街道去赶那辆即将开走的公交车。

speed.example: The ambulance sped down the empty highway toward the hospital.  救护车沿着空旷的公路疾驰驶向医院。

deadpan.example: He told the joke with a deadpan face and nobody laughed.  他面无表情地讲了那个笑话，没有人笑。

expressionless.example: His expressionless face gave no hint of what he was thinking.  他毫无表情的脸没有透露他在想什么。

impassive.example: His face stayed impassive as the verdict was read aloud.  宣读判决时，他的脸上始终毫无表情。

inexpressive.cn: 无表情的，缺乏表现力的
inexpressive.phrase_cn: 缺乏表现力的单调声音
inexpressive.example: Her inexpressive reading of the poem bored the entire audience.  她毫无表现力的朗诵让全场听众感到乏味。

stolid.example: A stolid unsmiling guard stood beside the gate all afternoon.  一名麻木不笑的卫兵整个下午守在门旁。

vacant.example: He answered with a vacant stare that unsettled everyone present.  他以茫然的目光作答，让在场的人都不安。

demonstrative.example: Her demonstrative hugs surprised colleagues used to formal handshakes.  她热情的拥抱让习惯正式握手的同事很惊讶。

expressive.cn: 富于表情的，善于表达的
expressive.example: The dancer's expressive gestures told the whole story without any words.  舞者富有表现力的动作无需言语便讲完整个故事。

want.example: The project collapsed for want of steady funding and clear leadership.  项目因缺乏稳定资金和明确领导而失败。

deficit.example: The region faces a serious water deficit after three dry years.  该地区在三个干旱年后面临严重缺水。

insufficiency.example: The case was dismissed because of the insufficiency of the evidence.  由于证据不足，案件被驳回。

paucity.example: The paucity of reliable data made the researchers cautious about conclusions.  可靠数据的匮乏使研究者对结论十分谨慎。

pinch.example: Small shops began to feel the pinch as rents rose sharply.  租金猛涨后小店铺开始感到经济窘迫。

scantiness.example: The scantiness of the harvest worried farmers across the whole valley.  收成稀少让整个山谷的农民忧心。

scarcity.example: A scarcity of clean water threatens millions of people every year.  清洁水源的稀缺每年威胁数百万人。

undersupply.example: A chronic undersupply of nurses has strained the country's hospitals.  护士长期供应不足使全国医院不堪重负。

spate.example: The store received a spate of complaints about the faulty heaters.  商店收到大量关于取暖器故障的投诉。

copiousness.example: The copiousness of his notes impressed even the strictest professor.  他笔记的丰富程度连最严格的教授都佩服。

abundance.example: The market offered an abundance of fresh fruit at low prices.  市场以低价供应大量新鲜水果。

adequacy.example: Inspectors questioned the adequacy of the building's fire safety measures.  检查员质疑该建筑消防措施是否充足。

amplitude.example: The library's amplitude of rare manuscripts attracts scholars from many countries.  该图书馆丰富的珍稀手稿吸引了许多国家的学者。

opulence.example: The palace displayed an opulence that stunned every visiting guest.  这座宫殿展现出令每位来客震惊的奢华。

flop.example: The expensive musical turned out to be a complete flop.  这部昂贵的音乐剧结果彻底失败。

complete success.example: The rescue operation was a complete success despite the terrible weather.  尽管天气恶劣，救援行动完全成功。

debark.example: The passengers debarked slowly onto a windy and unfamiliar wooden pier.  乘客们缓缓下船，走上一个多风而陌生的木码头。

land.example: The plane landed safely despite strong crosswinds at the airport.  尽管机场有强侧风，飞机仍安全降落。

embark.example: At forty she embarked on a new career as a literary translator.  四十岁时她开始从事文学翻译这一新职业。

debase.example: Politicians who lie to win votes debase the office they hold.  为拉票而撒谎的政客贬损了他们所担任的职务。

deprave.example: Critics claimed such films would deprave impressionable young viewers.  批评者称这类影片会腐化易受影响的年轻观众。

subvert.example: The group was accused of plotting to subvert the elected government.  该团体被指控阴谋颠覆经选举产生的政府。

debilitate.example: The virus gradually debilitates the immune system of healthy adults.  这种病毒会逐渐削弱健康成年人的免疫系统。

devitalize.example: Years of neglect devitalized the once thriving downtown district.  多年的忽视使曾经繁荣的市中心失去活力。

enervate.example: The long heat wave enervated the whole team before the final match.  漫长的热浪在决赛前使全队疲弱无力。

prostrate.example: The exhausted runner lay prostrate on the ground after crossing the line.  那名精疲力竭的跑者冲线后平躺在地上。
prostrate.cn: 平躺的，俯卧的；使极度虚弱

sap.example: Weeks of night shifts sapped the energy of the young doctor completely.  数周的夜班彻底削弱了这位年轻医生的精力。

beef up.example: The city beefed up security before the international summit began.  国际峰会开始前，该市加强了安保。

debris.example: Rescuers dug through the debris for hours looking for survivors.  救援人员在废墟中挖掘了数小时，寻找生还者。

dross.example: Most of the manuscripts were dross, but two showed real talent.  大多数稿件都是垃圾，但有两篇显出真才华。

dust.example: A thick layer of dust covered every book on the shelf.  书架上每本书都覆盖着厚厚的灰尘。

litter.example: Volunteers picked up litter along the riverbank all Saturday morning.  志愿者整个周六上午沿河岸捡垃圾。

offal.example: The butcher sold the offal cheaply to local sausage makers.  屠夫把内脏廉价卖给当地香肠作坊。

effluvium.example: A foul effluvium rose from the ditch behind the abandoned tannery.  废弃制革厂后面的沟里升起难闻的臭气。

junk.example: He finally cleared the junk out of his crowded garage.  他终于把拥挤车库里的废物清理掉了。

undress.example: She undressed quickly and slipped into the warm bath.  她迅速脱掉衣服，滑进温暖的浴缸。

show up.example: The simple test showed up serious flaws in their argument.  这个简单的检验暴露了他们论证的严重缺陷。

debut.example: The pianist made her professional debut at only sixteen years old.  这位钢琴家年仅十六岁就首次职业登台。

farewell performance.example: The aging soprano gave her farewell performance to a weeping audience.  这位年迈的女高音在观众的泪水中举行告别演出。

decadence.example: The historian blamed the empire's fall on decades of quiet decadence.  这位历史学家把帝国的覆亡归因于数十年的悄然衰颓。

degeneracy.example: The novel portrays the slow degeneracy of a once noble family.  小说描绘了一个曾经高贵家族的缓慢堕落。

degeneration.example: Doctors monitored the gradual degeneration of the patient's eyesight.  医生监测着病人视力的逐渐衰退。

degradation.example: Rapid environmental degradation has already destroyed much of the wetland.  快速的环境退化已破坏了大部分湿地。

deterioration.example: Doctors noted a sharp deterioration in the old man's health.  医生注意到这位老人的健康急剧恶化。

downfall.example: Greed eventually led to the powerful banker's sudden downfall.  贪婪最终导致这位有权势的银行家突然垮台。

eclipse.example: His later failures eclipsed the fame he had earned as a young pianist.  他后来的失败使他年轻时作为钢琴家赢得的名声黯然失色。

ascent.example: Her steady ascent to power surprised many longtime party members.  她稳步登上权位让许多老党员感到意外。

rise.example: Historians still debate the rise of that short-lived empire.  历史学家仍在争论那个短命帝国的兴起。

upswing.example: Retailers reported a welcome upswing in sales last quarter.  零售商报告上季度销售出现可喜的回升。

dislike.example: He dislikes crowded places and avoids the subway during rush hour.  他讨厌拥挤的地方，高峰时段避开地铁。

hate.example: She hates being lied to, even about very small things.  她讨厌被骗，哪怕是很小的事。

decipher.example: Scholars finally deciphered the inscription after comparing it with three others.  学者们把这段铭文与另外三段比对后终于将其破译。

crack.example: Mathematicians finally cracked the enemy's code after months of work.  数学家们经过数月努力终于破解了敌方密码。

decrypt.example: Only the recipient's private key can decrypt this sensitive file.  只有收件人的私钥才能解密这个敏感文件。

decode.example: It took the analysts a week to decode the intercepted message.  分析人员花了一周时间才解读出截获的电文。

perceive.example: She perceived a subtle change in his tone during dinner.  晚餐时她察觉到他语气的微妙变化。

recognize.example: He recognized her familiar handwriting on the faded old envelope.  他在褪色的旧信封上认出她熟悉的字迹。

seize.example: Good students quickly seize the main point of a difficult lecture.  好学生能迅速抓住难懂讲座的要点。

make out.example: I could barely make out the faint writing on the label.  我几乎看不清标签上模糊的字迹。

encipher.example: Operators enciphered every message before sending it over the radio.  操作员在无线电发送前把每条消息加密。

encode.example: The app encodes your password before storing it on the server.  该应用在把密码存到服务器前先进行编码。

encrypt.example: Always encrypt sensitive emails before sending them across public networks.  在公共网络发送敏感邮件前务必加密。

decorous.example: Guests kept a decorous silence while the old bishop said grace.  老主教做餐前祷告时，客人们保持着得体的安静。

decent.example: He is a decent man who always keeps his promises.  他是个正派的人，总是守承诺。

respectable.example: They came from a respectable family with an excellent local reputation.  他们出身于当地声誉极佳的体面家庭。

seemly.example: The teacher expects seemly conduct from her students in public places.  老师期望学生在公共场所举止得体。

indecent.example: The comedian was fined for using indecent language on live television.  这位喜剧演员因在直播电视上使用下流言语被罚款。

indecorous.example: His indecorous jokes at the memorial service embarrassed nearly everyone in the room.  他在追悼会上不得体的玩笑让在场几乎所有人都很尴尬。

indelicate.example: Asking about her salary was an indelicate question at the party.  在聚会上问她的薪水是个不得体的问题。

sturdy.example: A sturdy wooden table stood in the middle of the farmhouse kitchen.  农舍厨房中间摆着一张结实的木桌。

sound.example: Her lawyer gave sound financial advice that saved the family thousands.  她的律师给出稳妥的理财建议，为家里省下数千元。
sound.cn: 牢固的；健康强壮的；（逻辑）严谨的

robust.example: At eighty he remains robust enough to work in the garden daily.  他八十岁了，身体依然强健，每天还能在园中劳作。

hale.example: At eighty he remains hale enough to walk five miles a day.  八十岁的他依然强健，每天能走五英里。

default.example: The company's default on its loans alarmed investors across the region.  这家公司拖欠贷款不还，使全地区的投资者惊慌。

delinquency.example: Social workers study why juvenile delinquency rises in poorer neighborhoods.  社工研究为何贫困社区的青少年违法行为增多。

dereliction.example: The officer was dismissed for a serious dereliction of duty.  该官员因严重失职被解职。

misprision.example: He was charged with misprision of a felony he witnessed.  他因对目睹的重罪知情不报而被起诉。

nonfeasance.example: The lawsuit alleged nonfeasance by several city safety inspectors.  诉讼指控几名市安检员不作为。

oversight.example: Your name was omitted through a simple clerical oversight.  你的名字因一个小小的文书疏忽被遗漏了。

defer.example: The committee deferred its decision until the new figures finally arrived.  委员会推迟决定，直到新数据终于送来。

delay.example: Heavy fog delayed the flight by more than four hours.  大雾使航班延误了四个多小时。

shelve.example: The company shelved the ambitious plan after funding fell through.  资金落空后公司搁置了这个宏大计划。

hold off.example: Let's hold off the announcement until the contract is signed.  我们把宣布推迟到合同签好之后吧。

hold over.example: The committee held over the vote until next month's meeting.  委员会把表决延到下月的会议。

lay over.example: The judge laid over the hearing to allow more evidence.  法官延期听证以便收集更多证据。

put off.example: Don't put off the dentist appointment any longer than necessary.  牙医预约别再往后拖了。

acquiescence.example: Her silent acquiescence surprised colleagues who expected a fierce argument.  她默默顺从让预料会激烈争论的同事很惊讶。

compliancy.example: The manager expected total compliancy from every member of staff.  经理期望每位员工完全顺从。

docility.example: The docility of these horses makes them ideal for beginners.  这些马的温顺使它们非常适合初学者。

obedience.example: Blind obedience to orders cannot excuse such cruel behavior.  盲目服从命令不能为如此残酷的行为开脱。

submissiveness.example: Her submissiveness in meetings hid a very sharp critical mind.  她在会上的顺从掩盖了极为敏锐的批判头脑。

contempt.example: He treated their careful proposal with open and unmistakable contempt.  他对他们精心的提案表现出公开而明显的蔑视。

defiance.example: The students marched in open defiance of the new ban.  学生们游行，公然违抗新的禁令。

disobedience.example: Civil disobedience became their main weapon against the unjust law.  非暴力反抗成了他们对抗不公法律的主要武器。

intractability.example: The intractability of the dispute frustrated every experienced mediator involved.  争端的难解让每位经验丰富的调解人都很沮丧。

recalcitrance.example: The department's recalcitrance blocked every attempt at meaningful reform.  该部门的顽抗阻挡了每次有意义的改革尝试。

document.example: The team documented every finding carefully in a detailed field notebook.  团队把每项发现都仔细记录在详尽的野外笔记本里。

demonstrate.example: The experiment demonstrated the theory clearly to every skeptical observer.  实验向每位持疑的观察者清楚证明了该理论。

prove.example: New evidence finally proved his innocence after eleven long years.  新证据在漫长的十一年后终于证明他无罪。

establish.example: The investigation established the facts beyond any reasonable doubt.  调查毫无疑问地确证了事实。

famine.example: Drought brought widespread famine to the region for three years.  干旱使该地区连续三年发生大范围饥荒。

surfeit.example: A surfeit of information often leaves readers more confused than informed.  信息过量常让读者更困惑而非更明白。

sufficiency.example: The harvest guaranteed a sufficiency of grain for the entire winter.  这次收成保证了整个冬天粮食充足。

beguiling.example: His beguiling manner hid a thoroughly calculating and selfish nature.  他迷人的举止掩盖了极其精于算计的自私本性。

guileful.example: The guileful merchant tricked several villagers out of their savings.  这个狡诈的商人骗走了几位村民的积蓄。

guileless.example: Her guileless smile made everyone in the room trust her immediately.  她天真无邪的笑容让屋里所有人立刻信任她。

ingenuous.example: His ingenuous questions about the city amused the veteran taxi driver greatly.  他关于这座城市的天真提问让老出租车司机大为好笑。

undesigning.example: His undesigning honesty won friends wherever he happened to travel.  他毫无心机的诚实让他无论走到哪里都能交到朋友。

to.example: They refused to yield to pressure from the powerful mining company.  他们拒绝屈从于强大矿业公司的压力。

dehydrate.example: Campers dehydrate fruit and meat so the food lasts for weeks.  露营者把水果和肉脱水，好让食物保存数周。

desiccate.example: Months without rain desiccated the fields and killed the young corn.  数月无雨使田地干透，幼小的玉米也枯死了。

parch.example: Weeks without rain had parched the fields into cracked brown dust.  数周无雨已把田地烤得干裂成褐色的尘土。

scorch.example: The blazing sun scorched the grass brown within a single week.  烈日一周之内就把草烤成褐色。

sear.example: Sear the meat quickly on both sides before roasting it.  烤之前先把肉两面快速煎焦。

petrify.example: Endless rules can petrify a living tradition into empty ritual.  无穷的规矩会使活的传统僵化为空洞的仪式。

hydrate.example: Drink water regularly to hydrate your body during long runs.  长跑时要定时喝水给身体补水。

saturate with water.example: Heavy rain saturated the garden soil with water overnight.  大雨一夜之间使花园土壤浸透了水。

reconstitute.example: Simply add warm water to reconstitute the dried milk powder.  只需加温水就能把奶粉复原。

vitalize.example: New investment vitalized the sleepy town within just two years.  新投资在两年内使这个沉寂的小镇焕发活力。

vivify.example: Vivid dialogue vivifies an otherwise dull historical narrative.  生动的对话使原本乏味的历史叙述活了起来。

dignify.example: Her quiet presence dignified the otherwise chaotic opening ceremony.  她安静的在场使原本混乱的开幕式显得庄重。

glorify.example: Critics said the film glorified war instead of questioning it.  批评者说这部电影美化战争而非质疑它。

debasement.example: He lamented the steady debasement of public political language.  他哀叹公共政治语言的持续降格。

deject.example: Nothing dejects a coach more than seeing his players quit trying.  没有什么比看到球员放弃努力更让教练沮丧。

oppress.example: The gloomy weather oppressed everyone stuck inside the small cabin.  阴沉的天气让困在小屋里的每个人都心情压抑。

sadden.example: The news of his death saddened the entire small village.  他去世的消息让整个小村庄都感到悲伤。

weigh down.example: Debt and illness weighed him down for many difficult years.  债务和疾病在许多艰难岁月里压得他喘不过气。

bum out.example: The cancelled concert really bummed out all of us.  演唱会取消让我们所有人都很扫兴。

brighten.example: A short phone call from home brightened her gloomy mood.  一个来自家里的短电话让她阴郁的心情变好。

lighten.example: A silly joke lightened the mood in the tense room.  一个傻笑话缓和了紧张房间里的气氛。

cheer up.example: We took her to the beach to cheer her up.  我们带她去海边让她开心起来。

mischievous.example: The mischievous rumor damaged her reputation for several years.  这个有害的谣言损害了她多年的名誉。

beneficial.example: Regular walking is beneficial to both your heart and mood.  经常步行对心脏和情绪都有益。

salubrious.example: Doctors sent him to a salubrious mountain village to recover his strength.  医生把他送到有益健康的山村去恢复体力。

wholesome.example: The children grew strong on wholesome food and plenty of fresh air.  孩子们靠有益健康的食物和充足的新鲜空气长得很结实。

thoughtful.example: She gave a thoughtful reply after considering the question carefully.  她仔细考虑问题后给出深思熟虑的回答。

impetuous.example: One impetuous remark at the meeting cost him a valuable client.  会上一句冲动的话让他失去了一位重要客户。

casual.example: A casual remark at dinner accidentally revealed the whole secret.  晚餐时随口一句话意外揭出了整个秘密。

unadvised.example: His unadvised comment to reporters caused weeks of serious trouble.  他对记者轻率的评论造成了数周的严重麻烦。

uncalculated.example: Her uncalculated kindness to strangers impressed everyone who watched.  她对陌生人不加算计的善意让旁观者都很感动。

unconsidered.example: An unconsidered reply in the interview cost him the job.  面试中一句未经考虑的回答让他丢了工作。

unstudied.example: Her unstudied charm won over the entire skeptical audience.  她自然不做作的魅力赢得了全场持疑观众。

delicacy.example: Everyone admired the delicacy of the carving on the ivory box.  大家都赞叹象牙盒上雕刻的精致。

daintiness.example: The daintiness of the porcelain teacups delighted every visiting guest.  瓷茶杯的精致让每位来客都很喜欢。

coarseness.example: The coarseness of the cheap fabric irritated her sensitive skin.  廉价布料的粗糙刺激了她敏感的皮肤。

delirium.example: For two nights the fever kept him in a restless delirium.  高烧使他两夜都处在不安的精神错乱之中。

agitation.example: He paced the hallway in a state of visible agitation.  他在走廊里踱步，显得焦躁不安。

distraction.example: The constant noise drove the exhausted writer to distraction.  持续的噪音让疲惫的作家心烦意乱。

hysteria.example: Rumors of invasion produced mass hysteria across the small town.  入侵的谣言在小镇引发集体歇斯底里。

rage.example: He flew into a rage when the waiter spilled the soup.  服务员把汤打翻时，他勃然大怒。

unreality.example: A strange sense of unreality followed the accident for days.  事故之后有好几天都伴随着奇怪的不真实感。

falsehood.example: He repeated the falsehood so often that people believed it.  他把这个谎言说了太多次，人们竟然信了。

misconception.example: It is a common misconception that bats are completely blind.  蝙蝠完全失明是个常见的误解。

verity.example: The play explores eternal verities about love and human loss.  这部戏探讨关于爱与失去的永恒真理。

transparent.example: He gave a transparent explanation that even beginners understood immediately.  他给出清晰易懂的解释，连初学者都立刻明白。

deluge.example: The announcement brought a deluge of angry letters to the editor.  这项公告引来大量愤怒的读者来信。

cloudburst.example: A sudden cloudburst flooded the narrow streets within ten minutes.  一场突降暴雨十分钟内就淹了狭窄街道。

downpour.example: A heavy downpour soaked the crowd waiting outside the stadium.  一场大雨把在体育场外等候的人群淋透了。

rainstorm.example: A violent rainstorm knocked out power across the whole valley.  一场猛烈暴风雨使整个山谷停电。

inundation.example: The dam failure caused the inundation of hundreds of farms.  水坝失事导致数百个农场被淹。

overflow.example: Melting snow made the river overflow its banks last spring.  去年春天融雪使河水漫过堤岸。

torrent.example: A torrent of muddy water swept the wooden bridge away.  一股浑浊激流把木桥冲走了。

drizzle.example: A light drizzle fell all morning but nobody bothered complaining.  整个上午下着小雨，但没人抱怨。

delve.example: She delved into the family archives and found a startling old letter.  她钻研家族档案，发现了一封令人震惊的旧信。

probe.example: Investigators continued to probe deeply into the company's missing funds.  调查人员继续深入调查公司资金失踪的问题。

investigate.example: Police are investigating the cause of the warehouse fire.  警方正在调查仓库火灾的原因。

inquire into.example: A committee will inquire into the missing department funds.  一个委员会将调查该部门丢失的资金。

look into.example: The manager promised to look into the customer's angry complaint.  经理承诺会调查这位顾客的愤怒投诉。

dig into.example: Reporters dug into the archives and found the missing letters.  记者深挖档案，找到了失踪的信件。

demagogue.example: The demagogue blamed foreigners for every problem the province faced.  那个蛊惑民心的政客把全省的每个问题都归咎于外国人。

firebrand.example: The young firebrand stirred the crowd with furious speeches.  这个年轻的煽动者用愤怒的演讲激起人群。

fomenter.example: Officials called him a fomenter of unrest in the province.  官员称他是该省动乱的煽动者。

incendiary.example: The government labeled the anonymous pamphleteer a dangerous incendiary.  政府把这位匿名小册子作者称为危险的煽动者。

instigator.example: Police identified the instigator of the riot from video footage.  警方从录像中认出了骚乱的主使者。

kindler.example: History remembers him as a kindler of popular rebellion.  历史记住他是民众叛乱的点火者。

provocateur.example: The blogger acted as a provocateur during the tense election.  这位博主在紧张的选举期间充当挑动者。

demanding.example: Caring for three small children is demanding work with no holidays.  照顾三个小孩是费时间花心思且没有休假的工作。

exacting.example: The airline maintains exacting standards for every part it installs.  这家航空公司对安装的每个部件都保持严格的标准。

finical.example: Their finical guest rejected almost every dish on the table.  他们挑剔的客人几乎拒绝了桌上每道菜。

finicking.example: His finicking attention to detail slowed the whole project down.  他对细节的过分讲究拖慢了整个项目。

fussy.example: The old tailor is fussy about the smallest details.  这位老裁缝对最小的细节都很挑剔。

picky.example: My nephew is a picky eater who refuses all vegetables.  我侄子很挑食，什么蔬菜都不吃。

challenging.example: The professor gave us a challenging assignment due next week.  教授给了我们一个下周交的有挑战性作业。

killing.example: They kept a killing schedule of twelve shows every week.  他们保持着每周十二场演出的要命日程。

persnickety.example: The persnickety inspector rejected the wall over one small crack.  这位挑剔的检查员因一条小裂缝就否决了那面墙。

toil-.example: Years of hard toil finally earned him a small farm.  多年辛苦劳作终于让他挣得一个小农场。

some.example: Some of the students finished the difficult exam surprisingly early.  有些学生出人意料地很早就做完了这场难考试。

demolition.example: Residents protested the demolition of the last old theater downtown.  居民抗议拆毁市中心最后一座老剧院。

annihilation.example: The battle ended in the near annihilation of the invading army.  战役以入侵军队几近被歼灭而结束。

decimation.example: Logging caused the decimation of wildlife in that ancient forest.  伐木导致那片古老森林野生动物大量死亡。

devastation.example: The hurricane left widespread devastation along the entire coastline.  飓风在整条海岸线留下大范围毁坏。

havoc.example: The flood wreaked havoc on roads and bridges throughout the valley.  洪水对整个山谷的道路和桥梁造成了大破坏。

wreckage.example: Investigators sifted through the wreckage looking for the flight recorder.  调查人员在残骸中翻找飞行记录仪。

building.example: The building of the new bridge took almost four years.  新桥的建造花了将近四年。

construction.example: The library has been under construction since early last spring.  图书馆自去年初春以来一直在建。

erection.example: The erection of the monument took the workers six months.  纪念碑的竖立花了工人六个月。

raising.example: Neighbors gathered for the raising of the new wooden barn.  邻居们聚在一起搭建新的木谷仓。

exemplify.example: This painting exemplifies the new style better than any other.  这幅画比其他任何作品都更能例证这种新风格。

instance.example: She cited a specific instance to support her broad claim.  她举出具体例子支持自己的宏观论断。

unable to prove.example: Prosecutors were unable to prove the claim beyond reasonable doubt.  检方无法在合理怀疑之外证明该指控。

demotic.example: The novelist wrote in demotic language that ordinary readers loved.  这位小说家用普通读者喜爱的通俗语言写作。

exception.example: He took exception to her remark about his careless research.  他对她关于他研究草率的话表示反对。

expostulation.example: The committee ignored his angry expostulation and approved the plan.  委员会无视他愤怒的抗议，通过了计划。

kick.example: Employees kicked about the new rules at every staff meeting.  员工在每次员工会上都对新规定表示不满。

protest.example: The ambassador registered a formal protest with the foreign ministry.  大使向外交部提出正式抗议。

remonstrance.example: The villagers sent a written remonstrance to the district governor.  村民向区长递交了一份书面抗议。

stink.example: Parents raised a stink about the sudden tuition increase.  家长们为学费突然上涨大闹抗议。

belittle.example: Don't belittle her achievements just because she works quietly.  别因为她默默工作就贬低她的成就。

depreciate.example: Do not depreciate the value of patience in such long negotiations.  不要贬低耐心在这样漫长谈判中的价值。

insincere.example: His insincere apology only made the situation considerably worse.  他虚伪的道歉只让情况更糟。

affected.example: She spoke with an affected accent that fooled nobody present.  她用装出来的口音说话，没骗过在场任何人。

dishonest.example: The company used dishonest advertising to attract careless customers.  公司用不诚实的广告吸引不细心的顾客。

disingenuous.example: It is disingenuous to claim you knew nothing about it.  声称你对此毫不知情是不诚恳的。

sincere.example: Her sincere apology repaired a friendship damaged for years.  她真诚的道歉修复了受损多年的友谊。

cite.example: The general cited three soldiers for exceptional bravery under fire.  将军嘉奖三名在火线下表现极其勇敢的士兵。

panegyric.example: The retirement dinner ended with a long panegyric to the old professor.  退休晚宴以对这位老教授的长篇颂词结束。

downsize.example: The firm downsized its workforce after losing two major contracts.  公司在丢掉两个大合同后裁员。

enlarge.example: They enlarged the kitchen by removing one interior wall.  他们拆掉一道内墙把厨房扩大了。

denude.example: The long drought denuded the hillside of grass and young trees.  长期干旱使山坡上的草和幼树消失殆尽。

consume.example: Data centers consume vast amounts of electricity every single day.  数据中心每天消耗大量电力。

devour.example: The hungry children devoured the entire meal in five minutes.  饥饿的孩子们五分钟内吞掉了整顿饭。

drain.example: The long war drained the country's resources and its morale.  漫长的战争耗尽了国家的资源和士气。

exhaust.example: Two dry summers exhausted the town's entire water supply.  连续两个干燥的夏天耗尽了全镇的水源。

draw down.example: The government drew down its oil reserves during the long crisis.  政府在漫长的危机期间动用了石油储备。

play out.example: The old strategy had played out its usefulness by then.  到那时旧策略已经用尽了它的价值。

use up.example: We used up the last supplies before reaching the base camp.  我们在到达大本营前用完了最后的补给。

renew.example: Spring rains renewed the reservoir after a long dry summer.  春雨在漫长干旱的夏季后补满了水库。

replace.example: The store quickly replaced the depleted stock of bottled water.  商店迅速补充了售空的瓶装水库存。

deploy.example: The army deployed engineers to rebuild the bridges after the flood.  军队部署工兵在洪水过后重建桥梁。

deportation.example: After years of appeals he still faced deportation to a country he barely knew.  上诉多年后，他仍面临被遣送到一个几乎陌生的国家。

banishment.example: The poet endured years of banishment far from his native city.  这位诗人远离故城，忍受了多年的流放。

displacement.example: The conflict caused the mass displacement of thousands of civilians.  冲突造成数千平民大规模流离失所。

expatriation.example: His voluntary expatriation to Paris lasted almost thirty years.  他自愿移居巴黎将近三十年。

expulsion.example: Cheating on the final exam led to his immediate expulsion.  期末考试作弊导致他被立即开除。

relegation.example: His relegation to a minor post ended a promising career.  他被贬到次要职位，结束了前途看好的事业。

depose.example: Rebel officers deposed the president and installed a temporary ruling council.  叛军军官废黜了总统，成立了临时统治委员会。

attest.example: Several neighbors will attest to his good character in court.  几位邻居将在法庭上证明他品行良好。

swear.example: Each witness must swear to tell the truth before testifying.  每位证人作证前必须宣誓说出真相。

defrock.example: The church defrocked the priest after the lengthy investigation.  经过漫长调查后教会剥夺了这位神父的神职。

deprive.example: The new law deprived many residents of their voting rights.  新法剥夺了许多居民的投票权。

oust.example: The board voted to oust the chairman after the scandal became public.  丑闻曝光后，董事会投票罢免了主席。

uncrown.example: The rebellion uncrowned a monarch who had ruled for decades.  这场叛乱废黜了统治数十年的君主。

perjure.example: He perjured himself in court to protect his younger brother.  他在法庭上作伪证以保护弟弟。

enthrone.example: Nobles enthroned the young prince before his tenth birthday.  贵族们在小王子十岁前拥立他登位。
