dregs.example: He poured out the bitter dregs of the cold coffee.  他倒掉了冷咖啡里苦涩的渣滓。

sediment.example: Thick sediment settled at the bottom of the old reservoir.  厚厚的沉积物沉在旧水库底部。

settlings.example: Workers scraped the settlings from the bottom of the barrel.  工人从桶底刮出沉淀物。

process of eroding.example: The cliff shows the slow process of eroding by seawater.  这处崖壁显示出海水缓慢侵蚀的过程。

withdraw.example: He stopped at the bank to withdraw money before the long trip.  他在长途旅行前去银行取钱。

depravity.example: The trial revealed a level of depravity that shocked the small town.  庭审揭露出的道德败坏程度震惊了这个小镇。

debauchery.example: He wasted his inheritance on years of reckless debauchery.  他把遗产浪费在多年放荡纵欲上。

iniquitousness.example: Reformers denounced the iniquitousness of the regime's secret prisons.  改革者谴责该政权秘密监狱的邪恶。

licentiousness.example: The novel exposes the licentiousness of the aristocratic court.  这部小说揭露了贵族宫廷的放荡。

perversion.example: Such a ruling is a perversion of the law.  这样的裁决是对法律的曲解。

turpitude.example: He was dismissed for acts of moral turpitude.  他因道德败坏的行为被解职。

dissoluteness.example: Years of dissoluteness ruined both his health and his fortune.  多年的放纵毁了他的健康和财产。

morality.example: The scandal raised hard questions about morality in politics.  这桩丑闻引出了政治道德的难题。

virtue.example: Patience is a virtue that few travelers keep at airports.  耐心是少有旅客能在机场保持的美德。

deprecate.example: He tends to deprecate his own achievements whenever anyone praises them.  每当有人称赞，他总倾向于贬低自己的成就。

disesteem.example: Critics held the popular novelist in open disesteem.  批评家公开轻视这位通俗小说家。

cry down.example: Officials tried to cry down the report as mere gossip.  官员们试图把那份报告贬为闲言碎语。

depress.example: A weak harvest can depress prices for the whole season.  歉收会压低整个季度的价格。

mark down.example: The store will mark down winter coats after the holidays.  节后这家店会给冬季外套降价。

depressed.example: She felt depressed for weeks after the letter of rejection arrived.  收到拒信之后，她消沉了好几个星期。

dejected.example: She left the interview dejected and sure she had failed.  她面试后神情沮丧，确信自己失败了。

despondent.example: After three rejections he became despondent about ever publishing.  三次被拒后他对出版感到绝望。

low-spirited.example: The rainy week left the whole team low-spirited.  连绵阴雨让整个团队情绪低落。

wretched.example: Families lived in wretched conditions beside the flooded riverbank.  一些家庭在泛滥的河岸边过着极差的生活。

blissful.example: They spent a blissful week beside the quiet mountain lake.  他们在宁静的山湖边度过了幸福的一周。

gleeful.example: The children were gleeful when the snow closed their school.  大雪停课时孩子们兴高采烈。

joyous.example: The village held a joyous festival after the autumn harvest.  村里在秋收后办了欢乐的节庆。

jubilant.example: The nominee gave a short speech before the jubilant crowd.  被提名人在欢欣鼓舞的人群前发表了简短讲话。

deprivation.example: Years of sleep deprivation left the young doctor exhausted and irritable.  多年的睡眠剥夺让这位年轻医生疲惫易怒。

fecundity.example: The delta is famous for the fecundity of its farmland.  这片三角洲以农田肥沃著称。

deracinate.example: Colonial policy sought to deracinate the island's native languages.  殖民政策企图根除岛上的本土语言。

plant.example: Volunteers came to plant young oaks along the muddy riverbank.  志愿者来到泥泞的河岸栽种小橡树。

derelict.example: The guard was found derelict in his duty on the night of the theft.  那名警卫被认定在失窃当夜玩忽职守。

disregardful.example: The driver was disregardful of every posted speed limit.  这名司机漠视每一处限速标志。

lax.example: Lax security standards at the warehouse allowed the theft to go unnoticed.  仓库松懈的安保标准使这起盗窃未被发觉。
lax.cn: 松懈的，不严格的；漫不经心的

neglectful.example: The report found the agency neglectful of basic safety inspections.  报告认定该机构疏忽了基本安全检查。

neglecting.example: He spent the term gaming, neglecting every assignment he received.  他整学期打游戏，忽视了收到的每项作业。

slack.example: The new manager was slack about deadlines and lost several clients.  新经理对截止日期很松懈，因此丢了好几个客户。

extremely careful.example: Restorers must be extremely careful with such fragile old manuscripts.  修复者对这类脆弱的古手稿必须极其小心。

attentive.example: The nurse stayed attentive to every change in his breathing.  护士留心他呼吸的每一点变化。

nonnegligent.example: The court ruled the pilot's actions entirely nonnegligent.  法院裁定飞行员的行为完全无过失。

deride.example: Critics derided the proposal as naive and completely out of touch.  批评者嘲笑该提案幼稚且完全脱离现实。

gibe.example: The other students gibed at his accent until he stopped speaking.  其他学生嘲弄他的口音，直到他不再开口。

scout.example: The old captain scouted every warning the young sailors offered.  老船长嘲笑年轻水手提出的每句警告。

shoot down.example: The committee shot down his budget request within ten minutes.  委员会十分钟内就否决了他的预算申请。

laugh at.example: Nobody dared laugh at the beginner's clumsy first attempt.  没人敢嘲笑新手笨拙的第一次尝试。

derivative.example: Reviewers called the album pleasant but derivative of earlier folk records.  评论者称这张专辑悦耳，却是对早期民谣唱片的模仿而无原创。

secondhand.example: Most of his knowledge of the war was secondhand.  他对那场战争的了解多是间接得来的。

precursory.example: Faint tremors were precursory to the eruption that followed.  轻微的震动预示了随后的火山喷发。

descend.example: The path descends steeply toward the river through thick pine forest.  小径穿过浓密的松林，向河边陡然下降。

dip.example: Temperatures dip sharply once the sun sets over the desert.  沙漠上日落后气温骤降。

fall.example: Share prices fell again after the disappointing earnings report.  令人失望的财报公布后股价再次下跌。

plunge.example: The road plunges into the valley just beyond the last farmhouse.  过了最后一座农舍，道路便骤降进山谷。

sink.example: The old boat began to sink soon after the storm.  暴风雨过后不久那条旧船开始下沉。

arise.example: New questions arise whenever the committee reviews these old files.  委员会每次复审这些旧档案都会出现新问题。

ascend.example: The balloon ascended slowly above the quiet morning fields.  热气球在清晨宁静的田野上缓缓上升。

climb.example: We climbed for hours before reaching the windy stone ridge.  我们爬了几个小时才到多风的石岭。

upsweep.example: The architect admired the graceful upsweep of the temple eaves.  建筑师赞叹寺庙屋檐优美的上扬。

upturn.example: Retailers finally reported an upturn in holiday spending.  零售商终于报告节日消费出现回升。

forbears.example: Her forbears farmed this narrow valley for nearly two centuries.  她的祖先在这条狭窄山谷耕作了近两百年。

divination.example: Ancient priests practiced the art of divination by reading cracks in burnt bones.  古代祭司通过解读烧裂的骨纹来施行占卜之术。

augury.phrase: a good augury for the future
augury.example: The clear sunrise was taken as a favorable augury.  晴朗的日出被视为吉兆。

predictions.example: Her predictions about the election proved surprisingly accurate.  她对选举的预测出乎意料地准确。

desecrate.example: Vandals desecrated the old cemetery and overturned a dozen stones.  破坏者亵渎了那座老墓园，推倒了十几块墓碑。

violate.example: Looters violated the tombs that villagers had guarded for centuries.  盗墓者亵渎了村民守护数百年的墓葬。

sanctify.example: The bishop came to sanctify the ground where the chapel would stand.  主教前来使这片将建礼拜堂的土地成为圣地。

hallow.example: Generations of pilgrims have hallowed this quiet mountain spring.  世代朝圣者把这泓山泉视为神圣。

castrate.example: Editors castrated the essay by cutting its sharpest passages.  编辑删去最犀利的段落，使文章失去了力量。

stimulate.example: Warm rain stimulated the seeds to sprout within a week.  温暖的雨水刺激种子一周内发芽。

assign.example: The editor assigned the story to her most careful reporter.  编辑把这篇报道指派给最细心的记者。

commission.example: The city commissioned a young sculptor to design the memorial.  市政府委托一位年轻雕塑家设计纪念碑。

denominate.example: Botanists denominated the flower after the valley where it grew.  植物学家以花生长的山谷为它命名。

dub.example: The papers dubbed the young pitcher the city's new hope.  报纸称这位年轻投手为全城的新希望。

entitle.example: He entitled his memoir after a song from his childhood.  他用童年的一首歌为回忆录命名。

label.example: Critics labeled the film propaganda before anyone had watched it.  批评者在无人观看前就把影片称为宣传品。

style.example: He styled himself a professor although he never finished college.  他自称教授，尽管从未读完大学。

term.example: Economists termed the sudden slowdown a mild technical recession.  经济学家把这次骤缓称为轻度技术性衰退。

title.example: She titled the final chapter after her grandmother's village.  她以祖母的村子为最后一章命名。

fire.example: The manager fired two clerks after the audit found losses.  审计查出亏损后经理解雇了两名职员。

despicable.example: Stealing from a charity is a despicable way to make money.  从慈善机构偷钱是一种令人鄙视的赚钱方式。

contemptible.example: Cheating a blind beggar is a contemptible thing to do.  欺骗盲丐是可鄙的行为。

detestable.example: He found the general's casual cruelty absolutely detestable.  他觉得那位将军随意的残暴极其可憎。

dishonorable.example: Betraying an old friend for money is plainly dishonorable.  为钱背叛老友显然可耻。

admirable.example: Her patience with difficult students was truly admirable.  她对难教学生的耐心确实令人钦佩。

commendable.example: The rescue team showed commendable calm during the long night.  救援队在漫长的夜里表现出值得赞扬的镇定。

creditable.example: The young violinist gave a creditable account of the concerto.  年轻小提琴手对协奏曲的演绎值得称赞。

meritorious.example: He received a medal for meritorious conduct under heavy fire.  他因在猛烈炮火下的有功表现获得奖章。

praiseworthy.example: Their decision to return the money was entirely praiseworthy.  他们归还钱款的决定完全值得赞扬。

flout.example: Drivers who flout the rules face heavy fines this year.  今年蔑视规则的司机将面临重罚。

authoritative.cn: 专断的，命令式的；权威的
authoritative.example: She silenced the room with one authoritative wave of her hand.  她专断地一挥手就让全场安静。

tyrannous.example: The colony finally rebelled against a tyrannous foreign governor.  这块殖民地终于反抗暴虐的外来总督。

desultory.example: They made desultory notes instead of a real research plan.  他们做了些散漫的笔记，而非真正的研究计划。

digressive.example: His digressive style made the short talk feel endless.  他离题的讲法让短短的讲话显得没完没了。

excursive.example: His excursive lecture wandered far from the announced topic.  他的讲座散漫离题，远离了预告的主题。

meandering.example: The meandering path followed every bend of the small stream.  这条曲折的小径顺着小溪的每个弯道。

rambling.example: He gave a rambling answer that satisfied nobody present.  他给出散漫的回答，在场无人满意。

wandering.example: The wandering argument never reached any clear conclusion.  这番散漫的论述始终没有明确结论。

carefully planned.example: The escape was carefully planned over many patient months.  这次出逃经过好几个月耐心的精心策划。

strictly methodical.example: Her strictly methodical filing let her find anything instantly.  她极有条理的归档让她能立刻找到任何东西。

detach.example: Carefully detach the label before you put the jar in water.  把罐子放进水里之前先小心地把标签撕下来。

tether.example: The farmer tethered a goat outside the barn every morning.  农夫每天早上把山羊拴在谷仓外。

detain.example: Police detained the two men for questioning about the missing car.  警方拘留了这两名男子，就失踪汽车一事问话。

manumit.example: The dying planter chose to manumit every slave who had worked his fields.  这位垂死的种植园主决定解放所有为他耕作过的奴隶。

dissuade.example: His parents tried to dissuade him from leaving school before the final term.  他父母试图劝他不要在最后一学期前退学。

spur.example: Rising exports acted as a powerful spur to industrial growth.  出口增长成为工业发展的强大刺激因素。

persuade.example: Nothing could persuade the stubborn old farmer to sell.  没什么能说服这位固执的老农出售土地。

inducement.example: Free housing was the main inducement for teachers to move.  免费住房是吸引教师迁来的主要诱因。

incentive.example: Tax breaks gave farmers a strong incentive to plant native trees.  税收减免给了农民种植本土树木的强烈诱因。

devolution.example: Critics blamed the devolution of the service on constant cuts.  批评者把服务水平的退化归咎于不断削减。

improvement.example: The new coach brought a marked improvement in team defense.  新教练让球队防守有了明显改善。

recovery.example: Doctors expect a full recovery within about three months.  医生预计约三个月内完全康复。

recuperation.example: He spent the summer in quiet recuperation beside the sea.  他在海边安静休养度过整个夏天。

rehabilitation.example: The old mill's rehabilitation took four years and much money.  这座旧磨坊的修复花了四年和许多钱。

revitalization.example: The festival began the revitalization of the sleepy river town.  这个节庆开启了沉寂河镇的复兴。

detour.example: Roadworks forced us to take a long detour through the hills.  道路施工迫使我们绕道穿越丘陵走了很远。

deflection.example: A tiny deflection of the beam ruined the whole measurement.  光束的微小偏离毁了整次测量。

departure.example: The ruling marks a sharp departure from earlier court practice.  该裁决明显偏离了此前的法院惯例。

divergency.example: A slight divergency in the two accounts troubled the judge.  两份陈述的细微分歧让法官不安。

dispraise.example: Reviewers dispraised the novel for its clumsy final chapter.  评论者因结尾笨拙而贬低这部小说。

write off.example: Coaches wrote off the young rookie far too early.  教练们过早地否定了这名年轻新人。

panegyrize.example: Court poets panegyrized the emperor in long ceremonial odes.  宫廷诗人以长篇颂歌赞颂皇帝。

detritus.example: The beach was littered with the detritus of the summer crowds.  海滩上散落着夏日人群留下的垃圾碎屑。

residue.example: A dark residue remained at the bottom of the flask.  烧瓶底部留下了深色的残留物。

wreck.example: Divers photographed the wreck lying deep on the sandy bottom.  潜水员拍摄了深卧沙底的残骸。

valuable product.example: The refinery turns waste gas into a valuable product.  炼厂把废气变成有价值的产品。

devoted.example: She is a devoted teacher who remembers every student by name.  她是位投入的教师，能叫出每个学生的名字。

dedicated.example: She is dedicated to protecting the birds of this marsh.  她致力于保护这片沼泽的鸟类。

devout.example: His devout aunt attended the little chapel every single morning.  他虔诚的姑妈每天早晨都去那间小教堂。

pious.example: The pious old woman attended the early service every single morning.  那位虔诚的老妇人每天早上都参加早祷。

staunch.example: A staunch supporter of reform, she never wavered under public pressure.  作为改革的坚定支持者，她从未在公众压力下动摇。

faithless.example: The king punished his faithless advisers without any mercy.  国王毫不留情地惩罚了背信的谋臣。

perfidious.example: History remembers him as a perfidious partner in every treaty.  历史记住他是每份条约中背信弃义的伙伴。

unfaithful.example: He proved unfaithful to the promises he had already signed.  他背弃了自己已签下的承诺。

ham-fisted.example: His ham-fisted repair left the old clock worse than before.  他笨拙的修理让旧钟比之前更糟。

silly.example: It was silly to climb that tall ladder without help.  没人帮忙就爬那么高的梯子太傻了。

unwise.example: Borrowing more money now would be deeply unwise.  现在再借钱是很不明智的。

diabolic.example: The villain's diabolic plan was to poison the town's water supply.  那个恶棍恶魔般的计划是给全镇的水源下毒。

demoniac.example: The painting shows a demoniac figure crouching in the shadows.  画中有个恶魔般的身影蹲在阴影里。

demonian.example: Villagers spoke of a demonian shape haunting the burned mill.  村民谈起一个恶魔似的影子出没于烧毁的磨坊。

demonic.example: He worked with demonic energy until the mural was finished.  他以狂热的精力工作，直到壁画完成。

satanic.example: The film invents a satanic cult hidden beneath the city.  影片虚构了藏在城市之下的邪恶教派。

angelic.example: The child sang with an angelic clarity that hushed everyone.  孩子的歌声清澈如天使，让所有人安静。

seraphic.example: She listened with a seraphic calm that surprised the room.  她带着天使般的平静聆听，令全场惊讶。

diaphanous.example: She wore a diaphanous scarf that barely shaded her from the sun.  她戴着一条几乎透明的纱巾，几乎挡不住阳光。
diaphanous.cn: 几乎透明的；模糊的，非实在的

vague.example: His vague answer told the reporters almost nothing about the plan.  他含糊的回答几乎没有向记者透露任何计划内容。

unexplicit.example: The contract stayed unexplicit about who paid for repairs.  合同对谁支付修理费始终含糊。

insubstantial.example: His case rested on insubstantial rumor rather than real documents.  他的论据靠的是虚无的传言而非真实文件。

translucent.example: Morning light glowed softly through the translucent paper screens.  晨光柔和地透过半透明的纸屏。

transpicuous.example: His transpicuous explanation made the hard theorem suddenly obvious.  他明白易懂的讲解让难懂的定理忽然清晰。

gossamer.example: Her gossamer scarf floated on the breeze like a wisp of smoke.  她轻薄如蝉翼的围巾在微风中飘动，像一缕青烟。

opaque.example: The regulations remain opaque even to experienced tax lawyers.  这些法规连资深税务律师都觉得晦涩。

impermeable of light.example: The vault walls are impermeable of light and sound alike.  库房的墙壁既不透光也不透声。

diatribe.example: His speech turned into a long diatribe against modern popular music.  他的演讲变成了对现代流行音乐的长篇抨击。

tirade.example: The coach launched an angry tirade against the referee's decision.  教练对裁判的判罚发起愤怒的长篇抨击。

harangue.example: The manager harangued his staff for twenty minutes about missed deadlines.  经理就错过截止日期的事对员工发表了二十分钟的长篇训话。

jeremiad.example: His column became a weekly jeremiad about modern manners.  他的专栏成了每周对现代风气的哀叹式抨击。

philippic.example: The senator's philippic against the bill lasted two full hours.  这位参议员抨击该法案的演说整整两小时。

rant.example: The coach went on a long rant about the team's careless defending.  教练就球队漫不经心的防守训斥了很久。

didactic.example: The story is charming, though its ending is rather heavily didactic.  这个故事很动人，只是结尾说教味相当重。

homiletic.example: The novel turns homiletic whenever the narrator discusses money.  每当叙述者谈钱，小说就变得说教。

preachy.example: Readers disliked the preachy final chapter of the book.  读者不喜欢书中爱说教的最后一章。

moralistic.example: Her moralistic reading of the fable annoyed the students.  她对寓言的道德说教式解读让学生反感。

sententious.example: The old judge grew sententious after his second glass of wine.  老法官喝了第二杯酒后满口格言说教。

undidactic.example: Children prefer an undidactic story that simply entertains them.  孩子更喜欢单纯有趣、不说教的故事。

old-fashioned.example: His old-fashioned views on marriage puzzled his own children.  他守旧的婚姻观让自己的孩子困惑。

ultraconservative.cn: 极端保守的；极端保守者
ultraconservative.example: The party's ultraconservative wing blocked every proposed reform.  该党极端保守的一翼阻挠了每项改革提议。

liberal.example: His liberal social views often surprised the older members of the club.  他前卫的社会观念常常让俱乐部里年长的成员感到意外。

nonconservative.example: Younger voters favored the nonconservative candidate by wide margins.  年轻选民以巨大优势支持这位非保守派候选人。

open-minded.example: A good reviewer stays open-minded about unfamiliar musical styles.  好的评论者对陌生的音乐风格保持开明。

peaceful.example: Both sides finally chose a peaceful path out of conflict.  双方最终选择了走出冲突的和平道路。

pacifist.cn: 和平主义者；和平主义的
pacifist.example: As a pacifist he refused to carry any weapon.  作为和平主义者，他拒绝携带任何武器。

peaceable.example: The peaceable villagers settled disputes without ever calling police.  这些平和的村民解决纠纷从不报警。

bloodthirsty.example: The chronicle describes a bloodthirsty king who spared nobody.  编年史描写了一位不留活口的嗜杀国王。

hawkish.example: The new adviser took a hawkish line on the border.  新顾问在边境问题上持鹰派立场。

warlike.example: Ancient writers portrayed the tribe as fiercely warlike.  古代作家把这个部族描写得极其好战。

diffuse.example: His argument was far too diffuse to convince a careful reader.  他的论证过于散漫，无法说服细心的读者。

circumlocutory.example: His circumlocutory answers hid a very simple refusal.  他绕弯子的答复掩盖了一个简单的拒绝。

long-winded.example: The chairman's long-winded report emptied half the meeting room.  主席冗长的报告让会场走了一半人。

prolix.example: The judge criticized the prolix brief for burying its argument.  法官批评这份冗长的书状埋没了自己的论点。

verbose.example: Her verbose report could have said the same thing in two pages.  她冗长的报告本可以用两页说完同样的内容。

windy.example: His windy speech said very little in more than an hour.  他冗长的演讲讲了一个多小时却几乎没什么内容。

spread.example: Rumors spread through the office faster than the memo did.  谣言在办公室传得比通知还快。

disseminate.example: The society disseminated the findings to schools across the country.  学会把研究结果传播到全国各地的学校。

pithy.example: Her pithy summary captured the whole debate in two sentences.  她简练的总结用两句话概括了整场辩论。

terse.example: His terse note said only that the deal had collapsed.  他简短的字条只说交易破裂了。

center.example: The report centers its argument on three very clear examples.  报告把论点集中在三个非常清晰的例子上。

centralize.example: The reform centralized purchasing in a single national office.  改革把采购集中到一个全国性机构。

excurse.example: The lecturer excursed happily into stories about his childhood.  讲师愉快地离题讲起童年的故事。

get off the subject.example: Please try not to get off the subject today.  今天请尽量不要跑题。

discursive.example: His discursive account wandered from wine to politics and never reached a point.  他杂乱的叙述从红酒扯到政治，始终没讲到重点。

dilapidate.example: Years of neglect had dilapidated the once elegant mansion beyond any hope of repair.  多年疏于照管使这座曾经典雅的宅邸破败得无法修复。

be in use.example: The stone bridge is still in use after four centuries.  这座石桥四百年后仍在使用。

dilate.example: The doctor used drops to dilate her pupils before examining the retina.  医生先用药水扩大她的瞳孔，再检查视网膜。

dilatory.example: His dilatory response to the complaint annoyed every member of the committee.  他对投诉迟迟不作回应，令委员会每位成员恼火。

delaying.example: The defense filed one delaying motion after another.  辩方接连提出拖延性的动议。

procrastinating.example: His procrastinating habits cost the team an entire week.  他拖拉的习惯让团队损失了整整一周。

dragging.example: The dragging trial exhausted witnesses on both sides.  拖沓的审判耗尽了双方证人的精力。

lagging.example: Managers worried about the lagging performance of two branches.  经理们担心两家分店迟缓的业绩。

tardy.example: The company's tardy response angered customers waiting for their refunds.  公司迟缓的回应让等退款的顾客很生气。

rapid.example: The city saw rapid change after the railway finally arrived.  铁路终于通达后这座城市迅速变化。

fast.example: He is a fast worker who finishes every job ahead of schedule.  他做事很快，每项工作都提前完成。

fleet.example: The fleet young messenger crossed the valley before dark.  这位迅捷的年轻信使天黑前穿过了山谷。

rocketing.example: Rocketing fuel costs forced the airline to cancel routes.  飞涨的燃油成本迫使航空公司取消航线。

swift.example: Her swift decision saved the patient a great deal of pain.  她迅速的决定让病人少受许多痛苦。

hasty.example: A hasty decision made in anger often costs far more later.  盛怒之下作出的轻率决定往往日后代价更大。

hurrying.example: Hurrying passengers pushed past us toward the last train.  匆忙的乘客挤过我们奔向末班车。

scurrying.example: We heard scurrying mice behind the thin kitchen wall.  我们听见薄薄的厨房墙后有老鼠急窜。

dilettante.example: As a mere dilettante in astronomy, he owned a telescope but read little.  作为天文学上的业余涉猎者，他有望远镜却几乎不读书。
dilettante.cn: 浅尝辄止的业余爱好者；不专业的

dabbler.cn: 浅尝辄止者，业余涉猎者
dabbler.example: He remained a cheerful dabbler in half a dozen crafts.  他一直是好几门手艺的快乐业余涉猎者。

nonprofessional.example: The choir warmly welcomes nonprofessional singers of every age.  这个合唱团热情欢迎各年龄的非专业歌手。

pro.cn: 职业选手，专业人士；赞成的
pro.example: She played like a seasoned pro in her first tournament.  她首次参赛就打得像老练的职业选手。

professional.example: Only a professional could repair such a delicate mechanism.  只有专业人士才能修好如此精密的机构。

engaged.example: She was engaged in fieldwork throughout the entire rainy season.  整个雨季她都忙于野外调查。

hopping.example: The little diner was hopping from dawn until midnight.  这家小餐馆从清晨忙到午夜。

tied-up.cn: 忙得不可开交的；被占用的
tied-up.example: The manager is tied-up in meetings until late tonight.  经理要开会一直忙到今晚深夜。

thin.example: Thin the sauce with a little warm water before serving.  上菜前用少量温水把酱汁调稀。

densify.example: Engineers densify the powder before pressing it into blocks.  工程师在压块前先把粉末致密化。

thicken.example: Stir in a little flour to thicken the gravy.  拌入少许面粉让肉汁变稠。

lessen.example: Simple exercises lessen the pain in his stiff shoulder.  简单的锻炼减轻了他僵硬肩膀的疼痛。

lower.example: The bank lowered interest rates twice in one year.  银行一年内两次降低利率。

increase.example: Sales increased steadily after the store extended its opening hours.  延长营业时间后销量稳步增长。

disquisition.example: He delivered a long disquisition on art that lasted well past midnight.  他就艺术作了长篇论述，一直讲到午夜之后。

delving.example: Her patient delving into archives uncovered the forgotten letters.  她耐心钻研档案，发现了被遗忘的信件。

inquiry.example: Parliament ordered an inquiry into the collapse of the bridge.  议会下令调查那座桥的倒塌。

examination.example: A close examination of the ledger revealed two false entries.  仔细审查账簿发现了两笔假账。

exploration.example: The book is a careful exploration of rural childhood memory.  这本书是对乡村童年记忆的细致探索。

inquisition.example: The interview felt less like a chat than an inquisition.  这次面谈不像聊天，倒像审问。

probing.example: Her probing questions forced the witness to explain everything.  她深入的追问迫使证人解释一切。

dingy.example: They rented a dingy little room whose single window faced a brick wall.  他们租了一间昏暗肮脏的小屋，唯一的窗户对着一堵砖墙。

darkened.example: We felt along the darkened hallway toward the narrow stairs.  我们沿着昏暗的走廊摸向窄楼梯。

dirty.example: The children came home with dirty hands and happy faces.  孩子们回家时手很脏，脸上却很开心。

bedraggled.cn: 湿透脏污的，破旧不整的
bedraggled.example: The bedraggled dog waited patiently outside the bakery door.  那只又湿又脏的狗耐心等在面包店门外。

bemired.example: The bemired cart could not move another single meter.  沾满泥污的车再也挪不动一米。

besmirched.example: One careless lie left his besmirched name beyond repair.  一句大意的谎言让他受损的名声无法挽回。

dusty.example: We opened dusty boxes in the attic all afternoon.  我们整个下午在阁楼打开满是灰尘的箱子。

mucky.example: Their boots were mucky after crossing the flooded field.  穿过被淹的田地后他们的靴子满是污泥。

muddy.example: Vague statistics only muddy the argument instead of settling it.  含糊的统计数据只会把论点搅浑，而不能解决争论。

nasty.cn: 令人厌恶的，肮脏的；恶劣的
nasty.example: A nasty stain spread slowly across the pale carpet.  一块难看的污渍在浅色地毯上慢慢蔓延。

smudged.example: The smudged address made the letter impossible to deliver.  糊掉的地址让这封信无法投递。

soiled.example: Nurses collected the soiled sheets early every single morning.  护士每天清早收走脏污的床单。

sordid.example: They lived for years in a sordid little room without heat.  他们在没有暖气的肮脏小屋里住了多年。

stained.example: He hid the stained shirt at the back of the drawer.  他把有污渍的衬衫藏在抽屉最里面。

sullied.example: His sullied reputation never fully recovered after the scandal.  丑闻之后他被玷污的名声再也没有完全恢复。

clean.example: Keep the wound clean and change the bandage every day.  保持伤口干净，每天更换绷带。

cleanly.example: Cats are famously cleanly animals that groom themselves constantly.  猫是出名爱清洁的动物，不停梳理自己。

immaculate.example: After thirty years of service his record remained absolutely immaculate.  服务三十年后，他的记录依然毫无瑕疵。
immaculate.cn: 洁净无瑕的；完美无缺的

spotless.example: Her spotless kitchen shone under the bright evening light.  她一尘不染的厨房在明亮的夜灯下发亮。

stainless.example: The stainless surface showed not one mark after cooking.  烹饪后这块不锈表面没有一点痕迹。

unsoiled.example: Only one unsoiled napkin remained by the end of dinner.  晚餐结束时只剩一张未弄脏的餐巾。

unstained.example: He retired after forty unstained years of public service.  他在四十年毫无污点的公职之后退休。

unsullied.example: Her unsullied honesty made her the obvious choice for treasurer.  她未受玷污的诚实使她成为财务的当然人选。

diocesan.example: The bishop redrew the diocesan boundaries to serve the growing suburban parishes.  主教重划了教区边界，以服务日益扩大的郊区堂区。

ecumenical.example: An ecumenical council brought together leaders from every branch of the church.  一次世界性的宗教会议把教会各支派的领袖聚在一起。

diplomatic.example: Her diplomatic reply satisfied both sides without conceding anything of real importance.  她机智得体的回答让双方都满意，却没让出任何实质利益。

politic.example: It would not be politic to mention his failure at the dinner.  在晚宴上提他的失败并不明智。

gauche.example: His gauche remark about her salary embarrassed the whole table.  他关于她薪水的笨拙失礼的话让整桌人都很尴尬。

impolitic.example: It was impolitic to mention his failure at the party.  在聚会上提他的失败很不明智。

tactless.example: One tactless comment about her age spoiled the whole evening.  一句关于她年龄的不得体评论毁了整个晚上。

undiplomatic.example: His undiplomatic email offended half the department at once.  他不得体的邮件一下惹恼了半个部门。

untactful.example: Her untactful praise embarrassed everyone at the small table.  她不圆通的夸奖让小桌上的人都很尴尬。

dire.example: The report warned of dire consequences if the dam were not repaired soon.  报告警告说，若不尽快修复大坝，后果将十分可怕。

alarming.example: The alarming report described rivers drying up each summer.  这份骇人的报告描述河流每年夏天干涸。

direful.example: The old prophet issued direful warnings about the coming winter.  老先知对将至的冬天发出可怕的警告。

dread.example: The thought of another interview filled him with dread all weekend.  一想到还要再面试一次，他整个周末都充满恐惧。

fearsome.example: The boxer had a fearsome reputation long before this fight.  这名拳手在此战之前早已令人畏惧。

forbidding.example: The forbidding gray walls discouraged even the most curious tourists.  冷峻的灰墙让最好奇的游客都望而止步。

formidable.example: She faced a formidable opponent in the final round.  她在最后一轮遇到了难以对付的对手。
formidable.cn: 难以对付的，令人敬畏的

frightening.example: A frightening crack came from somewhere under the ice.  冰层下某处传来令人害怕的开裂声。

frightful.example: The storm did frightful damage to the small fishing harbor.  风暴给这个小渔港造成可怕的破坏。

ghastly.example: He turned a ghastly white when he heard the news.  他听到消息时脸色惨白。

hair-raising.example: She told a hair-raising story about the flooded coal mine.  她讲了一个关于被淹煤矿的骇人故事。

horrendous.example: The team suffered a horrendous defeat in the opening match.  球队在首场比赛中惨败。

horrible.example: The soup tasted horrible but nobody dared say so.  汤的味道很糟，但没人敢说出来。

horrifying.example: Rescuers described horrifying scenes inside the collapsed apartment block.  救援人员描述了倒塌公寓楼内令人震惊的景象。

intimidating.example: The examiner's intimidating stare made the candidate forget everything.  主考官令人发怵的注视让考生忘了一切。

redoubtable.example: She faced a redoubtable rival in the final round of the tournament.  她在锦标赛决赛轮中遇上一位令人敬畏的对手。

scary.example: The rope bridge looked scary but felt perfectly solid underfoot.  那座绳桥看着吓人，踩上去却很稳。

terrible.example: They lost everything in a terrible fire last winter.  去年冬天一场可怕的火灾让他们失去一切。

terrifying.example: Landing in that storm was the most terrifying moment yet.  在那场风暴中降落是至今最恐怖的时刻。

immediate.example: The village has an immediate need for clean drinking water.  这个村子迫切需要干净的饮用水。

burning.example: Housing remains the burning issue in this crowded district.  住房仍是这个拥挤城区最迫切的问题。

crying.example: There is a crying need for more rural doctors.  乡村医生的需求十分迫切。

emergent.example: Doctors must act fast in an emergent situation like this one.  在这样的紧急情况下医生必须迅速行动。

exigent.example: The exigent shortage of water forced the city to ration supplies.  紧急的缺水迫使该市实行配给。

imperative.example: It is imperative that we repair the dam before the rains arrive.  在雨季来临前修好大坝是迫切必需的。

importunate.cn: 迫切的；胡缠的，纠缠不休的
importunate.example: The importunate beggar followed us down the whole street.  那个纠缠不休的乞丐跟着我们走了一整条街。

instant.example: The letter spoke of an instant need for medical supplies.  信中提到对医疗物资的紧急需求。

necessitous.example: The charity was founded to help necessitous widows and orphans.  该慈善机构成立时旨在帮助贫困的寡妇和孤儿。

pressing.example: Housing remains the most pressing issue for the new mayor.  住房仍是新市长最紧迫的问题。

urgent.example: She sent an urgent message asking for immediate help.  她发了一条紧急消息请求立刻援助。

nonurgent.example: Nonurgent surgeries were postponed until the following month.  非紧急的手术被推迟到了下个月。

noncritical.example: Noncritical systems can be shut down during the upgrade.  非关键系统可以在升级期间关闭。

demography.example: Shifts in demography will reshape the country's schools within twenty years.  人口结构的变化将在二十年内重塑这个国家的学校。

disabuse.example: It took hours to disabuse him of the notion that the test was simple.  花了好几个小时才打消他认为考试很简单的错误念头。

disenchant.example: Years in politics disenchanted her with grand promises.  多年从政使她对宏大承诺不再抱幻想。

lead into error.example: A careless translation can lead readers into error about the author's meaning.  草率的翻译会使读者误解作者的意思。

disaffected.example: Disaffected young workers left the union and formed a committee of their own.  心生不满的年轻工人退出工会，自行组成了一个委员会。

discontented.example: Low pay left the staff increasingly discontented with management.  低薪使员工对管理层越来越不满。

dissatisfy.example: The vague reply seemed only to dissatisfy the audience further.  含糊的回答似乎只让听众更加不满。

satisfied.example: She looked satisfied with the results of the experiment.  她对实验结果看上去很满意。

contented.example: He lived a quiet, contented life in the countryside.  他在乡下过着平静而满足的生活。

disarm.example: His frank apology disarmed the critics who had come prepared to attack him.  他坦诚的道歉平息了那些原本准备攻击他的批评者。
disarm.cn: 使息怒，消除敌意；解除武装

anger.example: His dismissive remarks angered nearly everyone in the room.  他轻蔑的言论几乎激怒了在场所有人。

enflame.example: The rumor only enflamed the anger of the protesters outside.  那个谣言只是激起了外面抗议者的怒火。

ire.example: The new tax drew the ire of small business owners.  新税收招致了小企业主的愤怒。

madden.example: The endless delays maddened passengers waiting at the gate.  无休止的延误让在登机口等待的乘客怒不可遏。

confusion.example: There was total confusion at the station after the announcement.  广播之后车站里一片混乱。

disarrangement.example: The disarrangement of the files suggested someone had searched the office.  文件的杂乱表明有人搜查过办公室。

disorder.example: The room was left in complete disorder after the party.  聚会之后房间被弄得一片混乱。

disorderliness.example: The disorderliness of his notes made the argument hard to follow.  他笔记的杂乱让论证难以理解。

disorganization.example: The sudden resignation caused months of disorganization in the office.  突然的辞职给办公室带来数月的混乱。

mess.example: The kitchen was a terrible mess when the children finished baking.  孩子们烤完点心后厨房一片狼藉。

messiness.example: He apologized for the messiness of his handwriting in the notes.  他为笔记中字迹的凌乱表示抱歉。

misorder.example: A single misorder of the steps ruined the whole experiment.  步骤的一处错序毁了整个实验。

muss.example: The wind mussed his carefully combed hair in seconds.  风几秒钟就吹乱了他精心梳理的头发。

shambles.example: The project was in a shambles after the funding was cut.  资金被削减后项目一片混乱。

jumble.example: Her drawer held a jumble of receipts, coins, and old keys.  她的抽屉里杂乱地堆着收据、硬币和旧钥匙。

welter.example: The report buried its main point in a welter of small details.  这份报告把要点埋在了杂乱的琐碎细节之中。

disorganize.example: The storm disorganized every flight leaving the airport that day.  风暴打乱了那天所有离港航班。

disrupt.example: Protesters disrupted the ceremony by shouting from the balcony.  抗议者在楼上喊叫，扰乱了典礼。

hash.example: He made a complete hash of the presentation yesterday.  他昨天把演讲搞得一团糟。

scramble.example: The software scrambles the letters so the message stays private.  该软件打乱字母顺序以保证消息私密。

mix up.example: I always mix up the twins when they wear the same jacket.  这对双胞胎穿同样的外套时我总会认错。

orderliness.example: Visitors admired the orderliness of the small library.  参观者赞叹这座小图书馆的井然有序。

disavow.example: The senator moved quickly to disavow any knowledge of the secret payments.  参议员迅速表态，否认知晓那些秘密付款。

disaffirm.example: The court may disaffirm a contract signed by a minor.  法院可以否定未成年人签署的合同。

disclaim.example: The company quickly disclaimed any link to the failed venture.  公司迅速否认与那个失败项目有任何关联。

disconfirm.example: New data disconfirmed the theory proposed a decade earlier.  新数据否证了十年前提出的理论。

negate.example: One careless error can negate weeks of careful work.  一个粗心的错误能抹掉数周的细致工作。

discern.example: Even experts could barely discern a pattern in the scattered rainfall data.  就连专家也几乎辨不出这些零散降雨数据中的规律。

behold.example: The travelers stopped to behold the valley below them.  旅人们停下来注视脚下的山谷。

descry.example: From the cliff we could descry a boat on the horizon.  从悬崖上我们能看见地平线上的一只小船。

distinguish.example: Young children cannot always distinguish fantasy from reality.  幼儿并不总能区分幻想与现实。

espy.example: From the hilltop we could espy a thin column of smoke.  从山顶上我们能看见一缕细细的炊烟。

differentiate.example: It is hard to differentiate the two brands by taste alone.  仅凭味道很难区分这两个品牌。

discriminate.example: Young children can already discriminate between the two shades of blue.  幼儿已经能够区分这两种深浅不同的蓝色。

insightful.example: Her insightful reading of the poem impressed the whole class.  她对这首诗富有洞见的解读让全班佩服。

incisive.example: Her incisive questions exposed the weakness of the proposal.  她敏锐的提问暴露了该提案的弱点。

myopic.example: The city's myopic policy on housing ignored problems that residents saw daily.  这座城市在住房上缺乏远见的政策忽视了居民每天都看得见的问题。

shortsighted.cn: 短视的，缺乏远见的；近视的
shortsighted.example: Cutting research funding now would be extremely shortsighted.  现在削减研究经费是极其短视的。

indiscernible.example: The change in color was almost indiscernible to the naked eye.  颜色的变化用肉眼几乎辨别不出。

disenthrall.example: Education can disenthrall people from inherited prejudice.  教育能使人摆脱继承来的偏见。

emancipate.example: The new law emancipated the slaves working on the northern plantations.  新法律解放了在北方种植园劳作的奴隶。

enfranchise.example: The amendment enfranchised millions of citizens for the first time.  该修正案首次赋予数百万公民选举权。

loose.example: The keeper loosed the hawk and watched it climb into the sky.  饲养员放开那只鹰，看它飞向天空。

spring.example: His lawyer managed to spring him from custody within a week.  他的律师在一周内把他从拘留中弄了出来。

unbind.example: She knelt down to unbind the wounded man's hands.  她跪下来解开那名伤者被绑的双手。

uncage.example: The volunteers uncaged the rescued parrots at dawn.  志愿者在黎明时把获救的鹦鹉放出笼子。

unfetter.example: The reform unfettered small firms and let them compete freely.  改革解除了对小企业的束缚，让它们自由竞争。

employ.example: The factory employs nearly six hundred workers in this town.  这家工厂在本镇雇用了近六百名工人。

engage.example: They engaged a local guide to lead them through the forest.  他们聘请了一位当地导游带他们穿过森林。

hire.example: The bakery decided to hire two more people before the holidays.  面包店决定在假期前再雇两个人。

take on.example: The firm plans to take on twenty interns this summer.  公司计划今年夏天招收二十名实习生。

sign up.example: The club signed up three young goalkeepers last month.  俱乐部上个月签下了三名年轻门将。

on.example: Two nurses are always on duty in the ward at night.  夜间病房里总有两名护士值班。

bind.example: The treaty binds both countries to reduce their emissions.  该条约约束两国削减排放。

enchain.example: Old habits can enchain a person more tightly than any rope.  旧习惯对人的束缚比任何绳索都紧。

acolyte.example: The senator arrived with three acolytes carrying his papers.  参议员带着三名随从进场，他们拿着他的文件。

adherent.example: The movement attracted thousands of adherents in a single year.  这场运动一年内就吸引了数千名拥护者。

epigone.example: Critics dismissed the painter as an epigone of the great masters.  批评家把这位画家贬为大师的平庸模仿者。

votary.example: A lifelong votary of modern art, she visited the museum weekly.  作为现代艺术的终身崇拜者，她每周都去博物馆。

addle.example: Two nights without sleep had addled her thinking completely.  两夜没睡完全搞乱了她的思路。

fuddle.example: The lawyer's rapid questions fuddled the nervous witness.  律师快速的提问把紧张的证人问糊涂了。

gravel.example: His smug tone graveled everyone at the negotiating table.  他自鸣得意的语气惹恼了谈判桌上的每个人。

mystify.example: The sudden failure of the engine mystified the mechanics.  发动机的突然故障让机械师们十分困惑。

per-.example: The small room costs nine hundred dollars per month.  这个小房间每月租金九百美元。

plex.example: They bought a plex downtown and rented out three of the units.  他们在市中心买了一栋多户住宅，出租了其中三套。

coryphaeus.example: He served as coryphaeus, guiding the chorus through every entrance.  他担任领唱，引导合唱队完成每次进场。

discombobulate.example: The unexpected question completely discombobulated the young candidate.  这个意外的问题让年轻候选人彻底慌了。

embarrass.example: He tried to embarrass her in public and only embarrassed himself.  他想在公众面前让她尴尬，结果只是让自己出丑。

checkmate.example: A clever amendment checkmated the governor's entire plan.  一项巧妙的修正案彻底挫败了州长的全部计划。

further.example: She took the job abroad to further her research on glaciers.  她接受海外工作以推进她的冰川研究。

discommode.example: I hope the change of schedule will not discommode the guests too much.  希望日程变动不会给客人带来太多不便。

trouble.example: May I trouble you for directions to the train station?  能麻烦你告诉我去火车站的路吗？

incommode.example: The road work incommoded residents for nearly three months.  道路施工给居民带来了近三个月的不便。

put out.example: I hope my early arrival did not put you out too much.  希望我来得早没太麻烦你。

oblige.example: She asked for a second copy, and the clerk was glad to oblige.  她要了第二份，店员很乐意照办。

distemper.example: The long silence distempered everyone waiting in the hallway.  长久的沉默让走廊上等候的人都心烦意乱。

weird out.example: The empty hospital corridor really weirded us out at night.  夜里空荡的医院走廊让我们直发毛。

disarrange.example: The cat jumped up and disarranged every card on the table.  猫跳上来，把桌上的卡片全弄乱了。

range.example: He ranged the bottles along the shelf by size and color.  他把瓶子按大小和颜色沿着架子排好。

disaccord.example: His testimony was in clear disaccord with the written record.  他的证词与书面记录明显不一致。

disharmony.example: Years of disharmony finally split the once famous band.  多年的不和最终使这支曾经著名的乐队解散。

dissidence.example: The regime punished even mild dissidence among its writers.  该政权连作家中温和的异见也要惩罚。

dissonance.example: Cognitive dissonance arises when our actions contradict the beliefs we hold.  当行为与所持信念矛盾时，认知失调便产生了。
dissonance.cn: （音调）不和谐，刺耳；不一致，分歧

disunion.example: The debate over slavery pushed the nation toward disunion.  关于奴隶制的争论把这个国家推向分裂。

disunity.example: Open disunity among the leaders cost them the election.  领导层公开的不团结使他们输掉了选举。

division.example: There is deep division within the committee about the budget.  委员会内部在预算上存在深刻分歧。

friction.example: Constant friction between the two managers slowed the whole project.  两位经理之间不断的摩擦拖慢了整个项目。

schism.example: A bitter schism split the party into two hostile factions.  一场激烈的分裂把该党撕成两个敌对派系。

strife.example: Years of political strife left the country deeply exhausted.  多年的政治纷争使这个国家极度疲惫。

row.example: She had a furious row with her landlord about the unpaid repairs.  她和房东就未付款的维修大吵了一架。

cacophonous.example: The orchestra produced a cacophonous din while tuning up.  乐队调音时发出刺耳的嘈杂声。

disharmonic.example: The composer opened the piece with a deliberately disharmonic chord.  作曲家用一个刻意不和谐的和弦开始这首曲子。

disharmonious.example: Their disharmonious partnership collapsed within a single season.  他们不和的合作关系在一个赛季内就崩溃了。

concordance.example: The results show close concordance with earlier field studies.  结果显示与早期实地研究高度一致。

concordant.example: Both witnesses gave concordant accounts of that evening.  两位证人对那天晚上的叙述一致。

disgrace.cn: 使丢脸，使失去名誉；耻辱
disgrace.example: The scandal disgraced a politician once admired by everyone.  这桩丑闻让一位曾受众人敬仰的政客名誉扫地。

dishonor.example: Lying under oath would dishonor everything he had defended.  作伪证会玷污他一生所维护的一切。

shame.example: The teacher never tried to shame students in front of the class.  这位老师从不在全班面前羞辱学生。

distrust.example: Many villagers still distrust the promises made by developers.  许多村民仍不信任开发商的承诺。

believe.example: The jury seemed to believe every word of his testimony.  陪审团似乎相信他证词中的每一个字。

discrepancy.example: The auditors found a small discrepancy in the accounts of the charity.  审计人员在这家慈善机构的账目中发现了细小的差异。

contrast.example: There is a sharp contrast between his words and his actions.  他的言语与行为之间有鲜明的差异。

disparity.example: The report highlights a growing disparity between the two regions.  报告强调两个地区之间日益扩大的差距。

dissimilarity.example: Despite their shared origin, the dissimilarity of the two dialects is striking.  尽管同源，这两种方言的差异仍很惊人。

distance.example: There is still a considerable distance between his theory and the observed facts.  他的理论与观察到的事实之间仍有相当大的差距。

diversity.example: The reef supports a rich diversity of species found nowhere else on earth.  这片珊瑚礁养育着地球上别处没有的丰富物种多样性。

convergence.example: Recent talks show a slow convergence of the two positions.  近期会谈显示双方立场在缓慢趋同。

discrete.example: The program stores each measurement as discrete units of data on separate lines.  程序把每次测量作为离散的数据单元分行存储。

disconnected.example: His speech was a series of disconnected anecdotes.  他的演讲只是一串不连贯的轶事。

unattached.cn: 不相连的，独立的；未婚的
unattached.example: The scholar remained unattached to any university for years.  这位学者多年来不隶属于任何大学。

unconnected.example: Police believe the two robberies are entirely unconnected.  警方认为这两起抢劫毫无关联。

continuous.example: The machine has been in continuous operation for six days.  这台机器已连续运转六天。

discretion.example: You may spend the remaining funds at your own discretion this quarter.  本季度剩余的资金你可自行决定如何使用。

discreetness.example: His discreetness about the deal earned everyone's trust.  他对这笔交易的谨慎赢得了大家的信任。

prudence.example: Prudence suggests we wait for the full report before deciding.  谨慎起见，我们应等完整报告出来再决定。

continence.example: The monks were praised for their continence and quiet discipline.  僧侣们因节制与安静的自律而受称赞。

discipline.example: It takes real discipline to practice the violin every morning.  每天早晨练琴需要真正的自律。

refrainment.example: His refrainment from any complaint impressed the whole crew.  他对任何抱怨的克制让全体船员钦佩。

restraint.example: She showed remarkable restraint when the crowd booed her.  人群喝倒彩时她表现出惊人的克制。

self-control.example: It took every bit of my self-control not to answer him back.  忍住不回击他用尽了我全部的自制力。

self-restraint.example: The officers exercised admirable self-restraint during the protest.  警员在抗议期间表现出令人赞赏的自我克制。

imprudence.example: His imprudence with money ruined the small company.  他在金钱上的轻率毁了这家小公司。

indiscretion.example: One indiscretion in an interview cost him the appointment.  访谈中的一次失言让他失去了这个职位。

disinhibition.example: The drug can cause disinhibition in some elderly patients.  这种药会使部分老年患者失去自我抑制。

incontinence.example: His verbal incontinence at dinner embarrassed the whole family.  他晚餐时口无遮拦让全家尴尬。

discretionary.example: Managers have discretionary power over small purchases.  经理对小额采购有自主决定权。

elective.example: Most of the surgery performed here is elective, not urgent.  这里做的多数手术是可选择的，而非紧急的。

voluntary.example: Attendance at the evening seminar is entirely voluntary.  晚间研讨会完全自愿参加。

compulsory.example: Wearing a helmet is compulsory on every construction site.  在每个建筑工地戴安全帽都是强制的。

mandatory.example: Safety training is mandatory for all new employees here.  这里所有新员工都必须接受安全培训。

nonelective.example: The hospital continued nonelective procedures during the shortage.  医院在物资短缺期间继续进行非选择性手术。

nonvoluntary.example: Critics called the program nonvoluntary in everything but name.  批评者称这个项目除名义外都是非自愿的。

obligatory.example: In that country obligatory military service lasts for eighteen months.  在那个国家，强制的兵役要服十八个月。

required.example: A signed form is required before the trip can begin.  出行前必须提交一份签好的表格。

prejudiced.example: The judge dismissed the prejudiced juror before the trial began.  法官在审判开始前请走了那位有偏见的陪审员。

biased.example: Readers complained that the coverage was clearly biased.  读者抱怨这些报道明显带有偏见。

equitable.example: They finally reached an equitable division of the property.  他们最终达成了对财产的公平分配。

impartial.example: The dispute was settled by an impartial third party.  争端由一个公正的第三方解决。

unbiased.example: We need an unbiased assessment of the school's performance.  我们需要对这所学校表现的公正评估。

impersonal.cn: 客观的，不带个人感情的
impersonal.example: The report is written in a deliberately impersonal style.  这份报告刻意采用不带个人色彩的文体。

unprejudiced.example: Only an unprejudiced reader can judge the argument fairly.  只有无偏见的读者才能公正评判这个论证。

digressional.example: His digressional remarks made the lecture hard to follow.  他离题的评论让讲座难以跟上。

keen on title.example: He was always keen on title, though the job itself bored him.  他一向热衷头衔，尽管工作本身让他厌烦。

concentrated.example: The team made a concentrated effort to finish before Friday.  团队集中努力想在周五前完工。

contemn.example: He seemed to contemn every tradition the school held dear.  他似乎蔑视学校珍视的每一项传统。

disrespect.example: Interrupting her that way showed real disrespect.  那样打断她实在很不尊重人。

sniff.example: Wealthy collectors sniffed at the young artist's early work.  富有的收藏家对这位年轻艺术家的早期作品嗤之以鼻。

look down.example: She never looked down on people with less education.  她从不看不起受教育较少的人。

disengage.example: Both armies agreed to disengage from the conflict along the northern border.  双方军队同意从北部边境的冲突中脱离。

disentangle.example: It took hours to disentangle fact from rumor in the report.  在这份报告中把事实与谣言分开花了好几个小时。

untangle.example: The auditors are still trying to untangle the company's finances.  审计人员仍在努力理清这家公司的财务。

embroil.example: The memo embroiled the whole department in a bitter dispute.  那份备忘录把整个部门卷入了激烈的争执。

entangle.example: New objections entangled the negotiations and delayed the deal for weeks.  新的反对意见使谈判陷入纠缠，把交易推迟了数周。

disgorge.example: The overturned truck disgorged its contents across three lanes of the highway.  翻倒的卡车把车上的东西吐了一地，横跨三条车道。

belch.example: The old bus belched thick smoke as it climbed the hill.  那辆旧公交车爬坡时喷出浓烟。

eject.example: The machine ejected the disc with a loud click.  机器咔哒一声把光盘弹了出来。

eruct.example: The volcano eructed ash over the sleeping villages below.  火山向下方沉睡的村庄喷出火山灰。

jet.example: Hot water jetted from the crack in the old pipe.  热水从旧管道的裂缝中喷出。

spew.example: The chimney spewed gray smoke across the entire valley.  烟囱把灰烟喷向整个山谷。

spout.example: The whale surfaced and spouted a tall column of mist.  鲸鱼浮出水面，喷出一道高高的水雾。

swallow.example: He swallowed the bitter medicine without a word of complaint.  他一言不发地咽下了苦药。

ingest.example: Villagers who ingest contaminated water often develop serious stomach illnesses.  摄入受污染水源的村民常患严重的胃病。

displease.example: The change in schedule displeased nearly all the parents.  日程的变动让几乎所有家长不满。

please.example: The simple ending pleased readers far more than critics expected.  这个简单的结局比评论家预料的更让读者满意。

dignified.example: The old woman answered the insult with a dignified nod and left.  老妇人以庄重的一点头回应了侮辱，随后离开。

august.example: The august assembly of scholars rose when the old president entered.  当老校长进场时，这个威严的学者集会全体起立。

distinguished.example: The prize went to a distinguished historian of medieval law.  奖项授予一位杰出的中世纪法律史学家。

imposing.example: An imposing stone building dominates the square at the city center.  一座气势宏伟的石砌建筑主宰着市中心的广场。

solemn.example: The ceremony was solemn and lasted almost two hours.  仪式庄严肃穆，持续了近两个小时。

stately.example: A row of stately elms lined the road to the house.  一排庄严的榆树沿着通往房子的路排开。

disliking.example: He made no secret of his disliking for formal dinners.  他毫不掩饰对正式晚宴的厌恶。

disrelish.example: She agreed to speak, though with obvious disrelish.  她同意发言，但显然很不情愿。

mislike.example: The old captain misliked any change to the daily routine.  这位老船长厌恶日常安排的任何变动。

unwillingness.example: Their unwillingness to answer questions worried the investors.  他们不愿回答问题让投资者担忧。

flighty.example: She seemed flighty at first but proved remarkably reliable.  她起初显得轻浮，但事实证明非常可靠。

frivolous.example: The judge dismissed the frivolous lawsuit within a single morning.  法官在一个上午之内就驳回了这起无理的诉讼。

giddy.example: The giddy schoolgirls laughed through the entire serious lecture.  那些轻率的女学生在整场严肃的讲座中笑个不停。

undignified.example: The ministers made an undignified rush for the exit.  部长们不体面地冲向出口。

disinclination.example: His disinclination to speak in public cost him the promotion.  他不愿公开发言使他失去了升职机会。

appetite.example: The public has a huge appetite for stories about lost cities.  公众对失落之城的故事有极大兴趣。

fondness.example: He inherited his mother's fondness for long country walks.  他继承了母亲对乡间长途散步的喜爱。

liking.example: The dog took an immediate liking to our new neighbor.  这只狗立刻就喜欢上了我们的新邻居。

partiality.example: The coach was accused of partiality toward his own students.  教练被指责偏袒自己的学生。

preference.example: Most readers expressed a preference for the printed edition.  多数读者表示更偏好印刷版。

inclination.example: She had no inclination to argue with him that evening.  那天晚上她无意与他争辩。

disinfect.example: Nurses disinfect the wound carefully before applying a fresh bandage each morning.  护士每天早上换新纱布前都仔细给伤口消毒。

sterilize.example: Nurses sterilize every instrument before the operation begins.  护士在手术开始前给每件器械消毒。

disjointed.example: His disjointed narrative jumped between years and confused everyone in the room.  他不连贯的叙述在不同年份间跳跃，把在场的人都搞糊涂了。

coherent.example: He was too tired to give a coherent account of the accident.  他太累了，无法条理清晰地讲述事故。

connected.example: The two chapters are connected by a single recurring image.  这两章由一个反复出现的意象连接起来。

disinter.example: Archaeologists received permission to disinter the remains beneath the old chapel floor.  考古学家获准掘出旧礼拜堂地板下的遗骸。

unbury.example: Workers had to unbury the old pipeline before repairing it.  工人必须先挖出旧管道才能修理。

unearth.example: Archaeologists unearthed a marble head near the temple wall.  考古学家在神庙墙边挖出一个大理石头像。

bury.example: Squirrels bury nuts all over the garden every autumn.  松鼠每年秋天把坚果埋在花园各处。

inter.example: The villagers gathered at dawn to inter the body beside the old chapel.  村民们黎明时聚集，把遗体埋葬在古老的小教堂旁。

tomb.example: The tomb had lain untouched for more than two thousand years.  这座墓穴两千多年来未被触动。

inhume.example: The villagers inhumed their dead on the hillside above the river.  村民把亡者葬在河上方的山坡上。

disinterested.example: We need a disinterested judgment from someone with no stake in the outcome.  我们需要一个与结果无涉的人作出公正的判断。

evenhanded.example: The referee was praised for her evenhanded handling of the match.  裁判因公平处理这场比赛而受到称赞。

just.example: Everyone agreed the settlement was a just outcome.  所有人都认为这项和解是公正的结果。

nonpartisan.example: A nonpartisan panel was asked to redraw the district lines.  一个无党派小组被要求重划选区界线。

dispassionate.cn: 冷静客观的，不带感情的
dispassionate.example: The judge gave a dispassionate summary of both arguments.  法官冷静客观地总结了双方的论点。

objective.example: Reporters are expected to remain objective about the candidates.  记者应对候选人保持客观。

inequitable.example: Farmers called the water quotas deeply inequitable.  农民称这些用水配额极不公平。

nonobjective.example: Editors rejected the piece as a nonobjective attack on rivals.  编辑退了这篇稿子，认为它是对竞争对手的不客观攻击。

one-sided.example: The debate felt one-sided because only supporters were invited.  这场辩论显得片面，因为只邀请了支持者。

partial.example: The referee was clearly partial to the home team throughout the match.  整场比赛裁判明显偏袒主队。

unjust.example: Many considered the sentence unjust and demanded a new trial.  许多人认为判决不公，要求重审。

disjunctive.example: The two clauses form a disjunctive structure that offers readers a clear choice.  这两个分句构成分离的结构，给读者一个明确的选择。

disunited.example: A disunited opposition could not challenge the ruling coalition.  分裂的反对派无法挑战执政联盟。

jointed.example: The lamp has a jointed arm that folds against the wall.  这盏灯有一支可折向墙面的接合式支臂。

dismantle.example: Mechanics had to dismantle the engine completely to find the cracked valve.  机修工只得把发动机完全拆解，才找到那个开裂的气门。

knock down.example: They knocked down the old barn and sold the timber.  他们拆掉了旧谷仓并卖掉了木料。

chill.example: The news of the layoffs chilled everyone in the office.  裁员的消息让办公室里的每个人都心生寒意。

unsettle.example: The sudden change of plan unsettled the younger students.  计划的突然变动让年幼的学生们不安。

dissimilar.example: The two novels treat love in dissimilar ways.  这两部小说以不同的方式处理爱情。

diverse.example: The class brings together students from diverse cultural backgrounds.  这个班汇集了来自不同文化背景的学生。

nonidentical.example: The two samples proved nonidentical under the microscope.  显微镜下这两个样本被证明并不相同。

unalike.example: The brothers looked similar but were entirely unalike in temper.  兄弟俩外貌相似，但性情完全不同。

unpreju-.example: The line break split the word unpreju- across two printed pages.  换行把 unpreju- 一词拆到了两页印刷页上。

diced.cn: 切成小方块的；（断词后半）
diced.example: Add the diced potatoes to the pot and simmer gently.  把切丁的马铃薯加进锅里小火慢煮。

alike.example: The two paintings look alike until you study the brushwork.  这两幅画看起来相像，直到你细看笔法。

kindred.example: We recognized each other as kindred spirits within the first five minutes.  头五分钟我们就认出彼此是志趣相投的人。

like.example: They were of like mind on almost every important question.  他们在几乎所有重要问题上想法相似。

parallel.example: Historians found a parallel case in a much earlier war.  历史学家在一场更早的战争中找到了类似的例子。

same.example: Both machines run at the same speed under normal load.  两台机器在正常负载下以相同速度运行。

similar.example: The two species are similar in size but differ in color.  这两个物种大小相似，但颜色不同。

dispatch.example: The courier handled the urgent order with great dispatch and no complaints.  快递员极为迅速地处理了这份紧急订单，毫无怨言。

haste.example: In her haste she left the tickets on the kitchen table.  她匆忙之中把票忘在了厨房桌上。

swiftness.example: Everyone admired the swiftness of the rescue team's arrival.  所有人都赞叹救援队到达之迅速。

expedition.example: The clerk processed our papers with surprising expedition.  职员以惊人的速度处理了我们的文件。

promptitude.example: She answered every letter with unusual promptitude.  她以异常的迅速回复每一封信。

transfer.example: The bank will transfer the money to her account tomorrow.  银行明天会把钱转到她的账户。

transmit.example: The station transmits its broadcast to villages across the valley.  该电台把节目发送到山谷各处的村庄。

transport.example: Trucks transport fresh produce to the city every morning.  卡车每天早晨把新鲜农产品运往城市。

pack off.example: His parents packed him off to boarding school at twelve.  他十二岁时被父母送去了寄宿学校。

leisureliness.example: He worked with a leisureliness that infuriated his supervisor.  他工作时的悠然自得让主管十分恼火。

procrastination.example: Months of procrastination left the report unfinished.  数月的拖延使报告仍未完成。

receive.example: She received the letter three weeks after it was posted.  这封信寄出三周后她才收到。

dispose.example: Volunteers helped dispose of the waste left behind after the summer festival.  志愿者帮忙处理掉夏日节庆后留下的废弃物。

willing.example: Several neighbors were willing to look after the children.  几位邻居都愿意照看孩子。

predisposed.example: Readers were already predisposed to accept his conclusions.  读者本就倾向于接受他的结论。

prone.example: Handwritten records are prone to error and hard to search.  手写记录容易出错且难以检索。

heed.example: Few sailors heeded the warning about the coming storm.  很少有水手留意关于风暴来临的警告。

mind.example: Please mind the gap between the train and the platform.  请注意列车与站台之间的空隙。

attend to.example: A nurse stayed to attend to the patient through the night.  一位护士留下整夜照料这名病人。

dissect.example: Critics dissected the argument line by line and exposed its hidden assumptions.  批评者逐句剖析该论点，揭出其隐含的假设。

analyze.example: The team spent weeks analyzing data from the survey.  团队花了数周分析调查数据。

dissemble.example: He tried to dissemble his true motive, but his trembling hands betrayed him.  他试图掩饰真实动机，但颤抖的双手泄露了他。

dissimulate.example: He tried to dissimulate his disappointment with a thin smile.  他试图用一丝浅笑掩饰失望。

affect.example: She affected surprise, though she had known for weeks.  她装作惊讶，其实早已知情数周。

behave honestly.example: He promised to behave honestly even when no one was watching.  他承诺即使无人注视也诚实行事。

gather.example: Volunteers gathered signatures outside the library all weekend.  志愿者整个周末在图书馆外收集签名。

discordancy.example: Growing discordancy among the founders slowed every decision.  创始人之间日增的不和让每个决定都拖延。

nonconcur.example: Two members formally nonconcurred with the committee's recommendation.  两名成员正式表示不同意委员会的建议。

heterodoxy.example: The bishop condemned her writings as dangerous heterodoxy.  主教谴责她的著作是危险的异端邪说。

nonconformity.example: Her nonconformity made her unpopular with the school administration.  她的不合常规使她不受校方欢迎。

conformity.example: The company demands strict conformity to its dress code.  公司要求严格遵守其着装规范。

squander.example: Do not squander this opportunity to study abroad for a year.  不要浪费这次出国留学一年的机会。

conserve.example: We must conserve water during the long summer drought.  漫长的夏季干旱期间我们必须节约用水。

dissolute.example: The novel follows a dissolute lifestyle of late nights and squandered fortunes.  小说描写了通宵纵乐、挥霍家财的放荡生活方式。

dissipated.example: Years of dissipated living had ruined his health completely.  多年放荡的生活彻底毁了他的健康。

libertine.example: The play portrays an unrepentant libertine who ruins everyone around him.  这部戏刻画了一个毁掉身边所有人的不知悔改的放荡者。

rakish.example: His rakish reputation kept respectable families from inviting him to dinner.  他放荡不检的名声使正派家庭不愿请他吃饭。

stoic.example: Her stoic acceptance of pain impressed even the veteran nurses.  她隐忍地承受痛苦，连资深护士都为之动容。

spartan.example: The monks lived in spartan rooms with only a bed and a lamp.  僧侣们住在只有一床一灯的简朴房间里。

uncorrupted.example: He remained uncorrupted despite decades in machine politics.  尽管在政治机器中浸泡数十年，他仍未被腐蚀。

disintegrate.example: The old manuscript began to disintegrate the moment we touched it.  我们一碰那份古老手稿，它就开始碎裂。

freeze.example: The pond will freeze if the temperature drops below zero tonight.  如果今晚气温降到零度以下，池塘会结冰。

unify.example: A common language helped unify the scattered tribes into one nation.  共同的语言帮助把分散的部落统一为一个民族。

distain.example: Rumors spread by his rivals distained his good name for many years.  对手散布的谣言多年来一直损害着他的好名声。

distal.example: The surgeon examined the distal end of the broken bone under bright light.  外科医生在强光下检查断骨的远端。

proximal.example: Surgeons repaired the proximal portion of the fractured bone.  外科医生修复了骨折骨头的近端部分。

distend.example: Too much gas can distend the stomach and cause considerable discomfort.  气体过多会使胃膨胀，引起相当的不适。

distill.example: Engineers built a plant to distill seawater into freshwater for the island.  工程师建了一座工厂，把海水蒸馏成淡水供岛上使用。

filter.example: This device filters out impurities before the water reaches the tank.  这个装置在水进入水箱前滤除杂质。

refine.example: The plant refines crude oil into gasoline and other useful products.  这家工厂把原油提炼成汽油和其他有用的产品。

misinterpret.example: Readers often misinterpret irony as sincere praise.  读者常把讽刺误解为真诚的赞美。

misrepresent.example: Critics accused the report of misrepresenting the facts to favor one side.  批评者指责这份报告歪曲事实以偏向一方。

pervert.example: Lawyers accused him of trying to pervert the truth in court.  律师指控他试图在法庭上曲解真相。

twist.example: Do not twist my words to suit your own argument.  不要为了你自己的论点曲解我的话。

distract.example: Loud music can easily distract the driver on an unfamiliar mountain road.  在陌生的山路上，大声的音乐很容易使司机分心。

rapt.example: The children listened with rapt attention as the old sailor spoke.  老水手讲述时，孩子们全神贯注地听着。

agitated.example: She grew agitated when the police refused to answer her questions.  警察拒绝回答她的问题时，她变得焦躁不安。

delirious.cn: 神志昏乱的；极度兴奋的
delirious.example: The patient was delirious and kept calling out strange names.  病人神志不清，不停地喊出奇怪的名字。

distracted.example: He seemed distracted during the meeting and answered questions vaguely.  会上他显得心不在焉，回答问题含糊其辞。

frenzied.example: Traders made frenzied attempts to sell before the market closed.  交易员在收市前疯狂地尝试抛售。

hysterical.cn: 情绪失控的，歇斯底里的
hysterical.example: The child grew hysterical when she lost sight of her mother.  孩子看不见母亲时变得歇斯底里。

collected.example: She stayed cool and collected throughout the tense negotiation.  整个紧张的谈判过程中她都保持冷静镇定。

recollected.example: He faced the hostile crowd with a recollected calm.  他以镇定的从容面对充满敌意的人群。

self-collected.cn: 泰然自若的，自我镇定的
self-collected.example: The young pilot stayed self-collected as the engine began to fail.  发动机开始故障时，这位年轻飞行员依然泰然自若。

self-composed.example: She gave a self-composed reply to the reporter's rude question.  她对记者无礼的提问给出了沉着的回答。

self-possessed.example: Even at fifteen she was remarkably self-possessed in public.  即便才十五岁，她在公开场合也异常沉着。

diurnal.example: Most birds are diurnal, hunting and singing during daylight hours.  大多数鸟类是昼行的，在白天觅食和鸣叫。

nocturnal.example: Owls and other nocturnal hunters rely on hearing far more than on sight.  猫头鹰等夜行猎手对听觉的依赖远超视觉。

branch out.example: After years of selling coffee, they branched out into baking.  卖了多年咖啡后，他们拓展到烘焙业。

diverseness.example: The festival celebrates the diverseness of the city's immigrant communities.  这个节日庆祝该市移民社区的多样性。

multifariousness.example: His essays capture the multifariousness of modern urban experience.  他的散文捕捉了现代都市体验的多样性。

multiplicity.example: The failure resulted from a multiplicity of small errors.  这次失败源于多种小错误的叠加。

variousness.example: Readers admire the variousness of her poetic styles.  读者赞赏她诗歌风格的多样性。

miscellaneousness.example: The shop's charm lies in the miscellaneousness of its stock.  这家店的魅力在于其存货的五花八门。

deflect.example: The politician deflected every awkward question with a well practiced joke.  那位政客用一个练熟的玩笑挡开每个尴尬的问题。
deflect.cn: 使偏斜，使转向；挡开，避开

redirect.example: The city redirected traffic away from the flooded underpass.  该市把车流从被淹的地下通道改道。

swing.example: The bus swung left to avoid the fallen branch.  公交车向左急转以避开落下的树枝。

veer.example: The old boat began to veer sharply off course in the wind.  那艘旧船在风中开始急剧偏离航线。

wheel.example: He wheeled around when he heard footsteps behind him.  他听到身后的脚步声便猛地转身。

disport.example: Children disported themselves in the shallow water all afternoon.  孩子们整个下午都在浅水里嬉戏。

entertain.example: She entertained us with stories about her years abroad.  她讲述在国外的岁月，让我们听得很开心。

regale.example: The old sailor regaled us with tales of tropical storms.  老水手给我们讲热带风暴的故事，逗得我们很开心。

set.example: The captain set the ship's course toward the northern islands.  船长把船的航向设定为朝北方群岛。

divestiture.example: The court ordered forced divestiture of assets in three foreign subsidiaries.  法院下令强制剥离三家海外子公司的资产。

dispossession.example: The war led to the dispossession of thousands of families.  战争导致数千家庭被剥夺财产。

acquisition.example: The museum announced the acquisition of three rare manuscripts.  博物馆宣布获得三份珍稀手稿。

bare.example: In the interview he bared his family's darkest secrets.  在采访中他揭露了家族最黑暗的秘密。

discover.example: Auditors discovered that the accounts had been altered.  审计员发现账目被改动过。

cover up.example: Executives tried to cover up the safety violations for years.  高管们多年试图掩盖安全违规。

hide.example: She hid the letters in a drawer beneath her sweaters.  她把信藏在毛衣下面的抽屉里。

dodder.example: The old man doddered along the path with a cane in each hand.  老人两手各持一杖，沿小路蹒跚而行。

careen.example: The empty cart careened down the hill and struck a fence.  空车摇晃着冲下山坡，撞上了篱笆。

lurch.example: The bus lurched to one side and threw passengers against the windows.  公交车猛地向一侧歪倒，把乘客甩到窗户上。

teeter.example: The company teetered on the edge of bankruptcy for several months.  公司数月来一直在破产边缘摇摇欲坠。

totter.example: The toddler tottered a few steps and then sat down.  幼儿摇摇晃晃走了几步就坐下了。

waddle.example: The fat puppy waddled across the kitchen toward its water bowl.  那只胖胖的小狗摇摇摆摆地穿过厨房走向水碗。

escape.example: Two prisoners escaped through a tunnel under the wall.  两名囚犯从墙下的隧道逃脱。

malinger.example: Several workers tried to malinger during the busiest week of the harvest season.  有几名工人在收获季最忙的一周里试图装病逃工。

goldbrick.example: Two workers were fired for goldbricking during the busiest week of the year.  两名工人因在全年最忙的一周偷懒躲活而被解雇。

evade.example: The witness evaded every question about the missing money.  证人回避了所有关于失踪钱款的问题。

avert.example: Quick action by the crew averted a serious accident.  船员的迅速行动避免了一场严重事故。

elude.example: The thief eluded the police for nearly six months before being caught.  小偷躲开警方近六个月才被抓住。

shun.example: The writer chose to shun public attention after winning the prize.  那位作家获奖后选择避开公众关注。

bilk.example: He bilked elderly clients out of their retirement savings.  他骗走了年长客户的退休储蓄。

eschew.example: The monks eschew luxury and live on whatever the village offers.  僧侣们避开奢华，靠村民所给的一切生活。

weasel.example: He tried to weasel out of paying his share.  他试图耍滑不付自己那份钱。

doff.example: Visitors were expected to doff their hats upon entering the small chapel.  参观者进入这座小礼拜堂时须脱帽。

take off.example: Please take off your muddy boots before entering the house.  进屋前请脱掉沾泥的靴子。

don.example: The firefighters donned their heavy gear in less than one minute.  消防员不到一分钟就穿上了沉重的装备。

put on.example: She put on her gloves before stepping into the snow.  她走进雪地前戴上了手套。

dogged.example: Her dogged determination carried the project through two years of setbacks.  她顽强的决心让这个项目度过了两年的挫折。

inflexible.example: The manager was inflexible about the submission deadline.  经理在提交截止日期上毫不通融。

mulish.example: His mulish refusal to listen frustrated everyone on the committee.  他固执地拒绝倾听，让委员会所有人都很沮丧。

obdurate opinionated.example: The committee split between obdurate, opinionated factions on every issue.  委员会在每个议题上都分裂为顽固而固执己见的派系。

ossified.example: Decades of success left the firm ossified and slow to adapt.  数十年的成功使这家公司僵化，难以适应变化。

pertina-.example: The scan split pertinacious into pertina- and cious.  扫描把 pertinacious 断成 pertina- 和 cious。

cious.example: Joining pertina- and cious restores the word pertinacious.  把 pertina- 与 cious 合并即还原 pertinacious。

self-opinionated.cn: 固执己见的，自以为是的
self-opinionated.example: He is too self-opinionated to accept editorial advice.  他太自以为是，不肯接受编辑的建议。

self-willed.example: The self-willed teenager ignored every warning from her parents.  这个任性的少女无视父母的一切警告。

stubborn.example: My grandfather was too stubborn to see a doctor.  我祖父太固执，不肯去看医生。

unrelenting.example: Her unrelenting effort finally forced the company to apologize.  她不懈的努力最终迫使公司道歉。

unyielding.example: The union remained unyielding on the question of wages.  工会在工资问题上依然毫不让步。

acquiescent.example: Too acquiescent to protest, the staff accepted the new rules.  员工太顺从，没有抗议就接受了新规。

complying.example: Firms complying with the standard receive a tax rebate.  遵从该标准的企业可获得退税。

flexible.example: The company offers a flexible schedule to parents of young children.  公司为有幼儿的员工提供灵活的日程。

pliable.example: Young minds are pliable and easily shaped by the adults around them.  年轻的心智易受影响，很容易被身边的成年人塑造。

pliant.example: He wanted a pliant assistant who would never question his decisions.  他想要一个顺从的助手，永远不会质疑他的决定。

dogmatic.example: He is too dogmatic to consider any alternative explanation.  他太武断，不肯考虑任何别的解释。

doctrinaire.example: His doctrinaire approach left no room for evidence that contradicted the theory.  他教条主义的做法容不下任何与理论相悖的证据。

opinionated.example: My uncle is opinionated about politics and refuses to listen.  我叔叔在政治上固执己见，不肯倾听。

opinioned.example: The old scholar was opinioned but generous with students.  这位老学者固执己见，但对学生很宽厚。

latitudinarian.example: His latitudinarian views angered the stricter members of the church.  他宽容不拘的观点激怒了教会中较严格的成员。

undoctrinaire.example: Her undoctrinaire style made compromise possible.  她不教条的风格使妥协成为可能。

undogmatic.example: The book offers an undogmatic account of the dispute.  该书对这场争论给出了不武断的叙述。

dolorous.example: A dolorous sigh escaped him whenever the subject of his hometown arose.  每次提到故乡，他都发出忧伤的叹息。

agonized.example: She gave an agonized look as the verdict was read.  宣读判决时她露出痛苦的神情。

bemoaning.example: He spent the evening bemoaning the loss of his job.  他整晚都在哀叹失去工作。

bewailing.example: The villagers stood bewailing the destruction of the temple.  村民们站着痛惜寺庙的毁坏。

deplorable.example: Inspectors found deplorable working conditions inside the crowded garment factory.  检查人员在拥挤的服装厂内发现了恶劣的工作条件。

grievous.example: The report described grievous failures in patient care.  报告描述了病人护理中的严重失误。

miserable.example: Cold rain made the whole camping trip miserable.  冰冷的雨让整个露营之行变得凄惨。

plaintive.example: A plaintive melody drifted from the open window of the old house.  一段哀伤的旋律从那座老房子敞开的窗子里飘出。

happy.example: The children were happy to see snow for the first time.  孩子们第一次见到雪很开心。

joyful.example: The village held a joyful celebration after the harvest.  收获后村里举行了欢乐的庆祝。

dolt.example: Do not call him a dolt simply because he asked an obvious question.  别只因为他问了个显而易见的问题就骂他笨蛋。

idiot.example: Only an idiot would drive that fast in fog.  只有蠢人才会在雾中开那么快。

fool.example: He felt like a fool after believing the obvious lie.  信了那个明显的谎言后，他觉得自己像个傻瓜。

moron.example: Some moron parked across two spaces again.  又有某个蠢货横占了两个车位。

simpleton.example: They treated the new clerk as a simpleton until he corrected their figures.  他们把新来的职员当傻子，直到他改正了他们的数字。

dullard.example: The teacher wrongly treated the quiet boy as a hopeless dullard.  老师错把这个安静的男孩当成无可救药的笨蛋。

illuminati.example: The salon gathered the illuminati of eighteenth-century Paris.  这个沙龙聚集了十八世纪巴黎的智者。

intellectual.example: She became a leading intellectual in the reform movement.  她成为改革运动中的主要知识分子。

domicile.example: The city agreed to domicile the refugees in empty school buildings.  市政府同意把难民安置在空置的校舍里。

bestow.example: The king bestowed the title upon his loyal general.  国王把这个头衔授予他忠诚的将军。

lodge.cn: 提供住宿，寄宿；提出（申诉）
lodge.example: They lodged the travelers in a barn for the night.  他们让旅人在谷仓过夜。

leading.example: She is a leading authority on ancient Chinese bronzes.  她是中国古代青铜器的顶尖权威。

outweighing.example: With savings outweighing the costs, the plan was approved.  由于节省的开支超过成本，该计划获得批准。

prevalent.example: The belief that talent is innate remains surprisingly prevalent among teachers.  认为天赋是天生的这种看法在教师中仍出奇地普遍。

recessive.example: His recessive nature kept him silent at every noisy family gathering.  他内敛的性格使他在每次热闹的家庭聚会上都沉默不语。

donor.example: An anonymous donor paid for the entire wing of the children's hospital.  一位匿名捐赠者出资建起了儿童医院的整个侧楼。

donator.example: The plaque lists every donator to the new library.  牌匾上列出了新图书馆的每位捐赠者。

presenter.example: The presenter handed the medal to the young winner.  颁奖者把奖牌交给年轻的获奖者。

contributor.example: She was the largest contributor to the relief fund.  她是救灾基金最大的捐助者。

subscriber.example: Every subscriber to the fund received a printed report.  每位向基金捐款的人都收到一份印刷报告。

patron.example: The duke served as patron to several struggling painters.  这位公爵资助了几位困顿的画家。

sugar daddy.cn: 供养年轻情人的富有男子
sugar daddy.example: Tabloids claimed the actress had found a wealthy sugar daddy.  小报声称这位女演员找到了一个有钱的阔佬。

acceptor.example: In this reaction the molecule acts as an electron acceptor.  在此反应中该分子充当电子受体。

doodle.example: He would doodle in the margins of his notebook during long lectures.  上长课时他常在笔记本页边乱涂乱画。

dormant.example: The virus can stay dormant in the body for years.  这种病毒可在体内潜伏多年。

latent.example: A good teacher can discover latent talent in the quietest student.  好老师能在最安静的学生身上发现潜在的才能。

lurking.example: A lurking suspicion kept him from signing the contract.  一种潜藏的疑虑使他没有签合同。

abeyant.example: The title remained abeyant until an heir was found.  在找到继承人之前，该头衔一直处于中止状态。

quiescent.example: The volcano has remained quiescent for more than two hundred years.  这座火山已经平静了两百多年。

inert.example: Helium is an inert gas, so it rarely reacts with other elements.  氦是一种惰性气体，因此很少与其他元素发生反应。

active.example: She stays active by swimming every morning.  她每天早上游泳以保持活跃。

busy.example: The doctors were too busy to answer any of our questions.  医生们太忙了，无法回答我们任何问题。

operating.example: The plant has been operating without a break since March.  这家工厂自三月以来一直不停运转。

rough.example: The road grew rough as we climbed into the hills.  我们爬上山时路变得坎坷不平。

stark.example: The photograph shows the stark landscape of the desert.  这张照片展现了沙漠荒凉的景观。

douse.example: Firefighters worked all night to douse the flames on the upper floors.  消防员整夜奋战，扑灭了高层的火焰。

quench.example: A glass of cold lemonade quickly quenched my desperate thirst.  一杯冰镇柠檬水很快解了我的焦渴。

extinguish.example: Firefighters worked all night to extinguish the burning warehouse.  消防员整夜工作扑灭燃烧的仓库。

kindle.example: A single spark can kindle a dangerous forest fire.  一颗火星就能点燃危险的森林大火。

ignite.example: The verdict ignited public outrage across the entire country within a few hours.  判决在几小时内就激起了全国的公众愤怒。

understate.example: Officials understated the flood damage to avoid alarming the public.  官员们对洪灾损失轻描淡写，以免引起公众恐慌。

address.example: The report addresses the risks the company had ignored.  报告正视了公司此前忽视的风险。

underscore.example: The report underscores the urgent need for cleaner drinking water.  这份报告强调了对更清洁饮用水的迫切需求。

doom.example: A shortage of funds doomed the project to failure before it began.  资金短缺使这个项目在开始之前就注定失败。

fate.example: One careless remark sealed his political fate.  一句不慎的话决定了他的政治命运。

foredoom.example: Poor funding foredoomed the expedition from the start.  资金不足从一开始就注定了这次探险的失败。

foreordain.example: The theologians argued that God foreordains every event.  神学家们主张上帝预先注定每一件事。

predestine.example: The old prophecy seemed to predestine the prince to an early death.  那个古老的预言似乎注定了王子会早逝。

predetermine.example: Genes do not entirely predetermine a person's health.  基因并不完全预先决定一个人的健康。

doyen.example: For thirty years he was the doyen of critics at that newspaper.  三十年来他一直是那家报纸批评界的元老。

layman.example: Explain the diagnosis so a layman can understand it.  请解释诊断，让外行也能听懂。

doze.example: She dozed off in class and missed the announcement about the exam.  她上课打瞌睡，错过了关于考试的通知。

drowse.example: The old dog drowsed beside the warm stove.  老狗在温暖的炉子旁打瞌睡。

nap.example: He naps for twenty minutes after lunch every day.  他每天午饭后小睡二十分钟。

wink.example: I did not sleep a wink before the exam.  考试前我一点都没睡着。

slumber.example: The baby slumbered peacefully while the storm raged outside the window.  窗外风雨交加，婴儿仍安然沉睡。

wake.example: The noise of traffic woke me before dawn.  车流的噪音在黎明前把我唤醒。

draconian.example: Such draconian punishment for a minor offense shocked the entire village.  对轻微过错施以如此严酷的惩罚，震惊了全村。

rigid.example: The school enforces rigid rules about mobile phones.  学校对手机执行严格的规定。

ironhanded.example: The governor kept order through ironhanded control of the press.  这位总督通过铁腕控制新闻来维持秩序。

stringent.example: The factory now follows stringent safety standards set by the government.  这家工厂现在遵守政府制定的严格安全标准。

drawl.example: He answered in a slow drawl that made every sentence sound lazy.  他慢吞吞地回答，每句话听起来都懒洋洋的。

draw out.example: He drew out every word until the sentence seemed endless.  他把每个词都拖得很长，句子仿佛没完。

dreary.example: We spent a dreary afternoon indoors watching rain streak the windows.  我们在室内度过一个沉闷的下午，看着雨水划过窗玻璃。

monotone.example: The lecturer read his notes in a flat monotone.  讲师用平板单调的语调念稿。

pedestrian.example: The reviewer called the plot pedestrian and the dialogue painfully flat.  评论者称其情节平庸，对话乏味得令人难受。

somber.example: A somber mood settled over the town after the funeral procession passed.  送葬队伍过后，全镇陷入阴郁的气氛。

drench.example: A sudden storm drenched us to the skin before we reached shelter.  一场突来的暴雨在我们找到避处前就把我们浇得浑身湿透。

bathe.example: Moonlight bathed the quiet valley in silver.  月光把寂静的山谷浸在银色中。

soak.example: Soak the dried beans overnight before cooking them the next morning.  把干豆浸泡一夜，第二天早上再煮。

saturate.example: Heavy rain had saturated the field before the match even began.  比赛还没开始，大雨已浸透了球场。

sodden.example: Our boots sank into the sodden ground after three days of rain.  连下三天雨后，我们的靴子陷进湿透的地里。

sop.example: He used a towel to sop up the milk spilled on the floor.  他用毛巾吸干洒在地上的牛奶。

wet.example: My shoes got wet crossing the flooded street.  我的鞋在穿过被淹的街道时湿了。

dry.example: Hang the towels outside until they are completely dry.  把毛巾挂到外面直到完全干燥。

abracadabra.example: The magician waved his wand and shouted abracadabra.  魔术师挥动魔杖，喊出咒语。

diminutive.example: She noticed a diminutive figure standing quietly near the entrance.  她注意到一个小小的身影静静立在入口附近。

small.example: They live in a small house near the river.  他们住在河边一栋小房子里。

pocket.example: She carried a pocket edition of the poems everywhere.  她随身带着一本袖珍版诗集。

smallish.example: He rented a smallish office above the bakery.  他在面包店楼上租了一间略小的办公室。

subnormal.cn: 低于正常的，低于标准的
subnormal.example: The patient's subnormal body temperature worried the nurses.  病人低于正常的体温让护士们担心。

undersized.example: The undersized puppy needed extra feeding for weeks.  这只体型偏小的小狗需要额外喂养数周。

grand.example: They held the ceremony in a grand marble hall.  他们在宏伟的大理石厅里举行仪式。

outsized.example: The tiny country has an outsized role in world trade.  这个小国在世界贸易中的作用超乎其体量。

oversized.example: He wore an oversized sweater that hung to his knees.  他穿着一件垂到膝盖的超大毛衣。

whopping.example: The film earned a whopping two billion dollars worldwide.  这部影片全球赚了惊人的二十亿美元。

drollness.example: The drollness of his remarks kept the whole table laughing through dinner.  他言语的滑稽让整桌人整顿饭都在笑。

comedy.example: There was unintended comedy in his solemn speech.  他严肃的演讲里有意外的滑稽感。

funniness.example: Much of the funniness comes from the actor's timing.  好笑之处多半来自演员的节奏把握。

hilariousness.example: The hilariousness of the misunderstanding kept us laughing.  这场误会的滑稽让我们笑个不停。

humorousness.example: Critics praised the gentle humorousness of her novels.  评论家称赞她小说中温和的幽默。

pathos.example: The final letter gives the story real pathos.  最后那封信让这个故事真正带上悲怆。

drone.example: The speaker droned on for another twenty minutes.  演讲者又单调地讲了二十分钟。

hum.example: The refrigerator hums quietly all through the night.  冰箱整夜轻轻嗡嗡作响。

buzz.example: Bees buzzed lazily above the clover.  蜜蜂在三叶草上懒懒地嗡嗡飞。

drudgery.example: Machines have removed much of the drudgery of housework in modern homes.  机器已消除了现代家庭中大部分的家务苦累。

labor.example: Years of hard labor had bent his back.  多年的苦力劳动使他驼了背。

slavery.example: The job felt like slavery with no rest and little pay.  这份工作像苦役，没有休息、报酬又低。

toil.example: Farmers toiled from sunrise until dark during harvest.  收获时农民从日出劳作到天黑。

travail.example: After months of travail, the small team finally finished the bridge.  经过数月的辛苦劳作，这个小团队终于建成了这座桥。

sinecure.example: The post turned out to be a comfortable sinecure with almost no duties.  那个职位原来是个几乎无事可做的舒服闲差。

dubious.example: The advertisement made a dubious claim that no serious scientist would support.  那则广告作出了一个没有严肃科学家会支持的可疑说法。

debatable.example: Whether the policy helped the poor is debatable.  该政策是否帮助了穷人尚有争议。

disputable.example: His figures are accurate but his conclusion is disputable.  他的数字准确，但结论值得质疑。

problematic.example: The data set is problematic because many records are missing.  该数据集有问题，因为许多记录缺失。

questionable.example: The deal rested on questionable accounting practices.  这笔交易建立在可疑的会计做法上。

shaky.example: The theory rests on shaky historical evidence.  该理论建立在不可靠的历史证据上。

certain.example: We are certain that the letter was never sent.  我们确信那封信从未寄出。

incontestable.cn: 无可争辩的，不容置疑的
incontestable.example: The photograph offered incontestable evidence of the meeting.  这张照片提供了会面的无可争辩的证据。

undeniable.example: Her influence on modern dance is undeniable.  她对现代舞的影响不可否认。

ductile.example: Young recruits are ductile and quickly absorb the habits of the older soldiers.  新兵易受影响，很快就学到老兵的习惯。
ductile.cn: 有延展性的；易受影响的

supple.example: The gloves were made of supple leather that fit her hands perfectly.  这双手套用柔软的皮革制成，和她的手完全贴合。

dulcet.example: Her dulcet tones calmed the restless children within a couple of minutes.  她悦耳的音调几分钟内就安抚了不安的孩子们。

delightful.example: We spent a delightful evening by the lake.  我们在湖边度过了一个愉快的夜晚。

euphonic.example: Italian strikes many listeners as an unusually euphonic language.  许多听者觉得意大利语格外悦耳。

mellifluous.example: The narrator's mellifluous voice made even the dullest chapters pleasant to listen to.  叙述者优美悦耳的嗓音让最枯燥的章节也变得动听。
