tuneful.example: The musical is remembered for its tuneful songs.  这部音乐剧因旋律优美的歌曲而被记住。

grating.example: The grating noise of the saw filled the workshop.  锯子刺耳的声音充满了作坊。

wit.example: Her quick wit saved the interview after the microphone failed.  麦克风出故障后，是她的机敏救了那场访谈。

victim.example: He became the victim of an elaborate phone scam.  他成了一个精心设计的电话骗局的受害者。

hoax.example: The photograph turned out to be an elaborate hoax created by students.  那张照片原来是学生们精心设计的骗局。

duplicitous.example: His duplicitous behavior toward both partners eventually destroyed the company.  他对两位合伙人的两面派行为最终毁了公司。

deceptive.example: The calm surface of the river is deceptive and dangerous.  河面的平静具有欺骗性，很危险。

fraudulent.example: The insurer refused to pay several obviously fraudulent claims last year.  去年保险公司拒付了几笔明显欺诈的索赔。

shifty.example: The salesman had shifty eyes that made every customer uneasy.  那推销员眼神游移闪躲，让每个顾客都不安。

drop.example: Sales dropped by half after the price increase.  涨价后销量下降了一半。

irritable.example: Lack of sleep makes him irritable by mid-afternoon.  睡眠不足使他到下午中段就变得易怒。

fretful.example: The baby was fretful all night because of the heat.  因为炎热，婴儿整夜烦躁不安。

splenetic.example: The critic wrote a splenetic review of the new opera.  这位批评家为新歌剧写了一篇火气十足的评论。

easygoing.example: Her easygoing nature makes her popular with colleagues.  她随和的性格使她受同事欢迎。

grave.example: The doctor's grave tone told us the news was bad.  医生严肃的语气告诉我们消息不好。

serious.example: She is serious about becoming a research scientist.  她认真地想成为一名研究科学家。

staid.example: The staid law firm finally allowed casual clothing.  这家古板的律所终于允许穿便装。

facetious.example: His facetious remark at the funeral offended nearly everyone present.  他在葬礼上轻浮的玩笑话得罪了几乎所有在场的人。

flip.example: His flip reply annoyed the interviewer.  他轻率的回答让面试官不快。

flippant.example: She regretted her flippant comment about the accident.  她后悔自己对那场事故的轻率评论。

playful.example: Her playful tone made it clear that she was only teasing him.  她玩闹的语气清楚表明她只是在逗他。

embryonic.example: The project is still embryonic, so details may change considerably.  该项目仍处于萌芽阶段，细节可能会有很大变化。

aborning.cn: 刚萌芽的，正在诞生中的
aborning.example: The reform movement died aborning when funding vanished.  资金消失后，改革运动尚未成形就夭折了。

beginning.example: We are still at the beginning of the investigation.  我们仍处于调查的开端。

inceptive.example: The project is still in its inceptive stage.  该项目仍处于起始阶段。

incipient.example: The dentist spotted incipient signs of decay in two of the teeth.  牙医发现两颗牙齿上有初现的蛀坏迹象。

inchoate.example: His inchoate plans changed every time he described them to us.  他那些尚未成形的计划每次向我们描述时都变了。

initial.example: Our initial estimate turned out to be far too low.  我们最初的估计结果远远偏低。

nascent.example: Government loans helped the nascent solar industry survive its first decade.  政府贷款帮助新兴的太阳能产业度过了最初十年。

rudimentary.example: He had only a rudimentary knowledge of chemistry when he joined the lab.  他加入实验室时对化学只有基础的了解。

full-blown.cn: 完全成熟的，全面爆发的
full-blown.example: A minor dispute grew into a full-blown lawsuit.  一场小争执演变成全面的诉讼。

full-fledged.cn: 完全成熟的，羽翼已成的
full-fledged.example: After three years she became a full-fledged engineer.  三年后她成为一名完全合格的工程师。

earsplitting.example: An earsplitting shriek from the whistle stopped every conversation on the platform.  哨子发出的震耳尖啸让站台上所有的交谈都停了下来。

blaring.example: A blaring horn woke everyone in the street.  刺耳的喇叭声惊醒了街上所有人。

blasting.example: Blasting music from the next flat kept me awake.  隔壁公寓震耳的音乐让我无法入睡。

deafening.example: The crowd's cheer was deafening as the winner appeared.  获胜者出现时人群的欢呼震耳欲聋。

loud.example: The music was too loud for normal conversation.  音乐太响，无法正常交谈。

piercing.example: A piercing whistle stopped the game immediately.  一声尖利的哨响立刻中止了比赛。

plangent.example: The plangent cry of a gull echoed across the empty beach.  海鸥凄凉的叫声在空荡的海滩上回响。

resounding.example: The door shut with a resounding bang behind him.  门在他身后砰然作响地关上。

roaring.example: We could hardly talk over the roaring waterfall.  在轰鸣的瀑布声中我们几乎无法交谈。

stentorian.example: His stentorian voice carried easily to the back of the hall.  他洪亮的嗓音轻松传到大厅后排。

thunderous.example: The performance ended in thunderous applause.  演出在雷鸣般的掌声中结束。

eavesdrop.example: She was caught trying to eavesdrop on a conversation in the next room.  她被抓到试图偷听隔壁房间的谈话。

overhear.example: I happened to overhear two colleagues discussing the layoffs in the hallway.  我在走廊上偶然听到两位同事在谈裁员的事。

wiretap.example: Agents obtained a court order to wiretap the suspect's office phone.  探员取得法院许可，窃听嫌疑人办公室的电话。

ebullient.cn: 热情洋溢的，兴高采烈的
ebullient.example: An ebullient host greeted every guest at the door with genuine delight.  热情洋溢的主人在门口由衷欢喜地迎接每位客人。

boiling.example: She dropped the noodles into the boiling water and stirred once.  她把面条下进沸水里，搅了一下。

exuberant.example: Exuberant applause from fans greeted the singer's surprise return.  粉丝们热情洋溢的掌声迎接歌手的意外回归。

tepid.example: The proposal met a tepid response from the board members.  提案得到董事们不热情的回应。

torpid.example: The heat left the whole village torpid and unwilling to move.  酷热让整个村子都变得麻木迟钝，不愿动弹。

eccentric.example: An eccentric old professor kept three clocks that all showed different times.  一位行为古怪的老教授留着三只指着不同时间的钟。

strange.example: There was a strange smell coming from the kitchen last night.  昨晚厨房里传出一股奇怪的味道。

erratic.example: His erratic driving behavior alarmed the passengers long before the police stopped him.  早在警察拦下他之前，他飘忽不定的驾驶行为就让乘客惊慌。

idiosyncratic.example: His idiosyncratic habit of numbering every page twice confused the editors.  他给每页编两次号的怪癖让编辑们很困惑。

odd.example: It seemed odd that nobody answered the door at noon.  中午没人应门，这显得有点奇怪。

outlandish.example: Her outlandish hat made every head turn as she entered the hall.  她走进大厅时，那顶古怪的帽子让所有人回头。

quaint.example: We stayed in a quaint cottage with a thatched roof and stone walls.  我们住在一间茅草顶石墙的古雅小屋里。

weird.example: The film has a weird ending that nobody in the theater understood.  这部电影的结尾很怪，影院里没人看懂。

ordinary.example: He looked like an ordinary commuter waiting for the morning bus.  他看上去就像个等早班公交的普通上班族。

clat.example: The young pianist finished the concerto with remarkable clat.  这位年轻钢琴家以非凡的辉煌技艺弹完了协奏曲。

fame.example: Her fame spread quickly after the documentary aired nationwide.  纪录片在全国播出后，她的名声迅速传开。

renown.example: The violinist won international renown while still in her twenties.  这位小提琴家二十多岁就赢得了国际声望。

brilliance.example: Critics praised the brilliance of the young director's first film.  批评家盛赞这位年轻导演处女作的精彩。

triumph.example: The new bridge is a triumph of modern engineering and careful planning.  这座新桥是现代工程与周密规划的巨大成功。

overshadow.phrase_cn: 使她早期作品相形失色
overshadow.cn: 使相形失色；使蒙上阴影
overshadow.example: Her later novels overshadow the modest work that first made her famous.  她后来的小说使那部最初让她成名的平实作品相形失色。

euphoria.example: The euphoria after the victory faded within a couple of days.  胜利后的极度愉快在几天之内就消退了。

exhilaration.example: She felt pure exhilaration as the glider rose above the valley.  滑翔机升到山谷上方时，她感到无比兴奋。

rapture.example: The audience listened in rapture as the old singer began her final song.  老歌手唱起最后一曲时，观众听得如痴如醉。

depression.example: After losing his job he slid into a long depression.  失业之后，他陷入了长久的抑郁。

melancholy.example: Autumn rain always fills him with a vague melancholy.  秋雨总让他心里泛起一种莫名的忧郁。

planetary.example: Climate change is now treated as a planetary emergency by most scientists.  多数科学家现在把气候变化视为全球性紧急事态。

edible.example: The guide showed us which edible wild mushrooms grow beneath these pines.  导游告诉我们这些松树下长着哪些可食用的野生蘑菇。

eatable.example: The soup was salty but still eatable after we added water.  这汤很咸，加了水之后还算能吃。

comestible.example: The market sells every comestible item a village kitchen might need.  这个市场出售村里厨房可能需要的各种食品。

consumable.example: The budget separates equipment costs from consumable materials like paper and ink.  预算把设备费用与纸墨等消耗品分开列出。

digestible.example: The report was rewritten in short, digestible sections for busy readers.  报告被改写成简短易懂的小节，方便忙碌的读者。

esculent.example: Early settlers learned which esculent plants grew along the riverbank.  早期定居者学会辨认河岸上哪些植物可以食用。

inedible.example: The berries look attractive but are completely inedible for humans.  这些浆果看着诱人，但人完全不能吃。

edifice.example: A towering stone edifice now stands where the old market once stood.  高耸的石造大厦如今矗立在旧集市的原址上。

palace.example: Tourists queue for hours to enter the palace and see the throne room.  游客排队几小时才能进宫殿参观王座厅。

architecture.example: She studies the architecture of medieval churches in northern Spain.  她研究西班牙北部中世纪教堂的建筑。

configuration.example: Engineers changed the configuration of the engine to reduce noise.  工程师改变了发动机的构造以降低噪音。

framework.example: The treaty provides a framework for cooperation between the two countries.  该条约为两国合作提供了框架。

skeleton.example: Only the concrete skeleton of the unfinished hotel still stands.  未完工的酒店只剩下混凝土骨架还立在那里。

structure.example: The essay has a clear structure with three supporting examples.  这篇文章结构清晰，配有三个支撑例证。

cottage.example: They rented a stone cottage near the lake for the summer.  他们租了湖边一间石头小屋过夏天。

eradicate.example: Vaccination campaigns helped eradicate smallpox across the world.  接种运动帮助在全世界根除了天花。

erase.example: He tried to erase every trace of the message from the whiteboard.  他试图把白板上那条信息的痕迹全部擦掉。

expunge.example: The court agreed to expunge the conviction from her official file.  法庭同意将该定罪从她的正式档案中删除。

exterminate.example: The team worked for months to exterminate the invasive beetles.  团队花了几个月消灭那些入侵的甲虫。

extirpate.example: Farmers worked for years to extirpate the weed from their fields.  农民花了多年才把这种杂草从田里根除。

liquidate.example: The regime tried to liquidate every opponent who remained in the capital.  该政权试图肃清留在首都的每一个反对者。

obliterate.example: The March blizzard obliterated all traces of the early spring flowers.  三月的暴风雪抹去了早春花朵的一切痕迹。

wipe.example: Please wipe the table before you set out the plates.  摆盘子之前请把桌子擦一下。

root out.example: The new director promised to root out waste in every department.  新主任承诺根除各部门的浪费现象。

effervesce.example: The children effervesced with excitement as the parade turned onto their street.  游行队伍拐进他们那条街时，孩子们兴奋得沸腾起来。

exult.example: The fans exulted in the victory long after the final whistle.  终场哨响很久之后球迷们仍在为胜利欢喜。

jubilate.example: The whole town began to jubilate when the rescue team returned safely.  救援队平安归来时，全城开始欢庆。

grieve.example: The whole village grieved for the fishermen lost in the autumn storm.  全村人都为在秋季风暴中失踪的渔民而悲伤。

consumed.example: He was consumed by guilt for weeks after the accident.  事故之后他被负罪感折磨了好几周。

debilitated.example: The patient looked pale and debilitated after months of treatment.  经过数月治疗，病人显得苍白虚弱。

decadent.example: He described the court as decadent, idle, and blind to reform.  他形容那个宫廷腐败堕落、无所作为、对改革视而不见。

degenerate.example: The peaceful protest began to degenerate into shouting and shoving.  和平抗议开始恶化为叫骂和推挤。

depleted.example: Years of overfarming left the soil badly depleted of nutrients.  多年过度耕作使土壤养分严重枯竭。

drained.example: After the twelve-hour shift she felt utterly drained.  上了十二小时的班，她感到彻底精疲力竭。

exhausted.example: The hikers arrived exhausted but happy at the mountain hut.  徒步者们疲惫却愉快地到达了山中小屋。

malodor.example: A faint malodor drifted from the drain behind the restaurant.  餐馆后面的下水道飘来一股淡淡的恶臭。

stench.example: An unbearable stench rose from the drains during the hot afternoon.  炎热的午后，下水道里升起难以忍受的恶臭。

fragrance.example: The fragrance of jasmine filled the courtyard every evening.  每天傍晚，茉莉的香味充满庭院。

aroma.example: The aroma of baking bread drew customers into the little shop.  烤面包的香气把顾客引进了这家小店。

effrontery.example: He had the effrontery to lie about the accident right to my face.  他竟厚颜无耻地当着我的面对那场事故说谎。

audacity.example: She had the audacity to correct the professor in front of the class.  她竟敢在全班面前纠正教授。

brashness.example: His brashness in meetings offended several senior partners.  他在会上的放肆无礼得罪了几位资深合伙人。

brazenness.example: Reporters were stunned by the brazenness of his denial.  记者们对他否认时的厚颜无耻感到震惊。

presumption.example: It was sheer presumption to speak for the whole committee.  代表整个委员会发言纯属冒失无礼。

temerity.example: He had the temerity to ask his boss for another raise.  他竟然冒失地向老板再要一次加薪。

decorum.example: Guests were asked to observe decorum during the memorial service.  来宾被要求在追悼会上保持得体举止。

propriety.example: Her sense of propriety kept her from raising the subject at dinner.  她的得体分寸感使她没有在晚餐时提起这个话题。

grace.example: She handled the awkward question with unusual grace.  她极为得体地应对了那个尴尬的问题。

glorious.example: The mountains looked glorious in the late afternoon light.  傍晚的光线下群山显得壮丽辉煌。

radiant.cn: 光芒四射的；喜气洋洋的
radiant.example: The bride looked radiant as she walked into the garden.  新娘走进花园时神采飞扬。

splendid.example: From the roof we had a splendid view of the harbor.  从屋顶望去，港口的景色极为壮丽。

murky.example: The murky basement was lit by one failing bulb.  昏暗的地下室里只有一只快坏的灯泡照明。
murky.cn: 昏暗的，阴暗的；晦涩不清的

effusive.example: The principal offered effusive praise for the graduating class's achievements.  校长对毕业班的成就大加赞美。
effusive.cn: 感情过度外露的，热情洋溢的

emotional.example: He became emotional when describing his father's last letter.  描述父亲最后一封信时他动了感情。

expansive.example: After dinner he grew expansive and told stories all evening.  晚饭后他变得健谈，整晚讲故事。

gushy.cn: 感情流露过度的，肉麻的
gushy.example: Her gushy introduction embarrassed the guest speaker.  她过度热情的介绍让客座讲者很不好意思。

passionate.example: She is passionate about protecting the city's old neighborhoods.  她对保护城市的老街区充满热情。

inhibited.example: New students often feel inhibited during the first seminar.  新生在第一次讨论课上常感到拘谨。

reserved.example: Her father was a reserved man who rarely spoke about his feelings.  她的父亲是个内向的人，很少谈论自己的感受。

egalitarian.example: They founded an egalitarian society in which every member had one vote.  他们建立了一个平等主义的社会，每个成员都只有一票。

discriminating.cn: 有差别对待的；有鉴别力的
discriminating.example: The court struck down policies discriminating against women in hiring.  法院废除了在招聘中歧视女性的政策。

unfair.example: Workers complained that the new bonus system was deeply unfair.  工人抱怨新的奖金制度极不公平。

egoistic.example: Critics detected egoistic motives behind his sudden generosity toward the museum.  批评者察觉到他突然对博物馆慷慨背后的利己动机。

egocentric.example: His egocentric behavior slowly drove his teammates away.  他自我中心的行为慢慢把队友都赶走了。

individualistic.cn: 个人主义的，突出自我的
individualistic.example: Her individualistic approach clashed with the team's shared plan.  她突出自我的做法与团队的共同计划相冲突。

navel-gazing.phrase_cn: 政界无休止的自我纠缠
navel-gazing.example: The party spent a year on navel-gazing instead of policy.  该党花了一年时间自我纠缠，而非制定政策。

selfless.example: Neighbors praised her selfless care for the elderly couple.  邻居们称赞她对那对老夫妇的无私照料。

circumstantial.example: The witness gave a long, circumstantial description of that evening.  证人对那个晚上作了长篇详尽的描述。

particular.example: He gave a particular account of every repair the house needed.  他详细说明了房子所需的每一项修缮。

particularized.example: The auditor demanded a particularized record of every payment.  审计员要求提供每笔付款的逐项记录。

sketchy.example: Early reports about the fire were sketchy and often wrong.  关于火灾的早期报道很粗略，还常有错。

compendious.example: He wrote a compendious history of the city in ninety pages.  他用九十页写成了一部简明的城市史。

summary.example: Please attach a one-page summary to the front of the proposal.  请在提案前面附上一页摘要。

elastic.example: These trousers have an elastic waistband, so they fit almost anyone.  这条裤子有松紧腰带，几乎任何人都能穿。

bouncy.example: The children loved the bouncy mattress in the guest room.  孩子们很喜欢客房里那张弹性十足的床垫。

malleable.phrase_cn: 像黄金一样可塑的金属
malleable.example: Gold and other malleable metals can be hammered into thin sheets.  黄金和其他易延展的金属可以被锤成薄片。

resilient.cn: 有弹性的；能迅速恢复的
resilient.example: Children are often more resilient than their parents expect.  孩子往往比父母想象的更有恢复力。

stretchable.example: The chair comes with a stretchable cover that fits any shape.  这椅子配有可伸展的椅套，什么形状都能套上。

adaptable.example: Crows are adaptable birds that thrive even in crowded cities.  乌鸦适应力很强，连拥挤的城市里也能繁盛。

adjustable.example: The desk has adjustable legs so it suits both children and adults.  这张桌子的腿可调节，大人小孩都合用。

volatile.example: Investors hesitated because the stock market stayed volatile all spring.  由于股市整个春天都动荡多变，投资者犹豫不决。

stiff.example: The stiff leather collar rubbed his neck raw during the long march.  长途行军中，硬挺的皮领把他的脖子磨破了。

established.example: The firm has an established reputation for careful engineering.  这家公司在精细工程方面已有稳固声誉。

fixed.example: Tenants pay a fixed rent for the first three years.  租户前三年支付固定租金。

immutable.example: Gravity is an immutable law that no clever argument can suspend.  引力是不可变的法则，任何巧辩都无法使它失效。

elate.example: The unexpected award elated the whole team for the rest of the season.  这个意外的奖项让全队在赛季余下的时间里都欢欣自豪。

exhilarate.example: The fast ride down the mountain exhilarated everyone in the car.  沿山路飞驰而下让车里的每个人都兴奋不已。

humanitarian.example: Several agencies sent humanitarian supplies to the flooded region.  几家机构向洪灾地区运送了人道主义物资。

parsimonious.example: The parsimonious landlord refused to replace the broken heater.  吝啬的房东拒绝更换坏了的暖气。

elegy.example: He wrote a short elegy for the friend who died in the flood.  他为在洪水中丧生的朋友写了一首短短的挽歌。

dirge.example: The band played a mournful dirge as the coffin passed.  棺木经过时，乐队奏起哀伤的挽歌。

lamentation.example: The village filled with lamentation when news of the wreck arrived.  沉船的消息传来时，村里满是哀恸之声。

requiem.example: The choir performed a requiem in memory of the fallen miners.  合唱团演唱安魂曲，纪念遇难的矿工。

ode.example: The poet wrote an ode celebrating the river of his childhood.  诗人写了一首颂诗，赞美童年的那条河。

enormous.example: The project required an enormous amount of money and patience.  这个项目需要巨额资金和极大耐心。

gigantic.example: A gigantic stone statue guards the entrance to the temple.  一座巨大的石像守卫着神庙的入口。

massive.example: A massive wave struck the harbor wall just after midnight.  午夜刚过，一个巨浪撞上了防波堤。

graceless.example: His graceless attempt at an apology made things worse.  他笨拙的道歉尝试让事情更糟了。

microscopic.example: Scientists found microscopic cracks in the metal beam.  科学家在金属梁中发现了极微小的裂缝。

graceful.example: She made a graceful turn and landed without a sound.  她优雅地一个转身，落地时毫无声响。

enrapture.example: The young pianist enraptured everyone in the small concert hall.  这位年轻钢琴家让小音乐厅里的每个人都入了迷。

intoxicate.example: Sudden success seemed to intoxicate the young writer completely.  突来的成功似乎让这位年轻作家彻底陶醉了。

demote.example: The board decided to demote him to clerk after the scandal.  丑闻之后，董事会决定把他降为书记员。

elicit.example: The king's speech elicited sustained cheers and applause from the crowd.  国王的演讲激起了人群持久的欢呼和掌声。

arouse.example: The missing files aroused suspicion among the auditors.  丢失的文件引起了审计人员的怀疑。

evoke.example: The smell of wet chalk evokes my primary school classroom.  湿粉笔的味道让我想起小学的教室。

elliptical.example: Her elliptical reply told the reporters almost nothing about the final decision.  她含糊其辞的回答几乎没向记者透露任何关于最终决定的信息。

nebulous.example: The manager presented a nebulous plan with no dates, budgets, or clear goals.  经理提出了一个没有日期、预算或明确目标的模糊计划。

oval.example: She wore a small oval locket on a silver chain.  她戴着一条银链，挂着小小的椭圆吊盒。

ovate.example: This shrub can be identified by its ovate glossy leaves.  这种灌木可通过其光亮的卵形叶片辨认。

unambiguous.example: The contract gives unambiguous rules about late payment.  合同就迟付款给出了明确规定。

unequivocal.example: The board issued an unequivocal statement supporting the director.  董事会发表了明确支持主任的声明。

round.example: They sat at a round table so everyone could see each other.  他们围着圆桌坐，这样人人都能看见对方。

construe.example: Do not construe my silence as agreement with the plan.  别把我的沉默理解为赞同这个计划。

explicate.example: The teacher patiently explicated the most difficult passage in the poem.  老师耐心地解说了这首诗中最难的一段。

expound.example: The professor expounded her views on urban design for an hour.  教授用一个小时详细阐述了她的城市设计观点。

emaciate.example: Months of fever had emaciated the patient's body almost beyond recognition.  数月高烧使病人的身体消瘦衰弱得几乎认不出来。

droop.example: The plants drooped badly after three days without water.  三天没浇水，植物都严重萎蔫低垂了。

flag.example: His energy began to flag after the twentieth mile.  跑到第二十英里后他的精力开始衰减。

sag.example: The mattress sagged in the middle after years of use.  用了多年后，床垫中间下陷了。

decay.example: The abandoned mill has been left to decay for decades.  这座废弃磨坊已任其衰败数十年。

languish.phrase_cn: 在潮湿牢房中日渐衰弱
languish.example: The prisoners languished in damp cells for months without proper food.  囚犯们在潮湿的牢房里日渐衰弱，数月没有适当的食物。

embargo.example: The two governments agreed to lift the trade embargo after long talks.  经过长时间会谈，两国政府同意解除贸易禁令。

ban.example: The city voted to ban plastic bags in all supermarkets.  该市投票决定禁止所有超市使用塑料袋。

veto.example: The governor promised to veto the bill if it reached his desk.  州长承诺，若这项法案送到他手上就予以否决。

prescription.example: The charter contains a clear prescription of every member's duties.  该章程对每位成员的职责有明确规定。

begin.example: We will begin the renovation as soon as the permit arrives.  许可一到我们就开始装修。

commence.example: Construction will commence next month if funding is approved.  若资金获批，工程将于下月开始。

launch.example: The company plans to launch its cheapest model this autumn.  公司计划今秋推出其最便宜的型号。

initiate.example: The new governor plans to initiate a sweeping reform of rural education.  新州长计划发起一项农村教育的全面改革。

finish.example: She hopes to finish her thesis before the winter holiday.  她希望在寒假前完成论文。

embed.example: Engineers embed a tiny chip in each card to store the account data.  工程师在每张卡里嵌入一枚微小芯片来存储账户数据。

entrench.example: The reforms only entrenched the power of the largest banks.  这些改革只是让大银行的权力更加牢固。

ingrain.example: Years of training ingrained in her the habit of checking every figure twice.  多年训练使她养成了把每个数字复查两遍的习惯。

root.example: The custom is rooted in the farming life of the valley.  这一习俗根植于山谷的农耕生活。

extract.example: The dentist had to extract a badly decayed back tooth.  牙医不得不拔掉一颗严重腐坏的后牙。

dislodge.example: Rescuers used a bar to dislodge the beam trapping his leg.  救援人员用铁棍撬开压住他腿的横梁。

uproot.example: The storm uprooted dozens of trees along the coast road.  风暴把沿海公路旁数十棵树连根拔起。

confiscate.example: Customs officers confiscated the ivory carvings at the airport.  海关人员在机场没收了那些象牙雕件。

emboss.example: The binder chose to emboss the leather cover with a small gold crest.  装订工决定在皮封面上压出一个小小的金色纹章。

ornament.example: Carved birds ornament the wooden beams of the old temple.  雕刻的飞鸟装饰着古庙的木梁。

flatten.example: Workers flattened the ground before laying the new track.  工人在铺新轨道前先把地面整平。

adopt.example: The council voted to adopt stricter rules on noise at night.  市议会投票采纳了更严格的夜间噪音规定。

welcome.example: Residents welcomed the decision to reopen the public library.  居民们欢迎重新开放公共图书馆的决定。

embroider.example: He embroidered a simple story until nobody could tell what really happened.  他把一个简单的故事添枝加叶，直到没人分得清究竟发生了什么。

exaggerate.example: He tends to exaggerate how long the journey actually takes.  他总爱夸大这段路实际要走多久。

overstate.example: Critics say the report overstates the savings from the merger.  批评者说该报告夸大了合并带来的节省。

hyperbolize.example: Advertisers hyperbolize the effects of nearly every new product.  广告商几乎把每种新产品的效果都说得夸张。

emigrate.example: Her grandparents emigrated to Canada during the hard winter after the war.  她的祖父母在战后那个严冬移居加拿大。

migrate.example: These geese migrate thousands of miles every autumn.  这些大雁每年秋天迁徙数千英里。

immigrate.example: Her grandparents immigrated to this country after the war.  她的祖父母在战后移居到这个国家。

eminent.example: An eminent legal scholar was asked to review the draft constitution.  一位杰出的法学学者受邀审阅宪法草案。

famous.example: The small town is famous for its handmade paper.  这座小镇以手工纸而闻名。

celebrated.example: The museum displays work by several celebrated local painters.  博物馆展出了几位著名本地画家的作品。

famed.example: The valley is famed for its cold, clear spring water.  这座山谷以清冷的泉水而闻名。

notable.example: There has been a notable drop in traffic accidents this year.  今年交通事故有显著下降。

prominent.example: Her name appears in a prominent place on the donor list.  她的名字出现在捐赠名单的显眼位置。

renowned.example: The city is renowned for its ancient bridges and narrow lanes.  这座城市以古桥和窄巷闻名。

mediocre.example: The orchestra's mediocre performance disappointed listeners who had waited months for the concert.  乐团平庸的表演让等了几个月的听众很失望。

undistinguished.example: He had a long but undistinguished career in local government.  他在地方政府中干了很久，却毫不出众。

emollient.example: He answered in an emollient tone of voice that cooled the argument.  他用缓和的语气回答，让争吵冷了下来。

appeasing.example: He raised both hands in an appeasing manner and spoke softly.  他举起双手作出安抚的姿态，轻声说话。

assuaging.example: Her assuaging remarks slowly calmed the angry crowd.  她缓和气氛的话慢慢平息了愤怒的人群。

mollifying.example: The manager sent a mollifying email to every unhappy client.  经理给每位不满的客户发了安抚性的邮件。

mitigating.example: The judge considered several mitigating factors before sentencing.  法官在判决前考虑了几项减轻情节。

relieving.example: The relieving news arrived just before the family gave up hope.  这个令人宽慰的消息在家人放弃希望前刚好传来。

aggravating.example: Dust is an aggravating factor for people with asthma.  灰尘是哮喘患者病情加重的因素。

intensifying.example: Farmers face intensifying competition from cheap imports.  农民面临来自廉价进口品日益加剧的竞争。

emulate.example: The young painter tried to emulate his father's style in every canvas.  这位年轻画家在每幅画布上都力图效仿他父亲的风格。

mime.example: The actor mimed the act of drinking tea so convincingly that everyone laughed.  演员模仿喝茶的动作逼真到让所有人都笑了。

enact.example: Parliament moved quickly to enact a new tax law before the recess.  议会在休会前迅速制定了一部新税法。

legislate.example: Parliament moved quickly to legislate on data privacy.  议会迅速就数据隐私进行立法。

pass.phrase_cn: 通过一项有争议的法案
pass.example: The senate passed the budget after two nights of debate.  经过两晚辩论，参议院通过了预算案。

ratify.example: The senate voted to ratify the peace treaty after weeks of debate.  经过数周辩论，参议院投票批准了和平条约。

ordain.example: The old charter ordained that meetings be held every spring.  旧宪章规定会议须于每年春季举行。

lay down.example: The agreement lays down clear rules for sharing the water.  该协议为分配水源制定了明确规则。

abolish.example: The government promised to abolish the unpopular entrance fee.  政府承诺废除那项不受欢迎的入场费。

enamel.example: Craftsmen enamel each small plate by hand before firing it.  工匠在烧制前用手为每块小片施上珐琅。

encomium.example: The mayor delivered a warm encomium at the retiring teacher's farewell dinner.  市长在退休教师的告别晚宴上致以热情的赞颂。

salutation.example: The crowd offered a warm salutation to the returning champions.  人群向归来的冠军们热情致敬。

tribute.example: Colleagues paid warm tribute to her forty years of patient teaching.  同事们对她四十年的耐心教学致以热情的颂扬。

encompass.example: A single volume can hardly encompass every major topic in modern physics.  一卷书很难涵盖现代物理学的所有主要话题。

comprehend.example: Few readers can comprehend the full report without expert help.  很少有读者能在没有专家帮助时理解整份报告。

embody.example: The new law embodies years of careful negotiation.  这部新法体现了多年的谨慎谈判。

entail.example: Rebuilding the bridge would entail considerable risk to the workers below.  重建这座桥会给下方的工人带来相当大的风险。

involve.example: The plan involves moving three departments to another building.  这个计划涉及把三个部门迁到另一栋楼。

subsume.example: The smaller agency was subsumed into the national ministry.  这家小机构被并入了国家部门。

exclude.example: The price excludes taxes and delivery to remote areas.  该价格不包括税费和偏远地区的运费。

hamper.example: Heavy snow hampered the rescue teams trying to reach the stranded climbers.  大雪妨碍了试图接近被困登山者的救援队。

endemic.example: This flightless bird is endemic to a single island in the Pacific.  这种不会飞的鸟只见于太平洋上的一个岛屿。

aboriginal.example: Researchers recorded songs from several aboriginal communities.  研究者录下了几个原住民社区的歌谣。

indigenous.example: Many indigenous species of the island cannot survive anywhere else on the planet.  这个岛上许多本土物种无法在地球其他任何地方存活。

native.example: This bamboo is native to the wet valleys of the south.  这种竹子原产于南方潮湿的山谷。

domestic.example: Most of the factory's output is sold on the domestic market.  这家工厂的产品大多在国内市场销售。

exotic.example: The market sells exotic tropical fruit flown in each morning.  这个市场出售每天清晨空运来的外来热带水果。

nonindigenous.example: Nonindigenous weeds now cover much of the riverbank.  外来杂草如今覆盖了大片河岸。

nonnative.example: The park removed several nonnative trees planted in the 1960s.  公园移除了几棵上世纪六十年代种下的外来树木。

certify.example: An independent lab must certify that the water is safe.  必须由独立实验室证明水质安全。

disable.example: The injury disabled him for most of the season.  这次受伤让他大半个赛季无法上场。

fatigue.example: Firefighters battling the blaze all day suffered from severe fatigue.  整天与大火搏斗的消防员疲劳不堪。

rescue.example: Helicopters rescued twelve people from the flooded village.  直升机从被淹的村庄救出十二人。

disenfranchise.phrase_cn: 剥夺贫困选民的投票权
disenfranchise.example: Critics argue the new rules disenfranchise thousands of rural residents.  批评者认为新规剥夺了数千农村居民的投票权。

disempower.example: Centralized budgeting disempowered the small district councils.  集中化的预算安排剥夺了小区议会的权力。

enfetter.example: Old superstitions still enfetter the minds of many villagers.  旧迷信仍束缚着许多村民的思想。

induce.example: The soft music and dim lighting induced a deep sense of calm in everyone.  轻柔的音乐和昏暗的灯光让每个人都产生了深深的平静感。

invoke.example: The clumsy apology only invoked more anger among the injured workers.  拙劣的道歉只是在受伤的工人中引发了更多愤怒。

engross.example: The adventure novel engrossed the young reader for an entire rainy weekend.  这本冒险小说让小读者整个雨天的周末都全神贯注。

absorb.example: The puzzle absorbed him completely for the whole afternoon.  这道谜题让他整个下午都全神贯注。

enthrall.example: The magician enthralled the entire audience with a single deck of cards.  魔术师仅用一副牌就吸引住了全场观众。

immerse.example: He immersed himself in the language by living with a local family.  他住在当地人家中，让自己沉浸在语言环境里。

enlighten.example: Perhaps you can enlighten us on the issue of the missing receipts.  或许你能就收据丢失的问题为我们解惑。

feud.example: The two villages carried on a feud over water rights for decades.  两个村子为水权争斗了几十年。

ennui.example: A deep sense of ennui settled over the students during the long summer.  漫长的夏天里，一种深深的倦怠感笼罩着学生们。

listlessness.example: A strange listlessness settled over the office in August.  八月里办公室弥漫着一种奇怪的倦怠。

tedium.example: She read novels to escape the tedium of the long commute.  她读小说以逃避长途通勤的乏味。

weariness.example: You could hear the weariness in the old teacher's voice.  你能从老教师的声音里听出疲倦。

keen interest.example: She showed a keen interest in insects from an early age.  她从小就对昆虫表现出浓厚的兴趣。

energy.example: The children still had plenty of energy after the long hike.  长途徒步之后孩子们仍精力充沛。

enthusiasm.example: Her enthusiasm for the project convinced the whole committee.  她对这个项目的热情说服了整个委员会。

exuberance.example: The band played with an exuberance that lifted the whole room.  乐队演奏得热情洋溢，带动了满屋气氛。

expostulate.example: The villagers expostulated with the officials about the new road.  村民们就这条新路向官员们提出抗议。

inveigh.example: Farmers gathered downtown to inveigh against the new fuel tax.  农民们聚集在市中心痛斥新的燃油税。

ensue.example: A bitter argument ensued as soon as the results were read aloud.  结果一被大声读出，激烈的争吵便随之而来。

complexify.example: New regulations only complexify an already confusing process.  新规定只是让本已混乱的流程更加复杂。

sophisticate.example: Engineers sophisticated the model until nobody could explain it.  工程师把模型改得越来越复杂，最后没人能解释清楚。

simplify.example: The new software simplifies the way teachers record grades.  新软件简化了老师登记成绩的方式。

streamline.example: The hospital streamlined admissions and cut waiting times in half.  医院精简了入院手续，把等候时间减半。

episodic.example: Episodic bursts of rain kept interrupting the outdoor ceremony all afternoon.  断断续续的阵雨整个下午不断打断露天典礼。

aperiodic.example: The signal turned out to be aperiodic and hard to model.  这个信号最终被证明是非周期的，难以建模。

discontinuous.example: The fossil record here is discontinuous and full of long gaps.  这里的化石记录是间断的，有很多长期空缺。

fitful.example: Noise from the street gave her a fitful night's sleep.  街上的噪音让她一夜睡得断断续续。

intermittent.example: Intermittent power failures made it impossible to finish the experiment that night.  断断续续的停电使当晚无法完成那项实验。

habitual.example: Habitual lateness eventually cost him the job.  惯常迟到最终让他失去了工作。

periodic.example: The bridge undergoes periodic checks every six months.  这座桥每六个月接受一次定期检查。

steady.example: Sales have shown steady growth for eight straight quarters.  销售额已连续八个季度稳定增长。

entrance.example: The puppet show entranced the small audience of restless children completely.  木偶戏让这群坐不住的小观众完全入了迷。

ravish.example: The painter's bold colors ravish the eye and hold it captive.  这位画家大胆的色彩令人赏心悦目、目不转睛。

carry away.example: He got carried away and promised far more than he could deliver.  他一激动忘了形，承诺远超他能做到的。

bore.phrase_cn: 让人受不了的老唠叨鬼
bore.example: My uncle is such a bore that guests leave early.  我叔叔特别无趣，客人们都早早离席。

disappoint.example: The sequel disappointed almost everyone who loved the first film.  这部续集让几乎所有喜欢第一部的人都失望了。

disgust.phrase_cn: 连他的盟友也感到厌恶
disgust.example: The state of the kitchen disgusted the health inspector.  厨房的状况让卫生检查员十分厌恶。

unprepossessing.example: The restaurant is unprepossessing outside but excellent inside.  这家餐馆外表不起眼，里面却极好。

entrap.example: The con artist entrapped an unwary buyer with a forged certificate.  骗子用一张伪造证书诱骗了一位不留神的买主。

ensnare.example: Cheap loans ensnared many families in years of debt.  廉价贷款使许多家庭陷入多年债务。

ensnarl.phrase_cn: 使市中心交通陷入混乱
ensnarl.example: The fallen crane ensnarled traffic for the entire morning.  倒下的吊车使整个上午的交通陷入混乱。

entoil.phrase_cn: 把敌方侦察兵诱入陷阱
entoil.example: The clever plan entoiled the smugglers near the border.  这个巧妙的计划在边境附近诱捕了走私者。

mesh.example: Dolphins are sometimes meshed in nets meant for other fish.  海豚有时会被捕捉其他鱼类的渔网缠住。

net.example: The police netted the thief before he could reach the border.  警察在小偷逃到边境前将他抓获。

snare.example: The hunter set a snare near the stream to catch rabbits.  猎人在溪边设下套索捕兔。

catch up.phrase: get caught up in a scandal
catch up.example: Several honest clerks were caught up in the fraud investigation.  几名诚实的职员被卷入了这起诈骗案调查。

besiege.example: Reporters besieged the minister with questions about the scandal.  记者们就丑闻不断向部长发问。

importune.example: Beggars importuned travelers for coins outside the station all evening.  乞丐整晚在车站外向旅客苦苦讨要零钱。

plead to.example: The prisoner pleaded to the judge for a lighter sentence.  囚犯向法官恳求减轻判刑。

appeal to.example: The charity appealed to donors for urgent help after the flood.  洪灾后慈善机构向捐赠者紧急求助。

promulgate.example: The government will promulgate a new law on data privacy next month.  政府将于下月正式颁布一项新的数据隐私法。

fleeting.example: For one fleeting moment the clouds parted above the valley.  有一个短暂的瞬间，云在山谷上方散开了。

impermanent.example: All fashions are impermanent, replaced by new styles within a few seasons.  一切时尚都是短暂的，几季之内就被新风格取代。

temporary.example: The company hired temporary staff to handle the busy holiday season.  公司雇了临时员工来应对繁忙的假日季。

transient.example: Fame in the internet age is often transient and quickly forgotten.  网络时代的名声往往短暂，很快被人遗忘。

transitory.example: His anger was transitory and he apologized within the hour.  他的愤怒很短暂，一小时内就道了歉。

fugacious.example: The fugacious scent of the blossoms vanished after a single warm afternoon.  花朵转瞬即逝的香气在一个暖午之后消失了。

fugitive.example: A fugitive smile crossed her face before she resumed her serious expression.  一丝转瞬即逝的笑意掠过她的脸。

permanent.example: They are seeking a permanent solution rather than another quick fix.  他们在寻找永久的解决办法，而不是又一个权宜之计。

ceaseless.example: The ceaseless traffic outside made it impossible for us to sleep.  外面不停的车流让我们无法入睡。

immortal.example: The poet's immortal lines are still quoted two thousand years later.  这位诗人不朽的诗句两千年后仍被引用。

undying.example: She pledged her undying loyalty to the cause she had joined.  她宣誓对所投身的事业永葆忠诚。

epic.example: Their epic journey across the desert took nearly four months on foot.  他们徒步穿越沙漠的宏大旅程花了近四个月。

grandiose.example: His grandiose plans for the company never survived contact with reality.  他为公司制定的浮夸计划一遇现实便破灭。

magnificent.example: From the summit we enjoyed a magnificent view of the whole valley.  从山顶我们欣赏到整个山谷的壮丽景色。

majestic.example: The majestic peaks rose above the clouds in the morning light.  雄伟的山峰在晨光中耸立于云端。

monumental.example: Building the cathedral was a monumental task that took two centuries.  建造这座大教堂是耗时两个世纪的浩大工程。

unheroic.example: His unheroic decision to flee disappointed everyone who had trusted him.  他不英勇的逃跑决定让所有信任他的人失望。

epicure.example: A noted epicure, he could name the region of any cheese he tasted.  他是知名的美食家，任何奶酪一尝就能说出产区。

bon vivant.cn: 讲究吃喝、会享受生活的人
bon vivant.example: As a bon vivant, he knew every good restaurant in Paris.  作为一个懂享受的人，他熟知巴黎每家好餐厅。

gastronomist.example: The gastronomist wrote a column comparing regional dumplings across the country.  这位美食家写专栏比较全国各地的饺子。

gourmand.example: The gourmand finished three courses before the rest of us started.  这位贪吃者在我们开始前就吃完了三道菜。

gourmet.example: As a serious gourmet, he traveled across three provinces for one soup.  作为一位认真的美食家，他为一道汤跨越了三个省。

apothegm.example: He ended every lecture with an apothegm his grandfather had taught him.  他每次讲座都以祖父教他的一句格言结尾。

byword.example: The brand became a byword for reliability among long-distance drivers.  这个品牌成了长途司机眼中可靠的代名词。

preface.example: The author used the preface to thank everyone who helped her research.  作者在序言中感谢了所有帮助她做研究的人。

epithet.example: He shouted an insulting epithet at the referee and was sent off.  他冲裁判喊出一个侮辱性的称号，结果被罚下场。

alias.example: The writer published her early novels under an alias to avoid attention.  这位作家用化名出版早期小说以避免关注。

cognomen.example: His teammates gave him a cognomen that stuck for twenty years.  队友给他起的绰号沿用了二十年。

sobriquet.example: The city earned the sobriquet of the Windy City long ago.  这座城市很早就得了风城的绰号。

epitomize.example: These narrow streets epitomize the era before automobiles reshaped the whole city.  这些狭窄的街道正是汽车重塑整座城市之前那个时代的典型。

body.example: The statue seems to body forth every ideal the founders cherished.  这座雕像仿佛体现了创建者珍视的每一个理想。

express.example: She struggled to express the gratitude she felt toward her mentor.  她难以表达对导师的感激之情。

externalize.example: Painting helped him externalize feelings he could never put into words.  绘画帮他把无法言说的情感外化出来。

incarnate.example: Many people think Hitler incarnated pure evil and boundless self-regard.  许多人认为希特勒是纯粹邪恶与极端自我的化身。

incorporate.example: The revised design incorporates suggestions from every member of the team.  修订后的设计纳入了团队每位成员的建议。

instantiate.example: These fossils instantiate the pattern the biologist predicted decades ago.  这些化石印证了生物学家几十年前预言的模式。

materialize.example: The promised funding never materialized, so the project was quietly dropped.  承诺的资金始终没到位，项目被悄悄放弃。

intemperate.example: His intemperate language during the debate cost him the support of moderates.  他在辩论中过激的言辞使他失去了温和派的支持。

excitability.example: His excitability made him a poor choice for delicate negotiations.  他易激动的性格使他不适合微妙的谈判。

equity.example: The reform aims at greater equity in education between rural and urban schools.  这项改革旨在促进城乡学校之间更大的教育公平。

evenhandedness.example: The referee earned respect for his evenhandedness in a heated match.  裁判在激烈比赛中的公正赢得了尊重。

fairness.example: Students accepted the grading system because of its obvious fairness.  学生们因评分制度明显公平而接受了它。

impartiality.example: A juror must maintain impartiality despite pressure from public opinion.  陪审员必须在舆论压力下保持公正。

neutrality.example: The small country preserved its neutrality throughout both world wars.  这个小国在两次世界大战中都保持中立。

nonpartisanship.example: The commission defended its nonpartisanship when both parties attacked its report.  两党都攻击报告时，委员会为自身的不偏不倚辩护。

bias.example: Reviewers were kept anonymous to reduce bias in judging the papers.  评审匿名以减少论文评判中的偏见。

nonobjectivity.example: The report's nonobjectivity was obvious to anyone who checked the sources.  任何核对来源的人都能看出报告不客观。

one-sidedness.example: Readers complained about the one-sidedness of the newspaper's election coverage.  读者抱怨报纸选举报道的片面性。

partisanship.example: Partisanship blocked every attempt to pass the compromise budget bill.  党派偏见阻碍了通过折中预算案的一切努力。

prejudice.example: Years of contact slowly wore away his prejudice against the newcomers.  多年接触慢慢消磨了他对新来者的偏见。

discriminatory.example: The court struck down the discriminatory rule as plainly unconstitutional.  法院以明显违宪为由推翻了该歧视性规定。

equivalent.example: They offered her the equivalent amount in shares instead of cash.  他们提出用等量的股份代替现金付给她。

coequal.example: The constitution treats the three branches as coequal partners in governing.  宪法把三个分支视为地位平等的治理伙伴。

counterpart.example: Our finance minister met his German counterpart to discuss the trade dispute.  我们的财政部长会见德国的对等官员，商讨贸易争端。

peer.example: His work is widely respected by his peers in the field.  他的研究在业内同辈中广受尊重。

equivocate.example: She equivocated under questioning about the true state of her finances.  在被问及财务真实状况时，她含糊其辞。

fudge.example: The spokesman fudged the question about layoffs for twenty painful minutes.  发言人就裁员问题含糊其词了痛苦的二十分钟。

prevaricate.example: Witnesses began to prevaricate whenever the lawyer asked about the missing money.  每当律师问到失踪的钱，证人就开始支吾其词。

palter.example: Witnesses should not palter with the truth when giving sworn testimony.  证人在宣誓作证时不应对真相含糊其词。

communicate straightforwardly.example: Good managers communicate straightforwardly instead of hiding bad news in jargon.  好的管理者坦率沟通，而不是用行话掩盖坏消息。

empirical.example: The theory sounds elegant but lacks empirical evidence from actual field trials.  这个理论听着优雅，却缺少来自实地试验的实证证据。

existential.example: Climate change poses an existential threat to low-lying island nations.  气候变化对低地岛国构成生存威胁。

experiential.example: The course emphasizes experiential learning through fieldwork rather than lectures.  这门课强调通过田野作业进行体验式学习。

experimental.example: The drug remains experimental and is not yet approved for sale.  该药仍处试验阶段，尚未获批销售。

observational.example: Observational studies suggest a link that trials have not yet confirmed.  观察性研究提示一种试验尚未证实的关联。

nonempirical.example: Purely nonempirical arguments rarely persuade scientists who demand hard data.  纯粹非实证的论证很难说服要求硬数据的科学家。

theoretical.example: His objection is theoretical and has no bearing on daily practice.  他的反对是理论性的，与日常实践无关。

unempirical.example: Editors rejected the paper as unempirical because it cited no measurements.  编辑因论文未引用任何测量数据而退稿。

errant.example: The errant student was suspended after ignoring three separate warnings.  这名行为不端的学生在忽视三次警告后被停学。

misbehaving.example: The teacher quietly separated the two misbehaving boys.  老师悄悄把那两个捣乱的男孩分开。

behaved.example: Their dog is remarkably well behaved even around excited small children.  他们的狗即使在兴奋的小孩身边也非常守规矩。

behaving.example: Teachers rewarded the well-behaving students with an extra afternoon outdoors.  老师奖励守规矩的学生多一个下午的户外时间。

nice.cn: 规矩得体的；令人愉快的
nice.example: He is a nice boy who never gives his parents trouble.  他是个规矩的男孩，从不给父母添麻烦。

changing.example: Farmers must adapt to changing rainfall patterns across the growing season.  农民必须适应生长季中变化的降雨模式。

fluctuating.example: Fluctuating oil prices made it hard to plan next year's budget.  波动的油价让明年的预算难以制定。

unstable.example: The ladder felt unstable, so we refused to climb any higher.  梯子感觉不稳，我们不肯再往上爬。

unsteady.example: Her voice was unsteady as she read the letter to us.  她给我们读那封信时声音颤抖不稳。

varying.example: The students finished the task with varying degrees of accuracy.  学生完成任务的准确度各不相同。

changeless.example: The village seemed changeless, though the world outside had transformed completely.  村子好像从未改变，尽管外面的世界已彻底变样。

stable.example: His condition has been stable since the operation last Tuesday.  自上周二手术以来他的病情一直稳定。

unchanging.example: Her unchanging kindness comforted everyone who worked in that busy office.  她始终如一的善意安慰了那间忙碌办公室里的每个人。

unvarying.example: The machine repeated the task at an unvarying speed all night.  机器整夜以一成不变的速度重复这项工作。

erudite.example: The erudite professor could quote ancient poetry from memory for hours.  那位博学的教授能凭记忆连续几小时引用古诗。

learned.example: The learned judge quoted three languages in a single short opinion.  这位博学的法官在一份简短意见中引用了三种语言。

lettered.example: Only a lettered few could read the inscriptions on those tombs.  只有少数有学问的人能读懂那些墓上的铭文。

literate.cn: 有读写能力的；有学识的
literate.example: Barely half the adults in that region were literate a century ago.  一个世纪前该地区成年人中识字的勉强过半。

scholarly.example: His scholarly habits kept him in the archive until closing time.  他学者式的习惯让他在档案馆待到闭馆。

well-read.example: She is well-read enough to place any quotation within seconds.  她博览群书，能几秒内说出任何引文的出处。

unlettered.example: Many unlettered farmers memorized long songs instead of writing them down.  许多未受教育的农民靠记诵长歌，而不是把它们写下来。

benighted.cn: 愚昧无知的；蒙昧落后的
benighted.example: He dismissed the whole century as benighted and hopelessly superstitious.  他把整个世纪都视为愚昧且不可救药地迷信。

illiterate.example: Millions remain illiterate because schools in their villages closed years ago.  数百万人仍是文盲，因为他们村里的学校多年前就关了。

uneducated.phrase_cn: 大多未受教育的农场工人
uneducated.example: Though uneducated, he could repair any engine brought to his shop.  他虽未受过教育，却能修好送到店里的任何发动机。

unscholarly.example: Reviewers called the footnotes unscholarly and demanded verifiable primary sources.  评审称脚注不够学术，要求提供可核查的原始资料。

pump up.example: Advertising pumped up demand until the small factory could not cope.  广告抬高需求，直到小工厂应付不来。

weasel out of.example: He tried to weasel out of the contract by citing vague technicalities.  他试图以含糊的技术细节为由逃避合同。

greet.example: She greeted every customer by name as they entered the shop.  客人进店时她都能叫出名字打招呼。

habitually indulge in.example: Those who habitually indulge in flattery lose the trust of colleagues.  惯于沉溺于奉承的人会失去同事的信任。

seek.example: Many families seek shelter in the school gym during heavy storms.  暴风雨期间许多家庭到学校体育馆寻求庇护。

recondite.example: The lecture grew so recondite that half the audience quietly left.  讲座变得如此深奥，一半听众悄悄离场。

take up.example: She took up painting after retiring from thirty years of teaching.  她在结束三十年教学生涯后开始学画画。

appreciation.example: He expressed his appreciation for the team that worked all weekend.  他对整个周末工作的团队表示感激。

estimation.example: Her honesty raised her greatly in the estimation of her colleagues.  她的诚实大大提升了同事对她的评价。

odium.example: Public odium followed the executives long after the company had been dissolved.  公司解散很久之后，公众的憎恶仍伴随着这些高管。

estimable.example: Her work in public health is an estimable achievement by any measure.  她在公共卫生领域的工作无论怎么看都是值得尊敬的成就。

prestigious.example: He turned down a prestigious post to stay near his family.  他为了留在家人身边拒绝了一个有声望的职位。

reputable.example: Buy the parts from a reputable supplier rather than an auction site.  从信誉良好的供应商买零件，而不是拍卖网站。

applaudable.example: Her decision to return the money was applaudable and widely reported.  她归还钱款的决定值得称赞，被广泛报道。

infamous.example: The dictator remains infamous for the brutal purges he ordered during his rule.  这位独裁者因其统治期间下令进行的残酷清洗而臭名昭著。

discreditable.example: The committee found his discreditable conduct unworthy of a public official.  委员会认为他不光彩的行为不配做公职人员。

illaudable.example: Critics judged his illaudable silence during the crisis a moral failure.  批评者认为他危机中不值称赞的沉默是道德失败。

estrange.example: A long quarrel over money estranged the two brothers for years.  一场长久的金钱纠纷使两兄弟多年感情失和。

etch.example: That afternoon is etched in my memory more clearly than yesterday.  那个下午比昨天更清晰地铭刻在我记忆中。

impress.example: His father impressed on him the value of finishing every job.  父亲让他牢记做完每件事的价值。

imprint.example: The melody was imprinted on her memory after a single hearing.  那段旋律听一遍就铭刻在她记忆里。

infix.example: Years of drill infixed the routine so deeply that he could perform it half asleep.  多年操练把这套流程深植于他心中，他半睡半醒都能做出来。

imperishable.example: The soldiers won imperishable glory defending the bridge for three days.  士兵们守桥三天赢得了不朽的荣耀。

ethereal.example: Her voice had an ethereal quality that hushed the entire hall.  她的嗓音有种轻灵飘逸的质感，让全场安静下来。

fluffy.example: The kitten was a fluffy ball of gray fur on my lap.  小猫是我膝上一团蓬松的灰毛。

bodiless.example: A bodiless voice from the speakers announced the final boarding call.  扩音器里传出无形的声音宣布最后登机通知。

formless.example: His fear was formless, attached to nothing he could actually name.  他的恐惧无形，没有依附于任何他能叫出名字的事物。

incorporeal.example: Medieval writers argued about whether angels were truly incorporeal beings.  中世纪作者争论天使是否真是无形的存在。

nonmaterial.example: Volunteers work for nonmaterial rewards such as gratitude and shared purpose.  志愿者为感激与共同目标等非物质回报工作。

nonphysical.example: The lawsuit claimed nonphysical harm such as anxiety and lost reputation.  诉讼主张焦虑与名誉损失等非身体伤害。

ethics.example: The committee revised its code of ethics after the scandal.  丑闻之后委员会修订了道德规范。

ethos.example: Teamwork lies at the heart of this small company's ethos.  团队合作是这家小公司精神准则的核心。

morals.example: The novel questions whether wartime morals differ from those of peacetime.  小说质问战时道德是否与和平时期不同。

norms.example: Newcomers quickly learn the unwritten norms of that tight-knit workshop.  新来者很快学会那间紧密作坊的不成文规范。

principles.example: She resigned rather than betray the principles she had taught for years.  她宁愿辞职也不背弃多年所教的原则。

standards.example: The clinic holds all its staff to strict hygiene standards.  诊所要求全体员工遵守严格的卫生标准。

euphemism.example: Downsizing is often just a euphemism for firing people.  精简规模常常只是解雇员工的委婉说法。

euphonious.example: The poet chose euphonious words that pleased the ear when read aloud.  诗人选用朗读时悦耳的词语。

melodious.example: Her melodious laugh carried across the courtyard on the still evening.  她悦耳的笑声在静夜里穿过庭院。

canorous.example: The monks' canorous chanting filled the stone hall every morning.  僧人洪亮悦耳的吟唱每天早晨充满石厅。

harmonizing.example: Two harmonizing melodies rose together at the end of the song.  两段和谐的旋律在歌曲结尾一同升起。

symphonious.example: Dawn brought a symphonious mixture of birdsong to the quiet valley.  黎明给静谷带来和谐悦耳的鸟鸣。

tuneless.example: He whistled a tuneless melody while waiting for the bus.  他等公交时吹着不成调的口哨。

unmelodious.example: The old violin produced an unmelodious sound that emptied the room.  那把旧小提琴发出难听的声音，把屋里人都赶走了。

intoxication.example: The intoxication of victory faded once the hard rebuilding work began.  艰难重建开始后，胜利的陶醉便消退了。

rhapsody.example: He went into rhapsodies about the noodles he ate in Osaka.  他对在大阪吃的面条大加赞美。

evacuate.example: Firefighters evacuated the entire building before the roof collapsed.  消防员在屋顶塌落前撤离了整栋大楼。

vacate.example: Tenants must vacate the apartment before noon on the last day.  租户必须在最后一天中午前搬出公寓。

void.example: Missing a single payment can void the entire warranty agreement.  漏付一期就可能使整个保修协议失效。

fill up.example: We filled up the tank before crossing the long desert road.  我们在穿越漫长沙漠公路前把油箱加满。

occupy.example: Troops occupied the town for six months before withdrawing quietly.  部队占领该镇六个月后悄然撤离。

load.example: Workers loaded the truck with sacks of rice before dawn.  工人们在黎明前把一袋袋大米装上卡车。

endless.example: The meeting felt endless, though it lasted only ninety minutes.  会议感觉没完没了，其实只开了九十分钟。

un-.example: Adding the prefix un- turns ending into unending without further change.  加上前缀 un- 就把 ending 变成 unending。

lasting.example: Her kindness left a lasting impression on everyone in the ward.  她的善意给病房里每个人留下持久印象。

miss out.example: Arrive early so you do not miss out on the free samples.  早点到，别错过免费样品。

mortal.cn: 终将死亡的，凡人的；致命的
mortal.example: The play reminds us that even great kings are mortal men.  这部剧提醒我们连伟大的国王也是凡人。

evict.example: The landlord threatened to evict the tenants who had not paid.  房东威胁要赶走那些没交房租的房客。

evince.example: His flat answers evinced very little interest in the job.  他平淡的回答表明他对这份工作兴趣不大。

bespeak.example: The neat handwriting bespeaks a patience few students still possess.  整洁的字迹表明少有学生仍具备的耐心。

betray.example: His trembling hands betrayed the fear his calm voice concealed.  他颤抖的双手泄露了平静语调所掩藏的恐惧。

give away.example: One careless remark gave away the surprise we had planned for months.  一句不慎的话泄露了我们筹划数月的惊喜。

keep hidden.example: The family kept the letters hidden in a drawer for decades.  这家人把信藏在抽屉里几十年。

choosy.example: He is so choosy about coffee that he grinds his own beans.  他对咖啡挑剔到自己磨豆子。

pernickety.example: Our editor is pernickety about commas but forgiving about long sentences.  我们的编辑对逗号极挑剔，对长句却宽容。

toilsome.example: Copying manuscripts by hand was toilsome work that ruined many eyes.  手抄书稿是毁坏许多人眼睛的辛苦活。

forgive.example: She forgave him quickly, though the insult had stung for days.  她很快原谅了他，尽管那侮辱刺痛了她几天。

emblazon.example: The old chronicle emblazons the deeds of the founding kings.  古老的编年史颂扬开国君王的功业。

burn up.example: That careless remark really burned me up for the rest of the day.  那句不经心的话让我一整天都很生气。

excavate.example: Archaeologists excavated the ancient tomb layer by careful layer.  考古学家一层一层小心地挖掘那座古墓。

fill in.example: Workers filled in the trench as soon as the pipes were laid.  管道铺好后工人立刻把沟填上。

exceptional.example: She showed exceptional talent for mathematics at a very young age.  她在很小的年纪就表现出非凡的数学天赋。

exceeding.example: He showed exceeding patience with students who kept asking the same question.  他对反复问同一问题的学生表现出极大耐心。

extraordinary.example: It took extraordinary courage to report what she had seen.  举报她所见之事需要非凡的勇气。

prosaic.example: Behind the legend lies a prosaic story about a lost receipt.  传说背后是一个关于遗失收据的平淡故事。

customary.example: It is customary here to remove your shoes at the door.  这里习惯在门口脱鞋。

flatter.example: He flattered the boss all morning hoping for a promotion.  他整个上午奉承老板，希望得到升职。

praise lavishly.example: Critics praised the film lavishly, calling it the year's finest work.  评论家对这部电影大加赞扬，称其为年度最佳。

excrete.example: Kidneys excrete waste that would otherwise poison the bloodstream.  肾脏排出否则会毒害血液的废物。

excruciate.example: The interrogators excruciated the prisoners for information they never had.  审讯者折磨囚犯，逼问他们从未掌握的情报。

rack.example: He was racked by guilt long after the incident was forgotten.  事件被淡忘后他仍长久受负罪感折磨。

harrow.example: The memory of that night harrowed him for the rest of his life.  那一夜的记忆折磨了他的余生。

exculpate.example: New evidence exculpated the accused man after ten years in prison.  新证据在这名被告入狱十年后为他开脱了罪责。

attribute guilt.example: The report attributes guilt to managers who ignored the safety warnings.  报告把罪责归于无视安全警告的管理者。

exemplary.example: The young officer received a medal for exemplary conduct under fire.  这名年轻军官因在战火中表现堪为楷模而获得奖章。

archetypal.example: Robin Hood is the archetypal outlaw who steals for the poor.  罗宾汉是为穷人偷窃的典型侠盗。

imitable.example: His prose is admirable but hardly imitable by ordinary writers.  他的文章令人钦佩，但普通作者很难效仿。

paradigmatic.example: Economists treat the crash as a paradigmatic case of market panic.  经济学家把这次崩盘视为市场恐慌的典型案例。

quintessential.example: That small cafe is the quintessential Parisian spot for slow mornings.  那家小咖啡馆是巴黎慢晨的典型去处。

exempt.example: The new law exempts school textbooks from the sales tax.  新法免除学校教科书的销售税。

expend.example: They expended most of their savings on repairing the leaking roof.  他们把大部分积蓄花在修补漏雨的屋顶上。

spend.example: The storm had spent its force by the time we arrived.  我们到时风暴已耗尽力量。

incomplete.example: The survey remains incomplete because two districts never returned their forms.  调查仍不完整，因为两个区从未交回表格。

electrify.cn: 使激动，使震惊；使电气化
electrify.example: Her final note electrified the audience and brought them to their feet.  她最后一个音让观众激动得站了起来。

galvanize.example: The coach's angry speech galvanized the team into immediate action.  教练愤怒的讲话激励球队立刻行动起来。

turn on.example: Live jazz really turns him on more than any recorded music.  现场爵士比任何录音都更让他兴奋。

soporific.example: Alcohol acts as a mild soporific, but it ruins deep sleep.  酒精是一种温和的催眠物，但会破坏深度睡眠。

exhort.example: The speaker exhorted the students to persevere despite repeated failures.  演讲者勉励学生们即使屡遭失败也要坚持下去。

nudge.example: Her patient questions nudged him into agreeing to see a doctor.  她耐心的询问说服他同意去看医生。

prod.example: Her friends had to prod her into applying for the scholarship.  朋友们不得不促使她去申请那份奖学金。

egg on.example: His friends egged him on until he agreed to the dare.  朋友们不断鼓动，直到他答应那个挑战。

deferrable.example: Treat this repair as deferrable and schedule it for next quarter.  把这项维修视为可推迟的，安排到下季度。

exodus.example: The factory closure caused a mass exodus from the small town.  工厂关闭造成大批人离开这个小镇。

gush.phrase_cn: 从破裂的水管喷涌而出
gush.cn: 喷涌而出；滔滔不绝地说
gush.example: Water gushed from the broken pipe and flooded the basement.  水从破裂的水管喷涌而出，淹了地下室。

outpour.example: The letter released an outpour of memories she had long suppressed.  那封信释放出她长期压抑的记忆洪流。

outpouring.example: The news brought an outpouring of sympathy from readers across the country.  这条消息引来全国读者的同情涌现。

influx.example: The sudden influx of tourists overwhelmed the small town's hotels and restaurants.  游客突然涌入，使这个小镇的旅馆和餐馆不堪重负。

flux.example: The whole industry is in flux as new regulations take effect.  新规生效后整个行业都在剧烈变动。

inflow.example: A sudden inflow of foreign money pushed local housing prices higher.  外资突然涌入推高了当地房价。

inrush.example: An inrush of cold air followed him through the heavy door.  一股冷空气随他穿过厚重的门涌入。

prove guilty.example: The prosecution failed to prove the defendant guilty beyond reasonable doubt.  检方未能排除合理怀疑地证明被告有罪。

exorbitant.example: Tourists complained about exorbitant prices for bottled water near the temple.  游客抱怨寺庙附近瓶装水价格过高。

extravagant.example: Their extravagant spending on parties left the charity nearly broke.  他们在宴会上的挥霍开支让这家慈善机构几乎破产。

intolerable.cn: 无法容忍的，难以承受的
intolerable.example: The heat in that attic room became intolerable by early afternoon.  下午刚过，那间阁楼里的暑热就变得无法忍受。

overdue.cn: 过期的，逾期的；早该发生的
overdue.example: The library fined her for three books that were badly overdue.  图书馆因三本严重逾期的书对她罚款。

unconscionable.cn: 过分的，不合理的；不道德的
unconscionable.example: Charging that fee for a five-minute repair seems unconscionable to me.  五分钟的维修收那笔费用在我看来太过分。

middling.example: The restaurant serves middling food at prices that feel a bit high.  这家餐厅食物一般，价格却偏高。

nonglamorous.example: Most research is nonglamorous work involving spreadsheets and long quiet afternoons.  多数研究是涉及表格和漫长安静下午的平淡工作。

plain-jane.example: She drove a plain-jane sedan that nobody ever looked at twice.  她开一辆没人会多看一眼的普通轿车。

unexotic.example: The menu was deliberately unexotic to please cautious family diners.  菜单故意不猎奇，以取悦谨慎的家庭客人。

communicative.example: He grew more communicative after the second cup of strong tea.  喝下第二杯浓茶后他变得更爱说话。

garrulous.example: Our garrulous neighbor talked for an hour about his lawn.  我们唠叨的邻居就他的草坪讲了一个小时。
garrulous.cn: 啰嗦的，话多令人厌烦的

glib.example: His glib answers convinced no one on the hiring committee that afternoon.  那天下午他油腔滑调的回答没能说服招聘委员会的任何人。

loquacious.example: Our loquacious guide talked steadily from the museum door to the exit.  我们话多的导游从博物馆门口一直讲到出口。

talkative.example: Our talkative driver described every building along the winding coastal road.  健谈的司机介绍了蜿蜒海滨路上的每座建筑。

vocative.example: Latin uses a vocative form when directly addressing a person.  拉丁语直接称呼某人时使用呼格形式。

voluble.example: Our voluble guide talked cheerfully about every stone in the old city.  我们健谈的导游兴致勃勃地讲述古城里的每一块石头。

taciturn.example: The taciturn farmer answered our questions with a nod or a shrug.  沉默寡言的农夫只用点头或耸肩回答我们的问题。

expedite.example: Hiring two more clerks expedited the review of every application.  又雇了两名职员加快了每份申请的审核。

celerity.example: The crew unloaded the ship with a celerity that impressed everyone.  船员卸货之迅速令所有人赞叹。

foot-dragging.example: Months of foot-dragging delayed the repairs until the roof finally collapsed.  数月的拖延使维修一再延后，屋顶最终塌了。

expediency.example: The truce was a matter of political expediency, not principle.  这次休战是政治上的权宜之计，而非出于原则。

advisability.example: The board debated the advisability of opening a branch abroad.  董事会讨论在海外开分支是否可取。

desirability.example: Few doubted the desirability of cleaner air, only the cost involved.  很少有人怀疑清洁空气的可取性，只质疑成本。

judiciousness.example: Her judiciousness in handling complaints kept small problems from growing large.  她处理投诉的审慎让小问题没有变大。

makeshift.example: Volunteers built a makeshift clinic from tents and folding tables.  志愿者用帐篷和折叠桌搭起临时诊所。

inadvisability.example: Engineers stressed the inadvisability of reopening the bridge before full inspection.  工程师强调未全面检查就重开大桥不可取。

inexpediency.example: Later events proved the inexpediency of announcing the merger so early.  后来的事证明这么早宣布合并并不明智。

injudiciousness.example: His injudiciousness in emailing the whole company cost him the promotion.  他给全公司群发邮件的欠考虑使他失去晋升。

expiate.example: He spent years doing charity work to expiate his guilt.  他做了多年慈善工作来赎自己的罪。

mend.example: He promised to mend his ways after the second stern warning.  第二次严厉警告后他承诺改正。

atone for.example: He spent years volunteering to atone for the harm he caused.  他多年做志愿者以弥补自己造成的伤害。

expire.example: Your passport expires next month, so apply for a new one.  你的护照下个月到期，所以要申请新的。

elapse.example: Three weeks elapsed before anyone noticed the missing files.  三周过去才有人注意到文件不见了。

decease.example: The estate was divided among the children after her decease.  她去世后遗产在子女间分割。

leave off.example: We left off reading at the chapter where the storm begins.  我们在暴风雨开始的那章停下阅读。

let up.example: The rain finally let up just before the parade was cancelled.  游行取消前雨终于停了。

wind up.example: They wound up the project a month ahead of the deadline.  他们比截止期提前一个月结束了项目。

wink out.example: One by one the harbor lights winked out before the dawn.  港口的灯在黎明前一盏盏熄灭。

come to life.example: The sleepy market comes to life the moment the fishing boats return.  渔船一回来，冷清的市场立刻活跃起来。

continue.example: The negotiations continued for eleven hours without a proper break.  谈判持续了十一小时没有正式休息。

persist.example: Fog persisted over the runway until late in the afternoon.  雾在跑道上空持续到下午晚些时候。

hang on.example: The old bridge hung on for decades after engineers condemned it.  那座旧桥在被判定危险后又存留数十年。

clear-cut.example: The evidence gave us a clear-cut answer for the first time.  证据第一次给了我们明确的答案。

univocal.example: The treaty needs univocal wording that no side can reinterpret later.  这份条约需要含义明确的措辞，任何一方都无法事后曲解。

implicit.example: Club members share an implicit agreement to split all travel costs.  俱乐部成员之间有一个心照不宣的约定：平摊所有旅行开销。

implied.example: His polite note carried an implied threat that everyone recognized.  他礼貌的字条里含着人人都听得出的威胁。

inferred.example: The date is inferred from tree rings rather than written records.  这个年代是从树轮而非文献推断出来的。

indefinite.cn: 不明确的，含糊的；无限期的
indefinite.example: They postponed the trip for an indefinite period without explaining why.  他们无限期推迟了旅行，也没解释原因。

unspecific.example: The warning was so unspecific that nobody knew which road to avoid.  警告太笼统，没人知道该避开哪条路。

exploit.example: The company plans to exploit the island's natural resources responsibly.  公司计划负责任地开发这个岛的自然资源。

play on.example: The advertisement plays on parents' fears about their children's safety.  广告利用父母对孩子安全的恐惧。

capitalize on.example: The team capitalized on a defensive mistake to score twice.  球队利用一次防守失误连进两球。

impose on.example: I hate to impose on you, but could I borrow the car tonight?  我不想麻烦你，但今晚能借下车吗？

exponent.example: He became a leading exponent of modern jazz in the fifties.  他在五十年代成为现代爵士乐的主要倡导者。

advocator.example: She became a tireless advocator of free school meals for children.  她成了儿童免费校餐不倦的提倡者。

backer.example: The play closed when its main backer withdrew his funding.  主要资助人撤资后这部剧停演了。

booster.example: He was the town's loudest booster long before tourists discovered it.  游客发现这里之前他就是全镇最响的鼓吹者。

espouser.example: As an early espouser of the theory, he faced constant ridicule.  作为该理论的早期拥护者，他不断受到嘲笑。

promoter.example: The concert promoter guaranteed the band a fee regardless of ticket sales.  演出主办方无论票房如何都保证付给乐队报酬。

proponent.example: She became the leading proponent of change within the old institution.  她成了这家老机构内部倡导变革的主要支持者。

launder.example: They laundered the profits through a chain of small restaurants.  他们通过一连串小餐馆洗白利润。

exquisite.example: The tiny box showed exquisite workmanship in every carved detail.  这个小盒子每一处雕刻细节都显示出精致的工艺。

dainty.example: She wore a dainty pair of silk gloves to the evening reception.  她戴着一副精致的丝质手套去参加晚间招待会。

elegant.example: The hotel lobby was decorated in an elegant and understated style.  酒店大堂以优雅内敛的风格装饰。

recherché.example: His recherché vocabulary impressed some readers and annoyed others.  他罕见讲究的用词让一些读者赞叹，也让另一些人厌烦。

select.example: Only a select few were invited to the private tasting.  只有精选的少数人受邀参加私人品鉴。

extant.example: Only three copies of the manuscript are still extant today.  这份手稿如今只有三个抄本现存。

current.cn: 现在的，通行的；水流，电流
current.example: The current version of the software fixes several old bugs.  该软件的现行版本修复了若干旧漏洞。

ongoing.example: The repairs are ongoing and should finish by next month.  维修仍在持续进行，应在下月完成。

present-day.example: Present-day readers may find the old spelling confusing.  当今的读者可能觉得旧拼写令人困惑。

existent.example: Only two existent copies of that pamphlet remain in the archive.  档案馆里只剩那本小册子的两份现存副本。

destroyed.example: Most of the destroyed documents could never be recovered.  大部分被毁的文件再也无法复原。

extinct.example: The dodo became extinct less than a century after sailors reached the island.  水手到达该岛不到一百年，渡渡鸟就灭绝了。

lost.example: Scholars still hope to recover the lost chapters of the epic.  学者们仍希望找回这部史诗失传的篇章。

missing.example: Two pages are missing from the only surviving copy.  唯一留存的副本缺失了两页。

nonextant.example: The play is nonextant, known only from a brief ancient description.  这部戏剧已不复存在，只从一段古代简述中得知。

extemporize.example: Asked to speak, the mayor extemporized a short but moving speech.  被请上台后，市长即兴发表了一篇简短而动人的演讲。

follow a script.example: Rather than follow a script, the host improvised the whole interview.  主持人没有按稿子来，而是即兴完成了整场访谈。

extenuate.example: His youth did not extenuate so serious an offense.  他年纪轻并不能减轻如此严重的罪责。

deodorize.example: They deodorized the kitchen after the fish had spoiled.  鱼变质后他们给厨房除了臭。

excuse.example: Nothing can excuse such careless handling of the evidence.  如此草率地处理证据是无法辩解的。

explain away.example: He tried to explain away the missing money as a bookkeeping error.  他试图把丢失的钱辩解为记账失误。

gloze over.example: The report glozes over the failures of the previous administration.  该报告掩饰了上届政府的失败。

bygone.example: The mansion still recalls the elegance of a bygone age.  这座宅邸仍让人想起逝去年代的优雅。

bypast.example: She spoke fondly of bypast summers on her grandfather's farm.  她深情地谈起祖父农场上往昔的夏天。

defunct.example: The rule has been defunct for over twenty years.  这条规定已废止二十多年。

expired.example: The pharmacy discarded all the expired medicines.  药房丢掉了所有过期药品。

vanished.example: Archaeologists study the pottery of that vanished people.  考古学家研究那个消失民族的陶器。

alive.example: The language is still alive in a few remote mountain villages.  这门语言在少数偏远山村中仍然活着。

existing.example: We can upgrade the existing system instead of buying a new one.  我们可以升级现有系统，而不必新买一套。

living.example: Coelacanths were long thought extinct until a living one was caught.  矛尾鱼长期被认为已灭绝，直到捕到一条活的。

resuscitated.example: The resuscitated swimmer was breathing on his own within minutes.  被救活的泳者几分钟内就能自主呼吸。

perpetuation.example: Such textbooks contribute to the perpetuation of old stereotypes.  这类教材助长了旧有成见的延续。

blanket.example: Firefighters blanketed the burning oil with thick white foam.  消防员用厚厚的白色泡沫覆盖扑灭了燃烧的油。

snuff out.example: A single storm can snuff out years of careful planting.  一场风暴就能毁掉多年的精心种植。

rekindle.example: The documentary rekindled public interest in deep-sea exploration.  这部纪录片重新激起了公众对深海探索的兴趣。

carol.example: The children caroled cheerfully outside every door on the street.  孩子们在街上每户门前欢快地颂唱。

resound.example: The hall resounded with applause for the young violinist.  大厅回响着对这位年轻小提琴手的掌声。

extort.example: The kidnappers tried to extort a large sum from the victim's family.  绑匪企图从受害者家人那里勒索一大笔钱。

wrest.phrase_cn: 从对手手中夺取控制权
wrest.example: The younger managers wrested control of the firm from their rivals.  年轻的经理们从对手手中夺取了公司的控制权。

wring.example: The lawyer wrung an admission from the reluctant witness.  律师从不情愿的证人口中硬逼出一句承认。

pull.example: The dentist pulled the broken tooth in a single minute.  牙医一分钟就拔掉了那颗断牙。

yank.example: She yanked the drawer open and grabbed the car keys.  她猛地拉开抽屉，抓起车钥匙。

tear out.example: He tore out the map and folded it into his coat pocket.  他撕下地图，折好放进外套口袋。

bloodline.example: The stallion comes from a famous racing bloodline.  这匹公马出自著名的赛马血统。

breeding.example: Her manners betrayed careful breeding rather than mere training.  她的举止透出良好家世，而非单纯的训练。

descent.example: He is a scientist of Hungarian descent working in Canada.  他是一位在加拿大工作的匈牙利血统科学家。

genealogy.example: She spent years compiling the genealogy of her mother's family.  她花了数年编纂母亲家族的家谱。

lineage.example: The family claims direct lineage from a medieval king.  这个家族自称是某位中世纪国王的直系血脉。

family tree.example: They pinned a huge family tree to the dining room wall.  他们把一张巨大的家谱钉在餐厅墙上。

encyclopedic.cn: 知识广博的，包罗万象的
encyclopedic.example: His encyclopedic memory for baseball statistics astonished everyone.  他对棒球数据的百科式记忆令所有人惊讶。

comprehensive.example: The committee produced a comprehensive report on water quality.  委员会就水质提出了一份全面的报告。

exhaustive.example: After an exhaustive review, the board found no wrongdoing.  经过详尽审查，董事会未发现不当行为。

inclusive.example: The fee is inclusive of meals and local transport.  费用包含餐食和当地交通。

panoramic.example: From the rooftop we enjoyed a panoramic view of the harbor at sunset.  从屋顶上我们欣赏到日落时港口的全景。

inapplicable.example: The old rule is inapplicable to digital contracts.  旧规则不适用于电子合同。

pertinent.example: Only evidence pertinent to the discussion should be presented today.  今天只应提出与讨论相关的证据。

profligate.example: The council's profligate spending on ceremonies angered local taxpayers.  议会在典礼上挥霍无度的开支激怒了当地纳税人。

spendthrift.example: A reckless spendthrift, he owed money to nearly every friend.  作为一个挥霍无度的人，他几乎欠了每个朋友的钱。

squandering.example: Squandering money on gadgets left him broke by December.  在小玩意上挥霍钱财让他十二月就身无分文。

thriftless.example: His thriftless spending soon exhausted the family savings.  他不节俭的花销很快耗尽了家庭储蓄。

unthrifty.example: The unthrifty young lord sold off the estate piece by piece.  这位挥霍的年轻贵族把地产一块块卖掉了。

wasteful.example: Printing every email is wasteful and completely unnecessary.  把每封邮件都打印出来既浪费又完全没必要。

immoderate.example: Her immoderate praise made the young writer distinctly uneasy.  她过度的赞美让这位年轻作家明显不安。

inordinate.example: He spends an inordinate amount of time arranging his desk.  他花过多时间整理书桌。

overmuch.example: She did not worry overmuch about the missed deadline.  她并没有过分担心错过的截止日期。

plethoric.example: The market suffers from a plethoric supply of cheap steel.  市场因廉价钢材供应过剩而受困。

uncon-.example: The scan split unconscionable into uncon- and scionable.  扫描把 unconscionable 拆成了 uncon- 和 scionable。

scionable.example: Together uncon- and scionable spell the word unconscionable.  uncon- 与 scionable 合起来就是 unconscionable。

unmerciful.cn: 过分的，无节制的；无情的
unmerciful.example: He works at an unmerciful pace that exhausts everyone around him.  他以过分的节奏工作，把身边所有人都累垮。

frugal.example: They led a frugal life and saved almost every coin.  他们过着节俭的生活，几乎每一分钱都存起来。

conserving.example: Simple habits like conserving water reduce the monthly bills.  节约用水这类简单习惯能降低每月账单。

economical.example: A small diesel engine is more economical on long journeys.  小型柴油发动机长途出行更省油。

penny-pinching.example: His penny-pinching ways annoyed everyone at the restaurant.  他抠门的做法让餐馆里所有人都不快。

scrimping.example: After years of scrimping, they finally bought a small house.  省吃俭用多年后，他们终于买了一栋小房子。

skimping.example: Skimping on safety checks eventually caused the accident.  在安全检查上偷工减料最终导致了事故。

thrifty.example: Thrifty habits helped her pay off the loan early.  节俭的习惯帮她提前还清了贷款。

extricate.example: It took him years to extricate himself from serious debt.  他花了好几年才使自己脱离沉重债务。

enmesh.example: He became enmeshed in a lawsuit that lasted a decade.  他被卷入一场持续十年的诉讼。

frolic.example: The puppies frolicked in the garden all afternoon.  小狗们整个下午都在花园里嬉戏。

exude.example: The new captain exudes confidence whenever the game gets tight.  每当比赛紧张，这位新队长都散发出自信。

bleed.example: The red dye bled onto the white shirt in the wash.  洗涤时红色染料渗到了白衬衫上。

ooze.example: Thick sap oozed slowly from the cut in the bark.  浓稠的树液从树皮的切口慢慢渗出。

seep.example: Rainwater seeped into the basement through a narrow crack.  雨水从一道窄缝渗进了地下室。

glory.example: He gloried in the praise his research finally received.  他为研究终于获得的赞誉而洋洋自得。

lament.example: Older residents still lament the loss of the orchards that once surrounded town.  年长的居民仍在哀叹曾环绕小镇的果园的消失。

mourn.example: The whole village mourned the fishermen lost at sea.  全村哀悼在海上失踪的渔民。

fable.example: An ancient fable says the mountain spring is a mother's tears.  一个古老的寓言说，这眼山泉是一位母亲的眼泪。

legend.example: According to legend, a dragon once guarded this valley.  据传说，曾有一条龙守卫这座山谷。

mythos.example: The film borrows heavily from Norse mythos and folklore.  这部电影大量借用北欧神话体系和民间传说。

tale.example: Grandmother told us a tale about a talking fox.  祖母给我们讲了一个会说话的狐狸的故事。

fabrication.example: The witness's story turned out to be a fabrication.  证人的说法最后被证明是捏造。

lie.example: He told an obvious lie about where he had been.  他就自己去过哪里说了个明显的谎。

prevarication.example: Her answer was pure prevarication rather than an honest denial.  她的回答纯属支吾，而非诚实的否认。

coin.example: Scientists coined the term to describe the new particle.  科学家创造了这个术语来描述这种新粒子。

feign.example: He feigned surprise when they announced the award.  他们宣布获奖时他装出惊讶的样子。

humorous.example: Her humorous account of the trip had everyone laughing.  她对旅行的幽默叙述让大家都笑了。

jocose.example: His jocose manner put the nervous guests at ease.  他诙谐的举止让紧张的客人放松下来。

waggish.example: The waggish waiter kept teasing us about our accents.  这个爱开玩笑的服务员一直拿我们的口音逗趣。

witty.example: Her witty toast at the wedding delighted every guest.  她在婚礼上机智的祝酒词让每位客人都很开心。

simplistic.example: That simplistic view ignores decades of careful research.  这种过分简单的看法忽视了数十年的细致研究。

deep.example: The essay offers a deep reading of the novel's ending.  这篇文章对小说结尾作了深刻解读。

facilitate.example: The new airport will facilitate tourism throughout the whole region.  新机场将促进整个地区的旅游业。

handicap.example: Poor equipment handicapped the researchers from the very start.  设备不足从一开始就妨碍了研究人员。

faction.example: A rival faction inside the party blocked the reform bill.  党内一个敌对派系阻挠了改革法案。

bloc.example: The farming bloc firmly opposed the new tariff bill.  农业集团坚决反对新的关税法案。

clique.example: A small clique controlled every decision in the department.  一个小团体控制着系里的每项决定。

coalition.example: Three parties formed a coalition to pass the budget.  三个党派组成联盟以通过预算。

sect.example: The sect broke away from the main church long ago.  该教派很久以前就从主教会分离出去。

wing.example: The reformist wing of the party demanded an open vote.  党内改革派要求公开投票。

fallacious.example: The lawyer exposed the fallacious reasoning behind the entire claim.  律师揭穿了整个主张背后的谬误推理。

mad.example: It would be mad to sell the house at that price.  以那个价格卖房子简直荒唐。

reasonless.example: His reasonless hostility puzzled everyone at the meeting.  他毫无理由的敌意让会上所有人困惑。

sophistic.example: The lawyer's sophistic argument collapsed under close questioning.  律师的诡辩论证在细致质询下崩塌。

fallow.example: The farmer left the tired field fallow for a whole season.  农民让这块贫瘠的田地整季休耕。

untilled.example: The untilled fields were slowly taken over by weeds.  未耕作的田地慢慢被杂草占据。

uncultivated.example: Much of the island remains uncultivated and covered in scrub.  岛上大部分地方仍未开垦，长满灌木。

failsafe.cn: 故障防护的；万无一失的
failsafe.example: The reactor has a failsafe system that shuts it down automatically.  这座反应堆有一套自动停机的故障防护系统。

caution.example: The guide urged caution on the icy mountain path.  向导叮嘱在结冰的山路上要谨慎。

palladium.example: A free press is often called the palladium of democracy.  自由的新闻界常被称为民主的保障。

preventive.example: Regular inspections are the cheapest preventive measure available.  定期检查是现有最便宜的预防措施。

safeguard.example: The new rules act as a safeguard against careless lending.  新规定是对草率放贷的一道保障。

foolproof.example: The engineers promised a foolproof plan, but the machine jammed anyway.  工程师承诺了万无一失的方案，机器却还是卡住了。

sure.example: Falling leaves are a sure sign that autumn has arrived.  落叶是秋天已到的可靠迹象。

hindrance.example: Poor roads are a serious hindrance to trade here.  糟糕的道路是这里贸易的严重障碍。

postponement.example: The postponement of the trial angered the victim's family.  审判延期激怒了受害者的家人。

prologue.example: The prologue to the play explains how the bitter feud began.  该剧的序言说明了这场激烈仇怨的由来。

finesse.example: She handled the awkward question with real finesse and everyone relaxed.  她娴熟巧妙地处理了那个尴尬的问题，大家都放松了。

adeptness.example: Her adeptness at negotiation saved the company millions of dollars.  她娴熟的谈判技巧为公司节省了数百万美元。

adroitness.example: He handled the hostile crowd with remarkable adroitness.  他极为机敏地应对了充满敌意的人群。

cleverness.example: The puzzle's design shows real cleverness rather than mere difficulty.  这个谜题的设计显示出真正的机巧，而非单纯的难度。

dexterity.example: Surgery demands great manual dexterity and very steady nerves.  外科手术需要极高的手部灵巧和极稳的神经。

proficiency.example: The job requires proficiency in at least two foreign languages.  这份工作要求精通至少两门外语。

awkwardness.example: His awkwardness with strangers faded after a few minutes.  他面对陌生人的笨拙在几分钟后消散了。

ineptitude.example: The failure exposed the ineptitude of the entire management team.  这次失败暴露了整个管理团队的无能。

gaucherie.example: He apologized for the gaucherie of arriving without an invitation.  他为未受邀就到场的失礼道歉。

ungainliness.example: The colt's ungainliness disappeared the moment it began to run.  小马驹一跑起来，笨拙就消失了。

finicky.example: The child is finicky about food and refuses most vegetables.  这孩子对食物很挑剔，多数蔬菜都不吃。

unfussy.example: She is an unfussy traveler who can sleep anywhere.  她是个不讲究的旅行者，在哪都能睡。

flaccid.example: Weeks in bed left his leg muscles flaccid and weak.  数周卧床使他的腿部肌肉松弛无力。

droopy.example: The dog's droopy ears made it look permanently sad.  这只狗下垂的耳朵让它看起来总是很忧伤。

floppy.example: She wore a floppy straw hat to block the sun.  她戴着一顶软塌塌的草帽遮阳。

lank.example: His lank hair fell over his forehead whenever he leaned forward.  他柔软下垂的头发每次前倾时都垂到额前。

fade.example: Their hopes of rescue began to fade after three days.  三天后他们获救的希望开始消退。

fail.example: His eyesight began to fail in his early seventies.  他七十出头时视力开始衰退。

wilt.example: The runners began to wilt in the heat of the final mile.  跑到最后一英里的酷热中，选手们开始萎靡。

thrive.example: Small shops thrive when the local economy is healthy.  当地经济健康时，小店就会兴旺。

flaring.cn: 耀眼张扬的；摇曳燃烧的
flaring.example: The dancer's flaring costume drew every eye in the theater.  舞者张扬耀眼的服装吸引了剧场里所有的目光。

florid.example: The critic mocked the florid prose of the young novelist.  评论家嘲讽这位年轻小说家辞藻华丽的文风。

garish.example: The lobby was painted in garish colors that hurt the eyes.  大堂被漆成刺眼的过于鲜艳的颜色。

ornate.example: The hall's ornate ceiling took two years to paint.  大厅华丽繁复的天花板画了两年。

showy.example: He drives a showy sports car to impress his clients.  他开一辆花哨的跑车来打动客户。

massage.example: The consultant massaged the director's ego to win approval.  顾问奉承主管的自尊心以换取批准。

stroke.example: She knew exactly how to stroke her boss's vanity.  她非常清楚该如何奉承老板的虚荣心。

imperfection.example: A tiny imperfection in the glass ruined the whole lens.  玻璃中一个微小的瑕疵毁了整枚镜片。

cripple.example: The strike crippled the city's transport system for a week.  罢工使该市交通系统瘫痪了一周。

fledgling.example: The fledgling airline struggled through its very first winter.  这家新兴航空公司艰难度过了第一个冬天。

apprentice.example: He started as an apprentice and now owns the shop.  他从学徒做起，现在拥有这家店。

beginner.example: This course is designed for the absolute beginner.  这门课程是为完全的新手设计的。

freshman.example: As a freshman he knew almost nobody on campus.  作为大一新生，他在校园里几乎谁也不认识。

neophyte.example: As a neophyte in politics, he underestimated how slowly legislation actually moves.  作为政界的新手，他低估了立法进程实际有多缓慢。

novice.example: A complete novice, he had never held a chisel before that afternoon.  他是个彻底的新手，那天下午之前从没握过凿子。

tyro.example: As a tyro at chess, he lost every game that afternoon.  作为国际象棋新手，他那天下午每局都输了。

recruit.example: Every new recruit spends six weeks in basic training.  每名新兵都要接受六周基础训练。

rookie.example: The rookie made a nervous throw that cost his team the game.  那名新手一次紧张的传球让球队输掉了比赛。

expeditious.example: The committee promised an expeditious review of the complaint.  委员会承诺迅速审查这项投诉。

nimble.example: Her nimble fingers tied the knot in one second.  她灵活的手指一秒钟就打好了结。

quick.example: A quick decision saved the patient's life that night.  一个迅速的决定在那晚救了病人的命。

rattling.example: The train moved at a rattling pace across the plain.  火车以飞快的速度穿过平原。

speedy.example: Everyone wished her a speedy recovery after the operation.  手术后大家都祝她迅速康复。

slow.example: Progress on the bridge has been painfully slow this year.  今年大桥的进展慢得令人痛苦。

alterable.example: The contract terms are alterable only with written consent.  合同条款只有经书面同意才可变更。

changeable.example: The weather in April is notoriously changeable here.  这里四月的天气以多变著称。
