modifiable.example: All settings in the program are modifiable by the user.  程序中所有设置都可由用户修改。

variable.example: Winds in the strait are variable and often dangerous.  海峡里的风多变且常常危险。

manageable.example: Split the task into smaller, manageable pieces first.  先把任务拆成较小、好处理的部分。

obstinate.example: Her obstinate refusal to compromise delayed the agreement by several months.  她固执地拒绝妥协，使协议推迟了几个月。

flippancy.example: His flippancy during the memorial upset the grieving family.  他在悼念仪式上的轻浮无礼让悲伤的家人很难受。

facetiousness.example: His facetiousness at the funeral offended nearly everyone present.  他在葬礼上的轻浮玩笑几乎冒犯了所有在场者。

flightiness.example: Her flightiness made her a poor choice for the job.  她的轻浮反复使她不适合这份工作。

frivolousness.example: The judge criticized the frivolousness of the entire lawsuit.  法官批评了整场诉讼的无聊琐碎。

frothiness.example: Critics mocked the frothiness of the summer blockbuster.  评论家嘲笑这部暑期大片的浅薄。

levity.example: A moment of levity relieved the tension in the crowded waiting room.  一时的轻松打趣缓解了拥挤候诊室里的紧张气氛。

silliness.example: The teacher tolerated a little silliness at the end of class.  老师容许下课前有点傻闹。

earnestness.example: He argued his case with disarming earnestness.  他以令人无法抗拒的诚挚陈述自己的理由。

gravity.example: Nobody seemed to grasp the gravity of the situation.  似乎没人明白形势的严峻。

seriousness.example: She explained the seriousness of the charge to her client.  她向委托人说明了指控的严重性。

soberness.example: The soberness of his tone silenced the whole room.  他语气的严肃让整个房间安静下来。

solemnity.example: The coronation was conducted with all the solemnity the occasion demanded.  加冕礼以这一场合所要求的全部庄严举行。

solemnness.example: The solemnness of the ceremony moved even the children.  仪式的庄严甚至打动了孩子们。

coquet.example: He liked to coquet with dangerous ideas he never pursued.  他喜欢玩弄那些从不真正追求的危险想法。

frivol.example: They frivoled away the whole afternoon playing cards.  他们打牌虚度了整个下午。

toy.example: She toyed with the idea of moving abroad but never made real plans.  她曾不认真地考虑过移居国外，却从未真正计划过。

flit.phrase_cn: 从一处快速掠到另一处
flit.example: Small birds flit from branch to branch searching for hidden insects.  小鸟在枝间轻快地飞来飞去寻找隐藏的昆虫。

dance.example: Sunlight danced across the surface of the lake.  阳光在湖面上跳动闪掠。

flick.example: She flicked through the magazine while waiting for the bus.  她等公交时快速翻动着杂志。

hurry.example: He hurried along the corridor to catch the elevator.  他匆忙穿过走廊去赶电梯。

zip.example: A motorcycle zipped past the window and vanished.  一辆摩托车飞快掠过窗前，消失不见。

plod.example: The tired horses plodded through the deep mud.  疲惫的马匹在深泥中沉重跋涉。

flock.example: Holidaymakers flock to the beach as soon as school ends.  学校一放假，度假者就涌向海滩。

mob.example: Fans mobbed the singer as she left the stage.  歌手离开舞台时粉丝蜂拥围住了她。

swarm.example: Reporters swarmed into the square before the announcement.  记者们在宣布之前蜂拥进入广场。

throng.example: Fans thronged the streets outside the stadium hours before kickoff.  开赛前几小时，球迷就挤满体育场外的街道。

bombastic.example: His bombastic speech impressed nobody in the audience.  他浮夸的演讲没有打动任何听众。

flowery.example: The letter was written in absurdly flowery language.  这封信用了荒唐华丽的辞藻。

grandiloquent.example: Voters grew tired of his grandiloquent promises about reform.  选民厌倦了他关于改革的夸张许诺。

magniloquent.example: The preface is written in a magniloquent, old-fashioned style.  这篇序言以浮夸而老派的风格写成。

rhetorical.example: His speech was full of rhetorical flourishes but offered no concrete plan.  他的演讲满是华丽辞藻，却没有提出任何具体计划。

flounder.example: The swimmer floundered in the cold water before help arrived.  救援到来之前，游泳者在冷水中挣扎。

lumber.example: The old bear lumbered across the yard toward the garbage cans.  那头老熊笨拙地穿过院子朝垃圾桶走去。

struggle.example: He struggled to keep up with the rest of the class.  他挣扎着跟上班上其他同学。

trudge.example: We trudged home through deep snow with our heavy canvas bags.  我们背着沉重的帆布包，在深雪中吃力地走回家。

glide.example: The skaters glided across the frozen pond without making a single sound.  滑冰者们悄无声息地轻盈滑过结冰的池塘。

slide.example: She slid into the room without making any sound.  她悄无声息地滑进了房间。

bloom.example: Her hobby bloomed into a highly profitable business.  她的爱好蓬勃发展成了一门赚钱的生意。

sneer.example: Critics sneered at his efforts, but he kept working on the design.  批评者嘲笑他的努力，他却继续完善设计。

taunt.example: The winning boys taunted the loser until a teacher intervened.  获胜的男孩们不停嘲弄输者，直到老师出面干预。

flabby.example: Months without exercise left his arms flabby and weak.  几个月不锻炼使他的手臂松软无力。

fluky.example: A fluky coincidence put me indoors when the blizzard finally struck.  一个侥幸的巧合让暴风雪来袭时我正待在室内。

lucky.example: They had a lucky escape when the roof collapsed.  屋顶塌落时他们幸运地脱险了。

providential.example: Their providential rescue came just minutes before the boat sank.  他们天意般的获救就发生在船沉前几分钟。

hapless.example: The hapless traveler lost both his passport and wallet.  这位倒霉的旅客丢了护照和钱包。

unlucky.example: He was unlucky to miss the last train by seconds.  他很倒霉，差几秒钟没赶上末班车。

ill-fated.cn: 注定不幸的，命运多灾的
ill-fated.example: Only two men returned from that ill-fated expedition.  那次注定不幸的远征只有两人生还。

lousy.cn: 多得很的，充满的；糟糕的
lousy.example: In August the town is lousy with tourists from every corner of Europe.  八月这座小镇挤满了来自欧洲各地的游客。

irrigate.example: The nurse carefully irrigated the wound before applying a clean bandage.  护士仔细冲洗了伤口，然后敷上干净的绷带。

rinse.example: Rinse the vegetables under cold running water first.  先用冷流水冲洗蔬菜。

sluice.example: The sailors sluiced the deck with buckets of seawater.  水手们用一桶桶海水冲洗甲板。

wash.example: Heavy rain washed away the dirt from the steps.  大雨把台阶上的污垢冲掉了。

short.example: We are short of money until the end of the month.  到月底之前我们都缺钱。

foible.example: The novel treats human foibles with warmth rather than scorn.  这部小说以温情而非嘲讽看待人性的小缺点。

demerit.example: The report lists the merits and demerits of each plan.  报告列出了每个方案的优点与缺点。

failing.example: Impatience is his greatest failing as a teacher.  没有耐心是他作为教师最大的缺点。

frailty.example: The novel explores human frailty with unusual tenderness.  这部小说以罕见的温柔探讨人性的弱点。

shortcoming.example: A good leader admits his own shortcomings openly.  好的领导者会坦然承认自己的不足。

sin.example: In her view, wasting food is a serious sin.  在她看来，浪费食物是严重的过错。

vice.example: Smoking is his only vice, and he defends it fiercely.  抽烟是他唯一的恶习，他还极力维护它。

weakness.example: Her main weakness is a reluctance to delegate work.  她的主要弱点是不愿把工作交给别人。

merit.example: The committee debated the merits of the plan for hours.  委员会就该方案的优点讨论了数小时。

brew.example: Trouble had been brewing in the department for months.  部门里的麻烦已酝酿了好几个月。

incite.example: He was charged with inciting a riot outside the county courthouse.  他被指控在县法院外煽动暴乱。

instigate.example: Several officers were accused of helping to instigate the rebellion in the province.  几名军官被指控参与煽动该省的叛乱。

stir.example: The article stirred up anger among local residents.  这篇文章激起了当地居民的愤怒。

quell.example: Troops were sent in to quell the growing unrest.  部队被派去平息日益扩大的动乱。

squash.example: The company quickly squashed the rumor about layoffs.  公司迅速压下了关于裁员的谣言。

guaranteed.example: This method offers a guaranteed result within two weeks.  这种方法保证两周内出结果。

infallible.cn: 绝无错误的；万无一失的
infallible.example: No editor is infallible, however careful he may be.  再怎么细心，编辑也不可能绝无错误。

safe.example: Taking the train is the safe choice in this weather.  这种天气坐火车是稳妥的选择。

fail-safe.cn: 有故障保险的，万无一失的
fail-safe.example: The reactor has a fail-safe system that shuts it down.  反应堆有一套故障保险系统可将其关闭。

footloose.example: After graduation he stayed footloose and traveled for two whole years.  毕业后他一直无拘无束，旅行了整整两年。

unbound.example: Young designers here feel unbound by any tradition.  这里的年轻设计师觉得不受任何传统束缚。

unconfined.example: The children ran about with unconfined delight.  孩子们毫无拘束地欢快奔跑。

unfettered.example: Reporters demanded unfettered access to the disaster site.  记者们要求不受限制地进入灾区。

unrestrained.example: Years of unrestrained spending finally ruined the company.  多年无节制的开支最终毁掉了这家公司。

untrammeled.example: He enjoyed the untrammeled freedom of a long summer.  他享受着漫长夏天里不受约束的自由。

tied.example: She felt tied to the desk from morning until night.  她觉得自己从早到晚被困在办公桌前。

forbearance.example: The teacher showed great forbearance with the noisy class.  老师对吵闹的班级表现出极大的忍耐。

patience.example: He finally lost his patience with the noisy neighbors.  他终于对吵闹的邻居失去了耐心。

temperance.example: The old doctor preached temperance in eating and drinking.  这位老医生倡导饮食节制。

tolerance.example: The school shows little tolerance for cheating of any kind.  学校对任何作弊都毫不容忍。

toleration.example: The act established religious toleration throughout the colony.  该法令在整个殖民地确立了宗教宽容。

impatience.example: His impatience with slow drivers is well known.  他对开车慢的人不耐烦是众所周知的。

forebear.example: Our distant forebears crossed these high mountains on foot long ago.  我们遥远的祖先很久以前徒步穿越了这些高山。

ancestor.example: Her ancestors came to this valley two centuries ago.  她的祖先两百年前来到这个山谷。

father.example: Galileo is often called the father of modern science.  伽利略常被称为现代科学之父。

grandfather.example: My grandfather built this house with his own hands.  我祖父亲手建造了这座房子。

primogenitor.example: Legend names a wandering soldier as the family's primogenitor.  传说称一名流浪士兵为这家族的始祖。

progenitor.example: This machine was the progenitor of every modern computer.  这台机器是所有现代计算机的前身。

descendant.example: She claims to be a direct descendant of the poet.  她自称是这位诗人的直系后代。

offspring.example: Penguins take turns feeding their hungry offspring.  企鹅轮流喂养饥饿的幼崽。

obviate.example: A short online form would obviate the need for three separate interviews.  一份简短的在线表格就能使三次单独面谈不再必要。

preclude.example: A lack of funding does not preclude us from starting the project.  资金不足并不能阻止我们启动这个项目。

foreword.example: A famous historian wrote the foreword to her first book.  一位著名历史学家为她的第一本书撰写了前言。

introduction.example: The book opens with a brief introduction by the editor.  这本书以编者的简短引言开篇。

preamble.example: The preamble to the treaty states its guiding principles.  条约的序言阐明了其指导原则。

mold.example: Newspapers helped mold public opinion during the war.  战争期间报纸帮助塑造了公众舆论。

sweaty.example: Moving the piano upstairs was hot, sweaty work.  把钢琴搬上楼是又热又累人的活儿。

tough.example: Editing that manuscript proved a tough assignment.  编辑那份手稿被证明是项艰巨的任务。

strenuous.example: Doctors advised him to avoid strenuous exercise for at least a month.  医生建议他至少一个月内避免费力的运动。

mindless.example: He wanted mindless work that let him rest his brain.  他想做点不用脑的活儿，让大脑休息。

candid.example: She gave a candid assessment of the team's weaknesses.  她对团队的弱点作了坦率的评价。

forthcoming.cn: 乐于提供信息的；即将到来的
forthcoming.example: The witness was not very forthcoming about that night.  证人对那晚的事不太肯透露。

frank.example: Let me be frank with you about the risks involved.  让我坦白地告诉你其中的风险。

outspoken.example: She is an outspoken critic of the new policy.  她是新政策直言不讳的批评者。

toughen.example: The government plans to toughen the rules on emissions.  政府计划强化排放规定。

incubate.example: The university incubates dozens of small companies every single year.  这所大学每年孵化数十家小公司。

founder.example: The peace talks foundered on the difficult question of wages.  和谈在棘手的工资问题上完全失败。

architect.example: He is widely seen as the architect of the reform.  他被普遍视为这场改革的缔造者。

author.example: The senator was the author of the original bill.  这位参议员是原始法案的制订者。

creator.example: The creator of the series also wrote its theme song.  该剧集的创作者还写了它的主题曲。

generator.example: The lab became a generator of remarkably original ideas.  该实验室成了极具原创性想法的源头。

initiator.example: She was the initiator of the citywide recycling program.  她是全市回收计划的发起人。

originator.example: Few remember the originator of this famous theory.  很少有人记得这一著名理论的首创者。

sire.example: That champion stallion sired more than forty foals.  那匹冠军种马生育了四十多匹小马。

flunk.example: He flunked the exam and had to repeat the course.  他考试不及格，只好重修这门课。

miss.example: The company missed its sales target for a third year.  公司连续第三年未达成销售目标。

strike out.example: He struck out completely in his first attempt at business.  他第一次创业彻底失败了。

wash out.example: Half the trainees washed out of the program by June.  到六月一半受训者被项目淘汰了。

terminator.example: History remembers him as the terminator of a long dynasty.  历史把他记作一个漫长王朝的终结者。

succeed.example: She succeeded in business where her brothers had failed.  她在兄弟们失败的生意上取得了成功。

work out.example: In the end, everything worked out better than expected.  最后一切结果都比预期更好。

fracas.example: A noisy fracas broke out in the bar after midnight.  午夜过后酒吧里爆发了一场吵闹的争斗。

battle.example: The two firms are locked in a long legal battle.  两家公司陷入一场漫长的法律争斗。

clash.example: Protesters clashed with police outside the courthouse.  抗议者在法院外与警方发生冲突。

combat.example: The soldiers were trained in hand-to-hand combat.  这些士兵受过近身格斗训练。

contest.example: The election became a bitter contest between old friends.  这场选举变成了旧友之间的激烈争夺。

hassle.example: They had a long hassle over who should pay.  他们为该谁付钱争吵了很久。

skirmish.example: A brief skirmish broke out along the disputed border.  争议边境沿线爆发了一场短暂冲突。

tussle.example: Two players tussled over the ball near the goal.  两名球员在球门附近为争球扭打起来。

rupture.example: The old pipe could rupture at any moment under such high pressure.  这根旧管道随时可能在如此高的压力下破裂。

fragment.example: The old empire fragmented into a dozen small states.  旧帝国分裂成了十几个小国。

rive.example: Lightning can rive a tall oak straight down the middle of its trunk.  闪电能把高大的橡树从树干正中劈开。

unity.example: The speech was an appeal for national unity.  这篇演讲是对国家团结的呼吁。

breakable.example: Pack all breakable items in the padded box.  把所有易碎物品装进带衬垫的箱子。

frangible.example: The shell is made of a deliberately frangible material.  这个外壳由一种刻意做成易碎的材料制成。

weak.example: The bridge has a weak structure and cannot bear trucks.  这座桥结构脆弱，无法承载卡车。

durable.example: These boots are made of remarkably durable leather.  这双靴子由极其耐用的皮革制成。

unsubstantial.cn: 不结实的；空洞无实质的
unsubstantial.example: The case rested on thin, unsubstantial evidence.  这个案子建立在单薄而缺乏实质的证据上。

characterless.example: They moved into a clean but characterless apartment block.  他们搬进一栋干净却毫无特色的公寓楼。

invertebrate.cn: 没有骨气的，软弱的；无脊椎动物
invertebrate.example: Critics called him an invertebrate politician without convictions.  批评者称他是毫无信念、没有骨气的政客。

nerveless.example: The cup slipped from his nerveless fingers and broke.  杯子从他无力的手指间滑落打碎了。

deceitful.example: The firm was fined for deceitful advertising practices.  该公司因欺诈性广告做法被罚款。

reliable.example: The story came from a reliable source inside the ministry.  这条消息来自部内一个可靠的来源。

trustworthy.example: He proved a trustworthy friend during her worst year.  在她最糟的一年里他证明是值得信赖的朋友。

frenzy.example: The crowd worked itself into a frenzy when the singer finally appeared.  歌手终于出场时，人群陷入了一片狂热。

fever.example: Election fever gripped the small town for weeks.  选举狂热笼罩了这个小镇数周。

furor.example: The painting caused a public furor when it was first shown.  这幅画首次展出时引起公众哗然。

fury.example: He flew into a fury when he saw the broken window.  他看到破碎的窗户时勃然大怒。

insanity.example: His lawyer entered a plea of insanity at trial.  他的律师在庭审时提出精神失常抗辩。

sanity.phrase_cn: 质疑他的神志是否正常
sanity.example: His lawyers questioned his sanity at the time of the robbery.  他的律师质疑他在抢劫时神志是否正常。

farfetched.example: His farfetched explanation convinced nobody on the committee.  他牵强的解释没能说服委员会里任何人。

unapt.example: That is an unapt comparison between two very different cases.  那是对两个截然不同案例的不恰当比较。

unlikely.example: It seems unlikely that the plan will be approved.  这个计划看来不太可能获批。

pettish.example: She gave a pettish reply and slammed the door.  她烦躁地回了一句，然后摔上了门。

abrasion.example: This coating is highly resistant to abrasion and heat.  这种涂层极耐磨损和高温。

contention.example: Water rights remain a point of contention between the villages.  水权仍是各村之间的争议之点。

war.example: A price war between the two airlines cut fares sharply.  两家航空公司的价格战大幅压低了票价。

passionless.example: The critic dismissed it as a technically perfect but passionless performance.  评论家称之为技术完美却毫无激情的表演。

unresponsive.example: The comedian struggled before a cold, unresponsive audience.  这位喜剧演员面对冷淡无反应的观众很吃力。

roasting.example: We crossed the desert on a roasting July afternoon.  我们在七月一个酷热的下午穿过沙漠。

seething.example: He sat silently, seething with anger at the insult.  他沉默地坐着，为这侮辱怒火中烧。

sizzling.example: The sizzling heat kept everyone indoors until evening.  灼人的酷热让所有人待在室内直到傍晚。

amorous.example: He sent her amorous letters throughout that long summer.  整个漫长的夏天他都给她写情意绵绵的信。

fringe.example: The novel describes families living on the fringe of society.  这部小说描写生活在社会边缘的家庭。

border.example: They crossed the border shortly before dawn.  他们在黎明前不久越过了边界。

boundary.example: A low stone wall marks the boundary between the farms.  一道矮石墙标出两个农场的边界。

circumference.example: Measure the circumference of the trunk at chest height.  在胸高处测量树干的周长。

edge.example: She stood at the edge of the cliff and looked down.  她站在悬崖边缘往下看。

margin.example: Tall reeds grow along the margin of the lake.  高高的芦苇沿着湖边生长。

periphery.example: New factories sprang up on the periphery of the city.  新工厂在城市外围拔地而起。

flimsy.example: He offered a flimsy excuse for missing the meeting.  他为缺席会议给出了一个站不住脚的借口。

trifling.example: He dismissed the missing coins as a trifling sum not worth reporting.  他把丢失的硬币当作微不足道的小钱，不值得上报。

eventful.example: It has been an eventful year for the whole family.  对全家来说这是多事的一年。

meaningful.example: She left banking to find more meaningful work.  她离开银行业去寻找更有意义的工作。

frothy.example: The theater is showing a frothy comedy about summer romance.  剧院正在上演一部关于夏日恋情的轻松不严肃的喜剧。

untidy.example: His untidy desk was buried under unopened letters.  他凌乱的书桌被未开封的信件埋住了。

neat.example: Her neat handwriting made the notes easy to read.  她整洁的字迹让笔记很好读。

tidy.example: Please tidy up the room before the guests arrive.  请在客人到来前把房间整理干净。

sparing.example: He was sparing with salt because of his doctor's strict orders.  遵医嘱，他用盐十分节省。

provident.example: A provident household sets money aside long before hard times arrive.  节俭有远见的家庭远在困难到来之前就存下钱。

stingy.example: He is stingy with money but surprisingly generous with his time.  他在钱上吝啬，在时间上却出奇大方。

prodigal.example: His prodigal spending emptied the family fortune within a few years.  他挥霍无度的花钱方式几年内就耗尽了家产。

fungible.example: Grain and oil are fungible goods traded by weight.  谷物和石油是按重量交易的可互换商品。

interchangeable.example: The two models use fully interchangeable parts.  这两个型号使用完全可互换的零件。

commutable.example: Under the plan, the pension is commutable into a single cash payment.  根据该方案，这笔养老金可换算成一次性现金支付。

substitutable.example: Coal and gas are largely substitutable in power generation.  在发电中煤和天然气基本可以相互替代。

switchable.example: The desk lamp has switchable warm and cool light settings.  这台台灯有可切换的暖光和冷光设置。

fullbodied.example: The wine has a fullbodied flavor that suits roasted meat.  这款酒味道醇厚饱满，适合配烤肉。

botch.example: The builders botched the job and had to start over.  建筑工人把活儿搞糟了，只能重来。

wrath.example: The clumsy apology only incurred his wrath again.  笨拙的道歉只是再次招致了他的暴怒。

indignation.example: The ruling provoked widespread public indignation.  这项裁决引发了广泛的公众愤慨。

punctilious.example: He is punctilious about details that others simply ignore.  他对别人干脆忽略的细节一丝不苟。

moldy.example: The cellar smelled of moldy paper and damp stone.  地窖里散发着霉纸和潮湿石头的气味。

gadfly.example: The columnist served as a gadfly to a complacent government.  这位专栏作家是自满政府的刺激者。

impetus.example: The grant gave fresh impetus to their stalled research.  这笔资助为他们停滞的研究提供了新动力。

impulse.example: She bought the painting on impulse and never regretted it.  她一时冲动买下那幅画，从未后悔。

stimulus.example: Cheap loans acted as a stimulus to small businesses.  低息贷款成为小企业的刺激因素。

impropriety.example: He resigned amid allegations of financial impropriety.  他在财务不当行为的指控中辞职。

indecorum.example: Her single moment of indecorum was discussed for years.  她一时的失礼被议论了好几年。

decency.example: He did not even have the decency to apologize.  他连道歉的基本礼数都没有。

naysay.example: Board members naysay every proposal that requires spending money on new equipment.  董事会成员否决每一项需要花钱买新设备的提议。

admit.example: She finally admitted that she had made a serious mistake.  她终于承认自己犯了一个严重的错误。

courageous.example: It was courageous of him to speak out against the policy.  他公开反对这项政策，很有勇气。

heroic.example: Firefighters made a heroic effort to save the trapped children.  消防员为营救被困儿童做出了英勇的努力。

motivate.example: Small weekly rewards motivate the students far better than long lectures do.  每周的小奖励比长篇说教更能激励学生。

gamble.example: They gambled on the outcome of the election and lost everything.  他们押注选举结果，结果输光了一切。

bet.example: He bet fifty dollars on the horse that eventually won.  他在最终夺冠的那匹马上押了五十美元。

adventure.example: They set off on an adventure across the empty desert.  他们出发穿越空旷的沙漠去冒险。

chance.example: She decided to take a chance and invest all her savings.  她决定冒险一试，投入全部积蓄。

risk.example: He risked his savings on a completely new business.  他拿积蓄冒险投入一项全新的生意。

stake.example: They staked their entire fortune on that single deal.  他们把全部财产押在那一笔交易上。

gambol.example: Young lambs gamboled in the meadow all through the warm afternoon.  小羊羔整个温暖的下午都在草地上欢跳。

caper.example: The children capered about the yard in sheer delight.  孩子们无比欢喜地在院子里雀跃。

cavort.example: The puppies cavorted happily in the fresh morning snow.  小狗们在清晨的新雪中欢快地嬉戏。

gag.example: The same running gag appears in every episode of the series.  同一个反复出现的笑料出现在这部剧的每一集里。

drollery.example: His lecture was full of gentle drollery that charmed the audience.  他的讲座充满温和的诙谐，迷住了听众。

giggle.example: The girls giggled at the teacher's silly joke about cats.  女孩们被老师关于猫的傻笑话逗得咯咯笑。

sally.example: Her clever sally made everyone at the dinner table laugh.  她机智的妙语让餐桌上所有人都笑了。

waggery.example: The old man's waggery kept the whole family entertained all evening.  老人的诙谐让全家整晚都很开心。

wisecrack.example: He made a wisecrack about the manager's new haircut.  他就经理的新发型说了句俏皮话。

witticism.example: The essay sparkles with witticisms about modern city life.  这篇文章充满关于现代都市生活的妙语。

garble.example: A bad connection garbled the message beyond all understanding.  信号不好把这条消息混淆得完全无法理解。

color.example: His prejudice clearly colored the report he submitted to us.  他的偏见明显影响了他交给我们的报告。

astronomical.example: The repairs came at an astronomical cost to the city.  这些维修给市政带来了天价开支。

immense.example: The project demanded an immense amount of time and money.  这个项目需要投入巨大的时间和金钱。

monstrous.example: A monstrous wave rose above the tiny fishing boat.  一个巨浪在小渔船上方涌起。

gaudy.example: She wore gaudy jewelry that clashed with her simple dress.  她戴着与朴素连衣裙不搭的俗丽首饰。

generic.example: Aspirin is now a generic term for that kind of drug.  阿司匹林现在成了那类药物的统称。

common.example: Spelling errors are a common problem in student essays.  拼写错误是学生作文中常见的问题。

general.example: This book gives a general introduction to ancient Greek history.  这本书对古希腊史作了总体介绍。

concrete.example: The detective needed concrete evidence rather than clever theories.  侦探需要确凿的证据，而不是巧妙的推论。

precise.example: We need precise figures before we can approve the budget.  批准预算前我们需要精确的数字。

unique.example: Each fingerprint is unique to the person who made it.  每个指纹都是其主人独有的。

chatty.example: Our chatty neighbor kept us at the door for an hour.  健谈的邻居让我们在门口站了一小时。

guardian.example: For decades she served as the guardian of the family's oldest traditions.  几十年来，她一直是这个家族最古老传统的守护者。

custodian.example: The museum serves as custodian of these ancient manuscripts.  博物馆是这些古代手稿的保管者。

defender.example: She became a tireless defender of migrant workers' rights.  她成了外来工权益不懈的捍卫者。

protector.example: The old dog was a loyal protector of the whole family.  这条老狗是全家忠诚的保护者。

gleam.example: A single candle gleamed in the window of the abandoned farmhouse.  一支蜡烛在废弃农舍的窗口闪着光。

flame.example: The candle flame flickered in the cold draft from the window.  烛焰在窗口的冷风中闪动。

flash.example: A light flashed briefly in the window across the street.  街对面的窗子里闪了一下光。

glisten.example: The wet leaves glistened in the early morning sunlight after the storm.  暴风雨后，湿漉漉的叶子在清晨阳光下闪闪发亮。

glitter.example: The frozen lake glittered under the pale morning sun.  结冰的湖面在淡淡的晨光下闪耀。

luster.example: Careful polishing restored the luster of the old silver bowl.  仔细打磨恢复了这只旧银碗的光泽。

scintillate.example: Her essays scintillate with wit even when the subject seems dull.  即使题目乏味，她的文章也闪耀着才智。

sparkle.example: Her eyes sparkled when she finally opened the present.  她终于打开礼物时眼睛闪闪发亮。

twinkle.example: Thousands of stars twinkled above the quiet desert camp.  成千颗星星在寂静的沙漠营地上方闪烁。

winkle.example: Reporters slowly winkled out the truth about the secret land deal.  记者们一点点挖出了那笔秘密土地交易的真相。

rustic.example: His rustic manners amused the guests at the elegant city dinner.  他粗俗的举止让城里雅致晚宴上的客人觉得好笑。

flashy.example: He arrived in a flashy suit that everyone immediately noticed.  他穿着一身浮华的西装到场，所有人立刻都注意到了。

meretricious.example: The hotel lobby was crowded with meretricious ornaments of gilded plaster and plastic.  酒店大堂里堆满了镀金石膏和塑料做的艳俗装饰。

tawdry.example: Tawdry decorations covered the walls of the cheap seaside hotel.  花哨庸俗的装饰铺满廉价海滨旅馆的墙壁。

homely.example: She had a homely but kind face that put strangers at ease.  她有一张其貌不扬却和善的脸，让陌生人感到自在。

gauge.example: Ticket sales are a rough gauge of the show's success.  票房大致是衡量这部剧成功的标准。

benchmark.example: This test has become the benchmark for measuring urban air quality.  这项测试已成为衡量城市空气质量的基准。

criterion.example: Cost was the main criterion for choosing this particular supplier.  成本是选择这家供应商的主要标准。

measure.example: Test scores are a poor measure of a child's real ability.  考试分数不是衡量孩子真实能力的好尺度。

touchstone.example: Public trust is the real touchstone of a good government.  公众信任是好政府真正的试金石。

yardstick.example: Profit alone is a crude yardstick for judging any company.  仅看利润是评判公司的粗糙标准。

determine.example: Scientists could not determine the cause of the sudden outbreak.  科学家无法判定这次突发疫情的原因。

scale.example: Rate your pain on a scale from one to ten.  请在一到十的标度上给你的疼痛评分。

gear.example: The factory geared production to the demand of local buyers.  工厂调整生产以配合本地买家的需求。

gracious.example: She was a gracious host who made every guest feel welcome.  她是位亲切的主人，让每位客人都感到受欢迎。

mellow.example: He has grown much mellower since he became a grandfather.  当上祖父后他变得温和多了。

pleasant.example: We spent a pleasant afternoon walking along the quiet river.  我们沿着静静的河边散步，度过了愉快的下午。

mannerly.example: The mannerly boy thanked everyone before he left the table.  这个有礼貌的男孩离席前向每个人道谢。

cultured.example: He was a cultured man who read poetry in four languages.  他是个有教养的人，能读四种语言的诗。

ridicule.example: Classmates began to ridicule him for his old shoes and worn coat.  同学们开始因他的旧鞋和破外套而嘲笑他。

scoff.example: Colleagues used to scoff at the idea of working from home.  同事们过去常嘲笑在家办公的想法。

gild.example: The memoir gilds the truth about his early business dealings.  这本回忆录粉饰了他早年商业交易的真相。

essence.example: In essence, the two proposals ask for exactly the same thing.  本质上，这两项提议要求的是同一件事。

vast.example: The company owns vast tracts of forest in the north.  这家公司在北方拥有大片森林。

glaze.example: The artisan will glaze each bowl before firing it a second time.  匠人会在第二次烧制前给每只碗上釉。

oily.example: His oily compliments made everyone in the room uncomfortable.  他油滑的奉承让屋里每个人都不舒服。

glitch.example: A minor software glitch delayed the launch by nearly two full hours.  一个小小的软件故障使发射延迟了将近两小时。

bug.example: A tiny bug in the code crashed the entire system.  代码里一个小错误让整个系统崩溃了。

peccadillo.example: Voters forgave the mayor's peccadilloes because of his real achievements.  因为确有实绩，选民原谅了市长的小过失。

fatal error.example: Ignoring the warning light proved a fatal error for the crew.  忽视警示灯对机组来说是致命错误。

gloat.example: He could not resist gloating over his rival's very public failure.  他忍不住为对手当众失利而幸灾乐祸。

crow.example: He crowed about his victory until even his closest friends grew tired.  他为胜利得意个不停，连最亲近的朋友都听厌了。

gloss.example: The editor added a short gloss explaining the unfamiliar legal term.  编者加了一条简短的解释，说明这个陌生的法律术语。

annotation.example: The editor added helpful annotations to every difficult passage.  编者为每个难解段落加了有用的注释。

epitome.example: That small hotel is the epitome of quiet good taste.  那家小旅馆是安静品味的典范。

synopsis.example: Please send a brief synopsis of your novel with the application.  请随申请寄来你小说的简短概要。

amplification.example: His answer was far too short and needed considerable amplification.  他的回答太简短，需要大量补充详述。

scrutinize.example: Auditors will scrutinize every receipt before approving the annual budget report.  审计员会在批准年度预算报告前仔细审查每一张收据。

glossy.example: The magazine printed her photograph on thick and glossy paper.  杂志把她的照片印在厚实而有光泽的纸上。

lustrous.example: Her lustrous black hair shone under the bright lights of the stage.  她有光泽的黑发在明亮的舞台灯光下闪耀。

burnished.example: The burnished brass handle shone brightly in the afternoon sunlight.  擦亮的铜把手在午后阳光下闪亮。

glistening.example: Glistening drops of rain hung from every bare branch.  闪亮的雨珠挂在每一根光枝上。

glut.example: Cheap imports have glutted the local market and driven prices down sharply.  廉价进口货使当地市场供过于求，价格大幅下跌。

cloy.example: The rich dessert began to cloy after only a few bites.  这道浓甜的点心吃几口就开始发腻。

cram.example: She crammed all her winter clothes into one small suitcase.  她把所有冬衣塞进一个小箱子。

fill.example: He filled the glass with cold water and drank it quickly.  他倒满一杯冷水，很快喝掉了。

satiate.example: No amount of reading could satiate the curiosity of that boy about stars.  再多的阅读也无法满足那男孩对星星的好奇。

oversupply.example: An oversupply of oil pushed prices down sharply last year.  去年石油供应过剩使价格大幅下跌。

sate.example: A single bowl of thin soup was not enough to sate his hunger.  一碗清汤不足以满足他的饥饿。

glutinous.example: The glutinous rice stuck to my fingers while I ate.  我吃的时候糯米粘在了手指上。

adhesive.example: She sealed the heavy box with strong adhesive tape.  她用结实的胶带把重箱子封好。

cloggy.example: Cloggy mud clung to the wheels of the heavy truck.  粘稠的泥巴粘在重型卡车的轮子上。

gluey.example: The old pot was coated with a gluey brown substance.  旧锅里裹着一层棕色的胶状物质。

sticky.example: The children's hands were sticky with melted chocolate candy.  孩子们的手被融化的巧克力糖弄得粘乎乎。

tenacious.example: She proved a tenacious opponent who never conceded a single point.  她是个顽强的对手，从不让出一分。

viscid.example: A viscid sap oozed slowly from the cut in the bark.  一种粘性的树液从树皮的切口缓缓渗出。

glutton.example: Only a glutton would order three desserts after such a heavy meal.  只有贪吃的人才会在这样一顿大餐之后再点三份甜点。

gorge.example: We gorged ourselves on fresh mangoes until nobody could eat another bite.  我们大吃新鲜芒果，直到谁也再吃不下一口。

urge.example: Her friends urged her to accept the job in Boston.  朋友们力劝她接受波士顿的那份工作。

propel.example: Ambition propelled him to work sixteen hours every day.  雄心驱使他每天工作十六小时。

gobble.example: The children gobbled down their sandwiches and ran outside to play again.  孩子们狼吞虎咽吃完三明治，又跑到外面去玩。

guzzle.example: He guzzled two bottles of soda before the game even started.  比赛还没开始他就狂饮了两瓶汽水。

quaff.example: The thirsty travelers quaffed mugs of ale at the roadside inn.  口渴的旅人在路边客栈痛饮大杯麦酒。

raven.example: The starving dogs ravened the scraps in a few seconds.  饿极的狗几秒钟就把残渣吞光了。

swill.example: They swilled cheap beer all night in the noisy bar.  他们在嘈杂的酒吧里痛饮廉价啤酒一整夜。

nibble.example: The mouse nibbled at the cheese we had left beside the kitchen door.  老鼠小口啃着我们放在厨房门边的干酪。

goggle.example: The tourists goggled at the enormous statue for several silent minutes.  游客们默默凝视那尊巨大的雕像好几分钟。

blink.example: She blinked several times before her eyes adjusted to the light.  她眨了几下眼才适应光线。

gawk.example: Tourists stood gawking at the enormous new glass tower.  游客们站着呆看那座巨大的新玻璃塔。

gaze.example: They gazed at the mountains until the sun had finally set.  他们凝望群山，直到太阳终于落下。

stare.example: He stared at the letter for a long time without speaking.  他久久盯着那封信，一言不发。

glance.example: She glanced at her watch and hurried toward the front door.  她看了一眼手表，匆匆走向前门。

glimpse.example: I caught only a glimpse of the singer through the crowd.  我只在人群中瞥见了歌手一眼。

devote.example: She devoted her whole career to teaching children in poor villages.  她把整个职业生涯投入到贫困乡村的教育中。

gap.example: A narrow gap in the ridge let the river through.  山脊上一道狭窄的缺口让河水穿过。

gulch.example: The miners camped beside a dry gulch below the ridge.  矿工们在山脊下的干沟旁扎营。

notch.example: The trail climbed toward a high notch between the two peaks.  小径向着两座山峰之间的高处隘口攀升。

ravine.example: The trail dropped suddenly into a deep wooded ravine.  小径突然下降，进入一条林木茂密的深谷。

ether.example: His radio message simply vanished into the ether that night.  那晚他的无线电讯息就那样消失在虚空中。

filmy.example: A filmy curtain stirred gently in the warm evening breeze.  一幅轻薄的窗帘在温暖的晚风中轻轻飘动。

tenuous.example: The lawyer's case rested on a tenuous argument about intent.  律师的诉讼建立在关于动机的站不住脚的论点上。
tenuous.cn: 站不住脚的，脆弱的；纤细的

entity.example: The subsidiary is now a separate legal entity from its parent.  这家子公司现在是独立于母公司的法律实体。

grimy.example: The mechanic wiped his grimy hands on an old checkered rag.  机械师用一块旧格子布擦了擦他肮脏的双手。

filthy.example: The kitchen floor was filthy after the long noisy party.  漫长喧闹的聚会后厨房地板脏得一塌糊涂。

unclean.example: Many villagers still rely on unclean water from the river.  许多村民仍靠河里不洁的水生活。

grandeur.example: Visitors fall silent before the sheer grandeur of the cathedral's vaulted interior.  在大教堂拱顶内部的宏伟面前，游客都不由沉默。

magnificence.example: Visitors are struck by the magnificence of this ancient temple.  游客为这座古庙的壮丽所震撼。

augustness.example: The augustness of the old hall silenced every new visitor.  这座老厅的庄严让每位初来者都安静下来。

majesty.example: Nothing prepares a traveler for the majesty of these falls.  这些瀑布的雄伟令旅人毫无准备。

nobility.example: His quiet nobility of character impressed everyone who met him.  他沉静高贵的品格令每个见过他的人印象深刻。

resplendence.example: The resplendence of the sunset silenced the whole tired group.  落日的辉煌让整群疲惫的人安静下来。

splendor.example: The restored palace now stands in all its former splendor.  修复后的宫殿如今重现昔日的壮丽。

inflated.example: The report was full of inflated claims about the new product.  报告里充满对新产品夸大的说法。

pretentious.example: His pretentious speech annoyed almost everyone in the audience.  他浮夸的演讲让几乎所有听众反感。

secretive.example: He was oddly secretive about where all the money came from.  他对这些钱的来源异常遮掩。

grandstand.example: The senator was clearly grandstanding rather than negotiating in good faith.  这位参议员显然是在哗众取宠，而不是诚意谈判。

act.example: He was only acting hurt to win the crowd's sympathy.  他只是装作受伤，以博取观众同情。

perform.example: The young pianist will perform on stage for the first time.  这位年轻钢琴家将首次登台表演。

scratch.example: The cat scratched the wooden door all night long.  猫整夜抓挠着木门。

scrape.example: He carefully scraped the old paint off the window frame.  他仔细地把窗框上的旧漆刮掉。

cater.example: This magazine caters to readers who love old racing cars.  这本杂志迎合喜爱老赛车的读者。

gratuitous.example: The film was criticized for its gratuitous violence and very thin plot.  这部电影因毫无必要的暴力和极单薄的情节而受到批评。

unjustified.example: The harsh criticism of her work was completely unjustified.  对她工作的严厉批评完全没有道理。

baseless.example: The company called the accusations baseless and refused to comment.  公司称这些指控毫无根据，并拒绝评论。

complimentary.example: The hotel offers a complimentary breakfast to every overnight guest.  酒店为每位住宿客人提供免费早餐。

unearned.cn: 非劳动所得的，不应得的
unearned.example: Most of his wealth was unearned inheritance from distant relatives.  他的大部分财富是远亲留下的非劳动所得遗产。

raw.example: The team was full of raw recruits with no real experience.  队里都是毫无实战经验的生手。

young.example: She was too young to handle such a difficult legal case.  她太年轻，处理不了这样棘手的法律案子。

gregarious.example: Unlike his shy brother, he is gregarious and knows everyone in town.  与害羞的弟弟不同，他爱社交，认识镇上所有人。

convivial.example: The dinner had a convivial atmosphere that lasted until midnight.  晚宴的欢快气氛一直持续到午夜。

extroverted.example: Her extroverted nature made her popular at every new school.  她外向的性格让她在每所新学校都很受欢迎。

outgoing.example: His outgoing personality helped him make friends very quickly.  他外向的性格让他很快就交到朋友。

social.example: Humans are social creatures who need regular company and talk.  人是需要经常陪伴与交谈的社会性生物。

solitary.example: The old writer led a solitary life high in the mountains.  这位老作家在高山上过着独居生活。

bemoan.example: Farmers bemoaned the loss of their crops after the flood.  洪水过后农民哀叹作物尽毁。

bewail.example: The villagers gathered to bewail the loss of their homes.  村民聚在一起痛惜失去家园。

exult in.example: The players exulted in their unexpected win over the champions.  球员们为意外战胜冠军而狂喜。

glory in.example: She gloried in the praise that her young students received.  她为学生们获得的赞誉而欣喜。

glamorous.example: She left her quiet hometown for a glamorous life in Paris.  她离开宁静的家乡，去巴黎过迷人的生活。

attractive.example: The company made him an attractive offer he could not refuse.  公司给了他一个无法拒绝的诱人条件。

bewitching.example: She gave the photographer a bewitching smile over her shoulder.  她回头对摄影师露出迷人的微笑。

revolting.example: A revolting smell came from the abandoned refrigerator in the yard.  院里那台废弃冰箱散出一股恶心的气味。

grin.example: He grinned broadly when the judges announced his name as the winner.  当评委宣布他获胜时，他开心地咧嘴大笑。

beam.example: The father beamed with pride as his daughter walked onstage.  女儿走上台时父亲笑得满脸自豪。

pout.example: She began to pout when her parents refused to buy the toy.  父母不肯买那个玩具时，她开始撅嘴表示不悦。

grisly.example: The newspaper spared its readers the grisly details of the accident.  报纸没有向读者披露事故中那些令人恐惧的细节。

appalling.example: The workers lived in appalling conditions close to the mine.  工人们住在矿区附近骇人的条件中。

gruesome.cn: 可怕的，令人毛骨悚然的
gruesome.example: The witness described the gruesome scene in a shaking voice.  证人用颤抖的声音描述了那可怕的场面。

hideous.example: They tore down the hideous concrete tower that blocked the view.  他们拆掉了那座挡住视野的丑陋混凝土塔楼。

macabre.example: He entertained the children with a macabre tale about a haunted mill.  他用一个关于鬼屋磨坊的恐怖故事逗孩子们开心。

groove.example: The whole crowd was grooving to the band's long final song.  全场观众都沉醉在乐队那首长长的终曲里。

get off on.example: He seems to get off on making other people nervous.  他好像很享受让别人紧张。

revel in.example: The young actress reveled in the attention of the huge crowd.  年轻女演员尽情享受着人群的关注。

grotesque.example: The mask was so grotesque that the youngest child began to cry.  那副面具太难看了，最小的孩子哭了起来。

ill-favored.example: The ill-favored old man was surprisingly gentle with small children.  这位相貌丑陋的老人对小孩子出奇地温和。

unappealing.cn: 没有吸引力的，不讨喜的
unappealing.example: The cold gray soup looked completely unappealing to all of us.  那碗冷灰色的汤在我们看来毫无食欲。

uncomely.example: She wore an uncomely dress that hid her real charm.  她穿了件不好看的裙子，掩住了她真正的魅力。

unsightly.example: Unsightly stains covered the wall behind the old kitchen sink.  难看的污渍覆盖了旧厨房水槽后的墙面。

aesthetic.example: The building's aesthetic appeal outweighs its many practical problems.  这栋楼的美感胜过它的诸多实用缺陷。

beautiful.example: From the hill we had a beautiful view of the whole bay.  从山上我们看到整个海湾的美丽景色。

bonny.example: Their bonny little girl charmed everyone at the family party.  他们可爱的小女孩迷住了家庭聚会上的每个人。

comely.example: A comely young woman greeted us politely at the gate.  一位秀丽的年轻女子在门口礼貌地迎接我们。

fetching.example: She looked quite fetching in that simple blue summer dress.  她穿那件素净的蓝色夏裙相当好看。

gorgeous.example: We watched a gorgeous sunset from the hotel balcony.  我们在酒店阳台上看了一场绚丽的落日。

ravishing.example: She looked absolutely ravishing in her long silver evening gown.  她穿着银色晚礼长裙，美得令人陶醉。

sightly.example: They turned the empty lot into a sightly little garden.  他们把空地改成了一个悦目的小花园。

taking.example: The child had a taking manner that won everyone over.  这孩子讨人喜欢的举止赢得了所有人的心。

well-favored.example: He was a well-favored young man with easy country manners.  他是个相貌好看、举止随和的乡下青年。

slither.example: A snake slithered quietly across the warm stone path.  一条蛇静静地滑过温热的石径。

wriggle.example: The boy wriggled through the narrow gap in the wooden fence.  男孩扭身钻过木栅栏的窄缝。

guile.example: He won the long negotiation through patience rather than guile.  他靠耐心而不是狡诈赢下了这场漫长的谈判。

artfulness.example: The artfulness of his questions trapped the witness completely.  他问题中的狡诈让证人彻底落入圈套。

craft.example: He won the case by craft rather than by solid evidence.  他靠诡计而非确凿证据赢了官司。

cunningness.example: Her cunningness in business earned her both money and enemies.  她生意上的狡诈为她挣来金钱也挣来敌人。

deviousness.example: His deviousness finally cost him the trust of every colleague.  他的狡诈最终让他失去每位同事的信任。

slyness.example: There was a hint of slyness in his friendly smile.  他友善的笑容里有一丝狡猾。

subtleness.example: The subtleness of the trap fooled even the veteran detectives.  这个陷阱的精巧连老练的警探都骗过了。

wiliness.example: The old trader's wiliness made every buyer extremely careful.  这位老商人的狡猾让每个买家都格外小心。

artlessness.example: Her artlessness in conversation made strangers trust her quickly.  她谈话中的率真让陌生人很快信任她。

ingenuousness.example: His ingenuousness was refreshing among so many calculating people.  在众多精于算计的人中，他的坦率令人耳目一新。

sincerity.example: No one doubted the sincerity of her apology that evening.  那天晚上没人怀疑她道歉的真诚。

manipulative.example: Her manipulative behavior slowly drove all her old friends away.  她操控人的行为慢慢让所有老朋友都离开了。

glean.example: Researchers gleaned useful details from hundreds of old letters stored in the attic.  研究者从阁楼上数百封旧信中收集到有用的细节。

fake out.example: The guard faked out two defenders and scored quite easily.  这名后卫晃过两名防守者，轻松得分。

gaff.example: He finally saw through the gaff of the smiling salesman.  他终于看穿了那位笑脸推销员的骗局。

string along.example: The company strung him along for months without any real offer.  公司吊着他好几个月，却没有真正的录用。

foundationless.example: The report dismissed the claim as completely foundationless gossip.  报告认定这一说法是毫无根据的流言。

unsubstantiated.example: The judge rejected the unsubstantiated claims for lack of proof.  法官因缺乏证据驳回了这些未经证实的主张。

unwarranted.cn: 无正当理由的，不必要的
unwarranted.example: Her fear of the final exam turned out to be unwarranted.  她对期末考试的担忧结果证明毫无必要。

substantiated.example: Only substantiated complaints will be forwarded to the ethics committee.  只有已证实的投诉才会转交伦理委员会。

well-grounded.cn: 有充分根据的；基础扎实的
well-grounded.example: Their suspicion about the contract proved well-grounded after all.  他们对合同的怀疑最终证明是有根据的。

drool.example: Fans drooled over every photo of the new sports car.  粉丝们对新跑车的每张照片都垂涎不已。

effuse.example: She effused praise for every painting in the small gallery.  她对小画廊里的每幅画都赞不绝口。

enthuse.example: He enthused about the trip for the entire evening.  他整晚都在热情地谈这次旅行。

slobber.example: The big dog slobbered all over my clean white shirt.  那只大狗把口水流满了我干净的白衬衫。

gust.example: A sudden gust of anger swept over him when he read the letter.  读到那封信时，一阵怒气突然涌上他心头。

ebullition.example: His calm speech ended in a sudden ebullition of anger.  他平静的讲话以突然爆发的怒气收场。

explosion.example: Her joke caused an explosion of laughter in the crowded hall.  她的玩笑在挤满人的大厅里引起一阵爆笑。

gulp.example: He gulped down a glass of water and ran outside.  他大口喝下一杯水就跑了出去。

swig.example: She took a long swig of cold juice after the run.  跑完步她大口喝了一口冰果汁。

booze.example: They boozed all night and then slept through the morning.  他们整夜酗酒，然后一觉睡到中午。

tipple.example: The old sailor tippled quietly by the fire every evening.  这位老水手每晚都在火炉边静静小酌。

hack.example: The novelist dismissed his critics as hacks writing for money alone.  这位小说家把批评他的人贬为只为钱写作的雇佣文人。

well-worn.example: The speaker repeated a well-worn joke about airline food.  演讲者又讲了个关于飞机餐的老掉牙笑话。

halcyon.example: He often talked about the halcyon days of his youth.  他常谈起年轻时那些宁静美好的日子。

hushed.example: The hushed audience waited for the pianist to begin playing.  安静的观众等着钢琴家开始演奏。

untroubled.example: Her face looked untroubled despite all the bad news.  尽管坏消息不断，她的神情依然平静。

tempestuous.example: Their tempestuous marriage ended after only two stormy years.  他们剧烈动荡的婚姻仅两年就结束了。

stormy.example: The stormy meeting lasted until well after midnight.  这场激烈的会议一直开到午夜之后。

turbulent.example: They married during a turbulent period of war and economic collapse.  他们在战争与经济崩溃的动荡时期结了婚。

unquiet.example: He spent an unquiet night waiting for the test results.  他不安地度过一夜，等着检测结果。

unsettled.example: The unsettled weather ruined all our plans for the weekend.  多变的天气打乱了我们全部周末计划。

well-conditioned.cn: 身体强健的，状态良好的
well-conditioned.example: Only well-conditioned runners finished the race in that heat.  在那样的高温下只有体能良好的跑者跑完了比赛。

blighted.example: Blighted crops left the whole valley without any income.  枯萎的庄稼让整个山谷失去收入。

halfbaked.example: They abandoned the halfbaked scheme after a single disastrous trial run.  经过一次灾难性的试运行，他们放弃了那个考虑不周的方案。

daffy.example: His daffy idea about selling ice in winter amused everyone.  他冬天卖冰的荒唐主意把大家逗乐了。

dippy.example: She made a dippy suggestion that nobody at all took seriously.  她提了个愚蠢的建议，根本没人当真。

harebrained.example: Their harebrained scheme to get rich quickly failed badly.  他们快速致富的轻率计划惨败。

half-witted.example: He made a half-witted remark that embarrassed the whole team.  他说了句愚笨的话，让全队难堪。

hallmark.example: Careful craftsmanship is the hallmark of every piece she makes.  精心的手工是她每一件作品的典型特征。

ensign.example: Sailors raised the ensign as the ship left the harbor.  船离港时水手升起了船旗。

impresa.example: The knight's shield bore an impresa of a golden lion.  骑士的盾上有一头金狮的徽记。

logo.example: The new logo appears on every product the company sells.  新标志出现在公司销售的每件产品上。

symbol.example: The white dove has long been a symbol of peace.  白鸽长久以来是和平的象征。

totem.example: The carved totem stood at the entrance of the old village.  雕刻的图腾柱立在老村口。

trademark.example: That wide black hat became the singer's personal trademark.  那顶黑色宽边帽成了这位歌手的标志。

uncharacteristic feature.example: Silence was an uncharacteristic feature of his usually lively lectures.  沉默是他平素生动讲课中很不典型的特征。

consecrate.example: The bishop consecrated the small stone church last Sunday morning.  主教上周日上午为这座小石教堂祝圣。

sacralize.example: Local custom gradually sacralized the old spring on the hillside.  当地习俗渐渐把山坡上的老泉神圣化了。

deconsecrate.phrase_cn: 撤销旧教堂的神圣地位
deconsecrate.example: The diocese decided to deconsecrate the empty stone chapel.  教区决定撤销这座空石教堂的神圣地位。

desacralize.example: Modern tourism has slowly desacralized this once holy mountain.  现代旅游慢慢让这座曾经的圣山失去了神圣性。

desanctify.example: The new regime tried to desanctify every royal monument.  新政权试图让每座王室纪念物不再神圣。

hamhanded.example: His hamhanded attempt at repair left the door worse than before.  他笨手笨脚的修理让那扇门比原先更糟。

sure-handed.example: The sure-handed pilot landed safely in heavy crosswinds.  这位手法稳健的飞行员在强侧风中安全着陆。

hammer.example: The coach hammered home the importance of defense at every single practice.  教练在每一次训练中都反复强调防守的重要性。

cramp.example: Lack of money cramped every plan the young director had.  资金短缺束缚了这位年轻导演的每个计划。

hamstring.example: Budget cuts hamstrung the agency's ability to investigate serious public complaints.  预算削减使该机构调查严重公众投诉的能力大打折扣。

immobilize.example: Doctors immobilized his broken leg with a heavy plaster cast.  医生用厚石膏固定了他骨折的腿。

incapacitate.example: The virus incapacitated the hospital's computers for two full days.  病毒使医院的电脑瘫痪了整整两天。

hangdog.example: He came home with a hangdog look after failing the exam again.  又一次考试不及格后，他一脸沮丧地回了家。

disconsolate.example: The disconsolate boy sat alone after losing the final match.  输掉决赛后，郁郁不乐的男孩独自坐着。

doleful.example: She told the whole story in a low doleful voice.  她用低沉悲哀的语调讲完了整件事。

hanker.example: After years in the city she hankered after the quiet countryside.  在城里待了多年后，她开始向往宁静的乡村。

craving.example: She had a sudden craving for chocolate late at night.  深夜她突然特别想吃巧克力。

hunger.example: His hunger for knowledge kept him reading until dawn.  对知识的渴望让他读书到黎明。

longing.example: A deep longing for home filled her every single winter.  每个冬天她都充满对家的深切思念。

lust.example: His lust for power destroyed several old and valuable friendships.  他对权力的强烈欲望毁掉了几段珍贵的旧友情。

yearning.example: She felt a deep yearning for the mountains of her childhood.  她对童年的群山怀有深深的渴望。

lack of desire.example: His lack of desire to travel surprised all of his friends.  他对旅行毫无兴致，这让朋友们都很吃惊。

haphazard.example: The files were stacked in a haphazard pile on the office floor.  文件杂乱无章地堆在办公室的地板上。

aimless.example: After graduation he drifted through several aimless years in the city.  毕业后他在城里虚度了几年漫无目的的生活。

scattered.example: Scattered books and papers covered every surface of his small desk.  零散的书和纸铺满了他小书桌的每一处。

stray.example: A few stray thoughts kept interrupting her careful reading of the contract.  几个零散的念头不断打断她对合同的细读。

methodical.example: A methodical search of the archive finally produced the missing land records.  对档案的有条理搜查终于找出了缺失的土地记录。

systematic.example: The team took a systematic approach to checking each component.  团队用系统的方法逐一检查了每个部件。

nonrandom.example: The nonrandom spacing of the trees suggested careful human planning.  树木非随机的间距说明这是人为精心规划的。

organized.example: She keeps an organized notebook for every course she takes.  她为每门课都备有一本条理分明的笔记。

speak temperately.example: Even when provoked, he chose to speak temperately to the angry crowd.  即使被激怒，他也选择对愤怒的人群温和地讲话。

foregoer.example: This little machine was the foregoer of the modern computer.  这台小机器是现代计算机的先行者。

outrider.example: The first robins are outriders of the coming spring.  第一批旅鸫是春天将至的先驱。

hold.example: He still holds a grudge against his former business partner.  他仍然对昔日的生意伙伴心怀怨恨。

hardbitten.example: Only a hardbitten reporter would keep digging after so many threats.  只有顽强的记者才会在受到如此多威胁后继续追查。

hardened.cn: 变得坚强的；铁石心肠的
hardened.example: Even hardened soldiers were shaken by what they saw there.  连久经沙场的老兵都被眼前所见震住了。

cast-iron.example: He has a cast-iron stomach and can eat almost anything.  他有铁打的胃，几乎什么都能吃。

inured.example: The miners had grown inured to the cold and the dust.  矿工们已习惯了寒冷和粉尘。

rugged.example: Only rugged travelers attempt that trail in the winter.  只有意志坚毅的旅行者才会在冬天走那条小径。

hardy.example: These hardy plants survive the winter without any shelter at all.  这些耐寒的植物完全不需遮蔽就能过冬。

nonhardy.example: Nonhardy seedlings must be moved indoors before the first frost.  不耐寒的幼苗必须在初霜前搬进室内。

hard-bitten.example: The hard-bitten sergeant rarely praised anyone in his platoon.  这位饱经风霜的中士很少表扬排里的任何人。

balanced.example: The room felt calm because the colors were carefully balanced.  房间给人平静感，因为色彩经过精心搭配。

eurythmic.example: The temple has eurythmic columns that please the eye at once.  这座神庙匀称和谐的立柱令人一见舒心。

harmonic.example: The two voices created a rich harmonic blend.  两个声部形成了丰富和谐的融合。

nonconflicting.example: We finally found two nonconflicting dates for the meeting.  我们终于找到两个不冲突的开会日期。

incongruous.example: His loud tie looked incongruous with the somber gray suit.  他花哨的领带与深灰西装很不协调。

harness.example: Engineers are learning to harness wind power in far colder climates.  工程师正在学习在更寒冷的气候中利用风力。

apply.example: Try to apply what you learned to a real problem.  试着把学到的东西用到实际问题上。

exercise.example: Judges must exercise restraint when public feeling runs high.  当民情激昂时，法官必须保持克制。

operate.example: She learned to operate the crane in only two weeks.  她只用两周就学会了操作起重机。

utilize.example: The village utilizes wind power to pump water from the well.  这个村子利用风力从井里抽水。

fail to utilize.example: Many firms fail to utilize the data they already collect.  许多公司未能利用自己已经收集的数据。

beset.example: The young author was beset by doubts about his second novel.  这位年轻作者被对第二部小说的疑虑所困扰。

harry.example: Small cavalry units harried the retreating army for three straight days.  小股骑兵连续三天不断骚扰撤退的军队。

everyman’swork.cn: 每个人的作品（原书粘连）
everyman’swork.example: The string Everyman’swork is a run-on form of every man's work.  字符串 Everyman’swork 是 every man's work 粘连而成。

anythingelse.example: The scanner joined the words, so anythingelse means anything else.  扫描把词粘在一起，anythingelse 即 anything else。

isalwaysaportraitofhimself.ipa: ɪz ˈɔlweɪz ə ˈpɔrtrət əv hɪmˈsɛlf
isalwaysaportraitofhimself.example: The garbled token isalwaysaportraitofhimself is always a portrait of himself.  粘连词条 isalwaysaportraitofhimself 意为总是他自己的写照。

afflicting.example: The afflicting heat kept everyone indoors for three whole days.  折磨人的酷热让所有人在室内待了整整三天。

agonizing.example: After an agonizing wait, the test results finally arrived.  经过痛苦的等待，化验结果终于来了。

cruel.example: It was cruel to leave the dog out in the storm.  把狗留在暴风雨里太残忍了。

galling.example: It was galling to lose to a much weaker team.  输给弱得多的队伍让人非常恼火。

harrowing.example: She described her harrowing escape from the burning building.  她描述了自己从燃烧的大楼中惨痛的逃生经历。

forbearing.example: His forbearing manner calmed even the rudest customers.  他宽容的态度连最无礼的顾客都能安抚。

tolerant.example: A good editor is tolerant of odd but honest writing.  好编辑对古怪却真诚的文字是宽容的。

bundle.example: The guards bundled the prisoner into a waiting van.  卫兵把犯人匆匆塞进等候的货车。

fast-track.example: The city decided to fast-track the new hospital project.  市政府决定加快推进新医院项目。

slow the progress of.example: Cold storage can slow the progress of decay in fresh fruit.  冷藏可以减缓新鲜水果腐烂的进程。

slow down.example: Please slow down so that I can write all of this out.  请慢一点，我好把这些都写下来。

rushed.example: The report felt rushed and full of careless mistakes.  这份报告显得草率，满是粗心的错误。

well-considered.example: Her well-considered answer impressed everyone on the panel.  她考虑周全的回答让评审组都很佩服。

haunt.example: As a student he haunted the secondhand bookshops near the river.  学生时代，他常去河边的旧书店。

habituate.example: Divers slowly habituate themselves to the pressure of deep water.  潜水员慢慢让自己习惯深水的压力。

visit.example: We visit my grandmother in the country every summer.  我们每年夏天都去乡下看望祖母。

hang at.example: The teenagers hang at the diner every Friday night.  这些少年每个周五晚上都泡在那家小餐馆。

resort to.example: When the talks failed they resorted to legal action.  谈判失败后他们诉诸法律行动。

pretentiousness.example: The pretentiousness of his speech annoyed the whole audience.  他讲话的装腔作势让全场观众反感。

super-.example: The prefix super- means above, as in the word supercilious.  前缀 super- 表示在上，如 supercilious。

ciliousness.example: The fragment ciliousness comes from the noun superciliousness.  片段 ciliousness 来自名词 superciliousness。

superiority.example: His tone of superiority made the new staff uncomfortable.  他那种优越的语气让新员工很不舒服。

unpretentiousness.example: People trusted her because of her plain unpretentiousness.  人们信任她，因为她质朴不张扬。

retreat.example: The cabin became his retreat from the noise of the city.  那间小屋成了他躲避城市喧闹的避难所。

unsafe place.example: The old bridge is an unsafe place for children to play.  那座旧桥是孩子们玩耍的危险之地。

dangerous place.example: That alley is a dangerous place after the shops close.  商店关门后那条巷子是个危险的地方。

dishevelment.example: His dishevelment after the long flight was obvious to everyone.  长途飞行后他的凌乱样子人人都看得出。

tumble.example: The room was a tumble of boxes, books and old toys.  屋里是一堆乱七八糟的箱子、书和旧玩具。

helter-skelter.example: The children ran helter-skelter across the muddy yard.  孩子们慌慌张张地跑过泥泞的院子。

hearken.example: Few leaders hearken to warnings until it is far too late.  很少有领导者在为时已晚之前听取警告。

attend.example: Please attend carefully to what the doctor tells you.  请仔细听医生对你说的话。

harken.example: The young priest urged them to harken to the ancient teachings.  这位年轻牧师劝他们倾听古老的教义。

buoy up.example: Letters from home buoyed up the soldiers during the long winter.  家书在漫长的冬天鼓舞了士兵们。

heartrending.example: The documentary tells the heartrending story of a village losing its children.  这部纪录片讲述了一个村庄失去孩子的令人心碎的故事。

hedonism.example: Critics accused the novel of celebrating hedonism above every other value.  批评者指责这部小说把享乐主义置于其他一切价值之上。

carnality.example: The novel condemns the empty carnality of the very rich.  小说谴责了极富者空洞的肉欲生活。

sybaritism.example: Ancient writers mocked the sybaritism of the wealthy merchants.  古代作家嘲讽富商们的奢华享乐。

voluptuousness.example: Critics praised the warm voluptuousness of her singing voice.  评论家赞赏她歌声中温暖的感官魅力。

abstinence.example: The doctor recommended total abstinence from sugar for a month.  医生建议一个月完全戒糖。

asceticism.example: The monk chose asceticism over the comforts of his family home.  这位僧人舍弃家中舒适，选择了苦行。

sobriety.example: He has kept his sobriety for more than ten years.  他已保持戒酒清醒十多年了。

hegemony.example: The empire lost its naval hegemony within a single generation.  这个帝国在一代人之内就失去了海上霸权。

ascendancy.example: The party gained ascendancy over its rivals after the election.  该党在选举后取得了压过对手的优势。

dominance.example: The company's dominance in search has lasted twenty years.  这家公司在搜索领域的支配地位已持续二十年。

dominion.example: The king held dominion over every valley in the north.  国王统治着北方的每一个山谷。

predominance.example: The predominance of small farms shapes the local economy.  小农场的主导地位塑造了当地经济。

preeminence.example: Her preeminence in the field was never seriously questioned.  她在该领域的卓越地位从未被真正质疑。

lack of authority.example: His lack of authority made the students ignore every rule.  他缺乏权威，学生们把每条规矩都当空气。

hew.example: The new mayor promised to hew closely to the party line.  新市长承诺严格遵循党的路线。

cling.example: Older residents still cling to tradition despite all the changes.  尽管变化很多，年长的居民仍然坚守传统。

heresy.example: Suggesting that the old tradition might be wrong was treated as heresy.  暗示这一古老传统可能有错，被视为异端邪说。

orthodoxy.example: Her paper challenges the orthodoxy of modern economics.  她的论文挑战了现代经济学的正统观念。

heretical.example: His heretical views cost him his teaching post at the seminary.  他的异端观点使他失去了神学院的教职。

nonconformist.example: He was a nonconformist who questioned every rule at school.  他是个不循规蹈矩的人，质疑学校的每条规定。

unconventional.example: Her unconventional teaching style made the class come alive.  她非传统的教学风格让课堂活了起来。

unorthodox.example: The coach used unorthodox drills that somehow worked very well.  教练用了非正统的训练，效果却出奇地好。

conforming.example: Only designs conforming to the code will be approved.  只有符合规范的设计才会获批。

conformist.example: In that office every conformist was rewarded and every rebel ignored.  在那个办公室，随大流者受奖，反叛者被无视。

conventional.example: They chose a conventional design to please the older members.  他们选了常规设计以取悦年长的成员。

orthodox.example: Many doctors still prefer orthodox treatments to these unproven herbal remedies.  许多医生仍偏爱传统疗法，而非这些未经验证的草药。

easily comprehended.example: The manual is written in easily comprehended everyday language.  这本手册用容易理解的日常语言写成。

hagiographic.example: The biography is so hagiographic that it mentions no flaws at all.  这本传记谄媚得如同圣徒传，完全不提任何缺点。

adulatory.example: The magazine ran an adulatory profile of the young director.  杂志刊登了一篇吹捧那位年轻导演的报道。

ingratiating.example: The salesman's ingratiating manner made me suspect he was hiding something important.  这位销售员逢迎的态度让我怀疑他隐瞒了重要的事。

oleaginous.example: The oleaginous host praised every guest far too warmly.  那位油滑的主持人对每位嘉宾都夸得过火。

soapy.example: His soapy manner with the boss embarrassed his colleagues.  他对老板谄媚的样子让同事们难堪。

unctuous.example: The unctuous salesman praised every choice we made in his store.  那个油嘴滑舌的销售员对我们在他店里的每个选择都大加赞美。

heartfelt.example: He offered heartfelt thanks to everyone who had supported his family.  他向所有支持过他家人的人表达了真心的感谢。

unfeigned.example: Her unfeigned joy at the news warmed the whole room.  她听到消息时真心的喜悦温暖了整个屋子。

dissenting.example: Two judges wrote dissenting opinions on the final ruling.  两位法官就终审判决写了异议意见。

out-there.example: His out-there theories amused the students but worried the dean.  他离谱的理论逗乐了学生，却让院长忧心。

archconservative.example: The archconservative judge opposed every proposed change to the law.  这位极端保守的法官反对法律的每项修改提议。

brassbound.example: The brassbound committee refused to consider any new idea.  这个顽固守旧的委员会拒绝考虑任何新想法。

standpat.example: His standpat views blocked every reform the town really needed.  他守旧的观点阻碍了小镇真正需要的每项改革。

broad-minded.example: Her broad-minded parents let her study art abroad.  她开明的父母让她出国学艺术。

large-minded.example: Only a large-minded judge could hear such a case fairly.  只有宽宏开明的法官才能公正审理这样的案子。

nonconventional.example: The city invested in nonconventional energy such as tidal power.  该市投资了潮汐能等非常规能源。

nonorthodox.example: She offered a nonorthodox reading of the ancient poem.  她对这首古诗提出了非正统的解读。

progressive.example: The school follows progressive methods that welcome student questions.  这所学校采用鼓励学生提问的进步方法。

pulchritudinous.example: The poet described his pulchritudinous neighbor in eight long stanzas.  诗人用八段长诗描写他貌美的邻居。

handsome.example: He was a handsome man with unusually kind eyes.  他是个英俊的男人，眼神格外和善。

hie.example: The messenger hied to the palace with news of the great victory.  信使带着大胜的消息匆匆赶往王宫。

bustle.example: I love the bustle of the market on Saturday mornings.  我喜欢周六早晨市场上的喧闹。

hustle.example: She hustled the children into the car before the rain.  她在下雨前把孩子们匆匆赶上车。

scoot.example: The cat scooted under the bed as soon as we arrived.  我们一到，猫就飞快钻到床底下。

scuttle.example: Crabs scuttled sideways over the wet rocks at low tide.  退潮时螃蟹在湿岩石上横着疾跑。

trot.example: The pony trotted happily beside the fence for a while.  小马在栅栏边欢快地快步走了一阵。

poke.example: The old truck poked along the highway at thirty miles an hour.  那辆旧卡车以每小时三十英里在公路上慢慢晃。

humbug.example: Most of his grand promises turned out to be pure humbug.  他那些宏大的承诺大多不过是骗人的空话。

quacksalver.example: The village quacksalver sold colored water as powerful medicine.  村里的江湖郎中把有色的水当灵药卖。

ringer.example: The team lost when the other side used a ringer.  对方用了冒名顶替的选手，我们队因此输了。

humbuggery e.example: Voters were tired of the humbuggery of both parties.  选民厌倦了两党的骗人把戏。

ridiculous.example: The clown's ridiculous hat made the children laugh out loud.  小丑那顶滑稽的帽子逗得孩子们大笑。

screaming.example: The show's screaming final scene had the audience laughing helplessly.  这出戏滑稽至极的最后一幕让观众笑得停不下来。

sidesplitting.example: His sidesplitting stories kept the whole table laughing all evening.  他令人捧腹的故事让整桌人笑了一晚上。

uproarious.example: The comedian's last joke drew uproarious laughter from the crowd.  喜剧演员最后一个笑话引来观众的哄堂大笑。

lame.example: His lame joke got nothing but an awkward silence from everyone.  他那个蹩脚的笑话只换来大家尴尬的沉默。

histrionic.example: Her histrionic response to the small mistake embarrassed the whole team.  她对这个小错误夸张做作的反应让全队难堪。

dramatic.cn: 戏剧性的；夸张的；显著的
dramatic.example: Her dramatic gestures made the simple announcement seem like a tragedy.  她夸张的手势让这个简单的通知显得像一场悲剧。

melodramatic.example: Her melodramatic sighs made the argument seem almost funny.  她夸张的叹气让这场争吵显得有点好笑。

operatic.example: He made an operatic scene over a simple parking ticket.  他为一张普通罚单闹得像演歌剧。

stagy.example: His stagy bow at the door annoyed the other guests.  他在门口做作的鞠躬让其他客人反感。

theatrical.example: He raised his arms in a theatrical gesture of despair.  他张开双臂，做出夸张的绝望姿态。

undramatic.example: The trial had a quiet, undramatic ending that pleased nobody.  审判以平淡无波的方式收场，谁都不满意。

hive.example: By dawn the kitchen was a hive of noisy and cheerful activity.  黎明时，厨房已成了喧闹欢快的忙碌之地。

squirrel.example: She squirrels away a little cash from every paycheck.  她从每份薪水里存下一点现金。

hoary.example: He told the same hoary anecdote at every family dinner.  他每次家庭聚餐都讲同一个老掉牙的轶事。

dateless.example: These dateless legends were told long before anyone wrote them down.  这些年代不明的传说早在有人记录之前就流传着。

hodgepodge.example: The house is a hodgepodge of every style he admired.  这房子是他欣赏过的各种风格的大杂烩。

agglomeration.example: The district is an agglomeration of tiny workshops and cafes.  这个区是小作坊和咖啡馆的聚集地。

assortment.example: The box held an odd assortment of buttons and coins.  盒子里装着一堆杂七杂八的纽扣和硬币。

collage.example: Her film is a collage of interviews and old home movies.  她的影片是访谈与旧家庭录像的拼贴。

medley.example: The buffet table offered a medley of flavors from six different countries.  自助餐台上供应着来自六个不同国家的各式风味。

mishmash.example: The report was a mishmash of statistics and personal opinion.  这份报告是数据与个人意见的大杂烩。

pastiche.example: The novel is a clever pastiche of Victorian detective fiction.  这部小说是对维多利亚时代侦探小说的巧妙模仿。

potpourri.example: The concert offered a potpourri of jazz, folk and blues.  音乐会呈现了爵士、民谣与蓝调的大杂烩。

hymn.example: The whole congregation stood up to sing a hymn of thanksgiving.  全体教众站起身来唱一首感恩的赞美诗。

paean.example: The review read like a paean to the young violinist and her talent.  那篇评论读来像是对这位年轻小提琴手及其才华的赞歌。

dithyramb.example: His review was less an essay than a dithyramb to the singer.  他的评论不像文章，更像献给歌手的狂热赞歌。

lovely.example: We spent a lovely afternoon by the quiet lake.  我们在安静的湖边度过了一个美好的下午。

pretty.example: She wore a pretty blue dress to the party.  她穿了一条漂亮的蓝裙子去派对。

rav-.example: In the book rav- and ishing together spell the word ravishing.  书中 rav- 与 ishing 合起来拼成 ravishing。

ishing.example: The tail ishing belongs to the adjective ravishing, meaning stunning.  词尾 ishing 属于形容词 ravishing，意为惊艳的。

groaner.example: His pun was such a groaner that everyone just sighed.  他的双关语烂得让所有人只能叹气。

homogenize.example: National testing tends to homogenize teaching across very different schools.  全国统考往往使差异很大的学校的教学趋于统一。

formalize.example: The two firms decided to formalize their loose partnership.  两家公司决定把松散的合作正式化。

normalize.example: The treaty helped normalize relations between the two countries.  这项条约帮助两国关系正常化。

regularize.example: The new law regularized the status of thousands of workers.  新法规使数千名工人的身份合规化。

hone.example: She spent the summer honing her interviewing skills at a local paper.  她整个夏天都在一家本地报社磨练采访技能。

meliorate.example: Simple drainage work meliorated conditions in the crowded district.  简单的排水工程改善了拥挤街区的状况。

hortative.example: The coach ended with a hortative shout that lifted every player.  教练最后一声激励的呼喊振奋了每位球员。

false.example: His false praise fooled nobody at the small dinner table.  他虚假的赞美在那张小餐桌上骗不了任何人。

hubris.example: His hubris led him to ignore every warning from his own advisers.  他的狂妄自大使他无视自己顾问的所有警告。

unassuming.example: The famous author was surprisingly unassuming in person.  这位著名作家本人出乎意料地谦逊。

demure.example: She gave a demure nod and said nothing more.  她端庄地点了点头，没再多说。

down-to-earth.example: Despite his fame he remained a down-to-earth neighbor.  尽管成名，他仍是个不摆架子的邻居。

demureness.example: Her demureness at dinner hid a very sharp wit.  她餐桌上的娴静掩藏着极机敏的才思。

lowliness.example: He spoke of the lowliness of his early years without shame.  他毫无羞愧地谈起早年的卑微。

meekness.example: Her meekness should not be mistaken for weakness.  她的温顺不应被误当成软弱。

conceited.example: He grew conceited after winning a single small prize.  他只赢了一个小奖就变得自负起来。

high-and-mighty.example: She dislikes his high-and-mighty way of correcting everyone.  她讨厌他那种傲慢地纠正每个人的方式。

lordly.example: He waved the waiter away with a lordly gesture.  他以傲慢的手势把侍者挥退。

toplofty.example: His toplofty remarks about the village offended everyone there.  他对那个村子趾高气扬的评论得罪了当地所有人。

uppish.example: The uppish clerk barely looked at the waiting customers.  那个傲慢的店员几乎不看等候的顾客。

uppity.example: The manager called her uppity for asking about the budget.  经理因她询问预算而说她不知本分。

waffle.example: The candidate waffled about the tax plan for a full ten minutes.  这位候选人就税收方案含糊其辞地扯了整整十分钟。

humor.example: She humored her grandfather by listening to the same story again.  她顺着祖父的心意，又听了一遍同样的故事。

indulge.example: Grandparents often indulge children in ways parents will not.  祖辈常以父母不会的方式纵容孩子。

hurricane.example: A hurricane of protest followed the sudden announcement of the new tax.  新税突然宣布之后，随即掀起一场抗议的风暴。

husband.example: The village learned to husband its water carefully through the dry months.  村民学会了在旱季小心节省用水。

economize.example: The family had to economize sharply after he lost work.  他失业后一家人不得不大幅节省。

prodigalize.example: He prodigalized his inheritance on cars and long holidays.  他把遗产挥霍在汽车和长假上。

husk.example: The children helped husk the corn on the back porch all afternoon.  孩子们整个下午都在后廊帮着剥玉米壳。

bark.example: Workers stripped the bark from the fallen pine trunk.  工人们把倒下的松树干上的树皮剥掉。

hull.example: She hulled the strawberries while the water came to a boil.  她在水烧开的时候给草莓去萼。

shell.example: We sat on the porch and shelled peas all afternoon.  我们整个下午坐在门廊上剥豌豆。

shuck.example: The cook shucked a dozen oysters in under two minutes.  厨师不到两分钟就开了一打牡蛎。

skin.example: He learned to skin and clean a fish as a boy.  他小时候就学会了给鱼剥皮清理。

husky.example: After the long concert his voice was husky and barely audible.  漫长的演唱会后，他的声音沙哑，几乎听不见。

gravelly.example: The old singer's gravelly voice suited the sad song perfectly.  老歌手粗哑的嗓音与这首悲伤的歌极为契合。

rasping.example: A rasping whisper came from behind the heavy curtain.  厚窗帘后传来一声沙哑的低语。

rusty.example: After years of silence his voice sounded rusty and thin.  多年不语后，他的声音听起来生涩而单薄。

scratchy.example: The scratchy old record still filled the room with warmth.  那张沙沙作响的老唱片仍让房间充满温暖。

throaty.example: She answered with a throaty laugh that filled the hallway.  她以一阵低哑的笑声作答，笑声充满走廊。

hybrid.example: This rose is a hybrid bred for cold northern gardens.  这种玫瑰是为寒冷北方花园培育的杂交品种。

bastard.example: Scholars call this script a bastard of two older alphabets.  学者称这种文字是两种更古老字母的混杂产物。

mixture.example: The soup is a mixture of beans, corn and smoked meat.  这汤是豆子、玉米和熏肉的混合。

mule.example: The farmer led a tired mule up the steep path.  农夫牵着一头疲惫的骡子走上陡坡。

crossbred.example: The crossbred sheep survive the mountain winters much better.  杂交的绵羊更能耐住山区的冬天。

mongrel.example: A cheerful mongrel dog followed us along the beach for nearly a mile.  一只快乐的杂种狗沿着海滩跟了我们将近一英里。

purebred.example: Her purebred collie won every prize at the county show.  她的纯种柯利犬在县展上赢得所有奖项。

psalm.example: The old man read a psalm before every evening meal.  老人每顿晚餐前都读一首圣歌。

bless.example: The priest blessed the fields at the start of spring.  神父在春天开始时为田地祝福。

celebrate.example: The poem celebrates the quiet courage of ordinary farmers.  这首诗赞颂普通农人的沉静勇气。

hyperbole.example: His claim of a million loyal fans is obvious hyperbole.  他声称拥有百万忠实粉丝，这显然是夸张之辞。

coloring.example: His account had enough coloring to make the fight sound heroic.  他的叙述加了足够渲染，把打斗说得很英勇。

embellishment.example: He tells the story with a little embellishment each time.  他每次讲这故事都添一点渲染。

embroidering.example: Her embroidering of the details made the tale hard to believe.  她对细节的添枝加叶让故事变得难以相信。

magnification.example: The report's magnification of small risks alarmed the whole town.  报告对小风险的夸大惊动了全镇。

overstatement.example: Calling it the best film ever is a clear overstatement.  说它是史上最佳影片显然言过其实。

hypnotic.example: The drummer kept a hypnotic rhythm that held everyone completely still.  鼓手保持着一种催眠般的节奏，让所有人一动不动。

drowsy.example: The warm room made everyone drowsy during the long lecture.  温暖的房间让所有人在长课上昏昏欲睡。

narcotic.example: The steady rain had an almost narcotic effect on us.  连绵的雨对我们几乎有催眠的效果。

opiate.example: He called cheap television an opiate for tired workers.  他把廉价电视称作疲惫工人的麻醉剂。

sleepy.example: The children grew sleepy long before the movie ended.  电影还没结束孩子们就困了。

slumberous.example: The slumberous heat of noon emptied every street in the village.  正午令人昏睡的暑气让村里每条街都空了。

pretended.example: Her pretended surprise did not convince anyone in the room.  她假装的惊讶没能说服屋里任何人。

iconoclast.example: As a lifelong iconoclast, she questioned every rule the institute cherished.  作为一生特立独行的人，她质疑该研究所珍视的每条规则。

bohemian.example: The young painter led a bohemian lifestyle in a crowded attic studio.  这位年轻画家在拥挤的阁楼画室里过着放浪不羁的生活。

deviant.example: Society once treated any deviant thinker as a genuine danger.  社会曾把任何异类思想者视为真正的危险。

heretic.example: In his own time the scientist was treated as a heretic.  在他那个时代，这位科学家被当作异端。

maverick.example: As a political maverick, she voted against her own party on almost every bill.  作为政坛的独行者，她几乎在每项法案上都投票反对本党。

non-conformer.example: Every class has one non-conformer who questions the teacher openly.  每个班都有一个公开质疑老师的不从众者。

conformer.example: The office rewarded the conformer and punished the original thinker.  办公室奖励顺从者，惩罚有独立想法的人。

idolatrize.example: Teenagers often idolatrize singers they have never actually met.  青少年常盲目崇拜从未见过的歌手。

idyll.example: Their summer by the lake was a brief idyll they never forgot.  他们在湖边的那个夏天是一段难忘的无忧无虑的时光。

frisk.example: The lambs frisked in the meadow all through the warm morning.  羊羔们整个温暖的早晨都在草地上欢跃。

lark.example: They climbed the fence for a lark and got caught.  他们为了好玩翻过栅栏，结果被抓住了。

spark.example: One careless remark sparked a long argument at the table.  一句不慎的话在餐桌上引发了长久的争论。

ignominy.example: He could not bear the ignominy of being dismissed so publicly.  他无法承受如此公开地被解职的耻辱。

disrepute.example: The scandal brought the whole institution into disrepute.  这场丑闻让整个机构声名扫地。

opprobrium.example: The mayor faced weeks of opprobrium after the decision.  市长在那个决定之后面对数周的谴责。

illiteracy.example: The government launched a campaign to reduce adult illiteracy in rural areas.  政府发起了一场运动，以减少农村地区的成人文盲。

ignorance.example: His ignorance of basic history embarrassed him during the interview.  他对基本历史的无知让他在面试中很难堪。

learning.example: The old librarian was a woman of deep learning.  那位老图书馆员是个学识深厚的女性。

literacy.example: The village raised literacy sharply within a single decade.  这个村子在十年内大幅提高了识字率。

clerisy.example: The city's clerisy gathered every Sunday in one small bookshop.  城里的知识阶层每周日聚在一家小书店。

intelligentsia.example: The reform was debated hotly among the country's intelligentsia.  这项改革在该国知识分子中引发热议。

literati.example: The novel was praised by the literati but ignored by readers.  这部小说受文人推崇，却被读者忽视。

demystify.example: The book demystifies statistics for readers who fear numbers.  这本书为怕数字的读者把统计学讲得浅显易懂。

interpret.example: A good guide can interpret each painting in one minute.  好的导览员能在一分钟内解说每幅画。

illusory.example: The advantage proved illusory once the competitors lowered their own prices.  竞争者一降价，这一优势就被证明是虚幻的。

fanciful.example: Her fanciful account of the accident convinced no one at all.  她对事故荒谬不切实际的描述完全没能说服任何人。

fantastic.example: His fantastic story about talking wolves amused the children.  他关于会说话的狼的荒诞故事逗乐了孩子们。

imaginary.example: The boy blamed every mess on an imaginary friend.  男孩把每次弄乱都推给一个想象出的朋友。

suppositious.example: The lawyer built her argument on a purely suppositious example.  律师用一个纯属假设的例子构建论点。

unreal.example: The empty city felt unreal in the early morning light.  清晨的光线里，空城显得不真实。

imbibe.example: The hikers imbibed cool spring water before climbing the last ridge.  徒步者在攀登最后一道山脊前喝了清凉的泉水。

drink.example: You should drink more water during this hot dry week.  这个干热的一周里你该多喝水。

hoist.example: The sailors hoisted a glass together after the long voyage.  水手们在漫长航行后一起举杯。

sip.example: She sipped her tea and watched the rain through the window.  她抿着茶，透过窗子看雨。

sponge.example: Dry moss sponges up water and holds it for weeks.  干苔藓吸收水分并能保存数周。

urinate.example: Patients are asked to urinate before the scan begins.  病人被要求在扫描开始前排尿。

imbroglio.example: The minister resigned in the middle of a diplomatic imbroglio.  部长在一场外交乱局之中辞职了。

complexity.example: Nobody expected the complexity of the new tax rules.  谁都没料到新税规如此复杂。

complication.example: A small complication delayed the whole project by two months.  一个小麻烦把整个项目推迟了两个月。

embarrassment.example: The missing file became a real embarrassment for the department.  丢失的文件成了部门真正的尴尬。

entanglement.example: He spent years escaping a costly legal entanglement.  他花了数年才摆脱一场昂贵的法律纠缠。

involvement.example: His involvement in the dispute cost him several old friends.  他卷入这场争端，失去了几个老朋友。

misunderstanding.example: The whole quarrel grew from one small misunderstanding.  整场争吵源于一个小小的误会。

quandary.example: The offer of two jobs left him in a real quandary.  两份工作的邀约让他陷入真正的困境。

imitation.example: The bag was a cheap imitation sold openly at the night market.  那只包是夜市上公开出售的廉价仿制品。

clone.example: The new phone is basically a clone of last year's model.  这款新手机基本上是去年型号的翻版。

duplication.example: The painting is a faithful duplication of a lost original.  这幅画是失传原作的忠实复制。

facsimile.example: The museum shows a facsimile while the original stays hidden.  博物馆展出摹本，原件则藏而不露。

reduplication.example: The office suffers from constant reduplication of the same paperwork.  这个办公室饱受同样文书不断重复之苦。

replica.example: Visitors climb a wooden replica of the ancient tower.  游客可以爬上那座古塔的木制复制品。

replication.example: The museum displays a careful replication of the ancient bronze vase.  博物馆展出了那只古代青铜花瓶的精细复制品。

reproduction.example: He hung a reproduction of the famous painting above his desk.  他在书桌上方挂了那幅名画的复制品。

prototype.example: Engineers tested a working prototype of the electric bus last spring.  工程师去年春天测试了这款电动公交车的可用原型。

faultless.example: Her faultless pronunciation impressed everyone in the room.  她无瑕的发音让房间里的每个人都印象深刻。

indefectible.example: The old monk was praised for his indefectible devotion to the temple.  这位老僧因对寺院无瑕的虔诚而受到赞誉。

irreproachable.example: His record as a judge was irreproachable for thirty long years.  他担任法官三十年的记录无可指责。

seamless.example: The two departments managed a seamless merger within three months.  两个部门在三个月内完成了无缝合并。

unblemished.example: She left the company with an unblemished professional reputation.  她带着毫无瑕疵的职业声誉离开了公司。

faulty.example: The fire was traced to a faulty electrical connection in the basement.  火灾被查明源于地下室一处有缺陷的电线接头。

flawed.example: Critics argued that the study was flawed from the very beginning.  批评者认为这项研究从一开始就有缺陷。

imperfect.example: Even an imperfect solution is better than doing nothing at all.  即便是不完美的方案也胜过什么都不做。

immanent.example: He argued that order is immanent in nature rather than imposed on it.  他认为秩序内在于自然，而非外加于自然。

ingrained.example: Habits ingrained since childhood are extremely difficult to change in later life.  童年就已根深蒂固的习惯到了晚年极难改变。

integral.example: Careful revision is an integral part of writing any serious research paper.  仔细修改是撰写任何严肃研究论文不可缺少的部分。

extrinsic.example: Money is an extrinsic reward that rarely sustains real interest.  金钱是一种外在奖励，很少能维持真正的兴趣。

adolescent.example: His adolescent jokes annoyed the older members of the committee.  他幼稚的玩笑让委员会里年长的成员很不快。

youngish.example: A youngish woman in a grey coat asked us for directions.  一个穿灰外套的略显年轻的女子向我们问路。

youthful.example: At sixty he still had a remarkably youthful energy.  六十岁时他依然有着惊人的年轻活力。

old.example: The village follows customs that are older than the kingdom itself.  这个村庄遵循着比王国本身更古老的习俗。

venerable.example: The venerable library has served scholars for over four centuries.  这座古老而受人尊敬的图书馆已为学者服务了四百多年。

contemporary.example: The gallery mixes ancient sculpture with contemporary photography.  这家画廊将古代雕塑与当代摄影混合展出。

immune.example: No public figure is entirely immune to criticism these days.  如今没有哪个公众人物能完全不受批评的影响。

insusceptible.example: The old general seemed insusceptible to fear of any kind.  这位老将军似乎不受任何恐惧的影响。

unaffected.example: Northern farms remained largely unaffected by the drought.  北方的农场基本未受这场旱灾影响。

susceptible.example: Young children are especially susceptible to infection during the cold months.  幼儿在寒冷的月份里尤其容易受到感染。

vulnerable.example: Wooden houses on the ridge are especially vulnerable to summer fires.  山脊上的木屋在夏季尤其容易受火灾侵袭。

incarcerate.example: The state chose to incarcerate him rather than offer treatment.  州政府选择监禁他，而不是提供治疗。

intern.example: The government interned thousands of civilians during the war.  政府在战争期间拘禁了数千名平民。

jail.example: He was jailed for six months after refusing to pay the fine.  他因拒缴罚款被监禁了六个月。

inalterable.example: Death is the one inalterable condition of every living thing.  死亡是一切生物唯一不可改变的境况。

unalterable.example: The terms of the contract are unalterable once both parties sign.  合同条款一经双方签署便不可更改。

unchangeable.example: He treated his own opinions as unchangeable truths.  他把自己的观点当作不可改变的真理。

cold-blooded.example: The court described the crime as cold-blooded and carefully planned.  法庭形容这起罪行冷血且经过精心策划。

numb.example: Numb with grief, she answered the reporters' questions in a flat voice.  她因悲伤而麻木，用平板的声音回答记者的提问。

phlegmatic.example: Her phlegmatic response to the crisis calmed the entire staff.  她对危机的冷静反应让全体员工镇定下来。

undemonstrative.example: Undemonstrative by nature, he simply nodded at the good news.  他天性不外露感情，听到好消息只是点了点头。

vehement.example: She made a vehement protest against the new tax.  她对新税提出了强烈的抗议。

beggared.example: The failed harvest left half the village beggared that winter.  歉收使那年冬天村里一半人家一无所有。

destitute.example: Thousands of refugees arrived destitute and without documents.  数千名难民抵达时穷困潦倒且没有证件。

penniless.example: He arrived in the city penniless and slept in the station.  他身无分文地来到这座城市，睡在车站里。

wealthy.example: Only the wealthy families could afford such an education.  只有富有的家庭才负担得起这样的教育。

impending.example: Dark clouds warned the villagers of an impending storm that evening.  乌云警示村民当晚有一场暴风雨即将来临。

approaching.example: Everyone worked late because of the approaching inspection.  由于即将到来的检查，所有人都加班到很晚。

coming.example: The coming months will decide whether the project survives.  即将到来的几个月将决定该项目能否存活。

imminent.example: Forecasters warned that a violent storm was imminent.  预报员警告说一场猛烈的风暴即将来临。

nearing.example: The bridge is nearing completion after four years of work.  经过四年施工，这座桥已接近完工。

pending.example: Several lawsuits are still pending against the company.  针对该公司的几起诉讼仍未判决。

proximate.example: Investigators identified the proximate cause of the collapse.  调查人员查明了这次倒塌的最直接原因。
