upcoming.example: She is preparing hard for the upcoming championship match.  她正为即将到来的锦标赛全力备战。

around the corner.example: Spring is around the corner, and the plum trees are budding.  春天即将来临，梅树已经开始发芽。

late.example: The rain came too late to save the withered crops.  雨来得太晚，救不了枯萎的庄稼。

impassable.example: Heavy snow made the mountain pass impassable for a week.  大雪使山口一周内无法通行。

impermeable.example: Clay forms an impermeable layer beneath the reservoir.  黏土在水库下方形成了一层不透水的岩层。

impervious.example: The coating makes the fabric impervious to rain and light oil.  这层涂层使织物不透雨水和轻质油。

impregnable.cn: 坚不可摧的，无法攻克的
impregnable.example: The cliffside castle was long considered impregnable by invaders.  这座悬崖上的城堡长期被入侵者视为坚不可摧。

unfathomable.cn: 难以理解的，深不可测的
unfathomable.example: His motives remained unfathomable even to his closest friends.  连最亲近的朋友也无法理解他的动机。

ungraspable.example: To a child, infinity is an ungraspable idea.  对孩子来说，无穷是一个无法领会的概念。

unintelligible.example: The recording was so noisy that the speech became unintelligible.  录音噪声太大，讲话内容变得无法听懂。

passable.example: The road is barely passable after the spring floods.  春季洪水过后，这条路勉强可以通行。

penetrable.example: Thin plywood is penetrable by an ordinary nail.  普通钉子就能穿透薄胶合板。

permeable.example: Water collects here because the rock layer below is highly permeable.  水在这里积聚，因为下面的岩层极易渗水。

pervious.example: Engineers laid a pervious pavement to reduce street flooding.  工程师铺设了透水路面以减少街道积水。

intelligible.example: Speak slowly so your questions are intelligible to the audience.  慢点说，好让你的问题让听众听得懂。

regretless.example: She left the job regretless and never looked back.  她毫无悔意地辞去工作，从未回头。

shameless.example: The politician told shameless lies on national television.  这位政客在全国电视上无耻地撒谎。

unashamed.example: He was unashamed about taking credit for other people's work.  他毫不羞愧地把别人的功劳记在自己名下。

regretful.example: She sounded regretful when she declined the invitation.  她拒绝邀请时语气中带着遗憾。

forced.example: The court threw out the forced confession as unreliable.  法庭以不可靠为由驳回了这份被迫的供词。

involuntary.example: Blinking is an involuntary response to sudden light.  眨眼是对突然强光的不自觉反应。

clamant.example: There is a clamant demand for clean drinking water here.  这里对清洁饮用水有迫切的需求。

optional.example: Attendance at the evening seminar is entirely optional.  参加晚间研讨会完全是自愿的。

imperial.example: The hall was decorated on an imperial scale that dazzled every visitor.  大厅以帝王般宏大的规模装饰，令每位来客惊叹。

noble.example: The horse moved with a noble grace across the field.  那匹马以高贵的优雅姿态穿过田野。

inferior.example: Customers complained that the new fabric was clearly inferior.  顾客抱怨新面料明显质量较差。

lowly.example: He began as a lowly assistant and rose to direct the firm.  他从卑微的助理做起，后来掌管了公司。

mousy.phrase_cn: 一个怯生生的小个子女人
mousy.example: The mousy student never raised her hand in class.  那个怯生生的学生在课上从不举手。

shy.example: He was too shy to introduce himself to the visitors.  他太害羞，不敢向来访者自我介绍。

imperturbable.example: The pilot stayed imperturbable while the engine warning sounded.  发动机警报响起时，飞行员依然沉着冷静。

disimpassioned.example: She gave a disimpassioned account of the violent quarrel.  她冷静地叙述了那场激烈的争吵。

unflappable.example: Even during the emergency landing the pilot remained completely unflappable.  即使在紧急降落时，飞行员依然十分镇定。

unruffled.example: He remained unruffled despite the angry shouting around him.  尽管周围怒吼声不断，他依然镇定自若。

bulletproof.example: The lawyers built a bulletproof case against the company.  律师们为起诉该公司建立了无懈可击的案子。

indestructible.example: Their friendship proved indestructible despite years of separation.  尽管分离多年，他们的友谊依然牢不可破。

inextinguishable.cn: 不可熄灭的，无法消除的
inextinguishable.example: She had an inextinguishable curiosity about distant places.  她对远方怀有无法熄灭的好奇心。

invulnerable.cn: 不会受伤的，无懈可击的
invulnerable.example: No fortress is truly invulnerable to a long siege.  没有哪座堡垒真能经受长期围攻而不受损。

impulsive.example: Buying that car was an impulsive act he later regretted.  买那辆车是他后来后悔的冲动之举。

impious.example: The villagers considered his joke about the shrine deeply impious.  村民认为他拿神龛开的玩笑极为不敬神。

blasphemous.example: The book was banned as blasphemous by church authorities.  这本书被教会当局以亵渎神明为由查禁。

irreverent.example: His irreverent humor delighted students and annoyed professors.  他不恭敬的幽默让学生开心却让教授不快。

sacrilegious.example: Smoking inside the temple was considered sacrilegious by the villagers.  在寺内吸烟被村民视为亵渎神圣的行为。

implacable.example: She faced an implacable opponent who refused every reasonable compromise.  她面对一个拒绝一切合理妥协的固执对手。

grim.cn: 冷酷的，不肯让步的；严峻的
grim.example: He fought on with grim persistence until the very end.  他以冷酷的坚韧一直战斗到最后。

relentless.example: Relentless pressure from creditors finally forced the small firm to close.  债权人无情的压力最终迫使这家小公司关门。

unappeasable.example: His unappeasable resentment poisoned every family gathering.  他无法平息的怨恨破坏了每次家庭聚会。

placable.example: Fortunately his father was placable and forgave the mistake.  幸好他父亲脾气容易平息，原谅了这个错误。

implement.example: The city will implement the new recycling policy in early spring.  市政府将在初春执行新的回收政策。

administer.example: A local committee administers the housing program.  一个地方委员会负责实施这项住房计划。

enforce.example: Police were sent to enforce the new parking regulations.  警察被派去强制执行新的停车规定。

execute.example: The team executed the rescue plan with remarkable precision.  团队极为精确地执行了救援计划。

implode.example: The glass flask began to implode under the sudden drop in pressure.  玻璃烧瓶在压力骤降时开始内爆。

buckle.example: The steel beams buckled when the roof collapsed inward.  屋顶向内塌陷时钢梁弯折了。

explode.example: The old boiler exploded, shattering every window nearby.  那台旧锅炉爆炸了，附近的窗户全被震碎。

impetrate.example: The villagers gathered to impetrate rain from the heavens.  村民聚集起来向上天祈求降雨。

pray.example: They prayed for the safe return of the fishermen.  他们祈求渔民平安归来。

impostor.example: The charming visitor turned out to be an impostor with forged papers.  那位迷人的来客原来是个持伪造证件的冒充者。

impotent.example: Without funding the committee was impotent to change anything at all.  没有资金，委员会无力改变任何事情。

hamstrung.example: The agency was hamstrung by a lack of funding.  该机构因缺乏资金而无力施展。

handcuffed.example: Teachers felt handcuffed by the rigid new curriculum.  教师们觉得被僵化的新课程束缚住了。

helpless.example: The villagers stood helpless as the river swallowed their fields.  河水淹没农田时，村民们无助地站着。

impuissant.example: The council proved impuissant against such powerful landowners.  面对如此强大的地主，议会显得软弱无力。

paralyzed.example: The whole office was paralyzed by the sudden power failure.  整个办公室因突然停电而陷入瘫痪。

potent.example: Fear of shame is a potent motive in small communities.  在小社群中，怕丢脸是一种强有力的动机。

puissant.example: Once a puissant empire, the kingdom now controlled two provinces.  这个王国曾是强大的帝国，如今只控制两个省。

imprecise.example: His imprecise measurements ruined the entire batch of expensive parts.  他不精确的测量毁了整批昂贵的零件。

approximate.example: Give me an approximate cost before we sign anything.  在我们签任何东西之前，先给我一个大概的费用。

inaccurate.example: The map turned out to be badly inaccurate near the coast.  这张地图在靠近海岸处相当不准确。

squishy.example: The report relies on squishy terms like "soon" and "substantial".  报告依赖“很快”“大量”这类含糊的说法。

accurate.example: We need accurate figures before making the final decision.  在做最终决定前我们需要准确的数字。

veracious.example: The court relied on one veracious witness to settle the case.  法庭依靠一位诚实的证人来了结此案。

improvisation.example: His solo was a brilliant improvisation on an old melody.  他的独奏是对一段古老旋律的精彩即兴演绎。

extemporization.example: The lecture was pure extemporization, yet perfectly organized.  这场讲座纯属即兴发挥，却条理分明。

ad-lib.example: The host had to ad-lib for ten minutes when the guest was late.  嘉宾迟到时主持人只好即兴撑了十分钟。

improvised.example: They slept in an improvised shelter made of branches.  他们睡在用树枝临时搭成的棚子里。

offhand.example: An offhand remark about the budget caused three days of angry headlines.  一句关于预算的随口评论引来三天的愤怒头条。

unplanned.example: An unplanned stop in the village became the trip's highlight.  在村里的一次临时停留成了旅行的亮点。

unprepared.example: The city was completely unprepared for such heavy snowfall.  这座城市对如此大的降雪毫无准备。

unrehearsed.example: Her unrehearsed answer was more convincing than any script.  她未经准备的回答比任何稿子都更有说服力。

prepared.example: Come prepared with questions for tomorrow's interview.  为明天的面试准备好问题再来。

improvise.example: The pianist improvised for ten minutes when the singer arrived late.  歌手迟到时，钢琴家即兴演奏了十分钟。

plan.example: They planned the whole ceremony months in advance.  他们提前几个月就筹划好了整个典礼。

premeditate.example: The lawyer argued that his client did not premeditate the attack.  律师主张他的委托人并未预先谋划这场袭击。

imprudent.example: Borrowing so much money at that rate was clearly imprudent.  以那样的利率借这么多钱显然是不明智的。

inadvisable.example: Doctors said surgery was inadvisable for a patient so weak.  医生说对如此虚弱的病人手术并不可取。

injudicious.example: One injudicious comment cost him the whole negotiation.  一句欠考虑的话让他输掉了整场谈判。

advisable.example: It is advisable to book your tickets several weeks early.  提前几周订票是明智的做法。

tactical.example: Staying silent was a tactical choice, not weakness.  保持沉默是策略上的选择，而非软弱。

attack.example: Rival scholars attacked the credibility of her new evidence.  对立的学者抨击她新证据的可信度。

cross.example: Nobody dared cross the old chairman in public.  没人敢在公开场合反驳这位老董事长。

negative.example: The committee negatived the motion after a short debate.  委员会经短暂辩论后否决了该动议。

traverse.example: The defense traversed every allegation made by the prosecution.  辩方否认了检方提出的每一项指控。

powerlessness.example: Long unemployment bred a deep feeling of powerlessness.  长期失业催生了深深的无力感。

potency.example: The vaccine loses potency if it is not kept cold.  疫苗若不冷藏就会失去效力。

puissance.example: The old chronicles celebrate the puissance of kings and their armies.  古老的编年史颂扬君王及其军队的权势。

irreflective.example: His irreflective answer showed he had not read the report.  他不加思索的回答说明他没读过报告。

thoughtless.example: It was thoughtless of him to slam the door at midnight.  他半夜摔门实在是欠考虑。

uncaring.example: She described the hospital staff as cold and uncaring.  她形容医院工作人员冷漠而不关心人。

intentional.example: The omission was intentional rather than a simple oversight.  这一遗漏是故意的，而非单纯的疏忽。

advertent.example: A good editor stays advertent to the smallest inconsistency.  好编辑对最细微的不一致也保持留意。

mindful.example: Be mindful of the time when you answer each question.  回答每个问题时要留意时间。

inalienable.example: The constitution describes these freedoms as inalienable rights of every citizen.  宪法称这些自由是每个公民不可剥夺的权利。

untransferable.example: This scholarship is personal and completely untransferable.  这项奖学金属于个人，完全不可转让。

alienable.example: Under the new law, such land became freely alienable.  依照新法，这类土地变得可以自由转让。

inane.example: The film's dialogue was inane and endlessly repetitive.  这部电影的对白空洞且不断重复。

empty.example: His speech was full of empty phrases about progress.  他的演讲满是关于进步的空洞辞藻。

inanimate.example: Children often speak to inanimate objects as though they could reply.  孩子常对无生命的物体说话，仿佛它们能够回答。

insentient.example: Ancient philosophers debated whether plants are insentient or capable of feeling pain.  古代哲学家争论植物是无知觉的还是能感到痛苦。

unfeeling.example: It seemed unfeeling to laugh at such a moment.  在这样的时刻发笑显得毫无感情。

inaugurate.example: The treaty inaugurated a long period of peace between the two nations.  这项条约开启了两国之间长期的和平。

introduce.example: The city introduced free bus travel for elderly residents.  该市开始为老年居民提供免费公交。

lucent.example: The lake lay lucent under a cloudless autumn sky.  湖水在无云的秋空下清亮透明。

incantation.example: The healer chanted an incantation over the sick child all night.  巫医整夜在病童身旁吟诵咒语。

bewitchment.example: The villagers blamed the illness on some bewitchment.  村民们把这场病归咎于某种魔法。

enchantment.example: Only true courage could break the enchantment on the castle.  唯有真正的勇气才能解除城堡上的魔法。

glamour.example: Old tales say a witch can cast a glamour over travelers.  古老传说称女巫能对旅人施下迷咒。

hex.example: She joked that a hex had ruined her whole week.  她开玩笑说有个恶咒毁了她一整周。

invocation.example: The ceremony opened with a long invocation to the ancestors.  仪式以对祖先的长篇祈祷开始。

personalize.example: Poets often personalize the seasons as quarreling brothers.  诗人常把四季人格化为争吵的兄弟。

personify.example: For many readers, she personifies quiet courage.  在许多读者心中，她就是沉静勇气的化身。

symbolize.example: The olive branch has long symbolized peace between enemies.  橄榄枝长久以来象征着敌人之间的和平。

disembody.example: The novel imagines a machine that can disembody human memory.  这部小说设想出一台能使人类记忆脱离肉体的机器。

exciter.example: The pamphlet named him as the chief exciter of the mob.  这本小册子指他是这群暴民的主要煽动者。

inciter.example: Police arrested the inciter of the street violence.  警方逮捕了这场街头暴力的煽动者。

agitational.example: The newspaper was closed for printing agitational articles.  这家报纸因刊印煽动性文章而被查封。

instigative.example: His instigative speech stirred the crowd into open revolt.  他煽动性的演讲激起人群公开反叛。

provocative.example: The article was deliberately provocative to attract attention.  这篇文章故意挑拨，以吸引注意。

seditious.example: Soldiers found seditious pamphlets hidden beneath the floor of the barn.  士兵们在谷仓地板下发现了藏着的煽动性小册子。

conciliatory.example: He adopted a conciliatory tone after the heated debate.  激烈辩论之后他改用了安抚的语气。

rankle.example: The unfair remark continued to rankle him for many years afterward.  那句不公平的评论此后多年一直令他愤懑。

dawn.example: Printing marked the dawn of mass education in Europe.  印刷术标志着欧洲大众教育的开端。

kickoff.example: The kickoff of the fundraising drive drew hundreds of donors.  募捐活动的启动吸引了数百名捐赠者。

omega.example: For him, that discovery was the omega of a lifelong search.  对他而言，那个发现是毕生求索的终点。

incessant.example: The incessant drumming from next door kept us awake all night.  隔壁不间断的鼓声让我们整夜无法入睡。

continual.example: Continual delays finally forced them to cancel the trip.  接连不断的延误最终迫使他们取消行程。

nonstop.example: It rained nonstop for three days in the mountains.  山里连续下了三天不停的雨。

running.example: They kept a running argument going for the whole journey.  他们一路上争论不休。

unbroken.example: The team enjoyed an unbroken run of twelve victories.  这支队伍取得了连续十二场不间断的胜利。

unceasing.example: Her unceasing questions finally uncovered the truth.  她不停的追问最终揭开了真相。

uninterrupted.example: He needs three uninterrupted hours to finish the draft.  他需要三小时不被打断的时间来完成草稿。

unremitting.example: Her unremitting practice over ten years made her a fine cellist.  十年不间断的练习使她成为出色的大提琴手。

interrupteddiscontinuous.example: The fossil layers form an interrupteddiscontinuous sequence across the valley.  这些化石层在山谷中形成一条间断不连续的序列。

inch.example: The heavy truck had to inch forward slowly across the snowy bridge.  那辆重卡只能缓慢地挪过积雪覆盖的桥梁。

creak.example: The old cart creaked slowly up the muddy hill.  那辆旧车吱吱作响地缓慢爬上泥泞的山坡。

limp.example: He limped slowly toward the door with his ankle wrapped in bandages.  他脚踝缠着绷带，一步一跛地慢慢走向门口。
limp.cn: 跛行，艰难缓慢地走；柔软的

slouch.example: The exhausted workers slouched slowly down the street toward the bus stop.  疲惫的工人沿街缓慢走向公交站。

snail.example: Traffic snailed along the flooded avenue all morning.  整个上午车流在被水淹的大道上蜗行。

incinerate.example: The city incinerates medical waste in a sealed furnace.  该市在密闭炉中焚烧医疗废物。

burn.example: They burned the old letters in the garden that evening.  那天晚上他们在花园里烧掉了旧信。

carbonize.example: Intense heat carbonized the timber beams completely.  高温把木梁彻底烧成了炭。

pick.example: He picked a quarrel with everyone at the table.  他跟桌上每个人都挑起了争吵。

bleak.example: The moor looked bleak under grey November skies.  灰暗的十一月天空下，荒原显得阴冷荒凉。

bitter.example: We waited an hour in bitter cold for the train.  我们在刺骨的严寒中等了一小时火车。

rigorous.example: Few crops survive the rigorous winters of the plateau.  很少有作物能度过高原严酷的冬天。

cloudless.example: We sailed all day beneath a cloudless summer sky.  我们在无云的夏日天空下航行了一整天。

sunny.example: The children played outside on that sunny spring morning.  在那个阳光明媚的春日早晨，孩子们在外面玩。

sunshiny.example: It was a sunshiny day, perfect for drying the laundry.  这是个阳光灿烂的日子，正适合晒衣服。

unclouded.example: Stars were vivid in the unclouded desert night.  在晴朗的沙漠夜空中，星星格外明亮。

incogitant.example: His incogitant comment about her illness hurt the whole family.  他关于她病情的那句欠考虑的话伤害了全家人。

discourteous.example: It was discourteous to leave without thanking the host.  不向主人道谢就离开是无礼的。

disrespectful.example: Interrupting your teacher like that is disrespectful.  那样打断老师说话是不尊重人的。

ill-mannered.example: The ill-mannered boy grabbed food before the guests sat down.  这个没礼貌的男孩在客人坐下前就抓起食物。

inconsiderate.example: Playing loud music at midnight is simply inconsiderate.  半夜大声放音乐实在是不体谅别人。

civil.example: Try to stay civil even when the discussion gets heated.  即使讨论变得激烈也要努力保持礼貌。

considerate.example: It was considerate of her to call before visiting.  她来访前先打电话，很体贴周到。

incongruent.example: The two surveys produced incongruent results that nobody could explain.  两项调查得出了无人能解释的不一致结果。

inconsonant.example: His account is inconsonant with what the witnesses reported.  他的说法与证人所述不一致。

fiddling.example: Do not waste an afternoon on such fiddling corrections.  别为这些琐碎的修改浪费一个下午。

inconsiderable.example: The risk is small but by no means inconsiderable.  风险虽小，却绝非微不足道。

negligible.example: The extra cost is negligible compared with the savings.  与节省的钱相比，额外成本微不足道。

nugatory.example: The court dismissed his nugatory objection and proceeded with the hearing.  法庭驳回了他无关紧要的反对，继续进行听证。

inarguable.example: That the climate is warming is now inarguable.  气候正在变暖，这一点现在无可争辩。

indisputable.example: The photographs offered indisputable proof of the damage.  这些照片提供了损害的无可争辩的证明。

indubitable.example: Her talent for languages is indubitable.  她的语言天赋是不容置疑的。

positive.example: I am positive that I locked the back door.  我确定我锁了后门。

unquestionable.example: His loyalty to the team is unquestionable.  他对团队的忠诚毫无疑问。

incontrovertible.example: The DNA test provided incontrovertible evidence of his innocence.  DNA 检测提供了他无罪的无可争议的证据。

arguable.example: Whether the reform helped the poor is highly arguable.  这项改革是否帮助了穷人很有争议。

refutable.example: A scientific theory must be refutable by observation.  科学理论必须能被观察所反驳。

incorrigible.cn: 屡教不改的；无法矫正的
incorrigible.example: Everyone knew he was an incorrigible liar, yet they still listened.  大家都知道他是个屡教不改的骗子，却还是听他讲。

incurable.cn: 不可治愈的；难以改变的
incurable.example: He is an incurable optimist, even after losing everything.  即便失去一切，他仍是个改不了的乐观主义者。

irrecoverable.cn: 无法挽回的，不能收回的
irrecoverable.example: The flood caused irrecoverable damage to the archive.  洪水对档案造成了无法挽回的损害。

irredeemable.cn: 不可救药的，无法挽救的
irredeemable.example: The critic dismissed the film as irredeemable rubbish.  评论家把这部电影贬为无可救药的垃圾。

irremediable.cn: 无法补救的，不可挽回的
irremediable.example: By then the split in the party was irremediable.  到那时党内的分裂已无法补救。

irretrievable.cn: 不可挽回的，无法找回的
irretrievable.example: Deleting the file caused an irretrievable loss of data.  删除该文件导致数据无法找回。

unrecoverable.cn: 无法恢复的，不能收回的
unrecoverable.example: The engineers declared the crashed drive unrecoverable.  工程师宣布损坏的硬盘无法恢复。

unredeemable.cn: 不可救赎的，无法挽救的

memorable.example: The final match was memorable for its dramatic ending.  那场决赛因戏剧性的结局而令人难忘。

unforgettable.example: The view from the summit was simply unforgettable.  从峰顶看到的景色实在令人难忘。

compensation.example: Workers received compensation for the injuries they suffered.  工人们获得了所受伤害的赔偿。

recompense.example: She was given a small sum as recompense for her trouble.  她得到一小笔钱作为麻烦的补偿。

redress.example: Victims went to court to seek redress for their losses.  受害者诉诸法庭为损失寻求赔偿。

requital.example: She sent a gift in requital for their long hospitality.  她送去礼物以报答他们长久的款待。

pococurante.cn: 漠不关心的；漠不关心者

uninterested.cn: 不感兴趣的，漠不关心的

requisite.example: Patience is a requisite for anyone hoping to teach very young children.  耐心是任何想教幼儿的人必备的条件。

lesson.example: The failure taught him a lesson he would never forget.  这次失败给了他一个永生难忘的教训。

teach.example: She has taught chemistry at the local high school for years.  她在当地高中教化学已有多年。

slothful.example: Years of easy living had made the once-diligent clerk slothful.  多年安逸生活使这位曾经勤勉的职员变得懒散。

merciless.example: The merciless summer sun beat down on the empty streets.  无情的夏日阳光炙烤着空荡的街道。

pitiless.example: The pitiless judge showed no mercy to the young first offender.  那位冷酷无情的法官对年轻的初犯毫不留情。

firm.example: She remained firm despite enormous pressure from the board.  尽管董事会施加巨大压力，她依然坚定。

ineffable.example: The pianist played with an ineffable tenderness that silenced the hall.  钢琴家弹出难以言表的温柔，让全场安静。

indefinable.example: There was an indefinable sadness in the old man's voice.  老人的声音里有一种说不清的悲伤。

inexpressible.example: She felt an inexpressible relief when the letter finally arrived.  信终于来时，她感到难以言表的宽慰。

unspeakable.example: The refugees described unspeakable suffering during the long winter march.  难民们讲述了漫长冬季行军中难以言说的苦难。

unutterable.example: He stared at the ruins with unutterable dismay.  他带着无法言说的沮丧凝视着废墟。

inescapable.example: The evidence led to one inescapable conclusion about the fire.  证据指向关于这场火灾的唯一无法回避的结论。

inevasible.example: Death is the one inevasible fact that unites all living things.  死亡是联结一切生命的唯一无法回避的事实。

inevitable.example: Given the drought, a poor harvest was inevitable that year.  鉴于旱情，那年歉收在所难免。

unavoidable.example: Heavy fog made the cancellation of the flight unavoidable.  浓雾使航班取消无法避免。

avoidable.example: Most of these accidents were entirely avoidable with proper training.  只要培训得当，这些事故大多完全可以避免。

unfitted.example: His hot temper left him unfitted for diplomatic work.  他的急躁性格使他不适合外交工作。

capable.example: She is perfectly capable of running the department alone.  她完全有能力独自管理这个部门。

competent.example: The report was written by a competent but uninspired analyst.  报告出自一位称职却缺乏灵气的分析师。

passive.example: He stayed passive while others argued fiercely about the plan.  别人激烈争论方案时，他始终无所作为。

evitable.example: The engineer insisted the collapse had been entirely evitable.  工程师坚称这次倒塌本来完全可以避免。

notorious.example: The neighborhood was notorious for its late-night noise and crime.  这个街区因深夜噪音和犯罪而声名狼藉。

esteemed.example: The award honored an esteemed scholar of ancient languages.  该奖项表彰了一位受人敬重的古语言学者。

limitless.example: The internet offers seemingly limitless sources of information.  互联网提供看似无限的信息来源。

immeasurable.example: The war caused immeasurable damage to the country's cultural heritage.  战争对该国文化遗产造成了不可估量的损害。

finite.example: We must plan carefully because our budget is finite.  我们必须谨慎规划，因为预算是有限的。

unhappy.example: He was deeply unhappy during his first year abroad.  他在国外的第一年非常不开心。

malapropos.example: His malapropos comment about money embarrassed everyone at dinner.  他关于钱的不合时宜的评论让餐桌上所有人尴尬。

unfit.example: The old bridge was declared unfit for heavy traffic.  这座老桥被判定不适合重型车辆通行。

income.example: Their household income barely covers rent and groceries.  他们的家庭收入勉强够付房租和食品。

instill.example: Good coaches instill discipline in children without crushing their natural curiosity.  好教练向孩子灌输纪律，却不压抑他们天生的好奇心。

conciliator.example: The union asked a professional conciliator to join the talks.  工会请了一位专业调解人参与谈判。

intercessor.example: A respected elder served as intercessor between the two feuding families.  一位受人尊敬的长者充当了两个敌对家族之间的调停者。

disarming.example: His disarming honesty won over even the harshest critics.  他令人释然的坦诚甚至赢得了最严厉批评者的好感。

endearing.example: The puppy's clumsy walk was oddly endearing to everyone.  小狗笨拙的走姿让所有人莫名喜爱。

deferential.example: The young clerk was unfailingly deferential toward senior partners.  这位年轻职员对资深合伙人始终恭敬有礼。

insinuating.example: He asked about her salary in an insinuating whisper.  他用一种别有暗示的低语问起她的薪水。

elemental.example: The story explores elemental fears of darkness and loss.  这个故事探讨对黑暗与失去的原始恐惧。

inimical.example: Such heavy censorship is clearly inimical to free discussion among scholars.  如此严厉的审查显然有害于学者之间的自由讨论。

inimitable.example: The old pianist played the sonata with his own inimitable sense of rhythm.  这位老钢琴家以他独一无二的节奏感演奏了这首奏鸣曲。

incomparable.example: The soprano's voice was incomparable among singers of her generation.  这位女高音的嗓音在同代歌手中无与伦比。

matchless.example: The old craftsman carved wood with matchless precision.  这位老工匠雕刻木头的精准无人能及。

peerless.example: She remains a peerless interpreter of Chopin's nocturnes.  她仍是肖邦夜曲无人能及的演绎者。

unparalleled.example: The city enjoyed unparalleled prosperity during the trade boom.  贸易繁荣期间这座城市享有无可比拟的富足。

iniquity.example: The novel exposes the iniquity of a legal system that protects only the rich.  这部小说揭露了只保护富人的司法制度的不公。

corruption.example: Investigators uncovered widespread corruption in the licensing office.  调查人员揭露了发证部门的普遍腐败。

evil.example: The novel examines how ordinary people come to commit evil.  这部小说探讨普通人如何走向作恶。

unfairness.example: Students complained about the unfairness of the grading policy.  学生们抱怨评分政策不公平。

wickedness.example: The preacher warned his listeners against greed and wickedness.  牧师警告听众远离贪婪与邪恶。

integrity.example: Everyone respected the judge as a man of unshakable integrity and courage.  所有人都尊敬这位法官，视他为正直不屈且勇气可嘉的人。

inkling.example: We had no inkling of their engagement until the invitations finally arrived.  直到请帖终于寄到，我们才知道他们订婚的事。

cue.example: The actor waited offstage for his cue to enter.  演员在台侧等待上场的提示。

hint.example: She gave me a subtle hint about the surprise party.  她微妙地暗示了那个惊喜派对。

nontoxic.example: The paint is nontoxic and safe for children's rooms.  这种涂料无毒，适用于儿童房。

neutral.example: Switzerland stayed neutral throughout most of the twentieth century.  瑞士在二十世纪大部分时间保持中立。

damaging.example: The leaked memo proved damaging to the minister's career.  泄露的备忘录对部长的仕途造成损害。

invasive.example: Gardeners struggle to remove the invasive vine from fences.  园丁们努力清除篱笆上的入侵藤蔓。

provoking.example: His provoking silence made the argument even worse.  他那令人恼火的沉默使争论更糟。

curious.example: The children were curious about the strange machine in the yard.  孩子们对院子里那台奇怪的机器很好奇。

discerning.cn: 有洞察力的，眼光敏锐的

enroot.example: Years of practice enrooted the melody in his fingers.  多年练习使这段旋律深植于他的指间。

inculcate.example: Her parents inculcated a strong sense of duty in her.  父母在她心中反复灌输强烈的责任感。

sow.example: The rumor quietly sowed distrust among colleagues who had worked together for years.  这则谣言在共事多年的同事间悄悄播下了不信任。

remove.example: Workers removed the fallen tree from the road quickly.  工人迅速将倒下的树从路上清除。

create.example: The city created a fund to support local artists.  该市设立了一项基金支持本地艺术家。

found.example: Two students founded the company in a rented garage.  两名学生在租来的车库里创办了这家公司。

mutinous.example: The captain faced a mutinous crew after months at sea.  海上数月后，船长面对一群抗命的船员。

local.example: The festival celebrates local food and traditional music.  这个节庆展示当地食物与传统音乐。

parochial.example: His parochial outlook kept him from appreciating other cultures.  他狭隘的眼界使他无法欣赏其他文化。

regional.example: Regional dialects vary greatly across this mountainous province.  在这个多山的省份，各地方言差异很大。

insulate.example: Wealthy parents often try to insulate their children from everyday hardship.  富裕的父母常常试图让孩子隔绝日常的艰辛。

quarantine.example: Officials placed the entire flock under quarantine after the outbreak.  疫情爆发后，官员将整群家禽予以隔离。

seclude.example: The writer secluded himself in a cabin for the winter.  作家整个冬天把自己隔离在小屋里。

segregate.example: The law once segregated students by race in public schools.  法律曾在公立学校按种族隔离学生。

sequester.example: The judge decided to sequester the jury until a verdict was reached.  法官决定隔离陪审团直到作出裁决。

insurgent.example: Government troops captured three insurgents near the border.  政府军在边境附近抓获三名叛乱分子。

mutineer.example: The mutineers seized the ship and sailed toward distant islands.  叛变者夺取了船只，向远方的岛屿驶去。

imponderable.cn: 无法估量的，难以捉摸的
imponderable.example: Forecasters admitted several imponderable factors could change everything.  预测者承认几个难以估量的因素可能改变一切。

invisible.example: Radio waves are invisible yet carry sound across continents.  无线电波看不见，却把声音传过大洲。

entire.example: She read the entire manuscript in a single night.  她一夜之间读完了整部手稿。

full.example: He gave a full explanation of the accident to police.  他向警方对事故作了完整说明。

intact.example: Remarkably, the vase survived the earthquake completely intact.  令人惊讶的是，这只花瓶在地震中完好无损。

plenary.example: Delegates gathered for the plenary session on Friday morning.  代表们周五上午参加全体会议。

total.example: The renovation cost a total of two million dollars.  翻修总共花费两百万美元。

whole.example: He spent the whole afternoon organizing his notes.  他花了整个下午整理笔记。

conscience.example: His conscience troubled him long after the lie.  说谎之后很久，他的良心仍在折磨他。

honesty.example: Her honesty about the mistake earned everyone's respect.  她对错误的坦诚赢得了所有人的尊重。

incorruptibility.example: The old judge was famous throughout the province for his incorruptibility.  这位老法官以廉洁在全省闻名。

righteousness.example: He defended the poor with a quiet righteousness that impressed everyone.  他以一种沉静的正义感为穷人辩护，令所有人钦佩。

scrupulousness.example: Her scrupulousness about sources impressed the editors greatly.  她对资料来源的严谨令编辑们印象深刻。

completeness.example: The archivist verified the completeness of the donated collection.  档案员核实了这批捐赠藏品的完整性。

entireness.example: Restorers preserved the entireness of the ancient mosaic floor.  修复者保住了这片古代马赛克地面的完整。

perfection.example: The chef rehearsed the dish to perfection before opening night.  厨师在开业前把这道菜练到完美。

wholeness.example: Therapy helped her recover a feeling of wholeness.  治疗帮她重获一种完整感。

baseness.example: The play exposes the baseness hidden beneath polite manners.  这部剧揭露礼貌举止下隐藏的卑劣。

excessive.example: Doctors warned him about his excessive salt intake.  医生警告他盐摄入过量。

overindulgent.cn: 过分放纵的，过分溺爱的
overindulgent.example: Overindulgent grandparents spoiled the boy with endless gifts.  过分溺爱的祖父母用无尽的礼物宠坏了这男孩。

meled.example: The old ballad describes meled voices rising through the great hall.  这首古老民谣描写交融的众声在大厅中升起。

deepen.example: The scandal deepened public distrust of the government.  这起丑闻加深了公众对政府的不信任。

redouble.example: The team redoubled its efforts after the early setback.  早期挫折后，团队加倍努力。

entomb.example: Ash from the eruption entombed the entire village.  火山喷发的灰烬埋葬了整个村庄。

dig.example: They dug through frozen soil to reach the broken pipe.  他们挖穿冻土才到达破裂的管道。

exhume.example: Investigators exhumed the remains for further forensic testing.  调查人员掘出遗骸以做进一步法医检验。

buffer.example: A row of trees serves as a buffer against street noise.  一排树成了隔挡街道噪音的缓冲。

intermediate.example: The reaction produces an intermediate compound that quickly breaks down again.  这个反应产生一种很快又分解的中间化合物。

peacemaker.example: She often played peacemaker between her quarreling brothers.  她常在争吵的兄弟间充当和事佬。

flame-fanner.example: Every dispute attracted the same flame-fanner eager to worsen things.  每场争执都吸引同一个急于把事情搞糟的煽风点火者。

interdict.example: Naval patrols were sent to interdict arms shipments along the coast.  海军巡逻队被派去拦截沿海的军火运输。

forbid.example: School rules forbid students to leave campus during the lunch break.  校规禁止学生在午餐时间离开校园。

prohibit.example: The city prohibits overnight parking on this narrow street.  该市禁止在这条窄街上过夜停车。

proscribe.example: The new regime moved quickly to proscribe every opposition political party.  新政权迅速采取行动取缔所有反对党。

interim.example: The committee published an interim report while the investigation was still continuing.  委员会在调查仍在进行时发布了一份中期报告。

interruption.example: She worked for three hours without a single interruption.  她连续工作三小时未被打扰一次。

interval.example: Buses arrive at ten-minute intervals during rush hour.  高峰时段公交每隔十分钟一班。

interlude.example: The trip was a pleasant interlude in a very busy year.  这次旅行是忙碌一年中愉快的插曲。

parenthesis.example: The war was only a brief parenthesis in the peaceful history of the town.  那场战争只是这个小镇平静历史中一段短暂的间断。

acting.example: She served as acting mayor for six months.  她担任代理市长六个月。

provisional.example: The two sides signed a provisional agreement pending final legal review.  双方签署了一份临时协议，等待最终的法律审查。

continuity.example: The handover plan preserves continuity in patient care.  交接方案保证了病患护理的连续性。

interlock.example: The gears interlock so precisely that the machine runs almost without noise.  这些齿轮咬合得如此精确，机器运转几乎没有噪音。

interminable.example: After an interminable meeting, we still had not agreed on a budget.  经过一场没完没了的会议，我们仍未就预算达成一致。

completed.example: Only completed forms will be accepted after Friday.  周五之后只接受填写完整的表格。

occasional.example: He makes occasional visits to his hometown in autumn.  他秋天偶尔回故乡看看。

periodical.example: The airline carries out periodical inspections of every engine and wing.  该航空公司对每台发动机和机翼进行定期检查。

recurrent.example: Loneliness is a recurrent theme in her early poems.  孤独是她早期诗作中反复出现的主题。

recurring.example: He suffers from a recurring pain in his left knee.  他左膝反复疼痛。

interregnum.example: A brief interregnum followed the old king's death before his nephew arrived.  老国王去世后出现了一段短暂的政权空缺期，直到他侄子到来。

interrogate.example: Detectives spent six hours interrogating the suspect about the missing money.  侦探花了六个小时审问嫌疑人关于失踪钱款的事。

ask.example: The reporter asked the senator about the missing funds.  记者就失踪的资金询问参议员。

grill.example: Lawyers grilled the executive for nearly four hours.  律师们盘问这位高管近四小时。

inquire.example: She inquired politely about the train's departure time.  她礼貌地询问列车发车时间。

milk.example: Reporters tried to milk the official for details he was not allowed to share.  记者试图从这位官员那里榨取他无权透露的细节。

question.example: Police questioned three men about the late-night break-in.  警方就深夜入室盗窃询问了三名男子。

answer.example: He answered every question without hesitation or notes.  他毫不犹豫、不看笔记地回答了每个问题。

reply.example: She replied to my message within a few minutes.  她几分钟内就回复了我的消息。

respond.example: The company responded quickly to customer complaints online.  公司迅速回应了网上的客户投诉。

confidential.example: These medical records are strictly confidential and cannot be shared.  这些病历严格保密，不得外传。

connote.example: For many readers the word cheap connotes poor quality.  对许多读者来说 cheap 一词隐含质量差的意味。

intoxicant.example: Wine was the only intoxicant served at the wedding banquet.  婚宴上供应的唯一致醉饮品是葡萄酒。

alcohol.example: He gave up alcohol after his doctor's stern warning.  医生严厉警告后他戒了酒。

liquor.example: The store cannot sell liquor before noon on Sundays.  这家店周日中午前不得售卖烈酒。

stimulant.example: Coffee acts as a stimulant for most healthy adults.  对大多数健康成年人来说咖啡起兴奋剂作用。

refresher.example: Iced tea made a welcome refresher after the long hike.  长途徒步后冰茶成了令人愉快的提神饮料。

brave.example: It was brave of her to speak against the new policy.  她敢于反对新政策，很勇敢。

conspiracy.example: Two officials were charged with conspiracy to hide the evidence.  两名官员被控共谋隐藏证据。

design.example: He denied having any design against his former partner.  他否认对前合伙人有任何图谋。

machination.example: Careful readers can trace the machinations that brought down the old regime.  细心的读者能追溯到使旧政权垮台的种种诡计。

scheme.example: They devised a scheme to avoid paying any taxes.  他们设计了一个逃税的计谋。

pall.example: The novelty of city life began to pall after his first lonely winter.  在孤独的第一个冬天过后，城市生活的新鲜感开始让他生厌。

intuitive.example: Good nurses often have an intuitive sense of when a patient is worsening.  优秀的护士常常凭直觉感知病人何时病情恶化。

instinctive.example: Her instinctive distrust of the offer proved entirely correct.  她对这份提议本能的不信任完全正确。

acquired.example: Fluency in Latin is entirely an acquired skill.  拉丁语流利完全是后天习得的技能。

inundate.example: Readers inundated the newspaper with letters after the controversial editorial appeared.  那篇有争议的社论刊出后，读者的来信淹没了报社。

avalanche.example: The announcement triggered an avalanche of angry emails.  这则公告引发了如雪崩般的愤怒邮件。

drown.example: Loud applause drowned out the speaker's closing words completely.  响亮的掌声完全淹没了演讲者的结束语。

engulf.example: Fire quickly engulfed the abandoned warehouse by the river.  大火迅速吞没了河边的废弃仓库。

overwhelm.example: That spring the whole valley was overwhelmed by floods from melting snow.  那年春天，整个山谷被融雪形成的洪水淹没。

submerge.example: The new dam will submerge the whole valley and three old villages.  新水坝将淹没整个山谷和三个古村。

inure.example: Years at sea had inured the fishermen to cold, wet, and hunger.  多年的海上生活使渔民们习惯了寒冷、潮湿和饥饿。

accustom.example: He had to accustom himself to the cold Boston winters very quickly.  他必须很快让自己习惯波士顿寒冷的冬天。

familiarize.example: New staff must familiarize themselves with safety procedures.  新员工必须熟悉安全流程。

invective.example: The politician's invective attacks on his rival shocked even his own supporters.  这位政客对对手的侮辱性攻击甚至震惊了他自己的支持者。

abusive.example: The referee ejected the player for abusive language.  裁判因辱骂性言语将该球员罚出场。

scurrile.example: Critics attacked the pamphlet for its scurrile tone.  批评者攻击这本小册子语调粗俗下流。

scurrilous.example: The pamphlet contained scurrilous attacks on every member of the council.  那本小册子对议会每位成员都有下流的攻击。

vitriolic.example: The review was so vitriolic that the author stopped writing.  那篇评论如此刻薄，作者因此停笔。

object.example: Several neighbors objected to the new parking rules.  几位邻居反对新的停车规定。

remonstrate.example: She remonstrated with the driver about his reckless speed.  她就司机的危险车速向他抗议。

repine.example: Rather than repine at his losses, he quietly started the business again.  他没有抱怨自己的损失，而是默默重新开始了生意。

inveigle.example: She inveigled her brother into lending her the car for the whole weekend.  她哄骗哥哥把车借给她用整个周末。

inventory.example: The report offers a valuable inventory of everything known about this virus.  这份报告对目前关于这种病毒的全部认识做了有价值的清点。

outline.example: He sketched an outline of the project in ten minutes.  他十分钟内勾出了项目的大纲。

résumé.example: She updated her résumé before applying for the position.  她申请该职位前更新了简历。

summarization.example: The report ends with a brief summarization of the findings.  报告以对研究发现的简短概括结尾。

inveterate.example: An inveterate gambler, he lost the family savings within a single year.  他是个积习难改的赌徒，一年之内就输光了家中积蓄。

entrenched.example: Corruption was entrenched at every level of the ministry.  腐败在该部门各个层级根深蒂固。

rooted.example: Her fear of water was rooted in a childhood accident.  她对水的恐惧源于童年一次事故。

settled.example: After years of moving they finally led a settled life.  多年漂泊后他们终于过上安定的生活。

hard-cored.example: Only hard-cored fans stayed until the very last song.  只有死忠粉丝留到最后一首歌。

invidious.example: Ranking the students publicly created invidious comparisons that poisoned the whole class.  公开给学生排名制造了招人反感的比较，毒害了整个班级。

abhorrent.example: The practice is abhorrent to anyone with basic decency.  这种做法令任何有基本良知的人厌恶。

obnoxious.example: His obnoxious jokes ruined the whole dinner party.  他讨人厌的玩笑毁了整场晚宴。

odious.example: Comparing the two writers seems both odious and pointless.  比较这两位作家显得可憎又无意义。

envious.example: He was openly envious of his cousin's new car.  他公开嫉妒表弟的新车。

jaundiced.example: Years of disappointment gave him a jaundiced view of politics.  多年失望让他对政治抱有偏见。

jealous.example: She grew jealous when he praised another student's essay.  他称赞另一名学生的文章时，她心生嫉妒。

green-eyed.example: He became green-eyed the moment his friend won the prize.  朋友获奖那一刻他就妒火中烧。

gratifying.cn: 令人满意的，令人欣慰的
gratifying.example: It was gratifying to see her hard work finally rewarded.  看到她的努力终获回报令人欣慰。

invincible.example: For a decade the team seemed invincible on its own home court.  十年间，这支球队在自己的主场上似乎不可战胜。

unbeatable.cn: 无法击败的，无可匹敌的
unbeatable.example: The champion looked unbeatable throughout the entire tournament.  整个锦标赛中冠军看来无人能敌。

unconquerable.example: Her unconquerable will carried her through the long illness.  她不可征服的意志支撑她度过长期病痛。

conquerable.example: The general believed the fortress was conquerable within a week.  将军相信这座要塞一周内可以攻下。

aggravated.example: He sounded aggravated when the call was cut off again.  电话再次中断时他听起来很恼火。

exasperated.example: The exasperated teacher repeated the instruction a fourth time.  恼火的老师第四次重复了指令。

wrathful.example: The poem describes a wrathful sea swallowing the entire fleet.  这首诗描写愤怒的大海吞没了整支舰队。

iridescent.example: Sunlight made the butterfly's iridescent wings flash green, blue, and gold.  阳光让蝴蝶五颜六色的翅膀闪出绿色、蓝色和金色。

nacreous.example: The shell's nacreous interior glowed softly in the lamplight.  贝壳珠光的内壁在灯下柔柔发亮。

opalescent.example: Dawn turned the lake water a soft opalescent blue.  黎明把湖水映成柔和的乳光蓝。

pearlescent.example: The car's pearlescent paint changed color with the light.  这辆车的珠光漆随光线变色。

monochromatic.example: The designer chose a monochromatic scheme of soft grays.  设计师选了柔灰的单色方案。

fret.example: She frets constantly about her children's safety at school.  她不停为孩子在校的安全担忧。

ironclad.example: The lawyers drafted an ironclad contract that left no room for dispute.  律师起草了一份无懈可击的合同，没有留下争议的空间。

secure.example: Make sure the ladder is secure before you start climbing.  开始攀爬前确保梯子牢固。

irradicable.example: Poverty left an irradicable mark on the way he viewed money.  贫穷在他看待金钱的方式上留下了无法根除的印记。

ineradicable.example: Prejudice proved ineradicable despite decades of public education.  尽管数十年公众教育，偏见仍难以根除。

eradicable.example: Smallpox proved eradicable once global vaccination programs began.  一旦全球疫苗接种计划启动，天花被证明是可根除的。

itinerant.example: An itinerant preacher traveled from village to village on an old bicycle.  一位巡回布道者骑着旧自行车在各村庄之间往来。

ambulant.example: The clinic treats ambulant patients who do not need a bed.  这家诊所治疗无需住院的能走动病人。

nomadic.example: Her nomadic childhood took her through eleven countries.  她流浪的童年带她走过十一个国家。

peripatetic.example: The peripatetic photographer rarely slept in the same city twice.  这位四处游历的摄影师很少在同一座城市住两次。

roaming.example: Roaming bands of musicians played in every square that summer.  那年夏天，漫游的乐队在每个广场演奏。

water.example: He waters the vegetable beds every morning before sunrise.  他每天日出前给菜地浇水。

nut.example: Funding the repairs is a hard nut to crack.  筹措维修资金是个难解决的问题。

problem.example: The committee spent an hour defining the problem before proposing answers.  委员会花了一小时界定问题，然后才提出方案。

emit.example: The old boiler emits a low hum whenever it starts.  这台旧锅炉每次启动都会发出低沉的嗡嗡声。

vent.example: She vented her frustration in a long letter she never mailed.  她在一封从未寄出的长信里发泄了挫败感。

speak slowly.example: Please speak slowly so the translator can keep up.  请说慢一点，好让译员跟上。

bored.example: The students looked bored until the experiment began to bubble.  学生们一直显得无聊，直到实验开始冒泡。

tired.example: By midnight everyone was too tired to argue further.  到午夜时，所有人都累得无法再争论。

wearied.example: Wearied by months of travel, he sold the van and flew home.  被数月旅行累垮后，他卖掉面包车飞回家。

fed up.example: Residents are fed up with the noise from the construction site.  居民们已经受够了工地的噪音。

absorbed.example: He was so absorbed in the puzzle that he missed dinner.  他太专注于那道谜题，错过了晚饭。

engrossed.example: The children sat engrossed in the storyteller's every word.  孩子们入迷地听着讲故事人的每一个字。

intrigued.example: Investors were intrigued by the startup's unusual pricing model.  投资者对这家初创公司奇特的定价模式很感兴趣。

jive.example: Quit jiving and tell me what actually happened last night.  别开玩笑了，告诉我昨晚到底发生了什么。

jolly.example: The jolly innkeeper kept refilling everyone's glass and telling old stories.  这位欢快的店主不停给每人续杯，还讲着旧日的故事。

josh.example: They joshed him about his terrible haircut all week.  他们整周都拿他糟糕的发型开玩笑。

jargon.example: The report was buried in technical jargon that ordinary readers could not follow.  这份报告埋没在普通读者无法理解的专业术语里。

argot.example: The novel is thick with the argot of dockworkers.  这部小说充满码头工人的行话。

cant.example: His speech was pure cant dressed up as principle.  他的演讲不过是伪装成原则的套话。

dialect.example: Her grandmother still speaks a dialect few young people understand.  她祖母仍说着一种少有年轻人懂的方言。

lingo.example: I could not follow the lawyers' lingo at all.  我完全跟不上律师们的行话。

patois.example: The fishermen bargained in a patois blending French and English.  渔民们用混合法语和英语的土话讨价还价。

jarring.example: A jarring noise from the construction site woke the whole neighborhood early.  工地传来的刺耳噪音很早就吵醒了整个街区。

strident.example: Her strident voice cut through the noise of the crowded hall.  她刺耳的嗓音穿透拥挤大厅里的喧闹。

jaundice.example: Long unemployment had filled him with jaundice toward everyone still working.  长期失业使他对所有还有工作的人心生偏见。

jaunty.example: He walked into the office with a jaunty step and a broad smile.  他步伐轻快、笑容满面地走进了办公室。

perky.example: She sounded surprisingly perky for six in the morning.  早上六点，她听起来却出奇地精神。

racy.example: Her racy narrative style keeps readers turning pages late into the night.  她生动活泼的叙述风格让读者深夜还在翻页。

languishing.example: The languishing plants revived after a week of rain.  那些萎靡的植物在一周雨后复活了。

spiritless.cn: 无精打采的，没有生气的
spiritless.example: The team gave a spiritless performance in the second half.  球队在下半场表现得毫无生气。

jejune.example: Critics dismissed the sequel as jejune and repetitive.  评论家认为这部续集乏味且重复。

arid.example: The professor's arid lecture emptied half the seats before the break.  这位教授枯燥乏味的讲座在课间前就空了一半座位。

weary.example: The weary meetings dragged on with no decision in sight.  这些令人厌倦的会议一拖再拖，看不到任何决定。

interesting.example: She raised an interesting objection nobody had anticipated.  她提出了一个无人预料到的有趣反对意见。

involving.cn: 引人入胜的，扣人心弦的
involving.example: The documentary is more involving than any thriller this year.  这部纪录片比今年任何惊悚片都更扣人心弦。

thoughtprovoking.example: Her thoughtprovoking talk kept the audience arguing for hours.  她引人深思的演讲让观众争论了数小时。

discard.example: He discarded the draft and started the chapter over.  他丢掉草稿，重写了这一章。

scrap.example: Managers decided to scrap the whole plan and start again from scratch.  管理层决定废弃整个计划，从头再来。

shed.example: The company shed three divisions to survive the downturn.  公司剥离了三个部门以度过衰退。

slough.example: The snake sloughs its skin several times a year.  这种蛇一年脱皮数次。

throw away.example: Do not throw away the receipt; you may need it.  别扔掉收据，你可能会用到。

jeopardy.example: Cutting the safety inspections would put thousands of lives in serious jeopardy.  削减安全检查会使数千人的生命处于严重危险之中。

endangerment.example: He was charged with reckless endangerment after the crash.  车祸后他被控危害公共安全。

imperilment.example: The report blamed the imperilment of the crew on poor training.  报告将船员陷入危险归因于训练不足。

safeness.example: Parents questioned the safeness of the playground equipment.  家长质疑游乐设施的安全性。

safety.example: Workers must wear helmets for their own safety.  工人必须戴头盔以保障自身安全。

secureness.example: Engineers tested the secureness of every bolt on the bridge.  工程师检测了桥上每颗螺栓的牢固程度。

security.example: The new fence gave the family a real sense of security.  新围栏给这家人带来真正的安全感。

butt.example: For years he was the butt of every joke in the office.  多年来他是办公室里所有笑话的对象。

derision.example: His proposal met with open derision from the board.  他的提议遭到董事会公开嘲笑。

solemn utterance.example: The ceremony closed with a solemn utterance of the oath.  仪式以庄严宣读誓词结束。

chauvinist.cn: 沙文主义者，盲目爱国者
chauvinist.example: The editorial called him a chauvinist unwilling to hear other views.  社论称他是不愿听取他人意见的沙文主义者。

nationalist.cn: 民族主义者，国家主义者
nationalist.example: The nationalist won the election by promising closed borders.  这位民族主义者以承诺封闭边境赢得选举。

superpatriot.example: Every talk show featured some superpatriot demanding war.  每个访谈节目都有极端爱国者要求开战。

war hawk.example: The senator built his career as an unapologetic war hawk.  这位参议员以毫不掩饰的鹰派立场建立起自己的事业。

dove.example: The cabinet split between hawks and doves over the treaty.  内阁就该条约分裂为鹰派与鸽派。

peacenik.example: A few peaceniks camped outside the base for months.  几名反战人士在基地外露营数月。

jitters.example: She had a bad case of the jitters before her first public performance.  首次公开演出前，她非常紧张不安。

butterflies.example: She had butterflies in her stomach before the audition.  试镜前她心里一阵发慌。

dither.example: He was in a dither about which offer to accept.  他为该接受哪份工作邀约而慌乱不安。

jimjams.example: Waiting for the results gave him the jimjams.  等结果让他紧张不安。

nerves.example: Nerves got the better of her during the opening speech.  开场演讲时紧张情绪占了上风。

shakes.example: By the third cup of coffee he had the shakes.  喝到第三杯咖啡时他浑身发抖。

shivers.example: The howling wind sent shivers down my spine.  呼啸的风让我脊背发凉。

willies.example: That empty hallway always gives me the willies.  那条空走廊总让我心里发毛。

imperturbability.example: She handled the interrogation with complete imperturbability.  她以完全的镇定应对了审问。

self-possession.example: The young pianist showed unusual self-possession on stage.  这位年轻钢琴家在台上表现出罕见的沉着。

blithesome.example: A blithesome tune drifted out of the open window.  一支欢快的曲调从敞开的窗户飘出。

festive.example: The whole street took on a festive air by evening.  到傍晚整条街都染上了节日气息。

mirthful.example: His mirthful laugh carried across the courtyard and made everyone smile.  他欢快的笑声传遍庭院，让所有人都笑了。

lachrymose.example: The film's lachrymose ending left half the theater reaching for tissues.  这部电影催人泪下的结尾让半个影院的人去找纸巾。

jog.example: An old photograph finally jogged his memory of that distant summer.  一张旧照片终于唤起了他对那个遥远夏天的记忆。

remind.example: Please remind me to call the dentist tomorrow.  请提醒我明天给牙医打电话。

jolt.example: News of the factory closing jolted the entire town into sudden panic.  工厂关闭的消息震惊了整个镇子，使其陷入突然的恐慌。

floor.example: The unexpected verdict floored everyone sitting in the crowded courtroom.  意外的判决震住了坐在拥挤法庭里的所有人。

shake up.example: The merger will shake up the entire publishing industry.  这次合并将震动整个出版业。

jot.example: Let me jot down your number before I forget it completely.  让我在彻底忘掉之前把你的号码草草记下来。

log.example: Nurses log every dose in the patient's chart.  护士把每次用药都记录在病历上。

mark.example: She marked the passage with a thin pencil line.  她用细铅笔线标记了那段文字。

put down.example: He put down the address before he forgot it.  他趁没忘先记下了地址。

register.example: You must register your bicycle with the city office.  你必须在市政办公室登记自行车。

report.example: The team reported its findings in a twelve-page memo.  团队用十二页备忘录报告了调查结果。

set down.example: The founders set down the rules in a single page.  创始人把规则写在了一页纸上。

exulting.example: Exulting fans poured onto the field after the whistle.  哨声后狂喜的球迷涌入场地。

glorying.example: The glorying crew waved flags from the deck.  欢欣的船员在甲板上挥舞旗帜。

rejoicing.example: A rejoicing crowd filled the square until dawn.  欢欣的人群直到黎明还挤满广场。

triumphant.example: She made a triumphant return to the stage after surgery.  手术后她胜利地重返舞台。

intelligent.example: Selling the old plant was an intelligent decision.  卖掉旧厂是个明智的决定。

judgmatic.example: His judgmatic reply calmed both sides of the dispute.  他有判断力的回答平息了争端双方。

inexpedient.example: Raising the issue now would be inexpedient and might delay the vote.  现在提出这个问题并不明智，还可能拖延表决。

indiscreet.example: One indiscreet email to a colleague cost him the promotion.  一封写给同事的轻率邮件让他失去了升职机会。

juggernaut.example: Industrialization became an unstoppable juggernaut that reshaped every corner of society.  工业化成了一股不可阻挡的巨大力量，重塑了社会的每个角落。

steamroller.example: The majority steamrollered the bill through in one night.  多数派一夜之间强行通过了议案。

ken.example: Advanced quantum mechanics lies well beyond the ken of most undergraduates.  高等量子力学远远超出大多数本科生的理解范围。

sight.example: The ship stayed in sight until fog closed in.  那艘船一直在视野内，直到大雾合围。

kidnap.example: Armed men tried to kidnap the businessman's son for a huge ransom.  武装人员企图绑架这位商人的儿子以索取巨额赎金。

abduct.example: Two men tried to abduct the businessman outside his office.  两名男子试图在办公室外绑架这位商人。

set free.example: The court ordered the prisoner set free after new evidence.  新证据出现后法院下令释放该囚犯。

enkindle.example: One good teacher can enkindle a lifelong curiosity.  一位好老师能点燃终身的好奇心。

torch.example: Vandals torched two abandoned cars in the lot behind the warehouse.  破坏者烧毁了仓库后停车场里两辆废弃的汽车。

frictionless.example: The two departments enjoy a frictionless working relationship.  两个部门保持着顺畅融洽的工作关系。

uncongenial.example: He found the damp coastal climate thoroughly uncongenial and moved inland.  他觉得潮湿的海滨气候极不宜人，于是搬到了内陆。

device.example: Flashbacks are a device she uses in every novel.  倒叙是她每部小说都用的手法。

gambit.example: His opening gambit was to praise his rival's work.  他的开场策略是赞扬对手的作品。

ploy.example: The free samples were simply a clever marketing ploy.  免费样品只是一个巧妙的营销手段。

sleight.example: The accountant hid the losses by sheer sleight of hand.  这位会计仅靠巧妙手法掩盖了亏损。

stratagem.example: The general won the pass by a simple stratagem.  将军用一个简单的谋略夺取了关隘。

foolishness.example: Lending him the car again was sheer foolishness.  再把车借给他实在是愚蠢。

kilter.example: The old washing machine has been out of kilter since the move.  搬家之后这台旧洗衣机就一直不正常。

keeping.example: The extension is in keeping with the old facade.  这处扩建与旧立面协调一致。

knit.example: The new festival helped knit two divided communities closely together again.  这个新节庆帮助把两个分裂的社区重新紧密联结起来。

bond.example: The glue bonds metal to glass in seconds.  这种胶数秒内就能把金属与玻璃黏合。

fasten.example: Please fasten your seatbelt before the plane begins to taxi.  飞机开始滑行前请系好安全带。

disassociate.example: The party moved to disassociate itself from the remarks.  该党着手与那些言论划清界限。

laurels.example: After one prize he rested on his laurels for a decade.  拿过一个奖后他十年都满足于既有荣誉。

belittlement.example: Years of constant belittlement had slowly eroded her confidence at work.  多年不断的贬低慢慢侵蚀了她在工作中的自信。

denigration.example: His campaign relied on the denigration of every opponent.  他的竞选依赖于诋毁每一个对手。

deprecation.example: Her humor is built on gentle self-deprecation rather than cruelty.  她的幽默建立在温和的自我贬低而非刻薄之上。

derogation.example: The review was a needless derogation of a fine book.  这篇评论是对一本好书不必要的贬损。

diminishment.example: Members resented the diminishment of their voting power.  成员们不满其投票权被削弱。

disparagement.example: He sued the paper over its disparagement of his research.  他因该报贬低其研究而起诉。

labile.example: The patient's labile mood shifted from cheerful to tearful within minutes.  这位病人易变的情绪几分钟内就从愉快转为流泪。

inconstant.example: The inconstant wind made sailing across the bay nearly impossible.  变化不定的风让横渡海湾几乎无法进行。

stationary.example: Traffic on the bridge stayed stationary for almost two hours.  桥上的车流几乎两小时一动不动。

occupied.example: She was occupied with the report all afternoon.  她整个下午都忙于那份报告。

difficult.example: The final section of the trail is genuinely difficult.  这条小径的最后一段确实艰难。

labored.example: His labored breathing worried the paramedics on the way to hospital.  他费力的呼吸让送医途中的急救人员很担忧。

lacerate.example: His careless remarks lacerated her feelings more deeply than he realized.  他随口的话比他意识到的更深地伤害了她的感情。

afflict.example: Drought has afflicted the region for three straight years.  干旱已连续三年折磨这个地区。

rend.example: The angry protester tried to rend the banner into two ragged halves.  那名愤怒的抗议者试图把横幅撕成破烂的两半。

wound.example: His careless joke wounded her more than he realized.  他随口的玩笑对她的伤害超出他的想象。

flat.example: The paint dried to a flat, lifeless gray.  油漆干成了一种无光而死板的灰色。

lusterless.example: The old coins were lusterless but perfectly preserved.  这些旧硬币虽无光泽却保存完好。

shiny.example: He polished the table until it was shiny.  他把桌子擦得闪亮。

sleek.example: She drove a sleek silver car that turned heads on every street.  她开着一辆线条优美的银色轿车，一路引人注目。

apothegmatic.example: His apothegmatic prose fits neatly on a postcard.  他格言式的文字正好能写满一张明信片。

telegraphic.example: She sent a telegraphic note: arriving Tuesday, bring keys.  她发来一条电报式的短信：周二到，带钥匙。

wordy.example: The editor cut the wordy opening by half.  编辑把啰嗦的开头删掉一半。

lamentable.example: The condition of the old school building is truly lamentable.  这所旧校舍的状况实在令人惋惜。

lugubrious.example: He wore a lugubrious expression whenever anyone mentioned his ruined garden.  每次有人提到他毁掉的花园，他就露出夸张悲哀的表情。

mournful.example: A mournful melody drifted from the church as the procession passed by.  送葬队伍经过时，教堂里飘出一段悲伤的旋律。

tearful.example: They said a tearful goodbye at the station gate.  他们在车站门口含泪告别。

teary.example: She grew teary at the mention of her old dog.  提到她的老狗时她泪汪汪的。

weepy.example: I get weepy every time that song plays.  每次那首歌响起我就想哭。

cheerful.example: He stayed cheerful even after the long delay.  即使长时间延误后他仍保持愉快。

slam.example: Critics slammed the film for its careless plotting.  评论家因情节草率而猛烈批评这部电影。

moan.example: They moaned about the heat for the entire drive.  整段车程他们都在抱怨炎热。

libelous.example: The newspaper apologized after printing a libelous accusation against the mayor.  报社在刊登了对市长诽谤性的指控后道了歉。

backbiting.example: Constant backbiting slowly poisoned the atmosphere in the whole department.  不断的背后诽谤慢慢毒害了整个部门的气氛。

calumnious.example: He denied the calumnious claims in a public letter.  他在一封公开信中否认了那些诽谤性说法。

defamatory.example: The court ruled that the anonymous blog post was defamatory.  法院裁定那篇匿名博文构成诽谤。

detractive.example: Her detractive comments about the design surprised us.  她对设计的贬损评论让我们意外。

scandalous.example: Critics called the project a scandalous waste of public money.  批评者称这个项目是对公共资金令人反感的浪费。

slanderous.example: He was fired for spreading slanderous gossip about his own manager.  他因散布造谣中伤上司的闲话而被解雇。

traducing.example: Traducing pamphlets circulated through the city days before the vote.  投票前几天，中伤性的小册子在全城流传。

vilifying.example: The vilifying editorial cost the paper many readers.  那篇诽谤性社论让报纸失去许多读者。

applauding.example: She bowed twice to the applauding audience before leaving the stage.  她向鼓掌的观众鞠了两次躬才离开舞台。

commendatory.example: His file contains three commendatory letters from clients.  他的档案里有三封客户的表扬信。

eulogizing.example: The eulogizing preface praised the author for ten pages.  那篇颂扬式序言用十页篇幅赞美作者。

laudatory.example: The novel received laudatory reviews from critics who rarely praise debut authors.  这部小说获得了盛赞，而这些评论家很少称赞新人作家。

praising.example: The coach sent a short praising note to each player.  教练给每位球员发了一条简短的赞扬留言。

lampoon.example: His savage political lampoon appeared on the front page of the weekly.  他犀利的政治讽刺作品登上了这份周刊的头版。

enfeebled.example: Enfeebled by fever, he could barely sit up.  因发烧而虚弱，他几乎坐不起来。

languor.example: The heavy heat brought a languor that made work nearly impossible.  酷热带来一种倦怠，几乎使人无法工作。

frazzle.example: Three night shifts wore her to a frazzle.  三个夜班让她累得精疲力竭。

stupor.example: He fell into a stupor and did not respond to our questions.  他陷入麻木状态，对我们的问题毫无反应。

prostration.example: Two hikers were treated for heat prostration at the trailhead.  两名徒步者在步道口接受了中暑虚脱的治疗。

debilitation.example: The disease causes slow debilitation of the muscles.  这种疾病导致肌肉缓慢衰弱。

enervation.example: Humid August afternoons brought a familiar enervation that no coffee cured.  八月潮湿的午后带来熟悉的虚弱无力感，喝咖啡也无济于事。

enfeeblement.example: Historians debate the causes of the empire's enfeeblement.  史学家争论这个帝国衰弱的原因。

fragility.example: The crisis exposed the fragility of the banking system.  这场危机暴露了银行体系的脆弱。

infirmity.example: Despite growing infirmity, she kept teaching until eighty.  尽管日渐体弱，她一直教到八十岁。

verve.example: The young pianist played that difficult passage with remarkable verve.  这位年轻钢琴家以非凡的热情演奏了那段高难度乐章。

vim.example: At seventy he still worked with surprising vim and good humor.  七十岁的他干活仍精力惊人，心情愉快。

animation.example: She described the trip with unusual animation and plenty of gestures.  她异常兴致勃勃地描述了那次旅行，还比划了许多手势。

vitality.example: The old market still brims with vitality on early summer mornings.  夏日清晨，这座老市场依然充满活力。

robustness.example: Engineers praised the robustness of the old bridge.  工程师赞赏这座旧桥的稳固。

strength.example: It took him months to regain his strength.  他花了几个月才恢复体力。

vivacity.example: Her vivacity lit up an otherwise dull dinner.  她的活泼点亮了原本乏味的晚宴。

emaciated.phrase_cn: 一只瘦骨嶙峋的流浪狗
emaciated.example: The rescued horses were painfully emaciated but still alive.  被救的马匹瘦得让人心痛，但还活着。

lean.example: Years of running left him lean and quick.  多年跑步让他精瘦而敏捷。

slender.example: She held the flower by its slender stem.  她捏着那朵花细长的茎。

svelte.example: Her svelte silhouette drew admiring glances across the crowded ballroom.  她苗条优雅的身影在拥挤的舞厅里引来赞赏的目光。

fat.example: The fat cat refused to move off the warm step.  那只肥猫拒绝离开温暖的台阶。

fleshy.example: He had a broad, fleshy face and kind eyes.  他有一张宽阔多肉的脸和一双慈祥的眼睛。

gross.example: The caricature gave the mayor a gross, swollen belly.  那幅漫画给市长画了个臃肿肥大的肚子。

obese.example: The clinic treats children who are clinically obese.  这家诊所治疗临床肥胖的儿童。

tense.example: His tense jaw showed how hard he was concentrating.  他紧绷的下颌显示出他多么专注。

miscue.example: A single miscue in the relay cost them the medal.  接力中的一次失误让他们丢了奖牌。

largesse.example: The museum was built entirely through the largesse of one wealthy family.  这座博物馆完全是靠一个富有家族的慷慨捐赠建成的。

bountifulness.example: Neighbors still speak of her bountifulness at holidays.  邻居们仍谈起她节日里的慷慨。

munificence.example: The library exists thanks to one man's munificence.  这座图书馆的存在全靠一个人的慷慨。

openhandedness.example: His openhandedness toward struggling students was legendary in the department.  他对困难学生的慷慨在系里是出了名的。

philanthropy.example: She turned to philanthropy after selling the company.  卖掉公司后她转向慈善事业。

miserliness.example: His miserliness left the heirs a fortune and no memories.  他的吝啬留给继承人一笔财富却没有回忆。

parsimony.example: Decades of parsimony left the museum without a roof fund.  数十年的过度节俭让博物馆没有修屋顶的钱。

penury.example: The once wealthy family ended its days in complete penury.  这个曾经富裕的家庭最终在彻底的贫困中度日。

stinginess.example: The waiter complained loudly about the large party's shocking stinginess.  服务员大声抱怨那桌大客人惊人的吝啬。

lash.example: Heavy rain lashed the windows all night and kept the children awake.  大雨整夜猛打窗户，让孩子们无法入睡。

lace.example: The boxer laced into his rival in the final round.  拳手在最后一轮猛击对手。

punch.example: He punched the wall and broke two knuckles.  他猛击墙壁，弄断了两根指骨。

inoperative.example: The old safety clause in the contract is now inoperative.  合同里那条旧的安全条款现已失效。

latitude.example: Students are allowed considerable latitude in choosing their own elective courses.  学生在选择选修课时被给予相当大的自由度。

freedom.example: Staff enjoy real freedom in setting their own hours.  员工在安排工作时间上有真正的自由。

leeway.example: The new contract gives designers plenty of leeway on materials.  新合同在材料方面给设计师留了很大余地。

free hand.example: The board gave her a free hand to rebuild the team.  董事会授予她全权重建团队。

limitation.example: Budget limitations forced the crew to shoot indoors.  预算限制迫使剧组在室内拍摄。

derogatory.example: He apologized for the derogatory term he used.  他为使用那个贬损词语道歉。

depreciatory.example: She spoke of her own paintings in depreciatory terms.  她用自贬的措辞谈论自己的画。

disparaging.example: Disparaging remarks about volunteers upset the staff.  贬低志愿者的言论让员工不满。

pejorative.example: Critics used the word in a purely pejorative sense.  评论家用这个词纯粹是取其贬义。

profuse.example: He offered profuse apologies for arriving so late.  他为迟到再三道歉。

riotous.example: The garden was a riotous mass of summer flowers.  花园里夏花繁茂缤纷。

blow.example: He will blow his entire bonus on a week in Tokyo.  他会把整笔奖金挥霍在东京的一周上。

fritter.example: She frittered away the whole grant on minor equipment.  她把整笔资助挥霍在零碎设备上。

misspend.example: The audit showed the agency had misspent millions.  审计显示该机构浪费了数百万。

leaven.example: A few good jokes leavened an otherwise dry lecture on tax law.  几个好笑话让一场本来枯燥的税法讲座变得生动。

inoculate.example: Every child here is inoculated before starting school.  这里每个孩子入学前都接种疫苗。

leer.example: He leered at the stranger across the bar until she walked away.  他色迷迷地盯着酒吧对面的陌生人，直到她走开。
leer.cn: 色迷迷地看，淫邪地注视

squint.example: He squinted at the tiny print on the label.  他眯着眼看标签上的小字。

gape.cn: 目瞪口呆地看，张口凝视
gape.example: Tourists gaped at the collapsed tower for hours.  游客们盯着倒塌的塔看了好几个小时。

glare.example: She glared at him until he put the phone away.  她怒视着他，直到他收起手机。

leery.example: Having been cheated once, she remains leery of every online seller.  被骗过一次后，她对每个网上卖家都存有戒心。

distrustful.example: Voters remain distrustful of every promise made.  选民对所做的每个承诺仍不信任。

suspicious.example: The guard grew suspicious of the unmarked van.  保安对那辆无标识的货车起了疑心。

legacy.example: The reformer left a lasting legacy of free schools across the province.  这位改革者在全省留下了免费学校这一长久的遗产。

bequest.example: The hospital wing was funded by a single bequest.  这栋医院侧楼由一笔遗赠资助建成。

heritage.example: The old town is protected as world heritage.  这座古城作为世界遗产受到保护。

patrimony.example: He sold the last of his patrimony to pay debts.  他卖掉最后的祖产来还债。

lucrative.example: Signing the lucrative contract changed the young athlete's life overnight.  签下这份有利可图的合同一夜之间改变了这位年轻运动员的生活。

remunerative.example: Translation proved more remunerative than teaching.  翻译比教书更赚钱。

unprofitable.example: They closed three unprofitable branches last spring.  去年春天他们关闭了三家无利可图的分店。

legion.example: His admirers are legion, though few of them have read his poems.  他的仰慕者众多，尽管其中很少有人读过他的诗。

beaucoup.example: The old truck came with beaucoup problems.  这辆旧卡车带来了一大堆问题。

multifold.example: The reform brought multifold benefits to small farmers.  这项改革给小农带来多方面的益处。

multitudinous.example: Multitudinous seabirds nested along the cliff.  数量众多的海鸟在崖壁上筑巢。

numerous.example: She has warned us about this on numerous occasions.  她在许多场合就此警告过我们。

few.example: Few visitors reach the island in winter.  冬天很少有游客到达这座岛。

lack in number.example: The defenders were lacking in number but still held the gate.  守军数量不足，却仍守住了城门。

lethal.example: Even a small dose of this drug can be lethal to children.  即使少量这种药对儿童也可能致命。

deathly.example: A deathly silence fell over the courtroom.  法庭上笼罩着死一般的寂静。

fatal.example: One fatal mistake in the calculation doomed the launch.  计算中一个致命错误注定了发射失败。

murderous.example: He shot her a murderous look and left.  他向她投去杀气腾腾的一瞥便离开了。

terminal.example: The clinic specializes in caring for terminal patients.  这家诊所专门照护晚期病人。

liability.example: The contract clearly limits the company's liability for accidental damage.  合同明确限制了公司对意外损害承担的责任。

accountability.example: Voters demanded greater accountability from the council.  选民要求议会承担更大责任。

answerability.example: The charter spells out the board's answerability to members.  章程明确了董事会对成员应负的责任。

responsibility.example: She took full responsibility for the missed deadline.  她为错过截止日期承担了全部责任。

immunity.example: The witness testified after being granted immunity.  证人在获得豁免后作证。

munificent.example: The university received a munificent donation from a former engineering student.  这所大学收到了一位工程系校友的慷慨捐赠。

unselfish.example: His unselfish passing made the whole team better.  他无私的传球让整支球队更出色。

unstinting.example: She gave unstinting support to every young researcher.  她对每位年轻研究者都给予毫不吝惜的支持。

stodgy.example: The course relied on a stodgy old textbook nobody enjoyed reading.  这门课用的是一本没人爱读的乏味旧教材。

traditional.example: His parents hold rather traditional views on marriage.  他父母对婚姻持相当传统的看法。

closefisted.example: Their closefisted landlord refused to fix the heater.  他们吝啬的房东拒绝修暖气。

miserly.example: He left a miserly tip after complaining about the service all evening.  他整晚抱怨服务，最后只留下吝啬的小费。

niggardly.example: The company offered a niggardly raise after record profits.  在创纪录盈利后公司给了少得可怜的加薪。

tightfisted.example: Their tightfisted employer counted every paper clip.  他们吝啬的雇主连回形针都要数。

backslider.example: The preacher warned the congregation against becoming backsliders.  牧师警告信众不要故态复萌堕落。

debaucher.example: The diary paints the duke as a shameless debaucher.  那本日记把公爵描绘成无耻的放荡者。

licentious.example: His licentious behavior at the party shocked even his closest friends.  他在派对上放荡的行为连最亲近的朋友都感到震惊。

concupiscent.example: The satire mocks the concupiscent courtiers of the era.  这部讽刺作品嘲弄那个时代好色的朝臣。

horny.example: The film is mostly about horny teenagers on holiday.  这部电影主要讲度假中好色的少年。

lascivious.example: He was fired for lascivious comments to coworkers.  他因对同事说淫秽言语被解雇。

lecherous.example: The novel's lecherous villain is oddly comic.  小说中好色的反派意外地滑稽。

libidinous.example: Critics called the poem libidinous and unpublishable.  评论家称这首诗淫秽且不宜出版。

lubricious.example: His lubricious jokes emptied the table quickly.  他下流的玩笑很快让桌边的人走光。

salacious.example: The tabloid printed salacious details about the trial.  小报刊登了关于审判的色情细节。

wanton.example: The court condemned the wanton damage to the church.  法庭谴责对教堂的恣意破坏。

undersexed.example: The novel's hero is lonely, undersexed, and oddly cheerful.  小说主角孤独、性欲淡薄，却出奇地开朗。

liken.example: Poets often liken life to a long and uncertain journey.  诗人常把生活比作一场漫长而不确定的旅程。

analogize.example: Lawyers analogize this dispute to an earlier tax case.  律师把这场争议类比为早前的税务案。

bracket.phrase_cn: 把这两位作家归为一类
bracket.example: Critics wrongly bracket her with the surrealists.  评论家错误地把她与超现实主义者归为一类。

equate.example: Do not equate silence with agreement.  不要把沉默等同于同意。

equalize.example: The reform aims to equalize funding across districts.  这项改革旨在使各区经费均等。

limber.example: Dancers stretch every morning to stay limber and avoid painful injuries.  舞者每天早上拉伸，以保持柔软并避免疼痛的伤病。

lissome.example: The lissome dancer moved across the stage as if she were weightless.  那位身姿柔软的舞者仿佛毫无重量地掠过舞台。

lithesome.example: The lithesome gymnast crossed the beam without a wobble.  这位轻盈的体操运动员走过平衡木毫无摇晃。

stiffened.example: His stiffened fingers could barely grip the pen.  他僵硬的手指几乎握不住笔。

limpid.example: The limpid water let us count stones on the bottom.  清澈的水让我们能数清水底的石头。

crystal.example: The lagoon was crystal clear even at noon.  即使正午，这片泻湖也清澈透明。

cloudy.example: The cloudy broth needed another straining.  这混浊的高汤还需再过滤一次。

turbid.example: After the storm the once clear stream turned brown and turbid.  暴风雨过后，原本清澈的溪水变得棕黄混浊。

lithe.example: She was lithe enough to slip through the narrow gap.  她身形轻盈，足以从窄缝中溜过。

agile.example: The agile goat crossed the rocks without slipping.  那只敏捷的山羊越过岩石毫不滑倒。

featly.example: The dancers moved featly across the wooden stage.  舞者轻盈地在木质舞台上移动。

feline.example: She turned with a feline grace that silenced the room.  她以猫一般的优雅转身，让全屋安静。

gracile.example: The statue shows a gracile youth holding a lamp.  这尊雕像刻的是持灯的纤瘦少年。

solid.example: The wrestler had a solid, heavy build unlike his slender opponent.  这名摔跤手体格粗壮结实，与瘦削的对手截然不同。

ungainly.example: The young bird made an ungainly landing on the narrow branch.  那只幼鸟笨拙地落在窄窄的树枝上。

list.example: The overloaded ship began to list badly in the rising waves.  这艘超载的船在渐高的浪中开始严重倾斜。

angle.example: He angled the lamp so the light fell on the page.  他把灯调斜，使光照在书页上。

heel.example: The yacht heeled sharply as the gust hit.  阵风袭来时游艇急剧倾斜。

incline.example: She inclined her head slightly to hear him.  她微微侧头以便听清他说话。

pitch.example: The boat pitched so badly that dishes slid off.  船颠簸得厉害，盘子都滑落了。

slant.example: The old wooden floor slants slightly toward the far corner.  这块旧木地板向远处的角落略微倾斜。

slope.example: The lawn slopes gently toward the river.  草坪缓缓向河边倾斜。

tilt.example: He tilted the screen back until the glare finally disappeared.  他把屏幕向后倾斜，直到反光终于消失。

tip.example: Do not tip the glass or the tea will spill.  别把杯子倾斜，茶会洒出来。

erect.example: The old soldier still stood perfectly erect.  这位老兵仍站得笔直。

loath.example: He was loath to admit that his own carelessness caused the accident.  他不愿承认是自己的粗心造成了这场事故。

chivalrous.example: He made a chivalrous offer to carry her heavy suitcase.  他很有骑士风度地提出替她拿沉重的行李箱。

elevated.example: The speech used elevated language that moved the crowd.  这篇演讲用高雅的语言感动了人群。

greathearted.example: Her greathearted forgiveness surprised even her critics.  她宽宏的原谅甚至让批评者惊讶。

high-minded.example: His high-minded refusal of the bribe cost him the job.  他高尚地拒绝贿赂，因此失去了工作。

magnanimous.example: She was magnanimous in victory and praised her rival.  她胜而不骄，还称赞了对手。

sublime.example: From the summit we watched a sublime landscape unfold below us.  从山顶我们看着一片壮丽的景色在下方展开。

debased.example: He complained about the debased state of public debate.  他抱怨公共辩论的堕落状态。

ignominious.example: The season ended in ignominious defeat at home.  这个赛季以主场可耻的失利告终。

mean.example: The family lived in a mean little room above a noisy printing shop.  一家人住在嘈杂印刷店楼上一间简陋的小屋里。

laze.example: They lazed by the pool all Sunday afternoon.  他们整个周日下午都在池边懒躺。

disproportional.example: Small towns bear a disproportional share of the cost.  小城镇承担了不成比例的成本。

off-balance.example: The sudden question caught the speaker off-balance.  突然的提问让演讲者措手不及。

conservational.example: He wrote in an easy, conservational tone that felt like speech.  他以轻松的闲谈语气写作，读来像说话。

gabby.example: Our gabby neighbor kept us at the gate for an hour.  话多的邻居把我们留在门口一小时。

uncommunicative.cn: 沉默寡言的，不爱说话的
uncommunicative.example: He grew uncommunicative after the move to a new school.  转到新学校后他变得沉默寡言。

uncivilized.example: Shouting at waiters is simply uncivilized behavior.  对服务员大喊大叫纯属野蛮行为。

uncultured.example: They dismissed him as uncultured because of his accent.  他们因他的口音就认定他没教养。

unrefined.example: His unrefined manners embarrassed the whole table.  他粗俗的举止让整桌人尴尬。

lubricate.cn: 润滑，涂润滑剂以减少摩擦
lubricate.example: Remember to lubricate the moving parts before you start the old engine.  启动这台旧发动机之前记得给活动部件上润滑油。

grease.example: He greased the squeaking hinges with a drop of oil.  他滴了一点油润滑吱吱作响的合页。

oil.example: Remember to oil the bicycle chain every month.  记得每月给自行车链条上油。

slick.example: He slicked back his hair before the interview.  面试前他把头发抹平贴后。

indistinct.example: The photograph shows an indistinct figure by the door.  照片上门边有个模糊的人影。

obfuscated.example: The report was so obfuscated that nobody could find the real numbers.  这份报告写得如此含混，没人能找到真实数据。

lug.example: She lugged a heavy suitcase up four flights of narrow stairs.  她把一只沉重的箱子费力地拖上四层窄楼梯。

cart.example: They carted the bricks to the building site all morning.  他们整个上午都在用车把砖运到工地。

convey.example: A long pipeline conveys water from the mountains to the city.  一条长管道把水从山里输送到城市。

ferry.example: A small boat ferries workers across the river each dawn.  每天黎明一艘小船把工人渡过河。

haul.example: The truck hauled twenty tons of gravel up the hill.  卡车把二十吨砂石运上了山。

pack.example: The guides packed our heavy gear up the steep trail.  向导把我们沉重的装备扛上陡峭的小路。

tote.example: She toted her books across campus in an old canvas bag.  她用旧帆布袋拎着书穿过校园。

deploring.example: He spoke of the ruined city in a deploring tone.  他用哀叹的语调谈起那座毁掉的城市。

breath.example: Not a breath of wind stirred the still lake at dusk.  黄昏时没有一丝风吹动平静的湖面。

becalm.example: The yacht lay becalmed for two days without any breeze.  游艇因无风停滞了两天。

lullaby.example: She sang a gentle lullaby until the restless baby finally fell asleep.  她唱着轻柔的摇篮曲，直到不安的婴儿终于睡着。
lullaby.cn: 摇篮曲；唱摇篮曲使入睡

salve.example: He gave money to the school to salve his uneasy conscience.  他向学校捐钱，以减轻内心的不安。

burden.example: They burdened the young manager with impossible sales targets.  他们让这位年轻经理背上无法完成的销售指标。

freight.example: The barge was freighted with coal for the northern mills.  驳船装满了运往北方工厂的煤。

lade.example: Workers laded the wagon with heavy sacks of flour.  工人们把一袋袋沉重的面粉装上马车。

laden.example: She arrived laden with gifts for the whole family.  她抱着给全家的礼物来了。

saddle.example: The new rules saddle small farmers with paperwork they cannot possibly manage.  新规让小农户背上他们根本应付不了的文书负担。

disburden.example: He finally disburdened himself of the secret he had kept for years.  他终于卸下了多年来藏着的秘密。

disencumber.example: She disencumbered herself of the heavy coat and sat down.  她脱掉厚重的外套坐了下来。

unlade.example: Dockers began to unlade the freighter at first light.  码头工人天一亮就开始给货轮卸货。

unload.example: They unloaded all the furniture before the rain started.  他们在下雨前把家具都卸完了。

luminary.example: Several luminaries in physics gathered to honor their retiring old professor.  物理学界的几位名人聚在一起向他们退休的老教授致敬。

celebrity.example: The restaurant is full of celebrities every Friday night.  每周五晚这家餐厅都挤满名人。

eminence.example: He achieved eminence as a surgeon before he turned forty.  他四十岁前就成了声名卓著的外科医生。

icon.example: She became an icon for a whole generation of young scientists.  她成了整整一代年轻科学家的偶像。

notability.example: Several notabilities attended the opening of the new library.  几位名流出席了新图书馆的开馆仪式。

star.example: She was the star of every school play she joined.  她参演的每部校园剧里她都是主角。

superstar.example: The young pitcher became a superstar in a single season.  这位年轻投手一个赛季就成了超级明星。

nobody.example: He arrived in the city a nobody and left it famous.  他到这座城市时无人知晓，离开时已成名。

nonentity.example: Once a political nonentity, he suddenly became the party's most quoted voice.  他曾是政坛的无名之辈，突然成了党内被引用最多的声音。

reel.example: The boxer reeled from the blow and clutched at the ropes.  拳手被那一击打得头昏眼花，抓住了围绳。

progress smoothly.example: Talks progressed smoothly once both sides dropped their preconditions.  双方放弃前提条件后，谈判进展顺利。

lurk.example: A photographer lurked in the shadows outside the actress's hotel all night.  一名摄影师整夜潜伏在女演员酒店外的暗处。

ambush.example: Rebels ambushed the supply convoy in a narrow valley.  叛军在狭窄的山谷里伏击了补给车队。

snake.example: The narrow path snakes quietly along the base of the cliff.  狭窄的小路沿着崖底静静蜿蜒。

steal.example: Each night he would steal quietly out of the house.  他每晚都会悄悄溜出房子。

appear.example: A figure appeared at the far end of the dark corridor.  一个人影出现在黑暗走廊的另一端。

come out.example: Stars come out over the desert as soon as clouds clear.  云一散开，星星就在沙漠上空出来了。

unproductive.example: Years of drought left the fields dry and unproductive.  多年干旱使这些田地干枯贫瘠。

gleaming.phrase_cn: 光洁发亮的大理石地面
gleaming.example: She polished the old silver teapot until it was gleaming.  她把那把旧银茶壶擦得闪闪发亮。

rubbed.example: The table top was rubbed smooth by generations of hands.  桌面被几代人的手摩擦得光滑。

self-indulgent.cn: 放纵自己的，纵情享乐的
self-indulgent.example: He spent a self-indulgent week eating out and sleeping late.  他放纵地过了一周，天天下馆子、睡到很晚。

lyric.example: The novel contains a lyric passage of prose about summer rain.  这部小说中有一段关于夏雨的抒情散文。

lyrical.example: Her lyrical prose makes even a train ride sound beautiful.  她抒情的文笔让坐火车都显得很美。

musical.example: He had a low musical laugh that everyone remembered.  他有一种低沉悦耳的笑声，人人都记得。

poetical.example: The old letter was written in oddly poetical language.  那封旧信用了一种奇特而富诗意的语言。

prose.example: He writes plain prose rather than flowery verse.  他写朴实的散文，而不是华丽的诗。

horrific.example: Survivors described the horrific scene inside the burning tunnel.  幸存者描述了燃烧隧道里可怕的场面。

nightmarish.example: Crossing the flooded streets was a nightmarish experience.  穿过被水淹的街道是噩梦般的经历。

terrific.cn: 极好的，了不起的；极大的
terrific.example: You did a terrific job on that presentation yesterday.  你昨天那个演讲做得非常棒。

enjoyable.example: We had a thoroughly enjoyable evening at the concert.  我们在音乐会上度过了非常愉快的一晚。

macerate.example: The chef macerated the fruit in sweet wine for several hours.  厨师把水果在甜酒中浸软了好几个小时。

impregnate.example: The wood is impregnated with resin so that it resists water.  这种木材浸透了树脂，因此能防水。

souse.example: She soused the vegetables in cold water before cooking them.  她做菜前把蔬菜泡在冷水里。

maculate.example: Careless painters maculated the white cloth with drops of red paint.  粗心的漆工用红漆点污了那块白布。

dot.example: Small green islands dot the blue bay near the harbor.  小小的绿岛点缀在港口附近蔚蓝的海湾上。

cleanse.example: She cleansed the deep cut with warm water and soap.  她用温水和肥皂清洗了那道深口子。

maelstrom.example: The young widow was caught in a maelstrom of grief and anger.  这位年轻的寡妇陷入了悲伤与愤怒的漩涡。

tumoil.example: The country fell into political tumoil after the disputed vote.  那次有争议的投票后，国家陷入政治动荡。

regal.example: She entered the hall with a regal calm that silenced everyone.  她带着帝王般的从容走进大厅，全场安静下来。

bumbling.cn: 笨手笨脚的，办事不力的
bumbling.example: The bumbling waiter spilled hot soup on two guests.  那个笨手笨脚的侍者把热汤洒在两位客人身上。

ambidexterous.phrase_cn: 双手同样灵巧的钢琴家
ambidexterous.example: Being ambidexterous, he could write neatly with either hand.  由于双手都灵巧，他两只手都能写得工整。

malaise.example: A general sense of malaise spread through the office after the layoffs.  裁员之后，一种普遍的不适感在办公室蔓延。

debility.example: Months of fever left him in a state of debility.  数月的发烧使他身体十分虚弱。

decrepitude.example: The old theater has slid into complete decrepitude.  那家老剧院已彻底破败。

disease.example: Clean drinking water prevents many diseases in the village.  干净的饮用水能预防村里许多疾病。

feebleness.example: His feebleness was obvious as he climbed the narrow stairs.  他爬那道窄楼梯时虚弱得很明显。

infirmness.example: Age brought an infirmness that kept her indoors all winter.  年龄带来的体弱使她整个冬天都待在屋里。

sickliness.example: Her sickliness as a child kept her out of school for years.  她儿时多病，好几年没能上学。

unhealthiness.example: Doctors warned about the unhealthiness of the damp old housing.  医生警告说潮湿的老房子不利健康。

complainer.example: Nobody wants to sit beside a constant complainer at dinner.  没人想在饭桌上挨着一个总抱怨的人。

ungratified.example: He left the meeting ungratified and quietly angry.  他离开会议时心有不满，暗自生气。

fulfilled.example: She feels fulfilled teaching children in her own hometown.  在家乡教孩子让她感到充实。

gratified.example: He was gratified to hear that his advice had really helped.  听说自己的建议真的起了作用，他很欣慰。

malicious.example: A malicious rumor about the candidate spread quickly across social media.  一条关于这位候选人的恶意谣言在社交媒体上迅速传播。

bad.example: There was no bad feeling between the two old rivals.  两位老对手之间并没有恶意。

despiteful.example: Her despiteful comments hurt him more than she realized.  她恶意的评论比她意识到的更伤他。

malevolent.example: The old man gave the boys a malevolent glare and slammed the gate.  老人恶毒地瞪了那些男孩一眼，砰地关上了大门。

spiteful.example: She sent a spiteful message to her former business partner.  她给前生意伙伴发了一条恶毒的消息。

virulent.example: The columnist launched a virulent attack on the new mayor.  这位专栏作家对新市长发起了恶毒的攻击。
virulent.cn: 恶毒的，充满敌意的；毒性强的

wicked.example: A wicked scheme to seize the estate was uncovered by the lawyer.  律师揭穿了一个夺取遗产的邪恶计谋。
