moldable.example: Warm wax is moldable enough for a child to shape.  温热的蜡足够柔软，孩子也能捏出形状。

waxy.example: The thick petals felt waxy and cool between her fingers.  厚厚的花瓣在她指间摸起来像蜡一样凉滑。

plastic.example: Young children have remarkably plastic minds and absorb new habits quickly.  幼儿的心智极为可塑，能很快吸收新习惯。

funky.example: A funky smell came from the lunch bag he had forgotten.  他忘掉的午餐袋里发出难闻的气味。

rank.example: The cellar had a rank smell of mold and damp earth.  地窖里有一股霉味和湿土的恶臭。

reeky.example: He threw the reeky fishing clothes straight into the wash.  他把臭气熏人的钓鱼衣直接扔进洗衣机。

stinking.example: They cleared a stinking heap of garbage from the alley.  他们清走了巷子里一堆发臭的垃圾。

incumbent.example: It is incumbent on every driver to check the brakes regularly.  定期检查刹车是每位司机义不容辞的责任。

mangle.example: The amateur band completely mangled the song at last night's concert.  那支业余乐队在昨晚的音乐会上把这首歌彻底演砸了。

butcher.cn: 弄糟，搞得一塌糊涂；屠宰
butcher.example: The band completely butchered my favorite old song.  这支乐队把我最爱的老歌演得一塌糊涂。

foul up.example: One careless email fouled up the whole delivery plan.  一封粗心的邮件把整个送货计划搞乱了。

mangy.example: He wore a mangy overcoat that looked as though it had survived two wars.  他穿着一件破旧邋遢的大衣，看上去像是经历过两场战争。

execrable.example: The hotel served execrable coffee at breakfast every morning.  酒店每天早餐提供的咖啡都糟糕透了。

squalid.example: The refugees endured squalid living conditions in the overcrowded camp.  难民在过度拥挤的营地里忍受肮脏的居住条件。

mania.example: Her mania for collecting antique clocks filled every room of the old house.  她对收集古董钟表的狂热塞满了老房子的每个房间。

craze.example: Skateboarding became a craze at our school that spring.  那年春天滑板在我们学校成了热潮。

obsession.example: His obsession with old maps filled the entire attic.  他对旧地图的痴迷塞满了整个阁楼。

preoccupation.cn: 全神贯注；念念不忘之事
preoccupation.example: Her preoccupation with the exam kept her awake all night.  她一心想着考试，整夜没睡。

prepossession.example: His prepossession with rank colored every judgment he made.  他对地位的执念影响了他所有的判断。

indifference.example: The crowd greeted the announcement with total indifference.  人群对这个通告完全漠不关心。

mysterious.example: A mysterious light appeared over the lake around midnight.  午夜时分湖面上出现了一道神秘的光。

manipulate.example: The campaign tried to manipulate public opinion by releasing carefully edited video clips.  竞选团队试图通过发布精心剪辑的视频片段来操控公众舆论。

maneuver.example: She patiently maneuvered the car into a very narrow parking space.  她耐心地把车挪进一个非常狭窄的停车位。

mannered.example: Her mannered prose impressed critics at first but soon began to feel tiresome.  她做作的文风起初让评论家赞叹，但很快就令人厌倦。

assumed.example: He traveled under an assumed name for several years.  他用假名旅行了好几年。

factitious.example: The applause sounded factitious and died away very quickly.  掌声听起来很假，很快就停了。

print.example: The publisher printed only five hundred copies of the poem.  出版社只印了五百册这首诗。

type.example: She typed the whole manuscript in three long nights.  她用三个漫长的夜晚把整份手稿打了出来。

typewriting.example: The old file contained neat typewriting from the 1950s.  这份旧档案里是五十年代的整齐打字稿。

patch.example: There was a damp patch on the ceiling above the door.  门上方的天花板上有一块潮湿的斑迹。

malfeasance.example: The auditor uncovered years of malfeasance in the city office.  审计员查出市政办公室多年的违法行为。

misconduct.example: Two officers were dismissed for serious misconduct last month.  上个月两名警官因严重不当行为被解职。

misbehavior.example: The school called his parents about his constant misbehavior.  学校因他不断的不良行为叫来了家长。

misdoing.example: He was never punished for his earlier misdoings.  他早年的不法行为从未受到惩罚。

wrongdoing.example: The company denied any wrongdoing in the contract.  公司否认在这份合同中有任何不法行为。

martinet.example: Their new sergeant was a martinet who inspected every button before morning drill.  他们的新中士是个执纪严苛的人，晨操前连纽扣都要检查。

disciplinarian.example: Their grandfather was a strict disciplinarian about bedtime.  他们的祖父在睡觉时间上极其严格。

purist.cn: 纯粹主义者，拘守传统的人
purist.example: Purists complain that the new translation is far too casual.  纯粹主义者抱怨新译本太随意。

stickler.example: Our new manager is a stickler for rules about punctuality.  我们的新经理在守时规则上一丝不苟。

marvel.example: Visitors still marvel at the vaulted ceiling of the cathedral after eight centuries.  八百年后，参观者仍对这座大教堂的拱顶惊叹不已。
marvel.cn: 惊叹，惊奇；令人惊奇的事物

miracle.example: It was a miracle that everyone walked away from the crash.  所有人都从车祸中走了出来，真是奇迹。

phenomenon.example: Scientists still cannot fully explain this strange phenomenon.  科学家仍无法完全解释这个奇怪现象。

prodigy.example: The young violinist was hailed as a prodigy at eight.  这位年轻小提琴手八岁时就被誉为神童。

wonder.example: The children stared at the waterfall in silent wonder.  孩子们默默惊叹地望着瀑布。

mash.example: Mash the boiled potatoes thoroughly before mixing in the warm milk.  在拌入温牛奶之前把煮好的土豆彻底捣碎。

crush.example: He crushed the dry leaves into powder between his palms.  他用手掌把干叶子搓成了粉末。

agglomerate.example: The wet powder agglomerated into hard grey lumps.  湿粉结成了灰色的硬块。

masquerade.example: His politeness was only a masquerade concealing deep resentment toward his colleagues.  他的客气只是掩盖对同事深深怨恨的伪装。

facade.example: Behind a facade of confidence he was deeply worried.  在自信的表象背后，他忧心不已。

pretense.example: He obtained the money under false pretenses and was arrested months later.  他以虚假的名义骗取钱财，几个月后被逮捕。

semblance.example: After the storm the town regained some semblance of normal life.  风暴过后小镇恢复了几分正常生活的样子。

pose.example: He posed as a doctor in order to get into the ward.  他冒充医生以便进入病房。

mastery.example: Her mastery of the violin was obvious from the very first bar she played.  她对小提琴的精通从她演奏的第一个小节就显露无疑。

deftness.example: He shuffled the cards with surprising deftness.  他洗牌的手法灵巧得令人惊讶。

prowess.example: His athletic prowess earned him a scholarship at a famous university.  他出色的运动才能为他赢得了一所名校的奖学金。

virtuosity.example: Her virtuosity at the piano silenced the whole hall.  她精湛的钢琴技艺让全场安静下来。

amateurishness.example: Critics mocked the amateurishness of the film's editing.  评论者嘲笑这部片子剪辑得很业余。

matriculate.example: Only students with excellent scores matriculate at the university's competitive engineering program each fall.  每年秋天只有成绩优异的学生才能被这所大学竞争激烈的工程专业录取。

enroll.example: She enrolled in evening classes to finish her degree.  她报名上夜校以完成学位。

inscribe.example: His name was inscribed in the college register that autumn.  那年秋天他的名字被登记进学院名册。

graduate.example: She graduated from law school with the highest honors.  她以最高荣誉从法学院毕业。

mushy.cn: 多愁善感的，肉麻的；软糊的
mushy.example: He wrote her a mushy letter that he later regretted.  他给她写了一封后来觉得肉麻的信。

overemotional.example: She apologized for her overemotional speech at the farewell.  她为告别会上过于情绪化的讲话道了歉。

ace.example: He is an ace with numbers and finished the audit alone.  他是数字高手，独自完成了审计。

dissentient.example: Only one dissentient member voted against the proposal.  只有一名持异议的成员投票反对提案。

dissident.example: The dissident writer published his essays abroad.  这位异见作家在国外发表了他的文章。

iconoclastic.example: His iconoclastic views upset the older professors.  他反传统的观点让年长的教授们不安。

conventionalist.example: As a conventionalist, he distrusted every new method.  作为一个守旧者，他不信任任何新方法。

meager.example: They raised four children on a meager income from a small roadside shop.  他们靠路边小店微薄的收入养育了四个孩子。

exiguous.example: They survived a whole year on exiguous rations of rice.  他们靠少得可怜的米粮过了整整一年。

poor.example: The harvest was poor after a whole summer without rain.  整个夏天没下雨，收成很差。

skimpy.example: The report gave only skimpy evidence for its bold claims.  报告只给出很少的证据来支持大胆的结论。

slim.example: We have only a slim chance of catching the last train.  我们赶上末班车的机会很小。

bountiful.example: The valley gave them a bountiful crop of apples.  这个山谷给了他们丰盛的苹果收成。

generous.example: She poured a generous glass of wine for each guest.  她给每位客人倒了满满一杯酒。

plenteous.example: That year brought plenteous rain and unusually heavy crops.  那年雨水充足，庄稼格外茂盛。

mingy.example: He left a mingy tip after a very long meal.  吃了很久之后他只留下少得可怜的小费。

ungenerous.example: It seemed ungenerous to refuse her such a small favor.  拒绝她这么小的请求显得很不厚道。

meander.example: We meandered through the park all afternoon with no particular destination in mind.  我们整个下午在公园里闲逛，心里并没有特定的目的地。

cruise.example: We cruised slowly down the river all afternoon.  我们整个下午沿河缓慢漫游。

drift.phrase_cn: 从一个城镇漂到另一个
drift.example: He drifted through Europe for two years without any plans.  他毫无计划地在欧洲漂了两年。

float.example: Leaves floated lazily past us on the warm current.  叶子随暖流懒懒地漂过我们身边。

roam.example: They roamed the narrow streets until the shops closed.  他们在窄街上闲逛到商店关门。

measly.example: He offered a measly ten dollars for a painting worth several hundred.  他为一幅值几百美元的画只出了少得可怜的十美元。

peanut.example: They paid him peanuts for a whole month of hard work.  他辛苦干了整整一个月，只拿到极少的钱。

big.example: She was offered a big raise and took the job at once.  她获得大幅加薪，立刻接受了这份工作。

measured.example: The minister gave a measured response that neither denied nor confirmed the accusations.  部长做出了审慎的回应，既未否认也未证实这些指控。

advised.example: Postponing the launch was a well advised decision after all.  推迟发布终究是个经过慎重考虑的决定。

knowing.phrase: a knowing violation of the rules
knowing.example: The judge called it a knowing violation of the safety rules.  法官称这是明知故犯地违反安全规定。

studied.example: He answered with studied calm that impressed the whole panel.  他以刻意保持的镇定作答，让整个评审组印象深刻。

weighed.example: Every sentence in the letter was carefully weighed.  信中每句话都经过仔细斟酌。

meddle.example: Neighbors should not meddle in the private affairs of the family next door.  邻居不该干涉隔壁一家的私事。

interfere.example: Please do not interfere in decisions that are not yours.  请不要干涉不属于你的决定。

interlope.example: He interloped in the negotiation without any invitation at all.  他毫无邀请就插进了谈判。

intermeddle.example: Foreign advisers intermeddled in the country's internal affairs.  外国顾问插手了该国内政。

intrude.example: I hope I am not intruding on your quiet evening.  希望我没有打扰你安静的夜晚。

obtrude.example: He obtruded his advice on everyone at the table.  他向桌上每个人强行灌输自己的建议。

pry.example: Reporters continued to pry into his private life for many weeks.  记者们连续数周不断打探他的私生活。

snoop.example: Someone had been snooping around my desk all week.  整整一周都有人在我桌子附近窥探。

mediate.example: A retired judge agreed to mediate the bitter dispute between the two companies.  一位退休法官同意调解两家公司之间的激烈争端。

intercede.example: Her teacher interceded with the principal on her behalf.  她的老师替她向校长说情。

interpose.example: A neighbor interposed before the argument turned violent.  在争吵动手之前一位邻居出面调停。

average.example: His work is average but it always arrives on time.  他的活儿一般，但总能按时交。

outstanding.example: She gave an outstanding performance in her very first concert.  她在首场音乐会上表现出色。

excellent.example: The students achieved excellent results in the final exam.  学生们在期末考试中取得了优异成绩。

montage.example: The exhibit opened with a montage of images from a century of protest.  展览以一组来自百年抗争的图像拼贴开场。

salad.example: The album is a salad of jazz, rock and folk tunes.  这张专辑是爵士、摇滚和民谣的大杂烩。

shuffle.example: He shuffled the papers into a hopeless mixture.  他把文件混成了一团乱。

variety.example: The market offers a wide variety of local cheeses.  市场上有各式各样的本地奶酪。

befitting.example: They gave him a farewell befitting a long and honest career.  他们为他举行了与漫长诚实的职业生涯相称的告别。

mellifluent.example: Her mellifluent voice made the old poem sound completely new.  她甜美流畅的嗓音让这首老诗听起来全然新鲜。

hammy.example: The film is ruined by hammy acting in the last scene.  最后一场戏表演过火，毁了整部片子。

raspy.example: Years of smoking had left him with a low, raspy voice.  多年吸烟使他的嗓音低沉而刺耳。

nondramatic.phrase_cn: 不带戏剧腔的朗读方式
nondramatic.example: He prefers a plain, nondramatic way of telling stories.  他偏爱平实、不夸张的讲故事方式。

nontheatrical.example: Her nontheatrical delivery made the whole speech feel honest.  她不夸张的表达让整篇讲话显得真诚。

save.example: The lifeguard saved two swimmers from the strong current.  救生员从急流中救出两名游泳者。

mendacious.example: His mendacious account of the accident collapsed under a few simple questions.  他对事故的虚假陈述在几个简单问题下就站不住脚了。

lying.example: He called the report lying propaganda and walked out.  他称那份报告是撒谎的宣传，然后走了出去。

untruthful.example: Her untruthful answers soon caught the officer's attention.  她不实的回答很快引起了警官的注意。

mentor.example: Senior researchers mentor young engineers throughout their first two years at the laboratory.  资深研究员在年轻工程师入职头两年里全程指导他们。

coach.example: She coached him through his difficult first month at work.  她指导他度过了工作中艰难的第一个月。

lead.example: He leads new employees through every step of the process.  他带着新员工走完流程的每一步。

shepherd.example: The teacher shepherded the children safely across the road.  老师把孩子们安全地领过马路。

comply.example: All drivers must comply with the new speed limits.  所有司机都必须遵守新的限速规定。

mercenary.example: Her mercenary motives became obvious once the inheritance was finally mentioned.  一提到遗产，她唯利是图的动机就显露无遗。

greedy.example: He grew greedy and lost everything in one bad deal.  他变得贪心，在一笔糟糕的交易中失去了一切。

moneygrubbing.example: Neighbors called him a moneygrubbing landlord behind his back.  邻居们背后叫他唯利是图的房东。

changeful.example: His changeful moods made him a hard man to work with.  他喜怒无常，很难与他共事。

tangle.example: The wind tangled the fishing line around the branches overhead.  风把鱼线缠在头顶的树枝上。

trap.example: Heavy snow trapped the climbers on the ridge for days.  大雪把登山者困在山脊上好几天。

mesmeric.example: The storyteller had a mesmeric voice that held the children completely still.  讲故事的人有种令人着迷的嗓音，让孩子们一动不动。
mesmeric.cn: 令人着迷的，难以抗拒的

drawing.example: The new gallery has real drawing power among younger visitors.  这家新画廊对较年轻的参观者很有吸引力。

alchemize.example: She alchemized her hardest years into two fine novels.  她把最艰难的岁月化成了两部好小说。

transmute.example: Great heat transmutes the soft metal into something far harder.  高温把这种软金属变成硬得多的东西。

transpose.example: The typist transposed two digits in the phone number.  打字员把电话号码里的两个数字调换了。

transubstantiate.example: The ritual is said to transubstantiate the bread completely.  据说这一仪式使饼彻底改变了实质。

conceptual.example: The book offers a clear conceptual model of human memory.  这本书提供了清晰的人类记忆概念模型。

ideational.example: The therapy focuses on ideational patterns behind constant anxiety.  这种疗法关注持续焦虑背后的观念模式。

notional.example: The line on the map is purely notional, not a real fence.  地图上这条线纯属假想，并非真的围栏。

heavenly.example: Astronomers charted the heavenly bodies visible that clear night.  天文学家绘制了那个晴夜可见的天体。

otherworldly.example: The frozen lake had an otherworldly blue glow at dawn.  黎明时结冰的湖泛着非尘世的蓝光。

paranormal.example: She writes novels about paranormal events in quiet small towns.  她写关于宁静小镇上超自然事件的小说。

preternatural.example: The pilot showed preternatural calm while the engine was clearly failing.  发动机明显故障时，飞行员表现出超乎寻常的镇定。

transcendental.example: He described a transcendental moment on the mountain top.  他描述了在山顶的一次超验体验。

unearthly.example: An unearthly cry came from somewhere deep in the forest.  森林深处传来一声诡异的叫声。

unworldly.cn: 超脱世俗的，不谙世事的
unworldly.example: He remained unworldly, indifferent to both money and fame.  他一直超脱世俗，对金钱和名声都不在意。

disgusting.example: The kitchen was left in a disgusting state after the party.  聚会后厨房脏得让人恶心。

loathesome.example: He found the whole scheme loathesome and refused to help.  他觉得整个计划可憎，拒绝帮忙。

remain.example: The old rules remain in force despite the new law.  尽管有了新法，旧规则仍然有效。

metaphysical.example: They argued about metaphysical questions until well past midnight.  他们争论形而上的问题直到深夜。

meteoric.example: Her meteoric rise in the company ended just as suddenly as it began.  她在公司里的迅速崛起结束得和开始时一样突然。

momentary.example: After a momentary pause she signed the contract.  短暂停顿之后她签了合同。

prolonged.example: The region suffered a prolonged drought lasting three years.  该地区遭受了长达三年的旱灾。

systematized.example: Her notes were carefully systematized by subject and by date.  她的笔记按主题和日期作了系统整理。

disorganized.example: The project failed because the team was hopelessly disorganized.  项目失败是因为团队毫无条理。

unsystematic.example: Their unsystematic reading of the data missed the key trend.  他们杂乱地读数据，漏掉了关键趋势。

mettle.example: The long climb in freezing rain proved the mettle of every young recruit.  在冻雨中的长途攀登考验出每个新兵的勇气。

bravery.example: She was given a medal for bravery during the flood.  她因在洪水中的勇敢而获得奖章。

dauntlessness.example: His dauntlessness in the storm saved the whole crew.  他在风暴中的无畏救了全体船员。

fortitude.example: She bore months of treatment with quiet fortitude.  她默默坚韧地承受了数月的治疗。

spirit.example: The small team played with spirit until the final whistle.  这支小队斗志昂扬地打到终场哨响。

spunk.example: It took real spunk to speak against her own boss.  当面反对自己的老板需要真正的胆量。

durability.example: Field tests proved the durability of the new leather boots.  实地测试证明了这种新皮靴的耐久性。

endurance.example: Long runs slowly built up her endurance over the winter.  长跑在整个冬天慢慢提高了她的耐力。

stamina.example: Long morning swims helped him build up remarkable stamina for racing.  长时间的晨泳帮他练出比赛所需的惊人耐力。

persistence.example: Sheer persistence, not talent, finally won her the research grant.  最终为她赢得研究资助的是坚持不懈，而非天赋。

resolution.example: She faced that difficult year with quiet resolution.  她以沉静的决心面对那艰难的一年。

miff.example: His careless joke about the budget miffed several colleagues at the meeting.  他关于预算的轻率玩笑让会上几位同事很不快。

migratory.example: Migratory birds pause at this shallow lake before continuing south for the winter.  候鸟在继续南飞过冬前会在这片浅湖停歇。

migrant.example: Thousands of migrant birds rest in the marsh each spring.  每年春天数千只迁徙的鸟在这片沼泽休息。

mobile.example: Young workers today are far more mobile than their parents.  如今的年轻工人比父辈流动性强得多。

nomad.example: A desert nomad guided us across the dunes toward the hidden well.  一位沙漠游牧者带我们穿过沙丘走向隐蔽的水井。

traveling.example: A traveling theater group performed in the village square.  一个巡回剧团在村广场上演出。

nonmigrant.cn: 不迁徙的；不迁徙的动物
nonmigrant.example: These nonmigrant sparrows stay in the valley all winter.  这些不迁徙的麻雀整个冬天都留在山谷里。

resident.example: A resident pair of owls nests in the old stone barn.  一对定居的猫头鹰在老石谷仓里筑巢。

sedentary.example: Years of sedentary office work had weakened his back and shoulders.  多年久坐不动的办公工作削弱了他的背和肩。

ape.example: The boy aped his father's walk to make everyone laugh.  男孩模仿父亲走路的样子逗大家笑。

copycat.example: The magazine was a shameless copycat of a French title.  这本杂志无耻地照抄了一份法国刊物。

imitative.example: Young children learn language mainly through imitative play.  幼儿主要通过模仿性游戏学习语言。

simulated.example: Pilots train for storms inside a simulated cockpit.  飞行员在模拟驾驶舱里练习应对风暴。

substitute.example: Powdered milk is a poor substitute for the fresh kind.  奶粉是鲜奶的劣质替代品。

synthetic.example: The jacket is made of synthetic fibers that dry quickly.  这件夹克由速干的合成纤维制成。

minatory.example: He sent a minatory letter demanding payment within one week.  他寄来一封带威胁的信，要求一周内付款。

doomy.example: Newspapers printed doomy forecasts about the country's economy.  报纸刊出了对国家经济的悲观预测。

foreboding.example: She felt a strange foreboding as the sky darkened.  天色转暗时她有种奇怪的不祥预感。

ill-boding.example: Ill-boding clouds gathered over the harbor before noon.  中午前不祥的云聚集在港口上空。

inauspicious.example: The team made an inauspicious start by losing twice at home.  球队主场连输两场，开局不利。

menacing.example: Two menacing dogs stood at the end of the narrow lane.  两条凶恶的狗站在窄巷尽头。

portentous.example: A portentous silence fell over the room before the verdict was read.  宣读判决之前，房间里陷入一阵预示不祥的沉默。

sinister.example: There was something sinister about the empty old house.  那座空荡的老房子有种阴森之感。

threatening.example: He made a threatening gesture and then walked quickly away.  他做了个威胁的手势，然后快步走开。

unthreatening.example: Her unthreatening manner made the children relax at once.  她毫无威胁感的态度让孩子们立刻放松了。

ministration.example: The patient recovered quickly under the gentle ministrations of a nurse.  在护士温柔的照料下，病人很快康复了。

blend.example: The two rivers blend into one wide brown stream.  两条河汇成一条宽阔的浑浊水流。

minimize.example: The company tried to minimize the risks in its statement to worried investors.  公司在给焦虑投资者的声明中试图刻意低估风险。

discount.example: Managers discounted the early warnings about the leaking roof.  管理者对屋顶漏水的早期警告不予重视。

underestimate.example: Never underestimate how long these repairs will actually take.  千万不要低估这些修理实际需要的时间。

underrate.example: Critics badly underrated her first novel at the time.  评论界当时严重低估了她的第一部小说。

undervalue.example: The company undervalued its most experienced engineers for years.  公司多年来低估了最有经验的工程师。

overestimateexaggerate.example: Critics tend to overestimateexaggerate the risks of new technology.  批评者往往过高估计并夸大新技术的风险。

mint.example: He keeps his old comic books in mint condition inside sealed plastic sleeves.  他把旧漫画书装在密封塑料套里，保持完好如新。

pristine.example: The cabin sat beside a pristine lake untouched by development.  那间小屋坐落在一个未受开发影响的纯净湖泊旁。

unmarred.example: The old table is unmarred by scratches or dark stains.  这张旧桌子没有刮痕或污渍。

virginal.example: They camped beside a virginal stretch of white beach.  他们在一段未经开发的白色沙滩旁扎营。

impaired.example: His impaired eyesight forced him to stop driving at night.  视力受损使他不得不放弃夜间开车。

damaged.example: The store sells damaged books at half the usual price.  这家店以平常一半的价格出售受损的书。

atomic.example: Under the lens we saw almost atomic specks of pollen.  在镜头下我们看到几乎微如原子的花粉粒。

little.example: She noticed one little detail that everyone else had missed.  她注意到一个别人都漏掉的小细节。

minutiae.example: He worries about the minutiae of daily life and forgets the larger goals.  他纠结于日常生活的琐事，却忘了更大的目标。

mirage.example: The shimmering lake ahead turned out to be only a mirage.  前方波光粼粼的湖泊原来只是海市蜃楼。

phantom.example: He kept chasing the phantom of an easy fortune.  他一直追逐轻松发财的幻影。

mire.example: The company sank into a mire of debt from which it never escaped.  公司陷入债务的泥潭，再也没能脱身。

dilemma.example: She faced the dilemma of staying home or taking the job.  她面临留在家里还是接受工作的两难。

hole.example: Bad loans put the small company in a very deep hole.  不良贷款让这家小公司陷入很深的困境。

impasse.example: The talks reached an impasse over pay and working hours.  谈判在薪酬和工时上陷入僵局。

jam.example: We were in a real jam when the car broke down.  车坏了的时候我们真的很为难。

pickle.example: Losing his passport left him in a nasty pickle abroad.  丢了护照让他在国外陷入麻烦。

quagmire.example: The company slowly sank into a quagmire of lawsuits.  公司慢慢陷入了诉讼的泥潭。

rattrap.phrase_cn: 陷在进退无路的困境中
rattrap.example: The old contract turned out to be a rattrap for both sides.  那份旧合同结果对双方都是死局。

swamp.example: He was lost in a swamp of forms and old receipts.  他陷在表格和旧收据的泥潭里。

bog.example: The plan got stuck in a bog of official rules.  这个计划陷在官方规定的泥沼中。

broil.example: The village was caught in a broil over the new road.  村子因新修的路陷入一场纷争。

mirth.example: A burst of mirth from the kitchen told us the party had begun.  厨房里传来一阵欢笑，告诉我们派对已经开始了。

festivity.example: The whole street joined the festivity after the harvest.  收获之后整条街都加入了欢庆。

gaiety.example: Music and colored lights filled the square with gaiety.  音乐和彩灯让广场充满欢乐。

glee.example: The children shouted with glee when the snow began.  开始下雪时孩子们欢呼雀跃。

happiness.example: Small daily habits brought her more happiness than money did.  日常的小习惯给她的快乐比钱更多。

hilarity.example: His clumsy dance caused hilarity among all the guests.  他笨拙的舞步引得所有客人大笑。

jocundity.example: The old inn was famous for its noisy jocundity.  这家老客栈以喧闹的欢快闻名。

joviality.example: His joviality at dinner put every guest at ease.  他在饭桌上的快活让每位客人都放松了。

lightheartedness.example: There was a lightheartedness in the office before the holiday.  假期前办公室里气氛轻松愉快。

antisocial.example: Loud parties every single night are simply antisocial behavior.  每晚都吵闹的聚会纯属妨害他人的行为。

cynical.cn: 愤世嫉俗的，怀疑一切的
cynical.example: Years in politics made him cynical about every promise.  多年从政让他对任何承诺都持怀疑。

pessimistic.example: He remained pessimistic about the company's chances of survival.  他对公司生存的机会仍然持悲观态度。

dejection.example: He sat in silent dejection after the results came out.  成绩出来后他沮丧地默默坐着。

desolation.example: The empty village left an impression of complete desolation.  空无一人的村子给人彻底荒凉之感。

despondence.example: Months without work drove him into deep despondence.  数月失业让他陷入深深的沮丧。

oppression.example: The low grey sky gave her a sense of oppression.  低垂的灰色天空让她感到压抑。

annoying.example: Tapping his pen was easily his most annoying habit.  敲笔无疑是他最恼人的习惯。

impish.example: She gave an impish grin and hid the last cookie.  她顽皮地一笑，把最后一块饼干藏了起来。

naughty.example: The naughty puppy chewed both of my new shoes.  这只淘气的小狗把我两只新鞋都咬了。

misconstrue.example: Outsiders often misconstrue her quiet manner as cold arrogance.  局外人常把她安静的举止曲解为冷漠傲慢。

misapprehend.example: She misapprehended his joke and left the room angry.  她误解了他的玩笑，生气地离开了房间。

misperceive.example: Investors misperceived the risk and lost a great deal.  投资者错判了风险，损失惨重。

misread.example: He misread her polite tone as real enthusiasm.  他把她客气的语气误读成真正的热情。

brute.example: The judge called him a brute who terrorized his neighbors.  法官称他是恐吓邻居的野蛮之徒。

offender.example: Young offenders are sent to a separate facility in this state.  在这个州年轻违法者被送到单独的机构。

infraction.example: The referee stopped play to penalize a minor infraction near the goal.  裁判中断比赛，对球门附近的轻微违规进行判罚。

infringement.example: The court ruled that the logo was a clear infringement of copyright.  法院裁定该标志明显侵犯了版权。

violation.example: Parking here is a direct violation of the city ordinance.  在此停车直接违反了市政条例。

misdemeanour.example: He was fined for a misdemeanour rather than sent to prison.  他因轻罪被罚款而没有入狱。

felony.example: He was convicted of a felony and lost his license.  他被判重罪，并被吊销了执照。

niggard.example: The old niggard refused to spend a penny on heating.  这个老吝啬鬼连一分钱取暖费都不肯花。

apprehension.example: She waited for the results with growing apprehension.  她越来越忧虑地等待结果。

fear.example: His fear of speaking in public gradually faded with practice.  他对公开演讲的恐惧随练习逐渐消退。

incertitude.example: Months of incertitude about funding paralyzed the whole project.  数月对资金的不确定使整个项目停滞。

suspicion.example: Her sudden wealth aroused the suspicion of the neighbors.  她突然的财富引起了邻居的怀疑。

confidence.example: He answered every question with quiet confidence.  他从容而自信地回答了每个问题。

sureness.example: She played the difficult passage with remarkable sureness.  她极其稳准地演奏了那个难段。

surety.example: His uncle agreed to act as surety for the loan.  他叔叔同意为这笔贷款作担保。

mishap.example: A minor mishap in the kitchen delayed dinner by nearly an hour.  厨房里的一个小事故让晚饭推迟了将近一小时。

adversity.example: He faced years of adversity without ever losing his sense of humor.  他多年身处逆境，却从未失去幽默感。

ill.example: The report lists the ills afflicting the health system.  报告列出了困扰医疗系统的种种弊病。

mischance.example: By sheer mischance the letter arrived a day too late.  纯属不幸，信迟到了一天。

fortune.example: A stroke of good fortune saved the failing bakery.  一次好运救了这家濒临倒闭的面包店。

luck.example: Pure luck brought them to the only open shelter.  纯凭运气他们找到了唯一开放的避难所。

serendipity.example: Pure serendipity led the researchers to a cure they were not seeking.  纯粹的意外机缘让研究者找到了他们并未寻求的疗法。

misrelate.example: Witnesses often misrelate details of events they saw only briefly.  证人常错述他们匆匆看到的细节。

misstate.example: The company was accused of misstating its annual earnings.  该公司被指错报年度收益。

mite.example: His brief letter offered a mite of comfort during those difficult winter months.  他简短的信在那些艰难的冬月里带来了一点点安慰。

atom.example: There is not an atom of evidence for that wild claim.  这一荒诞说法没有一丝证据。

bit.example: Add just a bit of salt to the simmering sauce.  往煮着的酱汁里加一点点盐。

iota.example: He has not changed one iota since we last met.  自上次见面他一点也没变。

molecule.example: Every water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms.  每个水分子含有两个氢原子。

particle.example: Not a particle of dust was left on the polished shelf.  擦亮的架子上一粒灰尘也没剩下。

trace.example: The tea showed only a trace of bitterness.  这茶只有一丝苦味。

boodle.example: The gang hid the boodle in an abandoned barn.  这帮人把赃款藏在废弃谷仓里。

unimposing.example: The unimposing office hid one of the city's best libraries.  这不起眼的办公楼藏着城中最好的图书馆之一。

scoffing.example: He dismissed the proposal in a scoffing tone.  他用嘲笑的语气否定了这项提议。

modulate.example: She learned to modulate her voice for the small room.  她学会为这小房间调节音量。

temper.example: The judge tempered strict justice with unexpected mercy.  法官以意外的仁慈缓和了严苛的公正。

heighten.example: The long silence only heightened everyone's sense of dread.  长久的沉默只是加剧了众人的恐惧感。

modicum.example: With a modicum of luck they finished the repairs before the storm arrived.  凭着些许运气，他们在暴风雨来临前完成了修理。

pamper.example: Grandparents love to pamper the children with sweets.  祖辈爱用糖果娇宠孩子。

ill-treat.example: The farm was fined for ill-treating its animals.  该农场因虐待动物被罚款。

molt.example: Most of these birds molt in the spring and look scruffy for weeks.  这些鸟大多在春季换羽，好几周都显得邋遢。

exfoliate.example: This cream helps exfoliate the dry skin on your elbows.  这款霜有助去除肘部干皮。

exuviate.example: The snake will exuviate its old skin within a few days.  这条蛇几天内就会蜕去旧皮。

fledge.example: The young swallows fledge about three weeks after hatching.  雏燕孵出约三周后长齐羽毛。

momentum.example: The campaign gathered momentum after the debate and won three states easily.  这场竞选在辩论后积聚了势头，轻松赢下三个州。

encouragement.example: A few words of encouragement kept the young runner going.  几句鼓励的话让这位小跑者坚持下来。

incitation.example: The pamphlet was banned as an incitation to violence.  这本小册子因煽动暴力被禁。

instigation.example: The strike began at the instigation of two union leaders.  罢工是在两位工会领袖的煽动下开始的。

motivation.example: Poor pay explains the team's total lack of motivation.  报酬低解释了团队完全缺乏动力。

drudging.example: Years of drudging clerical work dulled his early ambition.  多年枯燥的文书苦工磨钝了他早年的雄心。

tiresome.example: Washing dishes by hand is a tiresome nightly chore.  手洗碗碟是每晚烦人的活。

monologue.example: He delivered a long monologue about his childhood while everyone waited politely.  他讲了一大段关于童年的独白，众人礼貌地等着。

soliloquy.example: Hamlet's famous soliloquy reveals his deepest doubts about life and death.  哈姆雷特的著名独白揭示了他对生死的深切疑问。

solo.example: She played a short violin solo before the interval.  她在中场休息前演奏了一段小提琴独奏。

speech.example: He delivered a short speech thanking all the volunteers.  他发表简短演讲感谢所有志愿者。

dialogue.example: The two sides finally opened a dialogue about wages.  双方终于就工资开启对话。

resumption.example: Everyone welcomed the resumption of the peace talks.  各方都欢迎和谈的恢复。

morbid.example: She developed a morbid fascination with old newspaper reports of unsolved crimes.  她对旧报纸上未解案件的报道产生了病态的迷恋。

diseased.example: The surgeon removed the diseased tissue from the lung.  外科医生切除了肺部的病变组织。

pathological.example: His pathological fear of failure kept him from trying anything new.  他对失败的病态恐惧使他不敢尝试任何新事物。

brainsick.example: Only a brainsick general would attack in such weather.  只有疯狂的将军才会在这种天气进攻。

crazy.example: It sounded like a crazy idea until it actually worked.  这主意听着很疯，直到它真的成功了。

deranged.example: The letters were clearly written by a deranged admirer.  这些信显然出自一个精神错乱的仰慕者。

lunatic.example: Driving at that speed in fog is simply lunatic.  在雾中以那种速度开车简直疯狂。

psychotic.example: He was hospitalized after a brief psychotic episode.  他在一次短暂的精神病发作后住院。

moribund.example: Cheap imports left the region's textile industry moribund within a single decade.  廉价进口品在十年内就让该地区的纺织业濒于消亡。

dated.example: The furniture looked hopelessly dated beside the building's new glass walls.  在大楼新的玻璃幕墙旁，这些家具显得过时至极。

fossilized.example: The department's fossilized rules discouraged every new hire.  部门僵化的规定让每个新人失望。

outworn.example: She quietly abandoned the outworn methods of her teachers.  她悄悄抛弃了老师们过时的方法。

dark.example: He fell into a dark mood after reading the letter.  读了那封信后他陷入阴郁。

sanguine.example: She remains sanguine about the harvest despite three weeks without rain.  尽管三周无雨，她对收成依然乐观。

rejoiced.cn: 欢欣，喜悦（rejoice 的过去式）
rejoiced.example: The whole village rejoiced when the missing boy finally came home.  失踪的男孩终于回家时，全村都欢欣不已。

mosaic.example: The neighborhood is a mosaic of cultures, languages, and cooking smells.  这个街区是文化、语言与烹饪气味的拼合。

monolithic.cn: 铁板一块的，僵化统一的
monolithic.example: The party was less monolithic than outsiders assumed, and quiet disagreements ran deep.  这个政党并不像外界以为的那样铁板一块，暗中的分歧很深。

homogeneous.example: The town's population is unusually homogeneous in language and faith.  该镇人口在语言和信仰上异常同质。

uniform.example: The bricks were baked to a uniform shade of red.  这些砖被烧成统一的红色。

assorted.example: She brought a box of assorted chocolates to the office.  她带了一盒什锦巧克力到办公室。

eclectic.cn: 博采众长的；不拘一格的
eclectic.example: Her taste in music is remarkably eclectic and hard to label.  她的音乐品味相当博杂，难以归类。

heterogeneous.example: The class is a heterogeneous mixture of ages and backgrounds.  这个班是年龄和背景的混杂组合。

patchwork.example: From the plane the valley looked like a patchwork of green fields.  从飞机上看，山谷像是一块块绿色田地拼成的图案。

varied.example: A varied diet keeps both cook and eater interested.  多样的饮食让做饭的和吃饭的都有兴致。

motheaten.example: His motheaten ideas about education sounded strange to the younger teachers.  他陈腐过时的教育观念在年轻教师听来很奇怪。

motile.example: Motile bacteria swam rapidly across the slide under the student's microscope.  能动的细菌在学生显微镜下的载玻片上快速游动。

movable.example: The hall is divided by movable partitions into three rooms.  大厅用可移动隔板分成三间。

portable.example: She carried a portable heater into the drafty studio.  她把便携取暖器搬进四处漏风的工作室。

transportable.example: The clinic uses transportable equipment for remote villages.  该诊所为偏远村庄使用可搬运设备。

immobile.example: The injured hiker lay immobile until help arrived.  受伤的徒步者一动不动地躺着直到救援到来。

impel.example: Curiosity impelled her to open the sealed envelope.  好奇心驱使她打开了密封的信封。

innervate.example: These fibers innervate the muscles of the lower jaw.  这些纤维为下颌肌肉提供神经。

rouse.example: The speech was meant to rouse public anger against the proposed tax.  那场演讲意在激起公众对拟征税款的愤怒。

indiscriminate.example: The indiscriminate use of pesticides harmed local bees.  杀虫剂的滥用伤害了当地蜜蜂。

magpie.example: His study is a magpie hoard of maps, coins and shells.  他的书房是地图、硬币和贝壳的杂堆。

unvaried.example: Years of unvaried routine left him restless and bored.  多年一成不变的日程让他烦躁厌倦。

mottle.example: Years of sun and rain had mottled the surface of the wooden door.  多年风吹日晒使木门表面布满了杂色斑点。

dapple.example: Sunlight through the leaves dappled the path with gold.  阳光透过树叶把小路点成金色斑驳。

marble.example: The binder marbled the endpapers in blue and cream.  装订师把封内页做成蓝白大理石纹。

splotch.example: A splotch of ink spoiled the corner of the drawing.  一块墨渍毁了画的一角。

blanch.example: He blanched visibly when the bill was handed over.  账单递来时他明显脸色发白。

multifarious.example: Her multifarious duties ranged from bookkeeping to repairing the office plumbing.  她五花八门的职责从记账到修办公室水管都有。

divers.example: The plan failed for divers reasons never fully explained.  该计划因种种从未说清的原因失败。

manifold.example: The new director faced manifold problems in her first week.  新主任第一周就面对多方面的问题。

myriad.example: The new technology opens myriad possibilities for teaching students in remote villages.  这项新技术为教偏远村庄的学生打开了无数可能。

aching.example: She wrote the letter with an aching heart.  她怀着痛苦的心写下那封信。

anguished.example: An anguished cry came from the far end of the corridor.  走廊尽头传来一声痛苦的哭喊。

sad.example: It is a sad story, but the ending offers hope.  这是个悲伤的故事，但结尾给人希望。

metaphor.example: The speech collapsed into a mixed metaphor about ships, mountains, and rising tides.  这篇演讲陷入了船、山与涨潮混杂的暗喻之中。

simile.example: The poet uses an apt simile to compare memory with drifting smoke.  诗人用一个贴切的明喻把记忆比作飘散的烟。

cloud.example: Emotional appeals only clouded the real issue.  情绪化的诉求只把真正的问题搅浑。

fog.example: Too much detail fogged the memory of what mattered.  过多细节模糊了对要点的记忆。

soften.example: Thick curtains softened the noise from the busy street.  厚窗帘减弱了闹街的噪音。

stifle.example: She tried to stifle a yawn while the speaker droned on.  演讲者絮絮不休，她努力忍住哈欠。

immovable.example: He was immovable on the question of the deadline.  在截止日期问题上他毫不动摇。

grunt.example: He merely grunted a reply and turned back to his paper.  他只咕哝了一声便又看起报纸。

openhanded.example: The openhanded donor paid for the whole library wing.  这位慷慨的捐赠者出资建了整个图书馆侧楼。

whine.example: The children whined about the long walk to the station.  孩子们抱怨去车站要走那么远。

mutate.example: The virus can mutate quickly, making last year's vaccine far less effective.  这种病毒会迅速变异，使去年的疫苗效果大减。

fluctuate.example: Oil prices fluctuated wildly throughout the autumn months.  整个秋季油价剧烈波动。

modify.example: The engineers modified the design after the first test flight.  工程师在首飞后修改了设计。

shift.example: Public opinion shifted sharply after the televised debate.  电视辩论后民意急剧转变。

vary.example: Prices vary considerably from one region of the country to another.  价格在这个国家不同地区之间差别很大。

speechless.example: The unexpected gift left her completely speechless.  这份意外的礼物让她完全说不出话。

voiceless.example: The paper claims to speak for the voiceless poor.  这家报纸声称为无话语权的穷人发声。

wordless.example: They exchanged a wordless glance and left the room.  他们交换了无言的一瞥便离开房间。

narrow-minded.example: His narrow-minded remarks embarrassed everyone at the table.  他狭隘的言论让全桌人尴尬。

far-sighted.example: The city's far-sighted policy on parks now pays off.  该市有远见的公园政策如今见到成效。

foreseeing.example: A foreseeing manager had stockpiled parts before the strike.  一位有先见之明的经理在罢工前囤了零件。

innumerable.example: Innumerable stars appeared once the city lights went out.  城灯一灭，无数星星就出现了。

uncountable.example: The beach holds uncountable grains of pale sand.  这片海滩有数不清的浅色沙粒。

untold.example: The shipwreck was said to carry untold wealth in gold.  据说那艘沉船载有数不清的黄金财富。

foot.phrase: at the foot of the hill
foot.example: A small inn stands at the foot of the mountain.  山脚下有一家小旅店。

meridian.phrase: at the meridian of his career
meridian.example: The composer died at the meridian of his creative powers.  这位作曲家在创作力顶峰时去世。

top.phrase: at the top of the list
top.example: Her name sat at the top of the shortlist.  她的名字排在候选名单最上方。

nave.example: His nave belief in the honesty of strangers led to repeated disappointment.  他对陌生人诚实的天真信念让他屡屡失望。

narcissistic.example: His narcissistic self-regard made honest conversation with him nearly impossible.  他自恋的自我关注让人几乎无法与他坦诚交谈。

egotistical.example: The egotistical actor demanded a bigger dressing room.  这位自负的演员要求更大的化妆间。

self-absorbed.cn: 只顾自己的，自我专注的
self-absorbed.example: He was too self-absorbed to notice his friend's distress.  他太自我，没注意到朋友的痛苦。

self-infatuated.example: The self-infatuated poet quoted himself all evening.  这位自恋的诗人整晚都在引用自己。

self-obsessed.cn: 自我着迷的，只想着自己的
self-obsessed.example: Her diary reads like the work of a self-obsessed teenager.  她的日记读来像自我着迷的少年所写。

self-preoccupied.example: He listened in a self-preoccupied way, waiting to speak.  他心里只顾自己地听着，只等开口。

self-forgetting.example: Her self-forgetting care for the patients moved the whole ward.  她对病人忘我的照护感动了整个病房。

emerging.example: The firm shifted its attention to emerging markets in Asia.  该公司把注意力转向亚洲新兴市场。

introductory.example: She signed up for an introductory course in statistics.  她报名了统计学入门课程。

nauseate.example: The graphic descriptions in the film nauseated much of the audience.  影片中露骨的描写让大部分观众感到恶心。

revolt.example: The smell of the spoiled milk revolted everyone in the small kitchen.  变质牛奶的气味让狭小厨房里的每个人都反胃。

nautical.example: The captain spread the old nautical charts across the table.  船长把旧航海图铺在桌上。

marine.example: Warming water is changing marine life along this coast.  海水变暖正改变这一带的海洋生物。

maritime.example: The dispute was settled under international maritime law.  这场争端依国际海事法解决。

navigational.example: A navigational error sent the ferry far off course.  一次导航失误使渡轮严重偏航。

aeronautic.example: He studied aeronautic engineering before joining the airline.  他在加入航空公司前学的是航空工程。

disallow.example: The referee disallowed the goal for an obvious offside.  裁判因明显越位判该进球无效。

hazy.example: I have only a hazy recollection of that summer.  我对那个夏天只有模糊的记忆。

nefarious.example: Investigators uncovered nefarious schemes to divert relief money into private accounts.  调查人员揭露了把救灾款转入私人账户的邪恶计谋。

villainous.example: The novel turns on a villainous plot against the king.  这部小说围绕一个针对国王的邪恶阴谋展开。

righteous.example: Her righteous indignation at the ruling filled the courtroom.  她对判决的义愤充满法庭。

negation.example: Censorship of this kind amounts to the negation of freedom of thought.  这种审查等于是对思想自由的否定。

denegation.example: His flat denegation of the charge convinced nobody.  他对指控的断然否认没说服任何人。

denial.example: The ministry issued a brief denial the same evening.  当晚该部就发表了简短的否认声明。

gainsaying.example: There is no gainsaying the value of her early research.  她早期研究的价值无可否认。

rejection.example: The committee's rejection of the plan surprised no one.  委员会否决该方案并不令人意外。

repudiation.example: The government's repudiation of the debt shocked its creditors.  政府拒付债务震惊了债权人。

acknowledgement.example: The letter contained a quiet acknowledgement of his mistake.  信中含着他对错误的低调承认。

affirmation.example: The vote was a clear affirmation of the new charter.  这次投票是对新章程的明确肯定。

avowal.example: His public avowal of support surprised everyone at the meeting.  他公开表明支持，令会上所有人意外。

abecedarian.example: Even an abecedarian can follow these first three lessons.  连初学者都能跟上这最初三课。

intrepidity.example: The pilot's intrepidity saved everyone aboard that night.  那晚飞行员的无畏救了机上所有人。

steel.example: She steeled herself and walked into the interview room.  她鼓起勇气走进面试室。

activate.example: Smoke from the toaster activated the fire alarm.  烤面包机的烟启动了火警。

nexus.example: The port city became the nexus of trade between three neighboring empires.  这座港口城市成为三个邻近帝国之间贸易的枢纽。

connection.example: Researchers found a close connection between sleep and memory.  研究者发现睡眠与记忆有密切联系。

capital.example: Milan is often called the fashion capital of Italy.  米兰常被称为意大利的时尚之都。

heart.example: Let us get to the heart of the matter quickly.  我们快点谈到问题的核心。

hub.example: The old port grew into a busy transport hub.  这座旧港发展成繁忙的交通枢纽。

nucleus.example: Four veterans formed the nucleus of the new team.  四名老将构成了新队的核心。

bite.example: She took only one small bite and pushed the plate away.  她只咬了一小口就把盘子推开了。

nip.example: He poured himself a nip of whisky and sat down by the fire.  他给自己倒了一小口威士忌，坐到火边。

peck.example: The nervous child only pecked at her dinner and left the table early.  紧张的孩子只小口吃了几下晚饭就早早离席。

nicety.example: The instruments measure temperature with great nicety, down to a hundredth of a degree.  这些仪器极为精确地测量温度，精确到百分之一度。

accuracy.example: The new sensor measures temperature with surprising accuracy.  新传感器测温精确度出人意料。

exactness.example: He described the scene with almost photographic exactness.  他几乎以照片般的精确描述了那一幕。

fineness.example: The fineness of the carving amazed every visitor.  雕刻的精细令每位参观者惊叹。

precision.example: The team executed the plan with military precision.  团队以军事般的精确执行了计划。

veracity.example: Nobody seriously questioned the veracity of her account.  没人真正质疑她叙述的真实性。

imprecision.example: Imprecision in the early measurements ruined the whole study.  早期测量的不精确毁了整项研究。

inaccuracy.example: Readers pointed out several inaccuracies in the article.  读者指出文章中几处不准确之处。

nil.example: Our chances of finishing before dark were reduced to nil by the storm.  暴风雨把我们天黑前完工的机会降到了零。

nothing.example: Months of negotiation finally came to nothing at all.  数月谈判最终毫无结果。

nullity.example: The court declared the contract a complete nullity.  法院宣布该合同完全无效。

existence.example: The society came into existence just after the war.  这个学会在战后不久成立。

ounce.example: He used every ounce of strength to lift the beam.  他用尽每一分力气抬起那根梁。

snap.example: The frightened dog snapped at the stranger's hand.  受惊的狗猛咬陌生人的手。

nightly.example: Reading aloud became their nightly ritual before bed.  朗读成了他们睡前每晚的例行事。

nighttime.example: Nighttime temperatures fell well below freezing all week.  整周夜间气温都降到冰点以下。

daily.example: A short walk is part of his daily routine.  短距离散步是他日常作息的一部分。

loathsome.example: A loathsome smell rose from the neglected drain.  无人清理的下水道升起令人厌恶的气味。

nauseating.example: The nauseating stench drove everyone out of the kitchen.  令人恶心的臭味把所有人赶出厨房。

offensive.example: His offensive remark cost him the audience's goodwill.  他无礼的言论让他失去观众好感。

gallivanting.example: He spent the summer gallivanting about the southern coast.  他整个夏天在南部海岸四处闲游。

perambulatory.example: The old scholar kept his perambulatory habit into old age.  这位老学者到晚年仍保持漫游的习惯。

ranging.example: Wide-ranging herds cross the plateau twice each year.  游走范围极广的畜群每年两次穿越高原。

vagabond.example: He led a vagabond life among the river towns.  他在河边小镇间过着流浪生活。

vagrant.example: Charity workers found the vagrant sleeping under the bridge.  慈善工作者发现那名流浪者睡在桥下。

wan-.example: The line break split wandering into wan- and dering.  换行把 wandering 拆成了 wan- 和 dering。

dering.example: Rejoining dering to wan- restores the word wandering.  把 dering 接回 wan- 就还原成 wandering。

wayfaring.example: A wayfaring stranger asked for shelter at the farmhouse.  一位漂泊的旅人到农舍求宿。

nominal.example: The museum charges a nominal fee that barely covers the cost of printing tickets.  博物馆收取象征性的费用，几乎只够印门票的成本。

perfunctory.example: He gave the report a perfunctory glance and signed it immediately.  他敷衍地扫了一眼报告就立刻签了字。

nondescript.example: They met in a nondescript building with no sign above the door.  他们在一座门上没有招牌、毫不起眼的楼房里见面。

beige.example: The report describes him as a beige figure with no strong views.  报告把他描述成一个没有鲜明主张、缺乏特征的人物。

featureless.example: The road crossed a flat, featureless plain for eighty miles.  这条路穿过八十英里平坦、毫无特征的平原。

indistinctive.example: Her indistinctive style made the paintings hard to date.  她毫无特色的风格使这些画难以断代。

vanilla.example: They chose a plain vanilla version without extra features.  他们选了没有额外功能的最普通版本。

remarkable.example: Finishing the bridge in a year was a remarkable achievement.  一年建成这座桥是非凡的成就。

half-pint.example: That half-pint of a clerk dared to argue with the boss.  那个不起眼的小职员竟敢跟老板争辩。

insignificancy.example: He dismissed the complaint as a mere insignificancy.  他把这投诉当作微末小事而不理。

lightweight.example: Critics dismissed him as a political lightweight.  批评者把他当作政治上的小角色。

snippersnapper.example: The old sergeant called the recruit an impudent snippersnapper.  老班长骂那新兵是无礼的狂妄小子。

twerp.example: Stop behaving like a twerp and apologize to her.  别再像个蠢货那样，去向她道歉。

whippersnapper.example: Some young whippersnapper tried to lecture the veteran engineer.  某个自以为是的小年轻竟教训起老工程师。

zero.example: In that crowd he felt like a complete zero.  在那群人中他觉得自己毫无分量。

zilch.example: I know zilch about repairing car engines.  我对修汽车发动机一无所知。

mogul.example: A media mogul bought the struggling newspaper last spring.  一位传媒巨头去年春天买下了这家困境中的报纸。

big shot.example: Some big shot from head office visited the branch today.  总部来的某位大人物今天视察了分行。

big wheel.phrase: a big wheel in the party
big wheel.example: Her father was a big wheel in the local union.  她父亲是当地工会的实权人物。

bigwig.example: Every local bigwig turned up for the ribbon cutting.  当地每位大人物都来参加剪彩。

magnate.example: A shipping magnate funded the whole research station.  一位航运大亨资助了整个研究站。

personage.example: A distinguished personage opened the exhibition without a speech.  一位显要人物没有讲话就为展览开幕。

somebody.example: He left the village determined to become somebody.  他离开村子，决心成为有头有脸的人。

numinous.example: The empty stone chapel had a numinous quality that silenced every visitor.  空荡的石砌小教堂有种神秘气息，让每位来访者都沉默下来。

magic.example: The children believed a magic spell protected the old oak.  孩子们相信有魔咒护着那棵老橡树。

magical.example: Candlelight gave the small chapel a magical atmosphere.  烛光让这座小教堂有了神奇的氛围。

attain.example: She attained her doctorate before turning twenty-six.  她在二十六岁前取得了博士学位。

bag.example: The rookie bagged three medals at his first meet.  这名新手在首场比赛就拿下三枚奖牌。

chalk up.example: The team chalked up its fifth win of the season.  该队取得本季第五场胜利。

clock up.example: He clocked up thirty thousand miles in one year.  他一年累计跑了三万英里。

gain.example: Her essays gained recognition well beyond the campus.  她的文章赢得了远超校园的认可。

rack up.example: The store racked up huge losses over the winter.  这家店整个冬天累积了巨额亏损。

ring up.example: The shop rang up record sales during the festival.  这家店在节日期间创下销售记录。

score.example: She scored the winning point in the final second.  她在最后一秒拿下制胜分。

win.example: Their small documentary won an award in Berlin.  他们的小纪录片在柏林获奖。

unaccustomed.example: Unaccustomed to the cold, he wore three sweaters indoors.  他不习惯寒冷，在室内穿了三件毛衣。

unheard-of.cn: 前所未闻的，闻所未闻的
unheard-of.example: The painting sold for an unheard-of price that night.  那晚这幅画以闻所未闻的价格成交。

unknown.example: The diary was written by an unknown author in 1830.  这本日记由一位无名作者于1830年写成。

unprecedented.example: The city saw unprecedented growth in a single decade.  这座城市在十年间实现前所未有的增长。

time-honored.cn: 历史悠久的，因古老而受尊重的
time-honored.example: They opened the harvest with a time-honored village custom.  他们以历史悠久的村俗开始收获季。

warmed-over.example: The speech offered only warmed-over arguments from last year.  这篇讲话只是去年论点的老调重弹。

unwholesome.example: Her parents thought the crowd an unwholesome influence.  她父母认为那群人是不良影响。

abominable.example: His abominable behavior at dinner shocked the guests.  他晚餐时可憎的举止让客人震惊。

awful.example: An awful smell came from the forgotten lunchbox.  被遗忘的饭盒里飘出难闻的气味。

distasteful.example: She found the whole discussion deeply distasteful.  她觉得整场讨论令人极不舒服。

fulsome.example: His fulsome praise embarrassed everyone in the room.  他过分的赞美让屋里每个人尴尬。

horrid.example: The flight home turned into a horrid experience.  回家的航班变成一段糟糕的经历。

hurtless.example: The herb is hurtless even in fairly large doses.  这种草药即使较大剂量也无害。

nuance.example: Translators must capture subtle nuances of meaning that dictionaries rarely explain well.  译者必须捕捉词典很少能解释清楚的微妙意义差异。

patent difference.example: There is a patent difference between the two translations.  两个译本之间有明显的差别。

lack of subtlety.phrase: a lack of subtlety in color
lack of subtlety.example: Critics noted a lack of subtlety in his later work.  评论者指出他后期作品缺乏细腻。

sharp distinction.example: The author draws a sharp distinction between guilt and shame.  作者对罪感与羞耻作出鲜明区分。

patency.example: The patency of the contradiction embarrassed the whole committee.  矛盾如此明显，让整个委员会尴尬。

press.example: He pressed the button twice before the lift moved.  他按了两次按钮电梯才动。

major.example: Water shortage remains a major concern for the region.  缺水仍是该地区的主要关切。

unfrivolous.example: She raised an unfrivolous objection that delayed the vote.  她提出一个严肃的反对意见，推迟了表决。

edify.example: The lectures were meant to edify rather than entertain.  这些讲座意在教化而非娱乐。

stunt.example: Poor nutrition can stunt the growth of children in their early years.  营养不良会阻碍儿童早年的生长。

obtrusive.example: An obtrusive advertisement covered half the historic facade of the old theater.  一幅扎眼的广告遮住了老剧院半面历史立面。

intruding.example: An intruding noise from the street spoiled the recording.  街上扰人的噪音毁了这次录音。

highlighted.example: Please read the highlighted passage on the second page.  请读第二页被标出的段落。

unobtrusive.example: The hotel's unobtrusive service won it loyal guests.  这家酒店不张扬的服务赢得了忠实客人。

hard - nosed.example: Their hard-nosed negotiator refused every early offer.  他们强硬的谈判代表拒绝了所有早期报价。

compassionless.example: The compassionless verdict drew protests outside the courthouse.  这冷酷的判决在法院外引发抗议。

hard-hearted.example: Only a hard-hearted landlord would evict them in winter.  只有冷酷的房东才会在冬天赶他们走。

inhuman.example: The report described inhuman treatment inside the camp.  报告描述了营地内残忍的对待。

ironhearted.example: Even the ironhearted commander hesitated before that order.  连铁石心肠的指挥官在那道命令前也犹豫了。

softhearted.example: The softhearted judge suspended most of the sentence.  心软的法官缓期执行了大部分刑罚。

contrary.example: The contrary child refused whatever his mother suggested.  这执拗的孩子对母亲的建议一概拒绝。

froward.example: The froward apprentice ignored every warning from his master.  这倔强的学徒无视师父的每一次警告。

insubor-.example: The line break left insubor- stranded at the margin.  换行把 insubor- 孤零零留在页边。

dinate.example: Joining dinate to insubor- gives the word insubordinate.  把 dinate 接到 insubor- 上便得到 insubordinate。

una-.example: The scan split unamenable into una- and menable.  扫描把 unamenable 拆成 una- 和 menable。

menable.example: Read menable together with una- to recover the adjective.  把 menable 与 una- 合读才能还原该形容词。

obeisance.example: Court officials made obeisance to the king before presenting their petitions.  朝臣们在呈上请愿书之前向国王行礼致敬。

explain clearly.example: A good teacher can explain clearly without simplifying too much.  好老师能清楚解释而不过度简化。

selective.cn: 有选择性的，严格筛选的
selective.example: This college is highly selective and turns down most applicants.  这所学院筛选严格，拒绝了大多数申请者。

obliging.example: An obliging neighbor watered our plants every day while we were away.  一位乐于帮忙的邻居在我们外出期间每天给植物浇水。

accommodative.example: The landlord took an accommodative attitude toward late rent.  房东对迟交房租采取通融态度。

leaning.example: The leaning wall was propped up with heavy timbers.  倾斜的墙用粗木支撑起来。

sloping.example: Rain ran quickly off the steeply sloping roof.  雨水迅速从陡斜的屋顶流下。

even.example: Sand the board until the surface feels perfectly even.  把板子打磨到表面完全平整。

level.example: Pitch the tent on level ground away from the stream.  把帐篷搭在远离溪水的平地上。

wipe out.example: One bad season wiped out the family's savings.  一个糟糕的季节抹光了这家人的储蓄。

incognizant.example: The swimmers were incognizant of the strong current below.  游泳者未意识到水下的强流。

vigilant.example: Guards must remain vigilant throughout the long and quiet night shift.  守卫在漫长安静的夜班中必须始终保持警惕。

billingsgate.example: The driver let loose a stream of billingsgate at us.  那司机对我们大骂一连串脏话。

fulmination.example: His nightly fulminations against the press amused nobody.  他每晚对媒体的痛斥没让谁觉得有趣。

scurrility.example: The debate soon descended into open scurrility.  辩论很快沦为公开的恶言辱骂。

vitriol.example: Reviewers poured vitriol on the director's second film.  评论者对导演的第二部片恶言相加。

vituperation.example: She endured a torrent of vituperation without replying once.  她忍受一阵谩骂而一句未回。

fuliginous.example: A fuliginous haze hung over the factory district.  厂区上空笼罩着烟黑的雾霭。

blear.example: Tears and smoke bleared his vision at the doorway.  眼泪和烟雾使他在门口视线模糊。

darken.example: Heavy clouds darkened the valley by mid-afternoon.  厚云在午后使山谷变暗。

noteless.example: He was born in a noteless village near the border.  他生在边境附近一个无名村庄。

uncelebrated.example: She remains an uncelebrated pioneer of early radio.  她仍是早期广播一位未受赞誉的先驱。

unfamous.example: The gallery deliberately shows work by unfamous painters.  这家画廊有意展出不出名画家的作品。

unrecognized.cn: 未被认可的，未被认出的
unrecognized.example: His talent went unrecognized until long after his death.  他的才华直到死后很久才被认可。

unsung.example: The unsung engineers behind the project never appeared in any press photo.  项目背后那些默默无闻的工程师从未出现在任何新闻照片里。

nonambiguous.example: The contract needs nonambiguous wording about delivery dates.  合同需要关于交货日期的无歧义措辞。

legendary.example: The legendary singer gave her last concert here.  那位传奇歌手在此举行了最后一场演唱会。

noted.example: A noted scholar of Persian poetry opened the conference.  一位知名的波斯诗歌学者为会议开幕。

well-known.example: It is a well-known fact that the bridge leaks.  这座桥漏水是众所周知的事实。

obsequious.example: The waiter's obsequious flattery made the whole table distinctly uncomfortable.  侍者谄媚的奉承让整桌人都明显不自在。

obsess.example: He was obsessed with detail and rewrote every paragraph at least four times.  他痴迷于细节，每段都至少重写四遍。

intensively disgust.example: Scenes of cruelty intensively disgust most ordinary viewers.  残酷场面使多数普通观众强烈厌恶。

disciplined.example: Her disciplined class worked quietly without any supervision.  她那守纪律的班级无人监督也安静做事。

biddable.example: The biddable pupil did every task without complaint.  那听话的学生毫无抱怨地完成每项任务。

oafish.example: His oafish manners at dinner offended the host.  他晚餐时粗笨的举止得罪了主人。

vacuous.example: He answered the difficult question with a vacuous stare and a shrug.  面对这个难题，他只是茫然地望着，耸了耸肩。

brainy.example: The brainy student solved the puzzle in two minutes.  那个聪明的学生两分钟就解开了谜题。

sharp-witted.example: Her sharp-witted reply silenced the whole panel.  她机敏的回答让整个评审团哑然。

stave off.example: A handful of nuts staved off hunger until dinner.  一把坚果挡住了到晚餐前的饥饿。

head off.example: Early talks headed off a crisis at the plant.  及早的谈判避免了厂里的一场危机。

readily fathomable.example: The manual states readily fathomable rules for new users.  手册为新用户给出容易理解的规则。

hankering.example: He felt a sudden hankering for his grandmother's cooking.  他忽然渴望祖母做的饭菜。

infatuation.example: Her infatuation with the city faded after one winter.  她对这座城市的迷恋在一个冬天后消退。

queer.example: A queer feeling told her the house was empty.  一种奇怪的感觉告诉她房子是空的。

out-of-the-way.cn: 不寻常的，稀奇的；偏僻的
out-of-the-way.example: She collects out-of-the-way facts that surprise even seasoned quiz players.  她收集稀奇少见的知识，连资深答题者都感到意外。

officious.example: An officious clerk insisted we fill out two forms we clearly did not need.  一位爱管闲事的职员非要我们填两份明显不需要的表格。

interfering.example: An interfering aunt rearranged their whole kitchen.  一位爱插手的姑妈把他们厨房全重摆了。

meddlesome.example: Their meddlesome neighbor reported every small noise.  他们多事的邻居举报了每一点小声响。

snoopy.example: Their snoopy landlady read the postcards before delivering them.  他们爱窥探的女房东送信前先读明信片。

warm.example: The villagers gave the travelers a warm welcome.  村民热情欢迎了这些旅人。

offkey.example: His offkey remark about her divorce silenced the entire dinner table.  他关于她离婚的不合适言论让整桌人都沉默了。

ominous.example: An ominous silence fell over the crowd as the announcement began.  宣布开始时，人群陷入不祥的沉默。

auspicious.example: Rain on the wedding day was considered an auspicious beginning.  婚礼当天下雨被认为是个好兆头的开端。

omniscient.example: The novel uses an omniscient narrator who knows every character's private thoughts.  这部小说用了一位知晓每个角色私密想法的全知叙述者。

requiring little effort.example: Sorting the cards is a task requiring little effort.  给卡片分类是毫不费力的任务。

nondemanding.example: She chose a nondemanding job to leave time for painting.  她选了份轻松的工作，好留出时间画画。

opine.example: Several economists opined on the matter without agreeing on a single figure.  几位经济学家就此事发表看法，却未就任何一个数字达成一致。

comment.example: Officials declined to comment on the ongoing investigation.  官员拒绝就正在进行的调查发表评论。

editorialize.cn: 发表社论；加入个人观点
editorialize.example: The reporter began to editorialize instead of stating facts.  这名记者开始发表个人议论，而非陈述事实。

note.example: The judge noted that both accounts were plainly inconsistent.  法官指出两份陈述明显互相矛盾。

reflect.example: The rising sales figures reflect a real change in consumer confidence.  销售数字上升反映出消费者信心的真实变化。

weigh in.example: Several economists weighed in on the proposed tax reform.  几位经济学家就拟议的税改发表了意见。

opportune.example: She waited for an opportune moment to raise the question of salary.  她等着一个恰当的时机提出薪资问题。

seasonable.example: His seasonable warning saved the crop from frost damage.  他及时的警告使庄稼免遭霜害。

well-timed.example: Her well-timed joke eased the tension in the room.  她时机恰当的玩笑缓解了室内的紧张。

untimely.example: The untimely rain ruined the outdoor ceremony completely.  不合时宜的大雨彻底毁了露天典礼。

unseasonable.cn: 不合季节的；不合时宜的
unseasonable.example: Unseasonable heat in March confused the valley's fruit trees.  三月反常的高温让谷中的果树错乱了。

contumelious.example: His contumelious tone offended nearly everyone at the meeting.  他傲慢无礼的语气几乎冒犯了会上所有人。

disgraceful.example: Their disgraceful conduct cost the team its main sponsorship.  他们可耻的行为使球队失去了主要赞助。

shameful.example: It was shameful to abandon the injured climber on the ridge.  把受伤的登山者丢在山脊上很可耻。

unrespectable.example: He drifted into unrespectable circles soon after leaving school.  离校后他很快混进了不体面的圈子。

honorable.example: She made the honorable choice and returned all the money.  她做出可敬的选择，把钱全退了回去。

good repute.example: The firm has long enjoyed good repute among local builders.  这家公司在当地建筑商中素有好声誉。

outrageous.example: Charging fifty dollars for a sandwich seems outrageous to most travelers.  一个三明治收五十美元，对大多数旅客来说太离谱了。

acceptable.example: The revised offer seemed acceptable to both sides.  修改后的提议似乎双方都能接受。

bearable.example: Music made the long night shift almost bearable.  音乐让漫长的夜班几乎可以忍受。

endurable.example: The desert heat was endurable only in the early morning.  沙漠的酷热只有清晨才能忍受。

tolerable.example: Conditions in the shelter were crowded but tolerable.  避难所里拥挤，但还能忍受。

ate.example: We ate a light lunch before the long afternoon hike.  下午长途徒步前我们吃了顿简餐。

orient.example: New employees need a week to orient themselves to the company culture.  新员工需要一周时间来熟悉公司文化。

orientate.example: The guide helped us orientate ourselves with a paper map.  导游用纸质地图帮我们确定了方位。

earliest.example: The earliest records of the town date from the twelfth century.  这座城镇最早的记录始于十二世纪。

foremost.example: She is the foremost authority on medieval stained glass.  她是中世纪彩色玻璃领域最权威的学者。

headmost.example: The headmost carriage of the train was almost empty.  列车最前面的车厢几乎空着。

inaugural.example: The orchestra's inaugural concert sold out within hours.  该乐团的首场音乐会数小时内售罄。

leadoff.example: His leadoff question set the tone for the whole interview.  他开场的提问定下了整场访谈的调子。

maiden.example: The ship sank on its maiden voyage across the Atlantic.  这艘船在首次横渡大西洋时沉没。

premier.example: Cambridge remains a premier center for cancer research.  剑桥仍是癌症研究的首要中心。

virgin.example: Loggers finally reached the last virgin forest in the valley.  伐木者终于抵达谷中最后一片原始森林。

final.example: The final chapter explains why the theory was abandoned.  最后一章解释了该理论为何被放弃。

last.example: He was the last fluent speaker of that dying language.  他是那种濒危语言最后一位流利使用者。

latter.example: Of the two plans, the latter proved far cheaper.  两个方案中，后者便宜得多。

ultimate.example: Independence was the ultimate aim of their long struggle.  独立是他们长期斗争的最终目标。

ceremonial.example: The king wore ceremonial robes for the annual procession.  国王为年度游行穿上礼袍。

freewheeling.cn: 随心所欲的，不受拘束的
freewheeling.example: His freewheeling style annoyed the more orthodox critics.  他随心所欲的风格惹恼了较正统的批评家。

informal.example: They settled the dispute through informal talks over coffee.  他们在咖啡桌旁通过非正式交谈解决了争端。

oscillate.example: Public opinion oscillated wildly during the long campaign.  漫长的竞选期间民意剧烈摇摆。

transcend conventions.example: Great artists transcend conventions rather than merely break them.  伟大的艺术家超越常规，而不只是打破常规。

amenable to change.cn: 愿意变通的，易于改变的
amenable to change.example: A healthy institution stays amenable to change over time.  健康的机构会长期保持乐于变革。

unflamboyant.example: His unflamboyant suits contrasted with his loud opinions.  他朴素的西装与他张扬的观点形成对比。

unflashy.example: She favored unflashy clothes and quiet neighborhood restaurants.  她偏爱低调的衣着和安静的街边餐馆。

ostracize.example: Colleagues ostracized him after he reported the fraud.  他举报欺诈后被同事排斥。

bounce.example: The manager bounced two waiters for stealing tips.  经理因偷小费开除了两名侍者。

bootout.example: The landlord threatened to bootout the noisy upstairs tenants.  房东威胁要赶走楼上吵闹的房客。

castout.example: The village voted to castout the man who betrayed them.  村里投票要驱逐那个背叛他们的人。

runoff.example: The two leading candidates met again in a runoff.  两位领先的候选人在决胜选举中再度交锋。

drumout.example: The academy voted to drumout the cadet who cheated.  学院投票开除了那名作弊的学员。

kickout.example: They threatened to kickout anyone who missed three rehearsals.  他们威胁要开除任何缺席三次排练的人。

throw.cn: 扔，投；（与 out 连用）逐出
throw.example: Guards threw the heckler out of the crowded hall.  保安把那个捣乱者扔出了拥挤的大厅。

out.example: The committee voted him out soon after the scandal broke.  丑闻爆发后不久委员会就投票把他赶了出去。

turf out.example: The council moved to turf out families living in the derelict block.  议会着手赶走住在废弃楼里的家庭。

boot out.example: Members voted to boot out the treasurer who lost the funds.  会员投票赶走了亏掉资金的财务主管。

drum out.example: He was drummed out of the regiment for repeated insubordination.  他因屡次抗命被逐出部队。

turn out.example: The bank turned the family out of their farmhouse in winter.  银行在冬天把那家人赶出了农舍。

outfox.example: The small studio outfoxed the giants with one clever release.  这家小工作室凭一次巧妙发行智胜巨头。

outslick.example: He tried to outslick the negotiators and lost the contract.  他想耍手段胜过谈判方，结果丢了合同。

outsmart.example: The thieves outsmarted every alarm in the museum that night.  那晚窃贼智胜了博物馆的所有警报。

outthink.cn: 在思考上胜过，谋略上超越
outthink.example: A patient player can outthink a faster but reckless rival.  沉稳的选手能在谋略上胜过更快却莽撞的对手。

outwit.example: The clever fox managed to outwit the hunters and slip into the forest.  聪明的狐狸智胜了猎人，溜进了森林。

nonexotic.example: The garden used only nonexotic species native to the region.  这座花园只用本地原生的非外来物种。

unglamorous.example: Most research is unglamorous, patient work in a quiet lab.  多数研究是安静实验室里不光鲜的耐心工作。

unromantic.example: His unromantic account of the voyage listed only costs and dates.  他对航行的平实叙述只列了费用和日期。

outmaneuver.example: She outmaneuvered older rivals to win the committee's support.  她在策略上胜过资深对手，赢得委员会支持。

alpha.example: Curiosity was the alpha of his entire scientific career.  好奇心是他整个科学生涯的开端。

incipience.example: The disease is easiest to treat at its incipience.  这种病在初期阶段最容易治疗。

overlap.example: Our two research projects overlap in several important areas.  我们两个研究项目在几个重要领域有重叠。

lap.example: The roofer lapped each shingle over the one below it.  屋顶工让每块瓦叠盖住下面那块。

overlay.example: Engineers overlaid the old chart with new survey data.  工程师把新测量数据叠加在旧图上。

overlie.example: Thick clay deposits overlie the limestone across the whole plain.  厚厚的黏土层覆盖着整片平原的石灰岩。

overspread.example: Mist overspread the valley before the sun rose.  日出前雾气铺满了整个山谷。

shadowy.example: Money reached the party through a shadowy network of donors.  资金通过隐秘的捐款人网络流向该党。

preliminary.example: Preliminary results suggested the drug slowed the disease.  初步结果显示该药延缓了病情。

warm-up.example: The band played a short warm-up before the headline set.  乐队在主场演出前做了简短的热身表演。

curtain-raiser.example: The parade served as a curtain-raiser to the summer festival.  游行成了夏季节庆的开幕活动。

oxymoron.example: The phrase deafening silence is a famous oxymoron used by many poets.  「震耳欲聋的沉默」是许多诗人用过的著名矛盾修饰。

tantrum.example: The tired child threw a tantrum in the middle of the store.  疲倦的孩子在商店中央大发脾气。

padding.example: The essay would be much stronger without so much padding in the middle.  这篇文章若去掉中间那么多废话会有力得多。

elaboration.example: The proposal was accepted after some elaboration of the budget.  预算经一番详述后，提案获得通过。

embroidery.example: His memoir contains obvious embroidery of a modest career.  他的回忆录对平凡的经历明显有所渲染。

stretching.example: Calling that a discovery is a stretching of the term.  把那称为发现，是对这个词的夸大。

meiosis.example: Calling the storm a shower is meiosis, not honesty.  把风暴说成小雨是含蓄陈述，而非诚实。

citation.example: She received a citation for bravery after the rescue.  救援之后她获得了英勇嘉奖。

eulogium.example: The old professor delivered a graceful eulogium for his student.  老教授为学生致了一篇优雅的颂词。

palatable.example: The chef made the healthy vegetables surprisingly palatable to the children.  厨师把健康的蔬菜做得让孩子们意外地喜欢。

blessed.example: After the noise, the silence was a blessed relief.  喧闹过后，寂静是极大的宽慰。

delectable.example: She served a delectable dessert made from summer berries.  她端上用夏日莓果做的美味甜点。

delightsome.example: They wandered through a delightsome garden full of roses.  他们漫步在满是玫瑰的怡人花园里。

dreamy.example: They spent a dreamy evening beside the quiet lake.  他们在静湖边度过了一个美妙的夜晚。

grateful.example: The travelers rested in the grateful shade of an old oak.  旅人们在老橡树宜人的树荫下歇息。

luscious.example: The market sold luscious peaches picked that morning.  市场上卖着当天早上采的甘美桃子。

pleasurable.example: Reading aloud together became a pleasurable evening habit.  一起朗读成了愉快的晚间习惯。

pleasureless.example: Years of pleasureless work had drained his curiosity.  多年毫无乐趣的工作耗尽了他的好奇心。

unpalatable.cn: 难吃的；令人难以接受的
unpalatable.example: The report contained several unpalatable truths about spending.  报告里有几条关于开支的难堪真相。

unwelcome.example: His arrival brought unwelcome news about the closing factory.  他的到来带来了关于工厂停产的坏消息。

palatial.example: The old bank had a palatial marble hall.  那家老银行有一座宫殿般的大理石厅堂。

deluxe.example: They booked a deluxe suite overlooking the harbor.  他们订了一间可俯瞰港口的豪华套房。

no-frills.cn: 不加装饰的，简朴实用的
no-frills.example: They flew a no-frills airline with no meals included.  他们坐了一家不含餐食的简朴廉价航空。

increase intensity.example: Stopping the medication may increase intensity of the symptoms.  停药可能加剧症状的程度。

ashen.example: He came back from the hospital with an ashen face.  他从医院回来时脸色灰白。

ashy.example: Her ashy complexion alarmed everyone at the table.  她灰白的脸色让餐桌上的人都吃了一惊。

pasty.example: Weeks indoors left him with a pasty complexion.  数周待在室内使他气色苍白。

piquant.example: His piquant remarks kept the whole table laughing through dinner.  他令人振奋的妙语让整桌人整顿晚餐都在笑。

palmy.example: He liked to reminisce about the palmy days of the family business.  他喜欢追忆家族生意繁荣的那些年。

flourishing.example: The port supported a flourishing trade in spices.  这座港口支撑起兴旺的香料贸易。

prosperous.example: The harbor grew into a prosperous merchant town within a single generation.  这个港口在一代人的时间里发展成繁盛的商镇。

thriving.example: The town has a thriving market every Saturday morning.  这个镇每周六上午都有兴旺的集市。

booming.example: A booming tech sector pushed rents beyond most salaries.  科技业的繁荣把租金推高到多数薪水之上。

failed.example: He returned home after a failed venture in the capital.  在首都创业失败后他返回家乡。

unprosperous.example: The mine's closure left an unprosperous valley behind it.  矿场关闭留下了一个不景气的山谷。

unsuccessful.example: After three unsuccessful attempts, she changed her method.  三次尝试失败后，她改变了方法。

chaffer.example: The two traders chaffered over the price for an hour.  两个商人为价格磨了一个小时。

dicker.example: They dickered over delivery terms until both sides tired.  他们就交货条款争到双方都累了。

horse-trade.cn: 讨价还价，互相让步交易
horse-trade.example: Senators horse-traded for weeks before the bill finally passed.  参议员们讨价还价数周，法案才终获通过。

niggling.cn: 微不足道的；恼人琐碎的
niggling.example: A niggling doubt about the figures kept him awake.  对那些数字的一丝疑虑让他难以入睡。

piddling.example: They offered a piddling sum for months of demanding work.  他们为数月繁重的工作只给了微不足道的一笔钱。

piffling.example: The committee wasted hours on piffling procedural questions.  委员会在琐碎的程序问题上浪费了数小时。

panache.example: She delivered the closing argument with remarkable panache and confidence.  她以非凡的张扬气派和自信做了结案陈词。

unremarkable behavior.example: His unremarkable behavior at school gave no hint of later fame.  他在校时平淡的表现丝毫看不出日后的名声。

dullness.example: The dullness of the report hid several important findings.  这份报告的乏味掩盖了几项重要发现。

pandemic.example: A pandemic of wild rumors swept the campus within a single afternoon.  一个下午之内，各种狂想谣言就在校园里大范围流传。
pandemic.cn: 大范围流行的；大流行病

hubbub.example: We could barely talk above the hubbub of the crowd.  在人群的喧闹中我们几乎无法交谈。

moil.example: He escaped the moil of the city for a quiet island.  他逃离城市的喧扰，去了个安静的小岛。

pother.example: The announcement raised a pother among the shareholders.  这则公告在股东中引起一阵骚动。

ruckus.example: The decision caused a ruckus at the neighborhood meeting.  这一决定在社区会议上引起骚动。

ruction.example: His careless remark started a ruction in the newsroom.  他不慎的一句话在编辑部闹出一场风波。

denunciation.example: Her speech was a fierce denunciation of the new policy.  她的演讲是对新政策的猛烈谴责。

condemnation.example: The raid drew swift condemnation from neighboring states.  这次袭击迅速招致邻国的谴责。

cyclopedic.example: He had cyclopedic knowledge of every bird on the coast.  他对海岸上每种鸟都有百科式的了解。

embracive.cn: 包容广泛的，涵盖面广的
embracive.example: The law uses an embracive definition of public property.  该法律对公共财产采用涵盖面很广的定义。

in-depth.example: The magazine ran an in-depth study of village schools.  这家杂志刊登了对乡村学校的深入研究。

provenance.example: Experts still dispute the provenance of the vase found in the tomb.  专家们对墓中出土花瓶的来源仍有争议。

derivation.example: Scholars dispute the derivation of the village's odd name.  学者们对这个村子怪名的由来有争议。

fountain.example: The old librarian was a fountain of local history.  那位老图书馆员是地方史的活源泉。

wellspring.example: Childhood summers became the wellspring of all his novels.  童年的夏天成了他所有小说的源泉。

paradigm.example: This small library is a paradigm of thoughtful modern design.  这座小图书馆是精心现代设计的典范。

example.example: The chapel is a fine example of early Gothic building.  这座礼拜堂是早期哥特建筑的绝佳范例。

exemplar.example: Her career remains an exemplar of patient scientific work.  她的生涯至今仍是耐心科研的典范。

model.example: The clinic became a model of efficiency for the region.  这家诊所成了全区效率的典范。

pattern.example: The reform became a pattern for other cities to follow.  这项改革成了其他城市效法的样板。

paragon.example: The old librarian was a paragon of patience with every noisy student.  那位老图书馆员对每个吵闹的学生都是耐心的典范。

paradise.example: Reading quietly by the lake all afternoon was pure paradise for her.  整个下午在湖边静静读书对她来说是极大的快乐。

gloominess.example: A general gloominess settled over the town that winter.  那年冬天，一片阴郁笼罩着小镇。

paradox.example: It is a paradox that the richest country has so many hungry children.  最富有的国家却有这么多饥饿的孩子，这是个悖论。

incongruity.example: The incongruity between his words and his actions puzzled everyone.  他言行之间的不一致让所有人困惑。

assimilate.phrase_cn: 把一个案例比拟另一个
assimilate.example: Critics assimilate her early work to French realism.  批评家把她的早期作品比作法国现实主义。

compare.example: The poet compared memory to a house with locked rooms.  诗人把记忆比作有锁着房间的屋子。

match.example: Few players could match his skill on wet grass.  湿草地上少有球员比得上他的技艺。

predominant.example: Rice remains the predominant crop in the southern valleys.  稻米仍是南部谷地的主要作物。

primary.example: Safety was the primary concern in redesigning the bridge.  重新设计桥梁时安全是首要关切。

secondary.example: Cost was secondary to safety in the final decision.  在最终决定中，成本次于安全。

paranoid.example: He grew paranoid, convinced that his neighbors were reading his mail.  他变得多疑，确信邻居在偷看他的信件。

nervous.example: She grew nervous about the results as the week passed.  一周过去，她对结果越来越不安。

unbelieving.example: He met the explanation with an unbelieving stare.  他用怀疑的目光回应这个解释。

worried.example: Parents were worried about the flooded road to school.  家长为通往学校的淹水路面担忧。

paraphrase.example: Please paraphrase the main argument in two or three simple sentences.  请用两三句简单的话转述主要论点。

rephrase.example: Let me rephrase the question in simpler terms.  让我用更简单的说法重问一遍。

restate.example: She restated the main point so everyone could follow.  她重述了要点，让大家都跟得上。

reword.example: The lawyers carefully reworded the clause about late payment.  律师们仔细改写了关于逾期付款的条款。

translate.example: He translated the letters from Russian into plain English.  他把这些信从俄语译成平实的英语。

quote.example: The editor asked her to quote the passage exactly.  编辑要求她一字不差地引用该段。

discontinuity.example: Geologists found a sharp discontinuity in the rock layers.  地质学家在岩层中发现一处明显的断裂。

intermission.example: We bought coffee during the long intermission.  漫长的中场休息时我们买了咖啡。

interstice.example: Moss grew in the interstices of the old stone wall.  苔藓长在老石墙的缝隙里。

pariah.example: After the scandal he became a pariah among his former colleagues.  丑闻之后，他成了前同事中被排斥的人。

castaway.example: The novel follows a castaway on an empty coral island.  小说讲述一名漂流者在无人珊瑚岛上的经历。

castoff.example: The shelter took in castoffs whom no one else wanted.  这家收容所接纳了无人愿要的被弃者。

leper.cn: 被众人回避的人；麻风病人
leper.example: After the scandal he was treated like a leper at work.  丑闻之后他在单位被当作瘟神般回避。

respectable person.example: Neighbors described him as a quiet, respectable person.  邻居们说他是个安静而体面的人。

parity.example: The union fought for years to achieve parity in pay between both branches.  工会奋斗多年，以实现两个分部之间的薪酬平等。

coequality.example: The charter insists on the coequality of all member states.  该章程坚持所有成员国地位完全平等。

coordinateness.example: Grammarians stress the coordinateness of these two clauses.  语法学家强调这两个分句的并列关系。

equality.example: The movement fought for equality before the law.  这场运动争取法律面前的平等。

equivalency.example: The college granted her an equivalency for foreign credits.  学院对她的国外学分给予等值认定。

par.example: Their new engine is on a par with the German design.  他们的新引擎与德国设计不分高下。

sameness.example: A dull sameness marked every house on the street.  街上每栋房子都是沉闷的雷同。

imparity.example: The report exposed a clear imparity of treatment between branches.  报告揭露了各分部间明显的待遇不对等。

inequality.phrase_cn: 日益扩大的收入不平等
inequality.example: Growing income inequality worried even the bank's economists.  日益扩大的收入不平等甚至令银行经济学家担忧。

paroxysm.example: The assassination touched off a paroxysm of unrest across the whole region.  那场刺杀在整个地区引发了一场动荡的爆发。

bouleversement.example: The election produced a bouleversement no analyst had predicted.  这次选举造成了无人预料的政治剧变。

earthquake.example: The verdict was a political earthquake for the ruling party.  这项判决对执政党是一场政治地震。

parrot.example: The students merely parrot the textbook instead of forming their own opinions.  学生们只是机械复述课本，而不形成自己的观点。

ditto.example: The junior members simply dittoed whatever the chairman said.  年轻成员只是照搬主席说的话。

duplicate.example: Keep an exact duplicate of the contract in a separate locked drawer.  把合同的一份完全一样的副本另放在一个上锁的抽屉里。

echo.example: Younger delegates simply echoed the governor's opinion.  年轻代表只是附和州长的意见。

scape.example: The village scaped the worst of the flood by sheer luck.  这个村子纯凭运气躲过了洪水最猛的部分。

stinting.example: He was stinting with praise but generous with advice.  他吝于赞扬，却乐于给建议。

tight.example: Her uncle was famously tight with money all his life.  她舅舅一生在钱上出名地抠。

deficient.example: The diet was deficient in iron and essential vitamins.  这种饮食缺乏铁和必需的维生素。

fragmental.example: Only fragmental evidence of the settlement has survived.  该聚落只留下零碎的证据。

fragmentary.example: Our knowledge of his early years remains fragmentary.  我们对他早年的了解仍是零碎的。

half.example: Half measures will not fix a bridge this badly cracked.  半吊子办法修不好裂得这么厉害的桥。

halfway.example: They settled on a halfway solution that pleased nobody.  他们采取了一个谁都不满意的折中方案。

particularize.example: The judge asked the lawyer to particularize the charges against his client.  法官要求律师详述针对其委托人的各项指控。

detail.example: The manual details every step of the assembly process.  手册详述了装配流程的每一步。

specificate.example: The old contract tried to specificate every possible duty.  这份旧合同试图逐项列明每一项义务。

specify.example: Please specify the exact date and place of delivery.  请明确说明交付的确切日期和地点。

shorten.example: The editor shortened his rambling article by half.  编辑把他冗长的文章删短了一半。

jungle.example: Applicants face a jungle of overlapping regulations.  申请人面对的是一堆杂乱重叠的规章。

original work.example: Critics debated whether the play was an original work.  批评家争论这部剧是否为原创作品。

partition.example: The brothers argued for years over the partition of the family land.  兄弟们为家族土地的分割争执了多年。

bifurcation.example: A sharp bifurcation of the path confused the hikers.  小径突然分岔，把徒步者弄糊涂了。

breakup.example: Historians still argue about the breakup of the old empire.  史学家仍在争论那个旧帝国的解体。

cleavage.example: A deep cleavage split the party into two hostile wings.  一道深刻的裂痕把该党分成两个敌对派。

fractionalization.example: Cheap media accelerated the fractionalization of public opinion.  廉价媒体加速了公众意见的碎片化。

scission.example: The treaty produced a clean scission between the two neighboring provinces.  那份条约使两个相邻省份彻底分离。

sundering.example: The war brought a painful sundering of old family ties.  战争带来了旧日家族关系的痛苦割裂。

unification.example: The treaty prepared the way for the unification of the states.  这项条约为各邦统一铺平了道路。

union.example: The two colonies formed a lasting union after long talks.  两块殖民地经长期谈判形成持久联合。

patina.example: Years of careful manners gave the family a patina of respectability.  多年谨慎的举止给这家人涂上了一层体面的外表。

façade.example: Behind a façade of calm, the company was nearly bankrupt.  在平静的表象背后，这家公司已近破产。

veneer.example: His charm was only a veneer over real cruelty.  他的魅力只是掩盖真正残忍的一层虚饰。

air.example: The old doctor had an unmistakable air of authority.  这位老医生有一种不容错认的威严气派。

ambience.example: Soft lamps gave the café a relaxed evening ambience.  柔和的灯光给咖啡馆带来轻松的夜间氛围。

atmosphere.example: A tense atmosphere filled the room before the verdict.  宣判前，屋里弥漫着紧张的气氛。

climate.example: The current political climate discourages honest debate.  当前的政治气候不利于诚实的辩论。

flavor.example: The market gave the whole street its distinctive flavor.  这个市场赋予整条街独特的韵味。

halo.example: A halo of heroism surrounded the young captain for years.  多年间，一层英雄的光环笼罩着这位年轻船长。

odor.example: An odor of scandal clung to the firm for a decade.  丑闻的气息在这家公司周围萦绕了十年。

smell.example: The library had the comfortable smell of old paper.  这座图书馆有旧纸张那种令人安心的气息。

vibration.example: She picked up friendly vibrations from the whole team.  她从整个团队感受到友好的气场。

essential quality.example: Improvisation is the essential quality of early jazz.  即兴演奏是早期爵士乐的本质特性。

patrician.example: She came from an old patrician family that once owned half the county.  她出身于一个曾拥有半个县的古老贵族家庭。

aristocrat.example: The estate once belonged to a ruined Russian aristocrat.  这处宅邸曾属于一位没落的俄国贵族。

blueblood.phrase_cn: 新英格兰的老世家子弟
blueblood.example: The club admitted only bluebloods until well after the war.  这家俱乐部战后很久仍只收名门子弟。

aristocratic.example: His aristocratic manners made the other guests uneasy.  他贵族式的举止让其他客人不太自在。

great.example: The great families of the city controlled every guild.  城中的显赫家族控制着每个行会。

highborn.example: The play mocks a highborn lady who cannot cook.  这部剧嘲讽一位不会做饭的贵族女子。

highbred.example: He treated the servants with highbred courtesy.  他以良好教养的礼貌对待仆人。
