upper-class.cn: 上流社会的，上层阶级的
upper-class.example: His upper-class accent marked him out in the factory.  他上流社会的口音让他在工厂里格外显眼。

wellborn.example: Only wellborn officers could once buy such commissions.  从前只有出身高贵的军官才能买到这种官职。

plebeian.example: The critic sneered at the plebeian tastes of the weekend audience.  评论家嘲笑周末观众平民化的趣味。

patriot.example: He considered himself a patriot who would defend his country at any cost.  他自认为是不惜一切代价保卫祖国的爱国者。

loyalist.example: Only a few loyalists stayed with the leader after the split.  分裂后只有少数忠诚者仍跟随领袖。

apostate.example: Former comrades denounced him as an apostate and a liar.  昔日同志斥他为叛徒和骗子。

recreant.example: The ballad calls him a recreant who fled the battle.  这首民谣称他是逃离战场的怯懦叛徒。

renegade.example: Once a devoted monk, he became a renegade and denounced the church openly.  他曾是虔诚的修士，后来成了背教者并公开谴责教会。

traitor.example: History records him as a traitor to his own city.  历史把他记为背叛自己城市的叛徒。

turncoat.example: Old comrades denounced him as a turncoat after he joined the rival party.  他加入敌对政党后，老战友们谴责他是叛徒。

condescend.example: The lecturer condescended to his students in every class.  这位讲师每节课都对学生摆架子。

sabotage.example: Investigators concluded that the fire was an act of deliberate sabotage.  调查人员认定这场火灾是一次故意的破坏行动。

drought.example: The studio suffered a long drought of good scripts.  这家制片厂长期缺乏好剧本。

shortage.example: A shortage of nurses forced the ward to close early.  护士短缺迫使病房提前关闭。

plenitude.example: The archive offered a plenitude of letters and diaries.  这个档案馆提供了大量书信和日记。

province.example: Auditing the accounts falls outside my province as a technical adviser.  作为技术顾问，审计账目超出了我的职能范围。

business.example: Judging private morals is not the court's business.  评判私人道德不是法庭的职责。

duty.example: Checking the equipment was clearly the engineer's duty.  检查设备显然是那位工程师的职责。

function.example: The proper function of a review board is to advise.  评审委员会的应有职能是提供建议。

role.example: Her role was to coordinate the volunteers, not command them.  她的职责是协调志愿者，而非指挥他们。

dozen.example: Dozens of complaints arrived within the first week.  第一周内就来了数十起投诉。

mass.example: A mass of documents buried the clerk's small desk.  一大堆文件埋住了那位职员的小书桌。

mountain.example: She faced a mountain of paperwork after the audit.  审计之后她面对堆积如山的文书。

much.example: There was not much money left after the repairs.  修理之后剩下的钱不多了。

ton.example: The children came home with tons of homework.  孩子们带着大量作业回家。

volume.example: The bridge cannot handle this volume of traffic.  这座桥承受不了如此大的车流量。

glimmer.example: The letter offered a faint glimmer of hope.  那封信带来一丝微弱的希望。

handful.example: Only a handful of guests stayed until the end.  只有少数客人留到最后。

peanuts.example: Young interns worked for peanuts and long hours.  年轻实习生拿着微薄报酬长时间工作。

sprinkle.example: The cook added only a sprinkle of sugar to the batter.  厨师只往面糊里加了少量的糖。

pedagogue.example: A strict old pedagogue drilled Latin verbs into us every morning.  一位严厉的老教师每天早上让我们反复操练拉丁语动词。

educator.example: She became the most respected educator in the district.  她成了本区最受敬重的教育者。

instructor.example: Our swimming instructor made every lesson feel easy.  我们的游泳教练让每节课都轻松起来。

preceptor.example: The young monk revered his preceptor above all others.  这位小僧最敬重他的导师。

teacher.example: A gifted teacher can change a child's whole future.  一位有天赋的老师能改变孩子的一生。

pupil.example: He was her most promising pupil that difficult year.  在那个艰难的年份他是她最有前途的学生。

student.example: Every student in the class read the difficult text.  班上每个学生都读了那篇难懂的文章。

pedant.phrase_cn: 一个爱挑剔的老书呆子
pedant.example: Only a pedant would object to ending a sentence with a preposition.  只有墨守成规之人才会反对句子以介词结尾。

preordain.example: The outcome seemed preordained long before the vote.  结果在投票很久之前似乎就已注定。

jading.example: Years of jading paperwork dulled his early enthusiasm.  多年令人厌倦的文书工作磨掉了他早年的热情。

wearisome.example: The wearisome journey took three days by slow train.  这段疲乏的旅程坐慢车要三天。

peep.example: She took a quick peep at the answers before the teacher returned.  老师回来之前，她飞快地瞥了一眼答案。

gander.example: Take a gander at the new engine before we start.  开工之前先瞧一眼新引擎。

peek.example: The child sneaked a peek at the wrapped presents.  孩子偷瞄了一眼包好的礼物。

compeer.example: As a violinist she had no compeer in her generation.  作为小提琴家，她在同辈中无人匹敌。

fellow.example: His fellow researchers doubted the result at first.  他的研究同行起初怀疑这个结果。

rubberneck.example: Drivers slowed to rubberneck at the overturned truck.  司机们减速伸头围观翻倒的卡车。

frost.example: His smug reply frosted everyone in the small room.  他自得的回答把小屋里的人都惹恼了。

belittling.example: Her belittling comments discouraged the younger staff.  她贬低人的评语让年轻员工失去信心。

contemptuous.example: He gave the proposal a contemptuous glance and left.  他轻蔑地看了一眼提案就走了。

degrading.example: Prisoners complained of degrading treatment by the guards.  囚犯抱怨受到看守有损尊严的对待。

deprecatory.example: She spoke of her own work in a deprecatory tone.  她用贬抑的语气谈论自己的作品。

depreciative.example: His depreciative remarks about rivals damaged his reputation.  他贬损对手的言辞损害了自己的声誉。

derogative.example: The paper dropped that derogative nickname after complaints.  在收到投诉后，报纸弃用了那个贬义绰号。

disdainful.example: He met the accusation with disdainful silence.  他以不屑的沉默回应指控。

scornful.example: A scornful laugh greeted the young man's suggestion.  年轻人的建议招来一声轻蔑的笑。

clouded.example: Rain left the pond clouded for several days.  雨水使池塘浑浊了好几天。

grieving.example: Neighbors brought food to the grieving family each evening.  邻居每晚给悲痛的家人送饭。

heartbroken.cn: 极度悲伤的，伤心欲绝的
heartbroken.example: She was heartbroken when the old theater was demolished.  老剧院被拆时她伤心欲绝。

weeping.example: A weeping crowd followed the coffin through the square.  哭泣的人群跟着棺木穿过广场。

polymath.phrase_cn: 文艺复兴时期的博学者
polymath.example: Leonardo was a true polymath, excelling in art and science alike.  达·芬奇是真正的博学者，在艺术和科学上同样出色。

pundit.example: Every pundit predicted a close race and every one was wrong.  每位评论专家都预测选情接近，结果都错了。

sage.example: Villagers walked for days to ask the old sage for advice.  村民们走了好几天去向那位老智者求教。

savant.example: The quiet savant spent forty years cataloguing insects in a small museum.  那位沉静的博学之士在小博物馆里花了四十年为昆虫编目。

scholar.example: The lecture drew scholars from four different countries.  这场讲座吸引了四个国家的学者。

affection.example: He kept a lifelong affection for cheap detective novels.  他一生钟爱廉价侦探小说。

disposition.example: She has a natural disposition to question every rule.  她天生有质疑每条规则的倾向。

tendency.example: He has a tendency to exaggerate his own part.  他有夸大自己作用的倾向。

distaste.example: Her distaste for gossip kept her out of office politics.  她厌恶闲话，因此远离办公室政治。

loathing.example: He wrote with obvious loathing about the old regime.  他带着明显的憎恶书写旧政权。

repulsion.example: The photographs produced repulsion rather than sympathy.  这些照片引起的是厌恶而非同情。

sorry.example: He seemed genuinely sorry for the trouble he caused.  他似乎真心为自己造成的麻烦懊悔。

unapologetic.example: She remained unapologetic about the harsh review.  她对那篇苛评始终毫无悔意。

pensive.example: She grew pensive as the train passed her childhood village.  火车经过她童年的村子时，她变得沉思忧郁。

broody.cn: 沉思忧郁的，郁郁不乐的
broody.example: He fell into a broody silence after the phone call.  接完电话后他陷入郁郁的沉默。

cogitative.example: A cogitative pause followed the difficult question.  那个难题之后是一段沉思的停顿。

meditative.example: The slow music left the audience in a meditative mood.  舒缓的音乐让观众陷入沉思的心境。

musing.example: She answered with a musing expression and no words.  她带着沉思的神情作答，一言未发。

reflective.example: The long illness made him quiet and reflective.  长期的病痛使他变得安静而深思。

ruminant.example: He sat in ruminant silence beside the cold fireplace.  他在冷壁炉旁沉思静坐。

ruminative.example: His late essays have a slow, ruminative tone.  他后期的散文有一种缓慢沉思的语调。

unreflective.example: Unreflective borrowing of foreign models often fails.  不加思索地照搬外国模式常常失败。

destitution.example: The painter died in destitution in a rented attic.  这位画家在租来的阁楼里穷困而死。

impecuniosity.example: Years of impecuniosity taught him to repair everything himself.  多年的拮据教会他事事自己修补。

impoverishment.example: War brought the impoverishment of once wealthy towns.  战争使昔日富庶的城镇陷入贫困。

indigence.example: Illness reduced the family to sudden indigence.  疾病使这家人骤然陷入贫困。

neediness.example: Charities measured the neediness of each district carefully.  慈善机构仔细衡量了各区的贫困程度。

poorness.example: The poorness of the soil limited every harvest here.  土壤贫瘠限制了这里的每次收成。

poverty.example: Half the district still lives in serious poverty.  该区有一半人仍生活在严重贫困中。

closeness.example: His closeness with money became a family joke.  他花钱吝啬成了家里的笑谈。

niggardliness.example: The landlord's niggardliness left every corridor unlit.  房东的吝啬让每条走廊都没有灯。

penuriousness.example: His penuriousness surprised guests who knew his wealth.  他的吝啬让知道他财富的客人吃惊。

tightfistedness.example: The owner's tightfistedness kept wages low for years.  老板的吝啬让工资多年偏低。

tightness.example: Her tightness with expenses annoyed the whole department.  她在开支上的抠紧令整个部门不快。

richness.example: Visitors admired the richness of the museum's holdings.  参观者赞叹博物馆藏品的丰富。

perambulate.example: Every evening the old couple perambulate the narrow streets of the town.  每天傍晚，那对老夫妻都在镇上的窄街间徒步走一圈。

go.example: They had to go on foot across the whole valley.  他们不得不步行穿越整个山谷。

navigate.example: She navigated the crowded market with surprising ease.  她轻松自如地穿行于拥挤的市场。

peregrinate.example: Each summer he would peregrinate through the villages of northern Spain.  每年夏天他都会漫游西班牙北部的村庄。

proceed.example: We proceeded slowly along the muddy path toward the old bridge.  我们沿着泥泞的小路缓慢地朝老桥走去。

transit.example: The goods were damaged while in transit through the mountains.  货物在穿越山区运输途中受损。

travel.example: They traveled on foot across the valley for two long days.  他们徒步穿越山谷走了漫长的两天。

sectarian.example: His sectarian views blinded him to the merits of other traditions.  他狭隘的派系观念使他看不到其他传统的优点。

backstabbing.example: Constant backstabbing among colleagues poisoned the atmosphere in the small office.  同事间不断的暗中伤害毒化了这间小办公室的气氛。

sellout.example: Former allies called him a sellout after he joined the opposition.  在他投靠反对派后，昔日的盟友称他为叛徒。

unfaithfulness.example: Her unfaithfulness to the cause shocked everyone who had trusted her.  她对事业的背弃让所有信任过她的人震惊。

double cross.example: The smuggler's double cross left his partners in prison.  这个走私犯的背叛让他的同伙进了监狱。

staunchness.example: His staunchness in defending his friend impressed even his rivals.  他坚定不移地为朋友辩护，甚至令对手佩服。

perforate.example: The machine perforates each sheet so the pages tear off neatly.  这台机器在每张纸上打孔，使页面能整齐撕下。

drill.example: The workers drilled a small hole through the concrete wall.  工人们在混凝土墙上钻了一个小孔。

pierce.example: The needle pierced the thick leather without much effort.  针没费多大力气就刺穿了厚皮革。

puncture.example: A rusty nail punctured the front tire of my bicycle.  一根锈钉刺破了我自行车的前胎。

automatic.example: He murmured an automatic apology and hurried past me.  他机械地含糊道了个歉，匆匆从我身边走过。
automatic.cn: 机械的，不经思索的；自动的

mechanical.example: He gave a mechanical nod without listening to a single word.  他机械地点了点头，一个字也没听。

borderline.example: The village sits right on the borderline between two provinces.  这个村子正好位于两省的边界上。

verge.example: The company was on the verge of collapse last winter.  去年冬天这家公司濒临倒闭。

peregrine.example: He led a peregrine life, never staying in one city long.  他过着漂泊的生活，从不在一座城市久留。

accessorial.example: The invoice listed several accessorial charges for storage and handling.  发票上列了几项仓储和搬运的附加费用。

appurtenant.example: The garage and the driveway are appurtenant to the main house.  车库和车道是主屋的附属部分。

supplemental.example: She took a night job for supplemental income during college.  上大学时她做夜班工作以补充收入。

perish.example: Dozens of animals perished when the barn caught fire that night.  那晚谷仓失火，数十只动物丧生。

demise.example: Historians still debate the causes of the empire's sudden demise.  历史学家仍在争论该帝国突然灭亡的原因。

pass away.example: Her grandmother passed away peacefully in her sleep last night.  她的祖母昨夜在睡梦中安详离世。

breathe.example: He could hardly breathe after climbing all those steep stairs.  爬完那么多陡台阶后他几乎喘不上气。

live.example: Her great-grandfather lived to a great age in the countryside.  她的曾祖父在乡下活到了很大年纪。

survive.example: Only a few seedlings survived the unusually harsh winter.  只有少数几棵幼苗在异常严酷的冬天存活下来。

deathless.example: The poet won deathless fame with a single slender volume.  这位诗人凭一本薄薄的诗集赢得了不朽名声。

unending.example: An unending stream of visitors filled the museum all summer.  整个夏天络绎不绝的游客挤满了博物馆。

porous.example: Water seeps very quickly through the porous volcanic rock here.  水很快渗过这里多孔的火山岩。

waterproof.example: This jacket is made of waterproof fabric and dries quickly.  这件夹克用防水面料制成，干得很快。

hurtful.example: His hurtful remarks stayed with her for years afterward.  他伤人的话此后多年一直留在她心里。

stew.example: The building is a stew of styles from three different centuries.  这座建筑是三个不同世纪风格的杂糅。

persecute.example: The regime persecuted religious minorities for more than a decade.  该政权迫害宗教少数群体十多年。

curse.example: The old woman cursed her enemies in a trembling voice.  老妇人用颤抖的声音诅咒她的敌人。

persevere.example: She persevered in her research despite years of discouraging results.  尽管多年结果令人沮丧，她仍坚持研究。

carry on.example: They carried on with the experiment despite repeated failures.  尽管屡屡失败，他们仍继续做实验。

backchat.example: The teacher tolerated no backchat from students during her lessons.  这位老师上课时不容学生顶嘴。

jesting.example: Their good-humored jesting made the long trip pass quickly.  他们善意的说笑让漫长的旅程过得很快。

joshing.example: The brothers kept up a friendly joshing all through dinner.  兄弟俩整顿晚餐都在友好地互相打趣。

raillery.example: He endured her gentle raillery with a patient smile.  他带着耐心的微笑忍受她温和的调侃。

ceaselessness.example: The ceaselessness of the traffic noise kept him awake all night.  车流噪音无休无止，让他整夜无法入睡。

subsistence.example: Many families here depend on subsistence farming to stay alive.  这里许多家庭靠自给性农业维生。

stoppage.example: A sudden work stoppage halted production for three whole days.  一次突然的停工使生产中断了整整三天。

surcease.example: The rain fell without surcease for nearly a week.  雨几乎不停地下了近一周。

personable.example: The new receptionist is personable and remembers the name of every visitor.  新来的接待员风度翩翩，还记得每位来访者的名字。
personable.cn: 风度翩翩的，讨人喜欢的

ugly.example: The building had an ugly gray facade facing the street.  这栋楼临街的一面是丑陋的灰色外墙。

clearness.example: The clearness of her explanation impressed the entire committee.  她解释之清晰让整个委员会印象深刻。

pertain.example: Please bring any documents that pertain to the case tomorrow morning.  请在明天上午带来与该案件有关的任何文件。

appertain.example: Certain privileges appertain to the office of the mayor.  某些特权属于市长这一职位。

refer.example: The lawyer referred to an obscure clause in the contract.  律师提到了合同中一条不显眼的条款。

relate.example: His question did not relate to the topic under discussion.  他的问题与正在讨论的主题无关。

penance.example: He spent the whole winter doing penance for what he had done.  他整个冬天都在为自己的所作所为忏悔。

peruse.example: She perused the contract carefully before signing anything at all.  她在签任何东西之前都仔细通读了合同。

examine.example: The scientist examined every slide under the microscope twice.  这位科学家把每张切片在显微镜下看了两遍。

scan.example: He scanned the horizon for any sign of the missing boat.  他扫视地平线，寻找失踪小船的踪影。

skim.example: She skimmed the long report during the short taxi ride.  她在短短的出租车路程中浏览了那份长报告。

pervade.example: A faint smell of lavender pervaded the whole house that summer.  那个夏天，淡淡的薰衣草香弥漫了整座房子。

interpenetrate.example: Folk melodies and classical forms interpenetrate throughout his early symphonies.  民间旋律与古典形式在他早期交响曲中相互渗透。

percolate.example: Rainwater slowly percolated through the sandy soil into the well.  雨水缓慢渗过沙质土壤流入井中。

transfuse.example: The young coach transfused fresh confidence into the struggling team.  这位年轻教练把新的信心注入陷入困境的球队。

bearish.example: Analysts remained bearish about the housing market all year.  分析师全年对房地产市场都持看跌态度。

defeatist.example: Her defeatist attitude discouraged the rest of the team.  她认输的态度让队里其他人也丧了气。

despairing.example: He spoke in a despairing tone about the coming harvest.  他用绝望的语气谈起即将到来的收成。

downbeat.example: The minister gave a surprisingly downbeat assessment of the economy.  这位部长对经济给出了出人意料的悲观评估。

hopeless.example: The doctors described his condition as sadly hopeless.  医生们说他的病情令人遗憾地毫无希望。

optimistic.example: Despite the losses, the founders remained optimistic about next year.  尽管亏损，创始人们对明年依然乐观。

cry.example: The villagers sent out a desperate cry for outside help.  村民们发出绝望的呼声请求外界援助。

solicitation.example: The charity's solicitation of donations raised money for flood victims.  这家慈善机构的募捐为洪灾受害者筹得资金。

adjure.example: The judge adjured the witness to tell the whole truth.  法官恳请证人说出全部真相。

lobotomize.cn: 切除脑白质；使麻木呆滞
lobotomize.example: Hours of mindless television seemed to lobotomize the whole family.  几小时无脑电视似乎让全家人都变得麻木呆滞。

quicken.example: The good news quickened her pulse and lifted her spirits.  好消息让她心跳加快，精神振奋。

especial.example: This letter is of especial importance to the family history.  这封信对家族史有特别重要的意义。

unusual.example: It was an unusual coincidence that both letters arrived together.  两封信同时到达是个罕见的巧合。

eleemosynary.example: The hospital began as an eleemosynary institution for the poor.  这家医院最初是为穷人设立的慈善机构。

misanthropic.cn: 厌恶人类的，愤世嫉俗的
misanthropic.example: The misanthropic old writer refused every invitation he received.  这位厌世的老作家拒绝了他收到的每份邀请。

philistine.example: He dismissed modern poetry as nonsense, revealing himself a complete philistine.  他把现代诗贬为胡言乱语，暴露出自己是个十足的市侩。

lowbrow.cn: 低俗的；文化修养低的人
lowbrow.example: He openly enjoyed lowbrow comedies and felt no shame about it.  他公开喜爱低俗喜剧，对此毫不羞愧。

materialist.cn: 物质主义者，实利主义者
materialist.example: Critics dismissed the tycoon as a crass materialist without taste.  批评者把这位大亨说成毫无品味的粗鄙物质主义者。

highbrow.cn: 高雅的；文化修养高的人
highbrow.example: The magazine publishes highbrow essays on art and philosophy.  这份杂志刊登关于艺术与哲学的高雅文章。

impassible.example: The guard stood impassible while the crowd shouted insults.  人群叫骂时，卫兵毫无表情地站着。

promiscuous.example: The shop sold a promiscuous mixture of antiques and cheap junk.  这家店卖的是古董和廉价杂物的混杂堆积。

pigment.example: Ancient painters ground minerals to make pigment for their wall paintings.  古代画家把矿石磨碎，为壁画制作颜料。

colorant.example: The company replaced artificial colorant with extracts from beets.  该公司用甜菜提取物替代了人工着色剂。

dye.example: The weavers still use natural indigo dye for their cloth.  织工们仍用天然靛蓝染料给布料染色。

paint.example: A fresh coat of paint transformed the shabby old door.  一层新涂料让破旧的老门焕然一新。

tincture.example: A faint tincture of red appeared along the evening clouds.  傍晚的云边泛起一抹淡淡的红色。

tinge.example: The setting sun tinged the sky a delicate shade of pink.  落日把天空染成淡淡的粉色。

tint.example: The old photograph had acquired a faint yellow tint.  那张老照片已泛上淡淡的黄色调。

pilfer.example: Someone had been pilfering office supplies from the storage room for months.  几个月来一直有人从储藏室偷拿办公用品。

filch.example: The boy filched a few coins from his father's coat pocket.  男孩从他父亲的外衣口袋里偷了几枚硬币。

lift.example: A pickpocket lifted his wallet on the crowded subway platform.  一个扒手在拥挤的地铁站台上偷走了他的钱包。

thieve.example: The two brothers thieved from local shops for several months.  两兄弟连续几个月偷本地商店的东西。

precocious.example: The precocious girl was reading adult novels before she turned eight.  那个早熟的女孩不到八岁就在读成人小说了。

early.example: Her early talent for languages surprised all of her teachers.  她早年显露的语言才华让所有老师惊讶。

premature.example: Drawing a conclusion now would be premature and possibly misleading.  现在下结论过早，还可能造成误导。

pillory.example: The newspapers pilloried the minister for weeks after his careless remark.  他说了那句轻率的话后，报纸连续几周对这位大臣公开嘲弄。

developmental.example: The engine is still at a developmental stage and untested.  这台发动机仍处于开发阶段，尚未测试。

test.example: Engineers scheduled a test flight for early next month.  工程师们把试飞安排在下月初。

trial.example: The drug performed well in a small clinical trial.  该药在一项小型临床试验中表现良好。

conduct.example: A young monk conducted the visitors around the ancient temple.  一位年轻僧人带领参观者游览这座古寺。

guide.example: A local pilot guided the ship safely through the narrow channel.  一名当地领航员将船安全引过狭窄的航道。

route.example: Police routed the traffic around the flooded intersection.  警察把车流绕开被水淹的路口。

steer.example: He steered the small boat carefully between the rocks.  他小心地把小船驶过礁石之间。

eventual.example: Nobody could predict the eventual outcome of the long negotiation.  没人能预料这场漫长谈判的最终结果。

ache.example: After three years abroad she ached for her hometown.  在国外三年后，她十分渴望回到故乡。

pinpoint.example: Engineers finally pinpointed the exact cause of the power failure.  工程师们最终精确找出了停电的确切原因。

hairline.example: Inspectors found a hairline crack in the concrete support.  检查人员在混凝土支柱上发现一道极细的裂缝。

mathematical.example: The dancers moved with almost mathematical precision across the stage.  舞者们以近乎数学般的精确穿过舞台。

locate.example: Engineers finally located the leak beneath the kitchen floor.  工程师最终在厨房地板下找到了漏水处。

identify.example: Researchers identified the main cause of the outbreak within days.  研究人员在几天内确认了疫情的主要原因。

estimate.example: She gave only a rough estimate of the repair costs.  她只给出了修理费用的粗略估算。

exciting.example: The chef added chili to give the sauce an exciting edge.  厨师加了辣椒，让酱汁有了刺激的味觉冲击。

impassion.example: His closing speech impassioned even the most doubtful listeners.  他的结束演讲连最怀疑的听众都被激起热情。

move.example: The final scene moved the entire audience to tears.  最后一幕让全场观众感动落泪。

arrogate.example: The council arrogated to itself powers belonging to the mayor.  议会擅自把属于市长的权力揽为己有。

commandeer.example: Soldiers commandeered every truck in the village that morning.  那天早晨士兵们征用了村里所有的卡车。

expropriate.example: The state expropriated private land to build the new railway.  国家征收私人土地来修建新铁路。

preempt.example: Early arrivals had preempted the best seats near the stage.  早到的人已经预先占住了靠舞台的最好座位。

coldhearted.example: His coldhearted refusal to help shocked even his own family.  他冷酷无情地拒绝帮忙，连自己家人都震惊。

placebo.example: The promise of a review was a mere placebo for worried residents.  承诺复查对忧心的居民只是安慰性的东西。

plagiarize.example: The student was expelled for plagiarizing whole chapters of another thesis.  这名学生因抄袭另一篇论文的整章内容而被开除。

funeral.example: The organ played a slow funeral march as we entered.  我们进场时管风琴奏起缓慢的葬礼进行曲。

pleasing.example: Her voice carried a pleasing warmth that calmed the children.  她的声音带着悦耳的温暖，让孩子们安静下来。

plateau.example: Sales rose sharply for a year and then reached a plateau.  销售额猛涨了一年，随后进入平台期。

highland.example: Sheep grazed across the windswept highlands all through summer.  整个夏天羊群都在风大的高地上放牧。

mesa.example: A flat-topped mesa rose sharply above the desert floor.  一座平顶台地从沙漠地面陡然升起。

tableland.example: The road climbed for hours onto a barren tableland.  道路盘旋数小时才登上一片荒芜的高原。

upland.example: Farmers move their cattle to upland pasture every June.  农民每年六月把牛群赶到高地牧场。

equilibrium.example: The market took two years to reach a stable equilibrium again.  市场花了两年才重新达到稳定的平衡。

stage.example: The project is still at an early stage of planning.  这个项目仍处在规划的早期阶段。

stasis.example: The industry entered a long stasis after the financial crisis.  金融危机后该行业进入长期停滞。

lowland.example: Rice grows best in the fertile lowland fields near the river.  水稻在河边肥沃的低地田里长得最好。

plausible.example: He gave a plausible explanation, though nobody could actually verify it.  他给出了一个可信的解释，尽管无人能真正核实。

believable.example: The novel succeeds because every character feels entirely believable.  这部小说之所以成功，是因为每个人物都让人完全信服。

credible.example: The prosecution produced a credible witness at the last moment.  检方在最后一刻找出了一名可信的证人。

likely.example: The most likely explanation is simple human error.  最可能的解释就是简单的人为失误。

possible.example: There is one possible answer nobody has considered yet.  有一个可能的答案还没人想到过。

presumable.example: Fatigue was the presumable cause of the driver's mistake.  疲劳大概是司机失误的原因。

probable.example: A narrow victory seems the probable outcome of the election.  小幅胜出似乎是这次选举很可能的结果。

paradoxicalimplausible.cn: 自相矛盾而难以置信的
paradoxicalimplausible.example: Critics rejected his paradoxicalimplausible account of the accident.  批评者否定了他那自相矛盾又难以置信的事故说法。

improbable.cn: 不大可能的，难以置信的
improbable.example: He told a highly improbable story about losing the keys.  他讲了个极不可能的丢钥匙的故事。

incredible.example: She offered an incredible excuse that nobody in the room believed.  她给出一个难以置信的借口，屋里没人相信。

unbelievable.example: His unbelievable claim about the treasure amused the whole village.  他关于宝藏的荒唐说法逗乐了整个村子。

pestilence.example: A deadly pestilence swept the city during that dreadful summer.  那个可怕的夏天，一场致命瘟疫扫过全城。

poignant.example: The old photograph was a poignant reminder of everything they had lost.  那张旧照片令人感伤地提醒着他们失去的一切。

affecting.example: She told an affecting story about her grandmother's last letter.  她讲了一个关于祖母最后一封信的动人故事。

impactful.example: The documentary's impactful ending stayed with viewers for weeks.  这部纪录片震撼的结尾让观众记了好几周。

moving.example: His moving tribute to the old teacher silenced the hall.  他对老教师感人的悼念让全场静默。

unaffecting.example: The play was competent but oddly unaffecting throughout.  这部剧演得规矩，却全程出奇地缺乏感染力。

feast.example: The autumn hillside offered a feast of colors to hikers.  秋日的山坡为徒步者献上一场色彩的盛宴。

overabundance.example: An overabundance of rain ruined most of the wheat crop.  雨水过多毁掉了大部分小麦收成。

surplus.example: The country exported its grain surplus to neighboring markets.  该国把过剩的粮食出口到邻国市场。

plight.example: The documentary drew attention to the plight of refugees along the border.  这部纪录片让人们关注边境难民的困境。

predicament.example: Losing his passport abroad left him in a serious predicament.  在国外丢了护照让他陷入严重困境。

plodding.example: The novel has a plodding narrative that tests the patience of readers.  这部小说叙述单调乏味，考验读者的耐心。

humdrum.example: She left the humdrum job to travel and write full time.  她辞掉那份单调乏味的工作，去全职旅行和写作。

backbone.example: It took real backbone to challenge his own boss publicly.  公开质疑自己的老板需要真正的骨气。

grit.example: It took real grit to finish the race on an injured ankle.  脚踝受伤还跑完全程，靠的是真正的毅力。

coward.example: Nobody dared call him a coward after that rescue.  那次救援之后没人敢说他是懦夫。

plumb.example: The biographer tried to plumb the depths of that private grief.  传记作者试图深入探究那份私人悲伤的深处。

pure.example: Meeting her there was pure coincidence, nothing more.  在那里遇见她纯属巧合，别无其他。

sheer.example: What he wrote about the treaty was sheer nonsense.  他关于那份条约写的全是胡说。

very.example: They climbed to the very top of the ruined tower.  他们爬到了那座残塔的最顶端。

explore.example: The committee explored every possibility before making its decision.  委员会在做决定前探究了每一种可能。

plummet.example: Share prices plummeted to a record low after the announcement.  公告发布后，股价暴跌至历史低点。

crash.example: Share prices crashed within hours of the announcement.  公告发布后几小时内股价暴跌。

dive.example: Profits dived sharply after the factory fire last spring.  去年春天工厂火灾后利润急剧下跌。

skyrocket.example: Rents skyrocketed after the new factory opened downtown.  新工厂在市中心开业后房租飞涨。

soar.example: Building costs soared during the second year of construction.  施工第二年建筑成本猛增。

plump.example: Most of the villagers plumped for the cheaper of the two plans.  大多数村民选了两个方案中较便宜的那个。
plump.cn: 丰满的，圆胖的；选定，支持

chubby.example: The baby's chubby cheeks made everyone at the table smile.  婴儿圆胖的脸颊让桌边每个人都笑了。

rotund.example: A rotund gentleman in a gray coat blocked the doorway.  一位穿灰外套的圆胖先生堵在门口。

polarize.example: The proposed law polarized public opinion within a single week.  这项法律提案在一周之内就使公众意见两极分化。

polemic.example: His essay turned into a fierce polemic against the city council.  他的文章变成了对市议会的猛烈抨击。

controversy.example: The painting sparked a controversy that lasted for decades.  这幅画引发了持续数十年的争议。

disputation.example: The scholars spent the evening in learned disputation about grammar.  学者们整晚就语法进行博学的争辩。

desirable.example: Delaying the vote seemed the most desirable course available.  推迟投票似乎是最可取的做法。

pontifical.example: He answered every question in a pontifical tone that irritated us.  他用自大的口气回答每个问题，令我们厌烦。

ifyouputoutyourhands.ipa: ɪf ju pʊt aʊt jɔr hændz
ifyouputoutyourhands.example: He copied ifyouputoutyourhands directly from the damaged original page.  他直接从破损的原页上抄下了这串粘连的文字。

youarealaborer.cn: 你便是劳动者（原书粘连句）
youarealaborer.example: The teacher wrote youarealaborer on the board without any spaces.  老师在黑板上把这句话连着写成一个词，没有空格。

ifyouputoutyourhandsand.ipa: ɪf ju pʊt aʊt jɔr hændz ænd
ifyouputoutyourhandsand.cn: 若你伸出双手并…（粘连句）
ifyouputoutyourhandsand.example: The scanned page read ifyouputoutyourhandsand your head together.  扫描页上写着若你同时伸出双手与头脑。

youareacraftsperson.cn: 你便是工匠（原书粘连句）
youareacraftsperson.example: The garbled text ended with youareacraftsperson and no punctuation.  这段乱码文本以“你便是工匠”结尾，没有标点。

heartandsoul.example: She threw heartandsoul into the project from the first week.  她从第一周起就全心全意投入这个项目。

youareanartist.example: The final line, youareanartist, appeared in bold italic type.  最后一行“你便是艺术家”以粗斜体印出。

ponderable.example: Whether growth always brings happiness is a genuinely ponderable question.  增长是否总带来幸福，是个真正值得考虑的问题。

hefty.example: He carried a hefty volume of legal cases under his arm.  他腋下夹着一本厚重的法律案例集。

pontificate.example: He loves to pontificate about politics to anyone who will listen.  他喜欢对任何愿意听的人傲慢地大谈政治。

pore.example: She pored over the old letters for hours without saying anything.  她埋头细读那些旧信数小时，一言不发。

consider.example: She considered the options carefully before signing the lease.  她在签租约前仔细斟酌了各种选择。

contemplate.example: She sat by the window and contemplated the few choices left to her.  她坐在窗边，仔细思索留给自己的几个选择。

meditate.example: He sat by the window and meditated on the day's events.  他坐在窗边沉思白天发生的事。

perpend.example: The judge asked the jury to perpend the evidence overnight.  法官要陪审团用一夜时间仔细斟酌证据。

ruminate.example: He sat by the window and ruminated on the past.  他坐在窗边，反复回想往事。

weigh.example: They weighed the risks for several hours before agreeing.  他们权衡风险数小时后才达成一致。

chew over.example: Give me a night to chew over your generous offer.  给我一晚时间好好琢磨你这份大方的提议。

leaf.example: He leafed through the old magazine while waiting for coffee.  他等咖啡时翻阅那本旧杂志。

riffle.example: She riffled through the files looking for one missing page.  她快速翻查档案，寻找那缺失的一页。

ill-omened.example: Sailors called it an ill-omened voyage from the very start.  水手们从一开始就说这是一次不祥的航行。

propitious.example: They waited for a propitious moment to announce the merger.  他们等待一个吉利的时机来宣布合并。

poseur.example: Everyone at the gallery saw him as a poseur rather than a genuine artist.  画廊里人人都觉得他是个故作姿态的人，而非真正的艺术家。

grandstander.example: Colleagues dismissed the senator as a mere grandstander.  同僚们把这位参议员看作只会哗众取宠的人。

poser.example: The other musicians thought he was just a poser.  其他乐手觉得他只是个装样子的人。

posit.example: The researchers posit that early humans migrated along the coast.  研究者假定早期人类是沿着海岸迁徙的。

postulate.example: His theory rests on a single postulate that no one has yet disproved.  他的理论建立在一个至今无人驳倒的假设之上。

presuppose.example: His argument presupposes that everyone acts in good faith.  他的论证预设了每个人都出于诚信行事。

premise.example: The whole plan rests on a false premise about demand.  整个计划建立在一个关于需求的错误前提上。

presupposition.example: Her essay attacks an unexamined presupposition of modern economics.  她的文章批判了现代经济学一个未经检验的预设。

hypothesize.example: Researchers hypothesized a link between sleep and memory formation.  研究者假设睡眠与记忆形成之间存在联系。

posture.example: The candidates merely postured for the cameras instead of debating issues.  候选人只是对着镜头摆姿态，而不辩论议题。

attitudinize.example: The young actor attitudinized instead of simply speaking his lines.  这位年轻演员不老实说台词，反而故作姿态。

potable.example: The innkeeper offered us a strong potable brewed from local barley.  店主给我们端上一种用本地大麦酿的烈性饮品。

beverage.example: The airline offers a hot beverage on every morning flight.  该航空公司每趟早班机都提供热饮。

juice.example: She drinks fresh orange juice with breakfast every single day.  她每天早餐都喝新鲜橙汁。

spirits.example: The old cabinet held several dusty bottles of spirits.  那只旧柜子里放着几瓶满是灰的烈酒。

drinkable.example: After boiling, the river water became barely drinkable.  煮沸之后，河水勉强可以饮用。

non-intoxicant.example: The host offered a non-intoxicant to every driver at the party.  主人给聚会上每位司机都提供了无酒精饮品。

soft drink.example: He ordered a cold soft drink instead of beer.  他点了一杯冰软饮而不是啤酒。

potentate.example: The ancient potentate ruled his desert kingdom with absolute and unquestioned authority.  那位古代权贵以绝对且不容置疑的权威统治他的沙漠王国。

autocrat.example: The founder ran his company like a benevolent autocrat.  创始人像一位仁慈的独裁者那样经营公司。

monarch.example: For forty years the country was ruled by an absolute monarch.  四十年间这个国家由一位专制君主统治。

ruler.example: History remembers him as a wise and patient ruler.  历史将他记作一位贤明而有耐心的统治者。

figurehead.example: The king became a mere figurehead after the new constitution.  新宪法之后国王成了有名无实的元首。

potentiate.example: Alcohol can potentiate the sedative effect of these pills, so avoid drinking.  酒精会加强这些药片的镇静作用，所以要避免饮酒。

deactivate.example: A technician deactivated the alarm before entering the vault.  技术员进入金库前关闭了警报。

grump.example: He grumped about the weather all the way to the station.  他一路到车站都在抱怨天气。

mope.example: She moped around the house for days after the news.  听到消息后她在屋里闷闷不乐地转了好几天。

sulk.example: The boy sulked in silence for hours after losing the game.  输了比赛后，男孩闷声生气了好几个小时。

practitioner.example: The village relies on a single general practitioner for everything.  这个村子事事都依赖唯一的一位全科医生。

guru.example: They hired a marketing guru to rescue the failing brand.  他们请来一位营销权威拯救这个衰落的品牌。

premium.example: The shop sells only premium coffee beans from small farms.  这家店只卖来自小农场的高端咖啡豆。

expensive.example: He wore an expensive watch that his grandfather had left him.  他戴着祖父留给他的一只昂贵手表。

precious.example: The crown was set with precious stones from three continents.  王冠上镶着来自三大洲的宝石。

costly.example: Ignoring the warning proved a costly mistake for the firm.  忽视警告对这家公司是个代价高昂的错误。

valuable.example: A valuable painting hung unnoticed in the hallway for years.  一幅贵重的画在走廊里被忽视地挂了多年。

prate.example: He would prate for hours about matters he barely understood.  他会就自己几乎不懂的事情空谈好几个小时。

chat.example: They chatted over coffee for nearly two pleasant hours.  他们喝着咖啡愉快地闲聊了近两个小时。

chatter.example: The children chattered endlessly during the long bus ride.  孩子们在漫长的巴士行程中喋喋不休。

converse.example: The two diplomats conversed quietly in French all evening.  两位外交官整晚都用法语轻声交谈。

twitter.example: The guests twittered with excitement about the coming wedding.  客人们兴奋地喳喳谈论即将到来的婚礼。

preach.example: The young minister will preach in the village chapel every Sunday morning.  这位年轻牧师每周日上午在村里的小教堂布道。

discourse.example: The professor discoursed on morality for a full hour.  教授就道德问题论述了整整一小时。

sermonize.example: His uncle loved to sermonize about duty at family dinners.  他叔叔喜欢在家宴上就责任问题说教。

precarious.example: The climbers found themselves in a precarious position on the icy ledge.  攀登者发现自己处在冰封岩架上的危险境地。

previous.example: The court overturned the previous ruling on similar grounds.  法院以类似理由推翻了先前的裁决。

flying.example: She paid us a flying visit between two long meetings.  她在两场长会之间匆匆来看了我们一趟。

hurried.example: Their hurried decision to sell cost them a great deal.  他们仓促决定出售，代价惨重。

trigger.example: One careless remark triggered a diplomatic crisis that summer.  那年夏天一句失口的话引发了外交危机。

precipitation.example: Annual precipitation in the region has fallen sharply over the past decade.  该地区的年降水量在过去十年里急剧下降。

hastiness.example: He later regretted the hastiness of his angry reply.  他后来后悔自己气头上回信太草率。

precipitousness.example: The precipitousness of the market's fall alarmed every investor.  市场跌势之陡令每个投资者惊慌。

deliberation.example: She moved with slow deliberation through the crowded gallery.  她从容缓慢地穿过拥挤的画廊。

sequela.example: Chronic fatigue was a common sequela of the illness.  慢性疲劳是这种疾病常见的后遗结果。

successor.example: The chairman named his successor at the annual meeting.  董事长在年会上指定了他的继任者。

predecessor.example: She inherited several unfinished reforms from her predecessor in the mayor's office.  她从市长办公室的前任那里接手了几项未完成的改革。

nausea.example: A wave of nausea swept over him at the smell.  那股气味让他一阵恶心。

revulsion.example: Readers felt deep revulsion at the cruelty described.  读者对书中描写的残酷感到深深厌恶。

illustrious.example: She retired after an illustrious career in medical research.  在医学研究领域度过杰出的生涯后，她退休了。

superb.example: The young violinist gave a superb performance that night.  那晚这位年轻小提琴手献上了卓越的表演。

unmatchable.cn: 无可匹敌的，无与伦比的
unmatchable.example: Her unmatchable skill with the brush astonished older painters.  她无可匹敌的画笔技艺令年长画家惊叹。

preen.example: The dancer paused to preen before the tall mirror backstage.  那位舞者在后台的高镜前停下来打扮修饰。

groom.example: He groomed himself carefully before the important interview.  重要面试前他仔细打扮了自己。

plume.example: The bird plumed its feathers on the sunny branch.  那只鸟在阳光下的树枝上梳理羽毛。

primp.example: She spent an hour primping in front of the mirror before the party.  聚会前她在镜子前精心打扮了一个小时。

exordium.example: The speaker began with a brief exordium praising his hosts.  演讲者以一段简短开场白称赞主办方。

pregnant.example: Her answer was followed by a pregnant pause that unsettled the room.  她的回答之后是一段意味深长的停顿，令全场不安。

revelatory.example: One revelatory detail in the letter changed the whole story.  信中一个揭示性的细节改变了整个故事。

suggestive.example: His suggestive silence told the reporters more than words.  他意味深长的沉默比言语告诉记者的更多。

prearrange.example: They prearranged a meeting at the station for six o'clock.  他们预先安排六点在车站会面。

prepare.example: The team prepared for the debate weeks in advance.  这个队伍提前数周为辩论做准备。

preplan.example: She preplanned every detail of the long research trip.  她预先规划了这次长途考察的每个细节。

absorption.example: His absorption in the puzzle made him forget dinner entirely.  他专注于那道谜题，把晚饭忘得一干二净。

engagement.example: Her engagement with the material impressed the whole seminar.  她对材料的投入让整个研讨班印象深刻。

engrossment.example: His engrossment in the novel lasted until well past midnight.  他沉迷这本小说直到深夜过后。

immersion.example: A month of total immersion improved her Japanese dramatically.  一个月的完全沉浸让她的日语大幅提高。

overruling.example: Safety was the overruling concern in every design decision.  安全是每项设计决定中压倒一切的关切。

auspice.example: The voyage began under remarkably favorable auspices that spring.  那年春天航行在极为吉利的兆头下启程。

boding.example: The still air carried an ill boding of the coming storm.  凝滞的空气带着风暴将至的不祥预兆。

foreshadowing.example: The opening chapter is full of subtle foreshadowing of disaster.  开篇一章充满了对灾难的细微伏笔。

portent.example: Villagers read the comet as a dark portent of war.  村民们把这颗彗星看作战争的阴暗凶兆。

prefiguring.example: These sketches are a clear prefiguring of his later murals.  这些草图明显预示了他后来的壁画。

foretell.example: No economist foretold the collapse of that entire market.  没有经济学家预言到整个市场的崩溃。

prescience.example: His essay showed remarkable prescience about the coming crisis.  他的文章对即将到来的危机展现出非凡的先见之明。

foresight.example: The mayor showed great foresight in preserving the old harbor.  市长在保护老港口上表现出很强的远见。

forethought.example: With a little forethought the accident could have been avoided.  只要稍加事先考虑，这场事故本可避免。

providence.example: Their providence in storing grain saved the village that winter.  他们储粮的远见在那个冬天救了村子。

improvidence.example: Years of improvidence left the family with nothing saved.  多年的挥霍无谋让这家人毫无积蓄。

myopia.example: Critics blamed the crisis on the political myopia of leaders.  批评者把危机归咎于领导人的政治短视。

shortsightedness.example: Cutting research funding was pure shortsightedness on their part.  削减研究经费纯属他们的短视之举。

decree.example: The government issued a decree banning imports of that timber.  政府颁布法令禁止进口那种木材。

law.example: Parliament passed a new law protecting coastal wetlands.  议会通过了一项保护沿海湿地的新法律。

regulation.example: New safety regulations forced the factory to replace its machines.  新的安全规章迫使工厂更换机器。

rule.example: Anyone who breaks the rules twice loses their membership.  任何人两次违反规定就会失去会员资格。

primitive.example: Archaeologists uncovered primitive stone tools beside the ancient riverbed.  考古学家在古河床旁发掘出原始的石制工具。

advanced.example: The lab uses advanced technology unavailable elsewhere in the country.  该实验室使用国内其他地方没有的先进技术。

developed.example: The island became a highly developed economy within one generation.  这个岛在一代人之内成为高度发达的经济体。

evolved.example: Their later pottery represents a far more evolved technique.  他们后期的陶器代表着远为成熟的技艺。

reputation.example: She built a reputation for honesty over twenty long years.  她用漫长的二十年建立起诚实的声望。

affectation.example: His British accent struck everyone as a rather transparent affectation.  在众人看来，他的英式口音是相当明显的做作。

deceit.example: His whole story turned out to be a web of deceit.  他整个说法后来证明是一张欺骗之网。

imposture.example: A single letter exposed the imposture that had fooled everyone.  一封信揭露了骗过所有人的冒名行为。

lordliness.example: His lordliness toward the staff cost him their loyalty.  他对员工的傲慢让他失去了他们的忠诚。

miraculous.example: Doctors called her recovery nothing short of miraculous.  医生称她的康复简直是奇迹。

prognosis.example: The doctors offered a gloomy prognosis after reviewing the scans.  医生看过扫描片后给出了悲观的预后。

foretelling.example: Her foretelling of the drought proved uncomfortably accurate.  她对旱灾的预言准得让人不安。

predicting.example: Predicting the weather beyond ten days remains largely guesswork.  预测十天以上的天气基本上仍是猜测。

presaging.example: Dark clouds gathered, presaging a long and violent storm.  乌云聚集，预示一场漫长猛烈的风暴。

prediction.example: His prediction about the election proved surprisingly accurate.  他对选举的预测准得出人意料。

prophecy.example: The old prophecy seemed to fulfill itself within a decade.  那个古老的预言似乎在十年内自我实现了。

popular.example: It was a popular belief that the well never dried.  当时普遍认为那口井从不干涸。

prevailing.example: The prevailing view among historians has changed considerably since then.  历史学家中占主导的看法自那以后大为改变。

rife.example: The small town was rife with rumors about the mayor's resignation.  小镇上充斥着关于市长辞职的谣言。

absent.example: Such customs are entirely absent from the northern villages.  这类习俗在北方村庄完全不存在。

primordial.example: Life may have begun in a primordial soup of simple chemicals.  生命可能始于由简单化学物质构成的原始之汤。

ancient.example: Ancient civilizations along this river left almost no writing.  这条河沿岸的古代文明几乎没留下文字。

primeval.example: A patch of primeval forest still survives on the slope.  山坡上仍存留着一小片原始森林。

peddle.example: He used to peddle brushes and soap from door to door.  他过去挨家挨户兜售刷子和肥皂。

hawk.example: Vendors hawked cheap souvenirs outside the crowded temple gate.  小贩们在拥挤的庙门外叫卖廉价纪念品。

tainted.example: A tainted water supply sickened dozens of people last month.  上月被污染的水源使数十人生病。

contaminated.example: Workers removed several tons of contaminated soil from the site.  工人们从场地运走了数吨受污染的土壤。

corrupted by civilization.example: He imagined a valley not yet corrupted by civilization.  他想象着一处尚未被文明败坏的山谷。

privation.example: Years of privation had left the villagers thin and utterly exhausted.  多年的穷困匮乏使村民们瘦弱不堪、极度疲惫。

loss.example: The loss of income forced them to sell the farm.  收入的丧失迫使他们卖掉农场。

repletion.example: The guests ate to repletion and then dozed by the fire.  客人们吃到饱足，然后在炉火边打起了瞌睡。

probity.example: The judge was known for probity and unfailing patience.  这位法官以正直和永不失去的耐心闻名。

uprightness.example: His moral uprightness earned respect even from his opponents.  他道德上的正直连对手都尊敬。

unscrupulousness.example: The dealer's unscrupulousness eventually destroyed his own business.  这个商人的不择手段最终毁了他自己的生意。

shiftiness.example: His shiftiness during the interview made the panel distrust every answer.  他面试时的狡诈做派让评委不信任他的每个回答。

lowness.example: The lowness of his tactics shocked even his longtime political allies.  他手段之卑劣连长期的政治盟友都感到震惊。

aptitude.example: She showed an early aptitude for languages and mastered three by twelve.  她很早显出语言天赋，十二岁前就掌握了三门语言。

procrastinate.example: I always procrastinate when the deadline still feels comfortably far away.  截止日期还远的时候我总会拖延。

procure.example: The smugglers tried to procure weapons through a network of middlemen.  走私者试图通过中间人网络获取武器。

acquire.example: It took years for him to acquire a taste for olives.  他花了好几年才慢慢喜欢上橄榄。

pull down.example: He pulls down a decent salary writing code for a small startup.  他在一家小创业公司写代码，挣得一份不错的薪水。

bring in.example: The weekend market brings in more cash than the whole weekday trade.  周末集市带来的现金比整个工作日的生意还多。

forfeit.example: He forfeited his right to appeal by missing the deadline.  他因错过期限而丧失了上诉权。

lose.example: Careless investors can lose everything overnight when a bubble finally bursts.  泡沫破裂时，粗心的投资者可能一夜之间失去一切。

rein.example: The new director kept a tight rein on every department's spending.  新任主管对各部门的开支严加约束。

fritterer.example: Her brother is a fritterer who wastes both his savings and his talent.  她弟弟是个挥霍者，既浪费积蓄也浪费才华。

highroller.example: The casino treats every highroller to a free suite and private car.  赌场为每位豪客提供免费套房和专车。

spender.example: My uncle is a big spender who never checks his bank balance.  我叔叔花钱大手大脚，从不看银行余额。

squanderer.example: History remembers him as a squanderer of a vast family fortune.  历史把他记作败掉万贯家财的挥霍者。

waster.example: His father called him a waster who had thrown away every chance.  他父亲说他是个败家子，白白丢掉了每个机会。

wastrel.example: The family fortune was spent by a wastrel who gambled nightly.  家族财产被一个夜夜赌博的败家子花光了。

economizing.example: By economizing on small daily luxuries, they paid off the loan early.  靠在日常小奢侈上省俭，他们提前还清了贷款。

awesome.example: The view from the summit was awesome enough to silence the group.  峰顶的景色壮观得让全队都沉默了。

staggering.example: The company lost a staggering sum in a single trading afternoon.  公司在一个交易下午就亏掉惊人的一笔钱。

stu-.example: The line break split stupendous into stu- and pendous across two pages.  换行把 stupendous 拆成了 stu- 和 pendous 两半。

pendous.example: Joining stu- with pendous restores the original adjective stupendous.  把 stu- 与 pendous 接起来就还原成 stupendous。

unviolated.example: The tomb remained unviolated for nearly three thousand years.  这座墓近三千年未被侵扰。

inviolable.example: Freedom of conscience is treated here as an inviolable principle.  在这里，良心自由被视为不可侵犯的原则。

proffer.example: He proffered an apology before anyone had a chance to complain.  还没人来得及抱怨，他就主动致歉。

give.example: She gave her old winter coat to the first person who asked.  她把旧冬衣给了第一个开口要的人。

trot out.example: Politicians trot out the same tired promises every election season.  每逢选举，政客们都端出同样陈旧的承诺。

retain.example: The museum retained the building's original facade during the renovation.  翻修时博物馆保留了建筑的原有正面。

incompetent.example: The report blamed an incompetent contractor for the collapsed roof.  报告把屋顶坍塌归咎于一个不称职的承包商。

jackleg.example: Some jackleg plumber installed all these pipes backwards years ago.  多年前某个蹩脚水管工把这些管子全装反了。

unseasoned.example: The team fielded unseasoned players against the reigning champions.  球队派出毫无经验的球员迎战卫冕冠军。

unskilled.example: Most of these jobs are unskilled and pay barely above the minimum.  这些工作多为非技术岗，薪水刚过最低标准。

high-rolling.example: His high-rolling habits vanished the moment the money ran out.  钱一花光，他挥金如土的习惯立刻消失了。

thrift.example: Wartime thrift taught my grandmother to save every scrap of string.  战时的节俭让我祖母连每根线头都留着。

pushover.example: The exam looked hard but turned out to be a complete pushover.  那场考试看着难，结果却是易如反掌的事。

breeze.example: The final exam was a breeze compared with the weekly quizzes.  与每周的小测相比，期末考试轻松得多。

cake.example: Fixing that bug turned out to be a piece of cake.  修那个程序缺陷结果只是小菜一碟。

picnic.example: Moving house in the July heat was no picnic for any of us.  七月酷热中搬家对我们谁都不轻松。

headache.example: Coordinating six time zones became a daily headache for the team.  协调六个时区成了团队每天的头疼事。

pain.example: Filling out these forms is a pain, but skipping them costs more.  填这些表格很烦人，但不填代价更大。

scads.example: The film made scads of money in its first weekend alone.  这部电影仅首个周末就赚了大把的钱。

prohibitive.example: The cost of housing here is prohibitive for most young families.  这里的房价对多数年轻家庭来说高不可攀。

decrease in amount.example: Rainfall continued to decrease in amount over three consecutive dry summers.  连续三个干旱的夏天里降雨量持续减少。

extremely brief.example: His answer was extremely brief, just two words and a shrug.  他的回答极其简短，只有两个词加一个耸肩。

proem.example: The author's proem explains why the book took twenty years.  作者的序言解释了这本书为何写了二十年。

prolusion.example: This essay is only a prolusion to a much longer study.  这篇文章只是一部长篇研究的引言。

stretch.example: They stretched the two-day trip into a leisurely full week.  他们把两天的行程拉长成悠闲的一整周。

cut.example: The director cut twenty minutes from the film before its release.  导演在影片上映前剪掉了二十分钟。

proofread.example: Please proofread the manuscript carefully before sending it to the printer.  请在送印之前仔细校对这份手稿。

arouse hostility.example: His blunt remarks aroused hostility in a room full of allies.  他直白的话在满是盟友的房间里招来了敌意。

encouraging.example: The first trial produced encouraging results for the new treatment.  首轮试验为这种新疗法带来了令人鼓舞的结果。

heartening.example: It was heartening to see strangers helping clear the flooded street.  看到陌生人一起清理被淹的街道令人振奋。

promising.example: She is the most promising violinist the school has ever trained.  她是这所学校培养过的最有前途的小提琴手。

discouraging.example: The discouraging test scores made him consider dropping the course.  令人沮丧的考试成绩让他考虑退掉这门课。

disheartening.example: Losing by a single point was disheartening for the entire squad.  以一分之差落败让全队都很泄气。

futureless.example: He quit a futureless job and retrained as a nurse at thirty.  他辞掉没前途的工作，三十岁改学做护士。

unpromising.example: The team made an unpromising start but finished the season strongly.  球队开局不被看好，赛季末却表现强势。

unpropi-.example: Here unpropi- is only half of the adjective unpropitious.  这里 unpropi- 只是 unpropitious 的一半。

tious.example: Adding tious to unpropi- gives back the word unpropitious.  把 tious 接到 unpropi- 后面就还原成 unpropitious。

apostle.example: He became a tireless apostle of reform in the state legislature.  他成了州议会中不懈的改革倡导者。

expounder.example: He became the movement's clearest expounder and busiest public speaker.  他成了这场运动最清晰的阐述者和最忙的演讲人。

protagonist.example: She was a leading protagonist of free public transport in the city.  她是本市免费公交的主要倡导者。

detractor.example: Two winning seasons silenced most of the coach's detractors.  两个赛季的胜利让教练的多数批评者闭了嘴。

appositeness.example: Everyone praised the appositeness of the poem she read aloud.  大家都赞叹她朗读那首诗的贴切。

aptness.example: The aptness of his metaphor made the whole argument suddenly clear.  他比喻的贴切让整个论点顿时清楚了。

felicity.example: Her essays are admired for their felicity of expression.  她的散文以措辞得体而受赞赏。

fitness.example: The committee questioned his fitness for such a sensitive post.  委员会质疑他是否适合这样敏感的职位。

properness.example: No one could fault the properness of her behavior at dinner.  没人能挑出她晚宴上举止的不得体。

rightness.example: Years later he still defended the rightness of that difficult choice.  多年后他仍为那个艰难选择的正确性辩护。

seemliness.example: Her grandmother valued seemliness above almost every other virtue.  她祖母把得体看得几乎重于一切美德。

suitability.example: The panel debated her suitability for the demanding new role.  评审团讨论了她是否适合这个要求很高的新角色。

improperness.example: Guests noticed the improperness of his toast at once.  客人们立刻察觉到他祝酒词的失礼。

inappositeness.example: Critics pointed out the inappositeness of comparing the two crises.  批评者指出把两场危机相比并不贴切。

inappropriateness.example: He apologized for the inappropriateness of his remark about her family.  他为自己关于她家人的不当言辞道歉。

inaptness.example: Readers complained about the inaptness of the book's cheerful title.  读者抱怨这本书欢快的标题很不恰当。

infelicity.example: The editor marked every infelicity in the translated chapter.  编辑标出了译稿这一章里每处措辞失当。

unfitness.example: The inquiry cited his unfitness for command during the crisis.  调查指出他在危机中不适合担任指挥。

unseemli-.example: The typesetter left unseemli- dangling at the end of the line.  排版把 unseemli- 孤零零留在了行尾。

ness.cn: 名词后缀，表性质或状态
ness.example: Adding ness to unseemli- restores the noun unseemliness.  把 ness 接到 unseemli- 后面就还原成 unseemliness。

unsuitability.example: His unsuitability for the job became obvious within a week.  他不适合这份工作，一周内就显而易见。

wrongness.example: She argued the wrongness of the policy in plain, patient language.  她用朴实耐心的语言论证这项政策的错谬。

everyday.example: The book finds poetry in everyday chores like washing dishes.  这本书在洗碗一类日常家务里找到诗意。

unremarkable.example: He grew up in an unremarkable town two hours from the coast.  他在离海岸两小时车程的一个平凡小镇长大。

workaday.example: Her paintings turn workaday streets into something quietly strange.  她的画把平凡街道变得静静地陌生起来。

enjoin.example: The court enjoined the company from dumping waste in the river.  法院禁止该公司向河里倾倒废物。

outlaw.example: The city outlawed single-use plastic bags three years ago.  三年前本市明令禁止一次性塑料袋。

allow.example: The library allows visitors to photograph the manuscripts without flash.  图书馆允许访客不开闪光灯拍摄手稿。

let.example: Please let him finish his sentence before you object.  请让他说完再反驳。

prosecution.example: The general devoted every resource to the prosecution of the long war.  将军把一切资源都投入到这场漫长战争的推进上。

enactment.example: The enactment of the new law took almost four years.  这部新法的颁布用了将近四年。

execution.example: The idea was clever, but its execution was clumsy and slow.  想法很妙，执行却笨拙缓慢。

implementation.example: Full implementation of the reform will begin next spring.  这项改革将于明年春天全面实施。

performance.example: Payment depends on the timely performance of every listed duty.  付款取决于所列各项义务的按时履行。

perpetration.example: Two clerks assisted in the perpetration of the payroll fraud.  两名职员协助实施了这起工资欺诈。

pursuance.example: The officer acted in pursuance of a clear written order.  这名军官是在执行一份明确书面命令。

nonfulfillment.example: The buyer sued over nonfulfillment of the delivery terms.  买方因交货条款未履行提起诉讼。

nonperformance.example: Repeated nonperformance of basic duties cost him the position.  一再不履行基本职责让他失去了职位。

proselytize.example: The missionaries tried to proselytize the villagers with very little success.  传教士试图使村民改变信仰，收效甚微。

prospect.example: Thousands came west to prospect for gold in the mountain streams.  成千上万的人西行到山间溪流中探寻金矿。

hunt.example: Divers hunted for wreckage along the seabed for three weeks.  潜水员在海床上搜寻残骸达三周。

search.example: Volunteers searched the woods until the light finally failed.  志愿者搜寻树林直到天色全暗。

skirr.example: The hounds skirred over the open field looking for a scent.  猎犬在空地上疾走搜寻气味。

etio-.example: In this list the verb etiolate appears broken as etio- and late.  在这份表里，etiolate 被断成 etio- 和 late。

tire.example: Long meetings tire her far more than a hard morning run.  长会比清晨的剧烈跑步更让她疲倦。

protean.example: The actor's protean talent let him play villains and saints equally well.  这位演员多变的才华使他演反派和圣人都同样出色。

static.example: Wages have remained static while the cost of housing keeps rising.  房价不断上涨，工资却一直停滞不动。

protocol.example: Diplomatic protocol requires that the older ambassador be greeted first.  外交礼仪规范要求先向资历较长的大使致意。

drag out.example: Both sides dragged out the talks for another eleven months.  双方又把谈判拖了十一个月。

protrude.example: Rusty nails protrude from the wall, so please walk along the other side.  锈钉子从墙上凸出来，所以请沿另一侧走。

overhang.example: Wooden balconies overhang the narrow street on both sides.  木质阳台从两侧悬在窄街上方。

project.example: A stone ledge projects from the wall about two meters up.  一道石台从墙面约两米高处伸出。

stand out.example: Her red coat made her stand out in the gray crowd.  她的红外套让她在灰色人群中格外显眼。

stick out.example: A rusty pipe sticks out of the ground behind the shed.  一根锈管从棚屋后的地面伸出来。

concave.example: A concave lens spreads the light instead of focusing it.  凹透镜把光线发散而不是聚焦。

protuberant.example: The frog's protuberant eyes let it watch the whole pond.  青蛙凸出的眼睛让它能看遍整个池塘。

concavity.example: Water collects in a shallow concavity at the center of the stone.  水积在石头中央一处浅浅的凹陷里。

scrimpy.example: They survived the winter on a scrimpy budget and a lot of soup.  他们靠拮据的预算和大量汤水过完了冬天。

farseeing.example: A farseeing mayor planted these trees fifty years ago.  一位有远见的市长五十年前种下了这些树。

forehanded.example: Forehanded farmers had already stored grain before the drought hit.  有远见的农民在旱灾来临前已存好粮食。

forethoughtful.example: One forethoughtful engineer insisted on a backup generator.  一位深谋远虑的工程师坚持要装备用发电机。

prescient.example: His 1998 essay now looks remarkably prescient about the internet.  他一九九八年的文章如今看来对互联网极有先见之明。

proactive.cn: 积极主动的，未雨绸缪的
proactive.example: The clinic takes a proactive approach to seasonal flu each autumn.  诊所每年秋天都对季节性流感采取主动措施。

visionary.example: Their visionary founder predicted the mobile market twenty years early.  他们有远见的创始人提前二十年预见了移动市场。
visionary.cn: 有远见的；不切实际的，空想的

half-cocked.example: They went off half-cocked and launched the product without testing.  他们仓促行事，产品未测试就上线了。

improvident.example: Years of improvident borrowing left the family with nothing.  多年无节制的借贷让这家人一无所有。

ill-starred.example: The ill-starred expedition lost two ships in the first month.  这次不幸的远征第一个月就损失了两艘船。

star-crossed.example: The play follows two star-crossed lovers from rival families.  这部戏讲述两个来自仇家、命运多舛的恋人。

illiberal.example: His illiberal views on the arts surprised his younger colleagues.  他对艺术的狭隘看法让年轻同事很惊讶。

receptive.example: The committee proved unexpectedly receptive to her radical proposal.  委员会出乎意料地乐于接受她激进的提案。

provisionary.example: Both sides signed a provisionary agreement pending final review.  双方签了一份临时协议，等待最终审核。

short-term.example: She took a short-term contract to cover someone's parental leave.  她接了份短期合同，代人休育儿假的岗。

long-term.example: Forests are a long-term investment that nobody sees repaid quickly.  森林是一项长期投资，没人能很快看到回报。

provisory.example: The contract contains a provisory clause that lets either side withdraw.  合同中有一条附带条件的条款，允许任何一方退出。

fire up.example: One short speech fired up the whole exhausted team.  一段简短讲话点燃了整支疲惫队伍的斗志。

stir up.example: The rumor stirred up more anger than the original decision.  这条谣言激起的怒火比原来的决定还多。

whip up.example: Talk radio whipped up public anger against the new tax.  电台谈话节目煽起了公众对新税的怒火。

courageousness.example: Her courageousness during the rescue was mentioned by every witness.  每个目击者都提到她在救援中的勇敢。

daring.example: Climbing that face alone took real daring and long preparation.  独自攀那面岩壁需要真正的胆量和长期准备。

gallantry.example: He received a medal for gallantry after pulling three men out.  他救出三个人后获得了英勇奖章。

prowl.example: Hungry foxes prowl the dark streets long after the market closes.  市场关门很久之后，饥饿的狐狸仍在暗街徘徊觅食。

prude.example: Her neighbors dismissed her as a prim old prude who disliked laughter.  邻居们把她看作一个不喜欢笑声的一本正经的老古板。

bluenose.example: Some bluenose on the council wants the mural painted over.  议会里某个老古板想把这幅壁画涂掉。

moralist.example: The novel's narrator is a moralist who judges everyone harshly.  小说的叙述者是个对人人都苛评的道德家。

puritan.example: My aunt is a puritan about money and refuses all credit.  我姑姑在金钱上极为严谨，拒绝一切信贷。

immoralist.example: The poet posed as an immoralist to shock respectable readers.  这位诗人装作反道德者，以震惊体面的读者。

prudish.example: His prudish attitude toward modern art amused the younger students.  他对现代艺术过分守礼的态度让年轻学生觉得好笑。

nice-nelly.example: The editor replaced every blunt word with nice-nelly substitutes.  编辑把每个直白的词都换成假正经的说法。

prim.example: She sat very prim on the edge of the borrowed chair.  她一本正经地坐在借来的椅子边上。

puritanical.example: His puritanical upbringing left him uneasy about any luxury.  极严谨的家教让他对任何奢侈都不自在。

prune.example: We should prune the rose bushes before the first frost arrives.  我们应该在初霜到来之前修剪玫瑰丛。

shave.example: The carpenter shaved a thin layer off the sticking door.  木匠把卡住的门削掉薄薄一层。

shear.example: They shear the whole flock over two long spring weekends.  他们用春天两个长周末给整群羊剪毛。

snip.example: She snipped off the dead ends before putting the flowers in water.  她把枯掉的末端剪掉再把花插进水里。

trim.example: He trims the hedge every June before the neighbors complain.  他每年六月在邻居抱怨前修剪树篱。

nose.example: Reporters nosed around the office for two days looking for leaks.  记者在办公室四处打探了两天，想找到泄密者。

pseudonym.example: She published her early detective novels under a masculine pseudonym.  她早期的侦探小说是用一个男性笔名发表的。

nom de guerre.example: Every member of the group used a nom de guerre in letters.  小组每个成员在信中都用化名。

putative.example: Scholars question whether the putative author actually wrote the disputed play.  学者们怀疑那位推定的作者是否真写了这部有争议的剧本。

ostensible.example: The ostensible purpose of the trip was research, but he went sightseeing.  这次旅行表面上的目的是研究，但他去观光了。

presumed.example: Faulty wiring is still the presumed cause of the fire.  线路故障仍是这场火灾的推定原因。

reputed.example: He is the reputed owner of three houses on this street.  据说这条街上有三栋房子是他的。

seeming.example: Her seeming calm hid a week of sleepless worry.  她表面的平静掩盖了一周的失眠焦虑。

supposed.example: Nobody could measure the supposed benefits of the expensive program.  没人能衡量这个昂贵项目所谓的好处。

pecuniary.example: The judge found that he had acted purely for pecuniary gain.  法官认定他的行为纯粹是为了金钱上的收益。

fiscal.example: The report covers the fiscal year ending in September.  这份报告涵盖截至九月的财政年度。

monetary.example: The bank tightened monetary policy to slow rising prices.  央行收紧货币政策以抑制物价上涨。

financial.example: The museum survives on financial support from a few private donors.  博物馆靠少数私人捐助者的资金支持维持。

nonfinancial.example: Many volunteers stay for nonfinancial rewards such as friendship.  许多志愿者留下是为了友情这类非金钱回报。

puckish.example: A puckish grin spread across his face as he hid the keys.  他藏起钥匙时，脸上露出顽皮的笑容。

prankish.example: Even at seventy he kept a prankish sense of humor.  他七十岁了还保有一种顽皮的幽默。

might.example: He pushed the stalled car with all his might.  他竭尽全力推那辆熄火的车。

vigor.example: She argued her case with surprising vigor after a sleepless night.  一夜未眠后，她仍以惊人的活力申辩自己的主张。

sinew.example: Farmers were once called the sinew of the whole nation.  农民曾被称为整个国家的力量支柱。

pulchritude.example: Poets of that age praised pulchritude far more than intelligence.  那个时代的诗人赞美容貌远多于赞美才智。

ugliness.example: Locals still complain about the ugliness of the concrete tower.  当地人仍在抱怨那座水泥塔楼的丑陋。

homeliness.example: The portrait captures a homeliness that photographs always flattened.  这幅肖像捕捉到照片总也拍不出的朴拙。

hideousness.example: Children ran from the hideousness of the carved wooden mask.  孩子们被那木刻面具的丑怖吓跑了。

pulverize.example: Workers used heavy hammers to pulverize the rock into fine powder.  工人用重锤把岩石研磨成细粉。

starchy.example: The new director was starchy and never joined the lunch table.  新主管很古板，从不来午餐桌上坐。

stilted.example: Their stilted conversation died out before the soup arrived.  他们生硬的交谈在汤上来前就断了。

laid-back.example: His laid-back attitude drives the more anxious editors crazy.  他随性的态度让那些容易焦虑的编辑发疯。

puny.example: Their puny effort to clean the beach barely made any difference.  他们清理海滩的微小努力几乎没有产生任何效果。

dwarfish.example: Only dwarfish pines survive on that windswept ridge.  只有矮小的松树能在那道风口山脊上存活。

king-size.example: The tiny room somehow held a king-size bed and nothing else.  那间小屋居然塞进一张特大号床，别无他物。

outsize.example: This small country has an outsize influence on global shipping.  这个小国对全球航运有着超乎其体量的影响。

overscale.example: Overscale sofas make the little apartment feel even smaller.  尺寸过大的沙发让这小公寓显得更挤。

whacking.example: The repair came with a whacking great bill we could not pay.  这次维修带来一大笔我们付不起的账单。

claim.example: He claims to have finished the whole course in one weekend.  他自称一个周末就上完了整门课。

purlieu.example: He returned to his old purlieu near the docks after many years.  多年之后，他回到码头附近他常去的旧地。

rendezvous.example: That noisy cafe was our rendezvous every Friday evening.  那家吵闹的咖啡馆是我们每周五晚的聚会点。

resort.example: The lake became a busy summer resort within a decade.  这片湖十年间变成了热闹的夏日度假地。

stamping ground.example: He walked me around his old stamping ground near the docks.  他带我逛了他在码头附近常去的旧地。

stomping ground.example: Back on her old stomping ground, she knew every shortcut.  回到熟悉的老地盘，她知道每条近路。

backyard.example: Nobody wants a waste plant in their own backyard.  谁也不想垃圾处理厂建在自家门口。

neighborhood.example: They chose a quiet neighborhood with good schools nearby.  他们选了一个安静街区，附近学校也好。

vicinage.example: Every farm in the vicinage lost power for two days.  附近每个农场都停电了两天。

vicinity.example: Three witnesses were in the vicinity when the alarm sounded.  警报响时有三名证人在附近。

snitch.example: Someone snitched my pen while I was out of the room.  我离开房间时有人偷走了我的笔。

purvey.example: The small shop has purveyed fresh produce to local restaurants for decades.  这家小店几十年来一直向本地餐馆供应新鲜农产品。

dastardly.example: Poisoning the well was a dastardly act even in wartime.  即便在战时，往井里投毒也是卑劣之举。

poltroon.example: The old play calls the fleeing soldier a poltroon.  这部老戏把逃跑的士兵称作懦夫。

doughty.example: She was a doughty defender of the village school for decades.  她数十年来一直是村校勇敢的捍卫者。

lionhearted.example: Their lionhearted goalkeeper played the second half with a broken finger.  他们无畏的守门员断了手指还打完下半场。

stout-.example: The page break left stout- alone at the end of the line.  分页把 stout- 单独留在了行尾。

hearted.example: Joining stout- with hearted gives back the adjective stouthearted.  把 stout- 与 hearted 接起来就还原成 stouthearted。

honest practitioner.example: Every honest practitioner in town refused to sign the false report.  城里每个正派的从业者都拒绝在假报告上签字。

blench.example: He did not blench at the sight of the deep wound.  看到那道深伤口他也没有畏缩。

become resolute.example: Under pressure she chose to become resolute instead of giving up quietly.  在压力之下，她选择变得坚决，而不是默默放弃。

give bold.example: Students who give bold answers learn faster than silent ones.  敢给出大胆回答的学生比沉默的学得更快。

qualify.example: The professor qualified his praise by noting several serious flaws.  教授指出几处严重缺陷，对自己的赞扬作了限定。

equip.example: The course equips students with skills employers actually want.  这门课让学生掌握雇主真正需要的技能。

ready.example: Crews readied the boat while the tide was still high.  趁潮水还高，船员把船准备妥当。

season.example: Two hard winters seasoned the young crew completely.  两个艰苦的冬天把这批年轻船员彻底磨练老练了。

unreserved.example: She offered unreserved praise for the young translator's work.  她对这位年轻译者的作品毫无保留地称赞。

catch-pp.example: This rule is a catch-pp: you need experience to gain experience.  这条规定是个两难困境：要有经验才能获得经验。

double bind.example: Working parents are often caught in a double bind over childcare.  在职父母常在照看孩子上陷入双重困境。

state of complete certainty.example: Science rarely offers a state of complete certainty about anything.  科学很少对任何事给出完全确定的状态。

qualm.example: She had no qualms about reporting the accountant to the authorities.  她对向当局举报那名会计毫无顾虑。

repress.example: She struggled to repress a smile during the solemn ceremony.  在庄严的仪式上她努力忍住笑意。

squelch.example: Troops moved in quickly to squelch the rebellion in the province.  军队迅速开进，镇压该省的叛乱。

clamp down on.example: The city clamped down on illegal parking near the school gates.  市里严厉整治校门附近的违章停车。

crack down on.example: Regulators finally cracked down on the unlicensed lending apps.  监管部门终于取缔了这些无照放贷软件。

quirky.example: Her quirky sense of humor made even dull meetings entertaining.  她古怪的幽默感让沉闷的会议也变得有趣。

hush.example: She hushed the restless children with one long story.  她用一个长故事把躁动的孩子们哄安静了。

slake.example: They stopped at the well to slake their thirst after the long climb.  长途攀登后他们在井边停下解渴。

querulous.example: He answered every question in a querulous tone that annoyed everyone.  他用抱怨的语调回答每个问题，惹得所有人不快。

grouchy.example: He is grouchy every morning until the second cup of coffee.  每天早上第二杯咖啡之前他都很暴躁。

grumpy.example: Our grumpy neighbor complains whenever the children play outside.  孩子们一在外面玩，爱发牢骚的邻居就抱怨。

long-suffering.example: His long-suffering assistant rewrote the report for the fourth time.  他长期忍耐的助手第四次重写了那份报告。

patient.example: A good teacher stays patient with beginners who ask the same question.  好老师对反复问同一问题的新手仍有耐心。

uncomplaining.example: She was uncomplaining even through the longest night shifts.  即使最长的夜班她也从不抱怨。

tumultuous.example: The pianist returned to tumultuous applause from the standing crowd.  钢琴家返场时全场起立，掌声雷动。

restlessly active.example: His restlessly active mind jumped from project to project.  他躁动不停的头脑在各个项目间跳跃。

quixotic.example: His quixotic quest to reform the entire system ended in failure.  他要改革整个体制的不切实际的追寻以失败告终。

impractical.example: Building a bridge there proved impractical and hugely expensive.  在那里建桥被证明不切实际且极其昂贵。

romantic.example: He has a romantic notion that farming is always peaceful.  他有个浪漫想法，以为农耕总是宁静的。

starry.example: Her starry plans for the theater never survived the budget meeting.  她对剧院的梦幻计划没能通过预算会议。

utopian.example: The pamphlet proposed a utopian city without money or locks.  这本小册子设想了一座没有钱和锁的空想城市。

quota.example: The team worked overtime to meet the monthly sales quota.  团队加班以完成每月的销售配额。

allowance.example: Each passenger has a baggage allowance of two small bags.  每位乘客的行李限额是两个小包。

portion.example: They served a generous portion of rice with every dish.  每道菜都配了分量很足的米饭。

proportion.example: A large proportion of the budget goes to teacher salaries.  预算中很大比例用于教师工资。

unlimited number.example: The app allows an unlimited number of tries before the test.  这个应用允许考前无限次尝试。

quotidian.example: The novel finds real beauty in the quotidian routine of village life.  这部小说在乡村生活的日常事务中发现了真正的美。

ubiquitous.example: Cheap sensors are now ubiquitous in cars, phones, and doorbells.  廉价传感器如今在汽车、手机和门铃里无处不在。
ubiquitous.cn: 无所不在的，普遍存在的

seldom.example: He seldom answers the phone before ten in the morning.  他早上十点前很少接电话。

rabble.example: The speaker tried to stir up the rabble outside the courthouse.  演讲者试图煽动法院外的暴民。

ragtag and bobtail.example: The old chronicle dismisses the marchers as ragtag and bobtail.  旧编年史把这些游行者贬为乌合之众。

riffraff.example: The club raised its prices to keep out the riffraff.  俱乐部提价，把闲杂人等挡在门外。

scum.example: The guards treated every prisoner as the scum of the earth.  看守把每个囚犯都当成社会渣滓对待。

rag.example: The old phrase rag, tag, and bobtail simply meant the common crowd.  古语 rag, tag, and bobtail 就是指普通民众。

trash.example: Her letters show real contempt, calling the newcomers trash.  她的信里满是轻蔑，把新来者称作下层败类。

unwashed.example: Editorials of that era sneered at the great unwashed.  那个时代的社论嘲讽平民大众。

ferocious.example: A ferocious storm tore the roof off the fishing shed.  一场猛烈的风暴把渔棚的屋顶掀掉了。

feverish.example: There was feverish activity backstage an hour before curtain.  开演前一小时后台一片狂热忙乱。

frantic.example: A frantic search for the missing keys delayed everyone.  一场疯狂找钥匙的搜寻让大家都晚了。

frenetic.example: The kitchen keeps a frenetic pace from six until midnight.  厨房从六点到午夜都保持疯狂的节奏。

violent.example: Mixing the two powders causes a violent reaction.  把这两种粉末混合会引起剧烈反应。

languorous.example: They spent a languorous afternoon lying under the fig tree.  他们在无花果树下度过一个倦懒的午后。

raffish.example: The old actor had a raffish charm that everyone found irresistible.  这位老演员有种放浪不羁的魅力，人人难以抗拒。

lowbred.example: The hostess found his loud jokes lowbred and tiresome.  女主人觉得他大声的玩笑粗俗又乏味。

unpolished.example: His writing is unpolished but honest and often very funny.  他的文字粗糙，却真诚而常常很好笑。

ultrarefined.cn: 极其考究的，过分精致的
ultrarefined.example: The critic's ultrarefined taste made him hate every popular film.  这位评论家极其考究的品味让他讨厌每部流行电影。

summarize.example: Please summarize the report in three sentences for the board.  请把报告用三句话概述给董事会。

deliriousness.example: In his deliriousness he mistook the nurse for his sister.  昏乱中他把护士当成了自己的姐姐。

ragged.example: The saw left a ragged edge along the whole length of the board.  锯子在整块木板上留下参差不平的边缘。

broken.example: The horses slowed across the broken ground near the ravine.  马匹在峡谷附近高低不平的地面上放慢了脚步。

bumpy.example: The bumpy track shook every bolt loose on the old truck.  坑洼的土路把老卡车上每颗螺栓都震松了。

jagged.example: Jagged rocks below the cliff made landing impossible.  崖下锯齿状的岩石使登陆无法进行。

lumpy.example: I slept badly on a lumpy mattress in the attic room.  我在阁楼那张凹凸不平的床垫上没睡好。

pebbly.example: The pebbly beach hurt our feet but the water was clear.  卵石海滩硌脚，但水很清。

roughened.example: Years of rope work left his palms roughened and hard.  多年拉绳的活计让他手掌变得粗糙坚硬。

scraggy.cn: 粗糙不平的；瘦骨嶙峋的
scraggy.example: Goats climbed the scraggy slope without any trouble.  山羊毫不费力地爬上那道嶙峋的坡。

plane.example: Grinding produced a perfectly plane surface for the lens.  研磨为这枚镜片做出了完全平整的表面。

accredit.example: The board finally accredited the new nursing program.  委员会终于认可了这个新的护理专业。

debauched.example: The novel follows a debauched young lord toward his ruin.  小说讲一位放荡的年轻贵族走向毁灭。

demoralized.cn: 堕落的，道德败坏的；士气低落的
demoralized.example: The chronicle describes a demoralized court given over to gambling and drink.  编年史描述了一个沉溺于赌博与饮酒的堕落宫廷。

depraved.example: Critics called the film depraved, which only sold more tickets.  批评者称这部电影堕落，结果票卖得更多。

perverted.example: He justified the theft with a perverted sense of fairness.  他用一种扭曲的公平感为盗窃辩解。

blather.example: He blathered on about traffic while everyone waited to order.  大家等着点菜，他还在唠唠叨叨说交通。

maunder.example: The old sailor maundered on about ports nobody had heard of.  老水手漫无边际地讲着没人听过的港口。

patter.cn: 喋喋不休地说；急促轻响
patter.example: The magician kept up a cheerful patter while shuffling the cards.  魔术师一边洗牌一边说着轻快的顺口话。

ramshackle.example: They stored hay in a ramshackle barn that leaned toward the road.  他们把干草存放在一座向马路倾斜的摇摇欲坠的谷仓里。

rickety.example: We climbed a rickety wooden staircase to reach the attic bedroom.  我们爬上摇摇晃晃的木楼梯，来到阁楼卧室。

tottering.example: A tottering stack of books finally slid onto the floor.  一摞摇晃的书终于滑到了地上。

bitterness.example: Old bitterness surfaced whenever the two brothers discussed money.  两兄弟一谈钱，旧怨就浮上来。

grudge.example: She held a grudge against her cousin for more than ten years.  她对表姐怀恨在心十多年。

goodwill.example: They returned the boat as a gesture of goodwill.  他们归还了那条船，以示善意。

rapport.example: The new teacher quickly built a good rapport with her difficult class.  这位新老师很快与她难带的班级建立了友好关系。

rapprochement.example: Trade talks began a cautious rapprochement between the two capitals.  贸易谈判开启了两国首都间谨慎的和解。

random.example: The survey drew a random sample of two thousand households nationwide.  这项调查在全国抽取了两千户家庭的随机样本。

castigation.example: The report's castigation of the agency filled forty angry pages.  报告对该机构的严厉斥责写了四十页。

lambasting.example: He took a lambasting from the press after the failed launch.  发射失败后他受到媒体一顿痛斥。

coveting.example: Endless coveting of other people's houses made him miserable.  不停垂涎别人的房子让他很痛苦。

sated.example: Sated after the long dinner, nobody wanted dessert.  长长的晚餐后大家都饱了，没人要甜点。

satiated.example: Readers satiated with sequels ignored the studio's newest film.  对续集已厌腻的观众忽略了片方的新片。

communion.example: Long walks gave him a quiet communion with the hills.  长途步行让他与群山有了静默的交流。

evildoer.example: In these old tales every evildoer is punished by the last page.  在这些老故事里，每个作恶者到末页都受罚。

knave.example: The play's villain is a smiling knave who betrays everyone.  剧中反派是个笑面无赖，谁都背叛。

rogue.example: Audiences forgive the hero because he is a charming rogue.  观众原谅这位主角，因为他是个迷人的无赖。

scamp.example: That scamp hid my glasses in the flour jar again.  那个小淘气又把我的眼镜藏进面粉罐里。

varlet.example: The old comedy calls the servant a lazy varlet.  这部老喜剧把那仆人称作懒惰的无赖。

wretch.example: The poor wretch had slept outside for three freezing nights.  这可怜人在外冻睡了三个夜晚。

saint.example: Teaching that class demands the patience of a saint.  教那个班需要圣人般的耐心。

enraptured.example: The enraptured audience refused to leave after three encores.  如痴如醉的观众在三次返场后仍不肯走。

entranced.example: The children sat entranced by the puppet show for an hour.  孩子们入迷地看了一小时木偶戏。

euphoric.example: The team was euphoric after winning on the final kick.  最后一脚制胜后全队欣喜若狂。

intoxicated.example: Intoxicated with early success, the founders ignored every warning.  被早期成功陶醉，创始人们无视了每个警告。

rapturous.example: Her final aria met rapturous applause from the packed hall.  她最后一段咏叹调引来满场狂热的掌声。

rhapsodic.example: Reviewers were rhapsodic about the young cellist's tone.  评论者对这位年轻大提琴手的音色赞不绝口。

rarefy.example: Great altitude rarefies the air and makes every step exhausting.  海拔高会使空气稀薄，让每一步都令人疲惫。

gadarene.cn: 鲁莽疾冲的，一哄而上的
gadarene.example: There was a gadarene rush for the exits when the lights failed.  灯一灭，人们一哄而上冲向出口。

croaky.example: She answered in a croaky voice after two nights of coughing.  咳了两晚后她用低哑的嗓音回答。

finalize.example: Both sides hope to finalize the agreement before December.  双方希望在十二月前敲定协议。

ratiocination.example: The detective solved the case through careful ratiocination rather than luck.  这位侦探靠缜密的推理而非运气破了案。

deduction.example: By simple deduction she knew the letter had been opened.  通过简单推论她就知道信被打开过。

intellection.example: He treats mathematics as pure intellection, untouched by the world.  他把数学看作不涉世事的纯粹思辨。

reasoning.example: Her reasoning was clear enough for the jury to follow.  她的推理清楚得陪审团都能跟上。

ration.example: The city had to ration the water supply during the long drought.  长期干旱期间，城市不得不定量分配供水。

allocate.example: The council allocated most of the grant to school repairs.  议会把大部分拨款划给了校舍维修。

allot.example: Each speaker was allotted exactly seven minutes.  每位发言者被分配到整整七分钟。

apportion.example: The repair costs were apportioned among all six tenants.  维修费用在六位租户之间按比例分摊。

distribute.example: Volunteers distributed blankets to every family by nightfall.  志愿者在天黑前给每家分发了毛毯。

rhapsodize.example: He rhapsodized about the little bakery for a full hour.  他对那家小面包房赞不绝口地讲了整整一小时。

huff.example: She left in a huff when nobody supported her proposal.  没人支持她的提议，她气冲冲地走了。

ravel.example: She patiently began to ravel out the tangled thread with a needle.  她耐心地用针把缠住的线头解开。

unbraid.example: She unbraided her hair slowly in front of the small mirror.  她在小镜子前慢慢解开辫子。

unsnarl.example: It took an hour to unsnarl the fishing line.  理清那根钓鱼线花了一小时。

untwine.example: He patiently untwined the vine from the iron gate.  他耐心地把藤蔓从铁门上解下来。

unweave.example: Restorers must carefully unweave the damaged border before repairing the tapestry.  修复者必须小心拆开破损的边缘，然后再修补这幅壁毯。

unravel.example: Detectives worked for months to unravel the tangled web of lies.  侦探们花了几个月才解开这张谎言之网。

snarl.example: Heavy snow snarled traffic across the city for most of the morning.  大雪使全城交通整个上午陷入混乱。

braid.example: Her grandmother would braid her long hair every morning before school.  她奶奶每天早上上学前都会给她编辫子。

plait.example: The weaver taught us how to plait dried reeds into sturdy baskets.  那位编织匠教我们把干芦苇编成结实的篮子。

weave.example: Villagers still weave cloth on wooden looms handed down for generations.  村民们仍用世代相传的木织机织布。

annihilate.example: A single flood could annihilate the entire harvest of the valley.  一场洪水就能彻底毁掉整个山谷的收成。

decimate.example: The epidemic decimated herds of cattle across three provinces.  这场疫病使三个省的牛群大量死亡。

devastate.example: The earthquake devastated neighborhoods that had stood for a century.  地震摧毁了矗立了一个世纪的街区。

nuke.cn: 用核武器攻击；彻底摧毁
nuke.phrase_cn: 对一座城市发动核打击
nuke.example: Generals debated whether to nuke the island rather than invade it.  将军们争论是否用核武器打击该岛而非登陆进攻。

vaporize.example: A single blast vaporized the abandoned tower on the distant hill.  一次爆炸就把远处山上那座废弃塔楼彻底摧毁。

tear down.example: The council voted to tear down the crumbling stadium next spring.  市议会投票决定明年春天拆除这座破败的体育场。

altercation.example: A brief altercation over parking escalated into a lawsuit.  一场关于停车的短暂争吵最后升级成了诉讼。

quarrel.example: The brothers had a bitter quarrel about their father's will.  兄弟俩为父亲的遗嘱激烈争吵了一场。

squabble.example: The children squabble endlessly about who sits by the window.  孩子们为谁坐窗边没完没了地吵。

wrangle.example: A long legal wrangle over the land delayed construction for years.  一场关于这块土地的漫长法律纷争使工程推迟数年。

traditionalistic.example: His traditionalistic views made him distrust every new teaching method.  他守旧的观念使他不信任任何新教法。

ream.example: The sergeant reamed out the recruit for arriving late a third time.  中士痛骂那名第三次迟到的新兵。

ramification.example: Few politicians considered the far-reaching ramifications of the sudden tax cut.  很少有政客考虑到突然减税影响深远的后果。

outgrowth.example: The new festival was a natural outgrowth of the summer concerts.  这个新节庆是夏季音乐会的自然产物。

rebuff.example: The board rebuffed the offer without even reading the full proposal.  董事会甚至没读完提案就断然拒绝了该报价。

governable.example: With patience the once wild horse became perfectly governable.  在耐心训练下，这匹曾野性难驯的马变得十分听话。

retract.example: The newspaper agreed to retract the claim and print a formal apology.  报社同意收回那项说法并刊登正式道歉。

maintain.example: He continued to maintain that he had never seen the document.  他一直坚称自己从未见过那份文件。

stick.example: Under hours of questioning the witness stuck to her original account.  在数小时的盘问下，证人仍坚持她最初的说法。

backward.example: He was too backward to introduce himself to the newcomers.  他太腼腆，不敢向新来的人自我介绍。

bashful.example: The bashful boy hid behind his mother whenever guests arrived.  每次有客人来，这个害羞的男孩就躲到母亲身后。

coy.phrase_cn: 对自己的过去讳莫如深
coy.example: She was oddly coy about where she had spent the previous summer.  她对上一个夏天去了哪里出奇地讳莫如深。

introverted.example: Being introverted, she preferred a quiet library to a noisy party.  由于性格内向，她宁愿待在安静的图书馆而不是喧闹的派对。

sheepish.example: He gave a sheepish apology for forgetting our appointment again.  他为再次忘记约会难为情地道了歉。

immodest.cn: 不谦虚的，自负的；不检点的
