immodest.example: It seems immodest to list every award on the first page.  把每个奖项都列在第一页显得有些不谦虚。

recidivate.example: Many offenders recidivate within a year of release without proper support.  许多罪犯在缺乏适当支持时会在获释一年内重新犯罪。

regress.example: Under stress he tends to regress to childish and sulky behavior.  在压力下他往往退化为幼稚而怨怼的行为。

relapse.example: Without support many patients relapse into old habits within months.  缺乏支持的话，许多病人几个月内就重蹈旧习。

retrogress.example: Without steady funding the program began to retrogress noticeably.  缺乏稳定资金，这个项目开始明显倒退。

revert.example: After a week of dieting he reverted to eating late-night snacks.  节食一周后，他又回到深夜吃零食的老样子。

habilitate.phrase_cn: 使残障工人具备工作能力
habilitate.example: The center exists to habilitate young adults with learning difficulties.  该中心旨在使有学习障碍的青年具备生活能力。

reclaim.example: The charity tries to reclaim addicts through work and counseling.  该慈善机构试图通过工作和咨询感化成瘾者。

regenerate.example: The city spent millions to regenerate a neighborhood near the old port.  该市花费数百万使旧港附近的一个街区焕然一新。

rehabilitate.phrase_cn: 帮助刑满释放者重返社会
rehabilitate.example: The program aims to rehabilitate former inmates and find them jobs.  该项目旨在帮刑满释放者重返社会并找到工作。

reciprocate.example: They drove the neighbors to the airport to reciprocate her kindness.  他们开车送邻居去机场，以回报她的好意。

repay.example: I can never repay the patience my mentor showed me.  导师给我的耐心，我永远无法回报。

requite.example: He wanted to requite her kindness with a gift she would truly treasure.  他想用一件她会真正珍视的礼物报答她的善意。

retaliate.example: If we raise tariffs, our trading partners will almost certainly retaliate.  如果我们提高关税，贸易伙伴几乎肯定会报复。

return.example: She helped me move, so I returned the favor with dinner.  她帮我搬家，所以我请她吃饭作为回报。

owe.example: I owe my colleagues a great deal for covering my shifts.  同事们替我值班，我欠他们很多。

recluse.example: The poet lived as a recluse in a cabin deep in the woods.  这位诗人隐居在林深处的一间小屋里。

anchorite.example: The medieval anchorite spent forty years walled in a tiny cell.  这位中世纪隐修士在一间小室里封闭生活了四十年。

eremite.example: Legend says an eremite lived in that cave for decades.  传说有位隐士在那个洞穴里住了几十年。

hermit.example: After his wife died he became a hermit in the hills.  妻子去世后，他成了山中的隐士。

secluded.example: They honeymooned in a secluded valley far from any road.  他们在远离公路的僻静山谷度蜜月。

secluse.example: The poet led a secluse life in a mountain hut.  这位诗人在山间小屋过着隐居生活。

seclusive.example: His seclusive habits puzzled neighbors who never saw him outdoors.  他孤僻的习性让从未见他外出的邻居们困惑。

sequestered.example: The monks study in a sequestered wing closed to visitors.  僧侣们在一处不对外开放的幽僻侧厅研习。

squinch.example: The child squinched her eyes shut before the shot.  打针前那孩子把眼睛紧紧闭成一条缝。

reconnoiter.example: Two scouts went ahead at dawn to reconnoiter the enemy positions.  两名侦察兵黎明先行去侦察敌方阵地。

reconstruct.example: Engineers reconstructed the bridge using the original nineteenth-century plans.  工程师们依照十九世纪的原始图纸重建了这座桥。

reorder.example: The new editor reordered the chapters to improve the narrative flow.  新编辑重排了章节顺序以改善叙事节奏。

reorganize.example: Management reorganized the sales team after two disappointing quarters.  两个季度业绩不佳后，管理层重组了销售团队。

reshuffle.example: The prime minister reshuffled his cabinet to quiet the critics.  首相改组内阁以平息批评。

retool.example: The company must retool its whole strategy for a digital market.  公司必须为数字市场彻底调整整个战略。

virtuousness.example: Her virtuousness impressed even those who disagreed with her politics.  她的德行连政见不同的人也为之动容。

badness.example: The novel explores the badness lurking in ordinary people.  这部小说探讨潜藏在普通人身上的恶。

immorality.example: Preachers denounced the immorality they saw in the new theaters.  传教士谴责他们在新剧院里看到的不道德风气。

villainy.example: The play delights audiences with the villainy of its scheming duke.  剧中那位阴谋公爵的恶行让观众看得过瘾。

recumbent.example: A recumbent stone figure guards the entrance to the ancient tomb.  一尊卧姿石像守着这座古墓的入口。

decumbent.example: This herb has decumbent stems that spread across the sand.  这种草本植物的茎平卧着铺展在沙地上。

procumbent.example: Botanists noted the procumbent growth of the coastal plant.  植物学家记录了这种海岸植物匍匐的生长方式。

reclining.example: He read the newspaper in a reclining position by the window.  他在窗边半躺着看报纸。

supine.example: The legislature's supine acceptance of injustice angered many ordinary citizens.  立法机关对不公的消极接受激怒了许多普通市民。
supine.cn: 仰卧的；消极的，漠不关心的

rally.example: The patient rallied surprisingly quickly after a week of treatment.  经过一周治疗，病人恢复得出人意料地快。

unscented.example: She buys unscented lotion because perfumes irritate her skin.  她买无香味的乳液，因为香精会刺激她的皮肤。

noteworthy.example: The most noteworthy feature of the report is its honesty.  这份报告最值得注意的地方是它的诚实。

calming.cn: 令人平静的，使人安心的
calming.example: The nurse spoke in a calming tone until the child relaxed.  护士用令人安心的语调说话，直到孩子放松下来。

comforting.example: It was comforting to know that help was only minutes away.  知道救援只有几分钟就到，这很让人安心。

consoling.example: He offered a few consoling words before leaving the hospital room.  他在离开病房前说了几句安慰的话。

lulling.cn: 使人昏昏欲睡的，安抚的
lulling.example: The lulling hum of the train soon put everyone to sleep.  火车令人欲睡的嗡嗡声很快让所有人都睡着了。

pacifying.example: Her pacifying manner defused the argument within minutes.  她安抚的态度几分钟内就化解了争执。

quieting.example: Soft lighting had a quieting effect on the restless ward.  柔和的灯光让不安的病房安静了下来。

reassuring.cn: 令人安心的，使人放心的
reassuring.example: The pilot's reassuring announcement calmed the nervous passengers.  机长令人安心的广播让紧张的乘客平静下来。

relaxing.example: Nothing is more relaxing than an afternoon beside a quiet lake.  没有什么比在静湖边度过一个下午更放松了。

soothing.example: She played soothing music to help the baby fall asleep.  她放着舒缓的音乐帮助婴儿入睡。

redundant.example: The editor cut several paragraphs of redundant information from the report.  编辑从报告中删去了几段多余的信息。

excess.example: Trim any excess fabric before you sew the final seam.  在缝最后一道线前先剪掉多余的布料。

extra.example: We packed extra blankets in case the night turned cold.  我们多带了几条毯子，以防夜里变冷。

supererogatory.example: Sending flowers as well seemed a supererogatory act of kindness.  再送花显得是分外的好意了。

superfluous.example: The editor cut every superfluous detail from the opening chapter.  编辑删掉了开篇一章中所有多余的细节。

supernumerary.example: Two supernumerary actors filled the crowd scene without speaking.  两名临时演员在群众场面中充当配角，没有台词。

spin.example: Watch the wooden top spin steadily on the smooth kitchen table.  看那木陀螺在光滑的餐桌上平稳旋转。

swirl.example: Dead leaves swirled across the empty square in the wind.  枯叶在风中打着旋掠过空荡的广场。

turn.example: The heavy wheel turned slowly as the miller released the water.  磨坊主放水时，那沉重的轮子慢慢转动起来。

whirl.example: Snowflakes whirled madly in the beam of the streetlight.  雪花在路灯光柱中疯狂飞旋。

referee.example: A respected professor agreed to act as referee in the bitter dispute.  一位受人尊敬的教授同意在这场激烈争端中担任仲裁人。

adjudicator.example: An outside adjudicator was appointed to settle the contract dispute.  一名外部裁决人受聘解决这场合同纠纷。

arbiter.example: The court remains the final arbiter of constitutional questions.  法院仍是宪法问题的最终裁定者。

arbitrator.example: Both sides agreed to let an arbitrator decide the wage dispute.  双方同意由仲裁人裁决这起工资争端。

judge.example: Three judges scored each performance without conferring with one another.  三名评委各自评分，互不商议。

umpire.example: The umpire called the runner out despite loud protests.  尽管抗议声很大，裁判还是判跑垒员出局。

adjudge.example: The tribunal adjudged the contract void from the start.  法庭裁定该合同自始无效。

adjudicate.example: A retired judge was asked to adjudicate the long-running border dispute.  一位退休法官被请来裁决这场旷日持久的边界纠纷。

arbitrate.example: A retired judge was asked to arbitrate the family's property quarrel.  一位退休法官受邀仲裁这家人的财产纷争。

decide.example: It took the panel two days to decide who deserved the prize.  评审团花了两天才裁定谁该得奖。

consult.example: Before signing anything you should consult a lawyer you trust.  签任何东西前你都该咨询一位信得过的律师。

amend.example: Parliament amended the law to close an obvious loophole.  议会修改了法律以堵住一个明显的漏洞。

better.example: He took night classes to better his chances of promotion.  他上夜校以增加自己升职的机会。

muse.example: She sat by the fire and mused about the choices she had made.  她坐在火边，沉思自己做过的选择。

ponder.example: He pondered the offer for a week before finally accepting it.  他把这个提议考虑了一周才最终接受。

think.example: Give me a day to think carefully about what you proposed.  给我一天时间仔细想想你的提议。

occlude.example: Thick clouds occluded the sun for the entire afternoon.  厚云整个下午都遮住了太阳。

resplendent.example: The bride appeared resplendent in a gown embroidered with hundreds of tiny pearls.  新娘身着绣满数百颗小珍珠的礼服，光彩夺目。

recharge.example: A quiet weekend in the mountains recharged him completely.  在山里过了个安静的周末，他完全恢复了精力。

refresh.phrase_cn: 使疲惫的旅人恢复精神
refresh.example: A cold shower refreshed him after the long hike.  长途徒步后，一个冷水澡让他恢复了精神。

rejuvenate.cn: 使显得年轻，使恢复活力
rejuvenate.example: Two weeks by the sea seemed to rejuvenate my grandmother.  在海边待了两周，我外婆好像年轻了许多。

restore.example: Careful craftsmen restored the painting to its original brilliance.  技艺精细的匠人把这幅画修复到原来的光彩。

resurrect.example: The new director hopes to resurrect a play that failed thirty years ago.  新导演希望让三十年前失败的一部戏重获生机。

resuscitate.example: Paramedics worked for twenty minutes to resuscitate the man pulled from the lake.  急救人员花了二十分钟抢救从湖里救上来的男子。

revitalize.example: The new library helped revitalize a neighborhood everyone had abandoned.  新图书馆帮助振兴了一个人人都已放弃的街区。

revivify.phrase_cn: 使一项衰落的传统复兴
revivify.example: Fresh funding revivified a research program left dormant for years.  新的资金使一个沉寂多年的研究项目重获生机。

jurisdiction.example: The case falls under federal rather than state jurisdiction.  该案属于联邦而非州的管辖范围。

atrophy.example: Muscles atrophy quickly when a patient stays in bed for weeks.  病人卧床数周后，肌肉会迅速萎缩。

crumble.example: Their alliance crumbled as soon as the money ran out.  钱一花完，他们的联盟就瓦解了。

ebb.example: Public enthusiasm for the project ebbed over the winter.  公众对这个项目的热情在冬天渐渐消退。

retrograde.example: Banning the new textbooks feels like a retrograde step for the whole district.  禁用新教材对整个学区而言像是一次倒退。

revive.example: Local trade began to revive once the new highway opened last spring.  去年春天新高速开通后，当地贸易开始重获生机。

rehearsal.example: The cast held a dress rehearsal the night before opening.  剧组在首演前一晚进行了带装彩排。

practice.example: The choir needs one more practice before Sunday's concert.  合唱团在周日音乐会前还需要再排练一次。

dry run.example: We did a dry run of the presentation the night before.  我们前一晚把演示预演了一遍。

reign.example: Trade with distant ports flourished during her long and peaceful reign.  在她漫长而平静的统治期间，与远方港口的贸易十分繁荣。

arm.example: No one escapes the long arm of the tax authorities.  没人能躲过税务机关的长臂。

command.example: She took command of the regiment after the colonel fell ill.  上校病倒后，她接管了该团的指挥权。

control.example: Rebels seized control of the capital within a single night.  叛军一夜之间就夺取了首都的控制权。

sway.example: For decades one family held sway over the entire province.  几十年间，一个家族统治着整个省份。

dominate.example: Two firms dominate the industry and set nearly every price.  两家公司支配着这个行业，几乎决定所有价格。

prevail.example: Common sense finally prevailed after hours of pointless argument.  在几小时无谓的争论之后，常识终于占了上风。

predominate.example: Pine trees predominate on the northern slopes of the valley.  松树在山谷北坡占主导。

impotency.example: The crisis exposed the impotency of the old committee.  这场危机暴露了老委员会的无能。

circumscription.example: Strict circumscription of their duties frustrated the young officers.  对职责的严格限制让这些年轻军官感到沮丧。

confinement.example: Months of confinement indoors had left the children pale.  数月的室内禁闭让孩子们脸色发白。

stint.example: The builder refused to stint on materials even when costs rose.  即便成本上升，这位建筑商也不肯在材料上省钱。

govern.example: Strict rules govern how the samples must be stored.  严格的规定约束着样本必须如何保存。

loosen.example: The government loosened controls on foreign investment last year.  政府去年放宽了对外国投资的管制。

unleash.example: The decision unleashed criticism from every corner of the press.  这一决定引发了媒体各方的批评。

reiterate.example: The minister reiterated his warning about the danger of further delay.  部长重申了他关于再延误将有危险的警告。

chime.example: The candidate chimed the same three slogans at every campaign stop.  这位候选人在每个竞选点都反复念着同样的三句口号。

iterate.example: The teacher iterated the instructions until everyone understood them.  老师反复讲解要求，直到所有人都听懂。

rehearse.example: He rehearsed the same complaints at every family dinner.  他在每次家庭晚餐上都重复同样的抱怨。

repeat.example: Could you repeat the address more slowly this time?  你能把地址再慢一点重复一遍吗？

exuberate.example: The whole village exuberated when the harvest proved unusually rich.  收成出奇地好，全村人欢天喜地。

kvell.example: His parents kvelled as he walked across the graduation stage.  他走过毕业典礼的舞台时，父母满心欢喜。

regret.example: She regretted not saying goodbye before he left the country.  她后悔在他出国前没有道别。

weep.example: Some viewers still weep at the closing scene of that old film.  有些观众看到那部老电影的结尾时依然会哭。

rehash.example: The candidates simply rehashed old arguments instead of offering new ideas.  候选人只是老调重弹，没有提出新的想法。

ironfisted.example: The colony was run by an ironfisted governor for thirty years.  这块殖民地被一位铁腕总督统治了三十年。

reminiscent.example: The smell of wet grass was strongly reminiscent of her childhood summers.  湿草的气味强烈地让她想起童年的夏天。

evocative.cn: 引起回忆的，唤起感情的
evocative.example: The smell of woodsmoke is evocative of winters at my grandparents' house.  柴火烟味让我想起在祖父母家过的冬天。

taste.example: He developed a taste for opera surprisingly late in life.  他在相当晚的年纪才培养出对歌剧的爱好。

enjoy.example: She enjoys long walks along the river after dinner.  她喜欢晚饭后沿河长距离散步。

rev-.cn: revel 断行后的前半，尽情享受
rev-.example: The line break split the word revel into rev- and el.  换行把 revel 一词拆成了 rev- 和 el。

el.cn: revel 断行后的后半；高架铁路
el.example: Chicago commuters still take the el to work each morning.  芝加哥的通勤者每天早上仍乘高架列车上班。

hatred.example: Years of war left a hatred that no treaty could erase.  多年战争留下的仇恨，任何条约都无法消除。

unwilling.example: He was clearly unwilling to discuss what happened that night.  他显然不愿谈那晚发生的事。

resent.example: Older staff members resent being asked to train their own replacements.  资深员工对被要求培训自己的替代者感到愤恨。

begrudge.example: Nobody begrudges him the rest he has clearly earned.  没人不满他享受这份显然应得的休息。

envy.example: I envy the ease with which she speaks three languages.  我羡慕她能轻松讲三种语言。

complaint.example: Several residents filed a complaint about the noise from the site.  几位居民就工地噪音提出了投诉。

difficulty.example: The landlord made no difficulty about renewing our lease.  房东对续租没提任何异议。

objection.example: The lawyer raised an objection before the witness could answer.  证人还没来得及回答，律师就提出了异议。

remonstration.example: Their remonstration against the new tax filled three long letters.  他们反对新税的抗议写满了三封长信。

acceptance.example: His calm acceptance of the verdict surprised everyone in court.  他平静地接受判决，令法庭上所有人惊讶。

remorse.example: The defendant showed no remorse for the harm he had caused.  被告对自己造成的伤害毫无悔意。

contriteness.example: The letter's contriteness persuaded the judge to reduce his sentence.  信中的悔意说服法官减轻了他的刑罚。

contrition.example: He spoke with such contrition that his friends forgave him.  他说话时那样痛悔，朋友们都原谅了他。

penitence.example: Years of quiet penitence followed that one reckless night.  那一个鲁莽的夜晚之后是多年的默默忏悔。

remorsefulness.example: Her remorsefulness was obvious in every line of the apology.  她的悔恨在道歉信的每一行里都显而易见。

repentance.example: The parole board looked for evidence of genuine repentance.  假释委员会在寻找真正悔悟的证据。

rue.example: To his lasting rue, he sold the painting for almost nothing.  令他长久后悔的是，他几乎白送掉了那幅画。

self-reproach.example: Years of self-reproach followed the accident he could not prevent.  那场他无法阻止的事故之后是多年的自责。

impenitence.example: The court noted his impenitence when deciding the sentence.  法庭在量刑时注意到他毫无悔意。

remorselessness.example: Witnesses were shaken by the remorselessness in his voice.  证人们被他语气中的冷酷无情惊住了。

remunerate.example: The company promised to remunerate him generously for the extra work.  公司承诺为这些额外工作给他丰厚的报酬。

indemnify.example: The contract requires the builder to indemnify us for any damage.  合同要求建筑方赔偿我们的任何损失。

remedy.example: Nothing can remedy the harm done by that careless remark.  那句不慎的话造成的伤害无可弥补。

cleave.example: One blow of the axe cleaved the log in two.  斧头一击就把木头劈成了两半。

ribbon.example: The flag hung in ribbons after weeks of storms.  经过数周风暴，旗子已被撕成条条挂着。

rip.example: He ripped the letter open before he even sat down.  他还没坐下就把信撕开了。

shred.example: There is not a shred of evidence linking him to the theft.  没有一丝证据能把他和这起盗窃联系起来。

tatter.example: His reputation lay in tatters after the investigation.  调查之后他的名誉已经一败涂地。

tear.example: She tore the photograph in half and threw it away.  她把照片撕成两半扔掉了。

betrayer.example: History remembers him mainly as the betrayer of his own city.  历史主要记住他是自己城市的背叛者。

defector.example: The defector brought documents that embarrassed his former government.  这名投诚者带来了让其前政府难堪的文件。

deserter.example: Deserters were hunted down and tried before military courts.  逃兵被追捕并交军事法庭审判。

recondition.example: They recondition old bicycles and sell them at low prices.  他们翻新旧自行车并低价出售。

vandalize.example: Someone vandalized the bus shelter again over the weekend.  周末又有人破坏了公交候车亭。

abort.example: Bad weather forced the crew to abort the launch.  恶劣天气迫使工作人员中止发射。

null.example: The court declared the agreement null and void.  法院宣布该协议无效。

lure.example: Low prices lured shoppers away from the older stores.  低价把购物者从老店吸引走了。

repertoire.example: The young pianist has a wide repertoire of romantic pieces.  这位年轻钢琴家有大量的浪漫派曲目。

fund.example: The old sailor had an endless fund of sea stories.  这位老水手有说不完的海上故事。

pool.example: The city draws on a large pool of volunteer translators.  这座城市拥有大批志愿译员可供调用。

reservoir.example: She drew on a deep reservoir of patience that afternoon.  那个下午她动用了自己深厚的耐心储备。

stock.example: The politician answered every question with the same stock phrase.  这位政客用同一句套话回答每个问题。

complain.example: Guests complained about the cold water all through the week.  整周里客人都在抱怨水太冷。

growl.example: He growled something about the traffic and slammed the door.  他咕哝了几句路上堵车，然后重重关上门。

covet.example: Every young pianist in the country covets that scholarship.  国内每个年轻钢琴家都渴望得到那份奖学金。

desiderate.phrase_cn: 希望得到更完整的说明
desiderate.example: Scholars desiderate a complete edition of the poet's letters.  学者们渴望有一部这位诗人书信的全集。

salivate.example: Investors salivated at the thought of such easy returns.  想到如此轻易的回报，投资者们垂涎三尺。

wish.example: She wished for nothing more than a quiet evening at home.  她只盼望在家过一个安静的晚上。

thick.example: The air was thick with dust from the passing trucks.  空气里满是过路卡车扬起的尘土。

repose.example: After the long harvest, the villagers enjoyed a few days of repose.  漫长的收割之后，村民们享受了几天的休息。

leisure.example: Read the report at your leisure and tell me later.  你有空时看看报告，之后告诉我。

relaxation.example: Gardening is her chief form of relaxation after work.  园艺是她下班后主要的放松方式。

relax.example: Sit down and relax while I finish making the tea.  你坐下休息一会儿，我把茶泡好。

rest.example: The doctor ordered him to rest for at least a week.  医生要他至少休息一周。

placidity.example: Nothing disturbed the placidity of that summer afternoon.  没有什么打扰那个夏日午后的宁静。

quietness.example: I love the quietness of the house before anyone wakes.  我喜欢家人醒来之前屋子里的宁静。

restfulness.example: Visitors often remark on the restfulness of these old courtyards.  来客常常提到这些老庭院令人放松的宁静。

exertion.example: He was breathing hard from the exertion of the climb.  攀爬的辛劳让他呼吸沉重。

work.example: A day of heavy work in the fields left them exhausted.  在田里干了一天重活，他们累得不行。

knock.example: Critics knocked the film for its careless historical detail.  评论者批评这部电影历史细节草率。

smother.example: He turned away to smother a laugh at her odd remark.  他转过身去，忍住对她那句怪话的笑。

strangle.example: Heavy regulation strangled the small firms within two years.  繁重的管制两年内就压垮了这些小公司。

take out.example: A single missile took out the bridge before dawn.  黎明前一枚导弹就摧毁了那座桥。

reprieve.example: The governor reprieved the prisoner only hours before the execution.  州长在行刑前几小时才暂缓了对囚犯的处决。

amnesty.example: A general amnesty released hundreds of political prisoners.  一次大赦释放了数百名政治犯。

pardon.example: The president pardoned two men convicted decades earlier.  总统赦免了两名几十年前被定罪的男子。

respite.example: The afternoon rain gave the firefighters a brief respite from the intense heat.  午后的雨让消防员从酷热中得到短暂的休息。

spare.example: The victors spared everyone who surrendered before nightfall.  胜利者宽恕了所有在天黑前投降的人。

penalize.example: The league penalized the club for breaking transfer rules.  联盟因该俱乐部违反转会规则而对其处罚。

punish.example: Teachers no longer punish children by making them stand outside.  老师们不再用罚站门外的方式惩罚孩子。

degraded.example: The novel depicts a once proud family in degraded circumstances.  小说描写了一个曾经显赫的家族沦落的境况。

dissi-.example: The typesetter split dissipated into dissi- and pated.  排版者把 dissipated 拆成了 dissi- 和 pated。

pated.example: A gray-pated clerk stamped our papers without a word.  一个白头的职员一言不发地给我们的文件盖了章。

commination.example: His sermon ended in a commination against greedy landlords.  他的布道以对贪婪地主的严厉谴责收尾。

excoriation.example: The editorial was an excoriation of the mayor's housing policy.  这篇社论是对市长住房政策的痛斥。

stricture.example: The review contained harsh strictures on the author's careless research.  评论对作者草率的研究提出严厉批评。

disown.example: The party quickly disowned the candidate's offensive remarks.  该党迅速否认与该候选人冒犯性言论有关。

repute.example: She is a scholar of great repute in the field of ancient languages.  她是古代语言领域声誉卓著的学者。

name.example: She made a name for herself reporting from war zones.  她因在战区做报道而声名远播。

reimburse.example: The company will reimburse you for any tickets you buy.  公司会报销你购买的任何车票。

avenge.example: He swore to avenge the insult done to his family.  他发誓要为家族所受的侮辱报仇。

revenge.example: He waited years to take revenge on the men who ruined his family.  他等了多年才向毁掉他家庭的那些人报复。

necessity.example: Clean water is a necessity, not a luxury.  清洁饮水是必需品，不是奢侈品。

requirement.example: Two years of experience is a requirement for this post.  两年经验是这个职位的必要条件。

indispensable.example: A good dictionary is indispensable to any serious translator.  一本好词典对任何认真的译者都不可缺少。

needless.example: The delay caused needless anxiety among the waiting families.  这次延误让等候的家属们平添不必要的焦虑。

unnecessary.example: Cutting the paragraph removed an unnecessary repetition.  删掉这段去掉了一处不必要的重复。

recall.example: The maker recalled thousands of cars with faulty brakes.  制造商召回了数千辆刹车有缺陷的汽车。

closemouthed.example: Officials stayed closemouthed about the ongoing negotiations.  官员们对正在进行的谈判守口如瓶。

constrained.cn: 拘谨的，不自然的；受限的
constrained.example: Their conversation was polite but oddly constrained.  他们的谈话礼貌，却出奇地拘谨。

silent.example: He remained silent throughout the entire family argument.  整场家庭争执中他一直沉默。

remainder.example: We spent the remainder of the money on books.  我们把剩下的钱都花在买书上了。

remnant.example: Only a few remnants of the ancient wall still stand today.  今天只剩下古城墙的少量残余仍然矗立。

resilience.example: She showed remarkable resilience after losing everything in the fire.  在火灾中失去一切后，她表现出惊人的恢复力。

adaptability.example: The species survives through sheer adaptability to new habitats.  这个物种全靠对新栖息地的适应力而存活。

decided.example: She spoke in a decided tone that ended all discussion.  她用坚决的语气说话，结束了所有讨论。

resolved.example: He was resolved to finish the book before the winter ended.  他决心在冬天结束前写完这本书。

unwavering.example: Her unwavering belief in the plan convinced the whole committee.  她对方案坚定不移的信心说服了整个委员会。

jittery.cn: 紧张不安的，神经紧张的
jittery.example: Too much coffee left him jittery before the interview.  咖啡喝太多让他面试前紧张不安。

resonant.example: His resonant voice filled the stone hall without any need for a microphone.  他洪亮的嗓音无需麦克风便充满了石砌大厅。

orotund.example: The senator's orotund phrases impressed nobody in the small room.  参议员浮夸洪亮的措辞在这小房间里没打动任何人。

reverberant.example: Their footsteps echoed in the reverberant stone corridor.  他们的脚步声在回声很大的石廊里回荡。

sonorous.example: The priest read the passage in a slow, sonorous voice.  神父用缓慢洪亮的声音朗读那段经文。

muffled.example: We heard muffled laughter through the closed door.  我们透过关着的门听到低沉的笑声。

smothered.example: She gave a smothered sob and turned toward the wall.  她压着抽泣了一声，转向墙壁。

resourceful.example: A resourceful traveler can find shelter even in an unfamiliar mountain village.  机智的旅行者即使在陌生的山村也能找到住处。

able.example: He proved an unusually able negotiator during the crisis.  危机中他显示出非凡的谈判能力。

talented.phrase_cn: 一位有才华的年轻钢琴家
talented.example: The company hires talented designers straight out of school.  这家公司直接从学校招聘有才华的设计师。

pause.example: After a long pause she finally answered the question.  长久的停顿之后，她终于回答了问题。

retroactive.example: The new rule is retroactive to the first of January.  这项新规定可追溯至一月一日生效。

responsive.example: The new manager is unusually responsive to suggestions from the factory floor.  这位新经理对车间提出的建议反应格外积极。

nervy.cn: 紧张不安的；大胆无礼的
nervy.example: The horse grew nervy as the crowd pressed closer.  人群靠近时，那匹马变得紧张不安。

uneasy.example: She felt uneasy about leaving the children alone upstairs.  把孩子单独留在楼上让她感到不安。

uptight.example: Don't get so uptight about a single bad grade.  别为一次成绩不好这么紧张。

agitating.example: The agitating news kept everyone awake until morning.  这令人不安的消息让大家一直醒到早上。

distressful.cn: 令人痛苦的，使人难受的
distressful.example: Testifying about the accident was distressful for the young witness.  就事故作证对这名年轻证人来说十分痛苦。

disturbing.example: The film contains several disturbing scenes of urban poverty.  这部影片有几处描写城市贫困的令人不安的场景。

perturbed.example: She seemed perturbed by the letter she had just opened.  她刚打开的那封信似乎让她心烦意乱。

revelation.example: The diary contained a revelation that changed how historians view the war.  那本日记中的一处爆料改变了历史学家对这场战争的看法。

disclosure.example: The disclosure of the emails ended his political career.  这些邮件的披露结束了他的政治生涯。

divulgence.example: Any divulgence of client data breaks the contract.  任何泄露客户数据的行为都违反合同。

exposure.example: Public exposure of the scandal forced two directors to resign.  丑闻的公开曝光迫使两名董事辞职。

resurgence.example: Recent films have caused a surprising resurgence of interest in classical music.  近期的电影令人们对古典音乐的兴趣意外复兴。

reanimation.example: The festival brought a reanimation of local craft traditions.  这个节庆使当地手工艺传统重新活跃起来。

rebirth.example: The new theater marked the rebirth of the whole district.  新剧院标志着整个区域的重生。

regeneration.example: Urban regeneration brought shops back to the empty waterfront.  城市复兴让空荡的滨水区重新有了店铺。

renewal.example: Spring always brings a feeling of renewal to the village.  春天总给这个村子带来一种更新的感觉。

resurrection.example: Fans witnessed the resurrection of a club everyone had written off.  球迷们见证了一家人人都不看好的俱乐部的复兴。

resuscitation.example: Paramedics performed resuscitation on the scene for ten minutes.  急救人员在现场进行了十分钟的复苏抢救。

reanimate.example: A single letter reanimated a friendship dormant for years.  一封信让沉寂多年的友谊重新活了过来。

retainer.example: An elderly retainer opened the heavy door and led us into the hall.  一位年老的家仆打开厚重的门，带我们进入大厅。

servant.example: A servant carried the trunks up the narrow back stairs.  一名仆人把箱子搬上狭窄的后楼梯。

lord.example: Tenants paid rent to the lord of the manor each autumn.  佃户每年秋天向庄园领主交租。

repetitious.example: His lectures grew repetitious, covering the same three examples week after week.  他的讲座变得重复，一周又一周讲同样那三个例子。

duplicative.example: Two teams doing duplicative research wasted half the budget.  两个团队做重复研究浪费了一半预算。

reiterative.example: The song's reiterative chorus stays in your head for days.  这首歌反复的副歌能在你脑中盘旋好几天。

repetitive.example: The job is well paid but numbingly repetitive.  这份工作薪水不错，但重复得令人麻木。

retort.example: Her sharp retort silenced the heckler and delighted the rest of the audience.  她一句尖锐的回应让捣乱者噎住，其余观众都很开心。

comeback.example: She had a quick comeback for every insult he tried.  他每句挖苦，她都有一句机灵的回嘴。

rejoinder.example: His rejoinder silenced the entire table at once.  他的一句反驳立刻让满桌人都沉默了。

response.example: Her only response was a slight shrug of the shoulders.  她唯一的回应是轻轻耸了一下肩。

riposte.example: The critic's riposte was printed in the following issue.  这位评论家的回击刊在下一期上。

query.example: Send any queries about the schedule to my assistant.  关于日程的任何疑问都发给我的助理。

retouch.example: The editor asked her to retouch the photograph before printing.  编辑要她在付印前润饰这张照片。

retrench.example: When orders fell, the firm decided to retrench rather than borrow more money.  订单下降时，公司决定削减开支而不再借钱。

cut down.example: We had to cut down on staff travel to save money.  为了省钱我们不得不削减员工出差。

retribution.example: The villagers believed the flood was divine retribution for their greed.  村民认为洪水是对他们贪婪的天罚。

avengement.example: The old ballad tells of a bloody avengement across three generations.  这首古老的叙事诗讲述了三代人的血腥复仇。

payback.example: He saw the lawsuit as payback for years of humiliation.  他把这场诉讼看作对多年屈辱的报复。

repayment.example: The gift was repayment for kindness shown long ago.  这份礼物是对很久以前的善意的回报。

retaliation.example: The strike was launched in retaliation for the earlier raid.  这次打击是为报复此前的袭击而发动的。

vengeance.example: He devoted the rest of his life to vengeance.  他把余生都用在复仇上。

receding.example: We watched the receding shoreline from the ship's rail.  我们从船舷望着渐渐远去的海岸线。

regressive.example: Critics called the reform regressive and socially unfair.  批评者称这项改革是倒退且不公平的。

reversed.example: The names appeared in reversed order on the second list.  第二份名单上名字的顺序是颠倒的。

withdrawing.example: The withdrawing troops burned the bridges behind them.  撤退的部队烧掉了身后的桥梁。

retrospective.example: The museum opened a retrospective of her early photographs.  博物馆办了一场她早期摄影作品的回顾展。

anticipatory.example: An anticipatory hush fell over the hall before the curtain rose.  幕启之前，大厅里一片期待的寂静。

prospective.example: Several prospective tenants toured the apartment that afternoon.  那天下午有几位潜在租客看了这套公寓。

reprisal.example: Witnesses stayed silent for fear of reprisal.  证人们因害怕报复而保持沉默。

forgiveness.example: He wrote to ask forgiveness for what he had said.  他写信为自己说过的话请求原谅。

blaspheme.example: In that century anyone who blasphemed publicly risked imprisonment.  在那个世纪，公开亵渎神灵者可能被监禁。

resonate.example: Her speech resonated with everyone who had lost a job.  她的演讲在每个失业过的人心中引起共鸣。

ring true.example: Nothing in that confession rings true to me.  那份供词在我听来没有一句可信。

ribald.example: The old sailor entertained the crew with ribald songs late into the night.  老水手用粗俗下流的歌曲让船员们乐到深夜。

bawdy.example: The sailors sang bawdy songs late into the night.  水手们唱着下流的歌唱到深夜。

blue.example: His routine was too blue for a family audience.  他的表演对家庭观众来说太下流了。

obscene.example: The magazine was banned for printing obscene photographs.  这本杂志因刊登淫秽照片而被查禁。

pornographic.example: Customs officers seized several crates of pornographic prints.  海关人员查获了几箱色情印刷品。

insecure.cn: 不牢固的，不稳固的；缺乏自信的
insecure.example: The shelf was so insecure that it collapsed under the books.  那个架子太不牢固，被书压塌了。

tonic.example: A week in the mountains had a tonic effect on her.  在山里待一周对她起了滋补强身的作用。

curing.example: Locals attribute curing powers to this bitter mountain herb.  当地人认为这种苦味山草有治病的功效。

healing.example: The doctor praised the healing effect of rest and fresh air.  医生称赞休息和新鲜空气的治愈效果。

remedial.example: The school offers remedial classes for students who fell behind.  学校为落后的学生开设补习班。

sanative.example: Villagers long believed the spring had sanative properties.  村民长期相信这泉水有疗效。

lout.example: The crowd mocked the lout who shouted through the whole concert.  人群嘲笑那个整场演唱会大喊大叫的粗人。

fissure.example: A narrow fissure ran along the face of the cliff.  一道狭窄的裂缝沿着崖壁延伸。

reconciliation.example: Years of quiet talks finally brought reconciliation between the two families.  多年的私下商谈最终让两家和解。

ripen.example: The tomatoes will ripen quickly if you leave them on the sunny windowsill.  把西红柿放在向阳的窗台上会很快成熟。

age.example: The cheese must age for two years before it is sold.  这种奶酪必须陈化两年才能出售。

riot.example: A riot broke out downtown soon after the verdict was announced.  判决宣布后不久，市中心爆发了骚乱。

rite.example: The village still performs an ancient rite to mark the end of winter.  村里仍会举行一种古老的仪式来标志冬天结束。

ceremony.example: The graduation ceremony lasted nearly three hours in the hot sun.  毕业典礼在烈日下持续了近三小时。

observance.example: The village is known for its faithful observance of ancient customs.  这个村庄以忠实遵守古老习俗著称。

renaissance.example: The district is enjoying a cultural renaissance driven by young artists.  这个街区正经历由年轻艺术家推动的文化复兴。

revival.example: The neighborhood is enjoying a revival after decades of decline.  这个街区在数十年衰落后正迎来复兴。

rosy.example: Their report paints a rosy picture that ignores the falling export figures.  他们的报告描绘出乐观前景，却忽视了下滑的出口数据。

depressing.example: The rainy weather and empty streets felt deeply depressing.  阴雨天气和空荡的街道让人非常压抑。

greenhorn.example: As a greenhorn he asked questions the veterans found obvious.  作为新手，他问的问题老手们觉得显而易见。

rote.example: Learning grammar by rote rarely helps students speak the language naturally.  死记硬背语法很少能帮学生自然地说这门语言。

treadmill.cn: 枯燥单调的工作；跑步机
treadmill.example: She quit her job to escape the treadmill of endless meetings.  她辞职以逃离没完没了的会议苦役。

rationale.example: Nobody explained the rationale behind the decision to close the library.  没有人解释关闭图书馆这一决定背后的道理。

account.example: The witness gave a detailed account of what she had seen.  证人详细说明了她所看到的情况。

accounting.example: The board demanded a full accounting of the missing funds.  董事会要求对失踪资金作出完整说明。

argument.example: He built a convincing argument for keeping the old bridge open.  他提出了一个令人信服的论证，主张保留旧桥通行。

explanation.example: His explanation for the delay satisfied nobody at the table.  他对延误的解释没有让桌上任何人满意。

awake.example: The noise from the street kept me awake until dawn.  街上的噪音让我一直醒到黎明。

awaken.example: The smell of bread awakened memories of his grandmother's kitchen.  面包的香味唤起了他对祖母厨房的回忆。

waken.example: Try not to waken the baby when you come in.  你进来时尽量不要弄醒宝宝。

royalty.example: Members of royalty attended the ceremony in full dress.  王室成员盛装出席了这场典礼。

aristocracy.example: The revolution stripped the aristocracy of most of its estates.  革命剥夺了贵族大部分的地产。

rubicund.example: His rubicund complexion suggested a long life spent outdoors.  他红润的气色显示他常年在户外生活。

blooming.example: She returned from the coast blooming with color and energy.  她从海边回来，脸色红润、精神饱满。

ruddy.example: The farmer's ruddy face showed years of outdoor work.  这位农民红润的脸显示出多年的户外劳作。

basic.example: Students must master the basic rules before writing essays.  学生写文章前必须掌握基本规则。

fundamental.example: Trust is fundamental to any lasting partnership.  信任对任何持久的合作都是根本。

rudimental.example: His rudimental grasp of Latin was enough to read the inscription.  他对拉丁语的初步掌握足以读懂那段铭文。

underlying.example: Doctors searched for the underlying cause of her fatigue.  医生们寻找她疲倦的根本原因。

higher.example: These courses demand higher reasoning than introductory ones.  这些课程要求比入门课更高层次的推理。

erode.example: Heavy rains slowly erode the exposed hillside each spring.  每年春天大雨慢慢侵蚀裸露的山坡。

roughen.example: Sand the board to roughen it before applying the glue.  上胶前用砂纸把木板打磨粗糙。

rub.example: Do not rub your eyes with dirty hands.  不要用脏手揉眼睛。

revision.example: The author made one final revision before sending the manuscript to press.  作者在把书稿送去付印前做了最后一次修订。

alteration.example: The tailor made a small alteration to the sleeve length.  裁缝对袖长做了小小改动。

modification.example: Engineers approved one modification to the engine housing.  工程师批准了对发动机外壳的一处改进。

remodeling.example: The remodeling of the old library took eighteen months.  旧图书馆的改建花了十八个月。

revise.example: She had to revise the report after new data arrived.  新数据到来后她不得不修改报告。

variation.example: There is wide variation in rainfall across the region.  该地区降雨量差异很大。

fixation.example: The treatment relies on the fixation of the broken bone.  这种治疗依赖于对断骨的固定。

stabilization.example: The stabilization of the currency reassured foreign investors.  货币的稳定让外国投资者安心。

runic.example: Strange runic markings covered the stone we found beside the river.  我们在河边发现的石头上布满神秘的符号。

ruse.example: The empty truck was a clever ruse to draw the guards away.  那辆空卡车是个巧妙的诡计，用来引开守卫。

bumpkin.example: In the city he felt like a bumpkin staring at the towers.  在城里他觉得自己像个盯着高楼看的乡下人。

churl.example: Only a churl would refuse to thank his host.  只有粗鄙之人才会不感谢主人。

countryman.example: The old countryman knew every path through the woods.  这位老乡下人熟悉林中每条小路。

rube.example: The salesman took him for a rube and raised the price.  推销员把他当乡巴佬，抬高了价钱。

yokel.example: He stood in the marble lobby like a gawking country yokel.  他站在大理石大堂里，像个东张西望的乡下土包子。

bucolic.example: They spent the summer in a bucolic village far from traffic.  他们在远离车流的田园村庄度过了夏天。

country.example: We drove along a narrow country lane lined with hedges.  我们沿着两旁有树篱的乡间小路开车。

pastoral.example: The painter is famous for pastoral scenes of shepherds and hills.  这位画家以牧羊人与山丘的田园画作闻名。

impolite.example: It is impolite to interrupt someone in the middle of a sentence.  在别人话没说完时插嘴很不礼貌。

inelegant.example: His inelegant table manners embarrassed the whole family.  他不雅的餐桌举止让全家都很尴尬。

cosmopolite.example: A cosmopolite by nature, she felt at home in any capital.  她天性四海为家，在任何首都都感到自在。

rustle.example: She rustled up a hot meal for six guests in twenty minutes.  她二十分钟内为六位客人麻利地做出一顿热饭。

career.example: The empty cart careered down the slope and hit a fence.  空车沿坡疾冲而下撞上了栅栏。

jump.example: He jumped from his chair when the alarm sounded.  警报响起时他从椅子上一跃而起。

impairment.example: Long exposure to noise caused permanent impairment of his hearing.  长期暴露在噪音中造成他听力永久损伤。

subversion.example: The regime accused the writers of subversion of public order.  当局指控这些作家颠覆公共秩序。

undermining.example: Constant criticism led to the undermining of her confidence.  不断的批评削弱了她的自信。

assistance.example: Without her assistance the project would have collapsed.  没有她的帮助，这个项目早就垮了。

sugary.example: The song's sugary lyrics made the critics groan.  这首歌甜得发腻的歌词让评论家们直摇头。

fruity.example: The wine has a fruity flavor with a hint of spice.  这款酒带果味，还有一丝辛香。

sugarcoated.example: He gave a sugarcoated account of a very ugly quarrel.  他把一场很难看的争吵说得轻描淡写。

sacrilege.example: Selling the temple bells struck the villagers as outright sacrilege.  卖掉庙里的钟在村民看来是彻底的亵渎神圣。

blasphemy.example: In that century such a remark counted as blasphemy.  在那个世纪，这样一句话算是渎神。

defilement.example: Villagers mourned the defilement of the ancient shrine.  村民为古老神殿被玷污而悲痛。

desecration.example: The desecration of the cemetery shocked the whole town.  墓地遭亵渎震惊了全镇。

impiety.example: The philosopher was tried for impiety toward the city's gods.  这位哲学家因对城邦神灵不敬而受审。

profanation.example: Using the relic as decoration struck them as profanation.  把圣物当装饰在他们看来是亵渎。

adoration.example: The crowd looked at the old singer with pure adoration.  人群以纯粹的爱慕注视着这位老歌手。

glorification.example: Critics attacked the film for its glorification of violence.  评论家批评这部电影美化暴力。

impose.example: The court imposed a strict curfew on the district.  法院对该区强加了严格宵禁。

inflict.example: The storm inflicted serious damage on coastal villages.  风暴对沿海村庄造成严重破坏。

tax.example: The long delay taxed even the calmest passengers.  长时间延误让最镇定的乘客也难以承受。

unburden.example: She unburdened herself of the secret she had kept for years.  她把保守多年的秘密倾吐了出来。

aegis.example: The talks continued under the aegis of the United Nations.  会谈在联合国的主持庇护下继续。

guard.example: Two dogs guard the warehouse every night.  两条狗每晚守卫这座仓库。

precaution.example: As a precaution they stored extra water and batteries.  作为预防，他们储备了额外的水和电池。

bulwark.example: A free press is a bulwark against official abuse.  自由的新闻界是抵御官方滥权的堡垒。

defend.example: Soldiers defended the bridge for three days.  士兵们守卫这座桥三天之久。

fend.example: He learned to fend off criticism with humor.  他学会用幽默挡开批评。

protect.example: Thick gloves protect your hands from the cold.  厚手套保护你的双手免受寒冷。

shield.example: She raised a hand to shield her eyes from the glare.  她举手遮挡刺眼的强光。

ward.example: Garlic was once used to ward off illness.  大蒜曾被用来抵挡疾病。

assault.example: Troops launched a night assault on the fortress.  部队对要塞发动了夜间进攻。

salient.example: Please summarize the salient points of the report in a single page.  请把报告最突出的要点概括在一页之内。

inconspicuous.example: He chose an inconspicuous seat at the back of the hall.  他在大厅后排选了个不显眼的座位。

unnoticeable.example: The repair is so neat it is unnoticeable from a distance.  修补得如此整齐，从远处看根本看不出来。

healthy.example: Walking daily is a healthy habit at any age.  每天散步在任何年龄都是健康习惯。

retrieve.example: The engineer managed to retrieve the files from the damaged hard drive.  工程师成功从损坏的硬盘中找回了文件。

desert.example: The captain refused to desert his crew in the storm.  船长拒绝在风暴中抛下船员。

forsake.example: He would never forsake the people who raised him.  他绝不会抛弃养育他的人。

canting.example: His canting speech about virtue fooled nobody.  他关于美德的假虔诚演讲骗不了任何人。

deceiving.example: The calm surface was deceiving, for the current ran fast.  平静的水面骗人，水流其实很急。

religious.example: Her religious upbringing shaped every choice she made.  她的宗教家教影响了她的每个选择。

port.phrase: a safe port in a storm
port.example: The battered ship finally reached port before dawn.  受损的船在黎明前终于抵港。

shelter.example: They took shelter under a bridge until the hail stopped.  他们在桥下躲避，直到冰雹停下。

showcase.example: The festival will showcase new talent from villages across the province.  这场节庆将展示来自全省各村的新人才。

brandish.example: The angry pirate began to brandish a sword above his head.  愤怒的海盗开始在头顶挥舞长剑。

flaunt.example: He liked to flaunt his new watch at every meeting.  他喜欢在每次会议上炫耀他的新表。

parade.example: She never paraded her achievements before her classmates.  她从不在同学面前炫耀成绩。

show off.phrase: show off in front of others
show off.example: The boy climbed the wall just to show off to his friends.  那男孩爬上墙只是为了向朋友炫耀。

assured.example: She gave an assured performance despite the huge audience.  尽管观众众多，她的表演依然从容自信。

confident.example: The coach was confident that his team would recover.  教练确信他的队伍会恢复过来。

doubtless.example: The plan will doubtless face strong opposition in the council.  这项计划无疑会在议会遭到强烈反对。

unsure.example: She looked unsure when asked to explain the diagram.  被要求解释图表时她显得没有把握。

sanitary.example: The kitchen must stay sanitary during every shift.  厨房在每个班次都必须保持清洁卫生。

hygienic.example: Hospitals require hygienic practices in every ward.  医院要求每个病区都遵守卫生规范。

etiolate.example: Darkness will etiolate the seedlings within a week.  黑暗会在一周内使幼苗变得苍白衰弱。

dynamism.example: The city's dynamism attracts young workers every year.  这座城市的活力每年吸引年轻劳动者。

esprit.example: Her writing sparkles with wit and esprit.  她的文章闪耀着机智与才气。

get-up-and-go.example: The new manager has real get-up-and-go and works late.  新经理确实有干劲，常工作到很晚。

gusto.example: The children sang the old song with great gusto.  孩子们兴致高昂地唱着那首老歌。

sluggishness.example: The heat explained the general sluggishness of the crew.  炎热解释了船员们普遍的无精打采。

torpidity.example: Winter torpidity kept the frogs buried in the mud.  冬日的麻木状态让青蛙埋在泥中。

unperceptive.example: Only an unperceptive critic would miss the irony here.  只有缺乏洞察力的评论者才会漏掉这里的讽刺。

indignity.example: He endured the indignity of being searched at the gate.  他忍受了在门口被搜身的侮辱。

slap.example: Losing the award felt like a slap to the whole team.  没得奖对整个团队像是一记耳光。

sartorial.example: The ambassador was famous for his sartorial elegance and perfect manners.  那位大使以衣着优雅和举止得体闻名。

stuff.example: The boys stuffed themselves with cake at the party.  男孩们在派对上把蛋糕吃得饱胀。

starve.example: The siege starved the town for nearly two months.  围城让这座城镇饥饿了近两个月。

tantalize.example: The smell of roast meat tantalized the hungry travelers.  烤肉的香味挑逗着饥饿的旅人。

repellent repugnant.example: The scene was repellent, even repugnant, to everyone who watched it.  这一场景令所有看到的人厌恶，甚至反感。

satirize.example: The cartoonist loved to satirize politicians who promised more than they delivered.  这位漫画家喜欢讽刺那些承诺多于兑现的政客。

pasquinade.example: An anonymous pasquinade mocking the mayor appeared on walls across the city.  一篇匿名讽刺市长的短文出现在全城的墙上。

bedraggle.example: The rain bedraggled her coat before she reached the door.  雨还没等她到门口就把外套淋得又湿又脏。

wring out.example: She wrung out the shirt and hung it on the line.  她把衬衫拧干后挂到绳上。

depressive.example: Long winters left him in a depressive state for months.  漫长的冬天让他数月处于抑郁状态。

dismal.example: The dismal gray sky matched everyone's mood.  阴沉灰暗的天空与众人的心情相符。

heartwarming.example: Their reunion after ten years was heartwarming to watch.  他们十年后的重逢看着令人暖心。

unlearned person.example: Even an unlearned person could see the argument was weak.  连没学问的人都能看出这论证很弱。

delicious.example: The soup was so delicious that nobody left a drop.  这汤太可口，没人剩下一滴。

grati-.example: The prefix grati- carries the sense of pleasing.  词根 grati- 带有令人愉快的含义。

fying.example: The ending fying turns the root into an adjective here.  这里的词尾 fying 把词根变成形容词。

tasty.example: She cooked a tasty dish from the few vegetables left.  她用剩下的几样蔬菜做了一道美味的菜。

chops.example: The young pianist clearly has the chops for concert work.  这位年轻钢琴家显然有开音乐会的真功夫。

expertise.example: We hired her for her expertise in tax law.  我们因她在税法方面的专长而聘用她。

know-how.example: Building a boat takes patience and real know-how.  造一艘船需要耐心和真本事。

hard-boiled.example: The hard-boiled reporter never trusted an easy answer.  这位老练的记者从不相信轻易得来的答案。

heady.example: Success brought a heady sense of freedom.  成功带来令人兴奋的自由感。

simplicity.example: His simplicity in business matters cost him dearly.  他在商务上的头脑简单让他损失惨重。

tactlessness.example: His tactlessness at the funeral offended several relatives.  他在葬礼上的不得体冒犯了几位亲戚。

inexperience.example: Her inexperience showed in the first few interviews.  她的缺乏经验在前几次面试中显露出来。

slew.example: The new policy generated a slew of complaints from local business owners.  新政策引来当地商户的一大堆抱怨。

voluminous.example: The lawyer arrived with voluminous records of every payment ever made.  律师带着关于每一笔付款的浩繁记录到场。

snarky.example: Her snarky reply ended the conversation at once.  她讥讽的回答立刻结束了谈话。

calm compliment.example: Instead of mockery he gave a calm compliment on her work.  他没有嘲讽，而是平和地赞美了她的作品。

glister.example: All that glisters is not gold, as the proverb warns.  正如谚语所警示，闪光的并非都是金子。

foolly.example: He spoke foolly and regretted it within minutes.  他说话糊涂，几分钟内就后悔了。

dissolution.example: The dissolution of the company left hundreds jobless.  公司解散让数百人失业。

singe.example: She stood too close to the candle and singed her long hair.  她站得离蜡烛太近，把长发烧焦了一点。

scotch.example: The prime minister moved quickly to scotch rumors about her illness.  首相迅速出面平息关于她生病的谣言。

scour.example: Police continued to scour the countryside for the missing hiker.  警方继续在乡间搜寻失踪的徒步者。

comb.example: Police combed the woods for the missing child.  警方在林中彻底搜寻失踪的孩子。

dig through.example: She dug through boxes of letters to find the date.  她翻遍一箱箱信件来找那个日期。

dredge.example: Reporters dredged up records from twenty years ago.  记者翻挖出二十年前的记录。

hunt through.example: He hunted through his pockets for the missing ticket.  他翻遍口袋找那张不见的票。

rake.example: Investigators raked through years of email records.  调查人员细查了多年的邮件记录。

ransack.example: Thieves ransacked the office looking for cash.  窃贼把办公室翻遍寻找现金。

rifle.example: He rifled through the papers until he found the deed.  他翻遍文件直到找到那份契约。

rummage.example: She rummaged in her bag for a pen.  她在包里翻找一支笔。

sort through.example: We sorted through the boxes to find his diploma.  我们逐一翻查箱子找他的毕业证。

troll.example: Reporters trolled the archives for forgotten scandals.  记者在档案中搜寻被遗忘的丑闻。

scowl.example: The librarian began to scowl at the students whispering near the shelves.  图书馆员开始对书架旁窃窃私语的学生皱眉不满。

gloom.example: A deep gloom settled over the team after the loss.  失利后一股深深的阴郁笼罩全队。

glower.example: The coach glowered at the referee but said nothing about the call.  教练怒目瞪着裁判，却没对那次判罚说什么。

smile.example: She smiled at the child who had dropped his toy.  她对掉了玩具的孩子微笑。

nonaggressive.example: The dog is large but entirely nonaggressive with children.  这条狗很大，但对孩子完全不具攻击性。

unbelligerent.example: His unbelligerent reply cooled the whole argument.  他不挑事的回答让整场争论冷了下来。

scrawl.example: He had to scrawl a quick note before running for the train.  他赶火车前只能潦草地写了张便条。

squiggle.example: His signature is just a squiggle at the bottom.  他的签名只是底部的一道弯线。

scribble.example: The student began to scribble notes in the margin of the textbook.  那名学生开始在教科书页边潦草地写笔记。

write carefully.example: Please write carefully so the clerk can read your name.  请仔细书写，让职员能看清你的名字。

cutthroat.example: The market is cutthroat, and small shops rarely survive.  这个市场竞争残酷，小店很少能生存。

immoral.example: Many considered the deal immoral even if it was legal.  许多人认为这笔交易即使合法也不道德。

unethical.example: Hiding the test results was clearly unethical.  隐瞒检测结果显然不合道德。

unprincipled.example: The unprincipled agent sold the same house twice.  这个无良中介把同一栋房子卖了两次。

review.example: The committee will review each application in detail.  委员会将详细审查每份申请。

casually glance.example: He would casually glance at the report without reading it.  他会随意扫一眼报告，却不细读。

scurvy.example: Cheating an old friend was a scurvy trick nobody could excuse.  欺骗老友是种下流手段，谁也无法原谅。

grubby.example: The boy came home with grubby knees and a torn shirt.  男孩回家时膝盖脏兮兮，衬衫也破了。

scummy.example: That was a scummy way to treat an old friend.  那样对待老朋友太卑劣了。

laudable.example: Her attempt to save the library was laudable though it failed.  她拯救图书馆的尝试虽失败却值得赞扬。

seamy.example: The novel explores the seamy side of life in the port city.  这部小说探讨了那座港口城市生活的阴暗面。

decent and respectable.example: They lived a decent and respectable life in that town.  他们在那座小镇过着正派体面的生活。

isolated.example: The cabin sits on an isolated ridge above the lake.  小屋坐落在湖上一处偏僻的山脊。

retired.phrase: a retired corner of the garden
retired.example: They read in a retired spot behind the hedge.  他们在树篱后一处僻静地方读书。

undisturbed.example: The papers lay undisturbed on the desk for years.  这些文件在桌上多年未被动过。

unperturbed.example: She seemed unperturbed by the sudden change of plan.  她对计划突变显得毫不慌乱。

discomposed.example: The question left the speaker discomposed for a moment.  这个问题让演讲者一时慌了神。

disturbed.example: He was disturbed by the noise from the next room.  他被隔壁的噪音扰得不安。

flustered.example: She grew flustered when the lights went out.  灯熄灭时她变得慌乱起来。

ward off.example: He wore a thick scarf to ward off the wind.  他戴了厚围巾以挡开寒风。

unbecoming.example: Such language is unbecoming in a public hearing.  这种言辞在公开听证会上不得体。

ungenteel.example: His ungenteel jokes shocked the older guests.  他不文雅的玩笑让年长客人吃惊。

segment.example: Marketers try to segment the audience by age and shopping habits.  营销人员试图按年龄和购物习惯细分受众。

member.example: The sculptor carved the figure's members with remarkable anatomical accuracy.  雕塑家以惊人的解剖精确度雕出了人像的各个肢体部分。

self-abasement.example: His constant self-abasement made colleagues uncomfortable.  他不断的自我贬低让同事们不自在。

self-oriented.example: Her self-oriented planning ignored what the team needed.  她以自我为中心的规划忽视了团队需求。

self-asserting.cn: 自我主张强的，好出头的
self-asserting.example: The self-asserting newcomer soon dominated every meeting.  这位好出头的新人很快主导了每次会议。

seminal.example: Her seminal paper changed how biologists think about animal migration.  她开创性的论文改变了生物学家对动物迁徙的看法。

sensation.example: The young pianist caused a sensation at her very first public concert.  那位年轻钢琴家在首次公开演出上引起轰动。

unnoticed event.phrase_cn: 历史上无人注意的事件
unnoticed event.example: What seemed an unnoticed event later changed the law.  当时看似无人注意的事件后来改变了法律。

sift.example: Investigators will sift through the evidence before naming any suspect.  调查人员会先细查证据，再点名任何嫌疑人。

audit.example: An outside firm will audit the accounts each spring.  每年春天由外部公司查核账目。

oversee.example: She was hired to oversee the entire relocation.  她受聘监督整个搬迁工作。

showmanship.example: His victory owed more to showmanship than to any real skill.  他的胜利更多靠的是表演技巧而非真本领。

grandstanding.example: The senator's speech was mere grandstanding for the cameras.  这位参议员的演讲只是对着镜头哗众取宠。

sepulchral.example: He answered in a sepulchral voice that chilled everyone at the table.  他用阴沉的嗓音回答，让桌旁的人都发冷。

tenebrous.example: They crept along the tenebrous passage with one candle.  他们举着一支蜡烛沿幽暗的走道潜行。

merry.example: The house was merry with music and laughter.  屋里充满音乐和笑声，十分欢乐。

cheery.example: Her cheery voice on the phone lifted his mood.  她电话里愉快的声音让他心情好转。

septic.example: The cut turned septic after two days without treatment.  伤口两天未处理后感染化脓了。

free of infection.phrase: keep the wound free of infection
free of infection.example: Clean dressings keep the wound free of infection.  干净的敷料使伤口保持无感染。

cut off.example: Snow cut off the village for nearly a week.  大雪把村子隔绝了将近一周。

permit to mingle.example: The guards would not permit the prisoners to mingle.  看守不允许犯人们互相交往。

desegregate.example: The ruling forced the state to desegregate its schools.  这项裁决迫使该州取消学校的种族隔离。

reintegrate.example: Programs help former inmates reintegrate into their communities.  项目帮助前囚犯重新融入社区。

sere.example: By August the meadow had turned sere and brown under the sun.  到八月，草地在阳光下变得干枯发黄。

droughty.example: Three droughty years ruined the wheat harvest.  三个干旱年头毁掉了小麦收成。

waterless.example: They crossed a waterless plain for two long days.  他们花了漫长的两天穿越无水的平原。

humid.example: The air was so humid that our clothes never dried.  空气如此潮湿，我们的衣服总也干不了。

moist.example: Cover the seeds and keep the soil moist for a week.  盖好种子并保持土壤湿润一周。

arcadian.example: The valley offered an arcadian calm they had never known.  山谷带来他们从未体验过的田园宁静。

restful.example: The pale green walls make the room restful.  淡绿色的墙让房间显得宁静。

clattery.example: The clattery old train kept everyone awake.  哐当作响的旧火车让所有人无法入睡。

roistering.example: A roistering party next door lasted until dawn.  隔壁喧闹的聚会一直闹到黎明。

romping.example: The romping puppies knocked over two chairs.  嬉闹的小狗撞倒了两把椅子。

sermon.example: The old priest delivered a sermon about forgiveness that lasted an hour.  老神父做了一场关于宽恕的布道，持续了一小时。

serpentine.example: We drove slowly along a serpentine mountain road above the valley.  我们沿着山谷上方蜿蜒的山路缓慢前行。

curved.example: The bridge has a curved deck of pale stone.  这座桥有一段淡色石头的弧形桥面。

curvy.example: We drove slowly along the curvy road above the sea.  我们沿海边弯曲的公路慢慢开车。

sinuous.example: A sinuous river winds through the wide valley below the village.  一条蜿蜒的河流穿过村子下方宽阔的谷地。

tortuous.example: His tortuous explanation left the whole committee more confused than before.  他转弯抹角的解释让整个委员会比之前更困惑。

winding.example: A winding path led up to the old chapel.  一条蜿蜒的小路通向老教堂。

straightaway.example: Cars reach top speed on the final straightaway.  赛车在最后的直道上达到最高速。

self-defeating.cn: 适得其反的，自我拆台的
self-defeating.example: Cutting research funds is a self-defeating way to save money.  削减研究经费是适得其反的省钱办法。

serried.example: Serried ranks of soldiers filled the square before the parade began.  阅兵开始前，密集的士兵队列填满了广场。

dense.example: Dense fog closed the airport for three hours.  浓雾使机场关闭了三小时。

widely separated.example: The farms lay widely separated across the dry plain.  农场在干旱平原上彼此相距很远。

airy.example: They rented an airy apartment with tall windows.  他们租了一间有高窗、通风良好的公寓。

uncrowded.example: We chose an uncrowded train in the early afternoon.  我们选了午后一班不拥挤的火车。

shady.example: His money came from several shady arrangements abroad.  他的钱来自海外几笔可疑的安排。

gyve.example: The prisoner shuffled forward in heavy gyves.  囚犯戴着沉重脚镣蹭步向前。

handcuff.example: Officers handcuffed the man before leading him away.  警官在带走这名男子前给他戴上手铐。

pinion.example: Two guards pinioned his arms behind his back.  两名警卫把他的手臂反捆在背后。

interferewith.example: Loud construction will interferewith the exams next week.  嘈杂的施工会妨碍下周的考试。

short-circuit.example: They tried to short-circuit the review by calling the director.  他们打电话给主管，想绕过审查流程。

shadow.example: Two detectives agreed to shadow the suspect through the crowded market.  两名侦探决定在拥挤的市场里偷偷尾随嫌疑人。

track.example: Rangers tracked the wounded bear for two days.  护林员追踪那头受伤的熊两天。

trail.example: A gray car trailed them all the way home.  一辆灰色汽车一路跟踪他们回家。

pass for.example: With that uniform he could pass for a guard.  穿着那身制服他可以冒充警卫。

unfaked.example: Her surprise was clearly unfaked when the door opened.  门打开时她的惊讶显然不是假装的。

shipshape.example: The old sailor kept his tiny cabin perfectly shipshape at all times.  老水手始终把他的小舱室保持得井然有序。

antiseptic.example: The lab was antiseptic and almost uncomfortably tidy.  实验室洁净得几乎让人不自在。

kempt.example: He arrived kempt and calm despite the long flight.  尽管长途飞行，他到达时仍整洁镇定。

uncluttered.example: She works best at an uncluttered table.  她在不杂乱的桌前工作效率最高。

well-groomed.example: The well-groomed clerk greeted every visitor politely.  这位衣冠整洁的职员礼貌地招待每位来客。

disheveled.example: He looked disheveled after sleeping in his clothes.  他穿着衣服睡过之后显得很凌乱。

disordered.example: The disordered shelves made finding anything impossible.  杂乱的书架让人无法找到任何东西。

messy.example: His room was so messy that the floor disappeared.  他房间乱得连地板都看不见。

sloven.example: Only a sloven would leave dishes for a week.  只有懒散的人才会把碗放一周。

unclichéd.example: Critics praised the film for its unclichéd dialogue.  评论家称赞这部电影不落俗套的对话。

crumb.example: He swept every crumb from the table with his hand.  他用手把桌上每一点碎屑都扫掉。

driblet.example: News of the accident arrived in driblets all evening.  事故的消息整晚一点一点地传来。

scintilla.example: There is not a scintilla of proof for that claim.  那个说法没有一丝证据。

speck.example: A single speck of dust on the lens ruined the photograph.  镜头上一粒灰尘毁了这张照片。

sprinkling.example: There was only a sprinkling of guests in the hall.  大厅里只有稀稀落落几位客人。

tad.example: The soup needs just a tad more pepper.  这汤只需再加一点点胡椒。

blot out.example: Thick smoke blotted out the entire skyline.  浓烟遮蔽了整条天际线。

paper over.example: The statement papered over deep splits in the party.  这份声明掩盖了党内的深刻分裂。

shrug.example: The authorities simply shrugged off criticism from local residents.  当局对当地居民的批评一笑置之。

overpass.example: The editor overpassed several errors in the final draft.  编辑忽略了终稿中的几处错误。

shortcut.example: We took a shortcut through the park to save time.  我们穿过公园走捷径以节省时间。

signal.example: Landing the probe safely was a signal achievement for the young team.  探测器安全着陆是这支年轻团队非同寻常的成就。

beckon.example: The waiter beckoned us toward a table by the window.  服务员招手示意我们去靠窗的桌子。

gesture.example: She gestured toward the door without saying a word.  她一言不发地朝门做了个手势。

wave.example: He waved to the driver to stop at the corner.  他向司机挥手示意在拐角停下。

airhead.example: Do not treat her like an airhead; she reads constantly.  别把她当笨蛋，她一直在读书。

donkey.example: Only a donkey would sign a contract without reading it.  只有蠢人才会不读就签合同。

self-perpetuating.example: Poverty and poor schooling form a self-perpetuating cycle.  贫困与教育不良形成自我延续的循环。

sensuality.example: Critics praised the warm sensuality of the late orchestral works.  评论家称赞那些晚期管弦作品温暖的感官魅力。

drudge.example: She drudged in the kitchen from dawn to midnight.  她从清晨到午夜在厨房里做苦工。

sweat.example: Moving those crates was a real sweat.  搬那些箱子真是件苦活。

firepower.example: The team added real firepower to its front line.  这支球队为前锋线增添了实力。

horsepower.example: The truck lacks the horsepower for such steep hills.  这卡车缺乏爬如此陡坡的马力。

muscle.example: The company used its muscle to force lower prices.  这家公司利用实力压低价格。

char.example: The fire charred the beams but spared the roof.  大火烧焦了梁木，却保住了屋顶。

bending.example: The bending river hid the village from view.  弯曲的河流把村子挡在视野之外。

curling.example: Curling vines covered the whole stone wall.  卷曲的藤蔓覆盖了整面石墙。

curving.example: A curving row of trees marked the property line.  一排弯曲的树标出了地界。

snag.example: The negotiations hit an unexpected snag over the question of wages.  谈判在工资问题上遇到意外障碍。

hitch.example: The ceremony went off without a hitch.  典礼进行得毫无阻碍。

gotcha.example: The contract has one gotcha buried in the fine print.  合同的小字里埋着一个坑。

pitfall.example: A good guide will help beginners avoid the most common pitfalls.  好的指南能帮助新手避开最常见的陷阱。

sacrosanct.example: In this office the lunch hour is treated as absolutely sacrosanct.  在这间办公室里，午餐时间被视为绝对不可侵犯。

hallowed.example: The battlefield is hallowed ground for the whole nation.  这片战场对全国而言是圣地。

holy.example: Pilgrims walk barefoot into the holy chamber.  朝圣者赤脚走进圣室。

sacred.example: Protecting the archive was treated as a sacred duty.  保护档案被视为神圣职责。

unassailable.example: Decades of careful research gave her an unassailable reputation among historians.  数十年的严谨研究使她在史学界享有无可争辩的声誉。

affliction.example: Chronic back pain was an affliction she learned to live with quietly.  慢性背痛是她学会默默承受的一种折磨。

nemesis.example: The rival team became his nemesis for a decade.  这支对手球队十年间成了他的克星。

benefit.example: Regular exercise brings benefit to both body and mind.  规律锻炼对身心都有好处。

blessing.example: The early rain was a blessing for the dry fields.  早来的雨对干旱的田地是一件幸事。

godsend.example: The extra grant was a godsend to the small clinic.  这笔额外拨款对小诊所是天赐之助。

manna.example: The donation felt like manna to the struggling school.  这笔捐款对困难的学校像是天降恩赐。

skimp.example: Builders who skimp on materials always create problems for later owners.  在材料上省钱的建筑商总会给后来的业主留下麻烦。

scrimp.example: They had to scrimp and save for years to buy the shop.  他们省吃俭用多年才买下这家店铺。

loosened.example: He walked in with a loosened tie and tired eyes.  他领带松着、眼神疲惫地走进来。

relaxed.example: Her shoulders finally looked relaxed after the massage.  按摩后她的肩膀终于显得松弛了。

slackened.example: The slackened sail flapped uselessly in the calm.  松垂的帆在无风中徒然拍动。

unsecured.example: An unsecured ladder slid off the roof of the van.  一把未固定的梯子从货车顶上滑落。

taut.example: The wire was so taut that it hummed in the wind.  这根线绷得很紧，在风中嗡嗡作响。

ful.example: The suffix ful means full of the quality named.  后缀 ful 表示充满所指的性质。

outlook.example: His outlook on the economy changed after the report.  报告出来后他对经济的看法变了。

perspective.example: The film shows the war from a soldier's perspective.  这部电影从士兵的视角展现战争。

standpoint.example: From a safety standpoint the design is unacceptable.  从安全立场看这个设计不可接受。

viewpoint.example: Each panelist offered a sharply different viewpoint.  每位嘉宾都提出截然不同的观点。

canted.example: The camera used a canted angle to unsettle viewers.  镜头用倾斜角度让观众感到不安。

graded.example: The path is graded so wheelchairs can climb it.  这条路有坡度设计，轮椅可以上去。

pitched.example: Snow slides easily off the steeply pitched roof.  雪很容易从陡斜的屋顶滑落。

raked.example: The theater has a raked floor so everyone can see.  剧院地面是倾斜的，让所有人都能看见。

tilting.example: The tilting floor made the old farmhouse feel unsettling.  倾斜的地板让这座老农舍显得令人不安。

perpendicular.example: Draw a line perpendicular to the base of the triangle.  画一条与三角形底边垂直的直线。

vertical.example: The cliff presented a nearly vertical face to the climbers.  峭壁向攀登者呈现出几乎垂直的岩面。

slate.example: The old factory is slated for demolition early next spring.  这座旧工厂定于明年初春拆除。

catalog.example: Librarians catalog every donated volume before shelving it.  图书馆员在上架前为每本捐赠图书编目。

enter.example: Please enter your name in the register at the door.  请把你的名字登记在门口的簿子上。

index.example: The editor will index all the proper names in the book.  编辑将为书中所有专有名词编制索引。

record.example: The clerk recorded every decision made at the meeting.  书记员记录了会上做出的每一项决定。

schedule.example: They scheduled the hearing for early next month.  他们把听证会安排在下月初。

delete.example: She deleted her name from the volunteer list.  她把自己的名字从志愿者名单上删掉了。

scad.example: He earned scads of money from that single invention.  他靠那一项发明赚了大量的钱。

shipload.example: A shipload of grain reached the harbor before dawn.  黎明前一船谷物运抵港口。

mouthful.example: He swallowed a mouthful of cold water and kept running.  他喝了一口凉水，继续奔跑。

sling.example: Do not sling that heavy bag onto the delicate glass table.  别把那个重包扔到脆弱的玻璃桌上。

chuck.example: He chucked the empty can into the recycling bin.  他把空罐子扔进了回收箱。

fling.example: She flung her coat onto the chair and sat down.  她把外套一甩扔到椅子上坐下了。

heave.example: The workers heaved the sandbags onto the waiting truck.  工人们把沙袋用力扔上等候的卡车。

hurl.example: Protesters hurled stones at the armored vehicles.  抗议者向装甲车猛掷石块。

hurtle.example: The sled hurtled down the icy slope at frightening speed.  雪橇以骇人的速度冲下冰坡。

lob.example: She lobbed the ball gently over the net.  她把球轻轻高抛过网。

loft.example: The golfer lofted the ball onto the distant green.  高尔夫球手把球高高击上远处的果岭。

pelt.example: The children pelted each other with snowballs all afternoon.  孩子们整个下午互相投掷雪球。

slippery.example: The marble stairs became dangerously slippery after the heavy morning rain.  一场晨雨过后，大理石台阶滑得危险。

greased.example: The greased hinge no longer squeaked when the door moved.  上了油的合页在门开合时不再吱吱作响。

greasy.example: He wiped his greasy fingers on a paper napkin.  他把油腻的手指擦在纸巾上。

lubricated.example: A properly lubricated chain lasts far longer than a dry one.  润滑良好的链条比干燥的耐用得多。

oiled.example: The team worked like a well oiled machine all season.  整个赛季这支队伍运转得像上好油的机器。

slicked.example: He appeared onstage with his hair slicked back neatly.  他上台时头发整齐地向后梳光。

slithery.example: The slithery mud made every step along the bank treacherous.  滑溜的泥浆使沿岸每一步都很危险。

elusive.example: The precise meaning of the poem remains elusive to critics.  这首诗的确切含义仍让评论家难以捉摸。

evasive.example: The minister gave an evasive answer to every question.  部长对每个问题都给出含糊的回答。

botchy.example: The botchy paintwork peeled within a single winter.  粗劣的漆面一个冬天就剥落了。

slapdash.example: His report was so slapdash that the editor refused to publish it.  他的报告太马虎，编辑拒绝发表。

blowsy.example: She played a blowsy landlady in that old comedy.  她在那部老喜剧里演一个邋遢的女房东。

dowdy.example: She refused to wear the dowdy uniform to the party.  她拒绝穿那件土气的制服去聚会。

chaotic.example: The office looked chaotic after the sudden move.  突然搬迁后办公室看上去一片混乱。

disarranged.example: The burglars left every drawer disarranged.  窃贼把每个抽屉都弄得凌乱不堪。

disarrayed.example: The retreating army was hopelessly disarrayed by nightfall.  撤退的军队到夜幕降临时已完全溃乱。

jumbled.example: His notes were so jumbled that nobody could follow them.  他的笔记杂乱得没人看得懂。

littered.example: The beach was littered with plastic bottles after the festival.  节庆过后海滩上散落着塑料瓶。

rumpled.example: He arrived in a rumpled suit and unpolished shoes.  他穿着起皱的西装和没擦亮的鞋子来了。

tousled.example: The boy woke with tousled hair and sleepy eyes.  男孩醒来时头发蓬乱、双眼困倦。

tumbled.example: She left the tumbled sheets exactly as they were.  她把凌乱的床单原样留着。

dashing.example: The dashing young officer looked immaculate in his dress uniform.  那位潇洒的年轻军官穿着礼服显得一丝不乱。
dashing.cn: 衣着讲究的，潇洒时髦的

bandbox.example: He always looked as if he had stepped out of a bandbox.  他总是一身光鲜整洁的样子。

crisp.example: He wore a crisp white shirt to the interview.  他穿着一件挺括的白衬衫去面试。

sloth.example: Years of sloth had left him unfit for any demanding job.  多年懒散使他无法胜任任何要求高的工作。

idleness.example: Weeks of idleness left him restless and irritable.  数周的无所事事让他焦躁易怒。

indolence.example: His natural indolence kept him from finishing anything.  他天生的懒惰使他什么事都做不完。

inertia.example: Bureaucratic inertia delayed the reform for another decade.  官僚惰性使这项改革又推迟了十年。

laziness.example: He blamed his poor grades on laziness rather than ability.  他把成绩差归咎于懒惰而不是能力。

shiftlessness.example: The old farmer despised the shiftlessness of his youngest son.  这位老农鄙视小儿子的懒散。

assiduity.example: He pursued the research with remarkable assiduity for years.  他多年以非凡的勤勉从事这项研究。

diligence.example: Her diligence earned her a place at the top university.  她的勤奋为她赢得了顶尖大学的名额。

industry.example: The teacher praised the boy's industry rather than his talent.  老师赞扬那男孩的勤奋而非天赋。

fly.example: She flew down the corridor to catch the departing train.  她飞奔穿过走廊去赶将要开走的火车。

race.example: He raced across the field to warn the others.  他飞奔穿过田野去警告其他人。

whiz.example: Motorcycles whizzed past us on the narrow mountain road.  摩托车在狭窄的山路上从我们身旁飞驰而过。

sluggard.example: Her brother is a hopeless sluggard who sleeps until noon every day.  她弟弟是个无可救药的懒人，每天睡到中午。

deadbeat.example: His landlord called him a deadbeat who never paid rent.  房东说他是个从不付租金的懒汉。

idler.example: The foreman had no patience for idlers on his crew.  工头对手下的懒人毫无耐心。

loafer.example: The old man dismissed his nephew as a loafer.  老人把侄子看作一个游手好闲的人。

slug.example: He lay on the sofa all weekend like a slug.  他整个周末像懒虫一样躺在沙发上。

doer.example: The company needed doers rather than eloquent planners.  公司需要的是实干者，而不是能言善辩的策划者。

hummer.example: Their new manager is a hummer who never slows down.  他们的新经理是个从不放慢脚步的干将。

hustler.example: As a young salesman he was known as a hustler.  年轻时做销售，他以干劲十足闻名。

rustler.cn: 精明能干的人；偷牲畜者
rustler.example: Their new foreman is a rustler who never wastes a single minute.  他们的新工头是个从不浪费一分钟的能干之人。

crawling.example: We sat in crawling traffic for nearly two hours.  我们在龟速车流中坐了近两个小时。

creeping.example: The reform advanced at a creeping pace for years.  这项改革多年来以极缓慢的速度推进。

dallying.example: His dallying approach to deadlines infuriated the whole team.  他对截止日期磨蹭的态度让整个团队恼火。

leisurely.example: They took a leisurely stroll along the riverbank after dinner.  晚饭后他们沿河岸悠闲地散步。

snaillike.example: Negotiations moved at a snaillike pace for months.  谈判数月来以蜗牛般的速度进行。

bolting.example: A bolting horse dragged the cart across the yard.  一匹狂奔的马把车拖过了院子。

lightning.example: The runner reacted with lightning speed to the starting gun.  这名选手对发令枪的反应快如闪电。

racing.example: He woke with a racing heart and damp forehead.  他醒来时心跳飞快，额头潮湿。

catnap.example: She took a short catnap before the evening shift.  她在晚班前小睡了一会儿。

sleep.example: He fell into a deep sleep the moment he lay down.  他一躺下就进入了深睡。

snooze.example: Grandfather likes a snooze in the armchair after lunch.  祖父喜欢午饭后在扶手椅上打个盹。

blot.example: That scandal remains a blot on the family name.  那件丑闻至今是这个家族名声上的污点。

brand.example: The verdict left a brand of shame on his reputation.  这个判决给他的名声留下了耻辱印记。

onus.example: The onus of proving the claim falls on the plaintiff.  证明该主张的责任落在原告身上。

smudge.example: A smudge of ink spoiled the otherwise perfect page.  一处墨迹污点毁了这本来完美的一页。

stigma.example: The stigma of failure kept him from applying for another job.  失败带来的污名使他不敢再去申请工作。

forget.example: He chose to forget the insult rather than answer it.  他选择忘掉那句侮辱，而不去回应。

award.example: The committee awarded her a medal for outstanding service.  委员会因她的杰出贡献授予她一枚奖章。

designing.example: She soon saw through her designing business partner.  她很快看透了那个工于心计的生意伙伴。

scheming.example: The play centers on a scheming courtier and a weak king.  这部剧围绕一个诡计多端的臣子和一位软弱的国王展开。

smarmy.example: The salesman's smarmy praise made her uncomfortable.  推销员虚情假意的夸奖让她很不舒服。

skullduggery.example: Voters grew tired of the political skullduggery behind every appointment.  选民厌倦了每次任命背后的政治诡计。

trickery.example: He won the contract through outright trickery.  他完全靠欺诈手段拿下了这份合同。

smattering.example: He picked up a smattering of Spanish during his summer abroad.  他在国外过暑假时学了一点西班牙语。

smirk.example: The boy smirked when he heard that his rival had failed.  听说对手失败了，男孩得意地笑了。

simper.example: She simpered whenever the young officer looked her way.  每当那位年轻军官看向她，她就傻笑。

choke.example: Thick smoke nearly choked the firefighters in the hallway.  浓烟几乎使走廊里的消防员窒息。

smug.example: He wore a smug expression after winning the argument.  争论获胜后他一脸自鸣得意。

complacent.example: The team grew complacent about safety after years without accidents.  多年没有事故后，团队对安全变得自满。

proud.example: He was too proud to admit that he needed help.  他太自傲，不肯承认自己需要帮助。

self-satisfied.example: His self-satisfied smile irritated everyone at the table.  他自鸣得意的笑让桌边所有人都不快。

egoless.cn: 无自我的，不自我中心的
egoless.example: Good teamwork requires an almost egoless attitude from everyone.  良好的团队合作要求每个人几乎都放下自我。

smuggling.example: Two sailors were arrested for smuggling diamonds through the busy port.  两名水手因通过繁忙港口走私钻石被捕。

bootlegging.example: He made a fortune from bootlegging during the 1920s.  他在二十年代靠贩运私酒发了财。

contraband.example: Customs officers seized the contraband hidden in the crates.  海关人员查获了藏在板条箱里的走私货。

morass.example: The company sank into a morass of legal disputes.  公司陷入了法律纠纷的泥沼。

noose.example: Investigators slowly tightened the noose around the smuggling ring.  调查人员慢慢收紧了对走私团伙的包围。

quicksand.example: Borrowing more money each month felt like stepping into quicksand.  每月借更多的钱，感觉就像踏入流沙。

interlace.example: The willow branches interlaced above the narrow path.  柳枝在窄径上方交织在一起。

intertwine.example: Their lives intertwined after that chance meeting in Rome.  在罗马那次偶遇后，他们的生活便交织在一起。

intertwist.example: The vines intertwist so tightly that they cannot be separated.  这些藤蔓缠绕得太紧，无法分开。

interweave.example: The novel interweaves two family histories across a century.  这部小说把跨越一个世纪的两个家族史交织起来。

untwist.example: She patiently untwisted the tangled headphone cable.  她耐心地解开缠成一团的耳机线。

laugh.example: The other boys laughed at his worn-out shoes.  别的男孩嘲笑他那双破旧的鞋。

snobbish.example: Her snobbish remarks about the neighbors offended everyone.  她对邻居的势利言论让所有人不快。

elitist.cn: 精英主义的；精英主义者
elitist.example: Critics called the admissions policy narrow and elitist.  批评者称这项招生政策狭隘且精英主义。

abstentious.example: The monks led an abstentious life of prayer and labor.  僧侣们过着祈祷与劳作的节制生活。

joking.example: He said it in a joking tone, but nobody smiled.  他用戏谑的语气说出来，可没人笑。

hedonistic.cn: 享乐主义的，纵情享乐的
hedonistic.example: The novel satirizes the hedonistic excesses of the rich.  这部小说讽刺富人纵情享乐的过度行为。

sensual.example: He abandoned scholarship for a life of sensual pleasure.  他放弃学术，投入声色享乐的生活。

voluptuary.example: The prince was remembered as a voluptuary rather than a ruler.  这位王子被记住的是酒色之徒而非统治者的身份。

bathed.example: He arrived at the finish line bathed in sweat.  他到达终点时浑身湿透是汗。

doused.example: The burning coals were doused with buckets of water.  燃烧的煤块被一桶桶水浇透熄灭。

drenched.example: We came home drenched after walking through the storm.  在暴雨中走回来后我们浑身湿透。

logged.example: The logged field could not be plowed for weeks.  这片浸满水的田地数周都无法耕种。

saturated.example: The soil was completely saturated after three days of rain.  下了三天雨后土壤完全浸透了。

soaked.example: Her shoes were soaked through by the time she got home.  她到家时鞋子已彻底湿透。

watered.example: The freshly watered lawn glistened in the morning light.  刚浇过水的草坪在晨光中闪着光。

waterlogged.example: The match was cancelled because the pitch was waterlogged.  因为球场被水浸透，比赛被取消。

consolation.example: Her letters were his only consolation during those months.  那几个月里她的信是他唯一的慰藉。

relief.example: News of her recovery brought the family enormous relief.  她康复的消息给全家带来极大宽慰。

solder.example: The technician soldered the loose parts together with remarkable patience.  技师极有耐心地把松脱的部件焊接在一起。

marry.example: The design marries traditional craft with modern materials.  这个设计把传统工艺与现代材料结合起来。

graveness.example: The graveness of his tone silenced the whole room.  他语气的严肃让整个房间安静下来。

intentness.example: She studied the painting with an intentness that surprised us.  她以令我们惊讶的专注端详那幅画。

staidness.example: The staidness of the old bank appealed to cautious clients.  这家老银行的稳重作风吸引了谨慎的客户。

frivolity.example: The principal had no tolerance for frivolity in class.  校长绝不容忍课堂上的轻浮举动。

play.example: The garden was full of children at play that afternoon.  那天下午花园里满是玩耍的孩子。

unthinking.example: His unthinking comment hurt her more than he realized.  他那句欠考虑的话伤她比他以为的更深。

chorus.example: The villagers answered the question in chorus.  村民们齐声回答了这个问题。

ensemble.example: A small ensemble performed the piece without a conductor.  一支小型合奏团在无人指挥的情况下演奏了这首曲子。

solitude.example: After retiring, the writer lived in solitude on a remote island.  退休后，这位作家在偏远岛上过着孤独的生活。

aloneness.example: He came to value his aloneness rather than fear it.  他渐渐珍视自己的独处，而不再害怕它。

insulation.example: Their wealth provided insulation from ordinary hardships.  他们的财富使他们与普通苦难隔绝。

privacy.example: She wanted the privacy of a quiet room to write.  她想要一间安静的房间独处写作。

seclusion.example: The poet spent her last years in complete seclusion.  这位诗人晚年完全隐居。

segregation.example: The law finally ended segregation in public schools.  这项法律最终结束了公立学校的种族隔离。

separateness.example: Living abroad gave him a permanent sense of separateness.  在国外生活让他有一种长久的疏离感。

sequestration.example: The judge ordered the sequestration of the jury during the trial.  法官命令在审判期间隔离陪审团。

solitariness.example: The solitariness of his cabin life suited him perfectly.  小木屋中孤独的生活正合他心意。

companionship.example: After years alone he began to crave companionship.  独居多年后他开始渴望有人陪伴。

society.example: He enjoyed the society of old friends more than fame.  他更喜欢与老友交往，而非名声。

solvent.example: The small firm remained financially solvent despite the difficult trading year.  尽管经营艰难，这家小公司仍有偿付能力。

bankrupt.example: The factory went bankrupt after losing its largest client.  失去最大客户后，这家工厂破产了。

solute.example: Stir until the solute disappears completely into the water.  搅拌至溶质完全溶于水中。

animal.example: The book explores animal appetites and moral restraint.  这本书探讨肉体欲望与道德约束。

mental.example: Long hours took a toll on his mental health.  长时间工作损害了他的心理健康。

funereal.example: A funereal silence settled over the defeated team.  一片阴沉的寂静笼罩着落败的队伍。

somnolence.example: The warm lecture hall produced a general somnolence among the students.  温暖的讲堂让学生们普遍犯困。

doziness.example: A warm doziness crept over him beside the fire.  炉火旁一阵温暖的困倦袭上他心头。

drowsiness.example: The medicine may cause drowsiness, so avoid driving.  这种药可能引起困倦，所以不要开车。

insomnia.example: She has suffered from insomnia since the accident.  自那次事故以来她一直失眠。

sleeplessness.example: Weeks of sleeplessness left her pale and forgetful.  数周的失眠让她面色苍白、记性变差。

wakefulness.example: Coffee prolonged his wakefulness far into the night.  咖啡让他清醒到深夜。

unguent.example: The nurse spread a cooling unguent over the burn.  护士在烧伤处涂上清凉的药膏。

sophism.example: The professor patiently exposed the sophism hidden in the student's argument.  教授耐心揭穿了学生论证中隐藏的诡辩。

sophistry.example: His argument was clever sophistry rather than honest reasoning.  他的论证是巧妙的诡辩，而非诚实的推理。

suave.example: The suave diplomat deflected every awkward question gracefully.  这位圆滑的外交官优雅地挡开了每个尴尬问题。

somniferous.example: The professor's somniferous voice put half the class to sleep.  教授催眠般的声音让半个班的人睡着了。

somnolent.example: The somnolent heat of the village slowed everything down.  村里令人昏睡的暑气让一切都慢了下来。

vile.example: He shouted a vile insult and was quickly escorted outside.  他喊出一句卑劣的侮辱，很快被带了出去。

bombproof.example: The lawyer built a bombproof case from the documents.  律师用这些文件构建了无懈可击的案情。

hearty.example: At eighty he remains hale and hearty.  八十岁时他依然健壮结实。

analytic.example: Her analytic mind quickly exposed the flaw in the plan.  她善于分析的头脑很快找出了计划的漏洞。

consequent.cn: 合乎逻辑的；随之发生的
consequent.example: The delays were consequent upon a shortage of parts.  这些延误是零件短缺造成的。

ailing.example: The government pledged to rescue the ailing steel industry.  政府承诺拯救不振的钢铁业。

sick.example: Half the crew fell sick during the long voyage.  在漫长的航行中一半船员生病了。

illegitimate.example: Drawing that conclusion from such data is illegitimate.  从这样的数据得出那个结论是不合理的。

inconsequent.cn: 不合逻辑的，前后不连贯的
inconsequent.example: His inconsequent reasoning failed to convince the committee.  他不合逻辑的推理未能说服委员会。

plush.example: They spent their anniversary in a plush hotel suite overlooking the sea.  他们在一间俯瞰大海的豪华酒店套房里度过结婚纪念日。

spat.example: The couple had a brief spat over money and then apologized.  这对夫妻为钱小吵一场，随后互相道歉。

tiff.example: She had a silly tiff with him about the dinner plans.  她和他为晚餐安排闹了一场无谓的小别扭。

specious.example: His specious argument collapsed as soon as the data were examined.  一查数据，他似是而非的论证立刻站不住脚。

deluding.example: Those deluding advertisements cost investors millions.  那些骗人的广告让投资者损失数百万。

delusive.example: He clung to the delusive hope of a sudden rescue.  他抱着突然获救的虚妄希望不放。

delusory.example: The treaty produced a delusory sense of lasting peace.  这项条约带来了持久和平的虚妄感觉。

misleading.example: The report was criticized for its misleading statistics.  这份报告因误导性的统计数字受到批评。

spectator.example: A crowd of spectators cheered wildly as the runners entered the stadium.  跑者进入体育场时，一群观众疯狂欢呼。

bystander.example: Two innocent bystanders were injured in the crash.  两名无辜的旁观者在车祸中受伤。

observer.example: As a keen observer of politics, she predicted the result.  作为敏锐的政治观察者，她预测了结果。

onlooker.example: Curious onlookers gathered around the street performer.  好奇的旁观者围在街头表演者周围。

viewer.example: Millions of viewers watched the final episode live.  数百万观众直播观看了最后一集。

watcher.example: Bird watchers waited hours for the rare heron to appear.  观鸟者等了数小时才见到那只稀有的鹭。

actor.example: The young actor stole every scene he appeared in.  这位年轻演员在他出现的每一场戏中都抢尽风头。

performer.example: The performers bowed as the audience rose to applaud.  表演者鞠躬致意，观众起立鼓掌。

player.example: Each player rehearsed the scene until midnight.  每位演员都把这场戏排练到午夜。

spectrum.example: The survey captured a broad spectrum of views on the proposed reform.  这项调查收集了对改革提案的各种观点。

diapason.example: The organ filled the church with its deep diapason.  管风琴以其深沉洪亮的乐声充满教堂。

gamut.example: Her novels run the gamut from comedy to tragedy.  她的小说涵盖了从喜剧到悲剧的全部范围。

daresay.example: I daresay the results will surprise a few people.  我料想这些结果会让一些人吃惊。
