suspect.example: I suspect the delay has nothing to do with weather.  我猜想这次延误与天气无关。

economizer.example: As a lifelong economizer, she never wasted a coin.  作为终身节约的人，她从不浪费一分钱。

penny-pincher.cn: 吝啬鬼，一分钱都省的人
penny-pincher.example: His uncle was a penny-pincher who reused envelopes.  他叔叔是个连信封都重复使用的吝啬鬼。

spent.example: Utterly spent after the double shift, he fell asleep on the sofa.  连上两班后精疲力竭，他在沙发上睡着了。

beaten.example: He looked beaten after twelve hours on the road.  在路上跑了十二小时后他显得疲惫不堪。

bleary.example: She arrived bleary and yawning after the night flight.  夜间航班后她双眼倦怠、连连打呵欠地到了。

done.example: By the last mile the runners were completely done.  跑到最后一英里时选手们彻底累垮了。

fatigued.example: The fatigued climbers rested before the final ascent.  疲倦的登山者在最后攀登前休息。

worn-out.example: The worn-out nurse slept through her alarm.  精疲力竭的护士睡过了闹钟。

invigorated.cn: 精力充沛的，充满活力的
invigorated.example: He felt invigorated after a cold swim in the lake.  在湖中冷水游泳后他感到精力充沛。

peppy.example: A peppy tune played while the children marched in.  孩子们走进来时播放着一首活泼的曲子。

strengthened.example: The setback left him with a strengthened resolve to continue.  这次挫折让他继续下去的决心更强了。

tireless.example: She was a tireless campaigner for clean water.  她是一位不懈争取清洁饮水的活动家。

vitalized.example: The vitalized town grew quickly after the new railway opened.  新铁路通车后，这座重新充满活力的小镇迅速发展。

weariless.example: His weariless devotion to the project impressed everyone.  他对这个项目不倦的投入让所有人钦佩。

slump.example: Housing prices suffered a sharp slump after interest rates rose.  利率上升后，房价急剧下跌。

recession.example: The country slid into recession after the currency collapsed.  货币崩溃后该国陷入衰退。

spiny.example: The mayor avoided that spiny political question during the entire debate.  市长在整场辩论中都避开那个棘手的政治问题。

catchy.example: The examiner slipped a catchy question into the paper.  主考人在试卷里塞了一道棘手的问题。

ticklish.example: The two governments face a ticklish negotiation over fishing rights.  两国政府面临一场关于捕鱼权的棘手谈判。

troublesome.example: One troublesome clause held up the whole contract.  一条麻烦的条款拖住了整份合同。

painless.example: The dentist promised a quick and painless procedure.  牙医承诺这是个快速无痛的过程。

spleen.example: He vented his spleen on anyone who dared question the decision.  谁敢质疑这个决定，他就冲谁发泄怒气。

angriness.example: A sudden angriness crept into his otherwise calm voice.  一股突然的怒气渗入他原本平静的声音。

choler.example: The insult roused the old general's choler at once.  这句侮辱立刻激起了老将军的怒气。

madness.example: He broke the window in a fit of madness.  他一时怒火中烧砸破了窗子。

pleasure.example: She takes great pleasure in tending her small garden.  她非常喜爱照料自己的小花园。

splice.example: The engineer spliced the two cables together and sealed the joint carefully.  工程师把两根电缆接合起来，仔细封好接头。

spontaneous.example: A spontaneous burst of applause followed the young pianist's final note.  年轻钢琴家弹出最后一个音，掌声自发响起。

predetermined.cn: 预先确定的，事先决定的
predetermined.example: Critics said the vote had a predetermined outcome.  批评者说这次投票的结果早已预定。

mimicking.example: The comedian won laughs by mimicking the mayor's walk.  这位喜剧演员靠模仿市长走路的样子赢得笑声。

repeated.example: Repeated warnings from the inspector were simply ignored.  检查员反复的警告被完全无视。

sprawl.example: Cheap housing developments sprawled outward across the once quiet farmland.  廉价住宅区向外蔓延，铺满曾经安静的农田。

straddle.example: The old town straddles the border between two provinces.  这座老城横跨两省的边界。

mettlesome.example: The mettlesome colt refused to stand still.  这匹精神饱满的小马驹不肯站定。

viva-.example: The root viva- appears in vivacious, revive, and vivid.  词根 viva- 出现在 vivacious、revive 和 vivid 之中。

catalyst.example: The strike became a catalyst for sweeping labor reform.  这次罢工成为全面劳工改革的促成因素。

incitement.example: He was charged with incitement to riot after the speech.  演讲之后他被控煽动骚乱。

provocation.example: The dog bit him without the slightest provocation.  那狗毫无缘由就咬了他。

disincentive.example: High taxes act as a disincentive to small businesses.  高税收对小企业起到抑制作用。

saneness.example: The defense lawyer questioned the witness's saneness at the time.  辩护律师质疑证人当时的神志是否健全。

dementia.example: Her grandmother has suffered from dementia for three years.  她祖母患痴呆症已三年。

black.example: The miners' hands were black with coal dust.  矿工的手被煤尘弄得污黑。

squall.example: The frightened child squalled in pain until the nurse finally arrived.  受惊的孩子疼得尖叫，直到护士终于赶来。

screech.example: The car screeched to a halt inches from the wall.  汽车尖啸着停在离墙几英寸处。

squeal.example: The children squealed with delight when the clown appeared.  小丑一出现孩子们就高兴地尖叫。

thunder.example: The sergeant thundered orders across the parade ground.  中士在操场上怒吼着下达命令。

squat.example: A squat stone tower guarded the entrance to the ancient harbor.  一座又矮又粗的石塔守着古港入口。

chunky.example: A chunky man in overalls opened the gate for us.  一个穿工装的矮胖男人为我们开了门。

dumpy.example: She hated how the coat made her look dumpy.  她讨厌这件外套让她显得矮胖。

heavyset.example: A heavyset guard blocked the narrow doorway.  一名粗壮的警卫堵住了狭窄的门口。

squatty.example: A squatty clay jar held the flowers on the table.  桌上一只粗矮的陶罐插着花。

stocky.example: The stocky wrestler lifted his opponent with ease.  这位矮壮的摔跤手轻松举起了对手。

stubby.example: His stubby fingers moved surprisingly fast over the keys.  他短粗的手指在键上动得出奇地快。

stumpy.example: A stumpy little dog waddled ahead of its owner.  一只矮胖的小狗摇摆着走在主人前面。

thickset.example: A thickset farmer carried the sack on one shoulder.  一个粗壮的农夫单肩扛起那袋东西。

gangling.example: A gangling teenager ducked under the low doorway.  一个瘦长笨拙的少年低头钻过矮门。

lanky.example: The lanky player reached the shelf without a stool.  那位瘦高的球员不用凳子就够到了架子。

softpedal.example: Officials tried to softpedal the criticism in their public statements.  官员们试图在公开声明中淡化批评。

crack down.example: The government promised to crack down on tax evasion.  政府承诺严厉打击逃税行为。

secede.example: Two provinces threatened to secede from the federation over the new tax.  两个省威胁因新税而脱离联邦。

demit.example: He chose to demit from the club rather than apologize.  他宁愿退出俱乐部也不道歉。

disaffiliate.example: Several branches voted to disaffiliate from the national body.  几个分部投票决定脱离全国组织。

quit.example: She quit the committee after the second disagreement.  第二次分歧之后她退出了委员会。

enlist.example: He enlisted in the navy at the age of eighteen.  他十八岁时加入了海军。

adament.example: She remained adament that the deadline would not move.  她坚决表示截止日期不会更改。

stammer.example: The nervous boy stammered out an apology and hurried from the room.  紧张的男孩结结巴巴地道歉，然后匆匆离开房间。

stutter.example: He stuttered badly whenever he had to speak publicly.  每次必须公开讲话时他都严重结巴。

startle.example: A sudden noise from the kitchen startled the sleeping cat awake.  厨房突然的声响惊醒了睡着的猫。

amaze.example: The young pianist amazed everyone with her memory.  这位年轻钢琴家的记忆力令所有人惊叹。

astonish.example: The result astonished even the most optimistic forecasters.  这个结果连最乐观的预测者都感到惊讶。

astound.example: His confession astounded the officers questioning him.  他的供认让审问他的警官们震惊。

dumbfound.example: Her sudden resignation dumbfounded the entire department.  她突然辞职让整个部门惊呆了。

rock.example: The scandal rocked the party just before the election.  这桩丑闻在选举前震动了该党。

scare.example: The sudden thunder scared the children out of bed.  突然的雷声把孩子们从床上惊起。

shock.example: The photographs shocked readers across the country.  这些照片震惊了全国的读者。

stun.example: The verdict stunned everyone waiting outside the courtroom.  判决让在法庭外等候的人都震惊了。

stupefy.example: The sheer scale of the fraud stupefied investigators.  这起欺诈的规模之大让调查人员惊呆。

immotile.example: The sample contained mostly immotile cells under the microscope.  显微镜下样本中多为不能运动的细胞。

stagnant.example: The economy stayed stagnant for a decade despite repeated government reforms.  尽管政府反复改革，经济十年停滞不前。

lively.example: A lively debate broke out over the proposed budget.  围绕拟定预算爆发了一场热烈的辩论。

stature.example: He is a scholar of great stature in the field of linguistics.  他是语言学界水平极高的学者。

altitude.example: Breathing becomes difficult at an altitude above four thousand meters.  在四千米以上的海拔，呼吸会变得困难。

elevation.example: The village sits at an elevation of two thousand meters.  这个村子位于海拔两千米处。

quality.example: The judges praised the quality of her early work.  评委称赞了她早期作品的水准。

value.example: The old coin turned out to be of great value.  那枚旧硬币结果很有价值。

worth.example: The young engineer soon proved his worth to the firm.  这位年轻工程师很快向公司证明了自己的才干。

true-blue.example: He remained a true-blue supporter through every losing season.  每个失利的赛季他都是忠诚的支持者。

traitorous.example: The officer was executed for traitorous dealings with the enemy.  这名军官因与敌人的叛国交易被处死。

treacherous.example: A treacherous adviser sold the king's battle plans to the enemy.  一个背信弃义的谋士把国王的作战计划卖给了敌人。

stealth.example: The base was destroyed by a stealth attack just before dawn.  基地在黎明前被一次隐形突袭摧毁。

backstairs.example: The deal was arranged through backstairs negotiations.  这笔交易是通过暗中谈判安排的。

private.example: They held a private meeting before the public hearing.  他们在公开听证会前举行了私下会面。

gradual.example: The path rises in a gradual slope toward the temple.  小路以平缓的坡度向寺庙升高。

fetor.example: A sickening fetor rose from the neglected pond.  一股恶心的臭气从无人管的池塘升起。

funk.example: The basement carried the funk of damp and old paint.  地下室弥漫着潮气和旧漆的臭味。

reek.example: The kitchen reeked of burnt oil all evening.  厨房整晚都散发着油烧焦的臭味。

perfume.example: The perfume of roses filled the small courtyard.  玫瑰的芳香充满了小院。

scent.example: The scent of pine hung in the cool morning air.  松香在清冷的晨气中弥漫。

insanitary.example: Inspectors closed the kitchen for insanitary conditions.  检查员因卫生条件恶劣关闭了厨房。

unhygienic.example: Storing raw meat that way is plainly unhygienic.  那样存放生肉显然不卫生。

immalleable.example: Cold cast iron is brittle and largely immalleable.  冷铸铁很脆，基本不可延展。

impliable.example: The impliable rod snapped instead of bending.  这根不易弯曲的棒子直接断了而没有弯。

petrified.example: She stood petrified as the snake crossed the path.  蛇穿过小路时她吓得僵在原地。

testing.example: The final stage was a testing climb in thin air.  最后一段是在稀薄空气中艰难的攀登。

suffocate.example: Several residents nearly suffocated in the thick smoke from the fire.  几名居民在火灾的浓烟中几乎窒息。

freehanded.example: A freehanded donor paid for the entire new wing.  一位慷慨的捐赠者出资建了整座新翼楼。

sequel.example: Widespread famine was the tragic sequel of the long war.  大范围的饥荒是这场长期战争的悲惨后果。

fruit.example: This building is the fruit of ten years' planning.  这座楼是十年规划的成果。

product.example: The law was a product of decades of public pressure.  这项法律是数十年公众压力的产物。

sequence.example: Please perform the steps in the correct sequence.  请按正确顺序执行这些步骤。

causation.example: Correlation alone does not establish causation.  仅有相关性并不能确立因果关系。

occasion.example: A trivial remark was the occasion of their long feud.  一句琐碎的话成了他们长期不和的起因。

stipulate.example: The contract stipulates that all repairs must be finished within thirty days.  合同规定所有维修须在三十天内完成。

waive.example: The university agreed to waive the application fee.  校方同意免除申请费。

stitch.example: A sharp stitch in his side forced him to stop running.  肋侧一阵剧痛让他不得不停下奔跑。

pang.example: A sharp pang shot through his knee as he stood.  他站起时膝盖一阵剧痛。

prick.example: She felt only a slight prick when the needle went in.  针进去时她只感到轻微的刺痛。

sting.example: The alcohol caused a fierce sting on the cut.  酒精让伤口一阵剧烈刺痛。

throe.example: The patient lay in the throes of unbearable pain.  病人躺在难以忍受的剧痛之中。

tingle.example: His frozen fingers began to tingle beside the stove.  他冻僵的手指在炉边开始发麻刺痛。

twinge.example: He felt a twinge in his back as he lifted the box.  他抬箱子时背部一阵刺痛。

easiness.example: The easiness of the first exercises misled the students.  最初练习的轻松让学生们产生了误判。

stoke.example: The mayor's careless remarks stoked public anger across the whole district.  市长轻率的言论激起全区公众的怒火。

minify.example: The report tried to minify the scale of the leak.  这份报告试图缩小泄漏的规模。

subtract.example: Subtract the shipping cost from the total price.  从总价中减去运费。

catatonic.example: After the news he sat in a catatonic silence.  听到消息后他呆滞地默坐着。

handle.example: She handled the criticism with surprising calm.  她以出人意料的镇定应对了批评。

tolerate.example: He could not tolerate the noise from the street below.  他无法容忍下面街道的噪音。

stonewall.example: Company lawyers stonewalled the investigation for more than two years.  公司律师阻挠调查两年多。

cooperate.example: The witness agreed to cooperate fully with investigators.  证人同意完全配合调查人员。

fearful.example: The child was fearful of every shadow in the hallway.  这孩子害怕走廊里的每一个影子。

gimmick.example: Free shipping was just a gimmick to attract buyers.  免运费只是吸引买家的花招。

strand.example: The storm stranded dozens of travelers on the small island overnight.  暴风雨使数十名旅客一夜困在小岛上。

maroon.cn: 把…遗弃在孤岛上，使孤立无援
maroon.example: The mutineers marooned the captain on a tiny uninhabited island.  叛变者把船长遗弃在一个荒无人烟的小岛上。

stratify.example: Economists often stratify society by income to study patterns of spending.  经济学家常按收入将社会分层，以研究消费模式。

assort.example: Workers assort the apples by size before packing them into crates.  工人们在装箱前按大小把苹果分类。

categorize.example: Librarians categorize every new book by subject and reading level.  图书馆员按主题和阅读难度给每本新书分类。

classify.example: Biologists classify these strange creatures as neither plants nor animals.  生物学家把这些奇怪的生物归为既非植物也非动物。

forceful.example: She made a forceful case for reforming the outdated grading system.  她为改革过时的评分制度提出了有力的论证。

striate.example: Ancient glaciers striated the rock surface across the whole valley.  古代冰川在整个山谷的岩石表面刻出了条纹。

furrow.example: He furrowed his brow as he studied the confusing map.  他研究那张令人困惑的地图时皱起了眉头。

streak.example: A streak of lightning lit up the whole valley for a second.  一道闪电瞬间照亮了整个山谷。

stripe.example: The zebra's black and white stripes make it hard to see at dusk.  斑马的黑白条纹使它在黄昏时难以被发现。

soothsayer.example: The nervous king consulted a soothsayer before launching the long campaign.  紧张的国王在发动这场持久战役前求问预言家。

diviner.example: The tribe asked the old diviner to read the pattern of bones.  部落请老占卜者解读骨头的排列。

forecaster.example: The weather forecaster warned that a heavy storm would arrive by dawn.  天气预报员警告说一场暴风雨将在黎明前到来。

foreteller.example: Critics dismissed him as a foreteller of disasters that never came.  批评者把他当成预言从未发生的灾难的人而不予理睬。

prognosticator.example: Every prognosticator on television predicted a different winner this year.  电视上每位预测者今年都预测了不同的赢家。

prophet.example: The old prophet warned the city that its walls would fall.  老先知警告这座城市，它的城墙将会倒塌。

hoarse.example: After cheering all evening, her voice was hoarse and barely audible.  欢呼了一整晚后，她的声音沙哑得几乎听不见。

squawky.example: The squawky old radio made every song sound painful to hear.  那台刺耳的旧收音机让每首歌听起来都很难受。

strike.example: The boxer tried to strike a heavy blow before the bell rang.  拳手想在铃响前猛击一拳。

onslaught.example: The village could not survive another onslaught from the enemy cavalry.  村庄无法再承受敌方骑兵的一次猛攻。

nail.example: He nailed the loose board down before someone tripped over it.  他在有人绊倒之前把松动的木板钉牢了。

swat.example: She swatted the mosquito that had been buzzing near her ear.  她拍死了一直在她耳边嗡嗡叫的蚊子。

set on.example: The guard dogs were set on the intruder the moment he climbed in.  他一翻进来，看守犬就被放出去攻击他。

bang.example: Someone began to bang on the door in the middle of the night.  半夜有人开始猛敲门。

bump.example: He bumped into the table and knocked over two glasses of wine.  他撞到桌子，打翻了两杯酒。

collide.example: The two cyclists collided at the corner but neither was badly hurt.  两个骑车人在拐角处相撞，但都没受重伤。

impact.example: The meteor's impact left a crater clearly visible from the air.  流星的撞击留下了一个从空中清晰可见的坑。

impinge.example: New regulations impinge on the freedom of small local newspapers.  新规定侵犯了地方小报的自由。

ram.example: The truck rammed the barrier and crashed into the ditch beyond.  卡车撞穿护栏，冲进了后面的沟里。

swipe.example: The bear took a swipe at the fish but missed completely.  熊朝那条鱼挥了一爪，却完全没打中。

thud.cn: 砰的一声重击；发出重击声
thud.example: The heavy book fell off the shelf and landed with a thud.  那本厚书从书架上掉下来，砰的一声落地。

disrobe.example: The patients were asked to disrobe behind the curtain.  病人被要求在帘子后面脱下衣服。

unclothe.example: She gently unclothed the sleeping baby to change his diaper.  她轻轻给睡着的婴儿脱下衣服换尿布。

gown.example: The nurses gowned the surgeon before he entered the operating room.  护士们在外科医生进手术室前为他穿上手术袍。

robe.example: The judge put on his black robe before entering the courtroom.  法官进入法庭前穿上了黑色法袍。

strut.example: The winner strutted across the stage with his trophy held high.  获胜者高举奖杯，趾高气扬地走过舞台。

prance.example: The winner pranced around the room showing off his new trophy.  获胜者在房间里趾高气扬地走来走去，炫耀新奖杯。

stalk.cn: 高视阔步地走；潜行追踪
stalk.example: He stalked out of the meeting without answering a single question.  他没回答任何问题就气冲冲地走出了会议室。

swagger.example: He swaggered into the room after winning the bowling championship.  赢得保龄球锦标赛后，他大摇大摆地走进房间。

spike.example: The documentary spiked public interest in the region's vanishing wildlife.  这部纪录片激起公众对该地区濒危野生动物的兴趣。

liven.example: A little music would liven up this dull afternoon meeting.  一点音乐会让这个沉闷的下午会议活跃起来。

stultify.example: Endless paperwork stultified every reform effort the new director proposed.  没完没了的文书工作使新主任提出的每项改革都失效。

constipate.example: Endless paperwork constipated the once lively research department.  无尽的文书工作使曾经活跃的研究部门变得呆滞。

stagnate.example: Wages stagnated for a decade while housing prices kept climbing.  工资停滞了十年，而房价却持续攀升。

alertness.example: Strong coffee restored his alertness during the long night shift.  浓咖啡在漫长的夜班中恢复了他的警觉。

vigilance.example: Constant vigilance kept the small border town safe for years.  持续的警惕使这个边境小镇多年平安。

dwarf.example: The new tower dwarfs every other building in the old district.  新塔楼使老城区其他所有建筑都显得矮小。

wimpy.example: His wimpy excuse convinced nobody in the crowded room.  他软弱无力的借口没能说服拥挤房间里的任何人。

stygian.example: Stygian darkness filled the cave once our last lamp went out.  最后一盏灯熄灭后，洞里一片极度黑暗。

caliginous.example: They groped through the caliginous tunnel with a single candle.  他们举着一支蜡烛在昏暗的隧道里摸索前行。

pitch-black.example: The power failed and the whole corridor went pitch-black.  停电了，整条走廊变得漆黑一片。

illuminated.example: The illuminated cathedral could be seen from across the river.  被灯光照亮的大教堂在河对岸就能看见。

illumined.example: The great hall was softly illumined by dozens of candles.  大厅被数十支蜡烛柔和地照亮。

conquer.example: Rome conquered most of the Mediterranean world within two centuries.  罗马在两个世纪内征服了地中海世界的大部分地区。

subjugate.example: The empire sent legions to subjugate a rebellious northern province.  帝国派出军团征服叛乱的北方行省。

vanquish.example: A smaller force managed to vanquish the invading army in one day.  一支人数较少的部队一天之内就击败了入侵的军队。

subject.example: The entire plan is subject to approval by the city council.  整个方案须经市议会批准。

dependent.example: The village remains dependent on rainfall for its entire harvest.  这个村子的全部收成仍然取决于降雨。

reliant.example: The company is heavily reliant on a single overseas supplier.  这家公司严重依赖一个海外供应商。

independent.example: Her research stayed independent of any corporate funding or influence.  她的研究不受任何企业资金或影响的支配。

overpower.example: Three officers finally overpowered the struggling suspect in the hallway.  三名警官最终在走廊里制服了挣扎的嫌疑人。

ignoble.example: His generosity hid an ignoble desire for public praise.  他的慷慨背后藏着对公众赞誉的卑劣渴望。

subliminal.example: Researchers question whether subliminal advertising messages influence what shoppers actually buy.  研究者质疑潜意识广告信息是否真会影响购买。

subconscious.example: A subconscious fear of failure kept him from applying at all.  对失败的潜意识恐惧让他根本没去申请。

submerse.example: Gardeners submerse the bare roots in water before planting them.  园丁在栽种前把裸根浸入水中。

emerge.example: The diver emerged from the dark water holding a rusty helmet.  潜水员从黑暗的水中浮出，手里拿着一个生锈的头盔。

obeisant.example: The obeisant clerk bowed twice before daring to speak.  那个卑躬屈膝的职员鞠了两次躬才敢开口。

subservient.example: She refused to be subservient to anyone merely for a promotion.  她拒绝为了升职而对任何人卑躬屈膝。

junior.example: A junior partner handled the paperwork while the seniors argued.  一位资历较浅的合伙人处理文书，而资深者们在争论。

tributary.example: This small tributary joins the great river below the old bridge.  这条小支流在老桥下方汇入大河。

greater.example: Safety is of greater importance than speed on this narrow road.  在这条窄路上安全比速度更重要。

prime.example: Cutting costs became the prime concern of the new management team.  削减成本成了新管理团队的首要关切。

senior.example: A senior official signed the order without consulting his subordinates.  一位高级官员没有征询下属就签署了命令。

central.example: Water shortage is the central issue facing the whole region.  缺水是整个地区面临的核心问题。

subsidy.example: A generous government subsidy keeps the local bus service running.  政府的丰厚补助金维持着当地公交运营。

allotment.example: Each family received a small allotment of grain that winter.  那个冬天每家都领到了少量的粮食配给。

appropriation.example: Congress approved a large appropriation for rural road repairs.  国会批准了一笔用于乡村道路维修的大额拨款。

subvention.example: The theater survives on a modest annual subvention from the city.  剧院靠市政府每年适度的补助金维持运营。

earthshaking.example: Her paper was solid but hardly an earthshaking contribution.  她的论文很扎实，但算不上惊天动地的贡献。

substantive.example: The committee made substantive changes to the draft rather than cosmetic ones.  委员会对草案作了实质性改动，而非表面修饰。

overthrow.example: The rebels tried to overthrow the government within a single night.  叛军试图在一夜之间推翻政府。

overturn.example: The higher court overturned the verdict after new evidence appeared.  新证据出现后，上级法院推翻了原判。

topple.example: Mass protests toppled the dictator after only three weeks.  大规模抗议仅三周后就推翻了那位独裁者。

asphyxiate.example: Two workers nearly asphyxiated in the unventilated storage tank.  两名工人在不通风的储罐里几乎窒息。

cheerless.example: They spent a cheerless evening in the cold, empty apartment.  他们在冰冷空荡的公寓里度过了一个阴郁的夜晚。

glum.example: He sat in the corner with a glum expression all evening.  他整晚坐在角落里，一脸阴郁。

gray.example: The gray November sky matched everyone's low spirits that week.  十一月阴沉的天空与那周大家的低落情绪相配。

secular.example: The country insists on secular education in all its public schools.  该国坚持在所有公立学校实行世俗教育。

earthbound.example: His poems ignore heaven and dwell on earthbound troubles.  他的诗不谈天国，只写世俗的烦恼。

sublunary.example: The monk claimed to have risen above all sublunary desires.  那位僧人自称已超脱一切尘世欲望。

terrene.example: The hermit despised terrene comforts and slept on bare stone.  隐士鄙视尘世的舒适，睡在光石头上。

part.example: She parted the heavy curtains and let the morning light in.  她分开厚重的窗帘，让晨光照进来。

bendy.example: The toy is made of a bendy rubber that never cracks.  这个玩具由永不裂开的柔韧橡胶制成。

supplant.example: Cheap digital cameras quickly supplanted film in the consumer market.  廉价数码相机迅速在消费市场取代了胶片。

displace.example: Automation displaced hundreds of workers at the old assembly plant.  自动化取代了那家老装配厂的数百名工人。

displant.example: Settlers gradually displanted the tribes who had farmed the valley.  移民逐渐使世代耕种这座山谷的部落迁离故土。

supersede.example: New safety regulations will supersede the old rules next January.  新的安全条例将于明年一月取代旧规。

cut out.example: He cut out his rival and won the client's contract himself.  他挤掉了对手，自己赢得了客户的合同。

supplement.example: He took an evening job to supplement his modest teaching income.  他找了份晚间工作，以补充微薄的教书收入。

addendum.example: A short addendum to the contract listed the two new deadlines.  合同后的一份简短附录列出了两个新的截止日期。

addition.example: The new wing is a welcome addition to the crowded library.  新翼楼是拥挤图书馆一个受欢迎的增建。

expansion.example: Rapid expansion left the young company badly short of cash.  快速扩张使这家年轻公司严重缺乏现金。

increment.example: Salaries rise by a small increment every January.  工资每年一月小幅增长一次。

proliferation.example: The proliferation of cheap sensors changed how farmers water crops.  廉价传感器的激增改变了农民灌溉作物的方式。

step-up.example: The factory announced a sharp step-up in weekend production.  工厂宣布周末产量大幅提升。

hypothesis.example: Three experiments were designed to test her bold new hypothesis.  设计了三个实验来检验她大胆的新假设。

proposition.example: Moving abroad for work seemed an attractive proposition at first.  出国工作起初似乎是个有吸引力的提议。

slap down.example: The chairman slapped down every suggestion from the younger staff.  主席把年轻员工的每个建议都断然压了下去。

surcharge.example: The airline added a fuel surcharge to every international ticket this month.  航空公司本月给每张国际机票加了燃油附加费。

gouge.example: Hotels near the stadium gouge visitors on every game weekend.  体育场附近的旅馆每个比赛周末都向游客乱收高价。

overage.example: The warehouse reported a costly overage of unsold winter coats.  仓库报告了一批代价高昂的滞销冬衣过剩。

redundancy.example: The editor cut the redundancy from every paragraph of the draft.  编辑删去了草稿中每一段的冗余内容。

superfluity.example: The report drowned its argument in a superfluity of statistics.  这份报告用过多的统计数据淹没了自己的论点。

insufficient supply.example: An insufficient supply of vaccines delayed the clinic's program by weeks.  疫苗供应不足使诊所的计划推迟了数周。

famish.example: The long siege famished the townspeople before help finally arrived.  漫长的围城使镇民饥饿难耐，援助才终于到来。

privy.example: Only two aides were privy to the president's real schedule.  只有两名助手私下知道总统真正的行程。

behind-the-scenes.example: Months of behind-the-scenes negotiations produced the surprise agreement.  数月的幕后谈判促成了这份令人意外的协议。

endangered.example: Rising temperatures have left many mountain bird species endangered.  气温上升使许多山地鸟类濒临危险。

exposed.example: The camp sat on an exposed ridge with no shelter from wind.  营地位于毫无避风处的裸露山脊上。

unexposed.example: Children unexposed to the virus were vaccinated first.  未接触过病毒的儿童被优先接种。

unsusceptible.example: The old judge seemed entirely unsusceptible to flattery or pressure.  这位老法官似乎完全不受奉承或压力的影响。

suture.example: The surgeon sutured the deep wound with remarkable speed and care.  外科医生极其迅速细致地缝合了深创口。

incision.example: The surgeon closed the small incision with three neat stitches.  医生用三道整齐的针脚缝合了那个小切口。

avulse.example: The accident avulsed a tendon from the athlete's right heel.  这场事故把运动员右脚跟的一根肌腱撕脱了。

bony.cn: 瘦骨嶙峋的，骨头突出的
bony.example: His bony wrists stuck out from sleeves that were far too short.  他瘦骨嶙峋的手腕从太短的袖子里露出来。

skinny.example: The skinny boy could barely lift the heavy water bucket.  那个瘦弱的男孩几乎提不起沉重的水桶。

corpulent.example: The corpulent merchant filled the narrow doorway completely.  那位肥胖的商人把窄门堵得满满的。

paunchy and awkward.example: In the tight uniform he looked paunchy and awkward on stage.  穿着紧身制服，他在台上显得大腹便便又笨拙。

brag.example: He bragged about his new car until everyone stopped listening.  他一直吹嘘自己的新车，直到大家都不再听。

vapor.example: The old colonel vapored about battles he had never fought.  那位老上校吹嘘他从未参加过的战役。

vaunt.example: He vaunted his prizes until even his friends stopped listening.  他不停吹嘘自己的奖项，连朋友都不再听了。

gasconade.example: His speech was pure gasconade with no facts behind it.  他的演讲纯属吹牛，背后毫无事实依据。

cuss.example: He cussed loudly when the hammer landed on his thumb.  锤子砸到拇指时他大声咒骂。

pledge.example: Both parties pledged their support for the flood relief fund.  两党都承诺支持这项洪灾救助基金。

vow.example: She vowed never to set foot in that town again.  她发誓再也不踏进那个镇子。

fiery.example: The fiery afternoon sun drove every worker into the shade.  酷热的午后阳光把每个工人都赶进了阴凉处。

algid.example: The algid wind off the lake numbed their faces within minutes.  湖面吹来的寒风几分钟就冻麻了他们的脸。

bone-chilling.example: A bone-chilling wind swept across the empty parking lot.  一阵刺骨的寒风扫过空荡的停车场。

ice-cold.example: He washed his face in ice-cold water to wake himself up.  他用冰冷的水洗脸让自己清醒。

iced.example: She ordered an iced tea and sat under the wide umbrella.  她点了一杯冰茶，坐在宽大的伞下。

maintain direction.example: The pilot managed to maintain direction despite the sudden crosswind.  尽管突起侧风，飞行员仍设法保持了航向。

sterling.example: The young violinist gave a sterling performance at her first concert.  这位年轻小提琴手在首场音乐会上表现出色。

first-class.example: The small college offers a first-class education at a modest price.  这所小学院以适中的价格提供一流的教育。

superlative.example: The violin showed superlative craftsmanship in every carved detail.  这把小提琴在每处雕刻细节上都显出顶级工艺。

wonderful.example: Studying abroad was a wonderful opportunity she could not refuse.  出国留学是她无法拒绝的极好机会。

swindle.example: The broker swindled elderly investors out of their life savings.  经纪人骗取老年投资者的毕生积蓄。

fiddle.example: The manager fiddled the accounts for years before anyone noticed.  那位经理做假账多年才被人察觉。

gyp.example: The taxi driver gypped us by taking a much longer route.  出租车司机绕了很远的路来骗我们钱。

bunco.example: Two men buncoed elderly residents out of their savings.  两名男子骗走了老年居民的积蓄。

flimflam.example: The whole investment plan turned out to be a slick flimflam.  整个投资计划原来是个精巧的骗局。

sybarite.example: He lived like a sybarite until his inheritance was completely gone.  他过着奢靡的生活，直到遗产挥霍一空。

debauchee.example: The novel portrays a rich debauchee who wastes his family fortune.  这部小说描写了一个挥霍家产的富有放荡者。

hedonist.example: He calls himself a hedonist who lives only for pleasure.  他称自己是只为快乐而活的享乐主义者。

sensualist.example: The poet was a sensualist who chased every fleeting delight.  这位诗人是个追逐一切短暂欢愉的耽于声色者。

sycophant.example: The king was surrounded by sycophants who praised his every word.  国王身边围着一群对他每句话都大加称赞的马屁精。

fawner.example: Every fawner at court praised the king's dreadful poetry.  宫中每个谄媚者都称赞国王糟糕的诗。

flunky.example: He sent a flunky to deliver the bad news for him.  他派了个跟屁虫替他去传坏消息。

lickspittle.example: The minister kept a circle of lickspittles who never disagreed.  那位大臣身边围着一群从不反对他的谄媚者。

apple-polisher.example: Nobody trusted the apple-polisher who praised every memo the boss wrote.  没人信任那个称赞老板每份备忘录的马屁精。

bootlicker.example: His colleagues dismissed him as a bootlicker after the promotion.  升职之后同事们都把他当谄媚者看不起。

brownnoser.example: The team resented the brownnoser who reported everything to management.  团队讨厌那个把一切都报告给管理层的马屁精。

syllabus.example: The professor handed out the course syllabus on the very first day.  教授第一天上课就发了课程大纲。

syllogism.example: The student's flawed syllogism led him to an obviously false conclusion.  学生有缺陷的三段论把他导向明显错误的结论。

symbiosis.example: Certain ants and acacia trees live in a remarkable symbiosis.  某些蚂蚁与相思树处于一种奇妙的共生关系。

unrelated growth.phrase_cn: 两物种互不相关的生长
unrelated growth.example: The fungus and the tree showed unrelated growth rather than true symbiosis.  真菌与树表现为互不相关的生长，而非真正的共生。

symmetry.example: The butterfly's wings display an almost perfect bilateral symmetry.  蝴蝶翅膀呈现近乎完美的左右对称。

coherence.example: The essay had good ideas but very little coherence between them.  这篇文章观点不错，但彼此之间缺乏连贯。

disproportion.example: There is a clear disproportion between the effort spent and the results.  投入的努力与结果之间明显不成比例。

asymmetry.example: A slight asymmetry in the design made the building feel alive.  设计上轻微的不对称让这座建筑显得有生气。

imbalance.example: The trade imbalance between the two countries widened again last year.  两国之间的贸易失衡去年再次扩大。

incoherence.example: Exhaustion reduced his report to complete incoherence by midnight.  到午夜时疲惫使他的报告变得毫无条理。

violence.example: The violence of the storm tore the harmony of the garden apart.  暴风雨的猛烈把花园的和谐撕得粉碎。

occurring at different times.phrase_cn: 发生于不同时间的事件
occurring at different times.example: The two floods, occurring at different times, were often confused.  这两次洪水发生在不同时间，却常被混为一谈。

noncontemporaneous.example: The layers proved noncontemporaneous, separated by thousands of years.  这些地层被证明并非同期，相隔数千年。

out-of-phase.cn: 不同步的，相位不一致的
out-of-phase.example: The two out-of-phase speakers cancelled much of the bass.  两个不同步的音箱抵消了大部分低音。

synergic.example: The two drugs have a synergic effect far stronger than either alone.  这两种药物的协同作用远强于单独使用任何一种。

synonymous.example: For many readers his name became synonymous with commercial success.  对许多读者来说，他的名字成了商业成功的同义词。

recapitulation.example: She closed the lecture with a brief recapitulation of three key points.  她以三个要点的简短概述结束了讲座。

roundup.example: The paper prints a weekly roundup of local sports results.  这家报纸每周刊登一次本地体育赛果综述。

analysis.example: Careful analysis of the sample revealed three unexpected compounds.  对样本的细致分析发现了三种意外的化合物。

taking apart.example: Taking apart the old clock taught him more than any textbook.  拆解那台旧钟教给他的比任何教科书都多。

tacit.example: The manager gave tacit approval by simply saying nothing at all.  经理什么也不说，等于默许了。

unexpressed.example: Her unexpressed doubts surfaced only after the contract was signed.  她未说出的疑虑直到合同签署后才浮现。

unspoken.cn: 未说出口的，心照不宣的
unspoken.example: There was an unspoken rule that nobody mentioned his first marriage.  有条不言而喻的规矩：没人提他的第一次婚姻。

unvoiced.example: Several unvoiced objections finally appeared in the written survey.  几项未说出口的反对最终出现在书面问卷中。

expressed.example: They acted against the clearly expressed wishes of the committee.  他们的行动违背了委员会明确表达的意愿。

spoken.example: A spoken promise carried little weight without anything in writing.  没有书面记录，口头承诺没什么分量。

stated.example: The stated purpose of the trip was research, not tourism.  这次出行明确宣称的目的是研究，而非旅游。

voiced.example: Openly voiced concerns forced the school to change its plan.  公开表达的担忧迫使学校改变了计划。

tight-lipped.cn: 守口如瓶的，沉默寡言的
tight-lipped.example: Officials remained tight-lipped about the cause of the delay.  官员们对延误原因始终守口如瓶。

tackle.example: The new committee will tackle a difficult problem that others avoided.  新委员会将着手处理别人回避的难题。

dive into.example: She dived into the project without waiting for further instructions.  她没等进一步指示就一头扎进了项目。

wade in.example: He waded in and started rewriting the report immediately.  他二话不说就动手重写那份报告。

tact.example: She handled the awkward question with remarkable tact and warmth.  她以极高的分寸和善意处理了这个尴尬问题。

diplomacy.example: It took real diplomacy to refuse the offer without offending anyone.  拒绝这个提议而不冒犯任何人需要真正的手腕。

clumsiness.example: His social clumsiness offended the guests within five minutes.  他社交上的笨拙五分钟内就得罪了客人。

tactile.example: Blind readers rely on the tactile sensation of raised dots.  盲人读者依靠凸点带来的触觉感受。

ill-advised.example: His ill-advised joke about her accent ruined the dinner.  他关于她口音的失当玩笑毁了这顿晚餐。

tactful.example: A tactful reply saved everyone from an awkward argument.  一个得体的回答使大家免于一场尴尬的争论。

bend.example: He tried to bend the metal rod to fit the narrow frame.  他试着把金属棒弯折，以便装进窄框。

grade.example: Trucks slow to a crawl on the steep grade past the quarry.  卡车在采石场外的陡坡上慢得像爬。

gradient.example: The path climbs at a gentle gradient all the way to the lake.  这条小路以平缓的坡度一直通到湖边。

tarnish.example: One careless scandal tarnished a reputation built over thirty years.  一次不慎的丑闻玷污了三十年建立的名声。

unspoiled.example: The island keeps an unspoiled coastline with no hotels at all.  这座岛保有一段完全没有旅馆的原始海岸线。

tamper.example: Someone had tampered with the evidence before the trial began.  开庭前有人篡改过证据。

diddle with.example: Stop diddling with the settings or you will break the camera.  别再乱动设置，不然你会把相机弄坏。

fiddle with.example: He fiddled with the radio dial until the static disappeared.  他摆弄收音机旋钮，直到杂音消失。

fool with.example: Never fool with the wiring while the power is still on.  电源没断时千万不要瞎动电线。

mess with.example: Someone messed with my files and deleted half the folder.  有人乱动我的文件，删掉了半个文件夹。

tangent.example: The speaker went off on a tangent about his childhood pets.  演讲者突然离题谈起了他童年的宠物。

touchable.example: The museum offers touchable models for visitors who cannot see.  博物馆为视障参观者提供可触摸的模型。

unable to perceive.example: Most listeners were unable to perceive any difference between the recordings.  多数听众无法察觉两份录音之间的任何差别。

tangy.example: She served the grilled fish with a tangy lemon sauce.  她给烤鱼配上味道刺激的柠檬酱。

incommensurate.example: The tiny reward was incommensurate with the years of work.  这点微薄的报酬与多年的付出不相称。

blowup.example: His blowup in the meeting shocked even his closest colleagues.  他在会上的爆发连最亲近的同事都震惊了。

pacification.example: Hours of patient pacification finally calmed the angry crowd.  数小时耐心的安抚终于让愤怒的人群平静下来。

die down.example: They waited for the wind to die down before setting sail.  他们等风渐渐减弱后才起航。

phase down.example: The country agreed to phase down coal use over ten years.  该国同意在十年内逐步减少用煤。

fall away.example: Public support fell away sharply after the scandal broke.  丑闻曝光后公众支持急剧减少。

dawdling.example: Their dawdling progress meant the report missed the deadline again.  他们拖沓的进度使报告又一次错过了截止日期。

scooting.example: A scooting squirrel crossed the path before we could raise the camera.  一只飞奔的松鼠在我们举起相机前穿过了小路。

scudding.example: Scudding clouds raced across the moon all through the night.  疾飞的云整夜掠过月亮。

whirling.example: Whirling dust hid the road from the drivers for several minutes.  飞旋的尘土让司机好几分钟看不见路。

tatty.example: He wore a tatty old coat that had lost most of its buttons.  他穿着一件掉了大半扣子的破旧外套。

dilapidated.example: They bought a dilapidated farmhouse and spent two years repairing it.  他们买了一栋破败的农舍，花了两年修复。

scruffy.example: He turned up in scruffy jeans and a torn grey sweater.  他穿着破旧的牛仔裤和一件破灰毛衣出现了。

seedy.example: They spent the night in a seedy hotel near the station.  他们在车站附近一家破旧的小旅馆过了夜。

sleazy.example: The band's first gigs were in sleazy clubs with broken lights.  乐队最初的演出是在灯坏掉的低档酒吧里。

tatterdemalion.example: A tatterdemalion figure waited silently outside the bakery door.  一个衣衫褴褛的身影默默等在面包店门外。

haze.example: Older members used to haze the new recruits for a whole week.  老成员过去会整整一周戏弄新来的成员。

heckle.example: Protesters began to heckle the speaker throughout the entire rally.  抗议者在整场集会上不断起哄质问演讲者。

needle.example: His brothers needled him about the lost game for months.  他的兄弟们拿那场败局挖苦他好几个月。

ride.example: Editors sometimes ride young reporters about every comma in their first stories.  编辑有时会为新记者初稿里的每个逗号不停挑刺。

stuffy.example: The stuffy lecture put half the audience to sleep.  那场沉闷的讲座让一半听众睡着了。

entertaining.example: She is an entertaining speaker who never reads from her notes.  她是位从不照稿念的有趣演讲者。

hang back.example: He hung back at the door, unsure whether to enter.  他在门口犹豫，不确定要不要进去。

shilly-shally.example: Stop shilly-shallying and tell us which offer you accept.  别再犹豫，告诉我们你接受哪个方案。

stabilize.example: Two ropes stabilized the ladder against the shaking wall.  两根绳子把梯子在晃动的墙上稳住了。

dive in.cn: 果断投入，毫不迟疑地开始
dive in.example: Rather than debate further, she dived in and started cooking.  她没再讨论，直接动手开始做饭。

plunge in.example: He plunged in and repaired the wiring before anyone objected.  他一头扎进去，在有人反对前就修好了线路。

teetotalism.example: His teetotalism began after watching alcohol ruin his father.  在看到酒精毁了父亲之后，他开始彻底戒酒。

intemperance.example: Years of intemperance had ruined both his health and his savings.  多年的纵饮无度毁了他的健康和积蓄。

uncompelling.cn: 没有说服力的，不吸引人的
uncompelling.example: The evidence was real but the argument remained uncompelling.  证据是真的，但论证仍然缺乏说服力。

circumspection.example: The diplomat handled the question with unusual circumspection.  这位外交官以异常谨慎的态度处理了那个问题。

cautious approach.example: The board favored a cautious approach to the risky expansion.  董事会倾向于对这项冒险扩张采取谨慎做法。

temporize.example: The minister temporized for weeks rather than announce an unpopular decision.  部长拖延数周，不愿宣布不受欢迎的决定。
temporize.cn: 拖延以争取时间；打哈哈

tenable.example: That interpretation is no longer tenable given the newly discovered letters.  鉴于新发现的信件，那种解释已站不住脚。

defendable.example: Only one of his three conclusions is really defendable.  他三个结论中只有一个真正站得住脚。

justifiable.cn: 有正当理由的，说得过去的
justifiable.example: Her anger over the broken promise was entirely justifiable.  她因承诺被违背而生气完全合乎情理。

maintainable.example: That claim is hardly maintainable once you check the original data.  一旦核对原始数据，那个主张就很难站住脚。

supportable.example: His reading of the poem is supportable but not the only one.  他对这首诗的解读有依据，但并非唯一。

sustainable.example: Without new evidence the theory is no longer sustainable.  没有新证据，这一理论已经站不住脚。

indefensible.cn: 站不住脚的，无法辩解的
indefensible.example: Cutting the safety budget was an indefensible decision.  削减安全预算是个无法辩解的决定。

insistent.example: She was insistent that every witness be interviewed again.  她坚持要求重新询问每一位证人。

persevering.example: Only a persevering student finishes such a long translation project.  只有坚持不懈的学生才能完成这样漫长的翻译项目。

negotiable.example: The salary is negotiable, but the starting date is not.  薪水可以商量，但入职日期不行。

vacillated.example: He vacillated for weeks before finally rejecting the generous offer.  他犹豫了好几周，最终拒绝了那个优厚的提议。

tendentious.example: Critics dismissed the book as a tendentious account of the revolution.  批评者认为这本书是对那场革命的偏颇叙述。

distorting.example: The headline gave a distorting picture of what she actually said.  那个标题歪曲了她实际所说的内容。

subjective.example: Beauty remains a subjective judgment no test can settle.  美始终是任何测试都无法裁定的主观判断。

bestial.example: The novel describes the bestial cruelty of the prison guards.  这部小说描写了看守们野兽般的残忍。

sadistic.example: He took a sadistic pleasure in reading out every low score.  他念出每个低分时有一种施虐般的快感。

trucu-.example: In the printed line trucu- was broken off from its ending.  在印刷的那一行里 trucu- 与它的词尾断开了。

lent.example: Here the word truculent is split into trucu- and lent.  这里 truculent 一词被拆成 trucu- 和 lent。

uncompassionate.example: His uncompassionate reply left the grieving family speechless.  他毫无同情的回答让悲痛的家人无话可说。

lukewarm.example: The proposal met a lukewarm response from the whole committee.  这项提案在整个委员会得到冷淡的回应。

halfhearted.example: His halfhearted apology satisfied nobody in the crowded room.  他不情不愿的道歉没让挤满一屋的人满意。

wholehearted.example: The plan won wholehearted support from every teacher present.  该计划得到在场每位老师的全力支持。

terminology.example: Medical terminology often confuses patients reading their own records.  医学术语常让病人看不懂自己的病历。

slang.example: The novel is full of street slang that dates it precisely.  这部小说满是街头俚语，正好标出了它的年代。

terminus.example: The old railway terminus has been converted into an art museum.  旧铁路终点站已改建成艺术博物馆。

traumatic.example: Losing his home in the fire was a deeply traumatic experience.  在那场大火中失去家园是他极为痛苦的经历。

testimony.example: Her testimony in court decided the outcome of the entire case.  她在法庭上的证词决定了整个案件的结果。

attestation.example: The notary provided written attestation of both signatures.  公证人对两个签名出具了书面证明。

documentation.example: The claim was rejected for lack of supporting documentation.  该索赔因缺少证明文件而被驳回。

substantiation.example: The rumor spread widely without a shred of substantiation.  这个谣言广为流传，却没有一丝证据支持。

testament.example: The bridge still stands, a testament to careful nineteenth-century engineering.  这座桥依然屹立，是十九世纪精心工程的明证。

validation.example: The result needs independent validation before anyone publishes it.  这个结果在发表前需要独立验证。

disproof.example: One careful experiment offered clear disproof of the old claim.  一个严谨的实验明确反驳了那个旧说法。

good humor.example: He kept his good humor even after the third flight cancellation.  即便第三次航班取消，他仍保持着好脾气。

unable to irritate.example: The lawyer's taunts were unable to irritate the patient old judge.  律师的挑衅无法惹恼那位耐心的老法官。

tear loose.example: The frightened horse tore loose from the post and ran off.  受惊的马从桩上挣脱后跑掉了。

therapeutic.example: Gardening had a surprisingly therapeutic effect on her constant anxiety.  园艺对她持续的焦虑有出乎意料的治疗效果。

curative.example: Villagers still believe the spring has curative properties.  村民们仍相信这处泉水有疗效。

officinal.example: The garden grows officinal herbs once sold in every pharmacy.  这个园子种着曾在每家药房出售的药用草药。

prickly.example: Water rights remain a prickly problem for the two provinces.  水权对这两个省来说仍是个棘手问题。

hackney.example: Advertising has hackneyed that word far beyond any real meaning.  广告已把那个词用滥到失去真正含义。

fo-.example: The line break left fo- stranded at the edge of the page.  换行使 fo- 孤零零地留在页边。

ment.example: Joining fo- and ment gives us the verb foment again.  把 fo- 和 ment 接起来又得到动词 foment。

huffy.example: He gets huffy whenever someone questions his figures.  只要有人质疑他的数据，他就生气。

tetchy.example: The tetchy old man complained about noise every single evening.  那个易怒的老头每天晚上都抱怨吵闹。

thin-skinned.cn: 敏感易怒的，受不得批评的
thin-skinned.example: He is too thin-skinned to work with such blunt editors.  他太受不得批评，无法与这样直白的编辑合作。

dodgy.example: Driving that dodgy old van across the mountains worried everyone.  开那辆靠不住的旧货车翻山让大家都担心。

tricksy.example: The exam ended with two tricksy questions about ancient trade.  考试以两道关于古代贸易的刁钻题目结束。

altercate.example: The brothers altercated over the will for the entire afternoon.  兄弟俩为遗嘱争吵了整个下午。

bicker.example: The children bickered over the last piece of cake.  孩子们为最后一块蛋糕争吵起来。

brabble.example: Two vendors brabbled loudly about a few missing coins.  两个小贩为几枚不见的硬币大声吵嚷。

bounteous.example: Their bounteous host refused to let anyone leave hungry.  他们慷慨的主人不让任何人饿着离开。

fainthearted.example: The steep coastal path is not for the fainthearted.  那条陡峭的海岸小径不适合胆小的人。

tremulous.example: She answered in a tremulous voice that barely reached the back row.  她用颤抖的声音回答，后排几乎听不见。

venturous.example: Only the most venturous sailors tried that northern route.  只有最敢冒险的水手才尝试那条北方航线。

undaring.example: Their undaring strategy lost them the whole market.  他们不敢冒险的策略使他们丢掉了整个市场。

quailing.example: The quailing recruit could not meet the sergeant's stare.  那个畏缩的新兵不敢与班长对视。

recoiling.example: Recoiling from the noise, the shy dog hid under the table.  那只胆小的狗被噪音吓得退缩到桌下。

skittish.example: The skittish horse bolted the moment it heard the sudden thunder.  那匹易受惊的马一听到突然的雷声就狂奔起来。

decolorize.example: Strong bleach decolorized the fabric within a few minutes.  强漂白剂几分钟内就使织物脱了色。

tinker.example: He spent the whole weekend tinkering with the old tractor engine.  他整个周末都在乱修那台旧拖拉机发动机。

toy with.example: He toyed with the idea of moving abroad but never applied.  他随便想过出国，却从未去申请。

twiddle with.example: She twiddled with the knobs until the picture finally cleared.  她拨弄旋钮，画面终于清晰了。

trope.example: The lonely detective has become a familiar trope in modern crime fiction.  孤独的侦探已成为现代犯罪小说里常见的套路。

groveler.example: The court was full of grovelers who feared the queen's temper.  宫廷里满是害怕女王脾气的卑躬屈膝者。

flatterer.example: A wise ruler learns to distrust every skillful flatterer.  明智的统治者学会怀疑每个精于奉承的人。

medicinal.example: The forest contains dozens of medicinal plants still used locally.  这片森林里有几十种当地仍在使用的药用植物。

salutiferous.example: Doctors once sent patients here for the salutiferous sea air.  医生曾把病人送到这里享受有益健康的海风。

insalubrious.example: The damp, insalubrious basement made both children ill.  潮湿不卫生的地下室使两个孩子都病了。

unhealthful.example: Inspectors closed the plant for unhealthful working conditions.  检查人员因工作条件有害健康而关闭了该厂。

unhealthy.example: Years of an unhealthy diet finally caught up with him.  多年不健康的饮食终于让他付出了代价。

topsyturvy.example: Since the move, our daily routine has been completely topsyturvy.  搬家以来，我们的日常作息完全乱了套。

anarchic.example: The substitute teacher faced an anarchic classroom by noon.  到中午时，那位代课老师面对的是一个乱成一团的课堂。

well-ordered.example: She kept a well-ordered household despite four small children.  尽管有四个小孩，她仍把家管理得井井有条。

asleep.example: His right foot was asleep after sitting cross-legged so long.  盘腿坐了那么久，他的右脚麻了。

benumbed.example: His benumbed fingers could not tie the frozen rope.  他冻麻的手指系不上结冰的绳子。

insensitive.example: The scarred skin was completely insensitive to heat or pain.  那块疤痕皮肤对热和疼痛完全没有感觉。

numbed.example: Numbed by the cold, she dropped the keys twice.  被冻得麻木，她两次弄掉了钥匙。

feeling.example: Only a feeling reader would notice the quiet grief in that chapter.  只有有感受力的读者才会察觉那一章里静默的悲伤。

casualness.example: He announced the layoffs with shocking casualness.  他以令人震惊的漫不经心宣布了裁员。

complacence.example: Early success bred a complacence that ruined the second album.  早期的成功滋生了自满，毁了第二张专辑。

torrential.example: Torrential rain flooded the narrow streets within half an hour.  倾盆大雨半小时内就淹了狭窄的街道。

trickling.example: By August the river was only a trickling stream over stones.  到八月，那条河只剩下石头上的一道细流。

flaming.example: The flaming afternoon sun made the empty market street unbearable.  炽热的午后阳光让空荡的集市街道令人难以忍受。

intense.example: The intense heat inside the foundry forced the workers to rest hourly.  铸造厂内的酷热迫使工人每小时休息一次。

tout.example: Advertisements tout the new drug as a cure for nearly every ailment.  广告把这种新药吹捧成几乎万能的良药。

ballyhoo.example: The film arrived with enormous ballyhoo but disappointed almost everyone.  这部电影在大肆宣传中上映，却几乎让所有人失望。

rate.example: Critics rate her early novels far above the later ones.  评论家对她早期的小说评价远高于后期作品。

revile.example: Newspapers reviled the mayor for weeks after the scandal broke.  丑闻曝光后报纸辱骂市长数周。

monkey with.example: Please stop monkeying with the thermostat every time you walk past.  别每次走过都去乱动恒温器。

tinker with.example: He spent the weekend tinkering with an old radio in the garage.  他整个周末在车库里摆弄一台旧收音机。

recalci-.example: The scanned page split the word, leaving only recalci- at the line end.  扫描页面把这个词断开，行末只剩 recalci-。

trant.example: The stray syllable trant belongs to the word recalcitrant above it.  游离的音节 trant 属于上面的 recalcitrant 一词。

unquietness.example: A strange unquietness spread through the village before the storm.  暴风雨来临前，一种奇怪的不安在村里蔓延。

transcend.example: Great music can transcend the barriers of language and national culture.  伟大的音乐能超越语言和民族文化的障碍。

outreach.example: Her ambition outreached anything her small town could offer her.  她的抱负超出了小镇能给她的一切。

outrun.example: Demand for the vaccine quickly outran the factory's output.  疫苗的需求很快超过了工厂的产量。

overreach.example: The company overreached and lost both markets within a year.  这家公司做得过头，一年内丢了两个市场。

overrun.example: The project overran its budget by nearly two million dollars.  该项目超出预算近两百万美元。

overshoot.example: The plane overshot the runway and stopped on the grass.  飞机冲过跑道，停在草地上。

overstep.example: The officer clearly overstepped his authority during the search.  这名警官在搜查中明显越权了。

surpass.example: The young violinist's performance surpassed all expectations of the judges.  这位年轻小提琴手的表现超出评委的一切预期。

metamorphose.example: The shy student metamorphosed into a confident public speaker.  那个害羞的学生蜕变成了自信的演讲者。

make over.example: They made over the attic into a bright little study.  他们把阁楼改造成了明亮的小书房。

offend.example: The advertisement offended against every rule of good taste.  这则广告违背了一切良好品味的规则。

long-lived.example: Tortoises are famously long-lived compared with most other animals.  与大多数动物相比，乌龟以长寿闻名。

manent.example: The syllables manent were cut from permanent by the page break.  分页把 permanent 切开，留下音节 manent。

unappar-.example: The line ended with unappar-, so the full word continued below.  这一行以 unappar- 结束，整个词接在下面。

ent.example: The lonely ent on the next line completes the word unapparent.  下一行孤零零的 ent 补全了 unapparent 一词。

unclarified.example: Several unclarified points in the contract worried the lawyers.  合同中几处未澄清的地方让律师担忧。

cutacross.example: We cut across the meadow to reach the station before dark.  我们横穿草地，赶在天黑前到车站。

passover.example: The trail lets hikers pass over the ridge in a single morning.  这条小径让徒步者一个上午就能越过山脊。

proceedalong.example: Visitors should proceed along the marked path to the old lighthouse.  参观者应沿标记的小路前往旧灯塔。

unloyal.example: He was branded unloyal for leaking the plan to a competitor.  他因把计划泄露给竞争对手而被视为不忠。

betraying.example: One betraying glance told the guards exactly where he was hiding.  一个出卖他的眼神让守卫知道了他的藏身处。

down-the-line.cn: 彻底忠诚的，全力支持的
down-the-line.example: She gave the new policy her down-the-line support at the meeting.  会上她对新政策给予毫无保留的支持。

trenchant.example: His trenchant remarks left the panel with nothing to add.  他一针见血的评论让评委无话可补。

trepidation.example: She opened the letter with obvious trepidation, fearing the worst news.  她带着明显的恐惧打开信，担心是最坏的消息。

fright.example: The sudden bang gave the children a terrible fright.  突然的巨响让孩子们大惊失色。

horror.example: The villagers watched in horror as the bridge collapsed.  村民惊骇地看着桥塌了下去。

boldness.example: Her boldness in questioning the director impressed the whole team.  她敢于质疑总监的胆量令全组佩服。

trespass.example: Hikers who trespass on the ranch will be fined by the county.  擅自进入这座牧场的徒步者会被县里罚款。

invade.example: Reporters invaded her privacy for months after the trial.  审判后记者数月侵犯她的隐私。

reprobation.example: His conduct drew strong reprobation from the medical board.  他的行为受到医学委员会的严厉谴责。

trickle.example: Rainwater trickled down the cracked wall all through the quiet night.  雨水整夜顺着开裂的墙壁缓缓流下。

pour.example: Water poured through the broken roof all afternoon.  整个下午水从破屋顶倾泻而下。

roll.example: The muddy river rolled past the ruined mill without stopping.  浑浊的河水滚滚流过废弃的磨坊。

stream.example: Sunlight streamed through the tall windows onto the wooden floor.  阳光从高窗涌入，洒在木地板上。

truant.example: Two truant boys were found fishing by the canal at noon.  两个逃学的男孩中午在运河边被发现钓鱼。
truant.cn: 逃学的；逃学者，逃避责任者

dutiful.example: As a dutiful assistant he never once missed a deadline.  作为尽职的助手，他从未错过一次期限。

truce.example: The two sides agreed to a truce during the harvest season.  双方同意在收获季节休战。

armistice.example: The armistice was signed in a railway carriage at dawn.  停战协定在黎明时于一节火车车厢内签署。

cease-fire.example: The cease-fire held for three days before shelling resumed.  停火维持了三天，随后炮击又开始了。

feisty.example: The feisty debater challenged every point her opponent made.  这位好斗的辩手对对手的每个论点都提出挑战。

slog.example: We slogged through wet fields for two hours to reach the farm.  我们在湿田里跋涉两小时才到农场。

waltz.example: He waltzed into the meeting late without any apology.  他迟到了还大摇大摆地走进会场，毫无歉意。

whisk.example: Guards whisked the singer away before the crowd noticed.  在人群察觉前保镖飞快把歌手带走了。

trumpet.example: The company trumpeted its record profits in every newspaper that week.  那一周公司在各家报纸上大肆宣扬其创纪录的利润。

advertise.example: They advertised the concert on every bus in the city.  他们在全城每辆公交上宣传这场音乐会。

quietude.example: She moved north seeking the quietude of a small fishing town.  她北迁，只为寻求小渔镇的宁静。

crystalline.example: The crystalline lake showed every stone on its bed.  清澈的湖水把湖底每块石头都显露出来。

turgid.example: The report's turgid style hid a very simple argument.  这份报告浮夸的文风掩盖了一个极简单的论点。

flatulent.example: His flatulent speech impressed nobody in the audience.  他浮夸的演讲没能打动任何听众。

unadorned.example: The chapel was unadorned except for one small wooden cross.  礼拜堂除一个小木十字外别无装饰。

undecorated.example: They left the nursery undecorated until the baby arrived.  婴儿出生前他们让育儿室一直素净着。

unembellished.example: He told the story in plain, unembellished language.  他用朴实无华的语言讲述了这个故事。

turbulence.example: Years of turbulence left the country's economy in ruins.  多年动荡使这个国家经济破败。

peacefulness.example: The peacefulness of the garden calmed her at once.  花园的宁静立刻让她平静下来。

quisling.example: History remembers him as a quisling who served the invaders.  历史记住他是个为侵略者效劳的叛国者。

abjection.example: The novel traces one family's slow slide into abjection.  这部小说描写一个家庭缓慢堕落的过程。

corruptness.example: Voters were disgusted by the corruptness of the whole council.  选民对整个议会的腐败深感厌恶。

decadency.example: Critics saw only decadency in the court's endless festivals.  批评者在宫廷无尽的盛宴中只看到颓废。

demoralization.example: Defeat brought demoralization to every unit on the front.  战败使前线各部队士气涣散、风纪败坏。

dissipatedness.example: His dissipatedness ruined both his health and his fortune.  他的放荡毁了他的健康和财产。

libertinism.example: The play mocks the libertinism of the fashionable set.  该剧讽刺了时髦阶层的放纵。

rakishness.example: There was a careless rakishness in the way he dressed.  他的穿着带着一种随意的浮荡气质。

typo.example: A single typo in the headline embarrassed the whole editorial staff.  标题里的一个错字让整个编辑部很尴尬。

misprint.example: The date on the ticket was a misprint, not a change of plan.  票上的日期是印错了，不是改了计划。

old hand.example: As an old hand at winter climbing, he read the weather easily.  作为冬季攀登老手，他轻松读懂了天气。

old-timer.example: The old-timers in the shop still repair watches by hand.  店里的老师傅们仍手工修表。

vet.example: The team hired a vet of three Olympic campaigns as coach.  球队聘请了一位三届奥运老将当教练。

omnipresent.example: Advertising is omnipresent in the corridors of the station.  车站走廊里广告无处不在。

irrefutable.example: The letters gave irrefutable proof of his involvement.  这些信件提供了他参与其中的铁证。

unexceptionable.cn: 无可挑剔的，无可指责的
unexceptionable.example: Her conduct throughout the inquiry was unexceptionable.  在整个调查中她的行为无可指责。

unimpeachable.cn: 无可怀疑的，无懈可击的
unimpeachable.example: The witness had an unimpeachable record of public service.  这位证人有无可指责的公职记录。

superhuman.example: Lifting the beam alone took almost superhuman strength.  单人抬起那根梁几乎需要超人的力量。

supernormal.example: The dog showed supernormal sensitivity to distant thunder.  这只狗对远处的雷声表现出超常的敏感。

transcendent.example: Her transcendent performance silenced the entire hall.  她超凡的演出让全场安静下来。

disgracious.example: His disgracious tone offended even his closest allies.  他无礼的语气连最亲近的盟友都得罪了。

ungraceful.example: The dancer's ungraceful stumble was noticed by the judges.  舞者笨拙的踉跄被评委看到了。

ill-bred.example: It was ill-bred of him to leave without thanking the host.  他不谢主人就离开，实在没教养。

uncivil.example: The clerk's uncivil answer made the customer complain.  职员粗鲁的回答让客户投诉了。

desperate.example: After the flood the families were desperate and almost without hope.  洪水过后，这些家庭走投无路，几乎毫无希望。

carry.example: Four stone pillars carry the whole weight of the roof.  四根石柱承载着整个屋顶的重量。

usher.example: The invention of the printing press ushered in a new age of learning.  印刷机的发明开启了一个学术的新时代。

italicize.example: Please italicize every foreign word in the manuscript.  请把稿件中每个外来词排成斜体。

stress.example: The coach stressed defense in every session this week.  本周每次训练教练都强调防守。

underline.example: The accident underlines the need for better street lighting.  这场事故凸显了改善街道照明的必要。

bring out.example: A little salt brings out the sweetness of the tomatoes.  少许盐能突出西红柿的甜味。

deemphasize.example: The school deemphasized rankings to reduce student anxiety.  学校淡化排名以减轻学生焦虑。

glitzy.example: The glitzy launch party cost more than the product's research.  浮华的发布派对花费超过了产品研发。

assailable.cn: 易受攻击的，站不住脚的
assailable.example: His argument proved assailable on almost every point.  他的论证几乎每一点都站不住脚。

perturbable.example: A perturbable pilot would never survive such a storm.  易慌乱的飞行员绝无法在这种风暴中生还。

shakable.example: Their loyalty turned out to be quite shakable under pressure.  压力之下他们的忠诚原来很容易动摇。

blundering.cn: 笨手笨脚的，出错百出的
blundering.example: His blundering repair left the pipe worse than before.  他笨拙的修理让水管比原来更糟。

coordinated.example: Gymnasts must be far more coordinated than most athletes.  体操运动员必须比多数运动员协调得多。

open to question.example: Whether the drug works at all remains open to question.  这种药是否有效仍有疑问。

unneat.example: His unneat handwriting cost him marks on every paper.  他不整洁的字迹让他每份考卷都扣分。

topsy-turvy.example: The movers left the whole apartment topsy-turvy.  搬运工把整套公寓弄得乱七八糟。

untutored.cn: 未受教育的，未经训练的
untutored.example: Even to an untutored ear the violin sounded out of tune.  即便没受训练的耳朵也听出小提琴走调了。

unostentatious.example: He led an unostentatious life despite owning three factories.  尽管拥有三家工厂，他生活十分低调。

educated.example: An educated reader would notice the error in the very first paragraph.  受过良好教育的读者会在第一段就发现这个错误。

schooled.example: She was schooled in law long before entering politics.  她在从政之前很久就接受过法律训练。

fastuous.example: His fastuous display of learning bored the other guests.  他浮夸地炫耀学问，让其他客人厌烦。

assuming.example: The assuming clerk corrected the professor's own citation.  那位自以为是的职员纠正了教授本人的引注。

dissimulating.example: Her dissimulating calm hid real panic about the results.  她掩饰出的镇静藏住了对结果的真正恐慌。

unflagging.example: Her unflagging enthusiasm kept the whole team going for months.  她不懈的热情支撑着整个团队坚持了数月。

indefatigable.example: She was an indefatigable campaigner for cleaner rivers.  她是为河流洁净不懈奔走的活动家。

inexhaustible.example: The children seemed to have an inexhaustible supply of questions.  孩子们的问题似乎无穷无尽。

indocile.example: The indocile colt refused every rider that season.  那匹难驯的小马那一季拒绝了所有骑手。

indomitable.cn: 不屈不挠的，不可征服的
indomitable.example: Her indomitable will carried the team through the final round.  她不屈的意志带全队走完了最后一轮。

uncontrollable.example: The fire became uncontrollable once it reached the dry pines.  火势一到干松林就无法控制了。

undisciplined.example: The undisciplined squad lost every match by wide margins.  这支散漫的队伍每场都大比分落败。

untenable.example: Once the new evidence appeared, his earlier theory became completely untenable.  新证据出现后，他先前的理论就完全站不住脚了。

incalculable.example: The flood did incalculable damage to the old town center.  洪水给老城中心造成无法估量的损失。

countless.example: Countless letters arrived after the interview was broadcast.  访谈播出后寄来了无数信件。

innumerous.example: Innumerous insects filled the air above the marsh at dusk.  黄昏时沼泽上空满是数不尽的昆虫。

uncounted.example: Uncounted villages disappeared from the maps after the war.  战后有无数村庄从地图上消失。

countable.example: The damage was small and entirely countable in a single page.  损失不大，一页纸就能全部列清。

enumerable.example: The committee faced only three enumerable choices that morning.  那天上午委员会只面对三个可逐一列举的选择。

numberable.example: Everything in the small storeroom was numberable within an hour.  小储藏室里的一切一小时内就能数清。

quantifiable.example: The scheme produced no quantifiable benefits for local families.  该方案没有给当地家庭带来可量化的收益。

calculable.example: Engineers prefer a calculable risk to an unknown one.  工程师宁要可估量的风险，也不要未知风险。

misfortunate.example: One misfortunate passenger missed both connecting trains.  一位倒霉的乘客错过了两趟接续列车。

fortunate.example: We were fortunate that the storm turned east at the last hour.  我们很幸运，风暴最后一小时转向东去。

controllable.example: Fuel use is one of the few controllable costs on the farm.  燃油是农场少数可控成本之一。

unordinary.example: Snow in October is quite unordinary in this valley.  在这个山谷，十月下雪相当不寻常。

wonted.example: The old man took his wonted place beside the stove.  老人坐到炉边他惯常的位子上。

accustomed.example: He soon grew accustomed to working through the night.  他很快习惯了通夜工作。

take over.example: A rival group took over the factory within a month.  一个竞争集团一个月内接管了这家工厂。

inexplicit.example: The inexplicit wording let both sides claim victory.  含糊的措辞让双方都宣称自己赢了。

vaccinate.example: Nurses vaccinated every child in the village against measles that week.  那一周护士为村里每个孩子接种了麻疹疫苗。

immunize.example: Nurses immunized every child in the district by June.  护士在六月前为全区儿童完成了接种。

equipoise.example: The two powers stayed in uneasy equipoise for a decade.  两大势力维持了十年不安的均势。

moronic.example: Driving without lights at night was simply moronic.  夜里不开灯行车实在愚蠢。

vagary.example: Small farmers still suffer from the vagaries of weather and market prices.  小农户仍受天气与市场价格无常变化之苦。

vagrancy.example: The vagrancy of his thoughts made the long lecture hard to follow.  他思绪的游移不定让这场长讲座难以跟上。

whimsy.example: The garden's stone frogs add a note of whimsy.  花园里的石蛙添了一点奇趣。

foggy.example: My memory of that evening is still rather foggy.  我对那晚的记忆仍相当模糊。

misty.example: The misty hills beyond the lake looked almost unreal.  湖那边朦胧的山丘看着近乎不真实。

valediction.example: The old teacher offered a brief valediction and left the crowded hall.  老教师说了简短的告别词，便离开了拥挤的礼堂。

abreast.example: She reads three newspapers daily to keep abreast of political developments.  她每天读三份报纸，以便及时了解政治动态。

practiced.example: With practiced ease she filleted the fish in seconds.  她熟练自如，几秒钟就把鱼剔了骨。

professed.example: The professed authority could not answer a basic question.  这位自称的权威连基本问题都答不上。

tasteless.example: The hospital food was warm but completely tasteless.  医院的饭是热的，却全然无味。

rainbow.example: A rainbow of umbrellas filled the square during the rain.  雨中广场上满是五彩缤纷的雨伞。

varnish.example: The official tried to varnish the truth about the failed project.  那位官员试图粉饰这个失败项目的真相。

sugarcoat.example: The doctor refused to sugarcoat the test results.  医生不愿粉饰检查结果。

valorize.example: The museum's new exhibit valorizes the crafts of ordinary village women.  博物馆的新展览推崇普通乡村妇女的手工技艺。

boast.example: He boasted about the deal long before it was signed.  合同还没签他就开始吹嘘这笔交易。

venal.example: A venal official can be bought with a surprisingly modest bribe.  一个贪污受贿的官员用很少的钱就能买通。

bribable.example: Smugglers relied on a few bribable guards at the border.  走私者靠边境上几个会受贿的守卫。

corruptible.example: Any system run by corruptible clerks will fail eventually.  由易腐化的职员运行的制度终将失败。

purchasable.example: In that court every verdict seemed purchasable.  在那个法庭上似乎每份判决都能买到。

incorruptible.example: The city needed an incorruptible auditor more than new laws.  这座城市比起新法更需要一位廉洁的审计员。

vendor.example: A street vendor sold hot noodles outside the station every evening.  每天傍晚都有个街头小贩在车站外卖热面条。

dealer.example: The dealer offered a discount if we paid in cash.  经销商说现金付款可以打折。

merchandiser.example: The merchandiser rearranged the shelves before the sale began.  促销开始前销售商重新摆放了货架。

retailer.example: The retailer stopped stocking the brand after months of complaints.  投诉数月后零售商停售了这个品牌。

seller.example: The seller accepted our offer on the very first day.  卖主第一天就接受了我们的报价。

trader.example: Traders shouted prices across the crowded fish market.  商贩们在拥挤的鱼市上高声叫价。

buyer.example: They finally found a buyer for the empty warehouse.  他们终于为那座空仓库找到了买主。

consumer.example: Consumers switched to cheaper brands as prices climbed.  随着物价上涨，消费者转向更便宜的品牌。

purchaser.example: The warranty covers only the first purchaser of the device.  保修只覆盖该设备的首位购买者。

venial.example: Arriving five minutes late was a venial fault in her eyes.  在她看来，迟到五分钟是可以宽恕的小过失。

condonable.example: Lateness is condonable, but lying about it is not.  迟到可以宽恕，但为此说谎不行。

excusable.example: A slip on the first day is entirely excusable.  第一天出点差错完全可以原谅。

forgivable.example: Forgetting one name at such a party is forgivable.  在这种聚会上忘记一个名字是可以宽恕的。

pardonable.example: She showed a pardonable pride in her daughter's work.  她对女儿的作品流露出情有可原的自豪。

remissible.example: The fine was remissible if he attended the safety course.  只要他上安全课，罚款便可免除。

remittable.example: Only part of the interest was remittable under the new rule.  按新规定只有部分利息可以减免。

inexcusable.example: Leaving the child alone in the car was inexcusable.  把孩子单独留在车里不可原谅。

unforgivable.example: To her, hiding the diagnosis was unforgivable.  对她来说，隐瞒诊断结果不可宽恕。

unpardonable.example: His remark about her family was unpardonable.  他对她家人的那番话不可饶恕。

despite.example: He damaged the painting out of pure despite for its owner.  他纯出恶意，损坏了那幅画。

malevolence.example: There was open malevolence in the anonymous letters.  那些匿名信里满是公然的恶意。

maliciousness.example: The maliciousness of the rumor shocked even her critics.  谣言之恶毒连她的批评者都震惊。

malignance.example: Behind the polite words lay real malignance.  礼貌措辞背后藏着真正的狠毒。

malignity.example: He pursued the lawsuit with astonishing malignity.  他以惊人的恶毒不断打这场官司。

meanness.example: The meanness of his joke silenced the whole table.  他玩笑的刻薄让整桌人沉默了。

nastiness.example: The nastiness in the comments forced her offline for weeks.  评论中的恶意让她数周不敢上网。

viciousness.example: Neighbors were stunned by the viciousness of the quarrel.  邻居们对这场争吵的凶狠感到震惊。

prevaricating.example: The prevaricating official finally admitted the file existed.  那位支吾其词的官员终于承认文件存在。

verbatim.example: The clerk copied the confession verbatim into the official record.  书记员把供词一字不差地抄进了正式记录。

ad verbum.example: The clerk copied the oath ad verbum into the register.  书记员把誓词逐字抄进登记簿。

directly.example: She answered directly instead of repeating the official line.  她如实作答，而不是重复官方说法。

exactly.example: Repeat exactly what the caller said, word for word.  把来电者的话一字不差地重复一遍。

word for word.example: The child recited the poem word for word without a pause.  孩子一字不差地背完了那首诗，没有停顿。

inaccurately.example: The figures were inaccurately copied from the original survey.  这些数字是从原始调查中不准确地抄来的。

inexactly.example: The term was inexactly rendered in the English edition.  这个术语在英文版中翻译得不够确切。

grown.example: Fully grown trees now shade the whole southern side of the house.  长成的大树如今为房子南侧全部遮上了阴凉。

leafy.example: They walked along a leafy lane toward the old church.  他们沿着绿荫小路走向古教堂。

overgrown.example: The path was overgrown after two summers of neglect.  疏于打理两个夏天后，小路已杂草丛生。

leafless.example: Leafless poplars lined the road all through February.  整个二月路边都是光秃的白杨。

verisimilar.example: The novel gives a verisimilar account of daily life in wartime.  这部小说对战时日常生活作了似乎真实的描述。

implausible.example: His account of the missing keys sounded wholly implausible.  他对钥匙丢失的说法听来全然不可信。

cute.example: The children thought the muddy little dog was cute.  孩子们觉得那只满身泥的小狗很可爱。

vernacular.example: He wrote his plays in the vernacular rather than in formal Latin.  他用方言而非正式的拉丁语写作剧本。

conversational.example: Our conversational host kept every guest talking until well past midnight.  我们健谈的主人让每位客人一直聊到午夜之后。

nonliterary.example: Dictionaries now record many nonliterary spoken forms.  词典现在收录了许多非文学的口语形式。

bookish.example: His bookish vocabulary sounded odd in a casual chat.  他书卷气的用词在闲聊中显得别扭。

formal.example: Use formal language when writing to the committee.  给委员会写信时要用正式语言。

literary.example: The word survives only in literary contexts today.  这个词今天只存在于文学语境中。

versatile.example: A versatile performer, she sings, dances, and plays three instruments.  作为多才多艺的表演者，她能唱歌、跳舞并演奏三种乐器。

ambidextrous.cn: 双手同利的；多才多艺的
ambidextrous.example: Being ambidextrous let him write while holding the phone.  双手同样灵巧让他能一边打电话一边写字。

verse.example: Years abroad versed him thoroughly in the customs of that region.  多年的海外生活使他十分熟悉那个地区的风俗。

ballad.example: The fisherman sang a ballad his grandfather had taught him.  渔夫唱起祖父教他的一首民谣。

poetry.example: She read modern poetry aloud every Sunday evening.  每个周日傍晚她都朗读现代诗。

song.example: The whole hall joined in the final song.  全场一起唱起了最后一首歌。

misinform.example: Someone misinformed us about the museum's closing time last Saturday.  上周六有人把博物馆的关门时间告错了我们。

mislead.example: The chart was designed to mislead careless readers.  这张图表意在误导不细心的读者。

vertigo.example: Standing near the glass wall gave him a sudden attack of vertigo.  站在玻璃墙边让他突然一阵眩晕。

dizziness.example: Standing up too fast caused a wave of dizziness.  起身太快引起一阵头晕。

giddiness.example: The heat and noise together brought on real giddiness.  高温加噪音让人真的眩晕起来。

liveliness.example: The liveliness of the class surprised the visiting teacher.  班上的活力让来访的老师惊讶。

vibrancy.example: New cafes restored some vibrancy to the old harbor.  新开的咖啡馆让老码头恢复了些活力。

vigorousness.example: At eighty he kept a vigorousness that shamed younger men.  八十岁的他仍精力充沛，让年轻人自愧不如。

venue.example: Organizers changed the venue after the hall roof began to leak.  礼堂屋顶开始漏水后，组织者更换了场地。

locale location.example: The crew chose a quiet locale location beside the river.  剧组选了河边一处安静的地点。

locus.example: The port became the locus of all regional trade.  港口成了整个区域贸易的中心。

position.example: The tent was pitched in an exposed position on the ridge.  帐篷搭在山脊上一处暴露的位置。

site.example: Archaeologists mapped the site before any digging began.  开挖之前考古学家先测绘了这处场址。

vestige.example: Only a vestige of the ancient wall remains beside the modern road.  现代公路旁只剩下古城墙的一点遗迹。

ghost.example: Only the ghost of the old inscription remained on the stone.  石上只剩下旧铭文的一点残痕。

relic.example: The wooden wheel is a relic of the village's first mill.  这个木轮是村里第一座磨坊的遗物。

residual.example: Residual damp in the wall ruined the new plaster.  墙里残存的湿气毁了新抹的灰。

undeveloped.example: Much of the island remains undeveloped and hard to reach.  岛上大部分地区仍未开发，难以到达。

matured.example: The matured wine sold for four times the price of new bottles.  熟成的酒卖出了新酒四倍的价钱。

ripened.example: Ripened peaches filled the crates by early August.  八月初板条箱里装满了熟透的桃子。

vocation.example: He was lucky to choose a vocation that matched his hobby.  他很幸运，选择了与自己爱好一致的职业。

calling.example: Teaching was a calling for her, not merely a job.  教书对她是使命，而不只是工作。

employment.example: He found employment at the shipyard within a week.  他一周内在船厂找到了工作。

occupation.example: Her occupation was listed simply as engineer.  她的职业只写作工程师。

profession.example: Law was the only profession his family respected.  法律是他家中唯一看重的职业。

hobby.example: Woodworking started as a hobby and became his living.  木工起初是爱好，后来成了他的生计。

warhorse.example: The party sent in an old warhorse to steady the campaign.  该党派了一位老将来稳住选战。

colt.example: The team's colts learned fast under the veteran captain.  在老队长带领下队里的新手学得很快。

tenderfoot.example: As a tenderfoot he packed twice the gear he needed.  作为新手，他带了两倍于所需的装备。

blackball.example: Two members blackballed him at the club election.  俱乐部选举中两名成员投票否决了他。

kill.example: The senate killed the bill on its second reading.  参议院在二读时否决了这项议案。

viable.example: Solar power is now a viable alternative for many remote villages.  太阳能如今对许多偏远村庄是可行的替代方案。

achievable.example: Set achievable targets for the first three months.  为头三个月设定可实现的目标。

attainable.example: The new grade is attainable with steady weekly practice.  只要每周稳定练习，新等级是可以达到的。

doable.example: Finishing by Friday is doable if two more join us.  再来两人的话周五完工是做得到的。

feasible.example: Engineers judged the tunnel feasible but very costly.  工程师认为隧道可行，但造价极高。

practicable.example: Repairs must begin as soon as it is practicable.  一旦条件允许就必须开始维修。

realizable.example: With a scholarship her plan became realizable at last.  有了奖学金她的计划终于可以实现。

workable.example: They reached a workable arrangement about the shared yard.  他们就共用院子达成了可行的安排。

impossible.example: Repairing the roof in one day proved impossible.  一天修好屋顶最终证明不可能。

impracticable.example: The plan was impracticable without a second bridge.  没有第二座桥这个计划行不通。

infeasible.example: The deadline made the whole design infeasible.  这个期限使整个设计变得不可行。

unattainable.example: Perfect fairness may be an unattainable ideal.  完全的公平也许是无法达到的理想。

unviable.example: Rising rents made the little bookshop unviable.  房租上涨让这家小书店难以维持。

unworkable.example: Staff called the new schedule completely unworkable.  员工称新排班表完全行不通。

vicarious.example: Parents often take vicarious pleasure in their children's small victories.  父母常从孩子的小胜利中获得间接的快乐。

surrogate.example: The kindly neighbor became a surrogate parent to the orphaned twins.  好心的邻居成了这对孤儿双胞胎的代理家长。

firsthand.example: She reported the flood firsthand from the riverbank.  她在河岸边作了洪水的第一手报道。

barbaric.example: The treatment of prisoners there was frankly barbaric.  那里对囚犯的待遇坦白说是野蛮的。

butcherly.example: Witnesses described the raid as butcherly and senseless.  证人称这次袭击残忍且毫无意义。

vicissitude.example: Her memoir traces the vicissitudes of one family across three centuries.  她的回忆录追述了一个家族三百年的兴衰变迁。

fluctuation.example: Sharp fluctuations in demand ruined the small supplier.  需求剧烈波动毁了这家小供应商。

mutation.example: The language shows a slow mutation over four centuries.  这门语言在四个世纪中缓慢变化。

uniformity.example: The new houses had a depressing uniformity of design.  这些新房子设计一致得令人压抑。

victimize.example: Fraudulent callers often victimize elderly buyers who trust strangers easily.  诈骗电话常欺骗那些容易相信陌生人的老年买家。

defraud.example: He defrauded dozens of families of their savings.  他骗走了数十个家庭的积蓄。

disillusion.example: The leaked memo disillusioned even loyal employees.  泄露的备忘录让连忠诚的员工都幻想破灭。

observant.example: An observant guard noticed the broken lock before the thieves could return.  一名警觉的守卫在窃贼返回前注意到了被弄坏的锁。
observant.cn: 警觉的；严格遵守规章的

watchful.example: The children played under their grandmother's watchful eye.  孩子们在祖母警惕的注视下玩耍。

vignette.example: The memoir opens with a charming vignette of childhood in Paris.  回忆录以一段迷人的巴黎童年小品文开篇。

definition.example: The essay offers a vivid definition of small-town boredom.  这篇文章生动地界定了小镇的无聊。

delineation.example: Her delineation of the old teacher is unforgettable.  她对那位老教师的刻画令人难忘。

depiction.example: The novel's depiction of factory work feels entirely true.  小说对工厂劳作的描写十分真实。

portrait.example: The book is a warm portrait of his grandmother.  这本书是对他祖母的温情写照。

portraiture.example: His portraiture of country priests filled three volumes.  他对乡村神父的描写写满了三卷。

portrayal.example: Her portrayal of the widow won a national prize.  她对那位寡妇的刻画获得了全国奖项。

rendering.example: The film's rendering of the trial was surprisingly exact.  影片对审判的表现出人意料地准确。

sketch.example: He wrote a short sketch of each neighbor on the street.  他为街上每位邻居写了一篇小品。

vindictive.example: His vindictive lawsuit was clearly meant to punish a former partner.  他这场怀恨的诉讼显然是为了报复旧日的合作伙伴。

avenging.example: He returned like an avenging figure from an old play.  他归来时像旧剧里复仇的角色。

retaliatory.example: The country imposed retaliatory tariffs on farm goods.  该国对农产品加征了报复性关税。

revengeful.example: Losing the case left him bitter and revengeful.  败诉让他既苦涩又充满报复心。

vengeful.example: The vengeful neighbor cut down their shared hedge.  怀恨报复的邻居砍掉了两家共用的树篱。

forgiving.example: She was more forgiving than anyone expected her to be.  她比所有人预期的都更宽容。

wizard.example: The team's wizard with numbers spotted the error instantly.  队里的数字高手一眼就看出了错误。

unrighteous.example: The sermon warned against unrighteous profit.  布道警告人们不要取不义之财。

wrong.example: Everyone agreed the decision was simply wrong.  所有人都认为那个决定根本就是错的。

poisonous.example: Children were warned about the poisonous berries by the fence.  孩子们被告知篱笆边的浆果有毒。

venomous.example: Only two venomous snakes live on the whole island.  整个岛上只有两种毒蛇。

clingy.example: The clingy mud held our boots at every step.  黏稠的泥每走一步都拽住我们的靴子。

viscous.example: The viscous liquid moved slowly down the inside of the jar.  这种粘稠的液体在罐子内壁上缓慢流下。

syrup.example: The syrup poured slowly over the warm pancakes.  糖浆缓缓浇在温热的薄饼上。

watery.example: The stew turned watery after he added too much broth.  他加汤太多，炖菜变得很稀。

idealistic.example: Their idealistic plan ignored every practical cost.  他们理想主义的计划忽略了一切实际成本。

pragmatic.example: A pragmatic manager focuses on what works rather than on elegant theories.  务实的管理者关注什么有效，而不是漂亮的理论。

rebuild.example: Volunteers helped rebuild the school after the flood.  志愿者帮助在洪水后重建学校。

biting.example: His biting review ended the young author's confidence.  他尖刻的评论摧毁了那位年轻作者的信心。

nonabrasive.example: She gave the criticism in a nonabrasive, friendly tone.  她以温和友善的语气提出批评。

zippy.example: The zippy opening number woke the sleepy audience.  活泼的开场曲唤醒了昏昏欲睡的观众。

yowling.example: Yowling cats kept the whole street awake till dawn.  嚎叫的猫让整条街到天亮都睡不着。

volition.example: He resigned of his own volition, without pressure from the board.  他出于自己的意愿辞职，并未受到董事会的压力。

choice.example: She made the choice without consulting her family.  她没和家人商量就作了这个选择。

decision.example: The decision to sell the farm was entirely his own.  卖掉农场的决定完全是他自己作的。

will.example: No one may be held here against his will.  任何人不得被违背意愿地留在此处。

coercion.example: The confession was obtained by clear coercion.  这份供词明显是靠胁迫取得的。

compulsion.example: He signed under compulsion and later withdrew consent.  他在强迫下签字，后来撤回了同意。

pressure.example: Under pressure from lenders the family sold the land.  在债权人的压力下这家人卖掉了土地。

oversize.example: He arrived in an oversize jacket borrowed from his brother.  他穿着从哥哥那借来的特大号夹克来了。

voluptuous.example: He abandoned his studies for a voluptuous life of parties and wine.  他放弃学业，过上了纵情享乐、酒会不断的生活。

epicurean.cn: 享乐的，讲究口腹之欲的
epicurean.example: His epicurean tastes made every dinner an expensive event.  他讲究享乐的口味让每顿晚餐都花费不菲。

sensuous.example: The poem dwells on the sensuous detail of ripe fruit.  这首诗沉溺于熟果的感官细节。

edacious.example: The edacious puppy emptied both bowls in a minute.  贪吃的小狗一分钟就吃空了两个碗。

esurient.example: Esurient travelers cleared the table before the host sat.  饥饿的旅客在主人坐下前就吃光了满桌菜。

gluttonous.example: The emperor's gluttonous feasts lasted for several days.  皇帝暴食的宴席持续了好几天。

swinish.example: His swinish manners at table disgusted the other diners.  他餐桌上粗鄙的吃相让同桌人反感。

hungry.example: The workers came back hungry after ten hours outside.  工人们在外干了十小时，回来时饥肠辘辘。

ravenous.example: After the long hike the boys had a ravenous appetite for anything.  长途徒步之后，男孩们对任何食物都胃口极大。

fan.example: Thousands of fans waited outside the stadium all night.  数千名球迷在球场外等了整夜。

vouch.example: Two former employers agreed to vouch for his honesty and skill.  两位前雇主同意为他的诚实和能力担保。

guarantee.example: The maker guarantees every part for three full years.  厂商为每个部件提供整三年保证。

testify.example: Two neighbors agreed to testify about the noise.  两位邻居同意就噪音一事作证。

protected.example: The nesting birds are protected by law in this park.  这个公园里筑巢的鸟受法律保护。

shielded.example: The heir was shielded from every hardship throughout his childhood.  这位继承人整个童年都被保护得远离一切艰辛。

waft.example: The smell of fresh bread wafted through the open kitchen window.  新鲜面包的香味从敞开的厨房窗户飘荡进来。

hang.cn: 悬挂；（烟雾、气味）弥漫不散
hang.example: A smell of jasmine hung in the warm evening air.  茉莉的香味弥漫在温暖的夜风里。

hover.example: A hummingbird hovered in front of the red feeder for several seconds.  一只蜂鸟在红色喂食器前悬停了几秒。

raft.example: The mayor announced a raft of new measures to reduce traffic.  市长宣布了一大批缓解交通的新措施。

wag.example: The old dog wagged its tail whenever the children came home.  孩子们回家时，那只老狗总会摇尾巴。

swish.example: The horse swished its tail to drive the flies away.  马甩动尾巴驱赶苍蝇。

switch.example: The cat switched its tail before pouncing on the toy.  猫在扑向玩具前猛甩尾巴。

waggle.example: He waggled his eyebrows to show that he was only joking.  他挑动眉毛表示自己只是在开玩笑。

livid.cn: 铁青的，青灰色的；暴怒的
livid.example: Her face turned livid when she finally heard the news.  听到消息时她的脸色变得铁青。

lurid.example: The newspaper printed lurid details that upset the victim's family deeply.  报纸刊登了骇人的细节，令受害者家人深感不安。

sickly.example: He had a sickly complexion after weeks shut indoors.  在室内闷了几周后他面色病态苍白。

red.example: The cold wind left her cheeks red and glowing.  冷风让她的双颊红润有光。
