warble.example: A thrush warbled softly in the hedge just after first light.  天刚亮，一只画眉在树篱中柔和地鸣唱。

quaver.example: Her voice quavered as she read the letter aloud.  她朗读那封信时声音发颤。

trill.example: A lark trilled somewhere above the quiet meadow.  一只云雀在静谧的草地上方啼鸣。

snow-.example: The snow-capped ridge glowed pink at sunrise.  日出时白雪覆顶的山脊泛着粉色。

ball.example: The moon hung like a pale ball above the rooftops.  月亮像一个苍白的圆球挂在屋顶上方。

wanting.example: The bridge was tested and found wanting in several important respects.  这座桥经过检测，在几个重要方面被发现有欠缺。

lacking.example: The plan was lacking in detail and had to be revised.  这个计划缺少细节，必须修改。

nonexistent.example: Public transport in that village is virtually nonexistent.  那个村子几乎没有公共交通。

dissatisfactory.example: The committee called the report dissatisfactory and demanded revisions.  委员会称该报告不令人满意，要求修改。

unacceptable.example: Such rudeness to customers is completely unacceptable here.  对顾客如此无礼在这里完全不可接受。

unsatisfactory.example: His unsatisfactory explanation only raised more questions.  他不令人满意的解释只带来了更多疑问。

adequate.example: The room was small but adequate for two students.  房间不大，但对两名学生来说足够了。

warmonger.example: Opposition papers branded the new minister a reckless warmonger.  反对派报纸把这位新部长称为轻率的好战分子。

unguarded.example: In an unguarded moment he revealed the whole plan.  在毫无防备的一刻他说出了整个计划。

watershed.example: That election was a watershed in the history of the republic.  那次选举是这个共和国历史上的分水岭。

corner.example: The economy has finally turned the corner after two hard years.  经过两年艰难时期，经济终于出现转机。

event.example: The fall of the wall was a defining event of the century.  那道墙的倒塌是该世纪的决定性事件。

landmark.example: The court's landmark ruling changed employment law forever.  法院里程碑式的裁决永久改变了劳动法。

milestone.example: Her first solo exhibition was a milestone in her career.  她的首次个展是她职业生涯的里程碑。

waylay.example: Bandits used to waylay travelers on that narrow mountain road.  过去土匪常在那条狭窄的山路上伏击旅人。

require.example: The court required him to apologize to her in public.  法院责令他向她公开道歉。

bestir.example: He finally bestirred himself and began clearing the garage.  他终于振作起来，开始清理车库。

winnow.example: The committee will winnow the applicants down to five finalists.  委员会将把申请者筛选到只剩五名入围者。

whimsical.example: His whimsical changes of plan exhausted everyone on the small team.  他反复无常的计划变动让小团队里的每个人都疲惫不堪。

freakish.example: Freakish weather ruined the harvest across the whole valley.  反常的天气毁掉了整个山谷的收成。

recuperative.example: The mountain air had a wonderfully recuperative effect on her.  山间空气对她有极好的恢复作用。

iniquitous.example: They fought against an iniquitous system of forced labor.  他们抗争一种邪恶的强迫劳动制度。

quiver.example: Her lip quivered but she refused to cry.  她的嘴唇颤抖，但她拒绝哭。

tremble.example: His hands trembled as he opened the sealed envelope.  他打开密封信封时双手发抖。

windbag.example: The meeting dragged on because a pompous old windbag kept talking.  会议拖延不散，因为一个自负的老话痨一直在讲。

babbler.example: The talk show host was a cheerful babbler who never paused.  那位脱口秀主持人是个从不停口的快活话痨。

conversationalist.example: Her uncle was a brilliant conversationalist at every dinner party.  她的叔叔在每次晚宴上都是出色的健谈者。

gabbler.example: The nervous gabbler filled every silence with pointless chatter.  那个紧张的话痨用无意义的闲谈填满每段沉默。

gasbag.example: Voters dismissed the candidate as a gasbag with no real plan.  选民认为这位候选人是个没有实际计划的空谈者。

prattler.example: The child was a happy prattler from the moment she woke.  这孩子从醒来那刻起就唠叨不停。

adorable.example: Their adorable puppy won over everyone in the office.  他们可爱的小狗赢得了办公室所有人的喜爱。

winning.example: She greeted every guest with a winning smile.  她用迷人的笑容迎接每位客人。

hateful.example: He apologized for the hateful remark he had posted online.  他为自己在网上发的可憎言论道歉。

astuteness.example: Her astuteness in negotiations saved the company millions.  她在谈判中的精明为公司节省了数百万。

foxiness.example: The old trader's foxiness kept him ahead of his rivals.  这位老商人的狡猾使他始终领先对手。

intelligence.example: Her keen intelligence showed in every answer she gave.  她敏锐的才智体现在她的每个回答中。

perspicacity.example: The critic was praised for the perspicacity of her essays.  这位评论家因文章的洞察力受到赞扬。

sagacity.example: The old judge was known for his sagacity and calm.  这位老法官以睿智和沉稳闻名。

sharpness.example: Age had not dulled the sharpness of his mind.  年龄并未使他思维的敏锐减退。

brainlessness.example: The brainlessness of the plan was obvious to everyone present.  这个计划的愚蠢在场所有人都看得出。

fatuity.example: Critics mocked the fatuity of the government's latest promises.  批评者嘲笑政府最新承诺的愚昧。

lunacy.cn: 极其愚蠢的行为；精神失常
lunacy.example: Driving through that storm would have been sheer lunacy.  在那场暴风雨中开车纯属荒唐。

fall back.example: The troops had to fall back when their ammunition ran out.  弹药耗尽时部队不得不撤退。

wizen.example: The apples wizened in the cellar over the long winter.  苹果在地窖里经过漫长的冬天变得干瘪。

mummify.example: Priests mummified the king's body before the long burial rites.  祭司在漫长的葬礼前将国王遗体制成木乃伊。

faded.example: The faded curtains had hung in that window for thirty years.  那些褪色的窗帘在那扇窗上挂了三十年。

withered.example: Withered leaves crunched under our boots along the path.  枯叶在我们靴下的小路上嘎吱作响。

benediction.example: The rain after the long drought was a benediction for local farmers.  久旱之后的这场雨是当地农民的恩赐。

disasterbane.example: The failed merger became an utter disasterbane for the little town.  失败的并购成了那座小城的彻底灾祸。

argue.example: They argued over money for most of the evening.  他们为钱争吵了大半个晚上。

bick-.example: The two brothers would bick- and quarrel all afternoon.  两兄弟会整个下午争吵不休。

er.example: He answered with a hesitant er and then fell silent.  他犹豫地「呃」了一声，然后沉默了。

low-grade.example: The builder used low-grade materials in order to cut costs.  建筑商为压缩成本使用了劣质材料。

rubbishy.example: He wasted the whole summer reading rubbishy detective novels.  他浪费了整个夏天读毫无价值的侦探小说。

trashy.example: She admitted enjoying trashy magazines on long flights.  她承认在长途航班上喜欢看低劣杂志。

first-rate.example: The orchestra gave a first-rate performance of the new symphony.  乐团为这部新交响曲献上了一流的演出。

high-grade.example: The bridge was built from high-grade steel imported from Japan.  这座桥用从日本进口的优质钢材建造。

glad.example: I am always glad to help a neighbor in trouble.  我总是乐意帮助有困难的邻居。

wry.example: He gave a wry smile and admitted his own mistake.  他苦笑一下，承认了自己的错误。
wry.cn: （笑容）苦涩讽刺的；坚持错误的

wrongheaded.cn: 固执错误的，判断有误的
wrongheaded.example: Economists called the new tax a wrongheaded policy from the start.  经济学家从一开始就称这项新税是错误政策。

xenophobe.example: The candidate's speech pleased no one except a few noisy xenophobes.  候选人的演讲除了几个喧闹的仇外者外，谁都不满意。

xenomania.example: The essay criticized the xenomania of the country's young elite.  文章批评了该国年轻精英的媚外倾向。

extremist.example: The group expelled one extremist who openly advocated violence.  该团体开除了一名公开主张暴力的极端分子。

zesty.example: A zesty tomato sauce made the plain noodles taste much better.  一份味浓的番茄酱让清淡的面条好吃了许多。

peppery.example: The peppery stew made everyone at the table reach for water.  辛辣的炖菜让桌上每个人都去拿水。

salty.example: The salty sea air stung our faces out on the pier.  带咸味的海风刺痛了我们在码头上的脸。

spicy.example: We ordered spicy noodles and regretted it within a few minutes.  我们点了辣味面条，几分钟后就后悔了。

zingy.example: She added lime juice for a zingy finish to the salad.  她加了青柠汁，给沙拉带来爽口的收尾。

zestless.example: The zestless performance left the audience checking their watches.  乏味的表演让观众不停看表。

affiliate.example: The clinic chose to affiliate with a large teaching hospital.  这家诊所选择隶属于一所大型教学医院。

appendix.example: The full data set appears in the appendix at the back.  完整数据见书后附录。

appurtenance.example: He clearly enjoyed all the appurtenances of high office.  他显然享受着高位带来的一切附属特权。

salute.example: The mayor saluted the firefighters for their courage that night.  市长向消防员那晚的勇气致敬。

crusader.example: She became a tireless crusader for clean drinking water.  她成了不懈倡导清洁饮水的斗士。

accordance.example: All payments were made in accordance with the signed contract.  所有付款均依照已签合同进行。

congruence.example: There was little congruence between his words and his actions.  他的言语和行为几乎不一致。

congruity.example: The garden showed a pleasing congruity of color and form.  这座花园显示出色彩与形式的协调。

tune.example: His proposals are in tune with what most voters want.  他的提案与大多数选民的意愿一致。

sort.example: Such rudeness does not sort with her usual kindness.  这种无礼与她平日的善良并不相符。

vest.example: The constitution vests final authority in the highest court.  宪法将最终权力授予最高法院。

vouchsafe.example: The minister finally vouchsafed an answer to the waiting reporters.  部长终于给等候的记者一个答复。

incongruence.example: The report noted a clear incongruence between policy and practice.  报告指出政策与实践之间明显不一致。

incongruousness.example: Everyone smiled at the incongruousness of his formal suit and sandals.  他正装配凉鞋的不协调让所有人发笑。

wont.example: He rose at five, as was his wont in the summer.  他五点起床，这是他夏天的习惯。

wean.example: The clinic gradually weaned him off sugary drinks.  诊所逐步让他戒掉了含糖饮料。

capture.example: The startup captured a large share of the market within a year.  这家初创公司一年内夺取了很大市场份额。

draw.example: We drew useful lessons from the failed experiment.  我们从失败的实验中获得了有用的教训。

obtain.example: You must obtain a permit before cutting down any trees.  砍伐任何树木前你必须取得许可证。

realize.example: They realized a modest profit on the sale of the land.  他们在出售那块地时获得了不多的利润。

reap.example: Patient investors will eventually reap the benefits of the reform.  有耐心的投资者最终会获得改革的好处。

grabby.example: Locals accused the grabby developers of seizing public land.  当地人指责贪婪的开发商侵占公地。

misadventure.example: The coroner recorded the death as pure misadventure.  验尸官将该死亡记录为纯属意外。

fluke.example: Winning that first match was a complete fluke.  赢下第一场比赛完全是侥幸。

mannerism.example: His nervous mannerisms distracted the whole audience.  他紧张的小动作让全场观众分神。

genuineness.example: No one in the room doubted the genuineness of her concern.  屋里没人怀疑她关心的真诚。

innocence.example: She spoke with a childlike innocence that disarmed everyone.  她说话时的孩童般天真让所有人放下戒心。

naivety.example: His political naivety eventually cost him the election.  他政治上的幼稚最终使他输掉了选举。

contend.phrase: contend that the claim is false
contend.example: The lawyer contended that the evidence had been obtained illegally.  律师声称这些证据是非法取得的。

affix.example: Please affix a stamp to the corner of the envelope before mailing it.  寄出之前请在信封角上贴一张邮票。

attach.example: Please attach a label to each box before shipping it.  发货前请在每个箱子上贴标签。

undo.example: He undid the buttons of his heavy coat and sat down.  他解开厚外套的纽扣坐了下来。

unfasten.example: Passengers may unfasten their seat belts once the plane lands.  飞机着陆后乘客可以解开安全带。

unhook.example: He unhooked the trailer and drove away without a word.  他解开拖车挂钩，一句话没说就开走了。

agony.example: She lay in agony on the floor until the ambulance arrived.  她在地上极度痛苦地躺着直到救护车到来。

dolor.example: His later poems are filled with the dolor of exile.  他后期的诗充满流亡的悲痛。

excruciation.example: The last mile of the race was sheer excruciation for her.  比赛最后一英里对她纯粹是折磨。

tribulation.example: They survived years of tribulation in the refugee camp.  他们在难民营中度过了多年苦难。

woe.example: He told us a long tale of woe about his debts.  他向我们讲了一段关于债务的漫长悲惨遭遇。

exultation.example: A cry of exultation went up when the winning goal was scored.  制胜球进网时爆发出一声欢呼。

jubilation.example: There were scenes of jubilation in the streets that night.  那晚街头一片欢腾。

agape.example: The children stood agape as the elephants marched through the village.  大象穿过村子时，孩子们目瞪口呆地站着。

anticipant.example: The anticipant crowd fell silent as the curtain slowly rose.  幕布缓缓升起时期待的人群安静下来。

agility.example: The old goalkeeper still shows surprising agility in front of the net.  这位老门将在球门前依然显示出惊人的敏捷。

nimbleness.example: The dancer's nimbleness amazed the whole audience.  舞者的敏捷让全场观众惊叹。

spryness.example: At eighty he still moved with surprising spryness.  八十岁时他行动仍然出奇矫健。

gaucheness.example: His social gaucheness made every party painful for him.  他社交上的笨拙让每场聚会都很难受。

gawkiness.example: She never quite lost the gawkiness of her teenage years.  她始终没完全摆脱少年时的笨拙。

gracelessness.example: He later apologized for the gracelessness of his refusal.  他后来为自己拒绝时的失礼道歉。

bedevil.example: Delays have bedeviled the project from the very beginning.  延误从一开始就困扰着这个项目。

element.example: Trust is a key element in any lasting partnership.  信任是任何持久合作关系的关键要素。

ambivalent.example: Many voters remain ambivalent about the new tax proposal.  许多选民对新的税收提案态度依然矛盾。
ambivalent.cn: （态度、感情）矛盾的，摇摆不定的

contradictory.example: The witnesses gave contradictory accounts of the accident.  证人们对事故给出了相互矛盾的说法。

unquestioning.example: The regime demanded unquestioning obedience from all its officials.  该政权要求所有官员不加质疑地服从。

fad.example: Standing desks turned out to be more than a passing fad.  站立式办公桌最终不只是一时的风尚。

fashion.example: Wide silk ties went out of fashion decades ago.  宽丝绸领带几十年前就不流行了。

vogue.example: Loose linen shirts are in vogue again this summer.  宽松亚麻衬衫今年夏天又流行起来。

analogous.example: The human eye is roughly analogous to a camera in several ways.  人眼在若干方面大致类似于照相机。

akin.example: The feeling was akin to fear but much quieter.  那种感觉类似恐惧，但安静得多。

cognate.example: English and Dutch are cognate languages with many shared words.  英语和荷兰语是有许多共同词汇的同源语言。

comparable.example: The two schools produced comparable results again this year.  两所学校今年又取得了可比的成绩。

connate.example: Her sense of rhythm seemed connate rather than carefully trained.  她的节奏感似乎是天生的而非刻意训练出来的。

corresponding.example: Sales rose sharply over the corresponding period last year.  销售额比去年同期大幅上升。

matching.example: She bought matching curtains and cushions for the small room.  她为那个小房间买了相配的窗帘和靠垫。

resembling.example: The cloud had a shape resembling a running horse.  那朵云的形状像一匹奔马。

suchlike.example: We packed pens, paper and suchlike for the long trip.  我们为长途旅行装了笔、纸之类的东西。

different.example: The twins have completely different tastes in music.  这对双胞胎在音乐口味上完全不同。

unlike.example: Unlike his brother, he never enjoyed noisy crowds.  与他兄弟不同，他从不喜欢喧闹的人群。

annex.example: The empire moved quickly to annex the small territory to its north.  帝国迅速吞并了北面那块小小的领土。

adjoin.example: Their land adjoins the old churchyard on the north side.  他们的地在北侧与老教堂墓地相连。

append.example: She appended a short note to the end of the report.  她在报告末尾附上了一条简短注释。

subjoin.example: The editor subjoined a brief comment to the printed letter.  编辑在刊印的信后附加了一段简短评论。

tack.example: Lawmakers tacked on a clause about rural schools.  议员们附加了一项关于乡村学校的条款。

deduct.example: The company deducts travel expenses from every invoice.  公司从每张发票中扣除差旅费。

annotate.example: Scholars continue to annotate the manuscript with notes on its sources.  学者们仍在为这份手稿加上关于其来源的注解。

commentate.example: He was hired to commentate on the evening matches.  他受雇解说晚间的比赛。

footnote.example: The translator added a footnote explaining the old proverb.  译者加了一条脚注解释那句古谚。

antedate.example: These cave drawings antedate the invention of writing by many centuries.  这些洞穴壁画比文字的发明早了许多个世纪。

antecede.example: These local customs antecede the founding of the city itself.  这些当地习俗早于这座城市的建立。

forego.example: The foregoing chapters describe that earlier period in detail.  前几章详细描述了那个更早的时期。

predate.example: These rock carvings predate the arrival of the first settlers.  这些岩刻早于最早定居者的到来。

preexist.example: Small farming villages preexisted the modern city by centuries.  小农村比现代城市早存在了数百年。

postdate.example: The manuscript clearly postdates the fall of the empire.  这份手稿显然晚于帝国的覆灭。

obsolete.example: Once a marvel, the machine became obsolete within five years of its release.  这台机器曾是奇迹，上市五年内就被淘汰了。

antithetical.example: Censorship is antithetical to everything the university claims to defend.  审查制度与大学声称维护的一切完全对立。

antipodal.example: The two economists hold antipodal views on taxation.  两位经济学家在税收问题上持完全对立的观点。

antipodean.example: Their antipodean opinions made any agreement almost impossible.  他们截然相反的意见使达成一致几乎不可能。

diametric.example: The two reports stand in diametric opposition to each other.  两份报告完全相互对立。

opposite.example: The two cars sped off in opposite directions.  两辆车朝相反方向疾驰而去。

polar.example: The brothers are polar opposites in almost every way.  兄弟俩几乎在各方面都截然相反。

apparition.example: The old man swore he saw an apparition in the hallway.  老人发誓他在走廊里看到了一个幽灵。

shade.example: Old legends say the shades of drowned sailors haunt that cove.  古老传说称溺亡水手的幽魂出没于那个小湾。

specter.example: The specter of another famine hung over the whole region.  又一场饥荒的阴影笼罩着整个地区。

spook.example: The children insisted that a spook lived in the attic.  孩子们坚称阁楼里住着一个鬼。

sprite.example: In the tale a water sprite guards the hidden spring.  故事里有个水精灵守护着隐秘的泉水。

visitant.example: She described a pale visitant standing at the foot of her bed.  她描述有个苍白的幽灵站在她床脚。

wraith.example: A pale wraith seemed to drift along the empty corridor.  一个苍白的幽灵似乎在空荡的走廊上飘动。

actionable.example: The consultant offered actionable advice instead of vague theory.  顾问给出了可操作的建议而非空泛理论。

applicative.example: The lab focuses on applicative research with clear industrial uses.  该实验室专注于有明确工业用途的应用性研究。

applied.example: She switched from pure to applied mathematics in her third year.  她第三年从纯数学转到应用数学。

functional.example: The kitchen was plain but completely functional.  厨房很朴素，但完全实用。

serviceable.example: The old tractor is battered but still perfectly serviceable.  这台旧拖拉机破旧，但仍完全可用。

unusable.example: Flooding left the whole ground floor unusable.  洪水使整个一楼无法使用。

sentient.example: The novel asks whether machines could ever be sentient.  这部小说探讨机器是否可能有知觉。

ware.example: The old sailor was ware of every change in the wind.  这位老水手对风向的每一点变化都很警觉。

afraid.example: The little boy is still afraid of the dark.  这个小男孩仍然怕黑。

aghast.example: She stood aghast at the damage the storm had done.  她惊骇地看着风暴造成的破坏。

frightened.example: The frightened child clung to her mother's coat.  受惊的孩子紧抓着母亲的外套。

horrified.example: Neighbors were horrified by what they saw inside the house.  邻居们被屋里看到的情形骇住了。

scared.example: I was scared to death when all the lights went out.  灯全灭时我吓得要死。

shocked.example: The whole audience sat shocked into complete silence.  全场观众震惊得完全沉默。

terrified.example: He is terrified of heights and refused to climb the tower.  他极度怕高，拒绝爬那座塔。

unafraid.example: She was unafraid of criticism and published the essay anyway.  她不怕批评，仍然发表了那篇文章。

cultivable.example: Only a third of the island is cultivable land.  这座岛只有三分之一是可耕地。

tillable.example: The farm has forty tillable acres beside the river.  这个农场在河边有四十英亩可耕地。

unfruitful.example: Years of unfruitful negotiation exhausted both sides.  多年无成果的谈判使双方疲惫不堪。

willy-nilly.cn: 杂乱无章地；不由自主地
willy-nilly.example: Papers were scattered willy-nilly across the office floor.  文件杂乱地散落在办公室地板上。

argumentation.example: The essay wins by careful argumentation rather than emotion.  这篇文章靠严密论证而非情绪取胜。

arrangement.example: The neat arrangement of tools showed real discipline.  工具整齐的排列显示出真正的条理。

disposal.example: The general studied the disposal of troops along the ridge.  将军研究了沿山脊的兵力部署。

distribution.example: The map shows an even distribution of clinics across the county.  地图显示诊所在全县分布均匀。

ordering.example: The ordering of the chapters confused several reviewers.  章节的排序让几位评审感到困惑。

setup.example: Their studio setup lets three people record at once.  他们工作室的布置让三个人可以同时录音。

codify.example: The committee worked for years to codify these local customs.  委员会花了数年把这些当地习俗编成条文。

marshal.example: The lawyer marshaled the evidence into a clear sequence.  律师把证据整理成清晰的顺序。

systematize.example: The new director systematized the museum's messy records.  新馆长把博物馆混乱的记录系统化了。

devolve.example: The debate quickly devolved into shouting and insults.  辩论很快退化为叫喊和辱骂。

disharmonizedisarray.example: The sudden news threw the whole team into disharmonizedisarray.  突来的消息使整个团队陷入失谐混乱。

portly.example: A portly gentleman in a grey suit greeted us warmly.  一位穿灰西装的胖绅士热情迎接我们。

goofy.example: He answered with a goofy grin and a shrug.  他傻笑一下，耸了耸肩作答。

golden.example: This is a golden opportunity that we should not waste.  这是我们不该浪费的绝佳机会。

hopeful.example: There are hopeful signs that the talks will finally succeed.  有令人抱有希望的迹象表明会谈终将成功。

mechanic.example: His answers were mechanic, as if learned by heart.  他的回答很机械，像是死记硬背下来的。

assertion.example: His bold assertion was never supported by any real data.  他大胆的断言从未有真实数据支持。

asseveration.example: His solemn asseveration of innocence clearly moved the jury.  他郑重声明自己无罪，明显感动了陪审团。

avouchment.example: The witness offered a firm avouchment of the man's alibi.  证人坚定地为那人的不在场证明作保。

declaration.example: The company issued a public declaration of its new policy.  公司发布了新政策的公开声明。

insistence.example: At his insistence the meeting was moved to Monday morning.  在他的坚持下会议改到了周一上午。

disavowal.example: The party issued a swift disavowal of the leaked memo.  该党迅速公开否认了泄露的备忘录。

backfire.example: Their attempt to silence the press was bound to backfire.  他们压制新闻界的做法必然事与愿违。

boomerang.cn: 事与愿违，反伤自身；回旋镖
boomerang.example: The smear campaign boomeranged on its own organizers.  抹黑运动反过来伤了组织者自己。

backslide.example: Many patients backslide into old habits after leaving the clinic.  许多病人离开诊所后又退回旧习。

progress.example: The students made steady progress over the whole term.  学生们整个学期取得了稳步进展。

maze.example: We got lost in a maze of narrow hospital corridors.  我们在迷宫般的狭窄医院走廊里迷了路。

befuddling.example: The form came with befuddling instructions in tiny print.  表格附有小字印刷的令人迷惑说明。

bewildering.example: The menu offered a bewildering choice of desserts.  菜单提供了令人眼花的甜点选择。

confounding.example: The trial produced a confounding result that nobody expected.  试验产生了没人预料到的令人困惑结果。

confusing.example: His confusing directions sent us the wrong way twice.  他令人混乱的指路让我们走错了两次。

puzzling.example: Her puzzling silence worried everyone at the table.  她令人费解的沉默让桌上每个人担心。

perplexing.example: The engineers faced a perplexing problem with the new engine.  工程师们面对新引擎一个令人困惑的难题。

beholden.example: She wanted to be beholden to no one for her success.  她希望自己的成功不欠任何人人情。

indebted.example: I am deeply indebted to her for that timely advice.  我非常感激她那及时的建议。

obligated.example: She felt obligated to help her former teacher move house.  她觉得有义务帮旧日老师搬家。

obliged.example: I am much obliged to you for the ride home.  非常感谢你送我回家。

behoove.example: It would behoove the company to answer the letter quickly.  公司尽快回信才对自己有利。

befit.example: He wore a dark suit to befit the solemn occasion.  他穿深色西装以配这个庄重场合。

beseem.example: Such patience beseems a teacher of her long standing.  这样的耐心与她多年的教师身份相称。

serve.example: A folding table will serve our purpose well enough.  一张折叠桌就足够合我们的用途。

suite.example: The delegation stayed in a large suite upstairs.  代表团住在楼上一间大套房里。

faceless.example: Decisions were made by faceless bureaucrats far away.  决定由远处毫无个性的官僚做出。

noncommittal.example: The minister gave a noncommittal answer to every question.  部长对每个问题都给出不表态的回答。

diagnostic.example: The narrow leaves are a diagnostic feature of this species.  狭长的叶子是该物种的特征性特点。

distinctive.example: Her distinctive style makes each painting recognizable from across the gallery.  她独特的风格使每幅画在展厅另一端就能被认出。

distinguishing.example: The bird's red crest is its main distinguishing mark.  这种鸟的红冠是它主要的识别标记。

identifying.example: The report removed all identifying details of the patients.  报告删去了病人所有身份识别信息。

bureaucratic.example: Endless bureaucratic delays kept the clinic from opening on time.  没完没了的官僚拖延使诊所无法按时开业。

governmental.example: Several governmental agencies joined the flood investigation.  几个政府机构参与了洪灾调查。

agonistic.example: The study measured agonistic behavior among captive wolves.  该研究测量了圈养狼之间的对抗性行为。

gladiatorial.example: The debate turned into a gladiatorial contest of egos.  辩论变成了一场自负者之间的角斗式较量。

quarrelsome.example: Their quarrelsome neighbor complained about absolutely everything.  他们爱争吵的邻居对一切都抱怨。

aggressiveness.example: The dog's aggressiveness alarmed everyone in the park.  那条狗的好斗让公园里所有人警觉。

assaultiveness.example: Nurses noted the patient's growing assaultiveness at night.  护士注意到病人夜间攻击性日增。

bellicosity.example: The general's bellicosity alarmed even his own allies.  将军的好战甚至使他自己的盟友不安。

combativeness.example: Her combativeness in court intimidated younger lawyers.  她在法庭上的斗志让年轻律师畏惧。

contentiousness.example: His contentiousness made every committee meeting run long.  他的好争论让每次委员会会议都超时。

disputatiousness.example: The seminar was famous for its cheerful disputatiousness.  这门讨论课以愉快的好争辩闻名。

feistiness.example: The small terrier's feistiness surprised the larger dogs.  小猎狐犬的倔劲让大狗吃惊。

militance.example: The union's militance grew sharply after the wage cuts.  减薪后工会的战斗性急剧增强。

pugnacity.example: His natural pugnacity served him well as a boxer.  他天生的好斗使他成为出色的拳手。

quarrelsomeness.example: Their quarrelsomeness ruined nearly every family dinner.  他们的好争吵几乎破坏了每次家庭晚餐。

scrappiness.example: The team's scrappiness made up for its lack of size.  这支球队的拼劲弥补了身材上的不足。

truculence.example: He answered the reporters with unexpected truculence.  他以出人意料的凶蛮回应记者。

pacifism.example: Her pacifism kept her out of the army entirely.  她的和平主义使她完全不参军。

magnetic.example: His magnetic personality filled the small room instantly.  他有魅力的个性瞬间充满了那个小房间。

blackmail.example: They tried to blackmail the witness into staying silent.  他们试图敲诈证人让其保持沉默。

extortion.example: Two city officials were charged with extortion last week.  两名市政官员上周被控敲诈。

crusty.cn: 脾气坏的，粗率的；有硬皮的
crusty.example: The crusty old sailor barked orders at everyone on deck.  那个脾气粗率的老水手对甲板上所有人吼命令。

snippy.cn: 说话尖刻的，唐突无礼的
snippy.example: She sent a snippy reply and regretted it an hour later.  她发了一条尖刻的回复，一小时后就后悔了。

misguide.example: The advertisement was designed to misguide careless buyers.  这则广告旨在误导粗心的买家。

inauthentic.example: Experts declared the painting inauthentic after careful tests.  专家经仔细检测宣布这幅画并非真品。

snide.example: He made a snide comment about her cheap watch.  他对她廉价的手表说了句讥讽的话。

drip.cn: 令人厌烦的乏味之人；滴落
drip.example: They called him a drip because he never joined in.  他们叫他闷蛋，因为他从不参与。

droner.example: The lecturer was a droner who slowly emptied the hall.  那位讲师说话单调，把礼堂讲空了。

snoozer.example: The second half of the film was a real snoozer.  这部电影的后半段十足催眠。

yawner.example: The debate turned into a complete yawner by midnight.  到午夜辩论变得完全乏味。

jade.example: Years of endless touring had jaded the young singer.  多年不断的巡演使这位年轻歌手厌倦。

shake.example: He shook his fist angrily at the departing taxi.  他愤怒地朝驶离的出租车挥拳。

brim.example: Her eyes brimmed with tears as she read the old letter.  她读那封旧信时，眼里满是泪水。

pullulate.example: The shallow pond pullulated with tadpoles after the rains.  雨后浅池塘里蝌蚪繁生。

teem.example: The river teems with fish every spring.  每年春天这条河里鱼类繁多。

sputter.cn: 语无伦次地说；噗噗作响
sputter.example: He sputtered with rage and could not finish the sentence.  他气得语无伦次，那句话没说完。

pronounce.example: She pronounced each word slowly for the beginners.  她为初学者慢慢读出每个词。

coil.example: He coiled the wet rope neatly and hung it up.  他把湿绳整齐盘好挂了起来。

tranquillity.example: They moved to the coast for peace and tranquillity.  他们为了平静与宁静搬到了海边。

enshrine.example: The constitution enshrines the right to free speech.  宪法将言论自由的权利奉为神圣。

ensky.example: The old poem enskies the fallen warriors as bright stars.  这首古诗把阵亡战士奉为明亮的星辰。

captious.example: His captious comments on every draft discouraged the young writers.  他对每份草稿吹毛求疵的评论让年轻作者们气馁。

carping.cn: 吹毛求疵的，唠叨挑剔的
carping.example: His carping criticism discouraged the whole team.  他挑剔的批评让整个团队泄气。

caviling.example: The board dismissed his caviling objections at once.  董事会立即驳回了他无理挑剔的反对。

faultfinding.example: Her constant faultfinding wore out every new assistant.  她不断的挑剔让每个新助手都疲惫不堪。

judgmental.example: Try not to sound so judgmental when giving feedback.  给反馈时尽量别显得那么爱评判。

overcritical.example: An overcritical parent can easily destroy a child's confidence.  过于挑剔的家长很容易毁掉孩子的自信。

appreciative.example: The pianist played for a warm and appreciative audience.  钢琴家为热情且懂欣赏的观众演奏。

slaphappy.cn: 轻率乐观的，晕头转向的
slaphappy.example: Their slaphappy attitude to safety worried the inspector.  他们对安全轻率的态度让检查员担忧。

cascade.example: A cascade of complaints followed the sudden increase in fares.  票价突然上涨后，投诉接连不断。

cellular.example: The plant stem has a light cellular structure inside.  这种植物的茎内部是轻质的多孔结构。

ceremonious.example: The ambassador greeted the guests with a ceremonious bow.  大使以郑重的鞠躬迎接客人。

correct.example: His correct behavior impressed the elderly hosts.  他得体的举止令年长的主人印象深刻。

assuredness.example: She spoke with a quiet assuredness that convinced us all.  她以沉静的笃定说话，说服了我们所有人。

doubtlessness.example: He asserted his innocence with complete doubtlessness.  他以完全确信的态度声称自己无罪。

positiveness.example: Her positiveness about the date turned out to be mistaken.  她对日期的确信最终证明是错的。

uncertainty.example: Investors hate a long period of political uncertainty.  投资者厌恶长期的政治不确定。

channel.example: The government will channel more funds into basic medical research.  政府将把更多资金投入基础医学研究。

canalize.example: The leader tried to canalize public anger into peaceful reform.  领导者试图把公众怒气引向和平改革。

channelize.example: The agency channelized resources toward rural clinics.  该机构把资源引向乡村诊所。

funnel.example: Donors funneled money into the new scholarship fund.  捐赠者把钱汇入新的奖学金基金。

pipe.example: Engineers piped clean water to the remote mountain village.  工程师把清水引到偏远的山村。

siphon.example: The manager siphoned off funds from the charity account.  经理从慈善账户中抽走资金。

chaperone.example: Two parents chaperoned the students on the museum trip.  两位家长陪同学生去博物馆参观。

accompany.example: He offered to accompany her home after the concert.  音乐会结束后他提出陪她回家。

companion.example: She found a cheerful travelling companion on the night train.  她在夜车上遇到一位快活的旅伴。

convoy.example: Warships convoyed the supplies across the open sea.  军舰护送物资横渡公海。

escort.example: Two guards escorted the visiting minister to the waiting car.  两名警卫护送来访的部长上了等候的汽车。

squire.example: He squired his elderly aunt to the village dance.  他陪年长的姑妈去村里的舞会。

charisma.example: The coach has enough charisma to inspire even a losing team.  这位教练的魅力足以激励一支落后的球队。

attractiveness.example: The attractiveness of the offer surprised even her rivals.  该提议的吸引力连她的对手都感到惊讶。

captivation.example: The audience listened in total captivation to her voice.  观众完全被她的歌声迷住了。

fascination.example: He had a lifelong fascination with old maps and charts.  他终生迷恋古老的地图和海图。

glamor.example: The glamor of the stage drew her away from teaching.  舞台的魅力让她离开了教书。

seductiveness.example: The seductiveness of easy money ruined several promising careers.  快钱的诱惑力毁了好几个有前途的事业。

witchery.example: The old song held a strange witchery for him.  那首老歌对他有种奇异的魅力。

repulsiveness.example: The smell's repulsiveness drove us straight out of the kitchen.  那气味的令人厌恶把我们直接赶出厨房。

cherished.example: The photograph is her most cherished memory of that summer.  这张照片是她对那个夏天最珍爱的回忆。

beloved.example: The beloved teacher retired after forty years at the school.  这位深受爱戴的老师在校四十年后退休。

dear.example: She wrote a long letter to a dear old friend.  她给一位亲爱的老朋友写了封长信。

favored.example: She was clearly the favored child in that large family.  她显然是那个大家庭里最受宠的孩子。

favorite.example: This old jazz record is still my favorite after twenty years.  这张老爵士唱片二十年后仍是我最喜欢的。

fond.example: My grandmother was very fond of the stray cat next door.  我祖母非常喜爱隔壁那只流浪猫。

loved.example: He grew up feeling loved and supported by his whole family.  他在全家的关爱与支持中长大。

special.example: She saved that silk dress for special occasions only.  她把那条丝质连衣裙只留到特殊场合穿。

abhorred.example: Slavery was an abhorred institution that took centuries to abolish.  奴隶制是一种遭人痛恨的制度，废除它花了几个世纪。

abominated.example: The dictator was abominated by nearly everyone in the country.  这位独裁者几乎被全国所有人痛恨。

despised.example: The tax collector was the most despised man in the village.  税吏是村里最遭人鄙视的人。

detested.example: Broccoli remains the most detested vegetable among the children here.  西兰花仍是这里孩子们最讨厌的蔬菜。

disdained.example: Manual labor was long disdained by the educated elite.  体力劳动长期被知识精英所鄙视。

disliked.example: The new manager was disliked by almost all of his staff.  新经理几乎不受任何下属喜欢。

execrated.example: His name was execrated in every newspaper the following morning.  第二天早上每份报纸都在痛骂他的名字。

hated.example: He became the most hated figure in the entire industry.  他成了整个行业里最遭人憎恨的人物。

loathed.example: The loathed old rule was finally scrapped last year.  那条令人厌恶的旧规定去年终于被废除。

high.example: He held himself to high moral standards throughout his long career.  他整个漫长的职业生涯都以高尚的道德标准自律。

chorale.example: The village chorale sang three hymns at the evening service.  村里的合唱团在晚间礼拜上唱了三首圣歌。

anthem.example: The crowd stood and sang the anthem before the match began.  比赛开始前人们起立唱国歌。

canticle.example: The monks chanted a canticle at the close of the service.  修士们在礼拜结束时唱了一首颂歌。

choir.example: She has sung in the church choir since she was eight.  她从八岁起就在教堂唱诗班里唱歌。

clangor.example: The clangor of hammers filled the shipyard all morning.  锤子的巨响整个上午充满了船坞。

vociferation.example: The debate ended in angry vociferation from both sides.  辩论以双方愤怒的大声叫嚷收场。

clan.example: The whole gardening clan meets here on the first Sunday.  整个园艺团体每月第一个周日在这里聚会。

circle.example: She belongs to a small circle of literary critics.  她属于一个小小的文学批评家圈子。

community.example: The research community reacted quickly to the surprising new findings.  学术界对这些惊人的新发现反应迅速。

coterie.example: The poet was surrounded by a coterie of loyal followers.  这位诗人身边围着一小圈忠实的追随者。

coven.example: Local legend claims a coven once met in these dark woods.  当地传说称曾有女巫团在这片幽暗的树林聚会。

crowd.example: He started skipping class after joining the wrong crowd.  他结交了不良的一伙人后开始逃课。

network.example: She built a wide network of contacts in the publishing world.  她在出版界建立了广泛的人脉网。

ring.example: Police finally broke up the counterfeit ring last month.  警方上个月终于捣毁了这个假币团伙。

clannish ref.example: The club was clannish and openly hostile to newcomers.  这个俱乐部排外，对新人公开怀有敌意。

decouple.example: Economists hope to decouple energy use from economic growth.  经济学家希望使能源消耗与经济增长脱钩。

dissociate.example: The senator moved quickly to dissociate himself from the scandal.  这位参议员迅速与丑闻划清界限。

ramify.example: The main artery ramifies into dozens of smaller vessels.  主动脉分叉成数十条更细的血管。

slice.example: He sliced the melon into eight neat pieces.  他把瓜切成了八块整齐的片。

tasteful.example: The whole room was furnished in a quiet, tasteful style.  整个房间以一种素净雅致的风格布置。

cohesive.example: Two seasons together turned the players into a cohesive team.  两个赛季的磨合让球员成了一支有凝聚力的团队。

gummy.example: The candy left a gummy residue on my fingers.  糖在我手指上留下了黏黏的残渣。

tacky.example: Do not touch the varnish while it is still tacky.  清漆还发黏时不要碰。

non-adhesive.example: The pan has a non-adhesive lining that makes cleaning easy.  这个锅有不粘内衬，清洗很方便。

non-viscous.example: Water is a non-viscous fluid compared with thick honey.  与浓稠的蜂蜜相比，水是一种非黏稠液体。

commiserate.example: We stayed after the game to commiserate with the losing team.  比赛后我们留下来对落败的队伍表示同情。

sympathize.example: I sympathize with anyone who has lost a job this year.  我同情今年失业的每一个人。

prideful.example: His prideful manner cost him several close friendships.  他自负的态度让他失去了几段亲密友谊。

vainglorious.example: The general's vainglorious speech impressed nobody in the room.  将军自吹自擂的演讲没打动房里任何人。

correlative.example: Freedom and responsibility are correlative ideas in his philosophy.  在他的哲学中，自由与责任是相互关联的概念。

interdependent.example: Modern economies are deeply interdependent and rarely fail alone.  现代经济高度相互依赖，很少单独崩溃。

reciprocal.example: The two countries signed a reciprocal trade agreement yesterday.  两国昨天签署了一项互惠贸易协定。

uncomplacent.cn: 不自满的，不安于现状的
uncomplacent.example: Her uncomplacent attitude kept the team improving every season.  她不自满的态度让团队每个赛季都在进步。

conceive.example: I cannot conceive why she would refuse such a generous offer.  我无法理解她为何会拒绝这么优厚的条件。

see.example: Now I see why you were so worried last night.  现在我明白你昨晚为什么那么担心了。

number.example: The society numbers three thousand members across the whole country.  该协会在全国共有三千名会员。

misconceive.example: Many readers misconceive the author's argument about free will.  许多读者误解了作者关于自由意志的论证。

leave.example: The editor decided to leave that whole chapter out.  编辑决定把那一整章都删掉不用。

de facto.example: She became the de facto head of the company after his illness.  他病后她成了公司实际上的负责人。

conjectural.example: His account of the ancient battle remains largely conjectural.  他对那场古代战役的说法在很大程度上仍属推测。

hypothetical.example: The professor posed a hypothetical to test how students weighed competing rights.  教授提出一个假设情形，考察学生如何权衡相互冲突的权利。

platonic.cn: 柏拉图式的，纯精神的；理论上的
platonic.example: Their relationship stayed strictly platonic for over a decade.  他们的关系十多年来始终是纯精神的。

suppositional.example: Most of his reasoning rested on suppositional premises.  他的大部分推理都建立在假定的前提上。

anathematize.example: The council met to anathematize anyone denying the doctrine.  会议召开是为了诅咒任何否认该教义的人。

damn.example: Critics damned the novel as cruel and morally irresponsible.  批评者谴责这部小说残忍且在道德上不负责任。

decry.example: Local doctors decried the plan to close the only children's clinic.  当地医生强烈反对关闭唯一一家儿童诊所的计划。

tentative.example: The two sides reached a tentative agreement late on Friday night.  双方在周五深夜达成暂时性协议。

butinninecasesoutof.ipa: bʌt ɪn naɪn ˈkeɪsɪz aʊt ʌv
butinninecasesoutof.cn: 但十有八九（原书粘连串）
butinninecasesoutof.example: Butinninecasesoutof ten the simpler answer turns out to be correct.  但十有八九，较简单的答案才是对的。

conflate.example: Critics often conflate two separate issues and confuse the public.  批评者常把两个不同的问题混为一谈，令公众困惑。

goose-step.example: Soldiers goose-step past the reviewing stand every October.  士兵们每年十月都正步走过检阅台。

feature.example: I simply cannot feature him living quietly in the countryside.  我实在无法想象他在乡下安静生活的样子。

ideate.example: The team met weekly to ideate fresh marketing campaigns.  团队每周开会构思新的营销方案。

image.example: Try to image the room exactly as it looked then.  试着想象那房间当时的确切模样。

visualize.example: Athletes often visualize the race before they actually run it.  运动员常在真正比赛前先想象整个过程。

clearance.example: The pilot waited for clearance before entering the runway.  飞行员在进入跑道前等待许可。

granting.example: The granting of the visa took nearly three months.  签证的批准花了将近三个月。

consign.example: The court consigned the orphaned children to the care of their aunt.  法院把这几个孤儿转交给他们的姑妈照管。
consign.cn: 转交，托付；把…置于（某境地）

commit.example: They committed the child to the care of her aunt.  他们把孩子交给她姑妈照顾。

confide.example: She confided the manuscript to her most trusted editor.  她把手稿托付给最信赖的编辑。

delegate.example: A good leader delegates routine tasks and saves time for planning.  好的领导者会把日常事务移交出去，为规划省下时间。

deliver.example: The courier delivered the sealed envelope to her office.  快递员把密封信封送到了她的办公室。

entrust.example: They entrusted the family business to their youngest son.  他们把家族生意托付给了小儿子。

hand.example: He handed the letter to his supervisor without a word.  他一言不发地把信递给了主管。

recommend.example: The dying man recommended his children to his brother.  临终的他把孩子托付给了弟弟。

alarm.example: The sudden noise filled the whole household with alarm.  突然的响声让全家人惊恐不安。

terror.example: The children ran home in terror after hearing the story.  孩子们听完故事后惊恐地跑回家。

consternation.example: His resignation caused considerable consternation among the board members.  他的辞职让董事们相当惊愕。

fearlessness.example: Her fearlessness in the courtroom impressed even hostile judges.  她在法庭上的无畏甚至让敌意的法官动容。

mull.example: He mulled over the decision for several sleepless nights.  他为这个决定辗转思考了好几个夜晚。

revolve.example: She revolved the strange remark in her mind all evening.  她整晚都在心里反复琢磨那句奇怪的话。

wrestle.example: Philosophers still wrestle with the nature of consciousness.  哲学家们仍在苦苦思索意识的本质。

contemptuousness.example: The contemptuousness in her reply silenced the entire table.  她回答中的轻蔑让整桌人都沉默了。

despisement.example: His despisement of cheap sentiment shaped all his later poems.  他对廉价感伤的鄙视塑造了他后期所有的诗。

despitefulness.example: The despitefulness of the anonymous letters shocked the small town.  那些匿名信的恶意震动了这个小镇。

vie.example: Two young pianists vied for the final prize that evening.  那晚两位年轻钢琴家争夺最后的大奖。

give in.example: After hours of argument he finally gave in to her.  争论几小时后他终于向她让步。

contrived.example: The film's ending felt contrived and left the audience oddly unsatisfied.  这部电影的结局显得刻意，让观众莫名地不满足。

unnatural.example: Her voice sounded stiff and unnatural on the recording.  录音里她的声音听起来僵硬而不自然。

uncontrived.example: The film's power comes from its plain, uncontrived dialogue.  这部电影的力量来自朴素而不做作的对白。

unforced.example: Their easy, unforced rapport made the interview a pleasure.  他们自然轻松的默契让访谈非常愉快。

call.example: The chairman called an emergency meeting for Monday morning.  主席召集了周一上午的紧急会议。

correlate.example: Researchers correlated hours of sleep with performance on the memory tests.  研究者把睡眠时长与记忆测试的表现关联起来。

counterproductive.example: Punishing every mistake proved counterproductive in the long run.  长远看，惩罚每个错误反而起了反作用。

ineffectual.example: His ineffectual attempts to calm the crowd only made things worse.  他徒劳的安抚只让人群更加激动。

inefficient.example: The heating system is old, noisy, and terribly inefficient.  这套供暖系统老旧、吵闹，而且效率极低。

efficient.example: The new software makes the whole process far more efficient.  新软件让整个流程效率高得多。

expedient.example: Delaying the vote was expedient but hardly honorable.  推迟投票是权宜之计，却谈不上光彩。

operant.example: Cost, not quality, was the operant factor in their decision.  在他们的决定中起作用的是成本而非质量。

disbelief.example: She listened to the verdict with open disbelief.  她听着判决，一脸难以置信。

geld.example: Endless amendments gelded the reform until it had no force left.  无休止的修正案把这项改革削弱得毫无力量。

emboldened.cn: 受到鼓舞的，胆子大起来的
emboldened.example: Emboldened by the applause, she read a second poem.  掌声让她胆子大了起来，又读了第二首诗。

enterprising.example: Some enterprising students started a delivery service on campus.  几个有闯劲的学生在校园里办起了配送服务。

nerved.example: Nerved by his friend's example, he finally spoke up.  受朋友榜样激励，他终于开口了。

medieval.example: The company's leave policy feels frankly medieval today.  这家公司的休假制度如今显得实在过时。

deadlock.example: The talks reached a deadlock over the question of foreign inspectors.  谈判在外国检查员的问题上陷入僵局。

gridlock.example: Budget talks ended in complete gridlock again this spring.  预算谈判今春又一次陷入彻底僵局。

logjam.example: A single compromise finally broke the logjam over pensions.  一项妥协终于打破了养老金问题的僵局。

stalemate.example: The two sides reached a stalemate after nine hours of talks.  谈了九个小时后双方陷入僵局。

standoff.example: The standoff outside the embassy lasted three long days.  使馆外的对峙持续了漫长的三天。

standstill.example: Traffic came to a complete standstill after the accident.  事故发生后交通完全陷入停顿。

warped.example: The novel exposes the warped values of that gilded circle.  这部小说揭露了那个纸醉金迷圈子的扭曲价值观。

whip.example: She whipped around when she heard footsteps behind her.  听到身后的脚步声，她猛地转过身。

defray.example: The grant helped defray her travel expenses to the conference.  这笔资助帮她支付了参加会议的旅费。

disburse.example: The agency disbursed the grant money in three installments.  该机构分三期支付了这笔拨款。

pay.example: He paid the whole bill before anyone else noticed.  他在别人注意到之前付掉了整张账单。

earn.example: She earns more from her writing than from teaching.  她写作挣的钱比教书多。

wincharge.example: The clinic charges a modest fee for each home visit.  这家诊所每次上门出诊收取不高的费用。

deign.example: The manager never deigned to explain his decisions to the staff.  这位经理从不屈尊向员工解释他的决定。

stoop.phrase_cn: 堕落到小肚鸡肠的报复
stoop.example: I never thought he would stoop to reading her mail.  我从没想过他会堕落到偷看她的信件。

agent.example: Her agent negotiated the contract on her behalf.  她的代理人代表她谈成了合同。

assignee.example: The assignee assumed all rights and duties under the contract.  受让人承担了合同下的全部权利与义务。

commissary.example: The bishop sent a commissary to settle the local dispute.  主教派了一名代表去解决当地纠纷。

deputy.example: The mayor sent his deputy to the opening ceremony.  市长派副手出席了开幕式。

emissary.example: The king dispatched an emissary to negotiate the truce.  国王派出一名使者去谈判停战。

envoy.example: The envoy arrived in the capital late on Friday night.  这位使节周五深夜抵达首都。

legate.example: A legate from Rome presided over the long trial.  一位来自罗马的特使主持了这场漫长的审判。

minister.example: He served as minister to Spain for almost six years.  他担任驻西班牙公使近六年。

proxy.example: Shareholders unable to attend may vote by proxy instead.  无法出席的股东可以委托代理投票。

representative.example: Each department sends one representative to the weekly meeting.  每个部门派一名代表参加周会。

give over.example: He gave over the entire estate to his eldest daughter.  他把整份产业移交给了长女。

hand over.example: The retiring director handed over her files last Friday.  即将退休的主管上周五移交了她的文件。

turn over.example: The bank turned over its records to the investigators.  银行把记录移交给了调查人员。

delineate.example: The novel delineates village life in remarkable and affectionate detail.  这部小说以细致而深情的笔触描绘了乡村生活。

depict.example: The mural depicts workers building the first railway.  这幅壁画描绘了工人修建第一条铁路的场景。

limn.example: The essay limns her childhood in a few careful strokes.  这篇散文用寥寥几笔勾画出她的童年。

portray.example: The film portrays the scientist as stubborn but kind.  影片把这位科学家刻画得固执却善良。

bust.example: The sergeant was busted to corporal after the incident.  事件之后这名军士被降为下士。

disrate.example: The captain disrated two sailors for repeated negligence.  舰长因屡次疏忽将两名水兵降级。

dependable.example: We needed a dependable driver who would arrive on time every day.  我们需要一位每天都能准时到达的可靠司机。

responsible.example: We need a responsible person to lock up each night.  我们需要一个可靠的人每晚锁门。

trustable.example: Only two of the sources proved genuinely trustable.  这些消息来源中只有两个确实可信。

undependable.example: His undependable attendance eventually cost him the job.  他不可靠的出勤最终让他丢了工作。

unreliable.example: Early weather forecasts here are notoriously unreliable.  这里早期的天气预报出名地靠不住。

unsafe.example: Inspectors declared the old bridge unsafe for heavy trucks.  检查人员宣布这座旧桥不宜通行重型卡车。

untrustworthy.example: Two witnesses described him as lazy and untrustworthy.  两名证人形容他懒惰且不可信。

dictate.example: The victors dictated harsh terms to the defeated coastal cities.  战胜者向战败的沿海城市强行规定苛刻条件。

mandate.example: The new law mandates helmets for all young riders.  新法规定所有年轻骑手必须戴头盔。

prescribe.example: The rules prescribe exactly how ballots must be counted.  规则明确规定了选票必须如何清点。

conjunctive.example: The two clauses are joined by a conjunctive phrase.  这两个分句由一个连接短语相连。

connective.example: Cartilage is a tough connective tissue found in joints.  软骨是关节中一种坚韧的结缔组织。

confute.example: A single careful experiment confuted decades of speculation.  一次严谨的实验驳倒了数十年的猜测。

characteristic.example: He answered with characteristic patience and a faint smile.  他以惯有的耐心和淡淡的微笑作答。

classic.example: These symptoms are classic signs of severe dehydration.  这些症状是严重脱水的典型表现。

symptomatic.example: The delays are symptomatic of a badly managed project.  这些延误是项目管理混乱的典型表现。

uncharacteristic.cn: 不典型的，不像其一贯作风的
uncharacteristic.example: Her sharp reply was quite uncharacteristic of her.  她那句尖刻的回答很不像她平日的样子。

untypical.example: This mild, dry winter is untypical for the region.  这个温和干燥的冬天对该地区来说很不典型。

tyrannize.example: The foreman tyrannized the younger workers for years.  这个工头多年来一直欺压年轻工人。

reduplicate.example: Later editions merely reduplicated the printer's earlier mistakes.  后来的版本只是重复了印工先前的错误。

replicate.example: Two other laboratories failed to replicate the results of the original experiment.  另外两个实验室未能重复出原实验的结果。

reproduce.example: The catalog reproduces every drawing in full color.  图录以全彩复制了每一幅素描。

ragtag.example: A ragtag crew of amateurs somehow finished the whole film.  一伙杂凑的业余人员居然拍完了整部电影。

operative.example: The older statute is no longer operative in this state.  那部旧法规在本州已不再有效。

enamored.example: He was so enamored of her voice that he attended every concert.  他如此迷恋她的嗓音，以致每场音乐会都去。

besotted.example: He was utterly besotted with her from the first evening.  从第一晚起他就彻底迷上了她。

bewitched.example: The audience sat bewitched by her quiet, steady voice.  观众被她平静沉稳的嗓音迷住，静坐不动。

captivated.example: Readers were captivated by the novel's strange opening chapter.  读者被这部小说奇特的开篇迷住了。

dotty.example: My uncle is absolutely dotty about vintage motorcycles.  我叔叔对老式摩托车痴迷得不行。

fascinated.example: She has been fascinated by deep-sea creatures since childhood.  她从小就对深海生物着迷。

infatuated.example: The boy was hopelessly infatuated with his piano teacher.  这男孩无可救药地迷恋他的钢琴老师。

nuts.example: Everyone in that family is completely nuts about gardening.  那家人个个对园艺痴迷得很。

obsessed.example: He grew obsessed with solving that one old puzzle.  他变得一心只想解开那个老谜题。

endeavor.example: The mission was a joint scientific endeavor involving eleven different countries.  这次任务是一项有十一个国家参与的共同科学努力。

attempt.example: Her third attempt at the summit finally succeeded.  她第三次尝试登顶终于成功了。

essay.example: He essayed a smile, but his hands were shaking.  他勉力一笑，可双手还在抖。

striving.example: Her lifelong striving for accuracy shaped the entire field.  她一生对精确的追求塑造了整个领域。

undertaking.example: Restoring the cathedral was an enormous undertaking.  修复这座大教堂是一项浩大的工程。

assay.example: The young climber assayed the north face alone.  这位年轻登山者独自尝试了北壁。

slave.example: She slaved over the manuscript for eleven straight months.  她为这部书稿连续苦干了十一个月。

strain.example: He strained to lift the crate onto the truck.  他竭力把箱子抬上卡车。

strive.example: They strive daily to keep the small clinic running.  他们每天都在努力维持这家小诊所的运转。

tug.example: The child tugged at his mother's sleeve impatiently.  孩子不耐烦地拉着母亲的袖子。

spellbind.example: Her stories could spellbind a room full of restless children.  她的故事能让满屋好动的孩子入迷。

equilibration.example: Slow equilibration of temperature took nearly two hours.  温度缓慢达到平衡花了将近两小时。

poise.example: She answered the hostile questions with remarkable poise.  她以非凡的沉着回答了那些带敌意的问题。

disequilibration.example: The drug caused temporary disequilibration in the inner ear.  这种药导致内耳暂时失衡。

disequilibrium.example: Years of cheap credit produced a dangerous disequilibrium.  多年的廉价信贷造成了危险的失衡。

nonequilibrium.example: Living cells maintain a nonequilibrium steady state far from equilibrium.  活细胞维持着远离平衡的非平衡稳态。

unbalance.example: One heavy passenger can unbalance a small canoe.  一名重乘客就能让小独木舟失衡。

exorcise.example: Writing the letter helped her exorcise old fears about failure.  写那封信帮她除去了对失败的旧日恐惧。

cashier.example: The army cashiered him after the inquiry closed.  调查结束后军方将他撤职。

use.example: We used the old barn as a workshop all summer.  整个夏天我们把旧谷仓当作工作间使用。

unriddle.example: Scholars spent decades trying to unriddle the inscription.  学者们花了数十年试图解开这段铭文之谜。

sweep.example: The reform swept away centuries of local privilege.  这项改革扫除了几百年的地方特权。

preserve.example: The trust works to preserve wetlands along the coast.  该基金会致力于保护沿海湿地。

extrapolate.example: Analysts extrapolate future growth from limited historical economic data.  分析师根据有限的历史经济数据推断未来增长。

deduce.example: From the footprints she deduced that two people had passed.  她从脚印推断出有两个人经过。

derive.example: He derived the equation from three simple assumptions.  他由三个简单假设推导出这个方程。

guess.example: Nobody could guess how long the repairs would take.  没人猜得出修理要花多久。

divine.phrase_cn: 美妙极了的巧克力蛋糕
divine.example: The weather that week was simply divine.  那一周的天气简直美妙极了。

marvelous.example: They did a marvelous job restoring the old organ.  他们把这台老管风琴修复得非常出色。

pathetic.example: Their defense in the second half was frankly pathetic.  他们下半场的防守说实话很差劲。

rotten.example: I felt rotten about missing her birthday dinner.  没赶上她的生日晚餐，我心里很难受。

trend.example: The trend toward remote work continued after the crisis.  危机之后远程办公的趋势仍在延续。

tendentiousness.example: Critics attacked the tendentiousness of his historical account.  批评者攻击他历史叙述中的偏向性。

objectivity.example: Reviewers are expected to judge submissions with strict objectivity.  评审人应以严格的客观性评判投稿。

open-mindedness.example: Her open-mindedness made her an unusually good listener.  她的开明使她成为格外好的倾听者。

unbiasedness.example: Statisticians value the unbiasedness of this simple estimator.  统计学家看重这个简单估计量的无偏性。

crime.example: The crime went unsolved for more than twenty years.  这起案件二十多年未破。

misdemeanor.example: Shoplifting is treated as a misdemeanor in that state.  在那个州入店行窃被视为轻罪。

cyclonic.example: The storm brought cyclonic gusts along the whole coast.  风暴给整条海岸带来了旋风般的阵风。

explosive.example: His explosive anger frightened everyone in the office.  他暴烈的怒气让办公室里所有人害怕。

paroxysmal.example: The patient suffered paroxysmal pain throughout the night.  病人整夜遭受突发性疼痛。

volcanic.example: His volcanic temper erupted over a trivial mistake.  他火山般的脾气因一个小错就爆发了。

nonviolent.example: The movement stayed strictly nonviolent despite heavy provocation.  尽管遭到严重挑衅，运动始终坚持非暴力。

unaggressive.example: These large fish are surprisingly unaggressive toward divers.  这些大鱼对潜水者出人意料地温和。

materiality.example: The philosopher questioned the materiality of everything we perceive.  这位哲学家质疑我们所感知一切的实在性。

passing.example: His interest in sailing was only a passing enthusiasm.  他对航海的兴趣只是一时的热情。

forage.example: The children foraged for wild mushrooms along the damp forest path.  孩子们沿着潮湿的林间小路寻找野菇。

quest.example: The hounds quested through the tall grass for hours.  猎犬在高草丛中搜寻了好几个小时。

promise.example: Those heavy clouds promise rain before evening.  那些厚重的云预示天黑前会下雨。

punctuate.example: Loud applause punctuated her acceptance speech throughout.  响亮的掌声不时打断她的获奖致辞。

damages.example: The court awarded her substantial damages for the injury.  法院判给她一笔可观的伤害赔偿金。

forfeiture.example: Breaking the terms meant forfeiture of the entire bond.  违反条款意味着丧失全部保证金。

mulct.example: The merchant was mulcted a hundred pounds for the offense.  这名商人因该罪行被罚一百英镑。

penalty.example: Late filing carries a penalty of two hundred dollars.  逾期申报要罚两百美元。

bonus.example: Every employee received a modest bonus in December.  每位员工十二月都拿到了一笔小额奖金。

prize.example: Her short story won the magazine's annual prize.  她的短篇小说获得了该杂志的年度奖。

coldish.example: It was coldish outside, so we took our coats.  外面有点冷，我们就带上了外套。

gelid.example: He washed his face in the gelid stream and gasped.  他在冰冷的溪水里洗脸，冷得直吸气。

nippy.example: It turned nippy as soon as the sun went down.  太阳一落山天就变得刺骨地冷。

numbing.phrase_cn: 甲板上冻得发麻的严寒
numbing.example: The numbing wind made it hard to hold the rope.  刺骨发麻的寒风让人难以抓住绳子。

wintry.example: She greeted the visitors with a wintry nod.  她只对来客冷淡地点了点头。

blazing.example: They worked in the blazing heat until noon.  他们在灼热的高温下干到中午。

molten.example: Molten rock poured slowly down the eastern slope.  熔岩缓缓流下东坡。

warm-blooded.example: Birds are warm-blooded and keep a steady body temperature.  鸟类是温血动物，能保持稳定体温。

gawky.example: The gawky teenage boy tripped over his own long legs.  那个笨手笨脚的少年被自己的长腿绊倒了。

gawkish.example: His gawkish attempts at dancing amused the whole room.  他笨拙的跳舞尝试让满屋人发笑。

uncoordinated.example: The puppy was still clumsy and uncoordinated on the stairs.  小狗在楼梯上还是笨拙又不协调。

germinate.example: These seeds germinate quickly in warm, moist soil near the window.  这些种子在窗边温暖潮湿的土壤中很快发芽。

sprout.example: The beans sprouted within four days of planting.  这些豆子播下四天内就发芽了。

evolve.example: The small reading group evolved into a national society.  这个小读书会逐渐发展成全国性协会。

disappear.example: The path disappeared into thick fog halfway up.  小径在半山处消失在浓雾中。

vanish.example: Her keys vanished somewhere between the car and the door.  她的钥匙在车与门之间某处不见了。

bowl.example: The old truck bowled along the empty coastal road.  那辆旧卡车在空旷的海岸公路上平稳飞驰。

brush.example: A moth brushed past his cheek in the dark.  黑暗中一只蛾子从他脸颊边掠过。

coast.example: He switched off the engine and coasted into the driveway.  他关掉发动机，滑行进了车道。

sail.example: The hawk sailed silently over the wide open field.  那只鹰无声地掠过开阔的田野。

graft.example: Surgeons grafted healthy skin onto the burned area of his left arm.  医生把健康的皮肤移植到他左臂烧伤的部位。

transplant.example: We transplanted the roses to a sunnier corner.  我们把玫瑰移栽到更向阳的角落。

constancy.example: Her constancy through those hard years astonished everyone.  她在那些艰难岁月中的坚定令所有人惊讶。

fiber.example: The crisis revealed the moral fiber of the whole crew.  这场危机显出全体船员的道德骨气。

grittiness.example: The team's grittiness carried them through a brutal season.  这支队伍的坚韧让他们度过了残酷的赛季。

intestinal fortitude.example: Finishing that race took genuine intestinal fortitude.  跑完那场比赛需要真正的勇气。

cowardliness.example: His silence was later condemned as sheer cowardliness.  他的沉默后来被谴责为纯粹的怯懦。

groggy.example: He was still groggy and unsteady when the nurse helped him stand.  护士扶他站起来时，他仍然虚弱得站不稳。

rocky.example: He felt rocky on his feet after the long flight.  长途飞行后他站着腿都发软。

wobbly.example: The table is wobbly because one leg is shorter.  这张桌子晃是因为有条腿短了。

malice.example: She insisted the remark carried no malice at all.  她坚称那句话完全没有恶意。

resentment.example: Years of unequal pay bred quiet resentment among staff.  多年薪酬不公在员工中滋生了无声的怨恨。

croak.example: He croaked about the food from the moment we sat down.  我们一坐下他就开始抱怨饭菜。

hierarchical.example: The company's hierarchical structure discouraged junior staff from speaking up.  公司的等级制结构使低层员工不敢发声。

graduated.example: The country uses a graduated scale of income tax.  该国采用分级的所得税税率。

ranked.phrase_cn: 按等级排列的学校名单
ranked.example: Players are seeded from a ranked list of results.  选手按成绩排名名单来定种子位。

hobble.example: Poor infrastructure continues to hobble economic growth in the whole region.  基础设施薄弱继续阻碍整个地区的经济增长。

thrilling.cn: 激动人心的，令人兴奋的
thrilling.example: The last ten minutes of the game were absolutely thrilling.  比赛最后十分钟实在令人兴奋。

chasten.example: The public failure chastened him more than any lecture.  这次公开失败比任何说教都更让他收敛。

given.example: For a given temperature the reaction rate stays constant.  在特定温度下反应速率保持不变。

speculative.example: Much of the early chapter is frankly speculative.  开头一章的内容很大程度上属于推测。

induction.example: Science relies on induction from many careful observations.  科学依赖对大量细致观察的归纳。

inference.example: That conclusion is an inference, not a documented fact.  那个结论是推断，而非有据的事实。

idiosyncrasy.example: Writing all his notes in green ink was a harmless idiosyncrasy.  用绿墨水写下所有笔记是他一个无害的怪癖。

crotchet.example: Refusing to travel on Fridays was one of his crotchets.  拒绝在周五出行是他的怪癖之一。

eccentricity.example: The old professor's eccentricity delighted rather than annoyed students.  这位老教授的古怪让学生喜欢而非厌烦。

individualism.example: The painter's individualism set her apart from every contemporary.  这位画家的独特作风让她与所有同代人不同。

oddity.example: One oddity of the house is its doorless kitchen.  这房子的一个怪处是厨房没有门。

peculiarity.example: One peculiarity of the local dialect is its heavy use of double negatives.  这种当地方言的一个特点是大量使用双重否定。

quirk.example: Talking to his plants was just another harmless quirk.  跟植物说话只是他另一个无害的小怪癖。

singularity.example: Critics noted the singularity of her narrative voice.  评论家注意到她叙述声音的独特。

unused.example: Two unused machines sat rusting behind the workshop.  两台闲置的机器在车间后面锈着。

loaf.example: The boys loafed by the river instead of working.  这些男孩没干活，在河边闲混。

employed.example: Nearly every graduate was employed within six months.  几乎每位毕业生半年内都找到了工作。

functioning.example: Only one functioning elevator served the entire building.  整栋楼只有一台电梯还在运转。

working.example: We finally found a working phone in the lobby.  我们终于在大厅找到一部能用的电话。

illbred.example: Interrupting an elder in that manner struck everyone as illbred.  那样打断长辈说话让所有人觉得没有教养。

unmannerly.example: His unmannerly interruptions annoyed everyone at the meeting.  他无礼的插话让会上所有人不快。

continuing.example: The dispute remains a continuing source of tension.  这场纠纷仍是持续的紧张来源。

impunity.example: For years the smugglers operated with almost complete impunity.  多年来，走私者几乎完全不受处罚地活动。

exemption.example: Students may apply for an exemption from the fee.  学生可以申请免缴这笔费用。

motive.example: Police could find no obvious motive for the theft.  警方找不到这起盗窃的明显动机。

yeast.example: Cheap printing became the yeast of political change.  廉价印刷成了政治变革的催化剂。

contravention.example: The dumping was a clear contravention of local law.  这次倾倒明显违反了当地法律。

transgression.example: He apologized publicly for that youthful transgression.  他为年轻时的那次违规公开道歉。

rationalize.example: She rationalized the purchase as an urgent necessity.  她把这次购买说成迫切必需，为自己找借口。

rebound.example: Sales rebounded sharply in the final three months.  销售在最后三个月大幅回升。

lance.example: The doctor lanced the infected boil and drained it very carefully.  医生刺破感染的脓肿，并十分小心地把它排空。

gore.example: The farmer was gored by his own bull last spring.  这位农夫去年春天被自家的公牛顶伤。

harpoon.example: The crew harpooned the whale from a small boat.  船员们从小艇上用鱼叉刺中了那头鲸。

jab.example: The nurse jabbed the needle in before I could look.  我还没来得及看，护士就把针刺了进去。

stab.example: He stabbed the map with his finger to show the place.  他用手指戳着地图指出那个地方。

empowerment.example: The reform aimed at real empowerment of village committees.  这项改革旨在真正赋权给村委会。

custody.example: The suspect remained in custody until the hearing.  嫌疑人一直被拘押至听证会。

imprisonment.example: He faced ten years of imprisonment for the fraud.  他因诈骗面临十年监禁。

lionize.example: The media began to lionize the young author almost overnight.  媒体几乎一夜之间开始狂热吹捧这位年轻作家。

comical.example: The dog wore a comical hat all afternoon.  这只狗整个下午都戴着一顶滑稽的帽子。

derisive.example: A derisive shout came from the back of the hall.  大厅后面传来一声嘲笑的叫喊。

derisory.cn: 荒唐可笑的；微不足道的
derisory.example: The company made a derisory offer of two percent.  公司提出了少得可笑的百分之二涨幅。

risible.example: His defense of the policy was frankly risible.  他为该政策的辩护说实话相当可笑。

astral.example: An astral light hung above the quiet desert.  一片星光悬在寂静的沙漠上空。

enticing.example: The bakery sent an enticing smell down the whole street.  面包店让整条街都飘着诱人的香味。

inviting.example: The cool lake looked especially inviting that afternoon.  那天下午凉爽的湖水看着格外诱人。

madman.example: He shouted at the traffic like a complete madman.  他对着车流大喊，像个十足的疯子。

overconfident.example: The team became overconfident and lost the second match.  球队变得过于自信，输掉了第二场比赛。

importance.example: Nobody grasped the importance of that letter at first.  起初没人明白那封信的重要性。

momentousness.example: Few present understood the momentousness of that quiet vote.  在场者少有人明白那次平静投票的重大。

weightiness.example: The judge stressed the weightiness of the evidence involved.  法官强调了所涉证据的重要性。

insignificance.example: Beside that discovery his earlier work sank into insignificance.  与那项发现相比，他早期的工作显得微不足道。

littleness.example: The vast sky reminded him of his own littleness.  广阔的天空让他想到自己的渺小。

puniness.example: The puniness of the budget doomed the project early.  预算的微薄让项目早早注定失败。

slightness.example: The slightness of the difference surprised the researchers.  差异之微小让研究者们意外。

smallness.example: Visitors always comment on the smallness of the chapel.  来访者总会说起这座小教堂的窄小。

malignant.example: A malignant rumor about the coach spread through the school within a single afternoon.  一则关于教练的恶毒谣言一个下午就在学校里传开了。

finagle.example: He somehow finagled a seat at the head table.  他不知怎么耍手段弄到了主桌的座位。

mastermind.example: Two former employees masterminded the elaborate bank robbery.  两名前员工策划了这起精心设计的银行劫案。

wangle.example: She wangled two days off in the busiest week.  她在最忙的一周里设法弄到两天假。

mishandle.example: Officials badly mishandled the response to the flood.  官员们对洪水的应对处理得极糟。

muff.example: The nervous fielder managed to muff an easy catch in the ninth inning.  这名紧张的外野手在第九局漏接了一个容易的球。

marginal.example: The committee dismissed the objection as marginal and moved on to weightier matters.  委员会认为这项反对无关紧要，转而讨论更重要的事情。

milieu.example: She never felt comfortable in the social milieu of her husband's wealthy family.  她在丈夫富有家族的社交环境中从未感到自在。

ambient.example: The cafe's ambient lighting made the whole room feel warm and inviting.  咖啡馆的环境灯光让整个房间显得温馨宜人。

context.example: You cannot judge her remark without knowing the context in which it appeared.  不了解这句话出现的语境，你无法评判它。

environment.example: Children thrive in an environment where they feel both safe and respected.  孩子在既安全又受尊重的环境中才能成长得好。

setting.example: The novel's setting is a small fishing village on the Irish coast.  这部小说的背景是爱尔兰海岸的一个小渔村。

surroundings.example: The cat spent an hour cautiously exploring its new surroundings.  猫花了一小时小心地探索新环境。

terrain.example: The rescue team struggled across rocky terrain to reach the injured hiker.  救援队艰难穿越岩石地形去救受伤的徒步者。

monopolize.example: One guest managed to monopolize the conversation for the entire length of dinner.  一位客人在整个晚餐期间独占了谈话。

sew up.example: The company sewed up the contract before its rivals could even bid.  公司在对手投标前就敲定了合同。

nirvana.example: For her, a quiet beach at sunset was pure nirvana.  对她来说，日落时安静的海滩就是极乐世界。

empyrean.example: The poet imagined his soul rising into the empyrean far above the clouds.  诗人想象自己的灵魂升入云端之上的最高天。

fantasyland.example: Anyone expecting instant profits is living in fantasyland, the analyst warned.  分析师警告，指望立刻获利的人都生活在幻想中。

heaven.example: After a week of rain, this sunshine feels like heaven to me.  下了一周雨后，这阳光对我如同天堂。

lotusland.example: Tourists treat the island as a lotusland where nobody ever has to work.  游客把这座岛当成无需劳作的安乐乡。

utopia.example: No political system has ever produced the utopia its founders promised.  没有政治制度实现过其创立者承诺的乌托邦。

hell.example: The long march through the desert was sheer hell for the soldiers.  穿越沙漠的长途行军对士兵而言简直是地狱。

inferno.cn: 地狱般的地方；熊熊大火
inferno.example: Firefighters could not enter the burning warehouse, now a roaring inferno.  消防员无法进入这座已成火海的仓库。

nostalgia.example: A wave of nostalgia swept over her when she heard the old song.  听到那首老歌时，一阵怀旧之情涌上她的心头。

reminiscence.example: His reminiscences of wartime London filled three thick notebooks.  他对战时伦敦的回忆写满了三本厚笔记。

oblivion.example: Once famous, the singer slipped quietly into oblivion after the war.  这位歌手曾红极一时，战后却悄然被人遗忘。

anonymity.example: The donor insisted on complete anonymity when giving the museum his collection.  捐赠者把藏品赠给博物馆时坚持完全匿名。

newcomer.example: As a newcomer to the company, she asked plenty of sensible questions.  作为公司新人，她提了很多合理的问题。

rook.example: The sergeant had little patience with a rook who could not march.  中士对不会行军的新兵没什么耐心。

nullification.example: The nullification of the treaty left both governments without any legal framework.  条约的废除使两国政府失去了任何法律框架。

abolishment.example: The abolishment of the old tax rules took effect last January.  旧税法的废除于去年一月生效。

abrogation.example: Critics condemned the abrogation of workers' rights under the new law.  批评者谴责新法废除了工人的权利。

annulment.example: She sought an annulment of the marriage after only two months.  她仅两个月后就申请宣告婚姻无效。

cancellation.example: Heavy snow forced the cancellation of every afternoon flight.  大雪迫使下午所有航班取消。

invalidation.example: The court ordered the invalidation of all ballots signed in pencil.  法院裁定所有用铅笔签署的选票无效。

rescindment.example: Lawyers argued for the rescindment of the disputed regulation.  律师主张撤销这项有争议的法规。

voiding.example: Opening the case results in the voiding of your warranty.  打开机壳会导致保修失效。

legislation.example: Congress passed sweeping legislation to protect coastal wetlands.  国会通过了保护沿海湿地的重大立法。

oaf.example: Some clumsy oaf knocked over the display and walked away without apologizing.  某个笨手笨脚的蠢人撞倒了展台，一句道歉也没有就走了。

dope.example: Only a dope would leave his passport in a taxi.  只有蠢人才会把护照忘在出租车里。

dumbhead.example: Stop acting like a dumbhead and read the instructions carefully.  别像个笨蛋，仔细读一下说明。

imbecile.example: Any imbecile could see that the old bridge was unsafe.  任何蠢人都能看出这座旧桥不安全。

brain.example: She was the brains behind the company's most profitable product.  她是公司最赚钱产品背后的智囊。

law-abiding.example: Most law-abiding citizens never see the inside of a courtroom.  大多数守法公民从未进过法庭。

baseline.example: Doctors recorded a baseline measurement before the treatment began.  医生在治疗开始前记录了基准数据。

ordeal.example: Waiting for the test results was an ordeal she would never forget.  等待检测结果是她永远不会忘记的一场煎熬。

calvary.example: Her long illness became a calvary that lasted almost ten years.  她的久病成了一场近十年的苦难。

crucible.example: The campaign was a crucible that tested every young officer's nerve.  这场战役是考验每位年轻军官胆量的严峻磨炼。

gauntlet.example: New employees must run the gauntlet of three tough interviews.  新员工必须经受三轮艰难面试的考验。

enjoyment.example: He reads old detective novels purely for his own enjoyment.  他读旧侦探小说纯粹为了自己的乐趣。

ostensive.example: Teachers often use ostensive gestures when explaining words to small children.  老师给幼儿讲词时常用明示的手势。

aftereffect.example: Dizziness is a common aftereffect of this medication.  头晕是这种药常见的后遗反应。

demoded.example: His demoded suit drew smiles from the younger guests.  他过时的西装引来年轻客人的笑意。

override.example: Congress voted to override the veto and pass the spending bill.  国会投票推翻否决，通过了该支出法案。

pass over.example: The committee passed over three senior staff and promoted a newcomer.  委员会跳过三名资深员工，提拔了一位新人。

outrank.example: A captain outranks a lieutenant in every branch of the service.  在各军种中上尉级别都高于中尉。

outshine.example: The young violinist outshone every other performer at the festival.  这位年轻小提琴手让音乐节上其他表演者相形失色。

outstrip.example: Demand for the vaccine quickly outstripped the factory's supply.  疫苗需求很快超过了工厂的供应。

overbalance.cn: 重要性超过；使失去平衡
overbalance.example: The costs of the plan overbalance any short-term gains.  该计划的成本超过了任何短期收益。

overweigh.example: The advantages of the merger overweigh the risks involved.  合并的好处超过了其中的风险。

fall behind.example: He fell behind the rest of the class after missing two weeks.  缺课两周后他落后于全班。

overwrought.example: The overwrought father paced the hospital corridor for hours.  那位极度不安的父亲在医院走廊来回踱步了几个小时。
overwrought.cn: 十分激动的，不安的；过分华丽的

heated.example: A heated debate broke out over the proposed budget cuts.  就削减预算的提议爆发了激烈争论。

hectic.example: December is always hectic for everyone working in retail.  对零售业者来说十二月总是忙乱不堪。

hyperactive.example: The teacher struggled to calm a hyperactive class before the test.  老师考试前费力让过度活跃的班级安静下来。

overactive.example: His overactive imagination turned every shadow into a burglar.  他过度活跃的想象把每个影子都变成小偷。

bedizened.cn: 俗丽装饰的，过分打扮的
bedizened.example: She appeared bedizened with cheap beads and bright ribbons.  她浑身俗丽地缀着廉价珠子和鲜艳丝带。

gingerbreaded.example: The gingerbreaded old house was covered with fussy wooden trim.  这座花哨的老房子布满繁琐的木饰。

overdecorated.example: The overdecorated ballroom felt more tiring than elegant.  装饰过度的舞厅让人觉得累而不是雅。

colloquy.example: The two ministers held a long colloquy behind closed doors.  两位部长闭门进行了长时间会谈。

conference.example: The union leaders requested a conference with the factory owners.  工会领袖要求与厂主会谈。

parley.example: The two generals agreed to parley before dawn.  两位将军同意在黎明前谈判。

palpitation.example: The patient complained of palpitations whenever she climbed the stairs quickly.  病人抱怨每次快速上楼就会心跳加剧。

beating.example: She could hear the frantic beating of her own heart.  她能听见自己心脏的狂跳。

pulse.example: The nurse felt his pulse and frowned slightly.  护士摸了他的脉，微微皱眉。

throb.example: A steady throb of pain ran through his injured knee.  一阵持续的搏动性疼痛穿过他受伤的膝盖。

panacea.example: Technology is useful, but it is no panacea for deep social problems.  技术有用，但它不是解决深层社会问题的万灵药。

catholicon.example: Free trade was hailed as a catholicon for every economic ill.  自由贸易被誉为治百病的万灵药。

cure-all.example: Technology is not a cure-all for problems rooted in politics.  技术不是解决政治根源问题的万能药。

elixir.example: Alchemists spent lifetimes searching for an elixir of eternal youth.  炼金术士毕生寻找永葆青春的灵药。

nostrum.example: Voters grew tired of stale nostrums offered every election year.  选民厌倦了每逢选举年推出的陈旧灵丹妙药。

attribute.example: Patience is the most valuable attribute in a good teacher.  耐心是好老师最宝贵的特质。

character.example: Narrow streets give the old town its distinctive character.  狭窄的街道赋予老城独特的特色。

differentia.example: Logicians ask what differentia separates one species from another.  逻辑学家追问什么种差区分了两个物种。

fingerprint.example: Every volcano leaves a chemical fingerprint in the ice layers.  每座火山都在冰层中留下化学特征。

particularity.example: The essay ignores the particularity of each local tradition.  这篇文章忽视了各地传统的独特之处。

trait.example: Curiosity is a trait shared by nearly all great scientists.  好奇心是几乎所有伟大科学家共有的特征。

pedagogical.example: The new textbook reflects modern pedagogical methods and lively examples.  这本新教材体现了现代教学方法和生动的例子。

preceptorial.example: The college relies on small preceptorial groups rather than large lectures.  这所学院靠小型导师小组而非大课。

pupillary.example: The old statutes still describe pupillary duties in Latin.  古老章程仍用拉丁文描述学生的职责。

peel.example: He peeled off his wet coat and hung it near the fire.  他脱下湿外套，挂在火边。

imperceptive.example: Only an imperceptive critic would miss the irony in her novel.  只有不敏锐的评论者才会错过她小说中的讽刺。

perilous.example: The refugees made a perilous crossing in a small wooden boat.  难民们乘一条小木船进行了危险的横渡。

dangerous.example: Driving on that icy mountain road is extremely dangerous at night.  夜间在那条结冰山路上开车极其危险。

hazardous.example: Workers must wear masks when handling hazardous chemicals.  处理有害化学品时工人必须戴口罩。

jeopardizing.example: The gas leak was jeopardizing the safety of everyone inside.  煤气泄漏正危及楼内所有人的安全。

risky.example: Starting a restaurant during a recession seemed far too risky.  在经济衰退期开餐馆看来太冒险了。

venturesome.example: The venturesome sailor crossed the Atlantic in a tiny boat.  这位大胆的水手用小船横渡了大西洋。

perquisite.example: A company car was one perquisite of his new position.  一辆公司用车是他新职位的一项额外好处。

cumshaw.example: The dock workers expected a cumshaw for loading the crates quickly.  码头工人期待因快速装箱得到赏钱。

dividend.example: Learning a second language paid an unexpected dividend in her career.  学第二语言给她的职业带来意外收益。

donative.example: The emperor's donative to the soldiers kept the army loyal.  皇帝给士兵的赏赐使军队保持忠诚。

gratuity.example: A fifteen percent gratuity is already included in your bill.  百分之十五的小费已包含在账单中。

gravy.example: Any tips beyond his salary were simply gravy for him.  超出工资的小费对他纯属额外之财。

lagniappe.example: The baker added a free roll as a lagniappe for regulars.  面包师给老顾客额外赠送一个免费面包。

perk.example: Free parking was the best perk of her new job.  免费停车是她新工作最好的福利。

ratty.example: He gets ratty whenever he has not had enough sleep.  他睡不够就变得脾气很坏。

colonist.example: The first colonists built rough shelters near the river mouth.  最早的殖民者在河口附近搭了简陋住所。

colonizer.example: The island's laws still reflect the habits of its colonizers.  该岛法律仍反映其殖民者的习惯。

homesteader.example: Homesteaders plowed the dry plains hoping for a good harvest.  开拓农户耕作干旱的平原，盼望丰收。

settler.example: Settlers cleared the forest and planted corn the first spring.  定居者伐林，在第一个春天种上玉米。

innovate.example: Small firms must innovate quickly or lose their customers.  小公司必须快速创新，否则会失去客户。

shut.example: Please shut the windows before the storm arrives tonight.  今晚暴风雨来之前请关好窗户。

phase out.example: The factory will phase out diesel engines over five years.  工厂将在五年内逐步淘汰柴油发动机。

godly.example: He was raised in a quiet, godly household near the river.  他在河边一个安静虔诚的家庭长大。

sainted.example: Villagers still speak of the sainted doctor who never charged the poor.  村民仍谈起那位从不向穷人收费的圣洁医生。

saintly.example: Her saintly patience with difficult patients impressed the whole ward.  她对难缠病人的圣人般耐心让整个病房折服。

antireligious.example: The regime published antireligious pamphlets in every provincial town.  该政权在各省城印发反宗教小册子。

godless.example: Preachers denounced the city as a godless place of pleasure.  传道者谴责这座城市是不信神的享乐之地。

irreligious.cn: 不信教的，无宗教信仰的
irreligious.example: Though irreligious himself, he respected his wife's Sunday habits.  他自己不信教，却尊重妻子周日的习惯。

ungodly.example: The old preacher warned his flock against ungodly amusements.  老传道人告诫信众远离不敬神的娱乐。

unholy.example: Critics called the deal an unholy alliance of money and power.  批评者称这笔交易是金钱与权力的邪恶联盟。

joker.cn: 隐蔽的陷阱条款；爱开玩笑者
joker.example: A joker buried in the lease let the landlord raise rents.  租约中隐藏的陷阱条款让房东可以涨租。

coolheaded.example: The coolheaded pilot landed the damaged plane without panic.  冷静的飞行员毫不慌乱地降落了受损飞机。

possessed.example: She played the final movement like someone possessed by the music.  她演奏末乐章时像被音乐附身一般狂热。

elfish.example: The boy gave an elfish grin and darted behind the curtain.  男孩顽皮一笑，窜到窗帘后面。

fay.example: Her fay manner made the children believe in fairies again.  她精灵般的举止让孩子们重新相信仙子。

rollicking.example: They spent a rollicking evening singing old songs together.  他们一起唱老歌，度过了一个欢闹的夜晚。

sportive.example: Sportive dolphins followed the boat for almost an hour.  嬉戏的海豚跟着船游了将近一小时。

baseborn.example: The play mocks nobles who despise every baseborn neighbor.  这部剧讽刺瞧不起出身卑微邻人的贵族。

lowborn.example: Despite his lowborn origins, he rose to command the fleet.  尽管出身低微，他仍升任舰队指挥。

lumpen.example: The novel portrays the lumpen poor of the industrial suburbs.  这部小说描写工业郊区的下层穷人。

prole.example: In the novel, every prole works twelve hours for little pay.  小说中每个无产者工作十二小时却拿不到多少钱。

proletarian.example: The poet wrote proletarian verse about miners and dockhands.  这位诗人写关于矿工和码头工的无产阶级诗歌。

silken.example: She wore a silken robe that shimmered in the lamplight.  她穿着一件在灯光下闪亮的丝质长袍。

poach.example: He likes to poach an egg for breakfast every Sunday morning.  他喜欢每个周日早上水煮一个蛋当早餐。

parboil.example: Parboil the carrots for five minutes before roasting them.  烤之前先把胡萝卜焯水五分钟。

simmer.example: Let the soup simmer for twenty minutes before adding salt.  加盐前让汤小火煮二十分钟。

pointer.example: The coach gave the new players a few useful pointers before the game.  赛前教练给新球员提了几条有用的建议。

advice.example: Her advice about choosing a career proved surprisingly useful.  她关于择业的建议出乎意料地有用。

recommendation.example: The committee's recommendation was to postpone the project until spring.  委员会的建议是把项目推迟到春天。

earthy.example: Her earthy advice about money helped the young couple enormously.  她关于钱的务实建议对这对年轻夫妇帮助极大。

matter-of-fact.example: He described the accident in a calm, matter-of-fact voice.  他用平静务实的语调描述了事故。

practical.example: We need a practical plan, not another beautiful theory.  我们需要切实可行的计划，而不是又一个漂亮理论。

unrealistic.example: Their deadline was unrealistic given how little funding remained.  考虑到资金所剩不多，他们的截止期不切实际。

forethink.example: A good commander forethinks every move before the battle begins.  好的指挥官在开战前就预想好每一步。

precogitate.example: The thieves had clearly precogitated the escape route in detail.  窃贼显然事先详细谋划了逃跑路线。

prerequisite.example: Basic statistics is a prerequisite for admission to the graduate program.  基础统计学是进入该研究生项目的先决条件。

must.example: A warm coat is a must if you visit Chicago.  去芝加哥的话厚外套是必备的。

precondition.example: A ceasefire was the precondition for any serious negotiation.  停火是任何认真谈判的前提。

sine qua non.cn: 必要条件，必不可少之物
sine qua non.example: Trust is the sine qua non of any lasting partnership.  信任是任何长久合作必不可少的条件。

prerogative.example: Granting pardons remains the prerogative of the president alone.  赦免权仍然是总统独有的特权。

appanage.example: A private carriage was once the appanage of every duke.  私人马车曾是每位公爵应得的特权。

birthright.example: Free speech is the birthright of every person in this country.  言论自由是这个国家每个人生来的权利。

entitlement.example: Veterans lost several entitlements when the budget was cut.  预算削减时退伍军人失去了几项应得权益。

privilege.example: Members enjoy the privilege of borrowing rare books.  会员享有借阅珍本书的特权。

announce.example: The mayor will announce her decision at tomorrow's press conference.  市长将在明天的记者会上宣布决定。

publish.example: The team plans to publish its results in a major journal.  团队计划在一份重要期刊上发表结果。

proprietary.example: The company refuses to share its proprietary software with outside developers.  这家公司拒绝向外部开发者提供其私有软件。

rampant.example: Rampant inflation wiped out the savings of ordinary families that year.  那一年猖獗的通货膨胀吞掉了普通家庭的储蓄。

weedy.example: The weedy lot behind the school had not been mowed all summer.  学校后面那块杂草丛生的空地整夏未修剪。

abandoned.example: The dancers moved with an abandoned energy that thrilled the crowd.  舞者以放纵的活力舞动，令观众兴奋。

runaway.example: Runaway costs forced the city to cancel the new stadium.  失控的成本迫使该市取消新体育场。

unbounded.example: The children greeted the snow with unbounded delight.  孩子们以无限的喜悦迎接这场雪。

unbridled.example: His unbridled spending soon emptied the family savings.  他毫无节制的花钱很快耗尽了家里的储蓄。

unchecked.cn: 未受制止的，任其发展的
unchecked.example: Left unchecked, the vines will cover the entire wall.  若不加制止，藤蔓会覆盖整面墙。

uncontrolled.example: Uncontrolled logging has destroyed much of the coastal forest.  不受控制的伐木毁掉了大片沿海森林。

unhampered.example: Unhampered by traffic, the ambulance reached the hospital in minutes.  救护车未受交通阻碍，几分钟就到了医院。

unhindered.example: Reporters demanded unhindered access to the disaster site.  记者要求不受阻碍地进入灾区。

bridled.example: His bridled temper showed only in the tightness of his voice.  他受抑制的怒气只表现在声音的紧绷上。

checked.example: With spending checked, the department finally balanced its budget.  开支得到控制后，该部门终于收支平衡。

controlled.example: Prices stayed low under a tightly controlled market.  在严格管控的市场中价格保持低位。

curbed.example: Curbed by strict rules, the students rarely spoke in class.  受严格规定约束，学生在课上很少发言。
