governed.example: Every transaction here is governed by federal banking rules.  这里每笔交易都受联邦银行规则管辖。

hampered.example: The search was hampered by darkness and heavy rain.  搜寻受到黑暗和大雨的阻碍。

hindered.example: Repairs were hindered by a shortage of skilled workers.  维修因缺乏熟练工人而受阻。

stimulative.cn: 有激励作用的，令人振奋的
stimulative.example: Cold morning air had a stimulative effect on the runners.  清冷的晨风对跑者有振奋作用。

deadening.cn: 令人麻木的，使人乏味的
deadening.example: Years of deadening office work had dulled his curiosity.  多年令人麻木的办公室工作磨钝了他的好奇心。

wearying.example: The wearying meeting dragged on for almost four hours.  这场令人疲倦的会议持续了近四小时。

remains.example: Archaeologists found the remains of a Roman bathhouse here.  考古学家在此发现了一座罗马浴场的遗迹。

replenish.example: We must replenish the water tanks before crossing the desert.  穿越沙漠前我们必须把水箱补满。

refill.example: The waiter refilled our cups without being asked.  服务员没等我们要求就把杯子添满了。

reload.example: The hunter reloaded his rifle before moving up the ridge.  猎人在上山脊前重新装填了步枪。

originate.example: She originated a teaching method now used across the country.  她首创了一种如今全国通用的教学法。

leftover.example: We ate leftover pizza for breakfast the next morning.  第二天早上我们吃剩下的比萨当早餐。

remaining.example: Spend the remaining money on books rather than snacks.  把剩下的钱花在书上而不是零食上。

vestigial.example: Whales retain vestigial hip bones from their walking ancestors.  鲸保留着来自行走祖先的退化髋骨。

restitution.example: The court ordered the company to make full restitution to the injured workers.  法院命令公司向受伤工人做出全额赔偿。

recoupment.example: The lawsuit sought recoupment of every dollar the firm lost.  诉讼要求补偿公司损失的每一美元。

retentive.example: A retentive memory helped her recite the entire poem after one reading.  过人的记忆力使她读一遍就能背出整首诗。

absentminded.example: My absentminded uncle left his keys in the front door.  我心不在焉的叔叔把钥匙忘在前门上。

forgetful.example: Grandmother has become forgetful about names but still remembers songs.  奶奶记不住名字了，却仍记得歌。

reacquire.example: The museum hoped to reacquire the painting sold in 1930.  博物馆希望重新买回1930年售出的那幅画。

recapture.example: The team recaptured the lead in the final ten minutes.  球队在最后十分钟重新夺回领先。

re-collect.example: She paused to re-collect her thoughts before answering the question.  她停下重新理清思绪，然后回答问题。

regain.example: It took him months to regain his strength after surgery.  手术后他花了几个月才恢复体力。

repossess.example: The bank moved to repossess the house after six missed payments.  六次未还款后银行着手收回房屋。

retake.example: The commander ordered his soldiers to retake the bridge before dawn.  指挥官命令士兵在黎明前夺回那座桥。

mislay.example: I seem to have mislaid my passport somewhere in the house.  我好像把护照放在家里某处找不到了。

misplace.example: He misplaced the tickets and had to buy new ones.  他把票放错了地方，只好重新买。

reverberate.example: The thunder reverberated through the narrow mountain valley for several minutes.  雷声在狭窄的山谷中回荡了好几分钟。

reecho.example: The gunshot reechoed among the narrow canyon walls.  枪声在狭窄的峡谷壁间回响。

fustian.example: His speech was pure fustian, loud but entirely without substance.  他的演讲纯属浮夸，声大而毫无实质。

gaseous.example: Reporters dismissed the minister's gaseous promises about future reform.  记者不理会部长关于改革的空洞承诺。

gassy.cn: 空话连篇的，夸夸其谈的
gassy.example: The gassy editorial took two pages to say nothing.  这篇空话连篇的社论用两页什么也没说。

oratorical.example: Lincoln's oratorical power still impresses readers of his speeches.  林肯的演说力量至今仍打动读者。

purple.example: Editors cut the purple passages from his travel essays.  编辑删掉了他游记中辞藻过度华丽的段落。

rigmarole.example: His explanation was a long rigmarole that nobody could follow.  他的解释是一大段混乱无意义的话，没人听得懂。

iron-hearted.example: The iron-hearted landlord evicted the family in midwinter.  铁石心肠的房东在隆冬赶走了这家人。

ammunition.example: The soldiers carried enough ammunition for a three-day defense.  士兵携带了足够守三天的弹药。

armor.example: The knight's armor weighed nearly as much as he did.  骑士的盔甲几乎和他本人一样重。

protection.example: The thin tent offered little protection against the freezing wind.  薄帐篷几乎挡不住刺骨的寒风。

enshroud.example: Thick fog enshrouded the harbor by early evening.  傍晚时分浓雾笼罩了港口。

sectarianism.example: Sectarianism divided the small town for three generations.  宗派主义把这个小镇分裂了三代人。

dogmatism.example: Scientific progress suffers when dogmatism replaces careful argument.  当教条主义取代严谨论证，科学进步就受损。

illiberalism.example: The new censorship laws revealed the government's deepening illiberalism.  新审查法暴露了政府日益加深的不宽容。

intolerance.example: Intolerance of dissent slowly destroyed the club's friendly atmosphere.  对异议的不宽容慢慢毁掉了俱乐部的友好气氛。

narrow-mindedness.example: Their narrow-mindedness kept the village suspicious of every visitor.  他们的心胸狭窄使村子对每个来客都怀疑。

small-mindedness.example: Office politics revealed a surprising amount of small-mindedness.  办公室政治暴露出惊人的气量狭小。

broad-mindedness.example: Her broad-mindedness made her the natural mediator in disputes.  她的宽容大度使她自然成为纠纷的调解人。

liberalism.example: Nineteenth-century liberalism championed free trade and individual rights.  十九世纪自由主义倡导自由贸易和个人权利。

flickery.example: The flickery old projector made everyone's eyes ache.  闪烁不定的老放映机让大家眼睛发酸。

adventuresome.example: Adventuresome diners lined up to try the strange new dish.  爱冒险的食客排队尝这道奇怪新菜。

splutter.example: He spluttered with rage and could not finish a single sentence.  他气得语不成句，一句话也说不完。

nauseated.example: The smell of the fish market left her feeling nauseated.  鱼市的味道让她感到恶心。

qualmish.example: Rough seas soon made half the passengers qualmish.  颠簸的海面很快让一半乘客恶心。

queasy.example: Reading in the car always makes me feel queasy.  在车里看书总让我觉得恶心。

queerish.cn: 有点古怪的；略感不适的
queerish.example: He had a queerish look about him that morning.  那天早上他神色有点古怪。

sickish.cn: 有点恶心的，微感不适的
sickish.example: A sickish sweetness hung in the hot, closed room.  闷热封闭的房间里弥漫着令人恶心的甜味。

stereotype.example: The film challenges a cultural stereotype about immigrant families in the city.  这部电影挑战了关于城市移民家庭的一种刻板印象。

concept.example: Students must grasp the concept of gravity before doing the problems.  学生做题前必须掌握重力的概念。

conception.example: He had no conception of how hard the work would be.  他完全不了解这工作会有多难。

generality.example: The politician answered every question with comfortable generalities.  这位政客用轻松的笼统话回答每个问题。

notion.example: She rejected the old notion that girls dislike mathematics.  她否定女孩不喜欢数学的旧观念。

stigmatize.example: Such careless language stigmatizes the poor and deepens public prejudice.  这种粗率的说法给穷人贴上污名，加深公众偏见。

backup.example: The team kept a backup ready in case the goalie fell ill.  球队备好替补，以防守门员生病。

fill-in.example: She worked as a fill-in for the regular news anchor.  她给固定的新闻主播做临时替补。

replacement.example: The company hired a replacement within a week of her resignation.  她辞职一周内公司就找到了替代者。

stand-in.example: A stand-in performed the dangerous scenes for the lead actor.  一名替身为主演完成了危险场面。

bilious.example: The bilious old editor rejected nearly every manuscript he read.  这位脾气暴躁的老编辑几乎否掉所有读到的稿件。

ill-humored.cn: 脾气不好的，情绪恶劣的
ill-humored.example: He gave an ill-humored grunt and slammed the office door.  他不快地哼了一声，砰地关上办公室门。

ornery.example: Their ornery neighbor complained about the noise every single evening.  他们脾气坏的邻居每晚都抱怨噪音。

shot.example: Take a shot at the answer even if you are unsure.  即使不确定也猜一下答案。

surmount.example: She managed to surmount every obstacle placed in her path.  她设法克服了路上的每一个障碍。

overbear.example: The general's forces overbore the defenders within a single day.  将军的部队一天之内就压倒了守军。

overcome.example: She overcame her fear of water and learned to swim.  她克服了对水的恐惧，学会了游泳。

overmatch.example: The champion clearly overmatched every fighter in the tournament.  冠军明显胜过赛事中的每位拳手。

excel.example: He excels at mathematics but struggles with foreign languages.  他擅长数学，却学不好外语。

outclass.example: Their new engine outclasses everything else on the market.  他们的新发动机远胜市场上其他产品。

outmatch.example: The little company outmatched its larger rivals on service.  这家小公司在服务上胜过更大的对手。

overtop.example: The new tower overtops every building in the city center.  新塔高过市中心所有建筑。

surveillance.example: The suspect was kept under constant surveillance for several weeks.  嫌疑人被持续监控了数周。

supervision.example: Children use the pool only under adult supervision.  孩子只能在成人监督下使用泳池。

watch.example: Guards kept a careful watch on the warehouse all night.  警卫整夜仔细监视仓库。

domesticated.example: Dogs were domesticated thousands of years before horses were.  狗被驯化比马早数千年。

tamed.example: The tamed elephant carried tourists along the river path.  被驯服的大象沿河道驮着游客。

blank.example: He stared at the blank screen for nearly an hour.  他盯着空白屏幕近一个小时。

devoid.example: The moon's surface is completely devoid of running water.  月球表面完全没有流动的水。

ad interim.example: He served as ad interim director until a successor arrived.  他任临时主管，直到接任者到来。

thick-skinned.example: Anyone in advertising must be fairly thick-skinned about criticism.  做广告的人对批评必须相当脸皮厚。

thrill.example: A thrill of excitement ran through the crowd as the lights dimmed.  灯光暗下时，人群中掠过一阵兴奋的快感。

boot.example: The old man got a real boot out of teasing us.  老人逗我们时觉得非常开心。

frisson.example: A frisson of excitement ran through the waiting audience.  一阵兴奋的战栗掠过等待的观众。

jollies.example: Some people get their jollies from frightening other people.  有些人从惊吓别人中获得快感。

titillation.example: The tabloid offers gossip and titillation rather than real news.  这家小报提供的是八卦刺激而非真新闻。

wallop.example: That coffee packs a real wallop early in the morning.  那咖啡清早喝劲头十足。

titillate.example: The trailer was designed to titillate viewers without revealing anything.  预告片旨在撩拨观众而不透露任何情节。

timely.example: A timely warning from the coastguard saved the entire crew.  海岸警卫队及时的警告救了全体船员。

inopportune.example: Her question came at a most inopportune moment during dinner.  她的问题在晚餐时最不凑巧的时刻提出。

tycoon.example: The shipping tycoon donated an entire wing to the city museum.  那位航运大亨向市博物馆捐建了整整一翼。

baron.example: The railroad baron controlled every line west of the river.  这位铁路大亨控制了河西所有线路。

captain.example: The dinner honored several captains of industry from the region.  晚宴表彰了本地区几位工业巨头。

king.example: He became the undisputed king of the shipping business.  他成了航运业无可争议的大王。

lion.example: The old poet was still a lion in London society.  这位老诗人在伦敦社交界仍是名流。

prince.example: Bankers treated him as a prince of the financial world.  银行家把他视作金融界的巨子。

tyrant.example: The people finally rose up against the cruel tyrant in spring.  人民最终在春天起来反抗这个残暴的暴君。

dictator.example: The dictator ruled the small country for nearly thirty years.  这名独裁者统治这个小国近三十年。

oppressor.example: The people finally rose against their oppressor in the spring.  人民终于在春天起来反抗压迫者。

pharaoh.example: The pharaoh ordered thousands of workers to build his tomb.  法老命令数千工人建造他的陵墓。

strongman.example: The country was run by a strongman for two decades.  这个国家被一名铁腕统治者管了二十年。

umbrage.example: She took umbrage at his remark about her family's modest background.  他谈到她家境平凡，她对此十分不悦。

dudgeon.example: She left the meeting in high dudgeon without saying goodbye.  她怒气冲冲地离开会议，也没道别。

contentment.example: He found quiet contentment in tending his small garden.  他在照料小花园中找到宁静的满足。

gratification.example: Saving money offers less immediate gratification than spending it.  存钱带来的即时满足不如花钱。

consentaneous.cn: 一致同意的，全体赞同的
consentaneous.example: The board reached a consentaneous decision after brief discussion.  董事会经短暂讨论达成一致决定。

uncontested.example: Her reelection was uncontested because no rival filed papers.  她连任无人竞争，因为没有对手报名。

weather.example: The small company weathered the crisis without laying off anyone.  这家小公司度过了危机，没有裁掉任何人。

inconvincible.example: The old man remained inconvincible despite hours of patient argument.  尽管耐心争辩数小时，老人仍无法被说服。

willynilly.example: Books and papers lay willynilly across every chair in the study.  书和文件杂乱地堆在书房的每把椅子上。

tap.example: Agents tapped his phone for three months without a warrant.  特工无搜查令窃听他电话三个月。

wistful.example: He looked at the old photograph with a wistful little smile.  他望着那张旧照片，露出一丝惆怅的微笑。

nostalgic.example: Old photographs made her nostalgic for her childhood summers.  旧照片让她怀念童年的夏天。

scrounge.example: He managed to scrounge a meal from the neighbors again.  他又从邻居那儿讨到一顿饭。

blasé.example: After years of luxury travel he grew blasé about five-star hotels.  多年奢华旅行后，他对五星级酒店已兴趣索然。

anachronism.example: The sundial in the spaceship struck viewers as a glaring anachronism.  飞船里的日晷让观众觉得是明显的时代错误。
anachronism.cn: 不合时代的事物；时代错误

anthropogenic.example: Most scientists agree that anthropogenic emissions drive the current rise in global temperatures.  多数科学家认为人为排放推动了当前全球气温的上升。

anxiousness.example: A faint anxiousness crept over her as the interview time drew near.  面试时间临近时，一丝不安悄悄涌上她心头。

caused by human.example: Much of the reef damage caused by human activity could still be reversed.  人类活动造成的珊瑚礁破坏中，很大一部分仍可挽回。

circumlocution.example: His answer was buried in circumlocution, so nobody understood what he actually meant.  他的回答绕来绕去，没人明白他到底想说什么。

complementary.example: Their skills are complementary, which makes them an unusually effective research team.  他们的技能互补，因此成了一支异常高效的研究团队。

comprehension.example: The scale of the disaster was almost beyond human comprehension at first.  灾难的规模起初几乎超出了人类的理解。

concision.example: The editor praised the report for its concision and its total lack of jargon.  编辑称赞这份报告简洁，且完全没有行话。

condescending.example: She hated his condescending tone whenever she asked a simple technical question.  每次她问简单的技术问题，都讨厌他那种居高临下的语气。
condescending.cn: 摆出高人一等姿态的，居高临下的

conflagration.example: A minor border dispute soon escalated into a conflagration that engulfed the whole region.  一场小小的边界争端很快升级为吞没整个地区的战火。

diffuseness.example: The diffuseness of the essay made its central argument almost impossible to follow.  这篇文章过于散漫，中心论点几乎无法把握。

diffusion.example: The diffusion of new farming techniques across the valley took nearly two decades.  新耕作技术在山谷各地传播花了近二十年。

incomprehension.example: He stared at the equations with total incomprehension and quietly closed the textbook.  他一脸茫然地盯着方程式，悄悄合上了教科书。

long-windedness.example: The committee complained about the long-windedness of every report he submitted.  委员会抱怨他提交的每份报告都冗长啰嗦。

misapprehension.example: You are under a misapprehension if you think the deadline has been extended.  如果你以为截止日期延长了，那你是误解了。

miscalculation.example: A single miscalculation in the budget cost the department nearly a million dollars.  预算中的一处误算让该部门损失了近百万美元。

misconstruction.example: His careless wording was open to misconstruction by anyone reading it quickly.  他措辞随意，任何草草阅读的人都可能曲解。

misconstruing.example: Misconstruing her silence as agreement, he went ahead and signed the contract.  他把她的沉默误解为同意，就径自签了合同。

misimpression.example: The headline created a misimpression that the drug had already been approved.  这条标题造成了一种错误印象，好像该药已获批准。

misinterpretation.example: The vague instructions left plenty of room for misinterpretation by new employees.  含糊的说明给新员工留下了很大的误解空间。

misjudging.example: Misjudging the distance, the driver braked far too late and clipped the fence.  司机误判了距离，刹车太晚，刮到了栅栏。

misjudgment.example: Hiring him proved to be the most expensive misjudgment of her career.  雇用他被证明是她职业生涯中代价最高的一次误判。

misknowledge.example: Rumor and misknowledge spread faster online than any careful correction ever could.  谣言和错误认识在网上传播得比任何认真的更正都快。

misreading.example: Her whole argument rests on a misreading of the original survey data.  她的整个论点都建立在对原始调查数据的误读之上。

misstep.example: One misstep in the negotiations could undo three years of patient diplomacy.  谈判中一次失误就可能毁掉三年的耐心外交。

pithiness.example: Her essays are famous for their pithiness and never waste a single word.  她的散文以简洁有力著称，从不浪费一个字。

prepossessing.example: The young lawyer had a prepossessing smile that quickly won over the jury.  这位年轻律师有着讨人喜欢的笑容，很快赢得了陪审团的好感。

prolixity.example: The prolixity of his lecture made even the most patient students begin to yawn.  他讲座的冗长让最有耐心的学生也开始打哈欠。

sanctimonious.example: He lectured us in a sanctimonious tone about virtues he clearly did not practice.  他用假装虔诚的语气向我们大谈他自己显然并不践行的美德。

selfabasement.example: His constant selfabasement in meetings made colleagues uncomfortable rather than impressed by his modesty.  他在会上不断自我贬低，让同事们感到尴尬，而非佩服他的谦逊。

selfabsorbed.example: He was too selfabsorbed to notice that his friend had been crying all evening.  他太自我中心，没注意到朋友整晚都在哭。

selfdefeating.example: Cutting the research budget is a selfdefeating strategy that will harm future profits.  削减研究预算是一种适得其反的策略，会损害未来的利润。

selfperpetuating.example: Poverty and poor schooling form a selfperpetuating cycle that few families ever escape.  贫困与教育落后构成一种自我延续的循环，很少有家庭能够摆脱。

slipup.example: One tiny slipup in the calculation cost the company several thousand dollars last month.  计算中一个小小的差错上月让公司损失了数千美元。

succinctness.example: The editor praised the succinctness of the report, which conveyed everything in two pages.  编辑称赞这份报告的简洁，两页就把一切都讲清楚了。

terseness.example: The terseness of her reply suggested that she had no interest in further discussion.  她回答之简短表明她无意再谈下去。

thickskinned.example: Anyone entering politics must be thickskinned enough to ignore constant criticism from the press.  任何从政的人都必须脸皮够厚，能无视媒体不断的批评。
thickskinned.cn: 脸皮厚的，不易被批评伤害的

understanding.example: A thorough understanding of the rules is essential before you begin playing the game.  在开始玩这个游戏之前，对规则有透彻的理解是必不可少的。

uneasiness.example: A vague uneasiness settled over the crowd as the storm clouds gathered above them.  当暴风云在头顶聚集时，人群中弥漫着一种莫名的不安。

verbalism.example: His speech was full of empty verbalism and offered no concrete plan for reform.  他的演讲满是空洞的辞藻，没有提出任何具体的改革方案。

verboseness.example: The verboseness of the manual discouraged readers who wanted quick answers to simple questions.  这本手册的冗长让想快速找到简单答案的读者望而却步。

verbosity.example: Editors trimmed the verbosity from his draft and cut its length nearly in half.  编辑删去了他草稿中的累赘文字，篇幅几乎缩短了一半。

warfare.example: Modern warfare relies on drones and satellites far more than on massed infantry charges.  现代战争更多依赖无人机和卫星，而非大规模步兵冲锋。

wordage.example: Excessive wordage in the contract hid several crucial clauses from the hurried buyer.  合同中过多的字句让匆忙的买家忽略了几条关键条款。

wordiness.example: Good writing avoids wordiness and expresses each idea with as few words as possible.  好的文章避免啰唆，用尽可能少的字表达每个意思。

stumbling block.example: Cost remains the biggest stumbling block to wider adoption of the technology.  成本仍是该技术更广泛应用的最大障碍。

cut across.example: Support for the reform cut across every social class in the country.  对这项改革的支持跨越了该国的各个社会阶层。

proceed along.example: The negotiations proceeded along the lines both sides had agreed on.  谈判按双方商定的思路推进。
